text.body:
<1> oṃ tatsadbrahmaṇe namaḥ | bhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitā saṃskāraratnamālā | tatra prathamaṃ prakaraṇam | maṅgalācaraṇam | vātsalyātpitarau kapolayugulaṃ svasyā''gatau cumbituṃ dṛṣṭvā''kuñcitamāsyapadmamamalaṃ seṣatsmitaṃ satvaram | anyonyaṃ śivayostataḥ suvadane yukte abhūtāṃ tayoritthaṃ yena vinoditau sa bhagavānbālo gajāsyo'vatu || 1 || taṃ gajāsyaṃ stutaṃ devaiḥ praśāntaṃ vidyayā yutam | taṃtrayaṃtrāvṛtaṃ naumi tanvantaṃ jagatāṃ hitam || 2 || ṣaṭpatrapadmabandho'yam | vināyakaṃ sukaṇṭhakaṃ vidhīśaviṣṇuviṣṭutaṃ vināśitāmitāsuraṃ viṣāṇapāśapāṇikam | vipāṃsvibhāsyabhālakaṃ vibhākaraṃ paraṃ suraṃ viśāladaṇḍadantinaṃ vibhuṃ bhaje yaje sadā || 3 || aṣṭapatrapadmabandho'yam | namastasmai gaṇeśāya jñānavijñānadāyine | yasyānalāyate nāma vighnāraṇyavidāhane || 4 || vidyāmahāgaṇapatiṃ devaṃ vyāḍīśvaraṃ tathā | yogeśvarīṃ ca vāgdevīṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇau gurūn || 5 || satyāṣāḍhaṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ jātarūpaśiroruham | pitarau ca namaskṛtya mātṛdattaṃ tathaiva ca || 6 || sūtrabhāṣyaṃ ca vividhāḥ paddhatīḥ prekṣya ca smṛtīḥ | okopāhvena viduṣā gopīnāthena kautukāt || 7 || viśveśatuṣṭyai viduṣāṃ satāṃ saṃtoṣakāriṇī | saṃskāraratnamālākhyā paddhatiḥ pravitanyate || 8|| mahādevamaheśābhyāṃ paddhatyoḥ kṛtayoryataḥ | na vai mūlaṃ saṃgṛhītaṃ kartuṃ tasyāpi saṃgraham || 9 || kvacitkvacitkṛtāṃ tābhyāṃ sūtrasvārasyavarjitām | saṃtyajya paddhatiṃ tatrānyāṃ vai racayituṃ tathā || 10 || kvacitsūtre bhāṣyakṛtā vyākhyā naiva kṛtā yataḥ | vyākhyātumapi tatsūtramapi vyākhyāntaraṃ kvacit || 11 || sūtrasvarasataḥ kartuṃ kriyate'to mayodyamaḥ | mānyānmātsaryarahitānsadācārayutānbudhān || 12 || muhurmuhuḥ praṇamyāhaṃ prārthayāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ | atrānuktaṃ duruktaṃ vā matermāndyācchrutasya vā || yadbhavetpūraṇīyaṃ tadviśodhyaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 13 || saṃskārāḥ | atha saṃskārāḥ | tānāha gautamaḥ -- "garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīmantonnayanajātakarmanāmakaraṇānnaprāśanacaulopanayanāni, catvāri vedavratāni, snānaṃ, sahadharmacāriṇīsaṃyogaḥ, pañca mahāyajñāḥ, aṣṭakā pārvaṇaḥ śrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇī caitryāśvayujīti sapta pākayajñasaṃsthāḥ, agnyādheyamagnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau cāturmāsyānyāgrayaṇeṣṭirnirūḍhapaśubandhaḥ sautrāmaṇīti sapta haviryajñasaṃsthāḥ, agniṣṭomo'tyagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśī vājapeyo'tirātro'ptoryāma iti sapta somayajñasaṃsthāḥ, ityete catvāriṃśatsaṃskārā aṣṭāvātmaguṇā dayā sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntiranasūyā śaucamanāyāso māṅgalyamakārpaṇyamaspṛheti yasyaite catvāriṃśatsaṃskārā aṣṭāvātmaguṇāśca sa brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyamāpnoti" iti | snānaṃ samāvartanam | sahadharmacāriṇīsaṃyogo vivāhaḥ | pārvaṇaḥ pārvaṇasthālīpākaḥ | śrāddhaṃ māsikaśrāddhaṃ tasyaiva saṃsthātvāt | tacca śrāddhaprakaraṇe sādhayiṣyāmaḥ | śrāvaṇī paurṇamāsī tatra kartavyaṃ śravaṇākarma | āgrahāyaṇī mārgaśīrṣī tatra kartavyaṃ pratyavarohaṇam | caitrī tatra kartavyaḥ śūlagavaḥ | āśvayujyāśvinī paurṇamāsī tatra kartavyamāśvayujīkarmeti | āpannasya dveṣṭurapi rakṣaṇaṃ dayā | bāhya ābhyantare vā pareṇa duḥkha utpādite'pi tasminkopābhāvaḥ kṣamā | saiva kṣāntiḥ | guṇināṃ guṇānāviṣkaraṇamasūyā | etadbhinnā'nasūyā | ninditasaṃsargābhakṣyādiparihārapūrvakaṃ svadharmavyavasthānaṃ śaucam | śarīrapīḍāvahakṣudrakarmācaraṇamāyāsastadbhinno'nāyāsaḥ | apraśastakarmavivarjanapūrvakaṃ praśa stakarmācaraṇaṃ maṅgalaṃ tasya bhāvo māṅgalyam | adainyapūrvakaṃ satpātre bhaktyā śaktyā ca pratyahaṃ dānamakārpaṇyam | parakīyavastunyabhilāṣaḥ spṛhā tadbhinnā'spṛhā | sūtrakṛtā''śvayujyā avidhānāttatraupāsanahomaḥ saṃsthātvena grāhyaḥ | uktaṃ ca vaikhānasena -- "sthālīpāko'ṣṭakā amāśrāddhamaupāsanahāmaḥ śrāvaṇyāgrahāyaṇī caitrīti sapta pākayajñasaṃsthā vaiśvadevameke caitrīsthāne samāmananti" iti | pākayajñasaṃsthāḥ saptetyanvayaḥ | pākayajñasaṃsthā uddiśya saptatvaṃ vidhīyate | tacca saptatvaṃ caramapadalakṣaṇayā saptānyatamatvam | uddeśyavidheyabhāvasthale vidheyatāvacchedakarūpeṇa vidheyasyoddeśyatāvacchedakavyāpakatvabodho vyutpattisiddhaḥ | uddeśyatāvacchedakaṃ pākayajñasaṃsthātvam | vidheyatāvacchedakaṃ saptānyatamatvam | taccāṣṭakādibhedasaptakābhāvavattvam | tathā ca pākayajñasaṃsthāḥ saptānyatamā ityarthe siddha ādhikyavyavacchedasiddhiḥ | etena siddhyasiddhivyāghāto nirastaḥ | nyūnatvavyavacchedastu saptatvānvayādeva labhyate | baudhāyanena tu pākayajñasaṃsthānāmaparimitatvamapi pakṣa uktaṃ karmāntasūtre -- "aparimitā u haike bruvate yacca kiṃcānyatra vihārādbhūyate sarvāstāḥ pākayajñasaṃsthāḥ" iti | atraitadbhavasvāmibhāṣyam -- "aviśeṣeṇa yatkiṃcittretāgneranyatra hūyate sarvāstāḥ pākayajñasaṃsthāḥ" iti | etenāparimitatvaṃ darśitamiti | etanmate saptānyatamatvaṃ saptapadena na lakṣaṇīyam | aṅgirāḥ -- garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmanto balirevaca | balirviṣṇubaliḥ | jātakṛtyaṃ nāmakarma niṣkramo'nnāśanaṃ tathā | caulakarmopanayanaṃ tadvratānāṃ catuṣṭayam | snānodvāhau cā''grayaṇamaṣṭakāśca yathāyatham | śrāvaṇyamāśvayujyaṃ ca mārgaśīrṣyaṃ ca pārvaṇam | utsargaścāpyupākarma mahāyajñāśca nityakāḥ | nityā eva nityakāḥ | svārthe kapratyayaḥ | saṃskārā niyatā ete brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ | pañcaviṃśatisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtā ye dvijātayaḥ | te pavitrāśca yogyāḥ syuḥ śrāddhādiṣu suyantritāḥ" iti | tadvratānāmityatra prasiddhivācinā tacchabdena vedo grāhyaḥ | satyāṣāḍhena bhagavatā''cāryeṇa kāṇḍavratānāmuktatvādvedavratasthāne kāṇḍavratāni grāhyāṇi | tāni nava ṣaṭpañca catvāri vetyagre vakṣyate | (śrāvaṇyāṃ bhavaṃ karma śrāvaṇyam | āśvayujyāṃ bhavamāśvayujyam | mārgaśīrṣe bhavaṃ mārgaśīrṣyam | digāditvādyatpratyayaḥ |) śrāvaṇyāmāśvayujyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ krameṇa kartavyaṃ śravaṇākarmā''śvayujī pratyavarohaṇamiti tadarthaḥ | pārvaṇamityatra pārvaṇaśca pārvaṇaṃ cetyekaśeṣa ekavadbhāvaśca napuṃsakamanapuṃsakeneti sūtrāt | tena pārvaṇasthālīpākasyāpi saṃgrahaḥ | utsargo vedotsarjanam | śrāddhādiṣvityādiśabdādyajanādīnāṃ grahaṇam | atra brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ kṣattriyavaiśyayorupalakṣaṇam | "ataḥ paraṃ dvijātīnāṃ saṃskṛtirniyatocyate | saṃskārarahitā ye tu teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam" ityāśvalāyanena dvijātipadopādānāt | niyatā nityā | udāhṛtāṅgirovacane pañcaviṃśatirityuktistattadgṛhyoktasaṃskāropalakṣikā asti cātra smṛtiḥ -- "sve sve gṛhye yathā proktāstathā saṃskṛtayo'khilāḥ | kartavyā bhūtikāmena nānyathā siddhimṛcchati" iti | ato'smadgṛhye keṣāṃcitsaṃskārāṇāmanuktāvapi na doṣaḥ | saṃjñāviśeṣamapyāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "naimittikāḥ ṣoḍaśoktāḥ samudvāhāvasānakāḥ | saptaivā''grayaṇādyāśca saṃskārā vārṣikā matāḥ || māsikaṃ pārvaṇaṃ proktamaśaktānāṃ tu vārṣikam | mahāyajñāśca nityāḥ syuḥ saṃdhyāvaccāgnihotravat" iti | aṅgirovacanopāttā garbhādhānaprabhṛtayaḥ samudvāhāvasānakāḥ ṣoḍaśa naimittikā ityarthaḥ | āgrayaṇādyāḥ pārvaṇaśrāddhavyatiriktāḥ sapta saṃskārā vārṣikā matāḥ | pārvaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ māsi kartavyam | aśaktānāṃ vārṣikam | aśaktairvarṣe yasyāṃ kasyāṃcidamāyāṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ | etasmādeva vacanānmāsikaṃ pārvaṇaṃ proktamityatra pratidarśaṃ kartavyatā'vagatā bhavati | spaṣṭametaduktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "pratidarśaṃ pārvaṇaṃ syādaśaktau vārṣikaṃ bhavet" iti | pārvaṇasthālīpākastu parvaṇi parvaṇyeva | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "brahmakṣattriyaviṭśūdrā varṇāstvādyāstrayo dvijāḥ | niṣekādiśmaśānāntāsteṣāṃ vai mantrataḥ kriyāḥ" iti | niṣeko garbhādhānam | śmaśānaśabdenāntyakarma lakṣyate | teṣāṃ dvijānām | teṣāṃ maṃtrata ityukteḥ śūdrasyāmantrakā iti gamyate | saṃskārānuktvā''ha yamaḥ -- "śūdro'pyevaṃvidhaḥ kāryo vinā mantreṇa saṃskṛtaḥ" iti | tatra śūdrasya vedādhyayanādyabhāvāttadarthopanayanakāṇḍavratādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ | jātakarmādyāḥ kriyāḥ strīṇāmamantrakāḥ | "tūṣṇīmetāḥ kriyāḥ strīṇāṃ vivāhastu samantrakaḥ" iti smṛteḥ | etā jātakarmādicūḍāntāḥ | homo'pi dvijānāmeva | "gārbhairhomairjātakarmacūḍāmauñjīnibandhanaiḥ | baijikaṃ gārbhikaṃ caino dvijānāmapamṛjyate" | iti manuvākye dvijagrahaṇāt | bījaṃ śukraśoṇite tatsaṃbandhi niṣiddhakālamaithunādiprayuktaṃ baijikam | aśucigarbhakośasthitijaṃ gārbhikam | tadapagacchatīti kullūkabhaṭṭaḥ | bījagarbhayoḥ pāpanimittatvābhāvādubhayasaṃsargādaśucitvamātramenaḥśabdārtho na tu pāpamiti tu medhātithiḥ | vijñāneśvarastu -- "evamenaḥ śamaṃ yāti bījagarbhasamudbhavam" ityetadvyākhyāne vyādhisaṃkrāntyādinimittameno na tu patitotpannatvādītyāha | saṃskārāṇāṃ phalāni | atha saṃskārāṇāṃ phalāni | smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "niṣekādbaijikaṃ caino gārbhikaṃ cāpamṛjyate | kṣetrasaṃskārasiddhiśca garbhādhānaphalaṃ smṛtam || garbhe bhavecca puṃsūteḥ puṃstvasya pratipādanam | puṃsūtiḥ puṃsavanam | niṣekaphalavajjñeyaṃ phalaṃ sīmantakarmaṇaḥ | niṣeko garbhādhānam | garbhāmbupānajo doṣo jātātsarvo'pi naśyati | jātājjātakarmānuṣṭhānāt | apiśabdasya doṣaśabdenānvayaḥ | āyurvarcobhivṛddhiśca siddhirvyavahṛtestathā | vyavahṛtirvyavahārastasya siddhirityarthaḥ | nāmakarmaphalaṃ tvetatsamuddiṣṭaṃ manīṣibhiḥ | sūryāvalokanādāyurabhivṛddhirbhaveddhruvā || niṣkramādāyuḥśrīvṛddhirapyuddiṣṭā manīṣibhiḥ | annāśanānmātṛgarbhamalāśādapi śudhyati || balāyurvarcovṛddhiśca cūḍākarmaphalaṃ smṛtam | upanīteḥ phalaṃ tvetaddvijatāsiddhipūrvikā || vedādhītyadhikārasya siddhirṛṣibhirīritā | devapitrarṇāpagamo vivāhasya phalaṃ smṛtam" iti | yatra yatra cāpī śrūyete tatra baijikagārbhikainovināśo'pi phalaṃ jñeyam | anye'pi karṇavedhādayaḥ saṃskārāḥ śāstrāntaroktāstatra tatra vakṣyante | iti saṃskārāḥ | paribhāṣākārikāḥ | atha vakṣyamāṇakarmaṇāṃ paribhāṣādhīnatvādādau saṃkṣepataḥ paribhāṣārthaḥ kārikābhirnibadhyate | snātaḥ kurvītopavītī sarvaṃ karma pavitravān | ācāntaḥ punarācāmettilakī baddhacūḍakaḥ || 1 || śraddhayā karma kurvīta dhautavastradharo bhavet | avyagro'laṃkṛto maunī dambhāsūyādivarjitaḥ || 2 || āpadyukto'pi śuddhaḥ sanneva karma samācaret | japahomādiṣu naramanyaṃ nākāraṇāspṛśet || 3 || abuddhipūrvasaṃsparśaścettadā vāryupaspṛśet | buddhipūrvakasaṃsparśe prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ caret || 4 || varṇatrayasya saṃsparśādācamya prayato bhavet | saṃsparśe pratilomānāṃ snānameva vidhīyate || 5 || khalvāṭatvādidoṣeṇa viśikhaścennaro bhavet | kauśīṃ tadā dhārayīta brahmagranthiyutāṃ śikhām || 6 || kāryeyaṃ saptabhirdarbhairdhāryā śrotre tu dakṣiṇe | naikavāsā na ca dvīpe nāntarāle kadācana || 7 || śrutismṛtyuditaṃ karma na kuryādaśuciḥ kvacit | parito veṣṭito deśo'dbhiryaḥ sa dvīpamucyate || 8 || anāvṛtastu yo deśaḥ so'ntarālaṃ prakīrtitam | dānaṃ pratigraho homo bhojanaṃ balireva ca || 9 || sāṅguṣṭhena sadā kāryamasurebhyo'nyathā bhavet | aprauḍhapādaḥ kurvīta kṛtāsvāyāma eva ca || 10 || trimātraḥ praṇavo vācyaḥ karmārambhe ca sarvadā | upoṣitaḥ karma kuryādvidhyanujñe vinā sadā || 11 || peṣaṇādikayantreṣu śabdo yāvatpravartate | patitāntyajacaṇḍālādīnāṃ yāvacca śabdakaḥ || 12 || tāvatkarma na kartavyaṃ tathā saṃdhyādvaye'pi ca | saṃkīrtya māsapakṣādīnnimittāni tathaiva ca || 13 || idaṃ karma kariṣye'hamiti saṃkalpamācaret | yāvanti karmasaṃbaddhānyṛkṣāṇi syustu tāvatām || 14 || vārādīnāmapi tathā yuktaṃ sarvatra kīrtanam | kenacittu navīnena proktametattu yuktitaḥ || 15 || karmaṇyaniyatairghasraiḥ sādhye sādhāraṇoktitaḥ | vārādīnāṃ samullekho nirvāhyo'smiṃstu kalpake || 16 || prāyaugikāstvekabhādereva kurvanti kīrtanam | anullaṅghya svaśāstroktavidhiṃ karma samācaret || 17 || karmānyathā kṛtaṃ jñātvā tāvadeva punaścaret | pradhānasyākriyāyāṃ tu sāṅgaṃ tatpunarācaret || 18 || tadaṅgākaraṇe prāyaścittameva na karma tat | prācī diśāmanuktau syādatha vaiśānyudaksmṛtā || 19 || anuktau prahvatādīnāṃ karturāsīnatā bhavet | kartraṅgāṇāmanuktau tu dakṣiṇāṅgaṃ prakīrtitam || 20 || cakṣurādiṣu naitatsyāditi nārāyaṇaḥ sudhīḥ | kadaṅgasparśane vāmo hasto'nyasparśane'nyakaḥ || 21 || nābhyadho'ṅgānyasanti syurnābhyūrdhvaṃ syustu santi vai | nābhau tvanyataro hasta iti jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 22 || kare rogo yadi tadobhayatrobhāvapi smṛtau | avaidhaṃ nābhyadhaḥsparśaṃ karmakāle na cā''caret || 23 || raktapūyo(ya)retaādisparśe snānaṃ prakīrtitam | prāksaṃsthaṃ karma devānāmudagdigapavargakam || 24 || udagdiksaṃsthamathavā prācīdigapavargakam | dakṣiṇāśāpavargaṃ tu pratyagdiksaṃsthameva hi || 25 || pitryaṃ karma prakartavyaṃ spaṣṭaṃ yadi vaco bhavet | aṅgopasparśane vastradaśāsaṃsparśane tathā || 26 || chedane bhedane caiva nirāse khanane tathā | paitṛke rākṣase raudre nairṛte cā''bhicārike || 27 || eteṣu vai nimitteṣu jalopasparśanaṃ bhavet | adhovāyusamutsarge prahāse'nṛtabhāṣaṇe || 28 || mārjāramūṣakasparśa ākrande krodhasaṃbhave | nimitteṣveṣu sarveṣu karma kurvannapaḥ spṛśet || 29 || yattvotvākhvoḥ snānamuktaṃ tadvanyaviṣayaṃ bhavet | iti kecidbudhāḥ prāhuranye tvitthaṃ samūcire || 30 || pucchānyadeśasaṃsparśa udakasparśanaṃ bhavet | snānaṃ tu pucchasparśe syātkarmakāle ca bhojane || 31 || abuddhisparśaviṣaye vāryupasparśanaṃ bhavet | buddhipūrve tu snānaṃ syāditi prāhuḥ pare vudhāḥ || 32 || saumyākhyadiśi kartavyo nirāso devakarmasu | pitṛkarmasu yāmyākhyadiśyeṣa parikīrtitaḥ || 33 || daive karmaṇi sāmante prādakṣiṇyaṃ prakīrtitam | pitrye'pyevaṃ budhaijñeyaṃ nedaṃ syātpariṣecane || 34 || aprādakṣiṇyameva syāttatra sūtrakṛduktitaḥ | nivītitā mānuṣe syāddaive yajñopavītitā || 35 || prācīnāvītitā tu syātpitrye spaṣṭaṃ vaco yadi | smṛtyuktāṅgeṣu vijñeye ubhe smṛtyuktarītitaḥ || 36 || aprādakṣiṇyāpasavye sūtroktaniyamo'tra vā | havanaṃ bhojanaṃ dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ devārcanādi ca || 37 || bahirjānu na kāryaṃ syāttadvadācamanaṃ smṛtam | vihāraḥ pṛṣṭhato naiva prakartavyaḥ kadācana || 38 || pātrāṇyājyaṃ havirvahnireteṣvantaḥ kramātparam | kartārastu bahirbhūtā evaipvantastu homakṛt || 39 || bahirbhūtastato brahmā'nyebhyo'ntarbhūta īritaḥ | sarveṣveteṣu patnyantastato'pyantaḥ patirbhavet || 40 || etatsarvatra vijñeyaṃ viśeṣavidhinā vinā | avijñātasvarā mantrāḥ prayoktavyāḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ || 41 || ekaśrutyaiva sarvatra jayantasvāmibhāṣaṇāt | ṛṣiṃ ca devatāṃ chando viniyogaṃ manostathā || 42 || vijñāyaiva kriyāḥ kāryā yājñavalkyamunismṛteḥ | ṛṣiśchando devate ca cchandaścarṣiśca devatā || 43 || ṛṣiśca devatā chanda ityevaṃ syāttridhā kramaḥ | sautramantrā vedavidbhirvāmadevarṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 44 || liṅgodito bhaveddevo'spaṣṭe deve'nalaḥ smṛtaḥ | sautre hyṛṣyādivijñānaṃ netyuktaṃ pārijātake || 45 || vaitānike makhe śrāddhe brahmayajñe tathaiva ca | ṛṣyādyavagaternaivāpekṣā'stīti purātanāḥ || 46 || śraute śrāddhe ca mantrādau praṇavo'pi na hīṣyate | anye tvetasya vacaso nirmūlatvādihāpi ca || 47 || syādṛṣyādismṛtistāroccāraṇaṃ ceti vai jaguḥ | mantrāntyasya tvakṣarasya pāṭhakāle hi karmaṇaḥ || 48 || sarvatropakramaḥ kāryaḥ sūtrakārasya vākyataḥ | svāhākāro hi mantrānte nityo gārhye prakīrtitaḥ || 49 || pitryamantre'pi no yatra svadhākāranidarśanam | svāhānta eva tatra syāditi bhāṣyakṛteritam || 50 || mantrādau mantramadhye vā svāhāśabdo'sti cettadā | nānte prayoktavya iti proktavānāśvalāyanaḥ || 51 || bhavedavyavadhānena devatāpadataḥ purā | svāhākārasya pāṭhaścettadā nānte bhavedayam || 52 || na cedbhavetpāṭha itthaṃ tadā'nte'pi bhavetsa tu | svāhādhimiti mantre'sminnarthe hyasti nidarśanam || 53 || idamevānusartavyamata eva manīṣibhiḥ | mantrānte yā vahnijāyā sā tu mantrasvarūpiṇī || 54 || tadante'nyāṃ prayuñjīta sā homāṅgatayā matā | śaktisaṃgamatantroktādetasmādvākyataḥ punaḥ || 55 || svāhāśabdaṃ prayuñjīta tantrasya prabalatvataḥ | viśeṣo'yaṃ tantrayukte vaidike homakarmaṇi || 56 || juhotividhisaṃbaddhamantreṣveṣa vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ | svāhānto nāmamantraḥ syādamantrāsvāhutiṣvatho || 57 || karmaśiṣṭodakaṃ karmasamāptau tu parityajet || na tvanyatropayuñjītā''camanakṣālanādiṣu || 58 || mantramuccārayenmantrapratipādyaṃ tu śeṣiṇam | saṃstuvaṃstanmanā bhūtvā syādetadanumantraṇam || 59 || ābhimukhyekṣaṇādhikyādetadevābhimantraṇam | śeṣiṇaścintanaṃ kurvansamyaksthitvā samīpataḥ || 60 || natimudrāyuto mantraṃ paṭhediyamupasthitiḥ | tiṣṭhatā śravaṇaṃ cetsyādatra sā niyatā tadā || 61 || abhimarśo mantrapāṭhaḥ saṃsparśasamakālikaḥ | catuḥsvaroccāraṇātmā japatīti vidhau japaḥ || 62 || abhimarśānumantrābhimantropasthitikarmaṇām | prasādhitaṃ japatvaṃ hi vyākhyākṛdbhiratastvayam || 63 || catuḥsvaratvadharmastu mantreṣveteṣvapi smṛtaḥ | tato'nyatra tu mantrāṇāṃ niyataikaśrutirbhavet || 64 || kātyāyanamatādatrāpi syurvā svarasaṃyutāḥ | sarvatraiva nyūṅkhasāmnoścatvāro niyatāḥ svarāḥ || 65 || saṃvādapraiṣabhinnānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ syādupāṃśutā | āśrāvaṇaṃ pravaraṇaṃ pratyāśrāvaṇameva ca || 66 || śrauta etānyapi jñeyānyuccaireva vicakṣaṇaiḥ | kuryādupanayādīni vivāhāntāni laukike || 67 || prāyaścittākhyakarmāṇi kāmyakarmāṇi vai tathā | aupāsane laukike vā kartavyāni sadā budhaiḥ || 68 || upākarmotsarjane tu kuryācchiṣyayuto yadi | laukikānāṃ tadā kuryādaśiṣyaścetsvavahnike || 69 || gṛhyānale prakartavyo homaḥ pārāyaṇīyakaḥ | pārāyaṇasya kartā cedṛtviglokānale tadā || 70 || avaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhyakarma kāryamaupāsane'nale | aupāsanāgnisādhyeṣu prajāsaṃskārakarmasu || 71 || mukhyakarturabhāvena yadi kartrantaraṃ bhavet | laukikāgnau tadā karma na tu gṛhye kadācana || 72 || sarvādhānī bhavedvipraścettadā tatra lupyate | sthālīpākaḥ pārvaṇākhya aupāsanahutistathā || 73 || māsiśrāddhādi lokāgnāviti kecidbudhā jaguḥ | māsiśrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāgnāvaṣṭakādīni laukike || 74 || vaijayantīkṛdāheti prāhuranye'pi kecana | prajāsaṃskārakarmāṇi syurlokānala eva tu || 75 || śāstrāntaraproktacittahomāḥ saṃdhānahetavaḥ | naṣṭasya karmaṇo yasmāttasmātsyurgṛhya eva te || 76 || svatantratvāllaukikāgnāveva śāstrāntareritam | grahayajñādikaṃ kāryaṃ na tu gṛhyānale caret || 77 || gṛhyāntaroktaṃ lokāgnau gṛhyāgnāvatha vā''caret | punaragnyāhitau sarvādhānino mathitānale || 78 || ānīte śrotriyāgārādvā'gnau brahmaudanakriyā | vivāhe yadi nirmanthyastadā'tra syāttu manthanam || 79 || yadi dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ syātsvīkāryo'tra sa eva tu | evaṃrūpā vyavasthā tu vyākhyākṛdbhiḥ pradarśitā || 80 || bahuśuṣkendhane cāgnau susamiddhe vidhūmake | sāṅgāre lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ nānyathā kvacit || 81 || ājyahome sūtrakṛtā darvyeva vihitā yataḥ | atastatra bhavetsaiva na sruveṇā''hutirbhavet || 82 || sādhanaṃ kṣīradadhyādihome darvī sruvo'thavā | sūtrakṛdvihite home dravyasya kaṭhinasya tu || 83 || darvī hasto'thavā jñeyaḥ śāntyādau hasta eva tu | home śiṣṭairādṛto'sti yato'to'tra sa eva hi || 84 || hasta evā''cāryavākyādaupāsanahutau bhavet | homadravye tvanādiṣṭe sarvatrā''jyaṃ prakīrtitam || 85 || kaṇṭhoktyā samidhāṃ syāccedyatra prādeśamātratā | tatraiva sā syādanyatra tvaicchikīyaṃ samīritā || 86 || oṣadhyaḥ saktavaḥ puṣpaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ tṛṇam | etaddhastena hotavyaṃ nānyatkiṃcidacodanāt || 87 || anādeśe dakṣiṇā gaurhema vā pūrṇapātrakam | devakārye naiva deyaṃ rajataṃ tvaśrujaṃ hi tat || 88 || pātraṃ pādopasaṃspṛṣṭaṃ prakṣālyaṃ sarvathā budhaiḥ | hutaṃ yanmāṃsadhautena tanna bhuṅkte hi devatā || 89 || pātrāṇāṃ śodhanaṃ nātaḥ kāryaṃ kevalahastataḥ | kiṃtu darbhaistṛṇairvā'pi parṇairvā vāsasā'pi vā || 90 || sarveṣu dharmakāryeṣu patnī dakṣiṇato bhavet | abhiṣeke viprapādakṣālane vāmataḥ smṛtā || 91 || prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate | sa nā''pnoti phalaṃ tasya paratreti śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ || 92 || bahvalpaṃ vā svagṛhyoktaṃ yasya yāvatpracoditam | tasya tāvati śāstrārthe kṛte sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 93 || yannā''mnātaṃ svaśākhāyāṃ pārakyamavirodhi yat | ākāṅkṣitaṃ śeṣabhūtamanuṣṭheyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 94 || tatkṛtau phalavaiśiṣṭyaṃ na doṣastvakṛtau bhavet | sāmayācārikā dharmā deśajātikulodbhavāḥ || 95 || grāmācārāḥ parigrāhyā ye ca śāstrāvirodhinaḥ | yugadharmāḥ parigrāhyāḥ sarvatraiva yathocitam || 96 || iti saṃkṣepeṇa paribhāṣāḥ | dakṣiṇārthadravyeyattāvyavasthā dhanikādilakṣaṇaṃ ca | atha dhanikādipradeyadakṣiṇārthadravyeyattāvyavasthā | tatrā''dau dhanikādilakṣaṇaṃ vārāhe -- "vardhayitvā dhanaṃ yastu tasmādvāsamapīha yaḥ | na khādetsaṃgrahaparo dhanikaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ || poṣaṇīyakuṭumbasya nirvāho yāvatā bhavet | tāvadeva sukhaṃ yena labhate prativārṣikam || ṛṇaṃ yasya tu nāstyeva sa madhyama udāhṛtaḥ | dhanaṃ pūrvāparaṃ yasya vartate bahusaṃkhyayā | adhikasyārjako yaḥ syātsa mahādhana ucyate | sadācārarato vipro dhanārjanaparāṅmukhaḥ || kuṭumbyayatnamatikaḥ sa daridra iti smṛtaḥ | yasya syādaśanābhāvaḥ sadācāraratasya hi | mahādaridraḥ sa bhavedvāsodhānyavivarjitaḥ || vardhayitvā dhanaṃ yastu grāsaṃ vārṣikamarjayet | sa vai dhanya iti proktaścaikavarṣeṇa yaḥ pumān || varṣadvayamitaṃ grāsaṃ sa hi dhanyataraḥ smṛtaḥ || adhikasyārjako yaḥ syātsa dhanyatama īritaḥ | dhanenaiva vinā yastu grāsaṃ vārṣikamarjayet || sa vai dhīra iti proktastāratamyaṃ ca pūrvavat" iti | athaiteṣu madhye kena kiyaddeyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ vārāhe lakṣanamaskārahomaṃ prakṛtya -- "vyāhṛtīnāṃ sahasrasya home śulkaṃ dvije'rpayet | māṣamātraṃ suvarṇaṃ tu lakṣahome śataṃ yavāḥ" ityuktam | "dhaniko dviguṇaṃ dadyāttriguṇaṃ tu mahādhanaḥ | yavārdhaṃ tu daridreṇa dātavyaṃ puṇyalabdhaye || dadyānmahādaridrastu tadardhaṃ śulkameva ca" iti | madhyamādibhistu dhanikādyapekṣayā kiṃcinnyūnaṃ daridrādyapekṣayā kiṃcidadhikaṃ deyamityarthāttāratamyena kalpanīyam | dhīreṇa tu daridrato'pi nyūnaṃ samaṃ vā lābhānusāreṇa kalpanīyam | etacca suvarṇādidravyaviṣayameva, na tu gavādiviṣayam | suvarṇaṃ prakṛtyaiva dvaiguṇyāderuktatvāt | etatsarvaṃ nityakarmaviṣayamanuktaparimāṇaviṣayakaṃ ca jñeyam | kāmya uktaparimāṇe ca karmaṇi tu yathāvadeva deyam | dhanikādistu daridryahamiti prakhyāpayanyathāvanna dadāti sa karmaphalaṃ naivā''pnoti | tathāca manuḥ -- "prabhuḥ prathamakalpasya yo'nukalpena vartate | sa nā''pnoti phalaṃ tasya paratreti śrutiḥ smṛtiḥ" iti | purāṇāntare'pi -- "vittaśāṭhyaṃ naro yastu dhane sati karoti hi | sa nā''pnoti phalaṃ tatra cora eva prakīrtitaḥ" iti | evaṃ svalpakālasādhyabahukālasādhyakarmasu śramādyanurodhena dravyeyattā kalpanīyā | kuśāharaṇādividhiḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇa kuśāharaṇādividhiḥ | tatra śātātapaḥ -- "samitpuṣpakuśādīni brāhmaṇaḥ svayamāharet | śūdrānītaiḥ krayakrītaiḥ karma kurvanpatatyadhaḥ" iti | ādiśabdena dūrvādi | uttarārdhādidamapi jñāyate svasyā''haraṇāśaktau brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyāhṛtaiḥ karmakaraṇe doṣo nāstīti | lakṣapuṣpārcanādau tu krayakrītaniṣedho na "lakṣapuṣpārcanādau tu krayakrītamapīṣyate" iti mantrakośakārokteḥ | ādiśabdena dūrvādilakṣapūjanaṃ gṛhyate | kuśagrahaṇakālamāhāṅgirāḥ -- "ahanyahani karmārthaṃ kuśacchedaḥ praśasyate | kuśā dhṛtā ye pūrvatra yogyāḥ syurnottaratra te" iti | pūrvakarmaṇi dhṛtā ye kuśāste nottaratrānantaraṃ kriyamāṇeṣu karmasu yogyā ityarthaḥ | jābāliḥ -- "kuśānkāśāṃśca puṣpāṇi gavārthaṃ ca tṛṇādikam | niṣiddhe cāpi gṛhṇīyādamāvāsyāhani dvijaḥ" iti | ahanyahani darbhacchedanāsaṃbhave kālāntaramuktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "māsi māsyāhṛtā darbhāstattanmāsyeva coditāḥ" iti | asyāpyasaṃbhave viṣṇuḥ -- "darśe śrāvaṇamāsasya samantrotpāṭitāḥ kuśāḥ | ayātayāmāste darbhā niyojyāḥ syuḥ punaḥ punaḥ" iti | ayātayāmā aparyuṣitāḥ | niyojyā upayuktā apyaniṣedhe'nyatra prayojyā ityarthaḥ | yastu -- "amāyāṃ naiva hiṃsyāttu kuśāṃśca samidhastathā | sarvatrāvasthite some hiṃsāyāṃ brahmahā bhavet || vanaspatigate some yastu hiṃsyādvanaspatim | ghorāyāṃ brahmahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ" || iti niṣedhaḥ sa yasminmuhūrtatraye vanaspatiṣu somo vasati tatparo na tu kṛtsnāmāpara iti | yo'yaṃ vanaspatigatasomaviśiṣṭe kāle chedananiṣedhaḥ sa laukikacchedanaparo na tvidhmādicchedanaparastasya vihitatvāditi draṣṭavyam | somavāsakālastu garuḍapurāṇe'bhihitaḥ -- "trimuhūrtaṃ vasatyarke trimuhūrtaṃ jale tathā | trimuhūrtaṃ tathā goṣu trimuhūrtaṃ vanaspatau" iti | etaccāmāmārabhya jñeyam | kuśacchedanavidhimāha kauśikaḥ -- "śucau deśe śucirbhūtvā sthitvā pūrvottarāmukhaḥ | oṃkāreṇa tu mantreṇa kuśānspṛṣṭvā dvijottamaḥ || viriñcinā sahotpannaṃ parameṣṭhinisargaja | nuda sarvāṇi pāpāni kuśa svastikaro bhava || imaṃ mantraṃ samuccārya tataḥ pūrvottarāmukhaḥ | huṃphaṭkāreṇa darbhāṃstu sakṛcchittvā samuddharet" iti | ktvāpratyayādeva cchedane'pi pūrvottarāmukhatve siddhe punarvacanaṃ viśeṣavidhipratipāditadharmāntaraparisaṃkhyārtham | tena sthitvetyasyaiva viśeṣavidhipratipāditatvācchedane nivṛttiḥ | śucau deśe śucirbhūtvetyasya tu na nivṛttiḥ | viśeṣavidhipratipāditatvābhāvāditi draṣṭavyam | kvacicchedane viśeṣa ukto bharadvājena -- "pretakriyārthaṃ pitrarthamabhicārārthameva ca | dakṣiṇābhimukhaśchindyātprācīnāvītiko dvijaḥ" iti | chedanīyakuśānviśinaṣṭyaṅgirāḥ -- "acchinnāgrānpavitrāṃśca acchidrānkomalāñśubhān | pitṛdevakriyārthaṃ ca samādadyātkuśāndvijaḥ" iti | tyājyānkuśānāha hārītaḥ -- "pathi darbhāścitau darbhā ye darbhā yajñabhūmiṣu | staraṇāsanapiṇḍeṣu teṣāṃ tyāgo vidhīyate" iti | āpastambaḥ -- "brahmayajñe ca ye darbhā ye caiva pitṛtarpaṇe | hatā mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ teṣāṃ tyāgo vidhīyate" iti | devalaḥ -- "apūtā garbhitā darbhā cāgraccheditā nakhaiḥ | kvathitā agnidagdhāśca kuśā varjyāḥ prayatnataḥ" iti | garbhitā garbhadalasaṃyutāḥ | vastutastu sūtrakṛtā yatrānantargarbhatvamuktaṃ tatraiva niyatam, anyatrāniyatamiti draṣṭavyam | jābāliḥ -- "nīvimadhyasthitā darbhā brahmasūtre ca ye dhṛtāḥ | pavitrāṃstānvijānīyādyathā kāyastathā kuśāḥ" iti | smṛtyantare -- "amūlā devakāryeṣu pitṛkārye samūlakāḥ" iti | kauśikaḥ -- "saprasūnāḥ smṛtā darbhā aprasūnāḥ kuśāḥ smṛtāḥ | samūlāḥ kutapāḥ proktāśchinnāgrāstṛṇasaṃjñitāḥ" iti | prasūnaṃ puṣpam | atriḥ -- "ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāṃ dvijairdarbhapavitrake | dhāraṇīye prayatnena brahmagranthisamanvite" iti | prayatnena brahmagranthisamanvite dhāraṇīye iti yojanā | sa eva -- "brahmayajñe jape caiva brahmagranthirvidhīyate | bhojane vartulaḥ prokta evaṃ dharmo na hīyate" iti | brahmagranthilakṣaṇaṃ hemādriṇoktam -- "dviguṇīkṛtānāṃ darbhaśikhānāṃ pāśaḥ pradakṣiṇamardhāveṣṭanaṃ vidhāya paścādbhāgena yadā praveśyate tadā vartulo granthiḥ | sa eva yadā prādakṣiṇyena sarvaveṣṭanaṃ vidhāya purobhāgeṇa praveśyate tadā brahmagranthiḥ" iti | hārītaḥ -- "vāmahaste kuśānkṛtvā samācāmati yo dvijaḥ | upaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavettena rudhireṇa malena vā" iti | kevalaṃ vāmahasta ityarthaḥ | na caitadācamane vāmahaste kuśadhāraṇaniṣedhakamiti vaktuṃ śakyam | "ubhayatra sthitairdarbhaiḥ samācāmati yo dvijaḥ | saumapānaphalaṃ so'pi bhuktvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet" || iti devalavacanavirodhāpatteḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- "na brahmagranthinā''cāmenna dūrvābhiḥ kadācana | kāśahastastu nā''cāmetkadācidvidhiśaṅkayā iti | pavitralakṣaṇamāha kātyāyanaḥ -- "anantargarbhitaṃ sāgraṃ kauśaṃ dvidalameva ca | prādeśamātraṃ vijñeyaṃ pavitraṃ yatrakutracit" iti | viśeṣataḥ pavitralakṣaṇaṃ smṛtyantare -- "dvyaṅgulaṃ mūlataḥ kuryādgranthirekāṅgulastathā | caturaṅgulamagraṃ syātpavitrasya ca lakṣaṇam" iti | pravaṇena pavitragranthikaraṇamuktaṃ tatraiva -- "tāreṇa kuryādgranthiṃ tu pavitrasya vicakṣaṇaḥ" iti | tāraḥ praṇavaḥ | pavitradarbhasaṃkhyāmāha mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- "caturbhirdarbhapiñjūlairbrāhmaṇasya pavitrakam | ekaikanyūnamuddiṣṭaṃ varṇe varṇe yathākramam" iti | garuḍapurāṇe tu -- "saptabhirdarbhapiñjūlairbrāhmaṇasya pavitrakam | pañcabhiḥ kṣatriyasyaiva caturbhistu tathā viśaḥ || dvābhyāṃ śūdrasya vihitamāturāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | sarveṣāṃ vā bhaveddvābhyāṃ pavitraṃ granthitaṃ na vā" iti | smṛtyantare -- "caturbhirdarbhapiñjūlairdvābhyāṃ vā'tha pavitrakam | daive karmaṇi kartavyaṃ pitrye tattribhirīritam" iti | ratnāvalyām -- "dvayostu parvaṇormadhye pavitraṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ" iti | pavitrapātaprāyaścittamuktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "pavitre patite jñāte tathā japamaṇāvapi | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryātsnātvā vipro'ghamarṣaṇam" iti | japediti śeṣaḥ | pavitratyāge viśeṣa uktaḥ smṛtyantare -- "nitye naimittike vā'pi karmopakaraṇe dvijaḥ | dhṛtaṃ pavitraṃ karmānte granthiṃ muktvaiva tattyajet" iti | kuśābhāve smṛtyantare -- "kuśābhāve tu kāśāḥ syuḥ kuśāḥ kāśāḥ samāḥ smṛtāḥ | kāśābhāve grahītavyā anye darbhā yathocitam" iti | hārītaḥ -- "kuśābhāve tathā kāśā dūrvā vrīhiyavā api | godhūmāścaiva nīvārāḥ śyāmākośīravalvajāḥ || muñjā vā'tha parigrāhyāḥ sarvakarmasu niścitam" iti | atra vrīhiyavagodhūmanīvāraśyāmākaśabdāstattattṛṇaparāḥ | vistarastvācāraratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyate | yajñiyapātravṛkṣāḥ, yajñiyapātralakṣaṇāni ca | pātravṛkṣāḥ saṃgrahe -- "pātrāṇi dāravāṇi syuryathāśaktyanurūpataḥ | pūrṇapātrādayo grāhyāḥ śastā yajñadrumodbhavāḥ || praśaste pūrṇapātrārthe dārukāṃsyamaye makhe" iti | pātra iti śeṣaḥ | "khādireṇa sruvaḥ kāryaḥ pālāśī tu juhūrbhavet | tvakpradeśe bilaṃ syātāmanyairvā yajñiyairdrumaiḥ || tadalābhe palāśasya parṇābhyāṃ hūyate haviḥ | palāśaparṇābhāve tu parṇairvā pippalodbhavaiḥ" iti | gṛhyakarmaṇi sarvatrā''jyahome darvyevā''cāryokteḥ | śāstrāntare dṛṣṭatvātkhādiryapi darvī grāhyeti mātṛdattaḥ | apiśabdātpālāśī | baudhāyanagṛhye -- "khādirī darvī tejaskāmasyaudumbaryannādyakāmasya pālāśī brahmavarcasakāmasya" iti | sruve viśeṣamāha sa eva -- "pālāśena sraveṇetyātreyaḥ khādireṇetyāṅgirasastāmrāyasenetyātharvaṇaḥ kārṣṇāyasenābhicaranniti sārvatrikam" iti | darvyā ākṛtirlokaprasiddhā bhāṣayā 'palī' ityucyate | tadalābhe srugalābhe darvyalābhe ca sruvasthānīyaṃ parṇamatra madhyamaṃ grāhyam | "madhyamena parṇena juhoti srugdhyeṣā" iti śruteḥ | "khādiro musalaḥ kāryaḥ pālāśaḥ(śaṃ) syādulūkhalaḥ(lam) | yadvobhau vāraṇau kāryau tadalābhe'nyavṛkṣajau || camasaḥ syātpraṇītānāṃ kāṃsyapātramathāpi vā" iti | ājyasthālīlakṣaṇaṃ chandogapariśiṣṭe -- "ājyasthālī prakartavyā taijasadravyasaṃbhavā | mahīmayī vā kartavyā sarvāsvājyāhutīṣu ca || ājyasthālyāḥ pramāṇaṃ tu yathākāmaṃ tu kārayet | sudṛḍhāmavraṇāṃ bhadrāmājyasthālīṃ pracakṣate" iti | ājyasthālī mṛnmayīti mātṛdattavaijayantīkārau | kāṃsyamayīti kecit | sā cārthasiddhaparimāṇā viśeṣānukteḥ | yathākāmaṃ tu kārayedityanantarodāhṛtacchandogapariśiṣṭavacanācca | mṛnmayītipakṣe hastaghaṭitaiva na kulālacakranirmitā | acakrāvartāmityagnihotrahomaprakaraṇe sūtrakāreṇoktatvāt | "kulālacakraniṣpannamāsuraṃ mṛnmayaṃ smṛtam | tadeva hastaghaṭitaṃ sthālyādi daivikaṃ bhavet" | iti karmapradīpavacanācca | cakreṇā''varto bhramo yasyāḥ sā cakrāvartā na cakrāvartā'cakrāvartā tām | idamagnihotrasthālīviśeṣaṇam | ājyāhutīnāmatibāhulyenaikājyasthālyasaṃbhave'nekā mahatya ājyasthālya upayoktavyāḥ | pradarśitaṃ cāstyācāryeṇa -- "asaṃbhavādvā yathā'śvamedhe paśukarmasu" ityanena sūtreṇa | anyo nirvāpo vā kāryaḥ | ājyasthālīgatājyasya skandane'pyeṣaḥ | prāyaugikāstu saṃskṛte sthālīgata ājya eva laukikamājyamānīya tena karma kurvanti | praṇītāpraṇayanapātraṃ camasaḥ | sa ca nyagrodhajo rauhītakajo vā caturaṅguladaṇḍaścaturasraḥ ṣaḍaṅguladīrghastryaṅgulanimnaścaturasrabilo'daṇḍo vā | asminpakṣe parito vdyaṅgulamavaśeṣya sarvaṃ bilameva | rauhītako vaṭāvāntarajātiriti paśuprakaraṇe vyākhyātāraḥ | yadyapyamareṇa karañjabhede rauhītakaśabdapravṛttiruktā tathā'pyamaravyākhyāyām -- "rohī rohītakaścaityavaṭapādapayoḥ pumān" | iti rāmāśramodāhṛtakośāntarādvaṭavācitā'pi | yadyapi nyagrodharohitakaśabdayoḥ paryāyatā kośāntarātpratīyate tathā'pi naiyagrodhānrauhītakānveti sūtre pṛthagupādānādvaṭaviśeṣaparatā rauhītakaśabdasya | rohītakarohitakaśabdau paryāyau | vāraṇajo vā camasaḥ | "ahomārthāni tu vāraṇasya" itivacanāt | iyaṃ ca paribhāṣā gārhyakarmaṇyanityeti jñāpayiṣyate ca somasūtravyākhyāne | tathā ca vikaṅkatādyanyatamayajñiyavṛkṣajāna(nya)pi | mātṛdattastu praṇītāpraṇayanapātraṃ mṛnmayamityāha | kāṃsyapātraṃ brahmavarcasakāmanāyāmiti kecit | prokṣaṇīpātraṃ srugākāraṃ vāraṇavṛkṣajam | ahomārthatvāt | tatra sruglakṣaṇamitthaṃ yājñikā upadiśanti -- "āyāmaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā caturdhā vā'grato dvayoḥ | upāntyaḥ pātramityukto havirāśrayabhāvataḥ || upāntyabhāge vistāraḥ svadairghyeṇa samo bhavet | so'ñjalyākṛtiruddiṣṭo bilamatra ca vartulam | ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ bāhumātryāṃ tadardhena ca nimnatā | aratnimāne hastasya talamānaṃ bilaṃ smṛtam || vistārārdhena nimnaṃ syādantyabhāge'tha nirṇayaḥ | bhāge'ntime bhavedgrīvā dairghyārdhena ca vistṛtā || tasyā mukhaṃ haṃsamukhaṃ hastyoṣṭhamukhameva vā | bilātpraṇālikā tāvatparyantārthānurūpataḥ || karṇau sasuṣirau grīvāpārśvayoścoditau tathā | bilasya budhne padmaṃ syādatha daṇḍasya lakṣaṇam || avaśiṣṭāstrayo dvau vā bhāgau daṇḍa itīryate | tasya mūle bhavetsthūlaḥ pariṇāho navāṅgulaḥ || pariṇāho viśālatā | ante pañcāṅgulaḥ ślakṣṇo yantrato vartulo bhavet || daṇḍa evaṃ srucāṃ kākapucchatvaṃ samudīritam | yathāśobhaṃ srucaḥ kāryā iti baudhāyano'bravīt | śāstrāntarāttu vijñeyaṃ viśeṣāntaramatrayat | prādeśamātratā'pi syādbaudhāyanamatāditaḥ | daṇḍo bhāgadvayena syātpātraṃ bhāgadvayena ca | ūrdhvamekena bhāgena grīvā ceti yathārthataḥ | srucaḥ saha sruveṇa syuruktavṛkṣā athāpi vā" iti | etatkārikābhyaḥ pūrvatra khādirasyopakrāntatvāttena sākamayaṃ vikalpaḥ | gṛhyakarmaṇi -- 'vitastirgṛhyakarmaṇi' iti vacanādvitastipramāṇena prokṣaṇyarthā srukkāryā | evaṃ darvyādīnyapi | vitastirdvādaśāṅgulā | trayodaśāṅguleti kecit | śūrpaṃ lokaprasiddham | tacca vaiṇavaṃ nalamayaṃ veti bharadvājaḥ | ulūkhalaṃ pālāśaṃ vāraṇaṃ vā | muśalaṃ khādiraṃ vāraṇaṃ vā | etayoḥ parimāṇe arthasiddhe | dṛṣadupale peṣaṇārthe pāṣāṇamaye arthasiddhaparimāṇe | pātrī dhātumayī mṛnmayī vā | kapālāni tu navaṃ mṛnmayaṃ ghaṭaṃ bhittvā tacchakalāni puroḍāśaśrapaṇayogyāni catvāri | etairaśvaśaphamātro vistāro yathā saṃpadyate tāvanmānāni | yajñapārśve tu -- "samāni caturasrāṇi dvyaṅgulāni samantataḥ | kuryādekakapālānāṃ kapālaṃ pāṇisaṃmitam || dvikapālatrikādīni kuryāttadanusārataḥ | evamādisamādeśaṃ kuryādautsargikaṃ sadā" iti | maṇḍano'pi -- "rathacakravadākāraḥ sarvataśca ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ | yathā kapālayogaḥ syāttathaikaikaṃ kapālakam | utsedhā dvyaṅgulāsteṣāmevaṃ kuryānmṛdā pṛthak | yadvā bhinnaghaṭādīnāṃ gṛhṇītāvayavāniha" iti | kulālabhāvitayā mṛdā sarvataḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ rathacakrākṛti dvyaṅguloccaṃ samabhūmikaṃ vartulapīṭhaṃ kṛtvā'dhastātkiṃcitpariśeṣya prāñcaṃ tiryañcaṃ ca vibhajet | tena catvāri kapālāni bhavanti | tatastāni paktvā pariśeṣitapradeśeṣu vibhajet | atraiva kapālaśabdasya rūḍheḥ | śamyāmānamapyāha sa eva -- "triprādeśā bhavecchamyā kumbāgrā'timanoharā | ekaprādeśamātrā vā śamyā laugākṣidarśanāt" iti | dṛṣadādīnāṃ pūrvedyuḥśrāddha upayogaḥ | sruvalakṣaṇamāha maṇḍanaḥ -- "ardhāṅgulamitacchidraḥ sruvastvaṅgulabudhnavān | aṅguṣṭhaparvaṇo yadvā vṛttaṃ tanmātrapuṣkaram" iti | āśvalāyanasmṛtau -- "aṣṭāṅgulamitā sthālī prokṣaṇī ca ṣaḍaṅgulā | camasaścā''jyapātraṃ ca ṣaḍaṅgulamiti smṛtam" iti | uccatā'rthasiddhā | sthālī carusthālī | ājyapātramājyasthālī | vitastirgṛhyakarmaṇītivacanasiddhena vitastyātmakena prokṣaṇīpramāṇena ṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaṃ vikalpata iti kecit | kātyāyanena carusthālīlakṣaṇamanyathoktam -- "dṛḍhā prādeśamātryūrdhvaṃ tiryaṅnātibṛhanmukhī | mṛnmayyaudumbarī vā'pi carusthālī praśasyate" iti | etacca prādeśamātratvamāśvalāyanasmṛtyuktenāṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena vikalpate | audumbarī tāmramayī | mekṣaṇalakṣaṇamapyuktaṃ kātyāyanena -- "idhmajātīyamidhmārdhapramāṇaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ bhavet | vṛttaṃ vārkṣaṃ ca pṛthvagramavadānakriyākṣamam" iti | idhmajātīyamityanenaiva vṛkṣalābhe vārkṣamiti vacanamidhmavṛkṣātiriktavṛkṣasyāpi pakṣe saṃgrahārtham | saṃgrahe -- "āyāmaṃ pañcadhā kṛtvā tribhāgaṃ daṇḍameva ca | dvibhāgaṃ puṣkaraṃ proktaṃ darvyā lakṣaṇamuttamam" iti | iyaṃ ca darvī pūrṇāhutyādihome homānusāreṇa kalpanīyā | yatra dvistrirgṛhītājyahomaḥ prāyaścittādau tatrāpyevam | yatraivamājyahomo nāsti tatra karṣapramāṇamājyaṃ yāvati bile saṃmāti tāvatpramāṇabilā darvī grāhyā | pātrāṇāṃ śuddhiprakāraḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇa pātrāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca śuddhiprakāraḥ | tatra leparahitānāṃ dārumayāṇāmaśmamayānāṃ vaiṇavānāṃ ca lepaṃ vinocchiṣṭapuruṣādispṛṣṭānāṃ jalena prakṣālanācchuddhiḥ | salepānāmeteṣāṃ salepocchiṣṭādipuruṣaspṛṣṭānāṃ takṣaṇātprakṣālanācca śuddhiḥ | salepānāmeteṣāṃ lepaṃ vinocchiṣṭapuruṣādispṛṣṭānāmuṣṇodakena prakṣālanācchuddhiḥ | śūrpasya tu takṣaṇāsaṃbhavātparityāga eva | lepasahitānāṃ dārumayāṇāmaśmamayānāṃ ca kākādimukhāvamṛṣṭānāṃ takṣaṇācchuddhiḥ | leparahitānāṃ tūṣṇodakena prakṣālanāt | evaṃ mārjāravyatiriktaśvāpadamukhāvamṛṣṭānāmapi | caṇḍālādisparśaviṇmūtrādyupahatyostu sarvatra parityāga eva | salepānāṃ sauvarṇarājatakāṃsyamayatāmramayāṇāṃ yathākramamuṣṇodakagośakṛdbhasmāmlaiḥ śuddhiḥ | salepānāṃ sauvarṇarājatavyatiriktānāṃ pātrāṇāṃ kākādimukhāvamṛṣṭānāṃ śūdrasaṃspṛṣṭānāṃ ca takṣaṇātprakṣālanācca śuddhiḥ| evaṃ śūdropabhuktānāmalepānāmapi | sauvarṇarājatānāṃ tu dāhāduṣṇodakena prakṣālanācca śuddhiḥ | eteṣāṃ caṇḍālādisparśe viṇmūtrādyupahatau ca punaḥ karaṇam | athavā gomūtre saptarātraṃ saṃsthāpanāddāhāduṣṇodakena prakṣālanācca śuddhiḥ | nūtanānāṃ mṛnmayānāṃ vinā lepamucchiṣṭapuruṣādispṛṣṭānāṃ jalena prakṣālanam |ājyaliptānāmucchiṣṭapuruṣādispṛṣṭānāṃ punardāhaḥ | salepānāmucchiṣṭapuruṣādispṛṣṭānāṃ mūtrapurīṣādyupahṛtānāṃ ca parityāga eva | dravyāṇāṃ śuddhiprakāraḥ | kṛṣṇājinasya lepaṃ vinocchiṣṭasparśe gomayodakena prakṣālanam | salepocchiṣṭasparśe gaurasarṣapapiṣṭairgomayena mṛdoṣṇodakena ca śuddhiḥ | viṇmūtrādyupahatāvapyevam | ghanāyā bhūmerviṇmūtrādyupahatau gomayenopalepanam | sasuṣirāyāḥ karṣaṇam | ārdrāyā medhyamṛdā pracchādanam | aśuddhāyāṃ bhūmau nyastānāṃ prakṣālanam | puruṣavāhyānāṃ kāṣṭhaśileṣṭakānāṃ caṇḍālādispṛṣṭānāṃ prakṣālyāvaśoṣaṇam | yajñādyarthaṃ śūdrādibhirāhṛtānāṃ darbhakāṣṭhādīnāṃ pavamānānuvākena prokṣaṇācchuddhiḥ | ekapuruṣāhāraparimitānāṃ vrīhiyavagodhūmādīnāṃ viṇmūtrādyupahatau parityāgaḥ | adhikānāṃ tu yāvata upahatirbhavati tāvata evotsargaṃ kṛtvā'vaśiṣṭānāṃ prokṣaṇakaṇḍanakṣālanāni kāryāṇi | phalīkṛtānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ nirmalīkaraṇaprokṣaṇaprakṣālanāni | homārthasya carvādeḥ keśakīṭapataṅgādibhirupaghāte parityāga eva | sarpiṣastailasya cocchiṣṭasparśa udake tatpātraṃ nidhāyoddhṛtyopayojayet | madhupayodadhyādīnāṃ tasmātpātrādanyasminpātra uddhṛtyopayogaḥ kāryaḥ | eteṣāṃ lepasaṃbandhe parityāga eva | parityāgavyatirikte sarvatra pavamānānuvākaprokṣaṇasya samuccayaḥ | sarpirādīnāṃ kṣudrakeśakīṭakādibhiḥ saṃsarge tamuddhṛtya paryagnikaraṇaṃ vastrādibhirgālanaṃ pavitrābhyāṃ tūṣṇīmutpavanaṃ ca kāryam | evaṃ kākādibhiravaghrāteṣvapi | viṇmūtrādyupahatau tu parityāga eva | etanmūlabhūtāni vacanāni tu hemādrivijñāneśvaramadanapārijātādiṣu draṣṭavyāni | iti pātradravyaśuddhiprakāraḥ | dravyapratinidhinirūpaṇam | atha saṃkṣepeṇa pratinidhinirūpaṇam | tatra vrīhayo yavā vā mukhyāstadabhāve nīvāragodhūmau yathāyathaṃ tadabhāve veṇuyavāstadabhāve māṣacaṇakakodravādiniṣiddhadravyātiriktaṃ dravyam | gavyamājyaṃ mukhyaṃ tadabhāve māhiṣaṃ tadabhāva ājaṃ tadabhāve tailaṃ tadabhāve jartilātasīkusumbhasarṣapamadhūkabījanārikelasnehādīni pūrvapūrvālābhe grāhyāṇi | eteṣāmapyalābhe yavavrīhiśyāmākānyatamodbhavaṃ piṣṭaṃ jalenā''loḍyā''jyakārye niyojayet | evamañjane'pi | barhiḥkārye darbhā mukhyāstadabhāve kāśāstadabhāve śarasugandhitṛṇāśvabālamuñjadūrvāyavaśyāmākatṛṇekṣupatrakṣīradrūmapatrāṇi pūrvapūrvālābhe grāhyāṇi | samitkārye palāśo mukhyaḥ | idhmakārye khadiro'pi | tadabhāve'śvatthodumbaraśamyarkāpāmārgādayaḥ | api vā kapittharājavṛkṣakadambanimbakarañjaśālmalitilakañcanāraśleṣmātakavibhītakaśākadrumādīnniṣiddhānvarjayitvā'vaśiṣṭāñśucīnvanaspatīnupayuñjyāt | gopayo mukhyaṃ, tadabhāve māhiṣaṃ, tadabhāva ājaṃ, tadabhāve gavādīnāṃ dadhi, tadabhāve yavavrīhiśyāmākānyatamodbhavapiṣṭamiśritaṃ jalam | keṣāṃcidācāryāṇāṃ mate gopayobhāve dadhi, tadabhāve māhiṣaṃ payaḥ, tadabhāva āja, tadabhāve mahiṣyādīnāṃ dadhi, tadabhāve yavavrīhiśyāmākānyatamodbhavapiṣṭamiśritaṃ jalamiti kramaḥ | evaṃ dadhno'pi | pātreṣūktavṛkṣābhāve pūrvoktānkapitthādīnvarjayitvā pārayogyayajñiyavṛkṣamātraṃ grāhyam | dakṣiṇāmānam | dakṣiṇāsu vareṣu coktadravyālābhe vibhavānusāreṇa mūlyādhyāyoktamānena dravyaṃ deyam | tatra mānaṃ pañcadhā | varāṭakatāmraraupyakasuvarṇarajatabhedāt | tatraikasyā gormūlyaṃ varāṭakamānena ṣaṣṭyadhikapañcaviṃśatiśatī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānenaikasyā gormūlyaṃ madhumudrāṅkitaḍhabbūkasya catuścatvāriṃśadadhikaśataguñjātmakatvāttāmrapaṇasya | cāśītiguñjātmakatvātkiṃcinnyūnā aṣṭādaśa ḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena tvekasyā gormūlyaṃ kiṃcinnyūnaikayavādhikaguñjādvayaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena tvekasyā gormūlyaṃ catvāriṃśanmāṣakaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | rājatamānena tvekasyā gormulyaṃ rājatacatvāriṃśanmāṣaparimitaṃ rajataṃ bhavati | varāṭakamānena varamūlyaṃ viṃśatiyuktaśatādhikapañcasāhasrī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena tu kiṃcinnyūnaṣaṭtriṃśaḍhḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena tu kiṃcinnyūnayavadvayādhikacaturguñjāmātraṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena tu ṣoḍaśamāṣātmakāḥ pañca suvarṇā bhavanti | rājatamānena tu rājatāśītimāṣakaparimitaṃ rajataṃ bhavati | varāṭakamānena vṛṣamūlyaṃ ṣaṭpañcāśadyuktaśatādhikasaptasāhasrī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena tu kiṃcinnyūnacatuṣpañcāśaḍhḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena tu kiṃcinnyūnasaptaguñjāparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena tu sārdhasaptasuvarṇā bhavanti | rājatamānena tu viṃśatirajatamāṣādhikaśatamāṣā rūpyaṃ bhavati | anaḍuhi varāpekṣayā dviguṇaṃ bodhyam | varāṭakamānena dhenumūlyamaṣṭaśatādhikadvādaśasāhasrī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena kiṃcinnyūnanavatiḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena yavadvayādhikamāṣakadvayaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena sārdhadvādaśa suvarṇā bhavanti | rājatamānena rājataśatadvayaṃ māṣakā bhavanti | varāṭakamānenāśvamūlyaṃ śatadvayādhikaikonaviṃśatisāhasrī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena pañcaviṃśatyadhikaśataṃ ḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena yavatrayādhikamāṣakatrayaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena pādonaikonaviṃśatisuvarṇā bhavanti | rājatamānena rājataśatatrayaṃ māṣakā bhavanti | varāṭakamānena hiraṇyamūlyaṃ sahasradvayaṃ varāṭakā bhavanti | tāmramānenāṣṭaguñjānyūnacaturdaśaḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena kiṃcinnyūnasārdhapañcakamāṣapramāṇaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena sapādaikatriṃśa nmāṣā bhavanti | rājatamānena sapādaikatriṃśadrājatamāṣā bhavanti | varāṭakamānena vastramūlyamaśītyadhikadvādaśaśatī varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena kiṃcinnyūnanavaḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena kiṃcinnyūnasarṣapatrayādhikaguñjāmātraṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena viṃśatimāṣaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | rājatamānena viṃśatirājatamāṣaparimitaṃ rajataṃ bhavati | gorapekṣayā pādamātraṃ chāgamūlyam | avāvajāpekṣayā sārdhamadhikaṃ bodhyam | dhenvapekṣayā krameṇa pañcaguṇaṃ dāsīmūlyam | dāsīvanniṣkamūlyam | varāṭakamānena gajamūlyaṃ catvāriṃśatsahasrādhikalakṣaṣaṭkaṃ varāṭakānāṃ bhavati | tāmramānena sthūladṛśā pañcaśatyadhikasahasracatuṣṭayaṃ ḍhabbūkā bhavanti | raupyakamānena sthūladṛśā'śītyadhikapañcaśataguñjāparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | suvarṇamānena pañcaśatamāṣaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ bhavati | rajatamānena pañcaśatarājatamāṣaparimitaṃ rajatam | dhenvapekṣayā krameṇārdhaṃ naravāhyayānasya mūlyam | anaḍudvadgṛhasya mūlyam | etanmūlaṃ gopālakṛtamūlyādhyāyavivaraṇe draṣṭavyam | nityeṣu karmasu mūlyasyāpyabhāve manthaudanakandamūlaphalādīni pūrvapūrvālābhe deyāni | kāmyeṣu karmasu tu yathoktavastūnyeva na pratinidhiḥ | ārabdheṣveteṣu yathoktavastvalābhe'styeva pratinidhiḥ | iti saṃkṣepeṇa pratinidhinirūpaṇam |
karmādau gaṇeśapūjanasyā''vaśyakatā | atha gaṇapatipūjanam | tacca sarvakarmasvādau kartavyaṃ, nirvighnārthatvāt 'na ṛte tvatkriyate' iti mantraliṅgāt | "nārcito hi gaṇādhyakṣo yajñādau yatsurottamāḥ | tasmādvighnaṃ samutpannaṃ tatkrodhajamidaṃ khalu" iti padmapurāṇācca | atra pūjā dvividhā, ṣoḍaśopacārā pañcopacārā vā | tatra pratiṣṭhitapratimāyāmāvāhanavisarjanayorabhāvena caturdaśopacāraiva pūjā | athavā''vāhanavisarjanayoḥ sthāne mantrapuṣpāñjalidānaṃ tena ṣoḍaśopacārā bhavanti | nūtanapratimāyāṃ tu ṣoḍaśopacāraiva | āvāhanābhāve pratimādau pūjāyā asaṃbhavāt | kvacittu vacanādvisarjanamutkṛṣyate | āgnimārutādūrdhvamanūyājaiścarantītivat | yathā grahayajñādau -- "evaṃ samagraṃ niṣpādya sarvadevānvisarjayet" || iti mātsye vidhānādante visarjanam | īdṛśyeva ceyaṃ pūjā vacanatyājitakiṃcitpadārthā piṇḍarahitasaṃkrāntiśrāddhavatsvatantrāpi | pañcopacārapūjā tu yatra sthāpitadevānāṃ visarjanātprākpūjoktā tadviṣayā | svastivācanam | atha svastivācanam | vyāsaḥ -- "saṃpūjya gandhamālyādyairbrāhmaṇānsvasti vācayet | dharmakarmaṇi māṅgalye saṅgrāme'dbhutadarśane" iti || gandhamālyādyairiti vacanaṃ gandhapūrvabhāvināṃ pādaprakṣālanādīnāmupacārāṇāmanāvaśyakatvabodhanārtham | ādyaśabdena tāmbūlādigrahaṇam | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe -- "atha svastivācanamṛddhipūrtepyṛddhirvivāhāntā apatyasaṃskārāḥ pratiṣṭhodyāpane pūrte" iti | atra pratiṣṭhāgrahaṇamutsargopalakṣaṇam | baudhāyanaḥ -- "setubandhanadīkhātataḍāgapuṣkariṇīvāpīkūpadevagṛhaprāsādavasatīnāmoṣadhivanaspatīnāṃ ca pūrtaṃ bhavati" iti | setubandho jaloparigamanamārgaḥ | nadīkhātaṃ godāvaryādinadītīre snānasaṃdhyādikarmārthamupaveśanārthaṃ sthalaṃ sopānāni ca | nadītyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenāśvatthādivṛkṣamūlasamantādbhāgo'pi khātaśabdenocyate | taḍāgo dvārarahitaścaturdikṣu sopānavān | samantata āvṛtā caturdikṣu dvārasopānavatī puṣkariṇī kṣudrataḍāgo vā | ekatrasopānavatyanāvṛtā vāpī | kūpaḥ prasiddhaḥ | devagṛhaṃ devālayam(yaḥ)| prāsādo nadītīrādāvannasatrādyarthoccaśālā | vasatiḥ pānthebhyo vāsārthaṃ nirmitaṃ sthalam | oṣadhivanaspatayaḥ puṣpavāṭikārāmādikam | eteṣāṃ padārthānāmutsargaḥ pūrtaṃ pūrtasaṃjñako bhavatītyarthaḥ | etatprayogaviśeṣa utsargaratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyate | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "vaidike tāntrike cā''dau svastivācanamiṣyate" iti | prayogapārijāte smṛtyantare -- "garbhādhānādisaṃskāreṣviṣṭāpūrtakratuṣvapi | vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ purā kāryaṃ karmādau svastivācanam" iti | iṣṭānyagnyādhānadarśapūrṇamāsādīni darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākādīni ca | pūrtāni pratiṣṭhādīni | kratavo'gniṣṭomādayaḥ | vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ purā kāryamityetasya vacanasya yathāśrutamarthamanusarantaḥ pūrvaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tataḥ svastivācanamityetādṛśaḥ krameṇaiva kecidanuṣṭhānamācaranti | anye tu garbhādhānādītyasminvākye pūrvaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ tataḥ svastivācanamityetāvataiva siddhe punaḥ karmādāvityuktirvṛddhiśrāddhasahitakarmaṇa ādau svastivācanaprāptyarthā | tena pūrvaṃ svastivācanamanantaraṃ vṛddhiśrāddhamityevānuṣṭhānakrama ityāhuḥ | baudhāyanena sarvatra nāndīśrāddhasya saṃskāradinātpūrvedyuranuṣṭhānamuktam | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe tu -- "mahatsu pūrvedyustadaharalpeṣu" ityevaṃ vyavasthoktā | mahatsvanekadinasādhyeṣu | alpeṣvetadbhinneṣu | anyānyapi svastivācananimittāni saṃgraha uktāni -- "puṇye'hani tu saṃprāpte vivāhe caulake tathā | caulake caule | svārthe kapratyayaḥ | "vratabandhe ca yajñādau tathā jananakarmaṇi | gṛhārambhe dhanaprāptau tīrthābhigamane tathā | gṛhapraveśane caiva grāmasyābhiniveśane | navagrahamakhe śāntāvadbhutānāṃ tathaiva ca | gajabandhe turaṃgāṇāṃ dāsādīnāṃ ca saṃgrahe | dharmakarmasu sarveṣu prārambhe svastivācanam" iti | viśvaprakāśe -- "upākarmotsarjanayoḥ śrautānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathā | prathamānuṣṭhitāveva svastivācanamiṣyate" iti | upākarmotsarjanagrahaṇaṃ nityānāṃ śravaṇākarmāgrahāyaṇīsthālīpākādīnāmupalakṣaṇam | atra varṇānusāreṇa vidhiviśeṣamāha yamaḥ -- "puṇyāhavācanaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇasya vidhīyate | tadeva ca niroṃkāraṃ kuryātkṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ" iti || sarvamoṃkārasahitam | niroṃkāramoṃkārarahitam |ucairoṃkārarahitamiti kecit | saṃgrahe -- "śubhe karmaṇi puṇyāhavācane kalaśadvayam | sthāpayedaśubhe tvekamiti yajñavido viduḥ" iti | atra sthāpayeditivacanātsthāpanaviṣaya evāśubhasaṃbandhitā | tena śubhakarmasaṃbandhipuṇyāhavācane baudhāyanoktarītyā kalaśaikatve'pi na kṣatiḥ | tatra sthāpanābhāvāt | pūrvakartavyatāmāha hārītaḥ -- "gomayenopalipyorvīṃ raṅgavallikayā'rcayet | prasthadhānyaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyaṃ pūrṇaṃ hi kalaśadvayam | pratiṣṭhāpyamityatropasargātsunotīti ṣatvam | pūrṇamudakapūrṇam | dakṣiṇe cottare caiva uttare tu nidhāpayet | tāmbūlamakṣatā dravyaṃ dūrvāḥ puṣpāṇi candanam | kuṅkumāktāni pātrāṇi akṣatāḥ kuṅkumānvitāḥ | puṇyatīrthodakaṃ samyaṅnidhāya kalaśaṃ śubham | suvarṇaphalapuṣpādidravyaṃ tatra nidhāpayet | pātramakṣatapūrṇaṃ ca kalaśopari vinyaset" iti | ayamarthaḥ -- yatra svastivācanaṃ kariṣyanbhavati tatrā''dau gomayena bhūmimupalipya raṅgavallikayā tāṃ bhūṣayet | tato bhūṣitabhūpradeśāduttarataḥ prasthaparimitaṃ dhānyaṃ sthāpayiṣyamāṇakalaśadvayādhaḥpradeśadvaye puñjīkaraṇārthaṃ saṃsthāpya taduttarataḥ śuddhodakapūritaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ sthāpayiṣyamāṇakalaśadvayaparipūraṇārthamudaksaṃsthaṃ nidhāya taduttarataḥ pūjopayogitāmbūlādidravyāṇi saṃsthāpayet | tāmbūlākṣatādipātrāṇi kuṅkumena rañjitāni kāryāṇi | evaṃ kalaśadvayaṃ pūjopayogyakṣatāśca | puṇyatīrthajalapūritaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kalaśaṃ gaṇapatyādipūjārthaṃ nidhāya suvarṇaphaladhūpādidravyāṇi tṛtīyakalaśasamīpe nidhāya sthāpayiṣyamāṇakalaśadvayānanāpidhānārthaṃ pātradvayaṃ samīpe saṃsthāpya tatpūraṇārthākṣatāpātraṃ kalaśopari nidhāya saṃkalpamārabhediti | prasthapalayoḥ parimāṇam | prasthaparimāṇaṃ tu smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prastha āḍhako droṇa eva ca | dhānyamāneṣu boddhavyāḥ kramaśo'mī caturgaṇāḥ" iti | palaparimāṇaṃ bhaviṣyapurāṇe -- "paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ muṣṭirekaṃ palaṃ smṛtam" iti | skānde tvanyathoktam -- "pañcakṛṣṇalako māṣastaiścatuḥṣaṣṭibhiḥ palam" iti | kṛṣṇalo guñjā | tairmāṣaiḥ | dakṣiṇakalaśacālananiṣedhaḥ smṛtyantare -- "puṇyāhavācane caiva yaḥ kuryātkalaśārcanam | dakṣiṇasthaḥ sthiraścaiva uttarasthaścaro bhavet" iti | vāstoṣpata iti dhārāpātātprāksthiratā | kalaśadhātavaḥ pañcaratnāni ca | kalaśāḥ pañcaratnāni ca viṣṇudharmottare -- "haimarājatatāmrā vā mṛnmayā lakṣaṇānvitāḥ | suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ muktvā māṇikyaṃ ca pravālakam | pañcaratnamiti khyātaṃ samastasuravallabham" iti | pañcaratnābhāve hema -- "abhāve sarvaratnānāṃ hema sarvatra yojayet" ityādityapurāṇāt | pañca pallavāstvacaśca | pañca pallavāstvacaśca brahmāṇḍapurāṇaṃ -- "nyagrodhapippalaplakṣajambūcūtatarūdbhavāḥ | pallavāḥ pañca vijñeyāstvakaiteṣāmapīṣyate" iti | nyagrodho vaṭaḥ | pippalo'śvatthaḥ | plakṣaḥ pāyarīti bhāṣayā prasiddhaḥ | jambūḥ prasiddhā | cūta āmravṛkṣaḥ | eteṣāṃ tarūṇām | bhaviṣyapurāṇe tu jambūsthāna udumbara uktaḥ | sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ | sarvauṣadhyaśchandogapariśiṣṭe -- "kuṣṭhaṃ māṃsī haridre dve murā śaileyacandanam | saṭīcampakamustāśca sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti | kuṣṭhaṃ koṣṭhamiti bhāṣayā prasiddham | māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī | ekā haridrā prasiddhā | dvitīyā dāruhalada iti bhāṣayā prasiddhā | murā moravela iti paraśurāmakṣetre prasiddhā | śaileyaṃ śilārasaḥ | candanaṃ śvetacandanam | saṭī kacoraḥ | campakaḥ prasiddhastasya tvak | mustā bhadramothā | karmadevatānāmāni | karmadevatā āha baudhāyanaḥ -- "atha puṇyāhadevatā vyākhyāsyāmo vivāhasyāgniraupāsanasyāgnisūryaprajāpatayaḥ sthālīpākasyāgnirgarbhādhānasya brahmā puṃsavanasya prajāpatiḥ sīmantasya dhātā viṣṇubalerviṣṇurjātakarmaṇo mṛtyurnāmakarmaṇaḥ savitā tasyānte prajāpatirupaniṣkramaṇasya savitā tasyānte citriyāṇyannaprāśanasya savitā caulasya keśinastasyānte prajāpatirupanayanasyendraḥ śraddhāmedhe ante visarge suśravāḥ punarupanayanasyāgniratha yadi brahmacāryavratyamācarettasminnapāyahome savitā samāvartanasya śrīrindro vā śūlagavasyeśānaḥ pratyavarohaṇasya savitopākarmaṇi vrateṣu ca savitā vāstuhomasya vāstoṣpatirante prajāpatirahutahomasyendro'nte prajāpatirāyuṣyahomasyāgnirāyuṣmānnakṣatrahomasya nakṣatreṣṭiṣūktā'ṣṭamī pradoṣasyeśāna āgrayaṇasyā''grayaṇadevatāḥ sarpabaleḥ sarpā ekoddiṣṭasyānte prajāpatistaḍāgādīnāṃ varuṇo yakṣabaleryakṣā grahaśāntihomasyā''dityādinavagrahā nāgāritantrahome brahmādayaḥ prīyantāmityevamevānyeṣāṃ homānāṃ yānnyānuvākyayordevatā'sau prīyatāmiti sūtakānte pradhāmodakānte prajāpatiḥ kūṣmāṇḍahomasyā''dityādayaścāndrāyaṇasyāgnyādayo'gnyādheyasyāgnyādayo'gniṣṭoma indra evamanādiṣṭakarmasu prajāpatirityāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | puṇyāhavācanavidhiḥ | puṇyāhavācanavidhimapyāha sa eva -- "athātaḥ puṇyāhavācanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ śucau same deśe dūrvādarbhāndhārayamāṇāścatvāro brāhmaṇāḥ praśastā ariktahastāḥ prāṅmukhāstiṣṭhanti teṣāṃ dakṣiṇata udaṅmukho'pihitamudakumbhaṃ dhārayanvācayitā tasya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumāśritya patnayastiṣṭhanti tataḥ sapavitreṣu viprapāṇiṣu jalaṃ dadyādomāpa iti śivā āpaḥ santviti te pratyūcustato gandhā iti gandhaṃ dadāti sugandhāḥ pāntviti pratigṛhṇanti tataḥ sumanasa iti puṣpāṇi dadāti saumanasyamastviti pratigṛhṇanti tato'kṣatā ityakṣatāndadāti | akṣataśabdena vrīhimiśrāstaṇḍulā ucyante | akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstviti pratigṛhṇanti | tato dakṣiṇā iti dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti svasti dakṣiṇāḥ pāntu bahudeyaṃ cāstviti pratigṛhṇanti | tato vācayitā dakṣiṇaṃ jānu bhūmau nidhāya savyamutthāpyodaṅmukha iḍā devahūriti japitvodkumbhamādāyopottiṣṭhati | tato manaḥ samādhīyatāmiti vadati samāhitamanasaḥ sma iti viprāḥ pratyūcustato vācayitā prasīdantu bhavanta iti vadati prasannāḥ sma iti viprāḥ pratyūcustato vācayitā śāntirastu puṣṭirastu tuṣṭirastu vṛddhirastvavighnamastvāyuṣyamastvārogyamastu śivaṃ karmāstviti vadati tathā'stviti viprāḥ pratyūcuḥ karma yaddevatyaṃ bhavati tasya nāma gṛhṇātyasau prīyatāmiti | tataḥ puṇyāhaṃ bhavanto bruvantvityoṃ puṇyāhamiti viprāḥ pratyāhustataḥ svasti bhavanto bruvantvityoṃ svastīti viprāḥ pratyāhustata ṛddhiṃ bhavanto bruvantvityomṛdhyatāmiti viprāḥ pratyāhuḥ sarvāṇi tristrirvācayati | tato viprā upaviśya surabhimatyā'bliṅgābhirvāruṇībhirhiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhiśca vācayitāramabhiṣiñceyustato vācayitā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromiti japatītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | praśastāḥ śrāddhabhojanapratigrahādirahitāḥ | surabhimatī -- "dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam" ityṛgekā | abliṅgāḥ -- āpo hi ṣṭhādayaḥ | vāruṇyaḥ -- "yacciddhi te" ityādayaḥ | hiraṇyavarṇāḥ -- "hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ" ityādayaḥ | pāvamānyaḥ -- "pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ" ityanuvākopāttāḥ | anyatspaṣṭam | atha sakalaśiṣṭaparigṛhītaḥ puṇyāhavācanaprayogaḥ | sapatnīkaḥ kartā kṛtanityakriyaḥ kṛtamāṅgalikasnānaḥ svalaṃkṛto baddhaśikho gomayenopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau kaṃcitpradeśaṃ puṇyāhavācanakalaśasthāpanārthaṃ raṅgavallikābhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā taduttarata uktarītyā sarvānsaṃbhārānnidhāya raṅgavallikābhūṣitapradeśasya paścādvastrācchādite pīṭhe prāṅmukha upaviśya patnīṃ svasya dakṣiṇataḥ prāṅmukhīmupaveśya taddakṣiṇato yugmānbrāhmaṇānudaṅmukhānsvasyottarataḥ prāṅmukhānyopaveśayet | putrādisaṃskārakarmāṅgapuṇyāhavācanādau tu patnīdakṣiṇataḥ saṃskāryo'pyupaveśanīyaḥ | tataḥ pavitrapāṇirācamya prāṇānāyamyeṣṭadevatādinamaskāra pūrvakaṃ sumukhaścaityādīnmaṅgalaślokānpaṭhitvā etacchrāddhaṃ mātṛkāpūjanaṃ caikasyānekasaṃskāreṣvekakartṛkeṣu yugapadupasthiteṣu sarvādau sakṛdeva kāryaṃ na tu pratisaṃskāramāvṛttiḥ | yathā daivādakṛtajātakarmādikasyopanayanakāle jātakarmādyanuṣṭhāne deśāntaragatasya mṛtabuddhyā kṛtaurdhvadehikasyā''gatasya punarjātakarmādisaṃskārāṇāṃ vihitānāṃ yugapadanuṣṭhāne karmanāśājalaspṛṣṭādīnāṃ prāyaścittārthatvena vihitānāṃ punaḥsaṃskārāṇāṃ yugapadanuṣṭhāne vā | tathā ca brahmapurāṇam -- "gaṇaśaḥ kriyamāṇānāṃ mātṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ sakṛt | sakṛdeva bhavecchrāddhamādau na pṛthagādiṣu" iti || (bahvapatyānāṃ yugapatsaṃskārakaraṇaviṣayamidaṃ vacanamiti bopadeva āha |) mātṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ sakṛditipṛthagvacanādevaṃ jñāyate mātṛpūjanaṃ nāndīśrāddhasyānaṅgameva bhavatīti | ato'sminkalpe mātṛkāpūjanasya pṛthageva saṃkalpaḥ | yatra yatra bhavecchrāddhaṃ tatra tatra ca mātaraḥ" iti purāṇāntaravacanenāṅgatvam | asminkalpe na pṛthaksaṃkalpaḥ | athaitatkālaḥ | karmārambhāvyavahitapūrvatanadine mātṛpārvaṇaṃ karmārambhadine pitṛpārvaṇaṃ karmasamāptyuttaradine mātāmahapārvaṇam | evaṃ kartumaśaktau karmārambhāvyavahitapūrvatanadinatraye krameṇa pārvaṇatrayaṃ kāryam | prathamadine mātṛpārvaṇaṃ dvitīyadine pitṛpārvaṇaṃ tṛtīyadine mātāmahapārvaṇamiti | evaṃ kartumaśaktau karmārambhadinātpūrvasminnahanyeva pūrvāhṇe mātṛpārvaṇaṃ madhyāhne pitṛpārvaṇa maparāhṇe mātāmahapārvaṇamiti | atrāpyaśaktau pūrvasminnahani pūrvāhṇa eva pārvaṇatrayaṃ tantreṇa kāryaṃ, tadārambhadina eva vā | putrajanmani tu bhuktavatā'pi putrajanmānantarameva rātrāvapi kāryam | yajñādau kriyamāṇe nāndīśrāddhe'mūlā darbhā hastayordhāraṇīyāḥ | vivāhādimaṅgalakarmādau kriyamāṇe darbhasthāne dūrvā eva | agnyādhānasomayāgādau kriyamāṇe nāndīśrāddhe dakṣakratū, anyatra satyavasū iti kecit | garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīmanteṣvapi dakṣakratū ityanye | garbhādhānapuṃsavanasīmantasomeṣveva dakṣakratū nānyatretyapare | nāndīśrāddhādhikāriṇaḥ | athādhikāriṇaḥ | prathamavivāhānteṣu sutasaṃskāreṣu pitā vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ kuryāt | dvitīyādivivāhe tu vara eva kuryāt | prathamavivāhe yadi pitrādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāmadhikāriṇāmabhāvastadā'pi svayameva | pravāsādinā piturabhāvena jyeṣṭhabhrātā kurvansvapituḥ pitṛbhyo dadyān | yadi tu pitā na jīvati pitāmahastu pravāsasthitastadā pitṛprapitāmahavṛddhaprapitāmahānuddiśya pārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ mātṛmātāmahapārvaṇayorapi draṣṭavyam | sarveṣāṃ jīvane nāndīśrāddhalopa eva | nityavannāndīśrāddhavidhinaiva naiva kuryāditilopaśāstramahakṛtena tatprāpaṇāt | sarveṣāṃ yathoktādhikāriṇāmabhāvena yadi mātā putryā vivāhaṃ kuryāttadā svayaṃ saṃkalpamātraṃ kṛtvā svastivācananāndīśrāddhādikaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇadvārā kārayediti prayogapārijāte | samāvartane nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitaiva kuryāt | pravāsādinā piturabhāve svayameva kuryāditi kecit | atra pitari vidyamāne'pi svayameva kuryādityanye | sutasaṃskāreṣu ajīvanmātṛpitṛmātāmahaḥ pitā svamātrādyuddeśyakaṃ pārvaṇatrayaṃ kuryāt | mātari jīvantyāṃ tatpārvaṇalopaḥ | mātāmahe jīvati tatpārvaṇasya | tadā pārvaṇadvayenaiva nāndīśrāddhasiddhiḥ | mātṛmātāmahajīvane pitṛpārvaṇenaiva nāndīśrāddhasiddhiḥ | pitṛmātṛjīvane mātāmahapārvaṇenaiva | pitṛmātāmahajīvane devarahitena mātṛpārvaṇenaiva | jīvatprapitāmahaḥ pitṛpitāmahavṛddhaprapitāmahānuddiśya pitṛpārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | jīvatpitāmahaprapitāmahaḥ pitṛvṛddhaprapitāmahātivṛddhaprapitāmahānuddiśya pitṛpārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ mātṛmātāmahapārvaṇayorapi draṣṭavyam | sāpatnamātari mṛtāyāṃ tayā sahaiva mātṛpārvaṇaṃ kāryam | sapatnyoḥ pitāmahīprapitāmahyorapi svapitāmahīprapitāmahībhyāṃ saha svamātari jīvantyāmapi sāpatnamātrā mātṛpārvaṇanirvāha iti kecit | tanna | tasyā ekoddiṣṭadevatātvena pārvaṇe'nupraveśābhāvāt | āparapakṣikānvaṣṭakyādiśrāddhavatprāpakavacanābhāvācca | mātāmahapārvaṇe mukhyamātāmahyādiṣu jīvantīṣu tatsapatnībhiḥ sapatnīkatvaguṇopapattirdraṣṭavyeti kecit | vargatrayādyānāṃ jīvane sutasaṃskāreṣu nāndīśrāddhalopa eva | evaṃ svasya dvitīyādivivāhāṅgatvena nāndīśrāddhaṃ kurvañjīvatpitṛkastu pituḥ pitrādīnuddiśya pārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | jīvatpitṛpitāmahastu pitāmahasya pitrādīnuddiśya pārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | atra piturityasya sthāne pitāmahasya nirdeśaḥ | evaṃ mātṛmātāmahapārvaṇayorapi | evameva jātakarmanimittake puruṣārthe nāndīśrāddhe jātakarmāṅgabhūtadvitīyanāndīśrāddhaputraprathamavivāhāṅgabhūtanāndīśrāddhe tu sutasaṃskārāṅgakanāndīśrāddhavadeva kārye ityekaṃ matam | sutasaṃskāreṣvityudvāhaputrajananavyatiriktasutasaṃskāraparam | evaṃ ca prathamavivāhaputrajananayorapi yebhya eva pitā dadyāditiśāstrānurodhenaiva nāndīśrāddhaṃ bhavatītyaparaṃ matam | jīvatpitṛkaḥ sutasaṃskāravyatiriktakarmasu yebhya evetiśāstrātpituḥ pitāmahādīnuddiśya svamātṛmātāmahayorajīvatostaduddeśena pārvaṇadvayaṃ ca kuryāditi kecidvadanti | tanna | parasparaviruddhasya yebhya evetiśāstrasya gṛhyapariśiṣṭasya caikatra pravṛttyayogāt | yadā tu pitṛvyamātulādayaḥ kanyāvivāhaṃ kumārasyopanayanamupanītasya prathamavivāhaṃ vā kuryustadā saṃskāryasyājīvatpitṛmātamātāmahakatve tatpitrādīnuddiśya pārvaṇatrayaṃ kuryuḥ | sodarajyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ prayoge viśeṣo nāsti, tadīyapitrādīnāṃ saṃskāryapitrādibhirabhedāt | sāpatnajyeṣṭhastu saṃskāryasya mātrādīruddiśya mātṛpārvaṇaṃ kuryāditi kecit | mātṛpārvaṇalopa evātretyanye | pitṛvyādistu sarveṣu pārvaṇeṣu saṃskāryasyeti saviśeṣaṇaprayogaṃ kuryāt | saṃskāryasya jīvatpitṛmātṛmātāmahakatve tasya pituḥ pitrādīnudiśya pārvaṇatrayaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ prathamavivāhe'pi kartrantarābhāvavaśena vara eva nāndīśrāddhaṃ kurvañjīvatpitṛkaḥ pituḥ pitrādīnuddiśya pārvaṇaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ mātṛmātāmahapārvaṇayorapīti kecit | anye tvasminviṣaye tattadvargādyajīvane tattatpārvaṇalopa eveti vadanti | "ātmīkṛtya suvarṇena parakīyāṃ tu kanyakām | dharmyeṇa vidhinā dātumasagotro'pi yujyate" iti skāndāt | "anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dattvā sadṛśe nā'dhike vare | dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnoti kanyādāne yadīritam" || iti viṣṇudharmottaravacanādvā kenāpi hetunā kanyāṃ dātumaśaknuvatā dānādhikāriṇā tvaṃ kanyādānaṃ kurviti prārthanādvā yaḥ parakanyāṃ dātumicchati so'pi saṃskāryakanyāyāḥ pitrādīnuddiśya tasyā jīvatpitṛkatve tadīyamātrādyuddeśyakapārvaṇānuṣṭhānaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ kuryāt | dattakaputrastu yadi labdhabījirikthastadobhau pitarau pitāmahau prapitāmahau coddiśya kuryāt | evamitarayoḥ pārvaṇayorbodhyam | yadi tu bījirikthagrahaṇe'dhikāryantarasaṃbhavāt "gotrarikthe janayiturna bhajeddattimaḥ sutaḥ" iti | tatrāgnyāyatanadeśo gṛhye -- "prācīnapravaṇa udīcīnapravaṇe prāgudakpravaṇe same vā deśa uddhatyāvokṣya" iti | asyārthaḥ -- prācīnapravaṇādyanyatame deśa āyatanaṃ vidhāya tadabhryā'nyena vā khanitreṇoddhatyāvokṣet | pravaṇaḥ kramanimnaḥ | same vā deśa iti saptamīnirdeśena deśavyatiriktasyaiva kasyacitpadārthasyoddhananādikriyākarmatve pradarśite tatra sa ca kaḥ padārtha ityākāṅkṣāyāmāyatanapadārthasya grahaṇam | (etena kevale deśa evoddhananaprokṣaṇe uktvā tatra sthaṇḍilakaraṇamuktaṃ tatparāstam |) tatpramāṇaṃ śulbasūtre -- "piśīlamātrā bhavantīti dhiṣṇiyānāṃ vijñāyate" iti | piśīlaṃ ṣaḍvidham | aṣṭādaśāṅgulamekaṃ, viṃśatyaṅgulaṃ dvitīyaṃ, bāhvorantarālaṃ tṛtīyaṃ, baddhamuṣṭī ratniriti caturthaṃ, caturviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ pañcamaṃ, ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ ṣaṣṭham | ghiṣṇiyānyagnyāyatanāni | vijñāyata ityatra śrutiriti śeṣaḥ | aṅgulapramāṇaṃ baudhāyanenoktam -- "athāṅgulapramāṇaṃ caturdaśāṇavaścatustriṃśattilāḥ pṛthusaṃśliṣṭā ityaparam" iti | sarvapramāṇaśeṣatvādaṅgulapramāṇamucyata iti śeṣaḥ | aṇurdhānyaviśeṣaḥ | parasparasaṃśliṣṭāścaturdaśāṇavo yāvatpramāṇaṃ tāvadaṅgulapramāṇamityarthaḥ | kośasaṃsthānavatpṛthupradeśena saṃśliṣṭāścatustriṃśattilā aṅgulapramāṇamityaparaṃ matamiti vyākhyātametaddvārakānāthena | aṇuśabdapravṛttinimittaṃ kośa āha -- "vrīhibhedastvaṇuḥ pumān" iti | kecittvaṅgulapramāṇamaṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ madhyāṅgulimadhyamaparvamātraṃ vetyāhuḥ | etacca pramāṇaṃ yajamānasyādhvaryorvā grāhyam | "yajamānasyādhvaryorvaiṣa hi ceṣṭānāṃ kartā bhavati" iti śulbasūtrāt | atrādhvaryorabhāvātsvasyaiva pramāṇam | sācārye karmaṇi pākṣikatvenā''cāryasyāpi pramāṇaṃ grahītuṃ śakyaṃ tasyādhvaryutulyatvāt | sāṅgamāyatanaṃ smṛtāvuktam -- "aratnimātraṃ vijñeyamagnerāyatanaṃ śubham | śraute caupāsane kaṇṭhakhātayonivivarjitam | mekhalādvitayaṃ kāryaṃ rekhālagnaṃ tu bāhyataḥ | bāhyā dvyaṅgulavistārā''bhyantarā caturaṅgulā | bāhyā ṣaḍaṅgulotsedhā''bhyantarā dvādaśāṅgulā" iti | atraupāsanagrahaṇaṃ āgantukyāścihnamardhe śroṇyaṃsārdhaṃ tu tadbhavet | lakṣmāntarārdhe pāśau dvāvabhitaḥ sarvarajjuṣu || 2 || pṛṣṭhyāṃ prāgāyatāṃ kṛtvā śaṅkūnnyasyetpramāṇataḥ | dīrghabhāgasthitaṃ pāśaṃ pūrvaśaṅkau śroṇiṃ prakalpayet || 5 || tataḥ pāśau viparyasya tasyāṃsau kalpayetpuraḥ, iti || viśvakarmā'pi -- "kṛtvā prāksūtramṛjvekaṃ dakṣiṇottaramatsyayoḥ | nyasya sūtraṃ tataḥ koṇairaṅkitaiścaturaśrakam" iti | prāgaparasūtraṃ hastādīṣṭapramāṇakaṃ kṛtvā matsyena sādhitayordakṣiṇottaradiśostatpramāṇaṃ sūtramubhayataḥ samārdhaṃ kṛtvā tāvatpramāṇena sūtreṇa kṛtamadhyakarṣaṇena matsyena vā catuṣkoṇāṅkaiścaturaśraṃ saṃpannaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | kuṇḍarūpāgnyāyatanakaraṇāśaktau sthaṇḍile kāryam -- "kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'pi homakarma samācaret" iti smṛtisārokteḥ | etanmānaṃ gṛhyakārikāsu -- "hastamātraṃ catuṣkoṇaṃ bāhumātramathāpi vā | caturaṅgulamucchrāyaṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ sarvakarmasu" iti | atroktasya pramāṇadvayasya homānusāreṇa vyavasthā jñeyā | saṃgrahe'pi -- "caturaśraṃ ca suślakṣṇaṃ tulyaṃ sūtreṇa sādhayet | samaṃ vedāṅgulocchrāyaṃ prāgudakpravaṇaṃ bhavet | adhikaṃ veṣumātraṃ vā kuryāddhomānusārataḥ" iti | paridhita iṣumātraṃ na tu sarvata iti jñeyam | aṣṭādaśāṅgulāṣṭādaśāṅgulātmakacaturjyaṃ kartavyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | iṣuraratnitrayātmakaḥ -- "triraratniriṣuḥ smṛtaḥ" ityāpastambokteḥ | aratnipramāṇaṃ śulbasūtre -- "caturviṃśatyaṅgulayo'ratnistadardhaṃ prādeśa iti klṛptiḥ" iti | etatsūtravyākhyāne sārvatrikī caiṣā klṛptiriti sundarakaravindābhyāṃ vyākhyātam | kūrparamārabhya kaniṣṭhikāparyanta āyāmo'ratniriti smṛtyantare | śatapatha iṣupramāṇamanyathoktam -- "pañcaprādeśa iṣurbhavati" iti | asminkalpe pañcadaśāṅgulapañcadaśāṅgulātmakacaturjyaṃ bhavati | sikatāpramāṇaṃ varṇaviśeṣeṇā''kāraviśeṣaśca baudhāyanasūtre -- "pañcaprasthasikatāḥ śucayaḥ śuklā anārdrā aratnimātraṃ samacaturaśraṃ brāhmaṇasya raktavarṇaṃ trikoṇaṃ kṣattriyasya pītavarṇaṃ rathacakravadvaiśyasya prākpravaṇamudakpravaṇaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ karoti" iti | sikatā mṛtpāṃsavaḥ | pañcaprasthasikatā iti pramāṇaṃ hastamātrābhiprāyam | karaṇaprakāramapyāha sa eva -- "sikatāścaturaṅgulaṃ prācīnamucchrayati pañcāṅgulaṃ paścādūrdhvāṅguliviśeṣaṃ dakṣiṇata ūrdhvāṅgulipramāṇamuttarataḥ" iti | paścādityantaṃ prākpravaṇatvapakṣe | ūrdhvāṅguliviśeṣamityādyudakpravaṇatvapakṣe | ūrdhvāṅgulipramāṇasya yāvānviśeṣo bhavati tāvatparimito dakṣiṇata ucchrāyaḥ | ūrdhvāṅgulipramāṇa uttarata ucchrāya ityarthaḥ | viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ śūlbasūtre -- "pramāṇaṃ tṛtīyena vardhayettacca caturthenā''tmacatustriṃśonena" iti | pradeśinyā madhyamāyā vordhvāṅguleḥ pramāṇaṃ tredhā vibhajya tadekāṃśaparimitamaṃśaṃ vardhayitvā tadaṃśacaturthāṃśaṃ svacatustriṃśāṃśonaṃ tatra saṃyojya tāvatparimitā dakṣiṇata ucchrittiḥ kāryā | uttaratastūrdhvāṅgulipramāṇocchritiriti tātparyārthaḥ | śāstrāntare tu -- "prākpravaṇamudakpravaṇaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ karoti pañcāṅgulocchrāyaṃ paścāccaturaṅgulocchrāyaṃ purata evamevānyatra" iti | anyatra, udakpravaṇatve | yadyapi prāgudakpravaṇapakṣo'tra noktastathāpi deśe prāgudakpravaṇatāyā darśanādatra prāptiḥ | baudhāyanenaiteṣāṃ pakṣāṇāṃ kāmyatvamapyuktam -- "prācīnapravaṇaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasyodīcīnapravaṇamannādyakāmasya prāgudakpravaṇaṃ prajākāmasya samaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmasya" iti | sikatādoṣānapyāha sa eva -- "athātaḥ sikatādoṣānvyākhyāsyāmo bhasmakeśatuṣakapālaśarkarātṛṇāsthipipīlikāvatībhirārdrābhiḥ sikatābhirvajayedbhasmanā yajamānakṣayaḥ keśena strīmaraṇaṃ tuṣaiḥ putranāśaḥ kapālairarthanāśaḥ śarkarābhirbandhuviyogastṛṇena karmakṣayo'sthnā grāmanāśaḥ pipīlikābhī rāṣṭranāśa ārdrasikatābhirbhayaṃ bhavatītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | varjayedityanantaraṃ sthaṇḍilakaraṇamiti śeṣaḥ | pipīlikāgrahaṇaṃ jantūpalakṣaṇam | vidhānapārijāte sthaṇḍilocchrāye viśeṣa uktaḥ -- "kāryā śatārdhe'ṅgulasaṃmitocchritiḥ śatāhutau dvyaṅgulasaṃmitocchritiḥ | sahasrahome caturaṅgulocchritirvasvaṅgulā syādayute samucchritiḥ || nṛpāṅgulā lakṣahatau samucchritirviśāṅgulā syātprayute samucchritiḥ | tattvāṅgulā koṭimakhe samucchritistato'dhikaṃ no vidadhīta mānakam" iti | atha prasaṅgādbahvāhutikaśāntyādikarmopayogikuṇḍasthaṇḍilayoḥ parimāṇam | tatraikonapañcāśatsaṃkhyāhutiparyantaṃ sthaṇḍilameva | taccāṣṭādaśāṅgulaparimāṇaṃ parito'ṅguṣṭhonnatam | agre kuṇḍena saha vikalpo'śaktiśaktibhyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ | jñeyam | muṣṭyā vā caturaṅgulāni | ardhayavonacatustriṃśadaṅgulairdvihastaṃ sārdhaikacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaistrihastamaṣṭacatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiścaturhastaṃ pādonacatuṣpañcāśadaṅgulaiḥ pañcahastaṃ
