sthaṇḍilaṃ vā bhavati | kuṇḍāṅgānāṃ vyāsakhātanābhikaṇṭhamekhalāyonīnāṃ samyagjñāna eva kuṇḍaṃ yuktaṃ bhavati | tatkaraṇaprakārastu śāntiprakaraṇe vakṣyate | sthaṇḍilaṃ caturaśramaṅgulotsedhaṃ caturaṅagulotsedhaṃ vā | samatvapakṣe sthūladravyahome tattatparimāṇasyāparyāptau svottaraparimāṇamapi grāhyam | yattu kārikākṛtoktam -- "sthaṇḍilāttaṇḍulairekhā dvyaṅgulā dvyaṅgulādhikā | ekarekhaṃ dvirekhaṃ vā agnibhadraṃ tu kārayet" iti, tatra mūlaṃ cintyam | āyatanasya gomayenopalepanādikamuktaṃ saṃgraha āyatanasaṃskāraṃ prakṛtya -- "tadgomayenopalimpet" iti | tadagnyāyatanam | etatkāraṇamuktaṃ smṛtiratnākare purāṇe -- "sarvatra vasudhā medhyā saśailavanakānanā | atha viṣṇupadākrāntopalepanamidaṃ kutaḥ || purā śakro hi vajreṇa vṛtraṃ hatvā mahāsuram | tanmedasā hi nirliptā tadarthamupalepanam" iti || uddhananottaraṃ yadi śvā sthaṇḍilādāvadhitiṣṭhati tadā prāyaścittaviśeṣa ukto baudhāyanena -- "sthaṇḍilamuddhataṃ gauraśvo vā yadi vikiredanyadvā śvāpadamadhitiṣṭhettasya padamabhyukṣya japati pṛthivi devayajanyopadhyāste mūlaṃ mā hi siṣamiti kṛtāntātkarma pratipadyate" iti | (vikirenmūtrādibhirvikīrṇaṃ kuryāt | athavā saptamyarthe dvitīyā | asmi pakṣe vikiredityasya retomūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | adhitiṣṭhedityatra dvitīyānte sthaṇḍiloddhatapade anuvartanīye |) sthaṇḍilagrahaṇaṃ kuṇḍopalakṣaṇam | śvagrahaṇaṃ niṣiddhadvipadacatuṣpadapaśūpalakṣaṇam | rekhālekhanaprakāro'vokṣaṇādi ca dharmasūtre -- "yasmindeśe'gnimupasamādhāsyansyāttatra prācīrudīcīśca tisrastisro rekhā likhitvā'vokṣyotsicya tadudakaśeṣamuttareṇa pūrveṇa vā'nyadupanidadhyāt" iti | yatra kutra gārhye sāmayācārike vā karmaṇi gṛhe'raṇye vā'gnimupasamādhāsyanpratiṣṭhāpayiṣyansyāttatra pūrvaṃ prācīḥ prāgagrāstisra udagapavargā rekhā likhet | udagagrāstisraḥ prāgapavargā rekhā likhitvā'dbhiravokṣet | avokṣyaitadavokṣaṇodakamagnerāyatanasyottarataḥ pūrvato votsiñcet | utsicyānyadudakaṃ pātrasthamupadadhyāt | pāke tu striyā(yo) na bhavati(nti) | upasamādhāsyanniti liṅgasya vivakṣitatvāt | āryāḥ prayatā ityatra tu bhavatīti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | avokṣaṇodakādanyadudakaṃ karmaparyāptamavokṣaṇapātrasthaṃ kṛtvā svasamīpe nidadhyāt | athavā śuddhajalapūritakalaśasthamudakamavokṣaṇotsecanārthaṃ pātrāntare gṛhītvā tenodakenāvokṣaṇotsecane kṛtvā'nyadavaśiṣṭaṃ kalaśapātrasthamudakaṃ karmārthaṃ svasamīpe nidadhyāt | arthata evaṃ samīpa udakanidhāne siddhe'tra vacanamutsecanottarameva yasmātkalaśādavokṣaṇotsecanārthamudakaṃ gṛhītaṃ tasya kalaśasya svasamīpe sthāpanārtham | tenotsecanaparyantaṃ gṛhamadhya eva kalaśo bhavediti siddhaṃ bhavati | athavā tāvatparyantaṃ bhūmau tatkalaśasthāpanaṃ vārayitumatra vacanam | na caitasyādṛṣṭārthatvamevāstviti vācyaṃ, praṇītādyudakakāryaniṣpādanarūpe dṛṣṭe saṃbhavatyadṛṣṭakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt | utsecanābhāve'pyāvaśyakatvādetadbhavatyeva | rekhālekhanāvokṣaṇotsecananidhānānāṃ dharmasūtre vidhānaṃ parisaṃkhyānabalādagnikāryādiṣu pariṣekādivyatiriktagṛhyavihitatantranivṛttau tadvihitatvādrekhālekhanāvokṣaṇotsecananidhānānāmapi nivṛttiḥ syātsā mā bhūdityetadartham | gṛhyokte karmaṇyeteṣāmanāvaśyakatvārthaṃ vā | udakanidhānaṃ tvāvaśyakatvādbhavatyeva | vaiśvadeve tu naitadapi bhavati | yathopadeśaṃ kuruta iti viśeṣavacanena bādhāt | rekhālekhanādyudakanidhānāntamuddhananātprāgeva kartavyaṃ na tūddhananāvokṣaṇayormadhye | uddhatyāvokṣyetilyapā bodhitasyoddhananāvokṣaṇayoravyavadhānasya bādhāpatteḥ | uddhananāvokṣaṇayoravyavadhānaṃ bādhitvā madhya eva kartavyatā tadā vaktavyā, yadā dharmasūtroktollekhanādīnāṃ madhye kartavyatāyāṃ pramāṇamupalabhyeta | tadevātra nāsti | pratyutoddhananāvokṣaṇayoravyavadhānaṃ bahuṣu dṛṣṭamasti | na ca śiṣṭākopanyāyena vedakaraṇavedikaraṇayormadhye kṣute yathobhayoravyavahitatvabādhastathā'nayorapi so'stviti vācyam | tatra kṣutakramayorekadoṣasthitatvenānayoḥ kiṃ bādhyamiti vicāre prāpte padārthadharmarūpakramāpekṣayā padārtharūpakṣutanimittācamanasya prābalyādavyavahitatvabādhasya jaimininā svīkṛtatvātprakṛta uddhananānantaramevollekhanaṃ kartavyamityetādṛśe'rthe pramāṇābhāvenaitayoravyavahitatvabādhasyākalpanāt | na ca mātṛdattenoddhananottaramevollekhanādīnāṃ pradarśanāttadanantaramevānuṣṭhānamiti vācyam | (punarityādibhāṣyagranthasyollekhanāvokṣaṇotsecanodakanidhānānyapi dharmaśāstroktatvātkartavyānītyevaṃrītyā saṃgrahamātraparatāyā eva lyabbodhitāvyavahitānantaryabādhāpattyā kalpanāt | na cāstvavyavahitānantaryabādhaḥ, tathā ca kramabodhakatvameva punarityādigranthasyeti vācyam | avyavahitānantaryānuguṇyenaiva nirvāhe taditarakalpanāyā anucitatvāt | uddhatyettyasya saṃskāryapadārthasādhanapadārthapradarśanārthamātramuktiḥ | na tvavokṣaṇanivṛtyarthā | anyathā sūtraviruddhatvena bhāṣyagranthasyāprayojakatvāpatteḥ | avokṣaṇānuktistu spaṣṭatvāt | punadharmaśāstre darśanādityatra punaḥśabdena tatsattvaṃ sūcitam | katham | punarityasyā''vṛttibodhakatvenoddhananasya dharmasūtroktānāmullekhanādināṃ vā''vṛttyabhāvenoddhanana ullekhanādiṣu vā'nvayāsaṃbhavenāvokṣaṇasya vāradvayaṃ saṃbhavāddharmasūtroktāvokṣaṇātpūrvameva punaḥśabdasyānvaye satyarthāduddhananottaramanyadavokṣaṇamastīti | etenoddhananāvokṣaṇottarabhāvitvamullekhanādīnāmiti śaṅkā'pi nirastā |) ekame(ma)vokṣaṇamutsecanādikaṃ cedānīṃ nānutiṣṭhanti paddhatyantare likhitaṃ ca nāsti tadbhrāntimūlakameva | dharmasūtre eteṣāṃ vidhānabalādanāvaśyakamiti kṛtvā paddhatyantare na likhitamiti yadyucyate tadollekhanamapi na lekhanīyam | ullekhanasyevāvokṣaṇotsecanayorapyekasūtrapraṇītatvenollekhanakaraṇākaraṇādhīnatvenollekhanaṃ likhitamavokṣaṇādikaṃ na likhitamityatra bhrāntireva mūlaṃ paśyāmaḥ | rekhālekhanasādhanāni (baudhāyanagṛhye -- "na loṣṭena na kāṣṭhena na śarkarayā na nakhena | kāṣṭhena vai vyādhitaḥ syālloṣṭena kulanāśanam | śarkarayā putranāśaḥ syānnakhena bandhunāśanam | tasmātsuvarṇarajatatāmraśakalena vrīhibhiryavairvā darbhairaṅguṣṭhena ca mahānāmnyā copasaṃgṛhya tasya madhyamaṃ prācīna saṃtatamṛjumullikhet" ityādi | mahānāmnī, upakaniṣṭhikā | upasaṃgrahaṇāntamevāvirodhādatropayujyate | rekhālekhanaprakārastu tisraḥ prācīstisra udīcī rekhāḥ kṛtvetyanena viruddhatvānnopayujyate) | gobhilapariśiṣṭe -- "na nakhena na kāṣṭhena nāśmanā mṛnmayena vā | prollikhetsthaṇḍilaṃ vipraḥ siddhikāmastu yo bhavet || bhavennakhena kunakhī kāṣṭhena vyādhimṛcchati | aśmanā dhananāśaḥ syānmṛnmayena kalirdhuvam || phalena susamṛddhaḥ syātpuṣpeṇa śriyamṛcchati | parṇena dhanalābhaḥ syāddīrghamāyuḥ kuśena tu || tasmātphalena puṣpeṇa parṇenātha kuśena vā tāmraśalkayutenā''dau likhetsthaṇḍilamuttamam" iti | avokṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ saṃgrahe -- "avācīnena hastena kartavyaṃ syādavokṣaṇam" iti | gṛhye -- "agniṃ mathitvā laukikaṃ vā''tdṛtya nyuṣyopasamādadhāti" iti | yājñikātkāṣṭhādagniṃ mathitvā śrotriyāgārāllaukikaṃ vā''tdṛtyā''yatanamadhye saṃsthāpya kāṣṭhānyabhyādhāya prajvalayatītyarthaḥ | saṃgrahe -- "kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'laṃ tattannāmnā havirbhujam | sthāpayenmadhyadeśe tu" iti | smṛtisāre'pi -- "kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'pi tattannāmnā havirbhujam | vyāhṛtībhirmadhyadeśe yogyaṃ svābhimukhaṃ kṣipet" iti | havirbhujamagnim | alaṃ paryāptam | alamityatra homāyeti śeṣaḥ | yogyatvaṃ ca dvedhā | araṇyādijatvaṃ pradīptabahulāṅgāramayatvaṃ ca | tatrā''dyamuktaṃ siddhāntaśekhare -- "uttamo'raṇijanyo'gniruttamaḥ sūryakāntajaḥ | madhyamaḥ śrotriyāgārādadhamaḥ svagṛhādijaḥ" iti | dvitīyaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "kuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile vā'pi madhyadeśe havirbhujam | dīptabahvaṅgāramayaṃ nirdhūmaṃ sthāpayedbudhaḥ" iti | agnipraṇayanapātrāṇyāhātriḥ -- "sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ tadabhāve tu mṛnmayam | pātrāntareṇa pihitamagnipraṇayane smṛtam" iti | gobhilo'pi -- "pātrāntareṇa pihite tāmrapātrādike śubhe | agnipraṇayanaṃ kuryāccharāve tādṛśe'pi vā" iti | tādṛśe pihite | śarāvo mṛnmayapātraviśeṣaḥ | yastu -- "śarāve bhinnapātre vā kapāle tvāyase'pi vā | nāgnipraṇayanaṃ kuryādvyādhihānibhayāvaham" iti smṛtisārokto niṣedhaḥ sa purāṇaśarāvaparaḥ | "taijase tāmrapātre vā śarāve'bhinave tu vā" iti nāradapañcarātravacane'bhinavaśarāvasya grāhyatvokteḥ | taijasapadaṃ gobalīvardanyāyena tāmretaraparam | (gobhilīyapariśiṣṭe -- "kapālairbhinnapātrairvā na tvāmairgomayena vā | agnipraṇayanaṃ kāryaṃ yajamānabhayāvaham" iti | bhinnapātrairmṛnmayairdhātumayaiśca | āmairityatra yogyatayā mṛnmayānāmeva grāhyam | gomayena gomayakhaṇḍena | anyadapi tatraiva -- "alpaḥ praṇīto vicchinno'samiddhaścāpariṣkṛtaḥ | tvarayā punarānīto yajamānabhayāvahaḥ || tasmācchubhena pātreṇa avicchinnākṛśaṃ bahu | agnipraṇayanaṃ kuryādyajamānaśubhāvaham | śubhaṃ pātraṃ tu kartavyaṃ yajamānasukhāvaham | śubhaṃ pātraṃ tu kāṃsyaṃ syāttenāgniṃ praṇayedbudhaḥ | tasyābhāve śarāveṇa navenābhimukhaṃ ca tam" iti | alpaḥ karmāparyāptaḥ | vicchinnaḥ karmaparyāptaḥ praṇīto'pi śithilabahvavayavaḥ | asamiddho'pradīptaḥ| apariṣkṛtaḥ pātrāntarapidhānādidharmo'saṃskṛtaḥ | alpatvātpunaḥpunarānītaḥ | avicchinnākṛśamityatra karmadhārayaḥ | bahviti kriyāviśeṣaṇam | sauvarṇādyabhāve kāṃsyam |) agnisthāpanaṃ vāgyatena kartavyam -- "agnisaṃsthāpanaṃ kuryādvāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ" | iti prayogadarpaṇe saṃgrahokteḥ | evaṃ homakāle'pi vāgyamaḥ -- "snāsyato varuṇaḥ kāntiṃ juhvato'gniḥ śriyaṃ haret | bhuñjato mṛtyurāyuṣyaṃ tasmānmaunaṃ triṣu smṛtam" | iti prayogapārijāte smṛtyantarokteḥ | tattannāmnā havirbhujaṃ sthāpayedityuktaṃ tatra kāni nāmānītyākāṅkṣāyāṃ pārijāte -- "pāvako laukiko hyagniḥ prathamaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ | agnistu māruto nāma garbhādhāne vidhīyate | tataḥ puṃsavane jñeyaḥ pavamānastathaiva ca | sīmante maṅgalo nāma prabalo jātakarmaṇi | nāmni vai pārthivo hyagniḥ prāśane tu śuciḥ smṛtaḥ | sabhyanāmā tu caule syādvratādeśe samudbhavaḥ | godāne sūryanāmā'gnirvivāhe yojakaḥ smṛtaḥ | caturthyāṃ tu śikhī prokto dhṛtiragnirathāpi vā | āvasathye dvijo jñeyo vaiśvadeve tu rukmakaḥ | prāyaścitte tu viṭcaiva pākayajñeṣu pāvakaḥ | devānāṃ havyavāhaśca pitṝṇāṃ kavyavāhanaḥ | śāntike varadaḥ proktaḥ pauṣṭike balavardhanaḥ | pūrṇāhutyāmiḍo nāma krodho'gniścā''bhicārike | vaśyārthe kāmado nāma vanadāhe tu dūṣakaḥ | kukṣau tu jāṭharo jñeyaḥ kravyādo mṛtadāhane | vahnināmā lakṣahome koṭihome hutāśanaḥ | samudre vāḍavo hyagniḥ kṣaye saṃvartakastathā | brahmā vai gārhapatyastu īśvaro dakṣiṇastathā | viṣṇurāhavanīyastu agnihotre trayo'gnayaḥ | jñātvaivamagnināmāni gṛhyakarma samārabhet" iti || yadyapyetadvacanasya nāmajñānamātraparataivāvagamyate tathā'pi -- "tattannāmnā havirbhujaṃ sthāpayet" | iti saṃgrahādivacane nāmākāṅkṣāpūraṇasyā''vaśyakatvādākāṅkṣāpūrakasya śāstrāntarasya cābhāvādetasya tadarthatā'pi draṣṭavyā | sthāpanaṃ tu praṇavāntābhirvyāhṛtibhiḥ kāryam | punarādheye -- "bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromityagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya" iti darśanāt | "bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaromityāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati" iti bharadvājokteśca | etacca praṇavāntatvamudāhṛtasmṛtisāravakṣyamāṇabaudhāyanavacanoktakevalavyāhṛtividhānena vikalpa(lpya)te | uddhananādyagnipratiṣṭhāpanāntaṃ yatra yatra "agnimupasamādhāya" iti sūtrakṛdvadati tatra | yatra na vadati tatra svasthāne'vasthite paristaraṇādividhinaiva kāryam | agniprajvalanamupasamādhānaṃ siddhānuvādameke manyante teṣāmaupāsane kartavyānāṃ samindhanādi, itaratroddhananādīti draṣṭavyam | etanmatameva yuktam "dakṣiṇāgnimupasamādhāya" iti darśanāt | nanu "dakṣiṇāgnimupasamādhāya" ityatrā''haraṇāsaṃbhavādastu prajvalanamupasamādhānaśabdārthaḥ, atra tu saṃbhavādāharaṇamevopasamādhānaśabdārthaḥ, sthalāntara āharaṇe siddhe sthāpanasyāpi siddhatvāttatsaṃbandhyuddhananādīnāmapi siddhiriti cenna | vairūpyāpatteḥ | nanvevaṃ tatra tatrānuvādo vyarthaḥ, prajvalanasyārthata eva siddheriti cet | satyam | tatra tatrānuvādasya sthānaniyamārthatvena vaiyarthyābhāvāt | yatra "agnimupasamādhāya" iti vacanaṃ tatroktasthāna eva kāryam | anyatra tvaniyamaḥ | uktasthāne tadakaraṇe sarvaprāyaścittaṃ naitadanyatreti draṣṭavyam | agniprajvalanaṃ nāprokṣitaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ kartavyam | taduktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "nāprokṣitamindhanamagnāvādadhyāt" iti | śraute smārte laukike'gnāvaprokṣitamindhanaṃ nā''dadhyāt | kecillaukike necchantītyujjvalākṛtā vyākhyātam | agniprabodhane viśeṣo dharmasūtre -- "na cainamupadhamet" iti | aprayata ityeva | enamagnimaprayato nopadhamet | prayatasya na doṣa ityeke | apara āhurmukhena nopadhamet | 'nāgniṃ mukhenopadhamet' iti mānave darśanāt | smṛtyantare tu -- "mukhenopadhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata" iti | ubhayorvikalpaḥ | apara āha vājasaneyake śrautaprakaraṇe -- " mukhādagnirajāyata tasmānmukhenopasamidhyate" iti darśanācchraute mukhenopadhamanamanyatra smārtaḥ pratiṣedha iti | anye tu vaiṇavenā''yasena vā sasuṣireṇopadhamanamicchanti | evamagnermukhavyāpārasyānvayācchrutirapyanugṛhītā bhavati |āsyabindūnāṃ pātanaśaṅkābhayātpratiṣedhasmṛtirapīti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | saṃgrahe -- "dhamanīmantarā kṛtvā tṛṇaṃ vā kāṣṭhameva vā | mukhenopadhamedagniṃ mukhādagnirajāyata | veṇoragni(gneḥ)prasūtatvādveṇuragneśca pāvanaḥ | tasmādveṇudhamanyaiva dharmadagniṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ" iti | śrutirapi -- "tejo vai veṇuḥ | tenaḥ pravargyaḥ | tejasaiva tejaḥ samardhayati" iti | agnerveṇusparśaniṣedha ukto granthāntare -- "na veṇunā'gniṃ saṃspṛśet" iti | atra vārjyānyāha devalaḥ -- "vastreṇa vā'tha parṇena pāṇiśūrpāsyadārubhiḥ | na kuryādagnidhamanaṃ na kuryādvyajanādinā" iti | saṃgrahe -- "parṇena dhamane vyādhiḥ śūrpeṇa dhananāśanam | pāṇinā mṛtyumāpnoti dāruṇā kāntināśanam | vastreṇa strīvināśaḥ syādāsyenā''yuṣkṣayo bhavet" iti | yattu "mukhena dhamanakriyā" iti mukhadhamanasya kalivarjanaṃ tatsākṣānmukhadhamanasyaiva, na tu -- "dhamanīmantarā kṛtvā" ityanena vihitasyāpīti draṣṭavyam | pratiṣṭhāpitāgnerupasthānaṃ tataḥ kartavyam | "vyāhṛtibhirnyuṣyopasamādhāyopatiṣṭhatejuṣṭo damūnā atithirduroṇa iti" iti baudhāyanavacanāt | tato'gnerdhyānaṃ kartavyam -- "hoṣyannagnervijānīyātsvarūpaṃ śruticoditam | ajānatā kṛtaṃ karma tadalpaphalamiṣyate" | iti gobhilavacanāt | śruticoditaṃ catvāri śṛṅgetiśruticoditam | idaṃ ca smṛticoditasya saptahastaścatuḥśṛṅga ityasyopalakṣaṇam | dhyāne viśeṣaḥ śāradātilake -- "vaiśvānaraṃ sthitaṃ dhyāyetsamiddhomeṣu deśikaḥ | śayānamājyahomeṣu niṣaṇṇaṃ śeṣavastuṣu" iti | etacca tāntrike karmaṇi niyatam || tato'nvādhānam | taccā''cārāt | prayogavaijayantyāmapyevam | atrā''cārādanvādhānamiti | tacca sthūlasamitrayābhyādhānarūpaṃ śraute dṛṣṭatvāt | tatra devatollekhanamapi śiṣṭāḥ kurvanti, tacca prayoge vakṣyate | yattvatra yathā''ha taditi parisamūhanaṃ prayogāntara uktaṃ tattuccham | agnikāryaprakaraṇoktasya pūrvatra prāptyabhāvāt | tataḥ paristaraṇādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "prāgagrairdarbhairagniṃ paristṛṇātyapi vodagagrāḥ paścātpurastācca bhavati dakṣiṇānuttarānkarotyuttarānadharānyadi prāgudagagrāḥ" iti | prāgagrairdarbhaiḥ purastāddakṣiṇataḥ paścāduttarata iti paristṛṇāti hrasvā udagapavargāḥ paścātpurastācca bhavanti | api vā paścātpurastācca ye darbhāsta udagagrā bhavanti prāgagrā eva dakṣiṇā uttarāśca | prāgudagagrā ityatra pratyekamagraśabdaḥ parisamāpyate, prāgagrā udagagrāśceti | yadi paristaraṇadarbhāḥ prāgudagagrā bhavantītyetasminpakṣa ityarthaḥ | tatra dakṣiṇāndarbhānpūrvāparebhyo darbhebhya upariśayānkaroti | uttarāṃśca darbhānadharānadhaḥśayānkarotītyarthaḥ | atra darbhairiti vacanādekaikasminbhāge catvāraścatvāro darbhā ācārāt | nyāyena tu bahutvaṃ tritve paryavasyatīti vaijayantyām | paristaraṇadeśāvadhimāha kaśyapaḥ -- "daśāṅgulapramāṇena paristīrya kuśānkramāt" iti | smṛtyantare tu pañcāṅgulaḥ paristaraṇadeśāvadhiruktaḥ -- "tribhiścaiva caturbhiśca pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgulaiḥ | secanaṃ paridhīṃścaiva staraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā" iti | tenātra vikalpaḥ | atrāgnikṣetraṃ bāhyamekhalā vā'pādānāvadhirdraṣṭavyaḥ | tato brahmāyatane kuśāstaraṇādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "dakṣiṇenāgniṃ brahmāyatane darbhānsaṃ stīrya mayi gṛhṇāmi yo no agniriti dvābhyāmātmannāgniṃ gṛhītvottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃ stīrya yathārthaṃ dravyāṇi prayunakti" iti | dakṣiṇena paristīrṇamagniṃ brahmaṇa āyatana upaveśanadeśe darbhānsamyagbahulānastīrtvā mayi yo no agniriti dvābhyāmātmīyamagnimātmani gṛhītvā tathā saṃkalpya japitvottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsamyagbahulānstīrtvā yathārthaṃ yathāprayojanaṃ dravyāṇi prayunaktītyarthaḥ | mayi yo na ityagniṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ dvābhyāṃ darbhābhyāṃ saṃsthāpyetyātmannagniṃ gṛhītvetyasyārtho gṛhyakārikākṛtā pradarśitaḥ sa bhāṣyavirodhādupekṣyaḥ | ātmanyagnigrahaṇasamaye sakuśaṃ dakṣiṇahastaṃ hṛdi dhṛtveti prayogāntare yaduktaṃ tatra mūlaṃ cintyam | yadyapi gṛhye barhirnoktaṃ tathā'pi śraute darśanācchiṣṭasamācārācca grāhyam | tatpramāṇe viśeṣaḥ smṛtyantare -- "yajñiyānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ tu agre prādeśamātrataḥ | pracchidya pratigṛhṇīyānmuṣṭimātraṃ tu barhiṣi" iti || muṣṭimātramekahaviṣkeṣu sthālīpākādikarmasu | anekahaviṣkeṣu tu sarveṣāṃ haviṣāmāsādanaṃ yathā bhavati tathā paryāptaṃ barhirgrāhyam | "arthātparimāṇam" iti kātyāyanokteḥ | idhmakāṣṭhasaṃkhyā tatsaṃnahanaṃ ca gṛhye -- "ekaviṃ śatidārumidhma saṃnahyatyāhutiparimāṇaṃ vā tasmiñcchamyāḥ paridhīnidhmamupasaṃnahyati" iti | ekaviṃśatidārumekaviṃśatikāṣṭhamidhmaṃ saṃnahyati saṃnahya prayunaktītyarthaḥ | athavā yathāśruta evārthaḥ | asminkalpe darvyādanātprāksaṃnahanamātraṃ kāryam | āsādanaṃ tu yena cārtha itivacanenopaveṣāsādanottarameva, śraute dṛṣṭatvāt | saṃnahanottaramanadhonidhānamapi kāryam | barhiṣo'pīdhmātpūrvaṃ saṃnahanaṃ śraute darśanāt | idhmena saha barhiṣo'pyāsādanam | na ca prokṣaṇīpātrāsādanānantaramevedhmābarhiṣorāsādanamastviti vācyam | svasattayopayogināṃ padārthānāmāsādanānantarameva svalopenopayogināṃ padārthānāmāsādanasyocitatvāt | trividhā hyupayoginaḥ padārthāḥ | kecana svasattayā, svānyathābhāvena kecana, svalopena kecana | tatra darvyājyasthālīpraṇītāpraṇayanaprokṣaṇīpātropaveṣāḥ svasattayā homopayoginaḥ | aśmāhatavastradvayottarīyārthājinamauñjīmekhalādaṇḍakaupīnatadbandhanārthasūtropavītabhikṣāpātrakūrcāḥ svasattayā upanayanopayoginaḥ | svānyathābhāvenopayogino vrīhayaḥ sthālīpāke | svalopena sādhāraṇahomopayoginaḥ saṃmārgadarbhabarhiridhmāvajvalanadarbhājyātmakāḥ | sapta palāśasamidhaḥ svalopenopayogina iti | evaṃ tatra tatra jñeyam | svasattā svasya pātrādeḥ sattā'vikārisvarūpam | svānyathābhāvaḥ svasya vrīhyāderanyathābhāvastaṇḍulaudanādirūpaḥ | svalopaḥ svasya samidāderlopo nāśaḥ | evaṃprakārairyajñasādhanapadārthāstrividhā bhavanti | yathā''hurbhaṭṭācāryāḥ -- "svānyathābhāvamattābhyāṃ svalopena ca sādhakāḥ | trividhāḥ saṃprayujyante karmaṇā viniyojakāḥ" iti || āhutīnāṃ parimāṇaṃ saṃkhyā | āhutiparimāṇamiva parimāṇaṃ yasya sa āhutiparimāṇaḥ | uṣṭramukhaśabdavanmadhyamapadalopī samāsaḥ | yāvatya āhutayastāvaddāruko bhavedityarthaḥ | jayādīnupahomānvarjayitvā'ṅgapradhānāhutayo gaṇayitavyā iti kecit | jayādayo'pi gaṇayitavyā ityanye | tasminnidhme śamyāḥ śamyākṛtikāṃstrīnparidhīnupasaṃnahyati badhnāti | śamyāśabda ihākṛtivacanaḥ | "śamyābhiḥ paridadhāti" ityuttaratra vidhānādeva paridhīnāṃ śamyākṛtitve siddha iha śamyāgrahaṇamupasaṃnahanakāla eva śamyākṛtitvasaṃpādanaṃ yathā syādūrdhvaṃ mā bhūdityetadartham | ekaviṃśatidārutvapakṣe śrautavikṛtiṣu caturviṃśatidārutvasya dṛṣṭatvātparidhīnadhikānicchantyeke | apare tu saṃkhyāyāṃ paridhīnantarbhāvayanti, tathā darśapūrṇamāsayordṛṣṭatvāditi | āhutiparimāṇatvapakṣe tu pratyāhutisamidhāṃ darśanādabhyadhikatvameva paridhīnāṃ nyāyyam | śamyāḥ paridhīnupasaṃnahyatītyucyamāne pṛthagabhyadhikānāmupasaṃnahanaṃ prāpnoti tanmā bhūditi tasminnidhma ityucyate | tasminnityeva siddha idhmagrahaṇamidhmasaṃkhyāyāṃ paridhīnāmantarbhāvārtham | idhmetyeva siddhe tasminniti vacanamāhutiparimāṇatve'bhyadhikā evetikhyāpanārthamiti mātṛdatto'pi | śrautasūtra idhmavṛkṣa uktaḥ -- "pālāśaṃ khādiraṃ vaikavi śatidārumidhma saṃnahyati" iti | paridhisvarūpamapi tatraivoktam -- "trayaḥ paridhayo'niyatavṛkṣāḥ satvakkā ārdrā bhavanti te hi sarasā iti vijñāyate śuṣkā bhavanti medhyatvāyeti vijñāyate sthaviṣṭho madhyamo'ṇīyāndrāghīyāndakṣiṇārdhyo'ṇiṣṭho hrasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ" iti | aniyatavṛkṣā nānājātīyavṛkṣā upādānaṃ yeṣāṃ te | satvakkāstvaksahitāḥ | etacca viśeṣaṇaṃ gārhye na saṃbhavati | sūtrakṛtā paridhīnāṃ śamyākṛtitvavidhānāttasya ca vinā takṣaṇamasaṃbhavāt | yuktyā sthūlakāṣṭhamūlabhāgasya sūkṣmatvamagrabhāgasya sthūlatvaṃ śamyākṛtitvārthaṃ takṣaṇena kartavyameva | evaṃ ca śrautasūtradṛṣṭāyāḥ satvakkatāyāḥ śamyākṛtividhinā bādhaḥ | te hi sarasā iti vijñāyata ityayamarthavādaḥ | ārdrā bhavantītyasminnarthe śuṣkā bhavantītyasminnarthe medhyatvāyeti vijñāyata ityayamarthavādaḥ | etaccārthavādadvayapradarśanaṃ karmāṅgatvajñānārtham | uktaṃ ca baudhāyanena -- "arthavādairabhyudayāya" iti | evaṃ cā''rdrāḥ śuṣkā vā paridhayaḥ kartavyā iti pakṣadvayaṃ jñeyam | arthavādājñāne yajurbhreṣaprāyaścittaṃ bhuvaḥ svāhetyaupāsanāgnāveva hutvā sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt | sthaviṣṭhatvaṃ sthūlataratvaṃ tanmadhyamasya paridheḥ | aṇīyastvaṃ sūkṣmatvaṃ madhyamāpekṣayā dakṣiṇārdhye | evaṃ drāghīyastvaṃ dīrghatvamapi | aṇiṣṭhatvaṃ sūkṣmataratvaṃ hrasiṣṭhatvaṃ hrasvataratvam | ete madhyamāpekṣayaivottarārdhye | ardhaśabdo bhāgavācī | dakṣiṇabhāge bhavo dakṣiṇārdhyaḥ | uttarabhāge bhava uttarārdhyaḥ | idhmasya paridhīnāṃ parimāṇaṃ vailaṅkikātyāyanāvāhatuḥ -- "dviprādeśa idhmastriprādeśāḥ paridhayaḥ" iti | baudhāyanagṛhye (tu paridhīnāmaratnimātratvamuktam -- "aratnimātrāḥ paridhayaḥ śuṣkā ārdā vā satvakkāḥ" iti | etaccā''yatanasyālpamānatve'tropayuktaṃ bhavatīti draṣṭavyam | idhmasya prādeśaparimitatvamapyuktaṃ tenaiva -- "prādeśamātrāṇyekaviṃśatimidhmadārūṇi bhavantīti brāhmaṇena vyākhyātam" iti | etasmātsūtrādekaviṃśatisaṃkhyātaḥ paridhīnāṃ bhinnatvam | idaṃ ca baudhāyanīyānāmeva nāsmākam | "tasmiñchamyāḥ paridhīnidhma upasaṃnahyati" ityatratyedhmagrahaṇena sūtrakṛtā bhedābhāvasyaiva jñāpitatvena tadviruddhabhedasyāsvīkārāt |) dviprādeśa idhmaḥ prādeśamātro veti | paridhīnāṃ bāhumātratvamapyuktaṃ bharadvājena -- "śamyāmātrā bāhumātrā vā paridhayaḥ" iti | śamyā ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulā | dvicatvāriṃśadagulo bāhuḥ | saṃgrahe -- "samitpavitraṃ vedaśca trayaḥ prādeśasaṃmitāḥ idhmastu dviguṇaḥ kāryastriguṇaḥ paridhiḥ smṛtaḥ | smārte prādeśa idhmo vā dviguṇaḥ paridhiḥ smṛtaḥ" iti | prādeśaḥ prādeśapramāṇaḥ | dviguṇo dviprādeśaḥ paridhirityarthaḥ | paridhiriti jātāvekavacanam | etasmādvacanādgṛhya idhmasya pākṣikaṃ prādeśatvaṃ paridhīnāṃ pākṣikaṃ dviprādeśatvaṃ ca jñeyam | ayaṃ ca pakṣo'saṃbhave jñeyaḥ | paridhīnāṃ nyūnādhikabhāva ukto baudhāyanagṛhye -- "tisraḥ śamyāḥ paridhīnkaroti madhyamāṅguliranāmikā kaniṣṭhikā" iti | pramāṇānīti śeṣaḥ | bāhumūlamārabhya madhyamāṅgulyagrāntaparimito dakṣiṇaḥ | bāhumūlamārabhyānāmikāgrāntaparimito madhyamaḥ | bāhumūlamārabhya kaniṣṭhikāgrāntaparimita uttara ityarthaḥ | anyatspa ṣṭārtham | vastutastu śamyāśabdo yathā''kṛtigrāhakastathā ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulapramāṇasyāpi | evaṃ ca nātra śraute ukte drāghīyastvahvasiṣṭhatve bhavataḥ | nāpi ca madhyamāṅguliranāmikā kaniṣṭhiketi baudhāyanokto dakṣiṇottaraparidhyoḥ pramāṇabhedaḥ | evaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulātmakameva pramāṇamiti jñeyam | idhmasya saṃnahanaṃ śulbenaiva kāryaṃ śraute darśanācchiṣṭācārācca | śulbakaraṇaṃ tu śrautasūtre -- "samūlānāmamūlānāṃ vā darbhāṇāmayugdhātu śulbaṃ kṛtvā prāgagramudagagraṃ vā nidadhāti" iti | ayugdhātu viṣamadhātu | dhātuḥ saṃdhiḥ | avayava iti kecit | atrāyugdhātvityaviśeṣaśravaṇādidhmabandhanaparyāptaṃ viṣamadhātukaṃ śulbaṃ kāryam, na tu barhibandhanārthakaśulbavattridhātutvapañcadhātutvaniyamaḥ | tataḥ pātrāsādanādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "darvī kūrcamājyasthālīṃ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ yena cārthaḥ sakṛdeva sarvāṇi yathopapādaṃ vā" iti | kūrcaḥ sāvitrīvācanārthamāsanam | yena cārtha ityanuktānāmapi prayojanavatāmupasaṃgrahārtham | sakṛdeva yugapadeva | sarvāṇyuktānyanuktāni ca prayojanavanti pātrāṇi dravyāṇi ca prayunakti | yathopapādaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vetyarthaḥ | "yadekameka saṃbharetpitṛdevatyāni syuḥ" iti śrutyā pitryeṣvekaikasyaiva pātrasya saṃbharaṇavidhānātpitryeṣu māsikaśrāddhāṣṭakādiṣvekamekaṃ sādanīyam | "yatsaha sarvāṇi mānuṣāṇi" iti śrutyā mānuṣeṣu yugapatpātrasaṃbharaṇavidhānādupanayanādiṣu mānuṣeṣu yugapatpātrasādanam | "dve dve saṃbharati" itiśrutyā'vaśiṣṭeṣu daiveṣu karmasu dvaṃdvaṃ pātrāsādanamiti vyavasthaiva vā yathopapādaśabdārthaḥ | kūrcasya tūpanayana evopayogaḥ| uttaratra pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvetividhānādāsādane nyagbilatā gamyate | tato brahmopaveśanādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "etasminkāle brahmā yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā'pa ācamyāpareṇāgniṃ dakṣiṇā'tikramya brahmasadanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyāpa upaspṛśyāgnimabhimukha upaviśati" iti | etasminkāle pātrāsādanāntarakāle brahmartvigyajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā'pa āca myāgneradūreṇāparabhāgeṇa dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇena padā'tikramya brahmasadanasya paścātprāṅmukhaḥ sthitvā svasadanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyāpa upaspṛśyāgnimabhimukha upaviśati | etasminkāla iti vacanaṃ vaidike'pi pātrāsādanānantarameva brahmaṇaḥ praveśo nārvāgityetadartham | yajñopavītagrahaṇaṃ karmāṅgasyā''vikājinasya vāsaso vopādānārtham | pitrye vā tasya prācīnāvītitvanirākaraṇārtham | atha vā yajñopavītasyāpi prādhānyakhyāpanārtham | tena brahmālābhe tatsthāne yajñopavītaṃ vā syāt | "athaikeṣāmuktaṃ chatraṃ yajñopavītaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ vā" iti | athavaitasminkāla iti vacanamanityaḥ puruṣo nityaḥ kāla itijñāpanārtham | tena cchatrādīnāmeko vā brahmaṇaḥ sthāne'vaśyaṃ syāditi | apa ācamyetyanena śuddhasyāpi karmāṅgaṃ punarācamanaṃ vidhīyate | apareṇetyanena pātrahomakarturantaraṅgatvaṃ bādhyate | brahmaṇaḥ sadanamāsanaṃ tasmāttṛṇaṃ nirasyedityarthaḥ | brahmeti vacanamanyeṣāmapyāsanāni santīti gamayati | tena sarvairapyṛtvigbhiḥ svasvāsana upaviśyaiva karma kartavyaṃ na tu kevalaṃ bhūmiṣṭhairiti | yajamānena śraute darśanātsvāsanāttṛṇanirasanamapi kāryam | brahmasadanāttṛṇaṃ nirasyeti darśanāttṛṇamayamāsanamiti gamyate | smṛtita eva nirasanottaramudakasparśe siddhe punarvacanaṃ śrautaprāyaścittārtham | etacca yajñopavītakaraṇādikaṃ sarvaṃ svakarma yajamānena vṛtaḥ sanneva kuryāt | nāvṛtā yājayeyuriti varaṇarahitasya karmaṇi pravṛttiniṣedhāt | ṛtviktvaṃ tu varaṇabharaṇādhīnamityṛtvigadhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakairvistareṇa prapañcitamasti tattatra draṣṭavyam | śraute tu satre varaṇabharaṇābhāve'pi hotrādisaṃjñānirvāhārthaṃ saṃkalpaviśeṣasyāpi nimittatā mīmāṃsakairaṅgīkṛtā | tataḥ pavitrakaraṇādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "samāvapracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre kṛtvā'nyena nakhācchittvā'dbhiranumṛjya pavitrāntarhite pātre'pa ānīyopabilaṃ pūrayitvodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ trirutpūyottareṇāgniṃ darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhāti" iti | samau varṇarūpābhyāṃ, dairghyeṇa sāmyasya tu prādeśamātrāvityanenaiva siddhatvāt | pracchinnāgrāvityatra praśabdo durlakṣyasāgratānivṛttyarthaḥ | prādeśamātrau prādeśapramāṇāvetādṛśau yau darbhau tau pavitrau pavanayogyau saṃskāraiḥ karoti | pavitraśabdo yadyapi viśeṣyaliṅgo'sti tathā'pi pavanasādhane napuṃsaka eva dṛśyate | dvivacanaṃ tūdbhūtāvayavatvāt | bhūmau tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā'ntardhāya darbhāvagre prādeśamātrāvavaśeṣayaṃstadupari dhṛtvā tacca nakhādanyenāsidena kāṣṭhena vā chittvā pavanayogyau karoti | kṛtvā'dbhiranumārṣṭi mūlādārabhyāgraparyantaṃ sodakena hastena mārṣṭi | etacca dhūlyapasāraṇārtham | tena dhūlyabhāve na kāryamiti kecit | adṛṣṭārthaṃ kartavyamevetyanye | tataḥ pātraṃ gṛhītvā pavitrābhyāmantarhite tasminpraṇītāpraṇayanapātre'pa ānīyopabilaṃ pūrayet | yathā na skandantyutpavanādinā | tata udagagrābhyāṃ trirutpūyottarato'gneḥ saṃnikṛṣṭatare deśe darbheṣu sādayitvā darbhairapidadhātītyarthaḥ | udagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāmityatra pavitragrahaṇaṃ hastayorudagagratāvyāvṛttyartham | "samāvapracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre karoti" ityetasminkātyāyanasūtre devayājñikapitṛbhūtiharisvāminaḥ pavitrayoreva samānatvokteśchedanena pavitre eva same kārye na tu samapramāṇau kuśau chittvetyatrā''grahaḥ | bhinnapramāṇāvapi cchittvā samau kāryāviti tātparyārtha iti viśeṣamāhuḥ | tataḥ prokṣaṇīsaṃskārādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "tiraḥpavitraṃ prokṣaṇīḥ saṃ skṛtya yathāpūrastādbilavantyutānāni kṛtvā viṣāyedhmaṃ triḥ sarvābhiḥ prokṣati" iti | tiraḥpavitraṃ pavitre antardhāya prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya | yathāpurastātpraṇītāvat | bilavanti pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā viṣāya visrasyedhmaṃ sarvābhiḥ prokṣaṇīpātrasthābhiradbhistriḥ sapavitreṇa pāṇinā pātrāṇi prokṣati | prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtyetyeva siddhe tiraḥpavitramiti vacanamitaradharmanivṛttyartham | tena tūṣṇīṃ pātrasya triḥ prakṣālanamapāmānayanaṃ karaṇatvena pṛthivyabhidhyānasamakālaṃ pūraṇaṃ praṇītāsvivātra na bhavatīti | sarvābhirityavaśeṣapratiṣedhārtham | prokṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ saṃgrahe -- "uttānena tu hastena kartavyaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ bhavet" iti | tato darvīniṣṭapanādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "darvī niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya punarniṣṭapya nidadhāti saṃmārgānabhyukṣyāgnāvādadhāti" iti | darvīmagnau niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya punaragnau niṣṭapya nidadhāti | juhūvatsaṃmārga ityupadiśanti | caruhoma upastaraṇābhidhāraṇādyarthaṃ sruvasyāpyapekṣitatvāttasya ca saṃskṛtasyaivopastaraṇābhidhāraṇādirūpakarmaniṣpādane yogyatvādāsādanaprokṣaṇaniṣṭapanasaṃmārgādirūpāḥ saṃskārā darvīvatsruvasyāpi kāryāḥ | te ca darvyā sahaiva | saṃmārgastu śrautasruvasaṃmārgavatprathamameva kartavyaḥ | nidhānaṃ darbheṣviti kecit | saṃmārgadarbhānadbhirabhyukṣyāgnau praharatītyarthaḥ | abhyukṣaṇalakṣaṇaṃ saṃgrahe -- "muṣṭī kṛtvā tu tattoyamabhyukṣaṇamiti smṛtam" iti | tata ājyavilāpanādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "ājyaṃ vilāpya pavitrāntarhitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nirupyodīco'ṅgārānnirū(ru)hya teṣvadhiśrityāvadyotya darbhataruṇābhyāṃ pratyasya triḥ paryagni kṛtvodagudvāsyāṅgārānpratyū(tyu)hyodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhāramājyaṃ trirutpūya pavitre agnāvādhāya" iti | ājyaṃ bahireva vilāpya dravīkṛtya pavitrāntarhitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nirvapet | punarājyagrahaṇaṃ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham | tena gavyamājyaṃ syāt | dravyāntarasaṃsargapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca | tena śodhayitvoparipavanena grāhyam | tata udīca udagbhāgasthānaṅgārānkenacitkāṣṭhena nirū(ru)hya teṣu nirūḍheṣvaṅgāreṣvājyamadhiśrityāvadyotya darbhairavācīnajvālairupari jvalayitvā darbhataruṇābhyāṃ darbhāgrābhyāṃ pratyasya tasmiṃste prāsyolmukena triḥ paryagni kṛtvottaratastadudvāsya tānaṅgārāṃstenaiva kāṣṭhena pratyū(tyu)hyāgnau punaḥ prakṣipyodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ punarāhratyotpunāti | evamatra kramaḥ | ājyasthālyāṃ pavitre paścādbhāgamārabhya prāgbhāgaṃ nītvā punaḥ paścādbhāgamānīyotpunāti | punardvirevameva | śrutyaiva pratyagapavargatā'tra vihitotsargasya bādhikā | brāhmaṇe -- "punarāhāramevamiva hi prāṇāpānau saṃcarataḥ" iti pavitrayoḥ prāṇāpānarūpayoḥ saṃcāra uktaḥ | prāṇo hi prāgapavargaṃ saṃcarati tasya mukhanāsikānirodhena yato nirodhaḥ | apānaḥ pratyagapavargaṃ tasya nirodho'pānadvāraliṅganirodhena yato dṛśyate | tasmātprāṇāpānagatibhyāṃ kramikābhyāṃ punarāhāre pratyagapavargatā na nivāryeti | punarāhāramiti ṇamulpratyayāntam | punarāhāro'ṅgamutpavanasya | punarājyagrahaṇaṃ navanītasyāpi pitṛyajña utpavane punarāhāradharmo mā bhūdityetadartham | apare pūrvamājyagrahaṇaṃ tūṣṇīkenā''jyenetyatrāyameva saṃskāravidhirnatu mantravarjaṃ darśapaurṇamāsika ityetadarthamityāhuḥ | pavitre agnāvādhāyetyatra punaḥ pavitragrahaṇaṃ visrasya pṛthagbhūtayoḥ sahābhyādhānārtham | vyaktaṃ ca baudhāyanīye -- "pavitre visrasyādbhiḥ saṃspṛśyāgnāvanupraharati" iti | yastu paryagnikaraṇe darbhadvayolmukayoḥ samuccayo gṛhyakārikākṛtoktaḥ sa pramāṇābhāvādupekṣyaḥ | ājyanirvapaṇadeśa āpastambagṛhye -- "apareṇāgniṃ pavitrāntarhitāyāmājyasthālyāmājyaṃ nirūpya" iti | prayogapārijāte -- "athā''jyasthālīmādāya tasyāmājyaṃ niṣicya ca | udagagnernirūḍheṣu tvaṅgāreṣu sabhasmasu || vilāpyaitadadhiśritya avajvalya jvalattṛṇaiḥ | ājye pratyasya darbhāgre aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrake" iti | atroktanirūḍhaśabdārthaḥ smṛtidīpikāyāṃ vyākhyātaḥ -- "nirūḍhaḥ syādvibhakto'gniryaḥ paristaraṇādbahiḥ | anirūḍhaḥ sa vai vahniryaḥ paristṛtimadhyagaḥ" iti | etacca yatrāgneḥ pratyūhanavidhānamasti tatparam | yatra tu pratyūhanavidhānaṃ nāsti tatrā''yatanamadhya eva pṛthakkaraṇaṃ nirūḍhaśabdārtho vidyāraṇyaśrīpādokteḥ | paryagnikaraṇe tṛṇanirasanaviśeṣamāha saṃgrahakāraḥ -- "paryagnikaraṇāyāgnimanirūḍhādyadā''haret | bahirnirasya taccheṣaṃ nirūḍhādyadi yojayet" iti | sudarśanabhāṣye'pi -- "ājyasaṃskārārthānāmaṅgārāṇāṃ pratyūhanavidhānādapavṛtte karmaṇi laukikaḥ saṃpadyata iti na | avadyotanaparyagnikaraṇāgnyostu yadā''yatanasthādupādānaṃ tadā'pavṛttakarmatvena laukikatvāttyāgaḥ | yadā tu nirūḍhāttadā tasminneva prakṣepaḥ" iti | tataḥ paridhiparidhānādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "śamyābhiḥ paridadhātyapareṇāgnimudīcīnakumbāṃ madhyamāṃ nidadhāti dakṣiṇenāgni sa spṛṣṭāṃ madhyamayā prācīnakumbāmuttareṇāgni saspṛṣṭāṃ madhyamayā prācīnakumbāmapareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśati" iti | śamyābhiḥ śamyākṛtibhiḥ paridhibhiḥ paridadhāti | katham | apareṇāgnimudīcīnakumbāṃ madhyamāṃ nidadhāti | kumbaḥ sthūlapradeśaḥ | dakṣiṇenāgniṃ madhyamayā saṃspṛṣṭāṃ prācīnakumbāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śamyāṃ nidadhāti | uttareṇāgniṃ madhyamayā saṃspṛṣṭāṃ prācīnakumbāmuttarāṃ śamyāṃ nidadhāti | adharottarabhāvaḥ paristaraṇavadatrāpi draṣṭavyaḥ | ihādhikārādeva siddhe trīṇyagnigrahaṇāni kevalasyāgneḥ saṃpratyayaḥ syātparistaraṇasya mā bhūdityetadartham | tenoparyeva paristaraṇānāmagneḥ paridhibhiḥ paridhānaṃ kāryaṃ na bāhyata iti | itarathā pātrāsādanavadbrahmasadanavacca bāhyataḥ prāpnuyāt | dakṣiṇottarayoḥ punargrahaṇaṃ saṃspṛṣṭāmiti saṃśabdaścāgnerdakṣiṇata uttarataśca tayornidhānaṃ samyaksparśanenādharottarabhāvaśca yathā syādityetadartham | itarathā madhyamasyaiva dakṣiṇata uttarataśca nidhānaṃ sparśamātraṃ ca prāpnuyāt | apareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśatītyetatsūtraṃ dakṣiṇato yajñopavītyācāntaḥ kumāra ityetasminnuttarasūtre'nveti | tena kumārasya prāṅmukhatā'pareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśatītyetasya sūtrasya vaiyarthyāpattiparihāraśca sidhyati | etacca saṃskāryamātropalakṣaṇam | tena yatra saṃskāryā patnī tatra tasyā api patyurdakṣiṇata upaveśane prāṅmukhatvaṃ bhavati | agra upaviśyetivacanamupaveśanānvārambhayoḥ kālāvyavadhānārtham | athavā'pareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśatīti bhinnaṃ sūtram | dakṣiṇato yajñopavītyācāntaḥ kumāra upaviśyānvārabhata iti bhinnam | tatra pūrvamarthādācāryaparamuttaratra kumāragrahaṇādanyasya cāsaṃbhavāt | asminpakṣe pūrvasūtraṃ karmavaśenāyaṃ niyama itikhyāpanārthaṃ jñeyam | agnigrahaṇaṃ tviha paristīrṇasyāgneḥ saṃpratyayārtham | yattu smṛtyantare uktam -- "tribhiścaiva caturbhiśca pañcabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiraṅgulaiḥ | sacanaṃ paridhīścaiva staraṇaṃ pūjanaṃ tathā" iti caturaṅgulātmakaparidhiparidhānadeśāvadhikathanam | yacca kaśyapoktam -- "navāṅgulapramāṇena vidhinā paridhīnnyaset" iti navāṅgulātmakaparidhiparidhānadeśāvadhikathanaṃ tacchākhāntaraviṣayaṃ na satyāṣāḍhasūtrānusāriviṣayam | bhāṣyakṛtā paristaraṇānāmuparyeva paridhiparidhānasyoktatvāt | paridhiparidhānottarameva barhirāstaraṇaṃ kāryamanyathā pavitrābhyādhānaparidhiparidhānayorlyapā bodhitasyāvyavahitānantaryasya bādhāpatteḥ | etenotpavanātprāgeva barhistaraṇaṃ kaiściduktaṃ tannirastaṃ draṣṭavyam | barhirāstaraṇottaramājyasthālyāstatra sādanamupaveṣanirasanaṃ praṇītodvāsanādanantaraṃ brahmayajamānaniṣkramaṇātprāgeva, śraute dṛṣṭatvāt | praṇītodvāsanasyākriyāyāmuttarapariṣekānte | tataḥ pariṣekādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "atha pariṣiñcatyadite'numanyasveti dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnamanumate'numa nyasveti paścādudīcīna sarasvate'numanyasvetyuttarataḥ prācīnaṃ deva savitaḥ prasuveti sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣicyedhmamaṅktvā'bhyādadhātyayaṃ ta idhma ātmā jātavedaste0 samedhaya svāhā" iti | athānantaramācāryaḥ pariṣiñcati sarvataḥ siñcati | katham | adite'numanyasveti dakṣiṇato'gneḥ prācīnamudakaṃ siñcati | sarasvata iti cchāndase hrasvatve saṃbuddhilopo guṇaśca | deva savitaḥ prasuveti sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ tamagniṃ siñcati | sāvitrahomamantrasyā''digrahaṇametat | chandogānāṃ tathā darśanādityeke, tannetyuttaratra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ | athaśabdaḥ kumārādhikāranivṛttyarthaḥ | sarvamācāryakartṛkaṃ yāvaduktameva kumārasyāvaidhatvāt | pradakṣiṇavacanaṃ pratyekaṃ sarvatra mā bhūtsakṛdeva pariṣeko yathā syādityetadartham | pariṣicyaivamagnimidhmamājyena darvyāṅktvā prajvalitāgnau hastenābhyādadhātyayaṃ ta idhma ityanena mantreṇa | idhmābhyādhānasyājuhoticoditatve'pi vacanātsvāhākāraḥ | evaṃ sarvasamidādhāne draṣṭavyam | pariṣicyeti vacanamantrake'pi pariṣeke dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnamityārabhya sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇamityantaḥ pariṣeko yathā syānna tu sarvataḥ pradakṣiṇamityetāvānevetikhyāpanārthaṃ pariṣekedhmābhyañjanayormadhye karmāntarapratiṣedhārthaṃ ca | tena sacarutantrahome pariṣekātpūrvameva carūdvāsanaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | saṃgrahe samiddhome viśeṣaḥ -- "mūlataḥ karmanāśaḥ syānmadhyataḥ putranāśanam | agreṇa muñcato vyādhirekapāṇerdhanakṣayaḥ || mūlamadhyamamadhyena samiddhomasya lakṣaṇam" iti | mūlato mūlena | madhyato madhyena | mūlato madhyata ityubhayatrāpi muñcata ityetasyānvayaḥ | mūlamadhyamapradeśayormadhyabhāge dhṛtvā samidho hotavyāḥ | etadeva samiddhomasya samidabhyādhānasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyamiti | "atraikapāṇinā samiddhomaniṣedhena savyapāṇyanvārabdhadakṣiṇapāṇinā homavidhirgamyate" iti prayogapārijāte | sruvadhāraṇe viśeṣo vidhānamālāyām -- "agre dhṛto vināśāya dhṛto madhye prajākṣayī | mūle dhṛtastu hotustu mṛtiṃ dadyātsruvo dhruvam || agrānmadhyācca madhye tu mūlānmadhyācca madhyataḥ | sruvaḥ pradhāryo vidvadbhiḥ sarvakāmārthasiddhaye" iti | ayamarthaḥ -- daṇḍasya pañca bhāgānkṛtvā dvitīyabhāge caturthabhāge vā sruvadhāraṇaṃ kāryamiti | prayogārṇave -- "kaṭhinadravyahome tu muṣṭinā dhāraṇaṃ srucaḥ | dravaddravyasya home tu uttānāṅgulibhiḥ smṛtam" iti || sruvasyāpyuttānāṅgulibhireva dhāraṇam | etacca sruksruvadhāraṇaṃ saumyatīrthena kāryam | "nirvapaṇasaṃsravaṇalājahomanityahomānkāyatīrthena kuryāddaivena daivikaṃ pitryeṇa paitṛkaṃ kamaṇḍalusparśanaṃ navānnaprāśanaṃ sruvagrahaṇaṃ daivikaṃ saumyenā''gneyena pratigrahaṃ kuryāt" iti baudhāyanokteḥ | sruvagrahaṇaṃ srugupalakṣaṇam | atra daivikamiti viśeṣaṇātpitryaṃ sruvadhāraṇaṃ pitṛtīrthenaiva | saumyāgneyatīrthalakṣaṇaṃ baudhāyanoktam -- "aṅgulimūle saumyaṃ karamadhya āgneyam" iti | darvyāmapyevaṃ tasyāḥ sruvasthānīyatvāt | tata ādhārahomādi | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "atha darvyā juhotyuttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtya darvīṃ prajāpataye manave svāheti manasā dhyāyandakṣiṇāprāñcamṛjuṃ dīrgha saṃtataṃ dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtyendrāya svāheti prāñcamudañcamṛjumāghārāvāghāryā''jyabhāgau juhotyagnaye svāhetyuttarārdhapūrvārdhe somāya svāheti dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe tāvantareṇatarā juhoti yukto vaha jātavedaḥ purastādagne viddhi karma kriyamāṇaṃ yathedam | tvaṃ bhiṣagbheṣajasyāsi kartā tvayā gā aśvānpuruṣānsanema svāhā | yā tiraścī nipadyase'haṃ vidharaṇī, iti | tāṃ tvā ghṛtasya dhārayā'gnau sa rādhanīṃ yaje svāhā | sa rādhanyai devyai svāhā prasādhanyai devyai svāhā" iti | athedhmādhānānantaraṃ homānvakṣyamāṇāndarvyā juhoti | athaśabda idhmābhyādhānāghārayoḥ saṃbandhārthaḥ | tena yatra yatrā''ghārau tatraivedhmābhyādhānaṃ nānyatra | tenā''pūrvika idhmābhyādhānaṃ neti siddhaṃ bhavati | evamidhmābhyañjanamapi darvyaiva bhavatīti ca | uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanu uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhimanu lakṣayitvā tena yathā'vahṛtya praveśya darvīṃ prajāpataya ityanena mantreṇa manasā dhyāyannanuccārayanvācā dakṣiṇāprāgapavargamakuṭilaṃ saṃtatamavicchinnaṃ juhotyāghārayatītyarthaḥ | darvīgrahaṇaṃ sthālyā sahānvavahṛtya paścādupādāya homapratiṣedhārtham | tena pūrvamevopādāya praveśyā''ghārayitavyam | pūrvavaddakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhimanvavahṛtya darvīmindrāya svāhetyanenottarāprāgapavargamakuṭilaṃ dīrghaṃ saṃtataṃ juhotyāghārayati | manasā dhyāyanniti nivartate | tasmānmanasā prajāpataye juhvatītiśrutyā prājāpatyāghāra eva tasyoktatvāt | ato vācaivābhighārayati | āghārāvāghāryetivacanamanantaroktayorhomayorāghārasaṃjñārtham | tena jyotiṣmatyagnau homaḥ sarveṣāmidhmakāṣṭhānāṃ saṃsparśanaṃ ca siddhaṃ bhavati | dakṣiṇāprāñcamitivacanaṃ tiryaktvanirāsārtham | ṛjumitivacanaṃ jihmatvanirāsārtham | dīrghamitivacanaṃ śāstrāntaroktasya dveṣyasya hrasvamitikalpanirāsārtham | saṃtatamiti dveṣyasya nyañcaṃ vicchinattītyetasya kalpasya nirāsārtham | uttarāghāra ṛjugrahaṇaṃ dīrghasāṃtatyayoranāvaśyakatvadyotanārtham | āghāre dhārāyāṃ cā''disaṃyoga ityāpastamboktaviśeṣasvīkāre tu mantrārambhasamakālamāghārayorārambhaḥ | ājyabhāgāviti saṃjñā saṃvyavahārārthā | ājyabhāgāntaṃ kṛtvetyatrāgnaye svāhetyanena mantreṇāgneruttarārdhasya pūrvārthe somāya svāhetyanena dakṣiṇārdhasya pūrvārdhe juhotītyubhayatra śeṣaḥ | tāvantareṇetarā juhoti, tāvājyabhāgāvantareṇa taddhomadeśayormadhya itarā āhutīrjuhoti | tāvantareṇa juhotītyetāvaducyamāne yukto vahetyādānīmeva deśasaṃbandhaḥ prasajyeta tanmā bhūtkiṃtu sarvāsāmeva bhavatītyevamarthamitarā iti vacanam | yātiraścītyetasminmantre sa rādhanīmityeva pāṭhaḥ | yajeḥ sakarmakatvādityeke | sa rādhanī yaja ityeva pāṭho vibhaktivyatyayādityanye | niranunāsikaḥ pāṭho'papāṭha eveti mātṛdattaḥ | chāndasaḥ pāṭha iti tu yuktam | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti vyāhṛtibhirjuhotyekaikaśaḥ samastābhiśceti | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityetābhirvyāhṛtibhirjuhoti | ekaikaśa ekaikayā vyastābhirityarthaḥ | yathā bhūḥ svāhā | bhuvaḥ svāhā | suvaḥ svāheti | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti vacanaṃ vyāhṛtibahutvādiṣṭaparigrahārtham | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti siddhe vyāhṛtibhiriti vacanametāsāmevānyatra vyāhṛtigrahaṇe saṃpratyayārtham | tena vyāhṛtibhiranvādadhāti vyāhṛtibhī rākāmahamityevamādiṣu śrauteṣu smārteṣu caitāsāmeva saṃpratyayaḥ siddho bhavati | nanu bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti vyāhṛtaya ityetenaiva siddham | na sidhyati | tenā''dhāna eveṣṭaparigrahaḥ kṛtaḥ syāditi | karṣapramāṇamājyaṃ syāditi vacanātsarvāhutiṣu karmamātramājyaṃ jñeyam | atha karmasamṛddhisaṃpādakamuttaraṃ tantram | tatra gṛhyam -- imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvamagne ayāsya0 bheṣa svāhā | prajāpata ityeṣā | yadasya karmaṇo'tya0 samardhayitre svāhetyuttarārdhapūrvārdhe'sa saktāmitarābhirāhutibhirjuhotyatraike jayābhyātānānrāṣṭrabhṛta ityupajuhvati purastātsviṣṭakṛtaścittaṃ ca svāhā cittiśca svāheti jayānjuhoti cittāya svāhā cittaye svāheti vā'gnirbhūtānāmadhipatiḥ samāvatvityabhyātānānasminbrahmannasminkṣatra ityabhyātāneṣvanuṣajati pitaraḥ pitāmahā iti prācīnāvītī juhotyupatiṣṭhate vartāṣāḍṛtadhāmeti rāṣṭrabhṛtaḥ paryāyamanudrutya tasmai svāheti pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhoti tābhyaḥ svāhetyuttarām" iti | prājāpatyāyāmeṣeti vacanaṃ yatra yatra sāmānyataḥ prājāpatyā vihitā bhavati tatraiṣaiva jñeyetyetadartham | kecittu nanvāpūrvikaśabdabalātkevalaṃ yāvadukto homo'nyāni vaiśeṣikāṇi karmāṇi cetyetāvadevānuṣṭheyaṃ nānyānyaṅgānyatrānuṣṭheyānīti cet | satyam | nāsaṃskṛtena dravyeṇa juhuyāditi śāstrāntare'saṃskṛtadravyahomaniṣedhena dravyasaṃskārasyā''vaśyakatvāt | adhikaraṇasaṃbandhitvātparistaraṇapariṣekāvapi | na caivamidhmābhyādhānamapyagnisaṃbandhitvātsyāditi vācyaṃ, baudhāyanenānuktatvena tadabhāvasyaiva siddheḥ | ādhārābhāvādapīdhmābhyādhānasyābhāvaḥ | idhmābhyādhānasyā''ghārasaṃbandhitvenaikasaṃbandhinivṛttāvaparasaṃbandhino'pi nivṛtte nirvivādatvāt | etayoḥ parasparasaṃbandhitve jñāpakaṃ tvatha darvyā juhotītyasminsūtre pradarśitam | sarvaṃ caitadāha baudhāyanaḥ -- "āpūrvikeṣu yāvadarthaṃ dravyasaṃskāraḥ paristaraṇapariṣekau yāvaduktvā āhutayo'nyāni ca vaiśeṣikāṇi karmāṇi" iti | dravyagrahaṇaṃ homasādhanopalakṣaṇam | "nāsaṃskṛtena pātreṇa juhuyāt" iti śāstrāntarasaṃvādāt | etāvantyevāṅgānyāgnihotrikepu saṃskṛtājyena caturgṛhītvā sarvānmantrānanudrutya prathamāhutiḥ | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti dvitīyāhutiḥ | tato'gnihotravattriḥ prāśanaṃ sruco darbhaiḥ prakṣālanaṃ yathoktāni vaiśeṣikāṇi karmāṇi | tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ -- "āgnihotrikeṣu sruksruvau prayujyā''jyaṃ saṃskṛtya caturgṛhītvā sarvānmantrānanundrutya prathamāmāhutiṃ juhotyagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti dvitīyāmagnihotravattriḥ prāśya srucaṃ darbhaiḥ prakṣālayati yathoktāni vaiśeṣikāṇi karmāṇi tataḥ karoti" iti | darvihomāṇāmityatra bahuvacanaṃ nānāhaviṣkatvādyujyate | etaccobhayakalpe'pi samānam | sarvatraiṣa kalpa iti vaktavye darvihomavacanaṃ juhoticoditeṣveva karmasveṣa kalpo yathā syāt, japatyādicoditeṣu mā bhūdityetadartham | etadapyubhayakalpe samānam | yatrobhayānuvādo'nyatarānuvādo vā tatrā''ghāravadeva tantram | anyatra trayāṇāṃ dvayorvā vikalpaḥ kutracinniyamo vā | tatra trivṛdannahome bahiḥsaṃskṛtānnaprāpakopasthitavacanabalādāpūrvikatvameva | māsikaśrāddhe bahiḥsaṃskṛtānnahome'pyāghāravattantradarśanādāghāravattantramapi pakṣe | sthālīpāke tu vyākhyānadvaye'pyāpūrvikatvameva | bhāṣyakṛtā tu pakṣa āghāravattantramapyatroktam | yatra kevale caruhome sthālīpākaśabdena vidhānaṃ nāsti kiṃtu caruśabdena pakvājjuhotītyevaṃ vā tatrā''pūrvikatantrameva | yatra tvājyādihomasahitaścaruhomastatrā''ghāravattantreṇaiva caruhomaḥ | etadviṣaye jñāpakamathaināmāgneyena sthālīpākena yājayatītyasminsūtre pradarśayiṣyate | ekāhutikeṣūddravaṇādinimittakeṣu homeṣu trayāṇāṃ dvayorvaicchiko vikalpaḥ | dvitryādyāhutikeṣu homeṣu sarvānanudrutya prathamāmāhutiṃ juhotītyetasya vidheḥ svasūtraviruddhatvānnā''gnihotrikavidhiḥ | aupāsanahome tvāpūrvikameva tantram | atra yadyapyatidiṣṭo viśeṣavihito vā dravyasaṃskāro nāsti tathā'pi nāsaṃskṛtena dravyeṇa juhuyāditiśāstrāntare'saṃskṛtadravyahomaniṣedhācchrautahomopadiṣṭo mantravarjaṃ yathāyogyaṃ dravyasaṃskāraḥ kārya eva | evaṃ śrautahomopadiṣṭo homasādhanasaṃskāro'pi | sa ca niṣṭapanamārjanātmakaḥ | hastena home savyahastena dakṣiṇahastasya parimārjanam | ājyenopāsanahomapakṣa ājyasaṃskāro gṛhyokto mantravarjaṃ śrauto vā kāryaḥ | paristaraṇapariṣekāvapi kāryau | asminkalpa āhutigrahaṇaprayojanamaṅgulyuttarapārśvena homasiddhireva | vaiśvadeva itaratantranivṛttiḥ pūrvavadevātrāpi | śāstrāntaraprokteṣu carvatiriktadravyasādhyeṣu karmasu tvāghāravattantramāpūrvikaṃ tantraṃ veti yathācāraṃ vyavasthitaṃ jñeyamiti dik | ityagnimukhaprayogaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmadgaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ prathamaṃ prakaraṇam || 1 || <2> atha dvitīyaṃ prakaraṇam |
prāyaścittasaṃgrahakārikāḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇa karmasaṃdhānārthāni prāyaścittāni | tatra teṣāṃ saṃgrāhikā matkṛtāḥ kārikāḥ -- vihitasyānanuṣṭhāne'nyathānuṣṭhāna eva ca | śrutilakṣaṇakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtsnaṃ vidhīyate || 1 || prāyo vināśaparyāyaḥ saṃdhānaṃ cittamīritam | tacca jñeyaṃ dvidhā pratyakṣātīndriyavibhedataḥ || 2 || bahirgatasyānalasya tatra saṃsthāpanaṃ punaḥ | skannasya haviṣaḥ śuddhadeśasthasya punargrahaḥ || 3 || budhaiścittaṃ hyevamādi pratyakṣaṃ parikīrtitam | japahomādikaṃ cittaṃ budhaiḥ smṛtamatīndriyam || 4 || prāyaścittanimitte cedyatsaṃkhyāvacanādikam | śrūyamāṇaṃ bhavettacca vijñeyamavivakṣitam || 5 || ājyaṃ saṃskṛtya vahnestu paristaraṇamācaret | pariṣicya tato'dbhistaṃ śuklapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 6 || alaṃkṛtyāgnimādhāya pālāśīṃ samidhaṃ tataḥ | sasvāhākāramantreṇa juhuyādvihitāhutim || 7 || darvyā saṃskṛtayā jñeyaḥ prāyaścittāhutau vidhiḥ | athavā śrautasūtroktāḥ śrautasūtroktarītitaḥ || 8 || cittahomāḥ prakartavyā niyamena vicakṣaṇaiḥ | śāstrāntaroktāḥ sarve tu syurgārhyavidhinaiva hi || 9 || ete vivecayiṣyāmaḥ samanantarameva tu | śraute bhavetsrucā homo niyatā samidāhitiḥ || 10 || anekāhutike home tāvatyaḥ samidhaḥ smṛtāḥ | paristṛtau vikalpaḥ syātpariṣekastvamantrakaḥ || 11 || parītyānalamagreṇa tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitaḥ | nābhiṃ prati srucaṃ dhṛtvā juhuyādvihitāhutim || 12 || anekāhutike home vigrāhaṃ homa īritaḥ | yatra sruvāhutividhistatra nā''sādayetsrucam || 13 || gṛhye sruvāhutividhāvapi darvyeva kīrtitā | dvistrirgṛhītādihome syātsruvo'pyubhayatra tu || 14 || grahaṇārthaṃ sruvasyāpi kartavyaṃ sādanaṃ tviha | darvyāḥ sruco vā saṃmārgātpūrvaṃ saṃmārga īritaḥ || 15 || śrautasruvasyeva bhavetsaṃmārgo mantravarjitaḥ | saṃmārgadarbhādhānātprākcittahomo yadā''patet || 16 || tadā saṃskṛtya cirttāthamājyaṃ tena hutiṃ caret | nirvāpakāle cittaṃ cettadā''jyaṃ tvekameva hi || 17 || cittārthamatha karmārthaṃ nātrotpattiḥ pṛthagbhavet | śrautoktarītyā home'pi gṛhyoktaivā''jyasaṃskṛtiḥ || 18 || agneḥ paristṛterūrdhvaṃ naiva kāryā paristṛtiḥ | na kāryaṃ samidādhānamidhmādhānādanantaram || 19 || prāyaścittasya kālastu nimittānantaraṃ smṛtaḥ | pradhānahomataḥ prāgvā baudhāyanamunismṛteḥ || 20 || prāyaścittaviśeṣo na yatra proktastu tatra vai | samastābhirvyāhṛtibhirekāhutirudīritā || 21 || bhaveddarvyā srucā veyamāhutirna sraveṇa tu | etadeva smṛtaṃ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hi yājñikaiḥ || 22 || yatra homastvadṛṣṭārthaṃ vihito na bhavedyadi | sarvābhidhānakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tatra tadācaret || 23 || yatra homastvadṛṣṭārthaṃ vihito'pi bhavedyadi | sarvābhidhānakaṃ cittaṃ tatrāpi ca samācaret || 24 || pūrvamālekhanamatamāśmarathyamataṃ param | pātrānuktau cittahome śraute srugghomasādhanam || 25 || gārhye bhaveccittahome darvikā homasādhanam | saṃkhyānuktau sakṛdgrāho dravyānuktau ghṛtaṃ smṛtam || 26 || karmahomasya kartā yaḥ sa evātra prakīrtitaḥ | dāne kartā patiḥ proktaḥ patnī syāttadasaṃnidhau || 27|| evaṃ tyāge'pi vijñeyaṃ kātyāyanamunismṛteḥ| anāhitāgneścitteṣṭisthāne syuḥ pākadharmataḥ || 28 || sarvatra caravaḥ śāstrāntarājjñeyaṃ budhairidam | pūrṇāhutiraśaktau syāttatprakāro'dhunocyate || 29 || caturvāraṃ gṛhītvā''jyamaṣṭavāramathāpi vā | sruci dvādaśavāraṃ vā darvikāyāmathāpi vā || 30 || upottamenāntimena saha vā grahaṇena tu || abhipūryā''jyena tāṃ tu svāhāśabdasamanvitam || 31 || caturthyantaṃ devatāyā nāma proktvā tayā''hutiḥ | svāhānte tu budhairdeyā pūrṇāhutiriyaṃ smṛtā || 32 || pūrṇasruveṇātyaśaktau pūrṇāhutirudīritā | sarvatrānājñātajapo vaiṣṇavyṛgjapa eva ca || 33 || samastavyāhṛtīnāṃ ca japaḥ kāryo vipaścitā | dravyasya vihitasyātrābhāvaścetsyātsvarūpataḥ || 34 || strīkartavyaḥ pratinidhiḥ prāyaścittaṃ na cātra tu | arthadravyavirodhe'rtho balīyānsaṃprakīrtitaḥ || 35 || tatra svarūpasattāyāmapi prakṛtakarmaṇaḥ | pradhānakāryāśaktatva eṣa nyāyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 36 || virodhe dravyaguṇayorbalavaddravyamīritam | pradhānakāryaśaktatve guṇasaṃpādanāya na || 37 || upādānaṃ pratinidhestatraiṣa nyāya īritaḥ | lope svarākṣarādīnāmābhirityāhutiḥ smṛtā || 38|| mantralope prokṣaṇādilope ca vyatyaye tathā | tvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ na ityābhyāṃ juhuyādāhutidvayam || 39 || yadi pradhānayāgātprāgluptasya smaraṇaṃ bhavet | tadā cittottaramaniṣpannārthāṅgasya vai kriyā || 40 || niṣpannārthaṃ yadāṅgaṃ ceccittameva na tu kriyā | udāharaṇametasya jñeyamidhmendhanādikam || 41 || ājyabhāgottaraṃ mukhyāhutitaḥ prāksmṛtiryadi | tadedhmamanale dattvā viparyāsārthacittakam || 42 || ūrdhvaṃ ceccittameva syāditi sūtre nidānake | ājyabhāgādyaṅgalope tvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ na āhutī || 43 || akāle cetkṛtaṃ karma bhavedyattasya naiva tu | kramārthaṃ punarāvṛttirityuktaṃ kaṭhasūtrake || 44 || paristaraṇadarbhāṇāṃ paridhīnāṃ ca barhiṣaḥ | idhmopaveṣaśulbānāṃ dāhe ca cchedane tathā || 45 || mūtrādyairupaghāte ca sarvathā ca vināśane | tajjātīyaṃ ca tadrūpaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ tathaiva ca || 46 || āhṛtya tadyathāpūrvaṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśya ca | tena karma prakartavyaṃ naivopahatasaṃgrahaḥ || 47 || dve tvamagne ayāḥ prājāpatyarcā ca sruvāhutī | idhme nyūnā samiccetsyādyatpākatnāhutiṃ tadā || 48 || hutvā saṃpādayennyūnamuktasaṃskārapūrvakam | adhike tvadhikaṃ tyājyaṃ bhavedatrāpi sā''hutiḥ || 49 || bahiridhmādipatane sthālīpākādikarmasu | saṃsthāpya tūṣṇīṃ svasthāne juhuyātsarvacittakam || 50 || ādheyāgnyupaghāte tu punastvāmantrataḥ samit | etenaivā''hutistvekā hotavyopahate'nale || 51 || yadā kadācidagniścetsvayaṃ prajvalitastadā | uddīpyasvetimantrābhyāṃ dvābhyāmagnau samiddvayam || 52 || praṇītānāṃ prokṣaṇīnāṃ skandane pātrapūraṇam | āpo hi ṣṭhādibhiḥ kuryāttatamityāhutistataḥ || 53 || śoṣe srāve'pyevameva prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam | samutsarpedāyatanādbahiragniḥ sa cedyadi || 54 || punaḥ prakṣepaṇe yogyastaṃ dhṛṣṭyā''dāya vai punaḥ | svasthāne vyāhṛtībhistaṃ prakṣipettadanantaram || 55 || sarvaprāyaścittamanājñātatrayajapādi ca | adhvaryvāgnīdhrahotṝṇāṃ prayājānāṃ tathaiva ca || 56 || abhāvānmā tama iti cittaṃ naitadbhavediha | aṅgāro yadyāyatanātpatitaścedbahiḥ sa ca || 57 || śrautāgnerlaukikāgnervā sāṃnidhyājjñāyate nahi | kasyānalasyāyamiti tadāṅgāramupekṣya tam || 58 || sarvākhyacittaṃ juhuyādityuktaṃ dviśatīkṛtā | śrautāgnāvatha gṛhyāgnau hotavyaṃ sarvacittakam || 59 || nirvāpādūrdhvamājyaṃ cetskandedutpavanātpurā | varaṃ dattvā brāhmaṇāya devānjanamaganniti || 60 || etairmantraiḥ pañcabhiryatskannaṃ tadanumantrayet | utpūyamānamājyaṃ cetskandeddattvā tadā varam || 61 || ajāṃ gāṃ vā pradattvā ca devānityādi pūrvavat | skandedutpūtamājyaṃ cettadā yatsvagṛhe bhavet || 62 || mukhyaṃ dravyaṃ pradattvā taddevānityādi pūrvavat | gṛhītājyaskandane tu varadānānumantraṇe || 63 || vidhāya bhūpataya ityetena manunā puraḥ | skannājyasya prakurvīta prādeśaṃ tadanantaram || 64 || bhuvaneti tu mantreṇa tasya dakṣiṇato bhavet | bhūtānāṃ pataya iti tasya paścimato bhavet || 65 || bhūtāyetyuttare tasyordhvaṃ tu vyāhṛtibhiḥ smṛtaḥ | svāhāntā manavo jñeyā budhairvyāhṛtibhirvinā || 66 || skannopari tato vāri siñcetsaṃ tvetimantrataḥ | prakṣipecchucideśasthaṃ cedyajñasyetimantrataḥ || 67 || abhimantryāśucisthaṃ cedgṛhṇīyātsthānataḥ punaḥ | haviḥskande'pyeṣa eva prāyaścittavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 68 || skandanaṃ sruvaparyāptasyādhikasyāpi vā yadi | etatskandanacittaṃ tu tadā jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 69 || sruvaparyāptato nyūnaskande sarvābhidhaṃ bhavet || dravadravyeṣu sarveṣvapyevameva prakīrtitam || 70 || sarveṣu kaṭhinadravyeṣvaṅguṣṭhaparuṣo'dhikam | skannaṃ yadi bhavetpūrvaṃ cittamūne tu sarvakam || 71 || naiva cittaṃ bhavetskande barhirbhasmānalādiṣu | agnikṣiptāhuteḥ skando bahiṣparidhi cedbhavet || 72 || saṃkṛṣyāñjalinā tāṃ tu juhuyānmā yajetyataḥ | svasyaiva kartṛtā'tra syānnā''gnīdhrastadasaṃbhavāt || 73 || etā saṃkṛṣya juhudhītyetallopo'ta eva tu | pūrṇapātrapradānasyāpi lopo'tra prakīrtitaḥ || 74 || nirvāpādāvavihitāṃ devatāṃ yojayedyadi | tasmindravye tu saṃyojya vihitāṃ devatāṃ tadā || 75 || yadvo devā atītyetanmanunā juhuyāttataḥ | devatāṃ cedavihitāṃ saṃsmaranniṣṭavāṃstadā || 76 || prāyaścittamidaṃ kṛtvā yāgamāvartayetkṛtam | etadeva bhaveccittamaupāsanahutāvapi || 77 || viparyāso yadi bhavetsvāhākārapradānayoḥ | tadā manojyotiriti juhuyādvai manasvatīm || 78 || avadānadravyayāgadevamantraviparyaye | jñāte tantrasamāpteḥ prāktvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ na āhutī || 79 || juhuyāddve tataḥ sarvaprāyaścittādikaṃ smṛtam | yanmukhyaṃ svagṛhe dravyaṃ dadyādviprāya vai tataḥ || 80 || tantrāvṛttiḥ punaḥ kāryā'ta ūrdhvaṃ na bhaveddhutiḥ | pradhānadravyasyaikasyānekasyāpyathavā punaḥ || 81 || bahupradhāne home'nutpāde syādyadi yāgataḥ | pūrvaṃ smṛtistadā tvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ no agna āhutī || 82 || hutvā dravyaṃ tadutpādya yāgaṃ kuryādyathāsthitam | smṛte yāgāduttaraṃ tu karmā''rabdhaṃ samāpayet || 83 || cittaṃ tato'nantaroktamāhutyātmakamācaret | sāṅgasyāntaritasyaiva pradhānasya tataḥ kṛtiḥ || 84 || (ekadeśāpahāre'gnermanasvatyāhutirbhavet | aupāsanahutau prātarhome cedagnaye hutam || 85 || sāyaṃhome tu sūryāya hutaṃ cetsyātpunaḥ kriyā | tadā homasya kartavyā pakṣaścetsvīkṛto bhavet || 86 || tadaiva cittametatsyānnānyapakṣe bhavedidam |) ekāvadānāgrahaṇe jñāte yāgātpuro yadi || 87 || tvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ na ityābhyāṃ juhuyādāhutidvayam | avadānaṃ gṛhītvā tadyāgaṃ kuryādyathāsthitam || 88 || yāgottaraṃ yadi jñātamāhutidvayameva tu | hotavyaṃ na tadā yāgaḥ punaḥ kāryo manīṣibhiḥ || 89 || atha vakṣye havirdoṣānyairhavirduṣṭatāmiyāt | aśucirmakṣikā nīlā yā'śvadehe ca vartate || 90 || kuśātikā gavāmaṅge talpādiṣu ca matkuṇaḥ | yūkā cailaśiraḥsthā syātkīṭaśca malapiṇḍakṛt || 91 || mārjāro nakulaścā''khurviṣṭhā vāyasakukkuṭau | śvā vānaro vastradaśā chinnakeśanakhāni ca || 92 || aśuci syāccharīrasthamapi kutsitakaṃ nakham | dravyāṇi pūtigandhīni ghuṇākhyaḥ kīṭa eva ca || 93 || drapsasvedāśrvasṛksnehakāsakṣavathavastathā | nāsikāmukhajo bindurdrapso jñeyo hi sūribhiḥ || 94 || śarīrajaṃ jalaṃ svedo vāryaśrūktaṃ hi netrajam || asṛgjñeyaṃ hi rudhiraṃ sneho ghrāṇamalaḥ smṛtaḥ || 95 || kāsaḥ śleṣmavikāraḥ syādvadanādyo vinirgataḥ | kṣavathuḥ kṣutamityuktaṃ gopālākhyena sūriṇā || 96 || mūtramajje vasāśukre karṇaviṭpūyasastathā | etairaśucibhiḥ spṛṣṭamanyairetādṛśairapi || 97 || udakyāsūtikābhyāṃ vā caṇḍālapatitādibhiḥ | śiśuryajvā garbhiṇī ca brāhmaṇo nṛpa ityamī || 98 || bhrūṇā etadvihantāraḥ smṛtā bhrūṇahano budhaiḥ | etairanyaiśca pāpiṣṭhaiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ ca yadbhavet || 99 || yatra prasūyate nārī mriyate dahyate'pi vā | caṇḍālādhyuṣite yatra yatra viṣṭhādisaṃgatiḥ || 100 || tasminnamedhye deśe yannihitaṃ tacca duṣyati | duṣṭaṃ pradhānayāgātprāgghaviryadi bhavettadā || 1 || śuddhavāriṇi hastena taddhaviḥ prakṣipettataḥ | dve minde juhuyātsarvaprāyaścittādikaṃ tathā || 2 || punarhavistāvadevotpādya yāgaḥ kramādbhavet | atyaśaktau punaryāgamājyenaiva samācaret || 3 || duṣṭe yāgottaraṃ śeṣamājyenaiva samāpayet | duṣṭena haviṣā yāgaḥ kṛtaścejjuhuyāttadā || 4 || praṇavena vyāhṛtibhirjuhuyāddve sruvāhutī | punaryāgo nātra bhavetkātyāyanamunismṛteḥ || 5 || avadānasya grahaṇe doṣajñānaṃ yadā bhavet | prakṣipettaddhaviḥ sarvaṃ duṣṭaṃ śuddhajale tataḥ || 6 || punarhaviḥ samutpādya tvaṃ naḥ sa tvaṃ na āhutī | hutvā yāgaṃ tena kuryādanājñātajapādi ca || 7 || madhyātpūrvārdhato'vattaṃ gṛhītaṃ doṣagāmi cet | tatprakṣipya jale śuddhe madhyātpūrvārdhataḥ punaḥ || 8 || avadāya yajetsarvaprāyaścittādikaṃ tataḥ | pradhānayāgadravyasya pradhānātprāgvināśanam || 9 || jñātaṃ bhavettadā tasminneva tantre tadaiva tu | naṣṭaṃ haviḥ samutpādya tena yāgaṃ samācaret || 110 || yāge bahuhaviṣke syātsarveṣāṃ haviṣāṃ yadi | nāśo doṣopahāro vā pratisaṃkhyāya devatāḥ || 11 || iṣṭvā''jyenaiva sarvāstā yāgamāvartayetpunaḥ | avarjanīyaiḥ kṣudraiścenmakṣikākīṭakādibhiḥ || 12 || pipīlikādibhiścaiva jīvaiḥ syāddhaviṣo yadi | yogaḥ pañcādhikairjñeyā tadā tasya sadoṣatā || 13 || nyūnaiścetpatitāñjīvānuddhṛtyādbhiḥ samukṣya ca | laukikābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ pavanāttasya yogyatā || 14 || haviṣyapakve cittaṃ tu karmā''rabdhaṃ samāpya tat | catuḥśarāvamātraṃ tu paktvā suśṛtamodanam || 15 || bhojayettena caturaḥ suśīlānbrāhmaṇāñśucīn | teṣāṃ bhārgava ekaḥ syāttebhyo deyā varāḥ samāḥ || 16 || kṛtsnaṃ dagdhaṃ yadā tatsyātpunarutpādayeddhaviḥ | sa eva yāgaḥ kartavyo na punaryāga iṣyate || 17 || svalpaṃ haviradagdhaṃ cettadā sarvābhidhānakam | prāyaścittaṃ prakurvīta tato yāgaṃ ca śeṣataḥ || 18 || samāpayeddhṛtenānyanna punaryāga iṣyate | adhunā havirutsekaprāyaścittaṃ pravakṣyate || 19 || prācyāṃ diśi samutseke'gnaye svāhāhutirbhavet | dakṣiṇasyāṃ yamāyeti varuṇāyeti paścime || 120 || somāyetyuttarasyāṃ syātsarvābhyaḥ sarvadikṣu cet | yadyavāntaradikṣu syāddhomo vyāhṛtibhistadā || 21 || sarveṣveteṣu homatvātsvāhākārāntatā bhavet | āpyāyasveti samiti cā''jyenā''pyāyayeddhaviḥ || 22 || dve minde juhuyātsarvaprāyaścittādikaṃ tathā | yāgānvādhānayormadhye yadi sūryagraho bhavet || 23 || udvayaṃ tamasasparyudu tyaṃ citramiti tribhiḥ | juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ pradhānātpūrvameva tu || 24 || kaiścinmantratrayeṇātropasthānamapi kīrtitam | madhye candragrahaścetprākpradhānādāhutidvayam || 125 || navo navo yamādityā ityābhyāṃ juhuyāttadā | kaiścinmantradvayenātropasthānamapi kīrtitam || 26 || anvādhānākriyāyāṃ tu na prāyaścittamiṣyate | vānaspatyasya pātrasya bhedane'nyatsamāharet || 27 || gṛhyāgnau jvalitaṃ bhinnaṃ prāgdaṇḍaṃ praharettataḥ | laukikānalasādhyāyāṃ kriyāyāṃ laukike'nale || 28 || vānaspatyasya bhinnasya prakṣepaḥ pūrvavadbhavet | mṛnmayaṃ cedvibhidyeta bhūmirbhūmimagāditi || 29 || brahmābhimantritaṃ bhinnamabhāve svābhimantritam | kṣipetpātraṃ jale śuddhe tatkārye'nyanniyojayet || 130 || kriyākāle vidhimimaṃ prāhuranye tu sarvadā | yatkiṃcitpātrabhede tu praṇavena ghṛtāhutiḥ || 31 || samastavyāhṛtībhirvā hotavyā yajñapārśvataḥ | ājyādhiśrayaṇātpūrvaṃ nirūḍhāgnervināśanam || 32 || bhavedyadi tadā sthānātpunaḥ kuryānnirūhaṇam | tataścaturgṛhītena manasvatyāhutirbhavet || 33 || ājyasyodvāsanādūrdhvaṃ nirūḍhāgnervināśane | manasvatyeva hotavyā na tu tatra nirūhaṇam || 34 || pradhānāhutisaṃsṛṣṭā syāccetsviṣṭakṛdāhutiḥ | tadā sarvābhidhaṃ cittamanājñātajapādi ca || 135 || anvādhānottaraṃ svapne bhavetsvāmyṛtvijāṃ yadi | retaḥpātastademaṃ me tattvā yāmīti cā''hutī || 36 || hutvā vyāhṛtibhiścaikāṃ sūryaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ | punarmāmanuvākasya japastriratha vā sakṛt || 37|| visargo buddhipūrvaṃ cettadā vrātapato'dhikaḥ | sthālīpākaḥ prakartavyaḥ pūrṇāhutirathāpi vā || 38 || naimittiko virāmaścetkiṃcitprārabdhakarmaṇi | sadā sarvābhidhaṃ cittaṃ hutvā śeṣaṃ samāpayet || 39 || catuṣpādadvipādānāṃ karmamadhye bhavedyadi | ṛtvijāmṛtvigagnyorvā patihotrorathāpi vā || 140 || cedvā bhavetsvāmipatnyorantarā gamanaṃ tadā | mindādisaṃjñaṃ durgādisaṃjñaṃ vā juhuyādgaṇam || 41 || darvyāṃ dvādaśavāraṃ tu gṛhītvā sruci vā ghṛtam | tena pañcā''hutīḥ kāryā durgādigaṇahomake || 42 || etatkartumaśaktaścejjuhuyātsarvacittakam | mindāhutidvayaṃ caiva vyāhṛtyaḥ praṇavādhikāḥ || 43 || vāruṇyastantumatyaścānukhyā caiva manasvatī | mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sapta te prajāpata eva ca || 44 || eṣa mantrasamūhaḥ syānmidādigaṇasaṃjñakaḥ | jātavedasa ādyaḥ syānmanojyotirdvitīyakaḥ || 45 || mahāvyāhṛtayastisra eṣa durgādiko gaṇaḥ | anvāhitāgniratha cetprayāsyañjuhuyāttadā || 46 || tubhyamityāhutiṃ hutvā'raṇyoḥ samidhi vā tataḥ | samāropyānalaṃ yatra vasettatra tu manthanam || 47 || upāvarohamantreṇa kṛtvā karma samāpayet | pramādādiṣṭyakaraṇamanvādhānottaraṃ yadi || 48 || vyastābhiśca samastābhiḥ syādāhuticatuṣṭayam | aupāsanāhutidravyaṃ kaṭhinaṃ vā'tha ceddrutam || 49 || skandedaskāndyaudaskānityetābhyāmabhimantrya tat | unnambhayeti tasyāthopariṣṭātprakṣipejjalam || 150 || anājñātajapaṃ kṛtvā sarvacittaṃ vidhāya ca | skannaṃ dravyaṃ samādadyādgatvottaradiśaṃ tataḥ || 51 || udghāṭitabilāṃ kuryādvalmīkasya vapāṃ śucim | upaspṛśya jalaṃ śuddhaṃ dakṣiṇena kareṇa tu || 52 || skannaṃ sarvaṃ samādāya prajāpata iti hyṛcā | tasminbile kṣipedbhūrityupatiṣṭheddhṛdā tataḥ || 53 || juhoticodanābhāvānnarci svāhākṛtirbhavet | punarhomaṃ prakurvīta saṃkalpādi ca pūrvavat || 54 || aupāsanāhutidravye kaṭhine vā drute'pi vā | amedhyasevī piṇḍasya kartā kīṭo yadā patet || 155 || prāyaścittaṃ tadā tatra pūrvavattu samācaret | tatrā''dānaṃ hyantimena madhyamenāthavā bhavet || 56 || palāśasya ca parṇena mahī dyauḥ pṛthivītyṛcā | antaḥparidhi deśe tattyajetpātrasya saṃskṛtim || 57 || vidadhīta tato yogyāmanyatsarvaṃ tu pūrvavat | payasaupāsanahutau sthālyāścetsravaṇaṃ bhavet || 58 || garbha sravantamagadamityetenābhimantrayet | sūryāstato homakālaḥ proktastu nava nāḍikāḥ || 59 || tadatikramaṇe hutvā''hutiṃ doṣetimantrataḥ | etasyā āhuterdevo varuṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 160 || prāktanaṃ samidādhānātkarma kuryādyathāsthitam | rundhyādyāvadbalaṃ śvāsaṃ varaṃ dadyādanantaram || 61 || samastavyāhṛtīruktvā nityaṃ homaṃ samācaret | vyāhṛtībhirupasthāya homaśeṣaṃ samāpya ca || 62 || varuṇāya caruḥ kāryaḥ pūrṇāhutirathāpi vā | prātarhomasya kālastu ghaṭyo dvādaśa vā daśa || 63 || saṃgavaḥ sūribhiḥ proktaḥ praharātmaka eva vā | etasyātikrame prātarityetenā''hutirbhavet || 64 || etasyā āhuterdevo mitraḥ sūryo'thavā smṛtaḥ | pūrvaṃ ca samidādhānācchvāsarodho yathābalam || 165 || varadānaṃ prakurvīta vyāhṛtyuccāraṇaṃ tathā | nityahomamupasthānaṃ vyāhṛtībhistathaiva ca || 66 || homaśeṣaṃ samāpyātha maitrasauryacarū smṛtau | vakṣye homasya vicchede prāyaścittamathādhunā || 67 || ayāścetyāhutiḥ kāryā vicchede'rvāktrirātrataḥ | manasvatyā dvitīyā syādarvākcetsaptarātrataḥ || 68 || tantumatyā tṛtīyā syādarvākceddvādaśāhataḥ | tatrāpi homavicchede punarāhitireva tu || 69 || juhuyātpratisaṃkhyāya vaitānhomānmahāpadi | ūrdhvaṃ cedeṣa āpattāvapi kalpo na yujyate || 170 || khaṇḍasyā''kṣepakatve'pi vastutaḥ prabalatvataḥ | śrautameva bhaveccittaṃ nāyā ityādikaṃ bhavet || 71 || taddhi śāstrāntaroktatvāddurbalaṃ nātra yujyate | śrautaṃ cittaṃ tadadhunā suspaṣṭaṃ saṃpravakṣyate || 72 || dvayostrayāṇāmekasya vā homasyātipātanam | saptahotṛmanasvatyau juhuyāttadanantaram || 73 || samācaredatikrāntaṃ homaṃ netyapare jaguḥ | evameva prātaraupāsanahomaṃ samācaret || 74 || caturthyādiṣu ṣaṣṭhānteṣvekasya hyatipātanam | saptānteṣviti kecittu budhāḥ prāhuḥ purātanāḥ || 175 || dvayostrayāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ vā syāttantumate caruḥ | aṣṭamādiṣvapi carureva tāntumato bhavet || 76 || ata ūrdhvamatikrāme bhavettu punarāhutiḥ | utaikāhamiti śrutyaikāhaṃ vā dvyahameva ca || 77 || homātipattau cittaṃ na bhavetkaiściditīritam | yadyastamitavibhrāntyā juhuyādasvakālake || 78 || sāṅgo homaḥ punaḥ kāryastasminnevānale tataḥ || jātatvānna punaḥ kāryaṃ prāduṣkaraṇamatra tu || 79 || homānantaramagnestu bhavataṃ na upasthitiḥ | evamevoditabhrāntau prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam || 180 || ūrdhvaṃ prāduṣkṛterhomātpūrvaṃ svāmī samācaret | bhakṣaṇaṃ ceddhuteḥ pūrvaṃ tasminnevānale tataḥ || 81 || kuryādvrātapatasthālīpākaṃ syādvā''hutidvayam | yatte vayaṃ yathā heti homamantrau prakīrtitau || 82 || samidhau vā samādadhyādathavā prajapedimau | patnyāmapyevamevedaṃ prāyaścittaṃ prakīrtitam || 83 || atisaṃkaṭataḥ prātarhomo yadi na jāyate | tadaitasmindine svāmī bhojanaṃ na samācaret || 84 || sāyaṃhome tu tadrātrau bhojanaṃ na samācaret | etāvatā homasiddhiḥ prāyaścittaṃ na hīṣyate || 185 || pūrvāhuteścedupari skandaḥ syāduttarāhuteḥ | tadā yatretyṛcā vahnau vānaspatyābhidhānayā || 86 || ādadhyātsamidhaṃ paścātskannaśeṣeṇa tūttarām | tūṣṇīṃ hutvā''hutiṃ sarvaṃ homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || 87 || punarhomaṃ tataḥ kuryādabhihome'pyado bhavet | uttarāhutiparyāptadravyasattve bhavenna hi || 88 || aupāsanāhutidravye vṛṣṭibinduḥ patedyadi | upasādya haviḥ kūrce prākṛtāṃ samidāhitim || 89 || kṛtvā japedvyāhṛtīstu tenaiva haviṣā tataḥ | mitro janānkalpayatītyanayā prathamāhutiḥ || 190 || uttarāhutihomādihomaśeṣaṃ tataścaret | tataḥ saṃkalpaprabhṛtipunarhomaṃ samācaret || 91 || prāduṣkaraṇakālasyātikrame sarvacittakam | aupāsanāhutau syācceddvitīyāhutivismṛtiḥ || 92 || samāpteḥ karmaṇaḥ prāksā hotavyā'ntaritā''hutiḥ | uttaraṃ cetsmṛtiḥ sarvacittameva na cā''hutiḥ || 93 || ādyāhutervismṛtau tu kṛtsnaṃ homaṃ punaścaret | svakāle yadyanārambhaḥ syādādyaupāsanāhuteḥ || 94 || tadā paredyuḥ sāyaṃ syātsaptahotrāhutistathā | manasvatyā dvitīyā syāttato homaṃ samārabhet || 195 || piṇḍayajñātyaye saptahotṛhomaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | aupāsanāgnergamana upalepādi pūrvavat || 96 || āhṛtya śrotriyāgārātpratiṣṭhāpya havirbhujam | vivāhe yadi nirmanthyo mathitavyastadā'nalaḥ || 97 || ā'nyasmāddhomakālātstrī nāśnīyādathavā gṛhī | upoṣaṇāśaktatāyāṃ vidhyantaramathocyate || 98 || upalepādikaṃ vahnisthāpanāntaṃ tu pūrvavat | pātrāṇi ca samāsādya kuryātprāgvatpavitrake || 99 || saṃskṛtya prokṣaṇīḥ paścātpātrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tataḥ | darvīṃ saṃmṛjya saṃskṛtyā''jyaṃ prāguktavidhānataḥ || 200 || paristīryānalaṃ paścātpariṣekaṃ samācaret | alaṃkāraṃ prakurvītābhyādhānaṃ samidhastathā || 1 || ayāścetyāhutiṃ hutvā visṛjya staraṇāni tu | kṛtvottaraṃ tataḥ sekaṃ homaṃ nityaṃ samācaret || 2 || apoḍhe vartamāne tu mukhyo'gniryadi gacchati | apoḍhāgnerekadeśaṃ mukhyāgnyāyatane tataḥ || 3 || nidhāya sarvacittaṃ tu juhuyādbhuvaāhutim | śāntike pauṣṭike caiva gṛhyānukte tu karmaṇi || 4 || agneranugatiścetsyāttadbhasma prakṣipedbahiḥ | anantaraṃ sthaṇḍilasyopalepollekhanādikam || 205 || kṛtvā saṃsthāpya tatrāgnimājyasaṃskṛtimācaret | juhuyāttena sarvākhyacittaṃ saṃsthāpite'nale || 6 || ayāścetyapi hotavyamiti kecidbudhā jaguḥ | aupāsanāgnyanugatāvevāyā iti cittakam || 7 || ityetasminmate naitadbhavedupanayādiṣu | kiṃ tveteṣvapi vijñeyaṃ sarvākhyaṃ cittameva hi || 8 || gāyatryā upadeśātprāṅmukhyahomādanantaram | upanāye'gnināśaścedagniṃ saṃsthāpya pūrvavat || 9 || hutvā mukhyāhutī tatra juhuyātsarvacittakam | upadeśottaraṃ nāśe syātsarvābhidhamātrakam || 210 || pāṇigrahaṇataḥ prākcedvivāhe'nalanāśanam | tadā mukhyāhutīreva nāyāścetyādi cittakam || 11 || ata ūrdhvaṃ tvetadeva sarvākhyamubhayatra tu | saṃsarge kuṇapodakyāsūtikāpatitādibhiḥ || 12 || anyāgnibhiśca saṃsarge syāttatra punarāhitiḥ | (vastuto'nyāgnisaṃsarge vaivicaścarureva tu || 13 || kṣepakatvāttu khaṇḍasya naivātra punarāhitiḥ |) śrautātideśātsūtyādyaiḥ saṃsarga iyameva tu || 14 || gṛhyāgnidvayasaṃsarge gṛhyāgnisvāmināvubhau | gṛhītvā samidhau tasminsaṃsṛṣṭāgniṃ sahaiva tu || 215 || mantreṇa tu samāropya tatastaṃ laukikānalam | mantreṇācchā gira iti vibhajyobhau tato'nale || 16 || sve sve svāṃ svāṃ ca samidhamupāveti tu mantrataḥ | nikṣipettāṃ tataḥ pāko vaivicastūbhayorbhavet || 17 || pṛthaggato'gnyekadeśaḥ saṃsṛṣṭo laukikāgninā | śrautāgninā vā'tha yadi vaivico na tadā bhavet || 18 || kiṃtūpekṣyaikadeśaṃ taṃ juhuyātsarvacittakam | śatadvayīkṛdvaradarājābhyāmitthamīritam || 19 || vanadāhāgnisaṃsarge bhavedvrātapataścaruḥ | carustadā syācchucaye cetsaṃsargaḥ śavāgninā || 220 || sūtikānalasaṃsarge bhavetsāṃkusukaścaruḥ | vaidyutānalasaṃsarge bhavedāpsumataścaruḥ || 21 || pākānāṃ vaivicādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ saṃnipātane | nimittakramasattve'pi jñeyo vācanikaḥ kramaḥ || 22 || viviciśca śuciḥ paścādvratabhṛccāpsumāṃstataḥ | tataḥ saṃkusuka iti kramastatraivameva tu || 23 || saṃnipāte kṣāmavato'pyanta eva bhavedayam | caturādiṣu yasya syānnimittasya tvasaṃbhavaḥ || 24 || tāvanmātraṃ parityajyānyaḥ kramaḥ pūrvavadbhavet | sthālīpākātipattau tu caruḥ pāthikṛto bhavet || 225 || dvayoratikrame vaiśvānarapāthikṛtau carū | tṛtīyādyatipattau tu syāttatra punarāhitiḥ || 26 || kṣepakatve tu khaṇḍasya sthālīpākātipātane | śrauta eva prakāraḥ syātsa idānīṃ pravakṣyate || 27 || ārabdhau pārvaṇasthālīpākau cedatipannakau | syātāṃ tadā pāthikṛtaṃ sthālīpākaṃ samācaret || 28 || bhavetāṃ yadyanārabdhāvetau cedatipannakau | tadā vaiśvānarasthālīpākaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 29 || prathamasya prayogasya saṃkalpottaramakriyā | cedvibhreṣanimittaṃ tu prakartavyaṃ carutrayam || 230 || sthālīpākamakaraṇe tatprakāraḥ pradarśyate | karmaṇo gauṇakālaścettatastasyāpyanuṣṭhitiḥ || 31 || prakārāntaramapyatrādhunā'tipatane bruve | ārabdhayordvayoḥ pātaḥ syāccetpāthikṛtaścaruḥ || 32 || ūrdhvayorapi pātaścettadā vaiśvānaraścaruḥ | svakāle yadyanārambhaścetsthālīpākayordvayoḥ || 33 || vibhreṣārthaṃ tadā kāryaṃ sthālīpākatrayaṃ budhaiḥ | parvaṇi vratalope tu kuryādvrātapataṃ carum || 34 || parvaṇyārtyā'śrupāte tu kuryādvrātabhṛtaṃ carum | pavitrasya vināśe tu syātpavitravate caruḥ || 235 || hiraṇyasya vināśe tu syāddhiraṇyavate caruḥ | svakīyagṛhadāhe tu kuryātkāmavate carum || 36 || homamaupāsanaṃ darśasthālīpākādikaṃ tathā | juhuyātprātarasnātaścettadā vāruṇaścaruḥ || 37 || ṛtviksyādyadi susnāto'snātaścātha svayaṃ bhavet | tadā'pi vāruṇaḥ kāryo nātyantātura eṣa tu || 38 || vijñeyaṃ prātarevedaṃ sāyaṃ syātsarvacittakam | adane sūtakānnasya bhavettantumate caruḥ || 39 ||
