brāhmaṇamupanāyayet' iti | etayā'nnādyakāmaṃ yājayedityatra tu yajamānasya prayojyādhvaryvādikartṛtve mānābhāvādyajeḥ svārthaṇijarthaviśeṣaṇatayā parārthavaccoccāraṇaṃ vidhiśca syāditi ṇijarthāvivakṣayā yajanameva vidhīyata ityāhuḥ | kaiścittūpanāyanaśabdenopanayanamevābhidhīyata ityuktaṃ tadayuktam | upanayanaviṣayaprayojakavyāpārasyopanayanaśabdavācyatvāllakṣaṇāyāṃ mānābhāvāditi hemādriḥ | anye tu ācāryasamīpanayanāṅgako gāyatryupadeśaḥ pradhānaṃ 'gāyatryā brāhmaṇamasṛjat' iti śrutau 'gāyatryā brāhmaṇamupanayīta' iti kātyāyanasmṛtau copanaya nasya gāyatryupadeśāṅgatvadarśanāt | evaṃ copanayanapadaṃ yogarūḍham | samiddarśādipadasyevāṅgavācino'pyupanayanapadasya tatsaṃbandhena pradhānasaṃjñātvopapatterityāhuḥ | pare tu paṅkajapadasyevaikatra yaugikasya rūḍhasya ca yogarūḍhapadavācyatvādatra tu nayane yogasya gāyatryupadeśe ca rūḍheśca sadbhāvenaikatra vidyamānatvābhāvānna yogarūḍhatvamupanayanapadasya | tena samīpanayanasyaiva pradhānatvamityāhuḥ | gṛhyam -- "upanayanaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ saptavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayītaikādaśavarṣa rājanyaṃ dvādaśavarṣaṃ vaiśyaṃ vasante brāhmaṇaṃ grīṣme rājanya śaradi vaiśyamāpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre viśeṣeṇa puṃnāmadheye" iti | sapta varṣāṇi janmataḥ parimāṇaṃ yasya sa saptavarṣaḥ | etādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayet | ekādaśadvādaśavarṣaśabdayorapyevaṃ vyutpattirjñeyā | yasminpakṣe kalābhiścandramāḥ pūryate sa āpūryamāṇapakṣaḥ pūrvapakṣaḥ śuklapakṣa iti yāvat | puṇye nakṣatre śubhe nakṣatre jyotiḥśāstravihite | puṃnāmadheye puṃśabdābhidheye | viśeṣeṇetivacanātpuṃśabdābhidheye viśiṣṭamupanayanam | anyasminnapi puṇya eva na garhite | puṃśabdābhidheyāni nakṣatrāṇi tu mātṛdattenoktāni -- "aśvayukpunarvasū tiṣyo hastaḥ śatabhiṣakproṣṭhapadāḥ" iti | gargasmṛtau tu śravaṇābhijidanūrādhā apyuktāḥ -- "puṃnāma śravaṇastiṣyo hastaścaiva punarvasū | abhijitproṣṭhapāccaiva anūrādhā tathā'śvayuk" iti || dharmasūtre'pyupanayanakāla uktaḥ -- "vasante brāhmaṇaṃ grīṣme rājanya śaradi vaiśyaṃ garbhāṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇaṃ garbhekādaśe rājanyaṃ garbhadvādaśe vaiśyam" iti || garbhasahacaritaṃ varṣamapi lakṣaṇayā garbhaśabdenocyate | tadaṣṭamaṃ yeṣāṃ ṣaṣṭhādīnāṃ varṣāṇāṃ tāni garbhāṣṭamāni teṣūpanayanamityarthaḥ | garbhādiḥ saṃkhyā varṣāṇāṃ tadaṣṭameṣu brāhmaṇamupanayeditivacanāt | varṣaṃ cātra cāndramānena caitraśuklapratipadādīti kecit | anye tvaṣṭamamāsārambhaṃ garbhādhānaṃ vā''rabhya varṣapravṛttimāhuḥ | garbhāṣṭameṣvityatra bahuvacanaṃ ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ saṃgrahārthamiti sudarśanaḥ | kāmyānāmapi teṣvantarbhāvārthamityujjvalākṛto mahādevadīkṣitāḥ | vasantādīnāṃ punarvidhānamudagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre caulakarmopanayanagodānavivāhā ityāśvalāyanoktasya vasantātiriktasyodagayanasya bādhanārtham | 'saptavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vasanta upanayedekādaśavarṣa rājanyaṃ grīṣme dvādaśavarṣaṃ vaiśya śaradi' ityeva vaktavye kālavayasoḥ pṛthaggrahaṇamaśaktau kāmasaṃyoge vā'nyasminnapi vayasi sarvasminnapyudagayane bhavediti kālavayasoranityatvakhyāpanārtham | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "garbhāṣṭame'ṣṭame vā'bde brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam | rājñāmekādaśe saike viśāmeke yathākulam" iti || garbhādhānamavadhiṃ kṛtvā janmato vā'ṣṭamamiti vijñāneśvaraḥ | garbhagrahaṇaṃ sarvatrānuvartate | "garbhādekādaśe rājño garbhāttu dvādaśe viśaḥ" | itismṛtyantarādityapyāha saḥ | saike dvādaśe | ukteṣu vacaneṣvaṣṭamavarṣasaṃbandhenaivāṣṭavarṣatvaṃ na tvatītāṣṭavarṣatveneti bodhyam | atha kāmyakālaḥ | sa ca dharmasūtre -- "atha kāmyāni saptama āyuṣkāmamaṣṭame brahmavarcasakāmaṃ navame tejaskāmaṃ daśame'nnādyakāmamekādaśa indriyakāmaṃ dvādaśe paśukāmamāṣoḍaśādbrāhmaṇasyānātyaya ādvāviṃśātkṣatriyasyā''caturviṃśādvaiśyasya" iti | etāni kāmanimittānyupanayanāni | sarvatropanayedityanuṣajyate | atrāpi garbhata ityanuvartate | atrā''ṅabhividhau | maryādāyāmiti kecit | atyayo'tikramaḥ | sa evā''tyayastadabhāvo'nātyayaḥ | yādṛcchiko dīrgha āṅo vā prayogaḥ | prakaraṇādupanayanasyānātyaya iti gamyate | āpattau ṣoḍaśavarṣaparyanto'pyupanayanasya kāla iti tātparyārthaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ tu dharmasūtroktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kartavyam | tacca -- "atikrānte sāvitryāḥ kāla ṛtuṃ traividyakaṃ brahmacaryaṃ carettata upanayanamathodakopasparśanamathādhyāpyaḥ" iti | yasya yaḥ sāvitryāḥ kālastadatikrame traividyakaṃ tryavayavā vidyā trividyā tāmadhīyate te traividyāsteṣāmidaṃ traividyakam | 'caraṇāddharmāmnāyayoḥ' iti vuñpratyayaḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ brahmacaryamagniparicaryāmadhyayanaṃ guruśuśrūṣāmiti parihāpya sakalaṃ brahmacaryadharmaṃ caret | kiyantaṃ kālam | ṛtum | 'kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge' iti dvitīyā | ṛtumitivacanādṛtvārambhe prāyaścittārambhaḥ | tata upanayanam | evaṃcaritavrata upanetavyaḥ | athodakopasparśanam | tata upanayanamārabhya saṃvatsaramudakopasparśanaṃ snānaṃ kartavyam | śaktasya triṣavaṇamaśaktasya yathāśakti | saṃvatsaramityāpastambaḥ | athādhyāpyaḥ | evaṃcaritavrataḥ paścādadhyāpya iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | svasya pitṛpitāmahayoścānupanītatve teṣāṃ brahmahatulyatvamabhyāgamanādīnāṃ varjanaṃ coktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "atha yasya pitā pitāmaha ityanupetau syātāṃ te brahmahasaṃstutāsteṣāmabhyāgamanaṃ bhojanaṃ vivāhamiti varjayet" iti | yasya māṇavakasya pitā pitāmaha ityanupetāvanupanītau syātāṃ svayaṃ ca te tathāvidhā māṇavakā brahmahasaṃstutā brahmahaṇa ityevaṃ kīrtitāḥ | brahmavādibhiriti śeṣaḥ | atastasmiṃstacchabdaprayogastaddharmaprāptyarthaḥ | śmaśānavacchūdrapatitāvityadhyayanapratiṣedho vakṣyate | tataśca yathā brahmahasamīpe nādhyeyamevameṣāmapīti | teṣāmeṣāmabhyāgamanamābhimukhyena gamanaṃ mātṛpitṛputradāraśarīrarakṣaṇārthamapi varjayet | yadyapi rakṣā sarvato grāhyeti vakṣyate | bhojanamudyatamapi varjayet, api duṣkṛtakāriṇa iti satyapi vacane | vivāhaṃ varjayet, yadyapi "strīratnaṃ duṣkulādapi" iti mānavavacanaṃ tathā'pīti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | eteṣāmicchatāṃ prāyaścittamuktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "teṣāmicchatāṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathā prathame'tikrama ṛturevaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ pratipuruṣaṃ saṃkhyāya saṃvatsarānyāvanto'nupetāḥ syuḥ" iti | icchatāmitivacanānna balātkāreṇa prāyaścittam | yathā prathame brahmacaryasyartuḥ kāla evamasminnatikrame saṃvatsaraḥ kālaḥ | athopanayanaṃ tata udakopasparśanamiti pūrvavaccheṣam | āpastambe darśanāt | yadi pitaivānupetaḥ syātsaṃvatsaramekam | atha pitāmaho'pi tato dvau | atha svayamapi yathākālamanupanītastatastrīnsaṃvatsarāniti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | etadanantaramadhyāpayedityuktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "athādhyāpyaḥ" iti | udakopasparśanamantrā dharmasūtre -- "saptabhiḥ pāvamānībhiryadanti yacca dūraka ityetābhiryajuṣpavitreṇa sāmapavitreṇā''ṅgirasenāpi vyāhṛtībhireva" iti | pavamānaḥ somo devatā yāsāṃ tāḥ pāvamānyaḥ | tāśca yadanti yacca dūraka ityetāḥ sapta | yajuṣpavitreṇā''po asmānmātaraḥ śundhatvityetena pūta emītyantena | sāmapavitreṇa kayā naścitra ābhuvadititṛce gītena vāmadevyena sāmnā | āṅgirasena ha saḥ śuciṣadityetena mantreṇa | etairañjalinā śirasyapo'vasiñcet | api vā samastavyāhṛtībhireva siñcanamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | atha yasya pitā pitāmaha ityupakrame yasyetyekavacanamante'pyathādhyāpya iti | madhye tu te brahmahasaṃstutāsteṣāmabhyāgamanaṃ teṣāmicchatāṃ prāyaścittamityeteṣu bahuvacanam | tatropakramopasaṃhārānusāreṇa māṇavakasyaiva prāyaścittamupanayanamadhyāpanaṃ ca | bahuvacanaṃ tu tathāvidhamāṇavakabahutvāpekṣamityapyāha saḥ | svasya pitāmahādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ cānupanītatve sarveṣāṃ śmaśānatulyatvaṃ pūrvavadabhyāgamanādīnāṃ varjanaṃ prāyaścittaṃ coktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "atha yasya pitāmahādi nānusmaryata upanayanaṃ te śmaśānasaṃstutāsteṣāmabhyāgamanaṃ vivāhamiti varjayetteṣāmicchatāṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvādaśa varṣāṇi traividyakaṃ brahmacaryaṃ carettata upanayanamathodakopasparśanaṃ pāvamānyādibhiḥ" iti | yasya māṇavakasya pitāmahādi pitāmahādārabhya prapitāmahastasya pitā pitāmahaprapitāmahādyā anupanītāḥ svayaṃ ca yathākālamanupanītaste tathāvidhā māṇavakāḥ śmaśānasaṃstutāḥ | tena śmaśāne sarvataḥ śamyāprāsādityadhyayananiṣedha eṣāmapi saṃnidhau bhavati | teṣāmityādi spaṣṭārtham | pāvamānyādibhirityanena pratipuruṣaṃ saṃkhyāya saṃvatsarānityetadapi draṣṭavyamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | anyacca dharmasūtre -- "atha gṛhamedhopadeśanaṃ nādhyāpanaṃ tato yo nirvartate tasya saṃskāro yathā prathame'tikrame tata ūrdhvaṃ prakṛtivat" iti | gṛhamedhopadeśanaṃ gṛhyaśāstropadeśanaṃ gṛhasthadharmopadeśanaṃ vā nādhyāpanaṃ kṛtsnasya vedasya kiṃtu gṛhyamantrāṇāmeva | tata evaṃ kṛtaprāyaścittādgṛhasthībhūtādyo nirvartata utpadyate tasya saṃskāra upanayanākhyaḥ kartavyaḥ | kathaṃ, yathā prathame'tikrama ṛtuṃ traividyakaṃ brahmacaryaṃ caritvetyantam | tatastu yo nirvartate tasya prakṛtivadyathāprāptamupanayanaṃ kartavyamiti | yasya piturārabhya nānusmaryata upanayanaṃ tatra prāyaścittaṃ noktaṃ dharmaśāstraistūhitavyamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | atha saṃkṣepeṇāyanādinirṇayaḥ | tatrā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre caulakarmopanayanagodānavivāhāḥ" iti | kalyāṇaṃ jyātiḥśāstravirodhīti tadvṛttikṛt | gargaḥ -- "vipraṃ vasante kṣitipaṃ nidāghe vaiśyaṃ ghanānte vratinaṃ vidadhyāt" iti | nidāgho grīṣmartuḥ | ghanāntaḥ śaradṛtuḥ | nanvevaṃ vipraṃ prati vasantaniyamāt, "vinartunā vasantena kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe | anadhyāye copanītaḥ punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" | iti bṛhaspatinā vasantābhāve doṣakathanāccottarāyaṇasya vipraṃ prati nityaprāptatayā vidhivaiyarthyamiti cenna | kenāpi nimittena vasantālābhe tadanyottarāyaṇaprāpaṇārthatvāt, tathā ca gargaḥ -- "māghādiśukrāntakapañcamāsāḥ sādhāraṇā vā sakaladvijānām" iti | śukro jyeṣṭhamāsaḥ so'ntake prānte yeṣāṃ te śukrāntakāḥ | svārthe kapratyayaḥ | te ca te pañca māsāśceti karmadhārayaḥ | vṛddhagārgyaḥ -- "māghādimāsaṣaṭkaṃ tu mekhalābandhane matam" iti | maitreyasūtre'pi -- "vasanto grīṣmaḥ śaradṛtavo varṇānupūrvyeṇa māghādiṣaṇmāsā vā sarvavarṇānām" iti | ānupūrvyaṃ kramaḥ | uttarāyaṇaśūnyamāghādibhāgāṣāḍhāntyabhāgayornivṛttyai, uttarāyaṇavidherāvaśyakatvānnaitābhyāṃ śāstrābhyāṃ paunaruktyam | etacchāstrasya makarārkaviśiṣṭapauṣaniṣedhārthatvena pañcasaṃkhyāvidhermithunārkaviśiṣṭāṣāḍhanivṛttyarthatvena ca sārthakyānna māghādimāsavidhāyakaśāstrasyottarāyaṇavidhāyakaśāstreṇaiva prāptāvapi vyarthatā | ṣaṭsaṃkhyāvidhestu vaiśyaṃ prati śrāvaṇādiniṣedhārthatvātkenāpi nimittena śaradalābhe dakṣiṇāyanāntargatāṣāḍhabhāgaprāpaṇārthatvācca na vyarthatā | asti hi taṃ prati dakṣiṇāyanavidhirbṛhaspativṛddhavasiṣṭhoktaḥ -- "viprasya kṣatriyasyāpi mauñjī syāduttarāyaṇe | dakṣiṇe tu viśāṃ kuryānnānadhyāye na saṃkrame" iti | evaṃ ca brāhmaṇena dakṣiṇāyana upanayanaṃ naiva kāryaṃ, nāpi pauṣāṣāḍhayoḥ satyapyuttarāyaṇe | uttarāyaṇaviśiṣṭamāghādipañcamāseṣu kāryam | tatrāpi mīnārkaprabhṛti yāvanmithunapraveśaṃ praśastaḥ kālaḥ | cāndrasaurānyataravasantalābhāt | mīnameṣayostu praśastataraḥ | mīnameṣayorvā vasanta iti baudhāyanokteḥ | "mṛgakumbhagate bhānau madhyamaṃ mīnameṣayoḥ | uttamaṃ goyugasthe'rke hyadhamaṃ copanāyanam" || iti bṛhaspativacanācca | mṛgo makaraḥ | gaurvṛṣaḥ | yugaṃ mithunam | mīnārkaviśiṣṭaścaitro'nekaniṣedhāpavādakatayā praśastatamaḥ || "mīnasthite'rke khalu caitramāse śubhaprado brāhmaṇamauñjibandhaḥ" | iti bṛhaspativākyasya tadarthatvāt | ata evoktaṃ tenaiva -- "gocarāṣṭakavargābhyāṃ guruśuddhirna labhyate | tadopanayanaṃ kāryaṃ caitre mīnagate ravau || śukre naṣṭe tathā jīve durbale candrabhāskare | vratopanayanaṃ kāryaṃ caitre mīnagate ravau" iti | mauñjīpaṭale -- "janmabhādduṣṭage siṃhe nīce vā śatruge gurau | mauñjībandhaḥ śubhaḥ proktaścaitre mīnagate ravau" iti | śaunakaḥ -- "siṃhasthe devagurau meṣasthe yadi bhavetsahasrāṃśuḥ | maṅgalakāryaṃ kuryāditi nāradaparāśarau vadataḥ" iti || etaccātisaṃkaṭe jñeyam | jyotiḥśāstre gargaḥ -- "jyeṣṭhamāse viśeṣeṇa jyeṣṭhaputrasya naiva hi | mauñjībandhaṃ prakurvīta kṛtaścenmṛtyudo bhavet" iti || smṛtyantare -- "vivāhe copanayane janmamāsaṃ vivarjayet" iti | vṛttaśate -- "na janmadhiṣṇye na ca janmamāse na janmakālīyadine vidadhyāt | na jyeṣṭhamāsi prathamasya sūnostathā sutāyā api maṅgalāni" iti || janmadhiṣṇyaṃ janmanakṣatram | muhūrtacintāmaṇau -- "janmarkṣamāsalagnādau vrate vidyādhiko vratī | ādyagarbhe'pi viprāṇāṃ kṣatrādīnāmanādime" || iti viprakṣatriyādiparatvenopanayane viśeṣa uktaḥ | janmamāsa ukto gargeṇa -- "ārabhya janmadivasaṃ yāvatriṃśaddināni hi | janmamāsaḥ sa vijñeyo garhitaḥ sarvakarmasu" iti || etasmādvacanādvarṣamapyatra sāvanamānenaiva grāhyamiti kecit | janmamāsamātramatra grāhyametadvacanānna varṣaṃ janmamāsānurodhenātra grāhyamityanye | tatra yadyuktaṃ tadgrāhyam | etacca vasantātiriktakāle -- "vasantasamaye dadyādabde garbhāṣṭame'ṣṭame | mekhalāṃ janmamāse'pi janmabhe ca tithāvapi" iti rājamārtaṇḍokteḥ || atha tithayaḥ | jyotirnibandhe nṛsiṃhaḥ -- "tṛtīyā pañcamī ṣaṣṭhī dvitīyā vā'pi saptamī | pakṣayorubhayoścaiva viśeṣeṇa supūjitāḥ || dharmakāmau site pakṣe kṛṣṇe ca prathamā tathā | kṛṣṇe trayodaśīṃ kecidicchanti munayastathā || dvādaśyekādaśī caiva madhyame ca pracakṣate" iti | dharmo daśamī | kāmastrayodaśī | site śukle pakṣe dharmakāmau grāhyau | kṛṣṇe cetyatra cakāraḥ site pakṣa ityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ | tena śuklapratipado'pi grahaṇam | kecidācāryāḥ kṛṣṇapakṣāntavartinīṃ trayodaśīmapyupanayane svīkurvanti | madhyame cetyatra pakṣadvaya iti jñeyam | ṭoḍarānande vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "naimittikamanadhyāyaṃ kṛṣṇe ca pratipaddinam | mekhalābandhane śastaṃ caule vedavrateṣu ca" iti || ayaṃ ca pratipaddinavidhirnaimittikānadhyāyavidhiścātītakālasyā''rtasya vaṭorupanayanaviṣayaḥ | "praśastā pratipatkṛṣṇe kadācicchubhage vidhau | candre balayute lagne varṣāṇāmatilaṅghane" || itivyāsokteḥ | evaṃ -- "candre balayute lagnācchubhabhāve śubhekṣitau | caturdaśīṃ praśaṃsanti kumāre vayasā'dhike" || iti caturdaśīvidhirapi | "svādhyāyaviyujo ghasrāḥ kṛṣṇapratipadādayaḥ | prāyaścittanimitte tu mekhalābandhane matāḥ" || iti kālādarśādidhṛtavṛddhagārgyavacanātsarveṣāṃ naimittikānadhyāyānāṃ kṛṣṇapratipadādinityānadhyāyānāṃ ca prāyaścittopanayanaparataiva nāpūrvopanayanaparatā | viyujo viṣamāḥ | ghasrā dināni | svādhyāyaviyujo divasāstṛtīyāpañcamīsaptamīnavamyekādaśītrayodaśyantāḥ prāyaścittopanayana upayujyanta ityarthaḥ | amāvāsyā tvatrāpi niṣiddhaiva -- "amāvāsyā tu sarvatra ninditā śubhakarmaṇi" iti vacanāt || aparārke -- "naṣṭe candre'ṣṭame śukre niraṃśe bhāskare tathā | kartavyaṃ nopanayanaṃ nānadhyāye galagrahe" iti || niraṃśasvarūpaṃ jyotirnibandhe -- "rāśeḥ prathamabhāgastho niraṃśaḥ sūrya ucyate" iti | atriḥ -- "parājite'tinīcasthe nīce śukre gurau tathā | vratinaṃ yadi kurvīta sa bhavedvedavarjitaḥ" iti || rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "naṣṭe śukre'thavā jīve niraṃśe caiva bhāskare | upanītasya śiṣyasya jaḍatvaṃ mṛtyureva ca" iti || yugāditvādinā'nadhyāyānāmapi pratiprasavamāha bharadvājaḥ -- "yā caitravaiśākhasitā tṛtīyā māghasya saptamyatha phālgunasya | kṛṣṇe dvitīyopanaye praśastā proktā bharadvājamunīndramukhyaiḥ" iti | atra caitrasitatṛtīyāmāghaśuklasaptamyormanvādyoḥ pratiprasavaḥ | manvādiṣu tayoḥ smṛtyarthasāre pāṭhāt | vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyāyugāderapi | muhūrtatattve -- "trayodaśyādicatuṣkaṃ saptamyāditrayaṃ caturthī ca | aṣṭau galagrahāstyājyā gargasya mate tathā ṣaṣṭhī" iti | atrāpyapavādaḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamītrayodaśīnāṃ viniyogopanyāsena darśitaḥ ayaṃ galagrahāpavādo mūkādyupanayanaviṣaya iti kecit | smṛtyantare -- "anadhyāyasya pūrvedyuranadhyāyātpare'hani | vratārambhaṃ visargaṃ ca vidyārambhaṃ ca varjayet" iti | etadapavādo dvitīyāsaptamītrayodaśīnāṃ viniyogopanyāsena darśitaḥ | smṛtisāre -- "sopapadāsūpanītaḥ punaḥ saṃskāramarhati" iti | ayaṃ ca niṣedho yajurvedināṃ na bhavati -- "vedavratopanayane svādhyāyādhyayane tathā | na doṣo yajuṣāṃ sopapadāsvadhyāpane'pi ca" || iti smṛtidarpaṇe smṛtyantarokteriti kecit | mahānibandheṣvadarśanādidaṃ nirmūlaṃ, tena teṣāmapi niṣedho'styevetyanye | tāścoktāstatraiva -- "jyeṣṭhaśukladvitīyā tu āśvine daśamī sitā | caturthī dvādaśī māgha etāḥ sopapadāḥ smṛtāḥ" iti | caturthī dvādaśī māgha ityatra sitetyanuṣajyate | vāsarānāha nāradaḥ -- "guruśukrabudhānāṃ tu vārāḥ śreṣṭhatamāḥ smṛtāḥ | adhamaḥ somavārastu sūryavārastu madhyamaḥ || vārau mandārayorvarjyau kṛṣṇe varjyo niśāpateḥ | astaṃ gatasya saumyasya vāro varjyo dvijanmanām" iti || mandaḥ śaniḥ | āro bhaumaḥ | niśāpatiścandraḥ | saumyo budhaḥ | tathā -- "sarveṣāṃ jīvaśukrajñavārāḥ proktā vrate śubhāḥ | candrārkau madhyamau jñeyau sāmabāhujayoḥ kujaḥ || śākhādhipativāraśca śākhādhipabalaṃ tathā | śākhādhipatilagnaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tritayaṃ vrate" iti | sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇādīnām | jīvo bṛhaspatiḥ | jño budhaḥ | bāhujaḥ kṣatriyaḥ | balaṃ gocarāṣṭavargādi | śākhādhipabalāsaṃbhave doṣamapyāha madanaratne vṛddhagārgyaḥ -- "śākhāviṣe balini kendragate ca mauñjībandhastadīyadivaseṣu śubhāya klṛptaḥ | asminbalena rahite tu punardvijānāṃ syādvarṇasaṃkara iti pravadanti tajjñāḥ" iti | tadīyadivaseṣu śākhādhipadivaseṣu | etena śākhādhipabalasyā''vaśyakatoktā bhavati | tathā varṇādhipabalamapyapekṣate | "sadā'nukūle caikasminvarṇeśe balaśālini | brāhmaṇādeḥ prakurvīta kumāraṃ vratacāriṇam" iti parāśarokteḥ | "patī sitejyau viprāṇāṃ nṛpāṇāṃ kujabhāskarau | vaiśyānāṃ śaśabhṛtsaumyāviti varṇādhipāḥ smṛtāḥ" || iti tenaiva vyavasthāpradarśanācca | madanaratne rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "pituḥ sūryabalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śākhāvarṇeśayorbaṭoḥ | sarveṣāṃ gurucandrarkṣabalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ prakīrtitam || mauñjībandhe vivāhe ca pratiṣṭhāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ" iti | sarveṣāmityanena yeṣāṃ na śākhādhipo gurusteṣāmapi vaṭūnāṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ ca gurubalamāvaśyakam | ubhayoralābhe vaṭorāvaśyakamiti dhvanyate | saṃkaṭe candratārābalādyabhāve'pyadhikārāya dānamuktaṃ jyotirnibandhe -- "candre ca śaṅkhaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca vāre dine viruddhe tvatha taṇḍulāṃśca | dhānyaṃ ca dadyātkaraṇe tathā bhe yoge viruddhe kanakaṃ ca deyam" iti | dinaṃ tithiḥ | atra cakārā godānasamuccayārthāḥ | "sasyaṃ kṣetragataṃ prāhuḥ satuṣaṃ dhānyamucyate | āmaṃ tu vituṣaṃ proktaṃ svinnamannamudāhṛtam" iti vacanāddhānyaśabdena satuṣaṃ vrīhyādyucyate | nityakāle vaṭorgurubalālābhe śāntyā tallābhaḥ | anityakāle naivamityāha nāradaḥ -- "bālasya balahīno'pi śāntyā jīvo balapradaḥ | yathoktavatsare kāryamanukte nopanāyanam" iti | keṣucidduṣṭasthāneṣu sthite gurau śānyā'pi nopanayanādhikāra ityāha vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "bandhau tṛtīye ripurāśisaṃsthe icchanti pūjāṃ janige vyayasthe | purātanā aṣṭamage'pi sūrau śāntyā'pi naivopanayādhikāraḥ" iti | bandhuścaturthaḥ | ripurāśiḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ | janirjanmarāśiḥ | vyayo dvādaśarāśiḥ | atisaṃkaṭa eteṣvapi rāśiṣu pūjāhomāderdviguṇatvādivṛddhikalpanayopanayanaṃ kāryameva na tūktasaṃvatsarātikramaḥ kāryaḥ | "tasmādgrahebhyaḥ kālatvādbalī saṃvatsaro mataḥ" iti vacanāt | rāśiviśeṣasthasya guroraṣṭamādisthānasthitasyāpi nādhikārapratibandhakatvamityāha bharadvājaḥ -- "dhanurmīnakulīrastho jīvo janmāntyamṛtyugaḥ | atisaukhyaṃ vaṭoḥ kuryādvasiṣṭhavacanaṃ yathā" iti | kulīraḥ karkaḥ | sa ca guroruccasthānam | yathā''hurdaivajñāḥ -- "ajavṛṣabhamṛgāṅganākulīrā jhaṣavaṇijau ca divākarādituṅgāḥ" iti | ajo meṣaḥ | vṛṣabhaḥ prasiddho rāśiḥ | mṛgo makaraḥ | aṅganā kanyā | kulīraḥ karkaḥ | jhaṣo mīnaḥ | vaṇiktulā | divākarādīnāṃ saptānāṃ grahāṇāṃ krameṇa meṣādīni saptoccasthānānītyarthaḥ | rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "vrate janmatrikāristho jīvo'pīṣṭo'rcanātsakṛt | śubho'tikāle turyāṣṭavyayastho dviguṇārcanāt" iti || nakṣatrāṇyāha nāradaḥ -- "śreṣṭhānyarkatrayāntyejyacadrādityuttarāṇi ca | viṣṇutrayāśvimitrābjayonibhānyupanāyane" iti || arkatrayaṃ hastacitrāsvātayaḥ | antyaṃ revatī | ijyastiṣyaḥ | candro mṛgaśiraḥ | aditiḥ punarvasū | uttarāśabdenottarātrayam | viṣṇutrayaṃ śravaṇadhaniṣṭhāśatabhiṣajaḥ | aśvināvaśvinī | mitro'nūrādhāḥ | abjayonibhaṃ rohiṇīnakṣatram | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "triṣūttareṣu rohiṇyāṃ haste maitre ca vāsave | tvāṣṭre saumyapunarvasvoruttamaṃ hyupanāyanam" iti || maitramanūrādhāḥ | vāsavaṃ dhaniṣṭhāḥ | tvāṣṭraṃ citrā | saumyaṃ mṛgaśiraḥ | śārṅgadharīye -- "śravaṇādityapauṣṇādidvaye hastatraye mṛge | sarveṣāṃ mekhalābandhaḥ śubhaḥ prokto dvijanmanām" iti || vedaviśeṣeṇa nakṣatraviśeṣavidhijyotirnibandhe -- "mūle hastatraye sārpe śaive pūrvātraye tathā | ṛgvedādhyāyināṃ śasta mekhalābandhanaṃ budhaiḥ || puṣye punarvasau pauṣṇe haste maitre śaśāṅkabhe | dhruveṣu ca praśastaṃ syādyajuṣāṃ mauñjibandhanam || puṣpavāsavahastāśviśivaviṣṇūttarātrayam | praśastaṃ mekhalābandhe vaṭūnāṃ sāmavedinām || mṛgamaitrāśvinīhastarevatyaditivāsavam | atharvavedināṃ śasto bhagaṇo'yaṃ vratārpaṇe" iti || sārpamāśreṣāḥ | śaivamārdrāḥ | pauṣṇaṃ revatī | maitramanūrādhāḥ | śaśāṅkabhaṃ mṛgaśiraḥ | dhruvāṇyuttarātrayaṃ rohiṇī ca | vāsavaṃ jyeṣṭhā | aśvināvaśvinī | śiva ārdrā | viṣṇuḥ śravaṇam | aditiḥ punarvasū | eṣāmasaṃbhave sārasamuccaye -- "maghāgneyaviśākhaindrayāmyaṃ hitvā ca vāruṇam | vrate śastāni sarveṣāṃ cedvedoktaṃ na labhyate" iti | āgneyaṃ kṛttikāḥ | aindraṃ jyeṣṭhā | yāmyaṃ bharaṇī | vāruṇaṃ śatatārakā | tatrāpi puṃnakṣatrāṇyatipraśastāni | "viśeṣeṇa puṃnāmadheye" iti gṛhyokteḥ | tāni tu prāgevoktāni | yastu -- "tārācandrānukūleṣu grahābdeṣu śubheṣvapi | punarvasau copanītaḥ punaḥ saṃskāramarhati" || iti rājamārtaṇḍavacane punarvasuniṣedhaḥ, sa jyotirvitprasiddhavasiṣṭhādisaṃhitāsvadarśanāddhemādryādimahānibandheṣu punarvasuvidhereva pratīterdākṣiṇātyasakalaśiṣṭānāṃ punarvasvorupanayanānuṣṭhānācaraṇasyopalambhācca nirmūlaḥ | samūlatve'pi na yajurvedyatharvavediviṣayaḥ | anantarodāhṛtajyotirnibandhavacane yajurvedyatharvavedināṃ tasya vihitatvāt | yogeṣu vyavasthāmāha śrīpatiḥ -- "savaidhṛtistu vyatipātanāmā sarvo'pyaniṣṭaḥ parighasya cārdham | tisrastu yoge prathame savajre vyāghātasaṃjñe nava pañca śūle || gaṇḍe'tigaṇḍe ca ṣaḍeva nāḍyaḥ śubheṣu kāryeṣu vivarjanīyāḥ" iti | prathamo yogo viṣkambhaḥ | uktānyaviṣaye tvāha bṛhaspatiḥ -- "śiṣṭāṣṭādaśayogeṣu praśastamupanāyanam" iti | karaṇavyavasthā'pi tenaivoktā -- "bavādīnāṃ tu ṣaṭkaṃ syādupanāye supūjitam | śakunyādīni viṣṭiṃ ca varjayecca viśeṣataḥ" iti || dinabhāgavyavasthāmāha manuḥ -- "sarvadeśeṣu pūrvāhṇe mukhyaṃ syādupanāyanam | madhyāhne madhyamaṃ proktamaparāhṇe ca garhitam" iti || uttarārdhe'pi sarvadeśeṣvityanuṣajyate | evaṃ vyavasthite'pi śubhakāle nimittaviśeṣeṇa niṣedhamāha gargaḥ -- "grahe ravīndvoravaniprakampe ketūdgamolkāpatanādidoṣe | vrate daśāhāni vadanti tajjñāstrayodaśāhāni vadanti kecit" iti | vārjyānīti śeṣaḥ| saṃkaṭe tu caṇḍeśvaraḥ -- "dāhe diśāṃ caiva dharāprakampe vajraprapāte ca vidāraṇe ca | ketau tatholkāṃśukaṇaprapāte tryahaṃ na kuryādvratamaṅgalāni" iti || dharmaprakāśe gargaḥ -- "candrasūryoparāgeṣu tryahaṃ prāgaśubhaṃ bhavet | saptāhamaśubhaṃ paścātsmṛtaṃ grahaṇasūtakam" iti || etaccārdhagrāsaviṣayam | "sarvagrāse tu saptāhamardhagrāse dinatrayam | tridvyekāṅgulato grāse dinamekaṃ vivarjayet" || ityaṅgirasā viśeṣasyokteḥ | vistarato duṣṭakālāṃstu vivāhaprakaraṇe vakṣyāmaḥ | eteṣūkteṣu kāleṣu sūtrokto mukhyaḥ kālaḥ | smṛtyuktastu saṃkaṭe -- "mukhyo vidhiḥ svaśāstrokta itaraḥ syāttu saṃkaṭe" itivacanāt | lallaḥ -- "vratye'hni pūrvasaṃdhyāyāṃ vārido yadi garjati | taddine syādanadhyāyo vrataṃ tatra vivarjayet" iti | vratye'hnyupanayanadivase vārido meghaḥ | taddine vratyadina upanayanadina iti yāvat | vratamupanayanam | tatrānadhyāye | anena vacanena sarvasyaivopanayanakriyākalāpasya niṣedhe prāpte nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ vedārambharahitasya sarvasyopanayanasya kartavyatoktā jyotirnibandhe -- "nāndīśrāddhe kṛte cetsyādanadhyāyastvakālikaḥ | mauñjībandhaṃ tadā kuryādvedārambhaṃ na kārayet" iti | deśabhedenā''rdrādijyeṣṭhāntavyatirikteṣu mṛgādiviśākhāntavyatirikteṣu nakṣatreṣu vā yadvṛṣṭigarjanādikaṃ tadakālikaṃ tannimitto'nadhyāyo'kālikaḥ | sa ca nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ cettadā mauñjībandhamupanayanaṃ kuryāt | tatratyaṃ vedārambhamātraṃ tu naiva kārayedityarthaḥ | nāndīśrāddhe kṛta itivacanānnāndīśrāddhātprāgvārida garjane mauñjībandho'pi na bhavati | vedārambhaṃ na kārayediti niṣedhastu yeṣāṃ sūtre vedārambhastaddina eva vihitastatparaḥ | satyāṣāḍhasūtrānusāribhirakālikānadhyāye'pi mauñjībandha etasmādvacanātkartavya eva | vedārambhastvavihitatvādeva na bhavati | nanu gāyatryārambheṇaiva sarvavedārambho bhavatīti prayogāntara uktatvādgāyatryupadeśātmakārambha eva sarvavedārambhastasya ca vedārambhaṃ na kārayedityanena niṣedha iti cenna | tasyātharvavedavyatiriktasarvavedāntarādhyayanārthakapunarupanayananivṛttibodhanārthatvāt | na cātra kiṃ mānamiti vācyam | 'sarvebhyo vai vedebhyaḥ sāvitryanūcyata iti hi brāhmaṇam' iti dharmasūtrasyāgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvāt | ekamevopanayanaṃ sarvārthamiti nyāyaḥ | asminnarthe śāṭyāyanabrāhmaṇameva paṭhitam | atharvavedasya tu pṛthagupanayanaṃ vacanātkartavyam | tathā ca tatraiva śrutam -- "nānyatra saṃskṛto bhṛgvaṅgiraso'dhīyīta" iti | anyatrānyavedārtham | bhṛgvaṅgiraso'tharvaveda ityujjvalākṛdvyākhyānasya ca mānatvāt | athopanetāraḥ | tatra vṛddhagargaḥ -- "pitā pitāmaho bhrātā jñātayo gotrajāgrajāḥ | upanāye'dhikārī syātpūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ" iti || bhrātā pituḥ | "pitaivopanayetputraṃ tadabhāve pituḥ pitā | tadabhāve piturbhrātā tadabhāve tu sodaraḥ" || iti pitāmahasmaraṇāt | pitā vidvāṃścettadaivopanayedanyathā na | dharmasūtre'vidvatkartṛkopanayane doṣasyokteḥ | sa cāgre pradarśyate | piturvidvattvābhāve vakṣyamāṇavyāsavacanoktalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ kaścanopanayanaṃ kuryāt | etadvacanadvayaṃ vipraparaṃ na kṣatriyavaiśyaparaṃ gāyatrīvācanasyādhyāpanarūpatvena tatra tayoranadhikārāt | etadarthameva "vedaikaniṣṭhaṃ dharmajñam" iti vakṣyamāṇavyāsavacane vipragrahaṇaṃ jñeyam | ataḥ purohita evopanetaitayoriti jñeyam | jñātayaḥ sapiṇḍāsteṣu tadatirikteṣu ca gotrajeṣu ye'grajā vṛddhā vaṭorapekṣayeti dvitīyapādārthaḥ | upaneyakaniṣṭhācāryatvasya niṣiddhatvāt | gotrajā agrajā ityapekṣite'kāralopaśchāndasaḥ | yattu -- "asaṃskṛtāstu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ" | iti yogīśvaravacastatpitāmahavaconurodhena pitṛvyābhāvaviṣayamiti prāñcaḥ | bhaginyādivivāhaviṣayamiti navīnāḥ | pitrādyuktādhikāryabhāve kartāramāha śaunakaḥ -- "kumārasyopanayanaṃ śrutābhijanavṛttavān | tapasā dhūtaniḥśeṣapāpmā kuryāddvijottamaḥ" iti || ācāryaṃ kuryādityadhikṛtya vyāso'pi -- "vedaikaniṣṭhaṃ dharmajñaṃ kulīnaṃ śrotriyaṃ śucim | svaśākhāḍhyamanālasyaṃ vipraṃ kartāramīpsitam" iti || vedeṣu vedayorvede vaikā niṣṭhā yasya | śrotriyaśchandodhyāyī 'śrotriyaṃśchando'dhīte' iti pāṇinismaraṇāt | "dharmeṇa vedānāmekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriyo bhavati" | iti dharmasūtrācca | svaśākhāḍhyaṃ svasya yā pāramparyāgatā śākhā tayā''ḍhyam | etena svaśākhīya evā''cāryo bhavatīti sūcitam | vipragrahaṇaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyanivṛttyartham | śūdrasya nivṛttistu vedādhyayanādyabhāvādeva bhavati | ācāryaśabdārtho dharmasūtre -- 'yasmāddharmānācinoti sa ācāryaḥ' iti | ācinotyupadiśati | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "ācinoti ca śāstrāṇi ācāre sthāpayatyapi | svayamācarate yastu tasmācāryaṃ pracakṣate" iti | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "sa gururyaḥ kriyāḥ kṛtvā vedamasmai prayacchati | upanīya dadadvedamācāryaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ || ekadeśamupādhyāya ṛtvigyajñakṛducyate | ete mānyā yathāpūrvamebhyo mātā garīyasī" iti || yaḥ sarvā niṣekādikriyāḥ kṛtvā'smai māṇavakāya vedaṃ prayacchatyadhyāpayati sa guruḥ | evaṃ ca pitā gururniṣekādikriyākartṛtvāttasya | devalenānye'pi gurava uktāḥ -- "upādhyāyaḥ pitā jyeṣṭho bhrātā cā''cārya eva ca | mātulaḥ śvaśurastrātā mātāmahapitāmahau || varṇajyeṣṭhaḥ pitṛvyaśca puṃsyate guravaḥ smṛtāḥ | mātā mātāmahī gurvī piturmātuśca sodarāḥ || pitāmahī svasā jyeṣṭhā dhātrī ca guravaḥ striyaḥ" iti | atra puṃsavanādisaṃskārakriyākaraṇābhāve'pi piturgurutvam | yastu kevalamupanayanamātraṃ kṛtvā vedamadhyāpayati sa ācāryaḥ | ācāryasyopanetṛtvaṃ vidvatpitrabhāve draṣṭavyam | yastu vedaikadeśamātramadhyāpayati na tūpanayanādikriyāḥ karoti sa upādhyāyaḥ | yo yājayitā sa ṛtvigityudāhṛtaḥ | ete pūrvoktā yathāpūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvamanatikramyeti yathāpūrvaṃ yathākramaṃ pūrvaḥ pūrvo mānyaḥ pūjārha ityarthaḥ | ebhya etebhyo mātā jananī garīyasī śreṣṭhā, garbhadhāraṇādikleśasahanādityarthaḥ | dharmaprakāśe purāṇe tu -- "dvau gurū puruṣasyeha pitā mātā ca dharmataḥ | tayorapi pitā śreyānbījaprādhānyadarśanāt | abhāve bījino mātā tadabhāve tu pūrvajaḥ ||" iti piturgarīyastvamuktam | atrecchayā vikalpaḥ | tulyakalpatvaṃ veti navīnāḥ | avidvatkartṛkopanayane doṣa ukto dharmasūtre -- "tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśati yamavidvānupanayate yaścāvidvāniti vijñāyate" iti | vedamajānāno yaṃ māṇavakamupanayate | [sa] māṇavako'vidvānya upanetā sa ca tamasaḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ sakāśātpāpaphalaṃ duḥkhākhyaṃ tamo mohakaratvātpraviśati prāpnoti | māṇavako hyajñānanirāsārthaṃ vidyārthaṃ saṃskāramapekṣate sa yadā'viduṣā kṛtastadā tena vidyāṃ na prāpnoti | lokanindinena karmaṇobhāvapi duḥkhaṃ ca prāpnuta iti vijñāyate śrutirityartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | na caitadvacanebhyaḥ kṛtsnavedādhyāyina evā''cāryatvaṃ na vedaikadeśādhyāyina iti vācyam | gomadhuparkārho vedādhyāyyācārya ṛtviksnātakaḥ śvaśuro rājā vā dharmayuktaścetidharmasūtravyākhyānāvasare -- 'ata eva jñāyate vedaikadeśādhyāyināvapyṛtvegācāryau bhavataḥ' ityujjvalākṛtā'bhidhānāt | viśvaprakāśe smṛtyantare -- "asagotraḥ sagotro vā ya ācārya upāyane | tadopaneyapitrādīnuddiśyābhyudayaṃ caret | kanyodvāhe'pyayaṃ mārgo munibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ" iti | vaṭūpanetroradhikārasiddhyai prāyaścittamāha prayogapārijāte bṛhadviṣṇuḥ -- "kṛcchratrayaṃ copanetā trīnkṛcchrāṃśca vaṭuścaret" iti | vaṭoḥ prāyaścittaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanādisugamapratyāmnāyadvāraiva, asāmarthyāt | gāyatrījaparudraikādaśinyādi vaidikāḥ pratyāmnāyā etasya naiva bhavanti, anadhikārāt | upanetrā vā mukhyakalpena caritavyam -- "ūnadvādaśavarṣasya prāyaścittaṃ caretpitā" iti vacanāt | pitetyupalakṣaṇamupanetuḥ | ācāryasya gāyatryupadeśādhikārārthaṃ japamapyāha sa eva -- "sāvitrīmabhyasedagnipavitrāṇi ca saṃsmaran | gururdvādaśasāhasraṃ sāvitrīṃ prajapettataḥ | svādhikārārthamevāsyāḥ pradānārthaṃ hi tatsmṛtam" iti | pradānārthamidaṃ smṛtamityapi kvacitpāṭhaḥ | agnipavitrāṇi agna āyū ṣi pavasa ityādayo devasya tvetipraśnāntargatāḥ ṣaṇmantrāḥ | saṃsmaranniti laḍādeśena dvādaśasahasraṃ dvādaśādhikasahasraṃ vā gāyatrījapaṃ saṃkalpya tasmātpūrvaṃ mānaso japa eteṣāṃ gāyatrījapādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ kārya iti jñāpyate | abhyasedityasya japedityarthaḥ | dvitīyārthe sāvitrīṃ prajapediti vacanamanuvādaḥ | sāvitrīṃ prajapedityasya vidhāyakatve tu sakṛjjapavidhāyakamekam | anyaddvādaśasahasradvādaśādhikasahasrānyatarasaṃkhyajapavidhāyakaṃ, nātaḥ punaruktidoṣaḥ | asminpakṣe gāyatrījapaṃ saṃkalpyāgnipavitrasaṃjñakānṣaṇmantrānsakṛjjapitvā sāvitrīṃ sakṛduktvā dvādaśasahasradvādaśādhikasahasrānyatarasaṃkhyayā sāvitrīṃ prajapediti kramaḥ | saṃsmarediti pāṭhe tu -- agnipavitrāṇi japitvā sakṛdgāyatrīmuktvā saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ dvādaśasahasraṃ dvādaśādhikasahasraṃ vā gāyatrīṃ japedityevaṃ kramaḥ | gururatrā''cāryaḥ | asyā gāyatryāḥ pradānārthaṃ yaḥ svasyādhikārastadarthamidaṃ smṛtamityantyārdhe yojanā | ityupanetāra upanetrupaneyakartṛkaprāyaścittaṃ ca | athopanayanopayogipadārthanirūpaṇam | tatra maṇḍapo vasiṣṭhenoktaḥ -- "ṣoḍaśāratnikaṃ kuryāccaturdvāropaśobhitam | maṇḍapaṃ toraṇairyuktaṃ tatra vediṃ prakalpayet | aṣṭahastaṃ tu racayenmaṇḍapaṃ vā dviṣaṣṭkaram" iti | tatra maṇḍape | dviṣaṭkaro dvādaśakaraḥ | etasya maṇḍapasyopanayanavivāhasaṃskārāṅgatvāttayośca sūtroktatvātsūtroktasaṃskārāṅgamaṇḍape sūtroktacaturviṃśāṅgulātmaka evāratnirgrāhyaḥ | anyatrāpi -- "maṅgaleṣu ca sarveṣu maṇḍapo gṛhamānataḥ | kāryaḥ ṣoḍaśahasto vā nyūnastu syāddaśāvadhiḥ | stambhaiścaturbhirevātra vedirmadhye pratiṣṭhitā" iti | gṛhamānata ityasya mahati gṛhe mahānmaṇḍapaḥ | alpe nyūna ityarthaḥ | daśāvadhiriti nyūnatāyā avadhiḥ | ato vasiṣṭhokto'ṣṭahasto'tyantāpadviṣayaḥ | stambhaiścaturbhirityatra yukteti śeṣaḥ | idaṃ ca vediviśeṣaṇam | vedirmadhye pratiṣṭhiteti vacanādvedyanurodhenaiva maṇḍapaḥ kāryaḥ, na tu pṛthak | anyathā -- sadmano vāmabhāge tu vedī kāryā catuṣkareti vedirmadhye pratiṣṭhiteti vacanayorvirodhaḥ syāt | "maṇḍapaḥ sadmano dvāri kartavyo gṛhamānataḥ" | itivacanānurodhena maṇḍapo yadi kriyate tadā vedermaṇḍapabahirbhāva eveti draṣṭavyam | vediruktā mānavasūtrānusāripaddhatau saṃgrahe -- "ācāryasya padaiḥ ṣaḍbhiścaturbhirathavā padaiḥ | āyāmavistāravatī vaṭorvedī karonnatā | lambā bhittirdvihastā syādunnatā tridaśāṅgulā | pratyagvedyāṃ ca sā kāryā vistārāddvādaśāṅgulā | aṣṭāvaṣṭau prakurvīta sopānānyatha pārśvayoḥ | tanmadhye kalaśākāramiti yajñavidāṃ matam" iti | vivāhavedidṛṣṭāḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhonnatatvaprāgudakpravaṇatvapuṣpamālārambhāstambhādyupaśobhitatvādayo dharmā avirodhādatrāpi jñeyāḥ | śiṣṭāstvidānīṃ vivāhavedivadeva vediṃ kurvanti | tatraiva granthāntare viśeṣaḥ -- "paścimābhimukhaṃ dvāraṃ yadvā ceduttarāmukham | vedikā tu tadā kāryā gṛhānnirgamadakṣiṇe" iti | nirgamaśabdena dvāramucyate | paścimābhimukhadvārottarābhimukhadvārayordakṣiṇe vedikaraṇoktyā dakṣiṇābhimukhadvārapūrvābhimukhadvārayorvāmabhāge vediḥ kāryetyarthādavagataṃ bhavati | evaṃ ca nairṛtyāṃ vedirna bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ sidhyati | kevalaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaṃ tu dvāraṃ śilpaśāstre niṣiddham | evaṃ cāvaśiṣṭaṃ pūrvābhimukhameva dvāraṃ tasya vāmabhāge vedirbhavatītyarthaḥ sidhyati | rāśiviśeṣaparatvena dvārasya dakṣiṇā[bhi]mukhatoktā śrīpatinā -- "karkinakraharikumbhagate'rke pūrvapaścimamukhāni gṛhāṇi | taulimeṣavṛṣavṛścikayāte dakṣiṇottaramukhāni(ṇi) tu kuryāt | anyathā yadi karoti durmatirvyādhiśokabhayahānimaśnute | mīnacāpamithunāṅganāgate bhāskare na tu gṛhāṇi kārayet" iti | upanayane mātrā saha bhojanamanujñātaṃ saṃgrahakāreṇa -- "mātrā sahopanayane vivāhe bhāryayā saha | anyatra sahabhuktiścetpātityaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ" iti | kṛcchratrayātmakaprāyaścittācaraṇottaraṃ kāmacārakāmavādakāmabhakṣaṇaniṣedhapravṛtteriva na striyā saha bhuñjīteti niṣedhasyāpi pravṛttatvāttasya bādho'nena kriyate | na ca mātrā sahopanayana iti vacanādupanayanamadhye yāvanti bhojanāni teṣu sarveṣvapi mātṛsahitatvamastviti vācyam | ācārasaṃvādena sūtroktāśanaparyāyake bhojana evaitasya vacanasya pravṛtterucitatvena pradhānottarakālike sūtrakṛtā kaṇṭharaveṇānukte bhojane mātrā sahetyasyāpravṛtteḥ | yattu -- "mātrā sahaiva bhuñjīta ūrdhvaṃ mātā rajasvalā | vratabandhaḥ praśastaḥ syādityāha bhagavānyamaḥ" | itivacanato bhojanātprāṅmātari rajasvalāyāṃ vratabandho na bhavatīti kecit | anye tvetasya vacanasyaiva mahānibandheṣvadarśanena nirmūlatvātkartavyamevetyāhuḥ | atrā''cārānurodhena grāhyam | kaṭisūtraṃ kaupīnaṃ ca parikalpanīyam, tadubhayaṃ yadyapyatra sūtrasmṛtyādau noktaṃ tathā'pi brahmacāridharmaprakaraṇe -- "mekhalāmajinaṃ daṇḍamupavītaṃ ca sarvadā | kaṭisūtraṃ ca kaupīnaṃ brahmacārī tu dhārayet" || iti vakṣyamāṇayamavacana upanayanīyamekhalājinadaṇḍopavītānāṃ sarvadā brahmacārikartṛkadhāraṇavidhānavatkaṭisūtrakaupīnayorapi sarvadā dhāraṇavidhānenopanayana ākṣepatastatprāptisiddheḥ | "vāsaḥ śāṇīkṣaumājināni" iti dharmasūtravyākhyānāvasare vasyate kaupīnamācchādyate yena tadvāsa ityujjvalākārokteḥ | "gṛhasthaḥ kurute karma vaidikaṃ vā'tha tāntrikam | kaṭibandhanasaṃyuktaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet" || iti smṛtyantare gṛhasthasyaiva karmakāle kaṭibandhananiṣedhena brahmacāryādīnāṃ kaṭibandhanasyānumatatvapradarśanāt | ujjvalākṛtā kaupīnadhāraṇoktyā kaṭibandhanasyāpyarthata eva darśitaprāyatvācchiṣṭācārācca | yajñopavītaṃ gṛhya -- "dakṣiṇato yajñopavītyācāntaḥ kumāra upaviśyānvārabhate" | iti dakṣiṇata ityasyopaviśyetyanenānvayaḥ | baudhāyanagṛhye -- "snāta śucivāsasaṃ baddhaśikhaṃ yajñopavītaṃ pratimuñcanvācayati -- yajñopavītaṃ pa0 balamastu teja iti yajñopavītinamapa ācamayya devayajanamudānayati" iti | dharmasūtre -- 'api vā sūtramevopavītārthe' iti | api vā sūtrameva sarveṣāmupavītakṛtye bhavati na vāsa eveti niyama ityartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | etacca kārpāsam | "kārpāsamupavītaṃ syādviprasyordhvavṛtaṃ trivṛt" iti manūkteḥ | kārpāsābhāve devalaḥ -- "kārpāsakṣaumagovālaśāṇavalkatṛṇādikam | yathāsaṃbhavato dhāryamupavītaṃ dvijātibhiḥ" iti | kṣumā'tasī | valkaṃ tarutvak | yathāsaṃbhavata ityatra sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | yathāsaṃbhavamityarthaḥ | chāndogyagṛhye -- "yajñopavītaṃ kurute sūtraṃ vastraṃ vā'pi vā kuśarajjumeva" iti | bhṛguḥ -- "trivṛdūrdhvavṛtaṃ kuryāttantutrayamadhovṛtam | trivṛtaṃ tūpavītaṃ syāttasyaiko granthiriṣyate' iti | ūrdhvavṛtaprakāramāha saṃgrahakāraḥ -- "kareṇa dakṣiṇenordhvaṃ gatena triguṇīkṛtam | valitaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sūtraṃ śāstra ūrdhvavṛtaṃ smṛtam" iti | ūrdhvaṃ gatenordhvasthitena dakṣiṇakareṇa triguṇīkṛtaṃ sadyadvalitaṃ tadūrdhvavṛtamityarthaḥ | devalaḥ -- "vidhavāracitaṃ sūtramanadhyāyakṛtaṃ ca yat | vicchinnaṃ cāpyadho yātaṃ bhuktvā nirmitamutsṛjet" iti | adho yātamityatra kaṭeriti śeṣaḥ | kātyāyanaḥ -- "pṛṣṭhadeśe ca nābhyāṃ na dhṛtaṃ yadvindate kaṭim | taddhāryamupavītaṃ syānnātilambaṃ na cocchritam" iti | nātilambamityanena kaṭito'dhikaṃ niṣidhyate | nocchritamityanena kaṭito nyūnam | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "nābherūrdhvamanāyuṣyamadho nābhestapaḥkṣayaḥ | tasmānnābhisamaṃ kuryādupavītaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ" iti | devalaḥ -- "upavītaṃ vaṭorekaṃ dve tathetarayoḥ smṛte | ekameva yatīnāṃ syāditi śāstraviniścayaḥ" iti | itarayorgṛhasthavānaprasthayoḥ | yatistridaṇḍī | smṛtyantare -- "chede vināśe vā snātaḥ kanyayā nirmitaṃ śubham | vidhavādyābhirathavā sūtraṃ gṛhṇīta vai śuciḥ" iti | vidhavetyāpatkalpaḥ | āhnikaprayogapārijāte kārpāsabījāharaṇādividhinā kārpāsavṛkṣalāpanaṃ tadbījena yajñopavītakaraṇamuktaṃ tattata evāvagantavyam | dhāraṇe viśeṣaḥ śrutau -- "dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumuddharate'vadhatte savyamiti yajñopavītametadeva viparītaṃ prācīnāvīta saṃvītaṃ mānuṣam" iti | manuḥ -- "uddhṛte dakṣiṇe pāṇāvupavītyucyate dvijaḥ | savye prācīnāvītī syānnivītī kaṇṭhasajjanam" iti || upavītanirmāṇadhāraṇavidhī baudhāyanasūtre -- "athāto yajñopavītakriyāṃ vyākhyāsyāmo brāhmaṇena tatkanyayā vā kṛtaṃ sūtramānīya bhūriti prathamāṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ minoti bhuva iti dvitīyāṃ suvariti tṛtīyāṃ mītvā palāśapatre saṃsthāpyā''po hi ṣṭheti tisṛbhirhiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakā iti catasṛbhiḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityetenānuvākena sāvitryā cābhiṣicya vāmahaste kṛtvā triḥ saṃtāḍya bhūragniṃ cetyetaistribhirvalitaṃ kṛtvā bhūrbhuvaḥ svaścandramasaṃ cetyetena granthiṃ kṛtvoṃkāramagniṃ nāgānyamaṃ pitṝnprajāpatiṃ vāyuṃ sūryaṃ viśvāndevānnavatantuṣu krameṇa vinyasya saṃpūjayeddevasya tvetyupavītamādāyodvayaṃ tamasasparītyādityāya darśayitvā yajñopavītaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ prajāpateryatsahajaṃ purastāt | āyuṣyamagryaṃ pratimuñca śubhraṃ yajñopavītaṃ balamastu teja iti dhārayedityāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | etāvatkartumaśaktau devalaḥ -- "grāmānniṣkramya saṃkhyāya ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulīṣu tat | tāvattriguṇitaṃ sūtraṃ prakṣālyābliṅgakaistribhiḥ || devāgāre'thavā goṣṭhe nadyāṃ vā'nyatra vā śucau | sāvitryā trivṛtaṃ kuryānnavantatu tu tadbhavet || kārpāsaṃ trivṛtaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ nidadhyādvāmahastake | sāvitryā daśakṛtvo'dbhirmantritābhistadukṣayet || haribrahmeśvarebhyaśca praṇamya paripūjya ca | yajñopavītamiti vā vyāhṛtyā vā'pi dhārayet" iti || ukṣayediti svārthe ṇic | tūṣṇīmevordhvavṛtatvādilakṣaṇaviśiṣṭaṃ yajñopavītaṃ nirmāya sāvitryā''po hi ṣṭhādibhirmantrairvā'bhimantritābhiradbhirdaśavāraṃ sāvitryaivābhyukṣya yajñopavītaṃ paramamiti mantreṇa vyāhṛtibhirvā dhārayediti smṛtyarṇave | kauṣītakiśākhāyāṃ tu -- "yajñopavītenopavyayāmi dīrghāyutvāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya sarveṣāṃ vedānāmādhipatyāya yaśase brahmavarcasāya" iti yajñopavītadhāraṇamantra uktaḥ | yajñopavītaśabdārtha uktaḥ smṛtisāre -- "yajñākhyaḥ paramātmā ya ucyate caiva hotṛbhiḥ | upavītaṃ tato'syedaṃ tasmādyajñopavītakam" iti || smṛtiprakāśe -- "jñātṛvijñeyayoraikyamavijānandvijottamaḥ | na tyajedātmanaḥ sūtraṃ brāhmaṃ brahmavinirmitam || sisṛkṣareka evāgre samāsīnaḥ śivaḥ svayam | dṛṣṭvā guṇamayīṃ māyāṃ sūtrarūpāmivākarot || tayā tadātmakaṃ viṣṇuṃ sṛṣṭvā pālaṃ divaukasām | svayaṃ brahmā bhavedrudro rudraścāsya kṣayāya saḥ || jñānātmakena hariṇā brahmātmani śive'vyaye | tatsūtramupavītatvādbrahmasūtramiti smṛtam || yajñena copavītatvādyajñasūtraṃ vidurbudhāḥ | tadājñayā''vṛtatvācca brahmaṇā brahmasūtrakam || tāvallokāstrayo vedāstrayo devāstrayo'gnayaḥ | śivasṛṣṭāstrayo varṇāstrivṛtsūtraṃ samāśrayet || tadgranthimāśrayaṃstārastrimātro nādasaṃyutaḥ | tadgranthyagraṃ ca sāvitrī vedamātā śivājñayā || evaṃ dvādaśadai(de)vatyaṃ brahmasūtraṃ dvijanmanām | brahmā'gre kalpayāmāsa vedārhāṇāmanuttamam || yenāṃse dhṛtamātreṇa brahmasūtreṇa te dvijāḥ | bhavanti brāhmaṇā nāma vedārhāśca trayastviha || yāvatprabhṛti vāmāṃse brahmasūtraṃ dvijasya tat | guruḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati kāle prabhṛtisaṃyataḥ || tāvatprabhṛti tasyaiva pitā''cāryaḥ sa ucyate || mātā ca tasya sāvitrī dvitīyaṃ janma cocyate | ākaṭestatpramāṇaṃ syāddīrghaṃ tu susthitaṃ tathā || āyurharatyatihrasvamatidīrghaṃ tapoharam | siddhārthaphalamānena sthūlaṃ syādupavītakam || yaśoharamatisthūlamatisūkṣmaṃ dhanāpaham | pavitraṃ paramaṃ śuddhamāyuṣyaṃ ca śubhāvaham | aujasyaṃ brahmavarcasyaṃ brahmasūtraṃ tathoditam" iti | "yajñopavītaṃ paramaṃ pavitraṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ brāhmaṇalakṣaṇaṃ ca | padmāsanasthena pitāmahena utpāditaṃ paṅkajanālasūtrāt" | iti yajñopavītotpattiḥ | "yajñopavītasyotpattiṃ jānāti brāhmaṇo na cet | sa vai vahati bhārāya pustakāni yathā vṛṣaḥ" iti || vāso dharmasūtre -- 'vāsaḥ śāṇīkṣaumājināni' iti | vasyate kaupīnamācchādyate yena tadvāsaḥ | śaṇasya vikāraḥ śāṇī paṭī | kṣumā'tasī tasya vikāraḥ kṣaumam | śvetapaṭṭākhyaṃ vāsoviśeṣa ityanye | ajinaṃ yasya kasyacinmedhyasya paśoḥ | eteṣu triṣvekaṃ vāsaḥ paridadhyādityartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | vasiṣṭhena tu brāhmaṇasya kārpāsaṃ vāsa uktam -- "brāhmaṇasya kārpāsaṃ vāsaḥ" iti | etaccāhataṃ, taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "athainamahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāpayati" iti | ahatalakṣaṇamāha pracetāḥ -- "īṣaddhautaṃ navaṃ śvetaṃ sadaśaṃ yanna dhāritam | ahataṃ tadvijānīyātsarvakarmasu pāvanam" iti | etacca vāsaḥ puṣye kartavyamiti baudhāyanagṛhye dṛṣṭaṃ tadasmākamapyaviruddham | etadanantaraṃ dvirācamanaṃ kāryam -- "snātvā pītvā kṣute svāpe bhuktvā rathyāprasarpaṇe | ācāntaḥ punarācāmedvāso viparidhārya ca" | iti yājñavalkyokteḥ | atrā''camanaṃ paurāṇameva na tu vaidikam -- "na hyasminyujyate karma kiṃcidā mauñjibandhanāt | śūdreṇa tu samastāvanna tu vedena yujyate" || iti manunopanayanottarameva vaidikakarmādhikārasyoktatvāt | uttarīyaṃ dharmasūtre -- "hāriṇamaiṇeyaṃ vā kṛṣṇaṃ brāhmaṇamya kṛṣṇaṃ cedamupastīrṇāsanaśāyī syādrauravaṃ rājanyasya vastājinaṃ vaiśyasyājinaṃ vaiśyasyā''vikaṃ sārvavarṇikam" iti | hariṇo mṛgastasya vikāro hāriṇaṃ carma | eṇī mṛgī tasyā vikāra aiṇeyaṃ tacca kṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ cedbibhṛyānna kevalaṃ hāriṇaṃ tadā tasminnāstīrṇe nā''sīta na ca śayīta | rururbindumānmṛgastasya vikāro rauravam | vastaśchāgastasyājinam | avirūrṇāyurmeṣastasya vikāra āvikaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ varṇānām | tasya hāriṇādibhirvikalpaḥ | kambalo'pyāvika eva sarveṣāmityartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | prāvaraṇaparyāptottarīyārthājināsaṃbhave śākalaḥ -- "akhaṇḍaṃ vā trikhaṇḍaṃ vā'ṣṭācatvāriṃśadaṅgulam | caturaṅgulavistīrṇaṃ dhārayedajinaṃ sadā" iti || khaṇḍatrayamānaṃ smṛtyantare -- "tryaṅgulaṃ tu bahirloma yadvā syāccaturaṅgulam | ajinaṃ dhārayedvipraścaturviṃśāṣṭaṣoḍaśaiḥ" iti || caturviṃśāṅgula ekaḥ | aṣṭāṅgulo dvitīyaḥ | ṣoḍaśāṅgulastṛtīyaḥ | evaṃ tribhiḥ khaṇḍairaṣṭācatvāriṃśadaṅgulaṃ(la) parimaṇḍalamajinaṃ dhāryamityarthaḥ | atra pariṣīvaṇārthaṃ kiṃcidadhikaṃ grāhyam | anyathā'ṣṭācatvāriṃśadaṅgulamajinaṃ dhāryamityanena virodhāpatteḥ | atrāṅgulāni saṃskāryasya grāhyāṇi | mekhalā gṛhye -- "mauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ trivṛtāṃ brāhmaṇasya jyā rājanyasyā''vīsūtraṃ vaiśyasya" iti | mauñjīṃ muñjatṛṇanirmitām | trivṛtāṃ triguṇām | dhanuṣo rajjurjyā | āvīsūtramavilomamayī rajjuḥ | dharmasūtre'pi -- "trivṛnmauñjī mekhalā brāhmaṇasya śaktiviṣaye dakṣiṇāvṛtānāṃ jyā rājanyasya mauñjī vā'yomiśrā''vīsatraṃ vaiśyasya sairī tāmalī vetyeke" iti | trivṛtriguṇā | muñjānāṃ vikāro mauñjī | evaṃbhūtā brāhmaṇasya mekhalā bhavati | sā ca śaktiviṣaye śaktau satyāṃ dakṣiṇāvṛtānāṃ kartavyā | taddhitārthe guṇabhūtānāmapi muñjānāmetadviśeṣaṇam | jyā dhanuṣo rajjuḥ | athavā mauñjī sā cāyomiśrā kvacitkālāyasena baddhā | avirevā''viḥ(vī)| a(ā)vyāḥ sūtramāvīsūtram | avilomamayī rajjuḥ | sairī sīravāhayoktrarajjuḥ| tāmalo vṛkṣastasya tvacā grathitā tāmalī | evaṃbhūtā vā vaiśyasya mekhaletyeka ācāryā manyanta iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | viśeṣamāha manuḥ -- "trivṛnmauñjī samā ślakṣṇā kāryā viprasya mekhalā | kṣatriyasya tu maurvī jyā vaiśyasya śaṇatāntavī" iti | samā na kvacitsūkṣmā na kvacitsthūlā kiṃ tarhi sarvata eva samā ślakṣṇā tantutanutvaguṇayuktā paridhṛṣṭā ca, jyā kadāciccarmamayī bhavati kadācittṛṇamayī | tatra carmamayīvyāvṛttyarthaṃ maurvīti jyāviśeṣaṇam, tayā dhanuṣo'vatāritayā śroṇibandhaḥ kartavya iti medhātithiḥ | jyāyāṃ trivṛttvādiguṇo na, svarūpanāśaprasaṅgāt | śaṇatāntavyāṃ tvastyeveti jñeyam | anukalpamāha manuḥ -- "muñjābhāve tu kartavyā kuśāśmantakabalvajaiḥ | trivṛtā granthinaikena tribhiḥ pañcabhireva vā" iti | atrā''diśabdalopo draṣṭavyaḥ | tenetthaṃ vākyaṃ bhavati -- muñjādyabhāva iti | granthayaśca pravarasaṃkhyayā | ekapravarasyaiko granthiḥ, tripravarasya trayaḥ, pañcapravarasya pañceti vṛddhāḥ | daṇḍo gṛhye -- "bailvaṃ pālāśaṃ vā daṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇasya naiyagrodha rājanyasyaudumbaraṃ vaiśyasya" iti | dharmasūtre'pi -- "bailvaḥ pālāśo vā daṇḍo brāhmaṇasya naiyagrodhaḥ skandhajo'vāṅagro rājanyasya bādara audumbaro vā vaiśyasya vārkṣo daṇḍa ityavarṇasaṃyogenaika upadiśanti" iti | naiyagrodho vaṭamayaḥ, sa caskandhaḥ śākhāviśeṣastasmājjātaḥ | avāṅavācīnamagraṃ yasyaitādṛśaśca | bādaro badaravṛkṣajaḥ | vārkṣo vṛkṣamātrajo'niyatavṛkṣajaḥ, etādṛśo daṇḍaḥ sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ bhavatītyeka ācāryā upadiśantītyarthaḥ | manurapi -- "brāhmaṇe bailvapālāśau kṣatriye vaṭakhādirau | paippalaudumbarau vaiśye daṇḍānarhanti dharmataḥ" iti | atra satyapi dvaṃdvanirdeśe bailvaḥ pālāśo vā daṇḍa iti dharmasūtre vikalpokteravivakṣitaṃ sāhityaṃ jñeyam | baudhāyanadharmasūtre -- "mūrdhalalāṭanāsāgrapramāṇo yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya daṇḍaḥ" iti | brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyānāṃ krameṇa daṇḍapramāṇānītyarthaḥ | eṣāṃ krameṇeti pūrvatropakramāt | atra mūrdhādipramāṇāni saṃskāryasya grāhyāṇi | daṇḍalakṣaṇānyāha manuḥ -- "ṛjavaste tu sarve syuravraṇāḥ saumyadarśanāḥ | anudvegakarāścaiva satvaco nāgnidūṣitāḥ" iti | ṛjavaḥ saralāḥ | avraṇā acchidrāḥ | saumyadarśanā akaṇṭakitādyāḥ | agnidūṣitā agnidagdhāḥ | gobhilagṛhye -- "kṣaumaśāṇakārpāsaurṇānyeṣāṃ vasanānyaiṇeyarauravājānyajināni muñjakāśatāmbalyo raśanāḥ pārṇabailvāśvatthā daṇḍāḥ | kṣaumaṃ śāṇaṃ vā vasanaṃ brāhmaṇasya kārpāsaṃ kṣatriyasyā''vikaṃ vaiśyasyaite naivetarāṇi dravyāṇi vyākhyātānyalābhe sarvāṇi sarveṣām" iti | tāmbalītāmalīśabdau paryāyau | kūrcastvasaṃkhyadarbhātmakaḥ -- "yajñavastuni muṣṭau ca stambe darbhavaṭau tathā | darbhasaṃkhyā na vihitā kūrce saṃstaraṇe'pi ca" | iti vacanāt | yattu prayogapārijāte -- "navabhiḥ saptabhirdarbhaiḥ pañcabhiḥ kramaśaḥ kṛtaḥ | kūrcaḥ śreṣṭho madhyamaśca kanīyāṃśca samīritaḥ || tadgranthirdvyaṅgulā jñeyā tadūrdhvaṃ caturaṅgulam" | iti kūrcalakṣaṇaṃ tadupaveśanārthakūrcavyatiriktaviṣayamiti draṣṭavyam | smṛtisāre -- "ekamātṛprasūtānāṃ kanye vā putrakau tayoḥ | sahodvāhaṃ na kurvīta tathaiva vratabandhanam" iti | upanayanārambhottaraṃ sūtake prāpte viśeṣaḥ saṃgrahe -- "kūśmāṇḍībhirghṛtaṃ hutvā gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm | cūḍopanayanodvāhapratiṣṭhādikamācaret" iti | brahmacārikartṛkakriyākaraṇībhūtamantrāṇāṃ śaṃ no devīrityevamādīnāmupanayanātprāgeva śikṣaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, sūtravṛttikṛdabhyanujñātatvāt | patnyā yathā'vekṣaṇādimantrāṇām | atha trivṛdannahomaḥ | tatretthaṃ sūtram -- "upasthite'nna odanasyāpūpānā saktūnāmiti samavadāya sarpirmiśrasya juhotyagnaye svāhā somāya svāhā'gnaye'nnādāya svāhā'gnaye'nnapataye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā viśvebhyo devabhyaḥ svāhā sarvābhyo devatābhyaḥ svāhā'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāheti sarvatraivamanādiṣṭadevate'muṣmai svāheti yathādevatamādiṣṭadevata eteṣāmevānnānā samavadāya prāgagreṣu darbheṣu baliṃ karoti vāstupataye svāheti trivṛtā'nnena brāhmaṇānpariviṣya puṇyāha svastyayanamṛddhimiti vācayitvā tryahavrataṃ carati" iti | asyārthaḥ -- upasthita āgata ānīte'nne brāhmaṇapariveṣaṇārthamodanasyāpūpānāṃ saktūnāṃ trayāṇāṃ samavadāya yāvadarthamavakhaṇḍya miśrayitvā punaḥ sarpiṣā miśrīkṛtasya juhotyagnaye svāhetyetairmantraiḥ | upasthitavacanaṃ bahiḥ saṃskṛtasya grahaṇārtham, odanasyāpūpānāṃ saktūnāmityetāvaducyamāne'traiva saṃskāraḥ prāpnuyāt | upasthitasyaudanasyāpūpānāṃ saktūnāmityetāvataiva siddhe'nnagrahaṇaṃ savyañjanārtham | tena jñāyate, bhojanārthamapyetadupasthitaṃ bhavati na homārthameveti | anena jñāyate bhojanaṃ hutaśeṣasyaiva nānyasyeti | odanādīnāṃ dvaṃdvasamāsana nirdeśa odanādīnāṃ kadācitsahitānāmapi pātrāntare grahaṇaṃ syāttanmā bhūdityetadarthamasamāsena nirdeśaḥ | apūpānāmiti bahuvacanāttriprabhṛtayo'pūpā grāhyāḥ | saktuśabdastu bahuvacanānta eva piṣṭaśabdavat, yathā saktubhirjuhotītyādau | odanādīnyakṣāralavaṇāni grāhyāṇi | "na kṣāralavaṇahāmā vidyate" iti dharmasūtre niṣedhāt | itiśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ, odanasyāpūpānāṃ saktūnāmeva samavadāyeti | tena haviṣyabhūtavyañjanavyāvṛttiḥ | odanādīnāmekadeśaṃ samavadāya tena sarpirmiśritena juhoti | na trayāṇāṃ sarveṣāmeva miśraṇam | sarpiḥśabdānmiśraṇe saṃskārarahitamevā''jyam | sviṣṭakṛdāhutiḥ pūrvāhutibhirasaṃsaktottarārdhapūrvārdhe hotavyā | amuṃ trivṛdannahomamanyatrāpyatidiśati -- 'sarvatraivamanādiṣṭadevate' iti | sarvatra sarvasminnapi karmaṇyanādiṣṭadevate | nā''diṣṭā'nādiṣṭā, anādiṣṭā devatā yatra tadanādiṣṭadevataṃ tasminnanādiṣṭadevate, etādṛśe'nna upasthite satyevaṃprakāreṇa homaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ | sarvatreti vacanaṃ sarveṣu karmasvevānna upasthite'yaṃ homaḥ syānna tu kevala upasthite laukike'nna ityetadartham | anādiṣṭadevata iti vacanaṃ sthālīpākamāsikādiśrāddhānnavyāvṛttyarthaṃ, tasyā''diṣṭadevatatvāt | kāṇḍavratādāvannopasthiterabhāvānnaiṣa homaḥ | iyaṃ cānnopasthitiḥ kaṇṭharavoktaiva grāhyā, anyathā śrāddhāntarasiddhabrāhmaṇabhojanā rthānnopasthiteḥ sūtrokteṣu kāṇḍavratādiṣu śāstrāntaraprokteṣu karṇavedhādikarmasu ca sattvenātiprasaṅgāpatteḥ | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ, tathā''cārābhāvāt | yadyevaṃ, yugmānbrāhmaṇānityatrāpi kaṇṭharavoktāyā atropasthiteḥ sattvāttrivṛdannahomaḥ prāpnoti | naiṣa doṣaḥ | yadyevamiṣṭaṃ syāttatraivedaṃ vidhāyātidiśet | tasmātprathamoktānnopasthitivyatiriktasthala evāyaṃ homa iti siddhaṃ bhavati | amuṣmai svāheti yathā -- devatamādiṣṭadevate | ādiṣṭadevate'nna upasthite tvamuṣmai svāheti yathādevataṃ homaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ | ādiṣṭadevate'nne sthālīpāka upasthite kaiścidācāryairyājyānuvākyābhyāṃ homo vihitaḥ sa mā bhūdityetadarthamamuṣmai svāheti vacanam | yathādevatamiti vacanaṃ yasminkarmaṇi mantre yathā yathā chāndaso dharmo devatāśabde dṛṣṭo bhavettathaiva nāmamantre'pi syādityevamartham | dṛṣṭaśca kṣetrasya patinetyasminmantre 'ṣaṣṭhīyuktaśchandasi vā' ityanena ghisaṃjñārūpaśchandasi vikalpena vihito dharmastaddharmeṇaiva nāmamantreṇa homaḥ | yathā kṣetrasya pataye svāheti ghisaṃjñābhāve kṣetrasya patye svāheti | ādiṣṭadevata iti vacanamādiṣṭadevatānnahomīyamantra evaitannā''jyahomīyanāmamantre | tena vedopākaraṇādau sadasaspataye svāhetyevameva mantraḥ, na tu sadasaspatye svāheti | vāstubalividhānātpūrvaṃ paribhāṣākaraṇādevaṃ jñāyate pūrvaṃ sviṣṭakṛddhomānantaraṃ karmaśeṣaṃ samāpyaiva vāstubaliriti | vāstubaleranāvaśyakatvadyotanārthaṃ vā madhye paribhāṣākaraṇam | athavottaratra yathāpurastādityetasya madhyamaṇinyāyena brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣyetyatrāpyanvayaḥ | tena sarvatrāpi vāstubalinaiyatyaṃ sidhyatyācāraścānugṛhīto bhavati | madhye paribhāṣākaraṇaṃ tu vāstubalerevāvyavahitatvātsarvatrātideśaḥ syāddhomasya naiva syādvyavahitatvāttanmā bhūdityetadartham | eteṣāmiti vacanaṃ balikaraṇe tānyeva dravyāṇīti | evakāro haviṣyavyañjanasyāpi vyāvṛttyarthaḥ | samavadāyetivacanātpunaḥ pṛthakpṛthaggṛhītvā'vakhaṇḍya miśrayitvā tena prāgagreṣu darbheṣu baliṃ karoti | prāgagravacanamudagagratāvyāvṛttyartham | nātra sarpirmiśraṇamavacanāt | baliṃ karotītivacanātprathamamavokṣya baliṃ tatra nyupya taṃ pariṣiñcati | trivṛtā triprakāreṇānnena savyañjanena brāhmaṇānpariviṣya saṃbhojya taiḥ puṇyāhādīni vācayitvā tryahavrataṃ caratītyarthaḥ | annenetyetāvataiva siddhe trivṛdgrahaṇaṃ yugmānbrāhmaṇānannena pariviṣyetyatrāpyodanāpūpasaktvātmakatrivṛdannasaṃpratyayārtham | upanayanaprayogaḥ | athopanayanaprayogaḥ | upanayanaṃ cikīrṣurācāryaḥ kārpāsamuktavidhinā nirmitamekaṃ yajñopavītaṃ prādeśamātraṃ samacaturaśramaśmānamahataṃ vastradvayaṃ kṣaumaṃ kārpāsaṃ vā kaupīnaṃ tadbandhanārthaṃ kṣaumaṃ sūtramuttarīyārthaṃ kāṣāyaṃ vastramajinaṃ vā trivṛtāṃ mauñjīṃ mekhalāṃ pravarasaṃkhyagranthiyutāmuktalakṣaṇaṃ daṇḍamapracchinnāgrāḥ prādeśamātrīḥ sapta pālāśīḥ samidho'niyatasaṃkhyairdarbhairnirmitamāsanārthaṃ kūrcaṃ kāṃsyavyatiriktaṃ bhikṣāpātraṃ gāṃ copakalpayet | homādisāmagrīṃ ca pitrādyupanetari kumāreṇa bhikṣayā varadānārthaṃ gaurupakalpanīyā | kṛtanityakriya ācārya ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamopanetṛtvādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ kṛcchratrayātmakaṃ prāyaścittamamukapratyāmnāyenāhamācariṣya iti saṃkalpya taccaret | evaṃ deśakālasaṃkīrtanapūrvakamupaneyatvādhikārasiddhyarthaṃ kṛcchratrayātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ godānapratyāmnāyenāhamācariṣya iti vaṭunā saṃkalpaṃ kārayitvā tatkārayet | tasyāśaktāvupanetā vā kuryāt | tato mama gāyatryupadeśādhikārārthaṃ dvādaśasahasraṃ dvādaśādhikasahasraṃ vā gāyatrījapamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya, agna āyū pītyādiṣaṇmantrāṇāṃ viśve devā ṛṣayaḥ | ādyayoragniḥ pavamāno devatā | madhyamayoragniḥ pāvakaḥ | antyayoragniḥ śucirgāyatrī chandaḥ | jape viniyogaḥ| 'oṃ agna āyū ṣi0 pyarcayaḥ' ityagnipavitrasaṃjñakānṣaṇmantrānsakṛjjapitvā, gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ, savitā devatā, gāyatrī chandaḥ | jape viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ0 dayāt' iti sakṛjjapitvā, ṛṣyādismaraṇapūrvakaṃ saṃkalpitapakṣānusāreṇa dvādaśasahasraṃ dvādaśādhikasahasraṃ vā yathākālaṃ gāyatrījapaṃ kuryāt | athavā'gnipavitrasaṃjñakānṣaṇmantrāngāyatrīṃ ca sakṛjjapitvoktasaṃkhyaṃ gāyatrījapaṃ saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ kuryāt | athavā gāyatryāḥ sakṛjjapo na kāryaḥ | tata ācāryo jyotirvidādibhyo'vadhāritādupayanadinātpūrvedyustaddidane vā sarvaṃ nityakarma vidhāya māṅgalikaṃ snānaṃ māṅgalikaṃ veṣaṃ ca kṛtvā sottaracchade raṅgavallikāyukte pīṭhe prāṅmukha upaviśya svadakṣiṇataḥ kṛtamāṅgalikasnānāṃ kṛtamāṅgalikaveṣāṃ bhāryāṃ taddakṣiṇataḥ kṛtamāṅgalikasnānaṃ kṛtamāṅgalikaveṣaṃ saṃskāryaṃ copaveśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtyāsya kumārasya dvijatvasi ddhipūrvakavedādhyayanādhikārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthamācāryapaitṛkasāvitrīmātṛkamupanayanākhyaṃ saṃskāraṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ 'oṃ indrāya tvāṃ paridade' iti kumāraṃ brūūyāt | paridehīti kumāraḥ | athā''cāryaḥ 'oṃ parīmamindra brahmaṇe mahe śrotrāya dadhmasi | athainaṃ jarimāṇaye jyokchrotre adhijāgarat' iti brāhmaṇakumāramindrāya paridadāti | kumāramālabhya mantraṃ bravītītyarthaḥ | utthāpya saṃspṛśya mantravacanaṃ paridānamiti gṛhyakārikākṛt | śrotraśabdasthāne rāṣṭraśabdaḥ kṣattriyakumāraparidāne poṣaśabdo vaiśyakumāraparidāne | athāgreṇāgniṃ kumāraṃ dakṣiṇato nītvā'pareṇāgnimudaṅmukhamupaveśya 'oṃ tvayi medhāṃ tvayi prajāṃ tvayyagnistejo dadhātu | tvayi medhāṃ tvayi prajāṃ tvayīndra indriyaṃ dadhātu | tvayi medhāṃ tvayi prajāṃ tvayi sūryo bhrājo dadhātu' iti tribhirhutoccheṣamājyaṃ sarvamardhaṃ vā sakṛtkumāraṃ prāśayati | trayāṇāmante prāśanam | yadā sarvasya prāśanaṃ tadā saptapalāśasamidhāmabhyādhānārthaṃ laukikājyenābhyañjanam | paridhyañjanaprāyaścittahomayoḥ kartavyatāyāmanyadājyaṃ pūrvavatsaṃskṛtya tenobhayaṃ kāryam | yadā tvardhasya prāśanaṃ tadā'vaśiṣṭena tenaivābhyañjanaṃ paridhyañjanaprāyaścittahomau ca | athavā hutoccheṣamājyamalpīyasi laukike dadhni sarvamardhe vā''nīyā''loḍanena pṛṣadguṇakaṃ kṛtvā tatprāśayedetaireva mantraiḥ | hutoccheṣājye'lpaṃ dadhyānīya pṛṣadājyaṃ kartavyamityevaṃ tu na bhavati | tṛtīyamājyasya dadhanyānīyeti pṛṣadguṇasvārthaṃ paśusūtre dṛṣṭasya dadhyadhikaraṇakājyānayanavidherevātra grahītumucitatvāt | tato yoge yoga ityasyāgnirindro gāyatrī | imamagna āyuṣa ityasya viśve devā agnivaruṇasomāditiviśvadevā bhūriktriṣṭup | kumārasamīkṣaṇe viniyogaḥ -- 'oṃ yoge yoge tava0 mūrtaye' 'imamagna āyuṣe0 thāsat' iti dvābhyāṃ prāśnantaṃ kumāraṃ samīkṣate | athavā hutoccheṣamājyaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ vā''bhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ prāśayati | asminpakṣe tvayi medhāmiti mantratrayasya samīkṣaṇasya ca lopaḥ | tataḥ kumāraḥ prāśanāṅgamācamanaṃ kuryāt | hutoccheṣājyanāśe prāśanābhāvaḥ | prāśanābhāvādācamanasyāpyabhāvaḥ | ājyāntaraṃ tatsthāna upādāya tatprāśanīyamiti kecit | athā''cārya ācāntaṃ kumāramātmānamupasparśayitvā(rśya) 'oṃ śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatā''yurgantoḥ' iti kumāramabhimantrayate | atha kumāra ācāryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bahiṣkṛtya pātrasahitamagniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ parikrāmati | ācāryaḥ oṃ āgantrā samaganmahi prāptamṛtyuṃ yuyotana | ariṣṭāḥ saṃcaremahi svasti caratādiha svastyā gṛhebhyaḥ' ityāsīna eva pradakṣiṇamagniṃ parikrāmantaṃ kumāramabhimantrāyate -- 'oṃ brahmacaryamāgāmupa mā nayasva brahmacārī bhavāni devena savitrā prasūtaḥ' iti kumāraṃ vācayati | ko nāmāsīti kumāraṃ pṛcchati | atha kumāraḥ svasya śarmāntaṃ vyāvahārikaṃ nākṣatraṃ ca nāmā''caṣṭe | yathā devadattaśarmā kārtiko'smīti | athā''cāryaḥ | 'oṃ svasti deva savitarahamanena devadattaśarmaṇā kārtikenodṛcamaśīya' iti kumārasya nāmanī gṛhṇāti | śaṃ no devīrityasya prajāpatirāpo gāyatrī | mārjane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ śaṃ no devī0 tu naḥ' ubhāvadbhirmārjate | ubhayormantraḥ | atha pradhānopanayanam | athā''cāryo jyotirvidaṃ saṃpūjyāgnerdakṣiṇataḥ prāṅmukha upaviśyāgnerāgneyyāṃ diśi svapurobhāga ātmābhimukhaṃ kumāramupaveśyobhayormadhye jyotirvidā svastikenāṅkita udagdaśe'ntaḥpaṭe dhṛte brāhmaṇairmaṅgalasūktapadyapāṭhe ca kriyamāṇe svakuladevatādīnāṃ cintanaṃ paṭasthasvastikāvalokanaṃ ca kurva nnāsīta | evaṃ kumāro'pi | athavā svasthānasthitāvevobhau | asminpakṣe prāgdaśo'ntaḥpaṭaḥ | tata ācāryo jyotirvidāṃ sulagnasamaye'ntaḥpaṭa udakprāgvā niṣkāśite tatrastha eva kumārasyopanayanaṃ kuryāt | taccettham | kumārasya dakṣiṇamaṃsaṃ svadakṣiṇena hastena savyahastena savyamaṃsaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kiṃcidanvārabhya, samastavyāhṛtīnāṃ prajāpatiḥ prajāpatirbṛhatī | gāyatryā viśvāmitro'gniśca savitā gāyatrī | devasya tvetyasya vāmadevaḥ savitā yajuḥ | kumārasyopanayane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ' 'oṃ tatsaviturva0 pracodayāt' 'oṃ devasya tvā sa0 hastābhyāmupanaye'mukaśarman' iti kumārasya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumātmana ābhimukhyenā''nīya samāsīnaḥ kumāramupanayate kumāraṃ svasamīpe saṃmukhaṃ karotītyarthaḥ | idaṃ pradhānopanayanamācāryaḥ karmamadhye na vismaret | vismaraṇaṃ cedakhilaṃ karmā''vartanīyaṃ mātṛdattokteḥ | pradhānatvāditi bhāvaḥ | agnerdakṣiṇata upanayanakriyāpakṣa ubhāvatra sve sve sthāna upaviśataḥ | atra 'oṃ ye yajñena dakṣiṇayā samaktā agne tejasvin' ityādyā āśiṣo dadyurācārāt | athā''cāryaḥ -- 'oṃ agniṣṭe hastamagrabhītsomaste hastamagrabhītsavitā te hastamagrabhītsarasvatī te hastamagrabhītpūṣā te hastamagrabhīdbṛhaspatiste hastamagrabhīnmitraste hastamagrabhīdvaruṇaste hastamagrabhīttvaṣṭā te hastamagrabhīddhātā te hastamagrabhīdviṣṇuste hastamagrabhītprajāpatiste hastamagrabhīt' [iti] kumārasya dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ dakṣiṇena hastena gṛhṇāti | 'oṃ savitā tvā'bhirakṣatu mitrastvamasi dharmeṇā'gnirācāryastava devena savitrā prasūto bṛhaspaterbrahmacārī bhavāmukaśarmannapo'śāna samidha ādhehi karma kuru mā divā svāpsīḥ' iti kumāraṃ saṃśāsti | saṃśāsanaṃ śikṣaṇam | apo'śānetyācamanādyupalakṣaṇam | mūtrotsargādau nimitte śaucānte vidhinā''camanaṃ kuru | samidha ādhehi yāvadbrahmacaryaṃ sāyaṃprātaḥ sāyameva vā'gnikāryaṃ kuru | karma kuru saṃdhyopāsanādikaṃ guruśuśrūṣāvedādhyayanādikaṃ ca karma kuru | mā divā svāpsīḥ | divā nidrāṃ mā kurvityarthaḥ | bāḍhamiti kumāro'ṅgī kuryāt | athā''cāryo dakṣiṇena hastena kumārasya tūṣṇīṃ dakṣiṇāṃsasyopari sāmīpyena pṛṣṭhataḥ praveśya krameṇāvācīnamabhimṛśya 'oṃ mama hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ te astu, mama cittaṃ cittenānvehi, mama vācamekamanā juṣasva, bṛhaspatistvā niyunaktu mahyaṃ, māmevānusa rabhasva, mayi cittāni santu te, mayi sāmīcyamastu te, mahyaṃ vācaṃ niyacchatāt" [iti] kumārasya hṛdayamabhimṛśati | apa upaspṛśya'oṃ prāṇānāṃ granthirasi samāvisrasaḥ" [iti] tathaiva nābhideśamabhimṛśati | apa upaspṛśya 'oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ suprajāḥ prajayā bhūyāsa suvīro vīraiḥ suvarcā varcasā supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ sumedhā medhayā subrahmā brahmacāribhiḥ" [iti] kumāramabhimantrya 'oṃ bhūrṛkṣu tvā'gnau pṛthivyāṃ vāci brahmaṇi dade'mukaśarman | bhuvo yajuḥṣu tvā vāyāvantarikṣe prāṇe brahmaṇi dade'mukaśarman | suvaḥ sāmasu tvā sūrye divi cakṣuṣi brahmaṇi dade'mukaśarman | iṣṭataste priyo'sānyamukaśarman | analasya te priyo'sānyamukaśarman | idaṃ vatsyāvaḥ prāṇa āyuṣi vatsyāvaḥ prāṇa āyuṣi vasāmukaśarman" [iti] punaḥ kumāramabhimantrayate | agnirāyuṣmāniti sānuṣaṅgāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ viśve devā agnyāyuṣmadādayo yajūṃṣi | kumārasya dakṣiṇahastagrahaṇe viniyogaḥ | 'agnirāyuṣmānsa va0 soma āyuṣmānsa0 yajña āyuṣmānsa0 brahmā''yuṣmatta0 devā āyuṣma0' etaiḥ pañcabhiḥ paryāyairdakṣiṇena hastena kumārasya dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhṇāti | āyuṣṭe viśvata ityasya viśve devā āyurdā agniranuṣṭup | agnau pṛthivyāmityasya vāmadevo'gnyādayo yajuḥ | kumārasya dakṣiṇakarṇe jape viniyogaḥ 'oṃ āyuṣṭe vi0 mite" "agnau pṛthivyā pratitiṣṭha vāyāvantarikṣe sūrye divi yā svastimagnirvāyurādityaścandramā āpo nu saṃcaranti tā svastimanusaṃcarāmukaśarmanprāṇasya brahmacāryabhūramukaśarman' [iti] kumārasya dakṣiṇe karṇe japati | āyurdā agna ityasya viśve devā āyurdā agnistriṣṭup | agnau pṛthivyāmityasya vāmadevo'gnyādayo yajuḥ | kumārasyottarakarṇe jape viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ āyurdā a0 dimam' 'agnau pṛthivyāṃ0 bhūramukaśarman' [iti] kumārasyottare karṇe japati | 'medhāṃ ta indro dadātu medhāṃ devī sarasvatī | medhāṃ te aśvināvubhāvādhattāṃ puṣkarastrajau' [iti] kumārasya mukhaṃ svamukhena saha saṃnidhāya japati | kaṣakādidevebhyastvāṃ paridada iti kumāraṃ brūyāt | paridehīti kumāraḥ | tata ācāryaḥ -- "kaṣakāya tvā paridadāmyantakāya tvā paridadāmyaghorāya tvā paridadāmi gadāya tvā paridadāmi yamāya tvā paridadāmi makhāya tvā paridadāmi vaśinyai tvā paridadāmi pṛthivyai tvā savaiśvānarāyai paridadāmyadbhyastvā paridadāmyoṣadhībhyastvā paridadāmi vanaspatibhyastvā paridadāmi dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā paridadāmi subhūtāya tvā paridadāmi brahmavarcasāya tvā paridadāmi viśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvebhyastvā bhūtebhyaḥ paridadāmi sarvābhyastvā devatābhyaḥ paridadāmi" iti kumāraṃ kaṣakādibhyaḥ paridadāti | yadi punarupanayanaṃ tadā'tra sāvitrīvācanaṃ kṛtvā saptapalāśasamiddhomādikaṃ karma kāryaṃ nātrākṣāralavaṇāśanādivrataṃ caritatvāt | punarupanayanaprayogastvagre vakṣyate | prathamopanayane tu paridānānantaraṃ saptapalāśasamiddhomāditrivṛdannahomāntaṃ vakṣyamāṇarītyā kṛtvā tryahavratamakṣāralavaṇāśanādikaṃ vakṣyamāṇarītyā devatopasthānapūrvakaṃ kumāreṇa kārayitvā caturthadivase prātaḥ sāvitrīvācanaṃ caturthadivasīyatrivṛdannahomādikaṃ sarvaṃ krameṇa samāpayedityekaṃ matam | sadyaḥ sāvitrīvācanamiti pauṣkarasādimatam | etanmate'pi tryahavrataṃ bhavatyeva | "sadyaḥ pauṣkarasādiḥ" ityasminsūtre prāgvratacaryāparisamāpteḥ śukriyāṇāmadhyayanadarśanāt | vratamanārabhyādhyayanasyānupapannatvāditi mātṛdattokteḥ | tatra pauṣkarasādimatamāśritya prayoga ucyate | paridānānantaraṃ kumāreṇā''sāditasaptapalāśasamidhāṃ ghṛtenābhyañjanaṃ kārayitvopanayanāgnāvabhyādhāpayati mantrānvācayati ca | kumāraḥ -- "oṃ agnaye samidhamāhārṣaṃ bṛhate jātavedase | yathā tvamagne samidhā samidhyasa evaṃ māṃ medhayā prajñayā prajayā paśubhirbrahmavarcasenānnādyena samedhaya svāhā" [iti] ekāṃ samidhaṃ ghṛtenābhyaktāmabhyādadhāti | agnaya idamiti tyāgaṃ kuryāt | tathaiva dve dvitīye | tathaivāvaśiṣṭāścatasrastṛtīye | agnaye samidhāvāhārṣamiti dvitīye mantrasaṃnāmaḥ | agnaye samidha āhārṣamiti tṛtīye | tyāgastu pūrvavadevobhayatrāpi | mantrāntargatadvitīyasamicchabde tu nohaḥ | tasyendhanamātrābhidhāyitvātsaṃnamanāvacanācca | kecidabhyādhānātpūrvaṃ saṃkalpamapi kurvanti, tanna | sarveṣvaṅgabhūteṣu karmasvatiprasaṅgāpatteḥ "samaste kratāvarthaṃ śrūyamāṇaṃ yajamānaḥ kāmayate, yāni tu kāmayati śrāvayati" iti sūtreṇa sākṣātkamidhātusamabhivyāhāra eva saṃkalpakartavyatokteśca | na hyatra kamidhātuḥ śrūyate | evamanyatrāpi | tataḥ śulbapraharaṇādisaṃsthājapāntaṃ karma samāpya "na gāyenna rodenna nṛtyadarśī bhavenmadhumāṃsāśanādi varjayet" ityādīni dharmasūtroktāni, etadvrata evāta ūrdhvamityārabhya na striyamupaitītyantāni gṛhyoktāni ca brahmacaryāśramavratāni kumārāyopadiśati | tato'gne vratapata ityādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ viśve devā ṛṣayaḥ | agnivāyusūryavratapatayaḥ krameṇa devatā yajūṃṣi | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | "oṃ agne vratapate vrataṃ ca0 dhyatām" [iti] agnimupatiṣṭhate | "oṃ vāyo vratapate0 vāyum | ādityavratapa0 ādityam | vratānāṃ vratapa0 vratapatim" atra vratapatiśabdenāgnirgrāhyaḥ | "vratena vai medhyo'gnirvratapatiḥ" iti śruteḥ | etadvratopāyanam | asya samāvartane tyāgaḥ | atra gurave varaṃ dadāti "guro varaṃ te dadāmi" iti | gururā''cāryaḥ | piturapyācāryatve pūrvopaklṛptā'nyasmātpratigraheṇā''nītā gaurvarārthe deyā | savituriti mantrasya prajāpatiḥ savitā yajuḥ | varapratigrahaṇe viniyogaḥ | "oṃ devasya tvā savi0 dakṣiṇe rudrāya gāṃ tayā'mṛtatvamaśyāṃ vayo0 gṛhṇātu" [iti] varaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | vāmahastena tṛṇapradānaṃ dakṣiṇahastena pratigrahaḥ | sūtre dātra ityanantaraṃ bhūyānmaya iti paṭhitaṃ tathā vā brūyāt | pratinidhitvena dravyadānapakṣe'pyayameva mantraḥ | niṣkrayatvena dravyadānapakṣe tu | uttānastvetyasya prajāpatirāṅgīraso yajuḥ | pratigrahaṇe viniyogaḥ | "oṃ uttānastvā''ṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu" iti pratigṛhṇāti | atrāpi sāvitrānvādhīsta iti kecit | vastutastūṣṇīmeva pratigraho na mantreṇa | etasyā dakṣiṇāyā yāgasaṃbandhitvābhāvāt | "devā vai varuṇamayājayan" iti śrutau yāgasyaivopakrameṇa tatsaṃbandhidakṣiṇāpratigraha eva samantrakapratigrahasyokteḥ | "tāntrīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ putrastaṃ te paridadāmi"iti sūryāya kumāraṃ paridadāti | tato brahmacāryācāryo vā -- taccakṣurityasya somaḥ sūryo yajuḥ | sūryopasthāne viniyogaḥ | "oṃ taccakṣurdeva0 dṛśe" iti sūryamupatiṣṭhate | athā''cāryaḥ 'oṃ agniṣṭa āyuḥ pratarāṃ kṛṇotvagniṣṭe puṣṭiṃ pratarāṃ dadhātvindro marudbhiriha te dadhātvādityaste vasubhirādadhātu' [iti] kumārāya pūrvāsāditamūrdhvāgraṃ daṇḍaṃ pradāya tūṣṇīṃ mitrakuleṣu | tatra pumāṃsaṃ bhavānbhikṣāṃ dadātviti | tadbhikṣitaṃ dravyamāhṛtya bhaikṣyamidaṃ bho ityācāryāya nivedayet | ācāryastatsubhaikṣamiti pratigṛhṇāti | atrāpi saptadaśakṛtvo'pānanamiti
