trivṛdannahomaḥ | ācāryo brahmacāryanvārabdhaḥ samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā trivṛdannahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi | jātavedasamagnimidhamenetyādiprasādhanīdevyantamuktvā pradhānahome, agniṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, somaṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, animannādaṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, agnimannapatiṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, prajāpatiṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, viśvāndevāṃstrivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, sarvā devatāstrivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye, agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣāhutyā yakṣye, etā devatāḥ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā samittrayamagnāvabhyādadhyāt | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣāhutyā yakṣya ityanantaraṃ vāstoṣpatiṃ trivṛdannabalinā yakṣya iti kecidvadanti | tato'gniṃ paristīrya mayi gṛhṇāmi yo no agniriti dvābhyāmātmanyagniṃ gṛhṇīyāt |
tato brahmāsanakalpanādi | pātrāsādane sruvaṃ darvīmājyasthālīṃ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānidhmaṃ barhiravajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ brāhmaṇapariveṣaṇārthamānītādbahireva saṃskṛtādannādgṛhītamodanāpūpasaktvātmakaṃ trivṛdannaṃ cā''sādayet | tatrāpūpāstribhyo'dhikā homaparyāptā grāhyāḥ | apūpaśabdena godhūmavikārāḥ sacchidrāḥ pūrikā ucyante | maṇḍakā iti kecit | saktavo bharjitayavapiṣṭāni | etadabhāve bharjitagodhūmapiṣṭāni | apūpā akṣāralavaṇā grāhyāḥ | tataḥ pavitrakaraṇādi | brahmā'tra sa eva | pṛthagvā | prathamapakṣe nātra tadvaraṇaṃ vṛtatvāt | tataḥ praṇītāpraṇayanādi paridhiparidhānāntaṃ kṛtvā''sāditaṃ trivṛdannaṃ bahirniṣpannatvādagnāvadhiśrityābhighāryottarata udvāsyādbhiḥ prokṣati | ayaṃ devapavitrasaṃskāro mātṛdattamate | ujjvalākṛnmate tu naiṣa saṃskāraḥ | śūdrakartṛkapāka eva tenokteḥ | evaṃ māsiśrāddhādāvapi | tatastamabhighāryāgneḥ paścādbarhiṣi nidhāyāpūpānavakhaṇḍyaudane prakṣipya saktava(ktūṃ)śca prakṣipya laukikamājyamāsicya miśrayitvā sapta bhāgānsamānkṛtvā, idaṃ viśvebhyo devebhya ida sarvābhyo devatābhya ityantimabhāgayordevatānirdeśaṃ kuryāt | na vā vibhāganirdeśau | tato'gniṃ pariṣicyedhmābhyādhānādiprasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ kṛtvā sarpirmiśritaṃ trivṛdannamavadānadharmeṇāvadāyāvadāya juhoti | darvyāmupastīrya madhyātpūrvārdhāccāvadāyābhighārya haviḥ pratyabhighārayatītyeṣo'vadānadharmaḥ | vibhāgapakṣe krameṇa tattadbhāgādavadānam | 'agnaye svāhā | somāya svāhā | agnaye'nnādāya svāhā | agnaye'nnapataye svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā | sarvābhyo devatābhyaḥ svāhā' iti krameṇa hutvā darvyāmupastīrya sarvebhyo havirbhya uttarārdhātsakṛtsakṛnmekṣaṇena hastena vā'vadāya dvirabhighārya na haviḥ pratyabhighārayati | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhetipūrvāhutibhirasaṃsaktāmuttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti yathāliṅgaṃ tyāgāḥ | vibhāgābhāvapakṣa ekamevāvadānamekatvāddhaviṣaḥ | ayaṃ cāvadānadharmo bhāṣyakṛnmate | anyeṣāṃ mate tu lājahomavyatiriktasthale na kutrāpyavadānadharmo'stīti draṣṭavyam | tataḥ paristaraṇavisargapariṣekau kṛtvā sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvopasthānaṃ kuryāt | śulbapraharaṇādidharmāḥ kṛtākṛtāḥ | tata uttareṇāgniṃ kāṃściddarbhānāstīrya tatra kiṃcidudakamāsicya pūrvavadāsāditamannatrayamekīkṛtya 'vāstupataye svāhā' [iti] tena baliṃ karoti | vāstupataya idaṃ0 | tato baliṃ pariṣiñcati | nātra sarpirmiśraṇamavacanāt | tato'nenānnenānyena ca savyañjanena brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya pūrvavatpuṇyāhādīni vācayet | tatra trivṛdannahomakarmaṇaḥ puṇyāhaṃ bhavanto bruvantu, trivṛdannahomakarmaṇaḥ svastyayanaṃ bhavanto bruvantu, trivṛdannahomakarmaṇa ṛddhiṃ bhavanto bruvantu | iti vākyeṣu viśeṣaḥ | omastu puṇyāham | omastu svastyayanam | omastvṛddhiriti viprāṇāṃ prativacanāni | tataḥ śraddhāmedhe prīyatāmiti vadet | ayaṃ ca homaḥ sthālīpākamāsiśrāddhādivyatirikteṣu sūtrokteṣu karmasūpanayanārambhavihitānnopasthitivyatiriktāyāṃ sūtrakṛdvihitāyāmannopasthitau kāryaḥ | atha vyāhṛtihomavāruṇīhomādisahito homaprayogaḥ | ācāryo brahmacāryanvārabdhaḥ samittrayamādāyetyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā trivṛdannahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādi vyāhṛtyantamuktvā pradhānahome, agniṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣya ityādi sarvā devatāstrivṛdannāhutyā yakṣya ityantaṃ devatāḥ pūrvavaduktvā'home varuṇamityādi samittrayābhyādhānāntaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ paristīrya pātrāsādanādi prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā vyastasamastavyāhṛtibhiścatasra āhutīrhutvā pūrvavadagnaye svāhetyādyāḥ saptā''hutīstrivṛdannena hutvā, imaṃ me varuṇetyādyāḥ ṣaḍāhutīrjayābhyātānarāṣṭrabhṛddhomapakṣe tānapi hutvā'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhetyetenaiva sviṣṭakṛddhomaṃ vidadhyāt | tataḥ śulbapraharaṇādihomaśeṣaṃ sarvaṃ samāpya vāstubaliṃ dattvā brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya puṇyāhasvastyayanardhīrvācayitvā śraddhāmedhe prīyatāmiti vadet | iti vyāhṛtihomavāruṇīhomādisahitastrivṛdannahomaprayogaḥ | athā''pūrvikatantreṇa prayogaḥ | ācāryo brahmacāryanvārabdhaḥ samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāntaṃ kṛtvā trivṛdannahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi | agniṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | somaṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | agnimannādaṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | agnimannapatiṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | prajāpatiṃ trivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | viśvāndevāṃstrivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | sarvā devatāstrivṛdannāhutyā yakṣye | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣāhutyā yakṣye | etā devatāḥ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā samittrayamagnāvabhyādhāyāgniṃ paristīryottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya pātrāṇi prayunakti | darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ havirāsādanārthaṃ darbhānsaṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ trivṛdannaṃ cā''sādya pavitre kṛtvā prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā prokṣya darvīniṣṭapanādyājyasaṃskārāntaṃ kuryāt | tato'gneḥ paścādāsāditāndarbhānāstīrya tatrā''jyaṃ nidhāya taduttarato darvīṃ nidadhyāt | tato devapavitrākhyasaṃskāreṇa saṃskṛtyābhighāryāgneḥ paścādāstṛteṣu darbheṣvodanāpūpasaktūnnidhāya tānekīkṛtya laukikamājyamāsicya miśrayitvā'gniṃ pariṣicyā''sāditāmekāṃ samidhamabhyādhāya darvyopahatyopahatyāṣṭāvāhutīrmiśritena trivṛdannena juhoti -- "agnaye svāhā | somāya svāhā | agnaye'nnādāya svāhā | agnaye'nnapataye svāhā | prajāpataye svāhā | viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā | sarvābhyo devatābhyaḥ svāhā | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā" iti pūrvāhutibhirasaṃsaktāmuttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti | yathāliṅgaṃ tyāgāḥ | antyāhutiḥ pūrvāhutibhirasaṃsaktottarārdhapūrvārdhe hotavyā | nātrāvadānadharma āpūrvikatvāt | tataḥ paristaraṇavisargapariṣekau kṛtvā sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvopasthānaṃ kuryāt | na vopasthānam | sarvaprāyaścittahomānantaraṃ vottarapariṣekaḥ | tata uttareṇāgniṃ kāṃściddarbhānāstīrya tatra kiṃcidudakamāsicya pūrvavadāsāditamannatrayamekīkṛtya "vāstupataye svāhā" [iti] tena baliṃ karoti | vāstupataya idaṃ0 | tato baliṃ pariṣiñcati | nātra sarpirmiśraṇamavacanāt | tato'nenānnenānyena ca savyañjanena brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya pūrvavatpuṇyāhādīni vācayet | tataḥ śraddhāmedhe prīyatāmiti vadet | ityāpūrvikatantreṇa trivṛdannahomaḥ | upanayanasamāvartanavatsātiriktagokṛtagostanapānaśālākaraṇavāstuśamanasīmantonnayanapuṃsavananāmakaraṇānnaprāśanacūḍākaraṇagodāneṣvevāyaṃ bhavati nānyatra | pāṇigrahaṇādiragnirityetatkhaṇḍoktarītyā punaḥsaṃdhānakaraṇapakṣe tatrāpyayaṃ bhavati | samāvartanāditrivṛdannahome vāstubalervikalpaḥ | tatastryahavrataṃ kumārāyopadiśati | ikṣuvikāralavaṇamāṣamudgādidhānyamadhumāṃsāśanaṃ mañcakādyupariśayanaṃ mṛnmayena jalapānaṃ mṛnmayapātre kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanaṃ śūdrāyocchiṣṭadānaṃ divāśayanaṃ ca na kāryam | ubhau kālau bhikṣācaryamudakumbhāharaṇa sāyamupakramya pratyahamubhau kālau pratyahaṃ sāyameva vā'gnikāryaṃ kartavyamiti | tryahavratasamāptyanantaramikṣuvikāralavaṇaśamīdhānyānāmaśane vikalpaḥ | udakumbhāharaṇamagnikāryaṃ ca brahmacaryavratasamāptiparyantameva | brahmacārī bāḍhamityuktvā'gne vratapata ityādibhirdevatopasthānaṃ kṛtvā tryahavrataṃ strī kuryāt | tata ācāryo yathācāraṃ gāyatrīpūjanaṃ vidhāya gāyatryupadeśārthamapareṇāgnimāsāditaṃ kūrcamudagagraṃ nidhāya 'rāṣṭrabhṛdasyācāryāsandī mā tyadyopam' [iti] tasminprāṅmukha upaviśet | tato brahmacārī tūṣṇīmādityāya namaskārāñjaliṃ kṛtvā''cāryasya dakṣiṇaṃ pādaṃ savyānvārabdhena dakṣiṇena hastenādhastādupariṣṭāccāvamṛśya pāṇī vyatyasya tābhyāṃ sakukṣikau tasya pādau dhārayet | idamupasaṃgrahaṇam | atrā''cāryeṇa guptaṃ nāma kumārāyopāṃśu kathanīyam | kumārastenopāṃśūccāritena nāmnā''cāryamabhivādayet | etannāmāvijñāne tu vyāvahārikeṇa nāmnopāṃśvevābhivādayet | tatrābhivādanaprakāra ittham | dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ savyānvārabdhaṃ śrotrasamaṃ prasāryāmukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpanno'mukaśarmā'haṃ bho abhivādaya ityupāṃśūccārayañśirovanatipūrvakaṃ tiṣṭhannācāryaṃ namaskuryāt | idamabhivādanam | tata ācāryeṇā''yuṣmānbhavāmukaśarmā3 a, ityavisargākārottareṇa plutāntyasvaroccāraṇena kevalaṃ plutāntyasvaroccāraṇena vopāṃśuprayuktāśīrvāda āsīno vinayāvanato bhūtvā sarvavedārambhārthatvena sāvitryupadeśaṃ vāñchannadhyeṣaṇārūpaṃ mantradvayamekaśrutyā paṭhet | adhīhi bho ityuktvā sāvitrīṃ bho anubrūhīti | tata uttānīkṛtavāmapāṇyaṅguṣṭhāṅgulīrnyaṅmukhīkṛtadakṣiṇapāṇyaṅguṣṭhāṅgulībhirdṛḍhasaṃyoginīḥ kṛtvā dakṣiṇāṅke nikṣipyā''sīta | tata ācāryo gaṇānāṃ tvetyasya viśve devā gaṇapatirjagatī | kumārābhi mantraṇe viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ gaṇānāṃ tvā0 sādanam' [iti] kumāramabhimantrayate | tatastamañjaliṃ svapāṇibhyāmādāya, vyastasamastavyāhṛtīnāṃ gāyatryāścarṣyādi pūrvavatsmṛtvā, kumārasya gāyatryupadeśe viniyoga iti viniyogavākyaṃ smṛtvā, "bhūstatsaviturvareṇyaṃ, bhūvo bhargo devasya dhīmahi, suvardhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt, bhūrbhuvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | suvardhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvastatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt" sāvitrīmevaṃprakāreṇa paccho'rdharcaśo'navānamiti prāṅmukhaṃ kumāraṃ vācayati | atra sarvānuvācanasyādṛṣṭārthatvādavasānaṃ vinā yathā vācanaṃ syāttathā vācanaṃ kāryam | sarvathaivamuccāraṇāśaktau yathāśakti vācayati | yathāśakti vācayansaṃdhikṛtaṃ varṇavikāraṃ nānyathā kurvīteti kaustubhe | taittirīyāṇāṃ gāyatryārambheṇaiva ṛgyajuḥsāmātmakavedatrayādhyayanādhikāro bhavati | tataḥ karmāṅgadevatāprītyarthaṃ śatadvayaṃ pañcāśadvā'tyaśaktau daśa vā brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | tataḥ karmāṅgadevatāprītyarthaṃ gandhatāmbūlādibhirbrāhmaṇapūjanaṃ tebhyo bhūyasīdakṣiṇādānaṃ ca kṛtvā 'oṃ agne tejasvin' ityādibhirmantrairāśiṣo grāhyāḥ | tataḥ pramādāditi karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ smaret | tato brahmacārī svakāle kālaprāptāṃ madhyāhnasaṃdhyāṃ kuryāt | nātra sāyamārambho niyato'nuktatvāt | "saṃdhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu" ityuktatvāt | "yāvadbrahmopadeśastu tāvatsaṃdhyādikaṃ ca na | jāte brahmopadeśe tu karma saṃdhyādikaṃ caret" || iti jaiminivacanato'pi madhyāhnasaṃdhyāyā eva prathamataḥ prāptatvācca | 'tryahe paryavete tathaiva trivṛtā'nnena brāhmaṇānpariviṣya' itisūtre tatheti vacanenopanayanāgniprāpterjñāpitatvāt, baudhāyanīya upanayanāgneḥ karmasamāptyantaṃ vyaktatayā dhāraṇasyokteścopanayanāgniścaturthadivasīyakarmasamāptyantaṃ saṃrakṣaṇīyaḥ | tasminneva karmasamāptiparyantaṃ sāyaṃprātaḥ sāyameva vā'gnikāryasaṃjñakaṃ samidabhyādhānaṃ kuryāt | tadanantaraṃ laukikāgnau | tatprayogastvagre vakṣyate | "jāte brahmopadeśe tu karma saṃdhyādikaṃ caret" iti jaiminivacanenopadeśottaraṃ saṃdhyopāsanakartavyatā pūrvatra pradarśitā | taccopāsanaṃ kathaṃ kāryamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ saṃdhyātrayasvarūpapradarśanapūrvakaṃ tadabhidhīyate | tatra saṃdhyāsvarūpaṃ prāha śrutiḥ -- "rakṣā si ha vā puronuvāke tapogramatiṣṭhanta tānprajāpatirvareṇopāmantrayata tāni varamavṛṇītā''dityo no yoddhā, iti tānprajāpatirabravīdyodhayadhvamiti tasmāduttiṣṭhanta ha vā tāni rakṣā syādityaṃ yodhayanti yāvadastamanvagāttāni ha vā etāni rakṣā si gāyatriyā'bhimantritenāmbhasā śāmyanti tadu ha vā ete brahmavādinaḥ pūrvābhimukhāḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ gāyatriyā'bhimantritā ā'pa ūrdhvaṃ vikṣipanti tā etā āpo vajrī bhūtvā tāni rakṣā si mandehāruṇe dvīpe prakṣipanti yatpradakṣiṇaṃ prakramanti tena pāpmānamavadhūnvantyudyantamastaṃ yantamādityamabhidhyāyankurvanbrāhmaṇo vidvānsakalaṃ bhadramaśnute'sāvādityo brahmeti brahmaiva sanbrahmāpyeti ya evaṃ veda" iti | vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa prāṇāyāmādikaṃ karma kurvanvakṣyamāṇayathoktanāmavarṇarūpopetasaṃdhyāśabdavācyamādityaṃ brahmeti dhyāyannaihikamāmuṣmikaṃ ca sakalaṃ bhadramaśnute | ya evamuktadhyānena śuddhāntaḥkaraṇo brahma sākṣātkurute sa pūrvamapi brahmaiva sannajñānājjīvatvaṃ prāpto yathoktajñānena tadajñānāpagame brahmaiva prāpnotītyarthaḥ | atrābhidhyānamupāsanam | vyāso'pyetadevābhipretyā''ha -- "na bhinnāṃ pratipadyeta gāyatrīṃ brahmaṇā saha | so'hamasmītyupāsīta vidhinā yena kenacit" iti || smṛtyantare'pi -- "saṃdhyeti sūryagaṃ brahma saṃdhānādividhānataḥ | brahmādyaiḥ sakalairbhūtaiḥ stambāntaiḥ saccidātmanaḥ || tasya dāso'hamasmīti so'hamasmīti vā matiḥ | bhavedupāsakasyeti hyevaṃ vedavido viduḥ" iti || saṃdhyāsvarūpamāha parāśaraḥ -- "ahorātrasya yaḥ saṃdhiḥ sūryanakṣatravarjitaḥ | sā tu saṃdhyā samākhyātā munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ" iti || atra yadyapi kālavācakatvena saṃdhyāśabdaḥ pratīyate tathā'pi tasminkāla upāsyā devatā saṃdhyāśabdenopalakṣyate | tathā ca devatāyā upāsanamupalakṣya parāśaravacane karmaparatvena saṃdhyāśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | athavā saṃdhau bhavā kriyā saṃdhyā | ata eva vyāsaḥ -- "upāste saṃdhivelāyāṃ niśāyā divasasya ca | tāmeva saṃdhyāṃ tasmāttatpravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ" iti || tāmeva kriyāṃ vidadhāti yājñavalkyaḥ -- "saṃdhau saṃdhyāmupāsīta nāstage nodgate ravau" iti | sā ca saṃdhyā trividhā | taduktamatriṇā -- "saṃdhyātrayaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dvijenā''tmavidā sadā" iti | tatra kālabhedena devatāyā nāmādibhedamāha vyāsaḥ -- "gāyatrī nāma pūrvāhṇe sāvitrī dinamadhyake | sarasvatī ca sāyāhne saiva saṃdhyā triṣu smṛtā || pratigrahānnadoṣāttu pātakādupapātakāt | gāyatrī procyate tasmādgāyantaṃ trāyate yataḥ || savitṛdyotanātsaiva sāvitrī parikīrtitā | jagataḥ prasavitrī vā vāgrūpatvātsarasvatī" iti || varṇabhedaḥ smṛtyantare vihitaḥ -- "gāyatrī tu bhavedraktā sāvitrī śuklavarṇikā | sarasvatī tathā kṛṣṇā upāsyā varṇabhedataḥ" iti || tatraiva -- "gāyatrī brahmarūpā tu sāvitrī rudrarūpiṇī | sarasvatī viṣṇurūpā upāsyā rūpabhedataḥ" iti || smṛtyantare -- "udyadādityasaṃkāśāṃ pustakākṣakarāṃ smaret | kumbhājinadharāṃ raktagandhāḍhyāṃ haṃsagāminīm || raktamālyāmbarāṃ devīṃ prātarbrāhmīṃ vicintayet || śvetāṃ śvetāmbarāṃ devīṃ śvetagandhānulepanām | trinetrāṃ varaśūlau ca paraśuṃ cābhayaṃ tathā || vṛṣagāṃ rudraśaktiṃ ca madhyāhne saṃvicintayet | kṛṣṇāṃ kṛṣṇāmbarāṃ devīṃ kṛṣṇagandhānulepanām || śaṅkhacakragadāpadmadharāṃ devīṃ suparṇagām | viṣṇuśaktiṃ tu sāyāhne sarvadā saṃvicintayet" iti || saṃdhyākālanirṇayaḥ | atha kālaḥ | tatra prātaḥsaṃdhyāyāḥ kālaparimāṇamāha dakṣaḥ -- "rātryantyayāmanāḍī dve saṃdhyādiḥ kāla ucyate | darśanādravirekhāyāstadanto munibhiḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || agnismṛtau tūdayātprāgdvimuhūrta uktaḥ -- "saṃdhyākālaḥ prāgudayādviprasya dvimuhūrtakaḥ" iti | etadbahvāhnikakartṛparamiti maheśādayaḥ | dharmasāre -- "uttamā tārakopetā madhyamā luptatārakā | adhamā sūryasahitā prātaḥsaṃdhyā tridhā matā" iti || madhyāhnasaṃdhyāyāḥ kālaparimāṇaṃ tatraiva -- "adhyardhayāmādāsāyaṃ saṃdhyā mādhyāhnikī smṛtā" iti | smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "madhyāhnasnānādūrdhvaṃ yaḥ kālastvavyavadhānataḥ | tatra madhyāhnasaṃdhyā syādūrdhvaṃ gauṇaḥ smṛto budhaiḥ" iti || sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyāḥ kālaparimāṇaṃ dharmasāre -- "uttamā sūryasahitā madhyamā luptatārakā | kaniṣṭhā tārakopetā sāyaṃsaṃdhyā tridhā matā" iti || smṛtyantare -- "prātaḥsaṃdhyāṃ sanakṣatrāṃ madhyamāṃ snānakarmaṇi | sādityāṃ paścimāṃ saṃdhyāmupāsīta yathāvidhi" iti || snānakarmaṇītyatra nirvṛtta iti śeṣaḥ | tena mādhyāhnikasnānānantaramityarthaḥ saṃdhyāyā gauṇakālamāha gobhilaḥ -- "udayāstamayādūrdhvaṃ yāvatsyādghaṭikātrayam | tāvatsaṃdhyāmupāsīta prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ param" iti || atha deśaḥ | vyāsaḥ -- "gṛhe tvekaguṇā saṃdhyā goṣṭhe daśaguṇā smṛtā | śatasāhastrikā nadyāmanantā viṣṇusaṃnidhau | bahiḥ saṃdhyā daśaguṇā gartaprasravaṇeṣu ca | khāte tīrthe śataguṇā hyanantā jāhnavījale" iti || viṣṇuriti śivādīnāmupalakṣaṇam | khāte devakhāte | śātātapaḥ -- "anṛtaṃ madyagandhaṃ ca divāmaithunameva ca | punāti vṛṣalasyānnaṃ bahiḥ saṃdhyā hyupāsitā" iti || yadi viharaṇādyaṅgalopastadā gṛha eva saṃdhyādvayaṃ kāryamityāhātriḥ -- "saṃdhyātrayaṃ tu kartavyaṃ dvijenā''tmavidā sadā | ubhe saṃdhye tu kartavye brāhmaṇādyairgṛhe sadā" iti || yadyapi praśastatvādbahireva saṃdhyātrayaṃ kartavyatvena prāptaṃ tathā'pi śrautatve viharaṇasya prābalyāttadanurodhena sāyaṃprātaḥsaṃdhye gṛhe'bhyanujñāyete | bhāradvājasūtravyākhyātārastu sāyaṃ saṃdhyāyāṃ viśeṣamāhuḥ -- "āhitāgnirgārhapatyasya paścātsāyaṃ saṃdhyāmupāsīta" iti | atha prayogaḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "prākkūleṣu tataḥ sthitvā darbheṣu susamāhitaḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā dhyāyetsaṃdhyāmiti śrutiḥ" iti || smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "baddhvā''sanaṃ niyamyāsūnsmṛtvā carṣyādika tathā | saṃnimīlitadṛṅmaunī prāṇāyāmaṃ samabhyaset" iti || smṛtisāre -- "prāṇānāyamya vidhivadvāgyataḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ | atha saṃdhyāmupāsiṣya iti saṃkalpamācaret" iti || prāṇāyāmātpūrvamācamanamapi kartavyam | taduktaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "ācamyāsūnsamāyamya saṃdhyopāsanamācaret" iti | asūnprāṇān | ācamanaprakāra ukto dharmasūtre -- "āsīnastrirācāmeddhṛdayaṃgamābhiradbhistriroṣṭhau parimṛjeddvirityeke sakṛdupaspṛśeddvirityeke dakṣiṇena pāṇinā savyamabhyukṣya pādau śiraścendriyāṇyupaspṛśeccakṣuṣī nāsike śrotre ca" iti | gautamo'pi -- "śucau deśa āsīno dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ jānvantarā kṛtvā yajñopavītyāmaṇibandhātpāṇiṃ prakṣālayati vāgyato hṛdayaspṛśastriścaturvā'pa ācāmetpādau cābhyukṣetkhāni copaspṛśet" iti | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "antarjānu śucau deśa upaviṣṭa udaṅmukhaḥ | prāgvā brāhmeṇa tīrthena dvijo nityamupaspṛśet" iti || atropasparśa ācamanam | brāhmatīrthasvarūpamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "kaniṣṭhādeśinyaṅguṣṭhamūlānyagraṃ karasya ca | prajāpatipitṛbrahmatīrthānyanukramāt" iti || etadeva śaṅkhalikhitābhyāṃ spaṣṭīkṛtam -- "aṅguṣṭhamūlasyottarataḥ prāgagrāyāṃ lekhāyāṃ brāhmaṃ tīrthaṃ, pradeśinyaṅguṣṭhayorantarā pitryaṃ, kaniṣṭhikātalayorantarā prājāpatyaṃ, pūrveṇāṅguliparvāṇi daivatam" iti | ācamanīyamudakaṃ viśinaṣṭi śaṅkhaḥ -- "adbhiḥ samuddhṛtābhistu hīnābhiḥ phenabudbudaiḥ | vahninā na ca taptābhirakṣārābhirupaspṛśet" iti || yājñavalkyo'pi -- "adbhistu prakṛtisthābhirhīnābhiḥ phenabudbudaiḥ | hṛtkaṇṭhatālugādbhistu yathāsaṃkhyaṃ dvijātayaḥ || śudhyeranstrī ca śūdraśca sakṛtspṛṣṭābhirantataḥ" iti | manurapi -- "hṛdgābhiḥ pūyate vipraḥ kaṇṭhagābhistu bhūmipaḥ | vaiśyo'dbhistālugābhistu śūdraḥ spṛṣṭābhirantataḥ" iti || pracetā api -- "anuṣṇābhiraphenābhiḥ pūtābhirvastracakṣuṣā | hṛdgatābhiraśabdābhistriścaturvā'dbhirācamet" iti || hṛdayaparyantamudakagamanamācamane niyatamanyathocchiṣṭadoṣa ityuktaṃ gobhilagṛhye -- "hṛdayaspṛśastvevāpa ācāmeducchiṣṭo haivāto'nyathā bhavati" iti idamupalakṣaṇaṃ kaṇṭhaparyantatvādīnām | udakasya grahaṇaprakāraṃ parimāṇaṃ cā''ha bhāradvājaḥ -- "āyataṃ parvataḥ kṛtvā gokarṇākṛtivatkaram | saṃhatāṅgulinā toyaṃ gṛhītvā pāṇinā dvijaḥ || muktāṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhena śeṣeṇā''camanaṃ caret | māṣamajjanamātrāstu saṃgṛhya triḥ pibedapaḥ" iti || sa ca pāṇirdakṣiṇo draṣṭavyaḥ -- "triḥ pibeddakṣiṇena tu" iti purāṇavacanāt | ācamane mantraviśeṣamindriyopasparśanaṃ cā''ha bhāradvājaḥ -- "devyāḥ pādaistribhiḥ pītvā khāni paścādupaspṛśet" iti | devyā gāyatryāḥ | atriṇā tu -- "āpo hi ṣṭhādibhirmantraistribhistriḥ prāśanaṃ caret" ityuktam | etaccā''camanaṃ dvivāraṃ kartavyam | taduktaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate -- "home bhojanakāle ca saṃdhyayorubhayorapi | ācāntaḥ punarācāmejjapahomārcanādiṣu" iti || pṛthvīcandrodaye devīnandipurāṇayoḥ -- "dāne pratigrahe home saṃdhyātritayavandane | balikarmaṇi cā''cāmedādau dvirnāntato dvijaḥ" iti | prāṇāyāmalakṣaṇaṃ manurāha -- "praṇavaṃ vyāhṛtīḥ sapta gāyatrīṃ śirasā saha | triḥ paṭhedāyataprāṇaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ sa ucyate" iti || yājñavalkyo'pi -- "gāyatrīṃ śirasā sārdhaṃ japedvyātdṛtipūrvikām | pratipraṇavasaṃyuktāṃ trirayaṃ prāṇasaṃyamaḥ" iti || atra pāṭhajapaśabdābhyāṃ varṇābhidhyānamātraṃ noccāraṇaṃ tasyāsaṃbhavāt | smṛtyantare -- "śanairnāsāpuṭe vāyumutsṛjenna tu vegataḥ | na kampayeccharīraṃ tu sa yogaḥ paramo mataḥ" iti | vyāsaḥ -- "ādānaṃ rodhamutsargaṃ vāyostristriḥ samabhyaset | brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ śaṃbhuṃ dhyāyandevānanukramāt" iti | yogayājñavalkyaḥ -- "pūrakaḥ kumbhako recyaḥ prāṇāyāmastrilakṣaṇaḥ | nāsikādhṛta ucchvāso dhyātaḥ pūraka ucyate | kumbhako niścalaśvāso ricyamānastu recakaḥ" iti | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "dakṣiṇe recakaṃ kuryādvāmenā''pūrya codaram | kumbhakena japaṃ kuryātprāṇāyāmasya lakṣaṇam" iti | dakṣastu -- "vāmena recakaṃ kuryāddakṣenā''pūrya codaram | kumbhakena japaṃ kuryātprāṇāyāmasya lakṣaṇam" ityāha | smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "pañcāṅgulibhirnāsāgraṃ pīḍayetpraṇavena vai | mudreyaṃ sarvapāpaghnī vānaprasthagṛhasthayoḥ | kaniṣṭhānāmikāṅguṣṭhairyateśca brahmacāriṇaḥ" iti | saṃdhyāmupāsiṣya iti pūrvaṃ saṃkalpakaraṇamuktaṃ tatra saṃkalpaprakāro matabhedena trividhaḥ | kaumārilamate tāvatsaṃdhyāvandanādiṣu nityeṣu karmasvadhikāravākyacoditaphalābhāve'pi mantraliṅgārthavādādibahuvākyaparyālocanayopāttaduritakṣaya eva phalatvena parikalpita iti tadanurodhādupāttaduritakṣayārthaṃ prātaḥsaṃdhyāyupāsiṣye jyotiṣṭomena yakṣya ityādirītyā sarveṣu nityakarmasu saṃkalpaḥ | gurumate tu vidhisiddhireva vidheḥ phalamiti coditaphalābhāve'pi vidhisiddhyarthaṃ prātaḥsaṃdhyāmupāsiṣye, jyotiṣṭomena yakṣya ityādirītyā nityeṣu saṃkalpaḥ | śārīrakabhāṣye tu 'janmādyasya yataḥ' iti sūtre yato vetyādiviṣayavākyavyākhyāne brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādeva prapañcajātamutpannaṃ, yathā mṛdaḥ sakāśādutpanno ghaṭaḥ svopādānāṃ mṛdamatyaktvā jīvati pralīyamāno'pi mṛdyeva pralīyate, evaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sakāśājjātaṃ jagadapi brahmātyaktvā jīvati pralīyamānaṃ ca brahmaṇyeva pralīyata ityuktvottaraśāstrasaṃdarbheṇa brahmaṇi samanvayādikaṃ pratipādya brahmārpaṇabuddhyaiva karmāṇi kartavyānītyuktam | etanmate śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ prātaḥsaṃdhyāmupāsiṣye jyotiṣṭomena yakṣya ityādirītyā saṃkalpaḥ | iti saṃkalpaprakāraḥ| tato mārjanam | taduktaṃ prayogapārijāte -- "saṃkalpya mārjanaṃ kuryādāpo hi ṣṭhādibhistribhiḥ" iti | smṛtisaṃgrahe'pi -- "āpo hīti tribhirmantraiḥ śirasyaṃse ca vipruṣaḥ | yasya kṣayāyetyadhastātkṣiptvā'dbhiḥ pariṣecayet || madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhaiḥ kṣepaṇaṃ tu kuśodakaiḥ | rakṣastamomohajātāñjāgratsvapnasuṣuptijān || vāṅmanaḥkāyajāndoṣānnavaitānmārjanaṃ dahet" iti | prajāpatirapi -- "ṛgante mārjanaṃ kuryātpādānte vā samāhitaḥ | ardharcānte'thavā kuryācchiṣṭānāṃ matamīdṛśam" iti | prakārāntaraṃ saṃgrahe -- "sasathatrayamākāśe mastake varavatrayam | bhūmyāṃ proktaṃ natrayaṃ tu etanmārjanalakṣaṇam" iti | varavatrayamastaka iti pāṭhastu asaṃgata eva | kvaciddivi syādvaravatrayamiti dvitīyapādapāṭhaḥ | nānhyā āsīdantarikṣamiti mantre'ntarikṣasya hṛdayajanyatvājjanyajanakayorabhedopacārasvīkāreṇa hṛdayaśabdenā''kāśo'tra gṛhyate | atra nābhiśabdo hṛdayalakṣakaḥ | antarikṣaśabdenā''kāśaḥ | nabho'ntarikṣaṃ gaganamiti kośāt | evaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartatetyatra padbhyāṃ bhūmirityatrāpi cābhedopacārasvīkāreṇa śiraḥpacchabdābhyāṃ krameṇa dyubhūmyorgrahaṇam | etānyakṣarāṇi pādāntapradarśanārthāni | cakṣase | rasaḥ | jinvatha | ityeteṣu pādānteṣu, ākāśe hṛdaye mārjanaṃ kuryāt | mayobhuvaḥ | mātaraḥ | gamāma vaḥ | ityeteṣu pādānteṣu mastake śirasi | dadhātana | iha naḥ | ca naḥ | ityeteṣu pādānteṣu bhūmyāṃ pādayorityarthaḥ | hārītaḥ -- "mārjanārcanabalikarmabhojanāni devatīrthena kuryāt" iti | tacca mārjanaṃ na dhārācyutodakena kāryam | tathā ca brahmā -- "dhārācyutena toyena saṃdhyopāstirvigarhitā | pitaro na praśaṃsanti devatā ṛṣayastathā" iti | kathaṃ tarhi mārjanamiti tatrā''ha sa eva -- "nadyāṃ tīrthe hṛde vā'pi bhājane mṛnmaye'pi vā | audumbare'tha sauvarṇe rājate dārusaṃbhave | kṛtvā tu vāmahaste vā saṃdhyopāstiṃ samācaret" iti | kṛtvetyanantaramudakamiti śeṣaḥ | mṛnmayādipātrasadbhāve tu vāmahastapratiṣedhaḥ -- "vāmahaste jalaṃ kṛtvā ye tu saṃdhyāmupāsate | sā saṃdhyā vṛṣalī jñeyā asurāstaistu tarpitāḥ" iti smaraṇāt | bhājana ityādikaṃ gṛhasaṃdhyāviṣayaṃ na tu nadyādisaṃnidhikartavyasaṃdhyāviṣayam | pūrvamārjanānantaramāpo vā idamityanuvākenābhimantraṇaṃ kurvanti śiṣṭāḥ | vastutastu sarvātmakatvenābhidhyānamātramanena kāryam | tataḥ samantramudakapānaṃ punarmārjanaṃ ca kuryāt | tatrā''ha baudhāyanaḥ -- "athātaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmastīrthaṃ gatvā prayato'bhiṣiktaḥ prakṣālitapāṇipādo'pa ācamyāgniśca mā manyuśceti sāyamapaḥ pītvā sūryaśca mā manyuśceti prātaḥ sapavitreṇa pāṇinā sāvitryā surabhimatyā'bliṅgābhirvāruṇībhirhiraṇyavarṇābhiḥ pāvamānībhirvyāhṛtibhiranyaiśca pavitrairātmānaṃ prokṣya prayato bhavati" iti | bhāradvājaḥ -- "sāyamagniśca metyuktvā prātaḥ sūryetyapaḥ pibet | āpaḥ punantu madhyāhne tataścā''camanaṃ caret" iti | prātaḥ sūryetyatrāpyuktvetyasyānvayaḥ | sūrya itītyapekṣite sūryetīti saṃdhiśchāndasaḥ | kātyāyano'pi -- "śiraso mārjanaṃ kuryātkuśaiḥ sodakabindubhiḥ | praṇavena vyāhṛtibhirgāyatryeti kramāttrayam | abdaivatābhirṛgbhiśca caturthamiti mārjanam" iti | mārjanānantaraṃ prajāpatiḥ -- "uddhṛtya dakṣiṇe haste jalaṃ gokarṇavatkṛte | niḥśvasannāsikāgreṣu pāpmānaṃ puruṣaṃ smaret | ṛtaṃ cetitṛcaṃ vā'pi drupadāṃ vā japedṛcam | dakṣanāsāpuṭenaiva pāpmānamapasārayet | tajjalaṃ nāvalokyātha vāmabhāge kṣitau kṣipet" iti | athārghyadānam | taccā''dityopāsanaṃ kurvankuryāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ -- "udyantamastaṃ yantamādityamabhidhyāyankurvan" iti | etadupāsanameva pradhānam | "saṃdhyāmupāsate ye tu satataṃ saṃśitavratāḥ | vidhūtapāpāste yānti brahmalokaṃ sanātanam" || ityatraiva phalasaṃbandhāvagamāt | ata eva raṇe'rjunādibhiraṅgeṣvasāmarthyātsūryopāsanamātraṃ pradhānamakāri | bhārate -- "te tathaiva mahārāja daṃśitā raṇamūrdhani | saṃdhyāgataṃ sahasrāṃśumādityamupatasthire" iti | arghyadānaṃ pradhānamiti kecit | aṅgamityanye | arghyadānaprakāramāha vyāsaḥ -- "karābhyāṃ toyamādāya gāyatryā cābhimantritam | ādityābhimukhastiṣṭhaṃstrirūrdhvamatha tatkṣipet" iti | atra saṃtata eva pāṭho grāhyaḥ | atha saṃtatāmityatrāthaśabdaḥ prādhānyakhyāpanārthastena saṃdhyopāsanādiṣu tṛtīya eva pāṭho grāhya iti mātṛdattokteḥ | jape'pyevam | dhīmahi dhiya ityanayoḥ sāṃtatye sasvaraḥ saṃdhiḥ | anavānatvamātraṃ vā'sminpāṭhe draṣṭavyam | hikāro'nudāttaḥ | āśvalāyano'pi -- "tatastiṣṭhañjalaṃ gṛhya prāṅmukho'ñjalinā smaran | maṇḍale susthitaṃ tejaḥ sphāṭikajyotiṣā samam | uttīrya tacca saṃprāptaṃ dakṣiṇena pathā'ñjalim | vyāhṛtyādi japenmantraṃ smṛtvaivaṃ parito raveḥ | mandehānyudhyataḥ krūrānnikṣipetteṣvavañjalīn | ṣoḍaśākṣaramantreṇa punarākṛṣya satvaraḥ | punarjalaṃ gṛhītvaivaṃ tejomantraṃ ca saṃsmaran || evaṃ trivāramāvartya dagdhvā tānasurāndvijaḥ | mantreṇā''kṛṣya tattejaḥ sthānādau sthāpayetsmaran || pūrvavadvāmamārgeṇa smṛtvā saṃsthāpya cā''tmani | pradakṣiṇaṃ samāvartya jalaṃ gṛhyā''camettataḥ" iti || sthānādāvādhāramaṇḍape sthitaṃ jyotirnāsādakṣiṇarandhreṇā''dhāramaṇḍapādantarañjalimāgataṃ mandehākhyarākṣasanāśāya toyena saha kṣiptaṃ gāyatrīśirasā nāsāvāmarandhreṇa punarādhāramaṇḍape sthāpayāmīti bhāvayediti sarvatātparyārthaḥ | ṣoḍaśākṣaramantramāha vyāsaḥ -- "ṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ brahma gāyatryāstu śiraḥ smṛtam | omāpo jyotirityeṣa mantro vai taittirīyake" iti || praṇavatvenaikamakṣaram | anyathā ṣoḍaśākṣarakaṃ brahmetyetadvirudhyeteti | athavā suvarityasyaikākṣaratvabhāvanayā ṣoḍaśākṣaratvaṃ draṣṭavyam | jalābhāve rajasā'rghyaṃ deyam -- "jalābhāve mahāmārge bandhane tvaśucāvapi | ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayoḥ kāle rajasā cārghyamutsṛjet" ityagnismṛteḥ | arghyadāne viśeṣaḥ saṃgrahe -- "muktahastena dātavyaṃ mudrāṃ tatra na kārayet | tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayoge tu rākṣasī mudrikā smṛtā || rākṣasīmudrikārghyeṇa tattoyaṃ rudhiraṃ bhavet | jaleṣvarghyaṃ pradātavyaṃ jalābhāve śucisthale || saṃprokṣya vāriṇā samyaktato'rghyaṃ tu pradāpayet | īṣannamraḥ prabhāte vai madhyāhna ṛjurāsthitaḥ || sūryāyārghyāñjalīndadyātsāyaṃ tūpaviśedbhuvi" iti | atha gāyatrījapaḥ | "japannāsīta sāvitrīṃ pratyagā tārakodayāt | saṃdhyāṃ prākprātarevaṃ hi tiṣṭhedā sūryadarśanāt" iti | sāyaṃ pratyaṅmukha āsīna ānakṣatrodayaṃ japet | prātaḥ prāṅmukhastiṣṭhannāsūryodayamityarthaḥ | śaunakaḥ -- "prātastiṣṭhañjapeddevīṃ sāyaṃ caivopaviśya ca | upaviśya tu madhyāhne prāṅmukho japamācaret" iti || tadvidhimāha manuḥ -- "ācamya prayato nityamubhe saṃdhye samāhitaḥ | śucau deśe japañjapyamupāsīta yathāvidhi" iti || kathamityapekṣita āha śaṅkhaḥ -- "kuśabṛsyāṃ samāsīnaḥ kuśottarīyāṃ vā kuśapavitrapāṇiḥ sūryābhimukho devatāṃ dhyāyañjapaṃ kuryāt" iti | āsanānyāha vyāsaḥ -- "kauśeyaṃ kambalaṃ caiva ajinaṃ paṭṭameva ca | dārujaṃ tāḍapatraṃ vā āsanaṃ parikalpayet || kṛṣṇājine jñānasiddhirmokṣaḥ śrīrvyāghracarmaṇi | kuśāsane vyādhināśaḥ sarveṣṭaści(ṣṭaṃ ci)trakambalam || vaṃśāsane tu dāridryaṃ pāpāṇe vyādhireva ca | dharaṇyāṃ tu bhavedduḥkhaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ chidradāruje || tṛṇe dhanayaśohāniḥ pallave cittavibhramaḥ" iti | pracetāḥ -- "gośakṛnmṛnmayaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā pālāśapippalam | lohabaddhaṃ sadaivā''rkaṃ varjayedāsanaṃ budhaḥ" iti | smṛtyantare -- "mṛgacarma prayatnena varjayetputravāngṛhī" iti | purāṇe -- "sāyaṃ prātaḥ samācamya dadyātsūryāya cāñjalim | dattvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā viśudhyati" iti | śrutirapi -- "yatpradakṣiṇaṃ praka(krā)manti tena pāpmānamavadhūnvanti" iti | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe -- "asāvādityo brahmeti pradakṣiṇaṃ parikrāmanpariṣiñcet " iti | upaveśanamantra ukto gāyatrīkalpe -- "pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ devi pavitraṃ kuru cā''sanam" iti | ṛṣyādyāha vyāsaḥ -- "pṛthivyā merupṛṣṭhaṃ tu ṛṣirityabhidhīyate | kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ devatā tu sutalaṃ chanda īritam | āsanārohaṇe tasya viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ" iti || gṛhyapariśiṣṭe -- "śucau deśe darbhāmbhasokṣite darbhānsaṃstīrya vyāhṛtibhirupaviśya prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā''tmānaṃ vyātdṛtībhirabhyukṣya sāvitryā ṛṣidaivatacchandāṃsyanusmṛtya ṣaḍbhistadaṅgamantrairyathāṅgamātmani vinyasyā''tmānaṃ tadrūpaṃ bhāvayet | tatsaviturhṛdayāya nama iti hṛdaye, vareṇyaṃ śirase svāheti śirasi, bhargo devasya śikhāyai vaṣaḍiti śikhāyāṃ, dhīmahi kavacāya humityurasi, dhiyo yo no netratrayāya vauṣaḍiti netralalāṭeṣu vinyasya, pracodayādastrāya phaḍiti karatale'straṃ prācyādiṣu daśasu nyasedeṣo'ṅganyāsa etameke necchanti sa hi vidhiravaidikaḥ" iti | atrā''sanopaveśanavidhipradarśanātpūrvatra tūṣṇīmeva darbhāsana upaveśanamiti gamyate | gāyatrīkalpe tu -- "vinyasyaivaṃ ṣaḍaṅgeṣu ṛṣyādīnsaṃsmarettataḥ" ityuktam | bṛhatparāśarasmṛtyādiṣu tu praṇavasaptavyāhṛtivargakukṣipādavarṇadevatānyāsādikamapyuktamasti tattatraiva draṣṭavyaṃ vistarabhītyā nocyate | tata āvāhanam | "āyātvityādibhirmantrairdevīmāvāhayettataḥ" iti pāṭhakramādapyatraivā''vāhanam | jape gāyatrī praṇavavyāhṛtiyutā jñeyā | tathā ca vyāsaḥ -- "praṇavavyāhṛtiyutāṃ gāyatrīṃ prajapettataḥ" iti | japasaṃkhyāmāha yogayājñavalkyaḥ -- "brahmacāryāhitāgniśca śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japet | vānaprastho yatiścaiva sahasrādadhikaṃ japet || sāyaṃ prātaśca madhyāhne sāvitrīṃ vāgyato japet | sahasraparamāṃ devīṃ śatamadhyāṃ daśāvarām | gāyatrīṃ prajapeddhīmānsarvapāpapraṇāśinīm" iti || baudhāyano'pi -- "darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇaḥ sodakena pāṇinā pratyaṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayedaparimitakṛtvaḥ prāṇāyāmaśo vā śatakṛtva ubhayataḥpraṇavāṃ sasaptavyāhṛtikāṃ manasā vā daśakṛtvaḥ" iti | prātaḥsaṃdhyāyāṃ viśeṣa uktastenaiva -- "evameva prātaḥ prāktiṣṭhan" iti | prāṇāyāmaśaḥ prāṇāyāmaprakāreṇa | tameva prakāramāha -- ubhayataḥpraṇavāmityādinā | ayaṃ ca prakāro baudhāyanīyānāmeva na satyāṣāḍhasūtrānusāriṇāṃ jñāpakasiddhasyopanayanopadiṣṭatṛtīyapāṭhasyaiva tairgrahītumucitatvāt | uktasaṃkhyāta ādhikyamevāparimitaśabdārthaḥ | na tu tato nyūnatvamapi | "aparimitaṃ pramāṇādbhūyaḥ" iti kātyāyanenādhikasyaivāparimitaśabdārthatvokteḥ | vyāsaḥ -- "aṣṭottaraśataṃ nityamaṣṭāviṃśatimeva vā | vidhinā daśakaṃ vā'pi trikālaṃ prajapedbudhaḥ" iti || nāradaḥ -- "sarvatraiva pradoṣeṣu gāyatrīmaṣṭasaṃkhyayā | aṣṭāviṃśatyanadhyāye japennāṣṭottaraṃ śatam" iti || sumantuḥ -- "aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ nityādardhaṃ japetsudhīḥ || pratipatsu turīyāṃśaṃ parvaṇyalpataraṃ japet" iti || japamāloktā smṛtyantare -- "parvabhistu japeddevīṃ mālā kāmyajape smṛtā | gāyatryā vedamūlatvādvedaḥ parvasu gīyate || ārabhyānāmikāmadhyaṃ parva devīmanukramāt | tarjanīmūlaparyantaṃ japeddaśasu parvasu | madhyamāṅgulimūle tu yatparvadvitayaṃ bhavet | taṃ vai meruṃ vijānīyājjape taṃ nātilaṅghayet" iti | agastyasaṃhitāyām -- "kaniṣṭhā'nāmikā madhyā caturthī tarjanī matā | tisro'ṅgulyastriparvāḥ syurmadhyamā tvekaparvikā | parvabhistu japaḥ kāryo nāṅgulīnāṃ nipātanaiḥ | madhyamādyadvayaṃ parva japakāle vivarjayet | etanmeruṃ vijānīyātkaramālājape budhaiḥ" iti || smṛtyantare tu -- "ārabhyānāmikāmūlātprādakṣiṇyena vai kramāt | madhyamāmūlaparyantaṃ japeddaśasu parvasu" ityuktam || japastrividhaḥ | nṛsiṃhapurāṇe -- "trividho japayajñaḥ syāttasya bhedaṃ nibodhata | vācikaśca upāṃśuśca mānasastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ | trayāṇāṃ japayajñānāṃ śreyānsyāduttarottaram" iti || vācikopāṃśutvayorlakṣaṇaṃ purāṇe'bhihitam -- "yaduccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ | mantramuccārayedvācā vāciko'yaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥ || śanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau pracālayet | aparairaśrutaḥ kiṃcitsa upāṃśujapaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || viśvāmitreṇa mānasasya lakṣaṇamuktam -- "dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇyā varṇādvarṇaṃ padātpadam | śabdārthacintanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathyate mānaso japaḥ" iti || trayāṇāṃ tāratamyaṃ ca tenaivoktam -- "uttamaṃ mānasaṃ jāpyamupāṃśu madhyamaṃ smṛtam | adhamaṃ vācikaṃ prāhuḥ sarvamantreṣu vai dvijaḥ(dvijāḥ) || vācikasyaikamekaṃ syādupāṃśu śatamucyate | sahasraṃ mānasaṃ proktaṃ manvatribhṛgunāradaiḥ" iti || (mānasajapasya phalamuktaṃ nṛsiṃhapurāṇe -- mānasaṃ japaṃ prakṛtya, "anena devatā nityaṃ stūyamānā prasīdati | prasannā vipulānbhogāndadyānmuktiṃ ca śāśvatīm" iti ||) smṛtyantare -- "caturviṃśatyakṣarāṃ tu gāyatrīṃ prajapantdṛdi | sarvānvarṇānabhidhyāyeddevatāmarthameva ca" iti | akṣaraśabdaḥ svareṣu vartate | tatra yadyapi svarāstrayoviṃśatireva gāyatrīmantre vartante tathā'pi ṇyamityatra bhāvanayā ṇiyamiti svaradvayaṃ jñeyam | uktaṃ ca piṅgalena -- "iyādipūraṇaḥ" iti | pāda ityanuvartate | iyādiḥ pūraṇo yasya sa iyādipūraṇaḥ | ādiśabdenovādayo gṛhyante | tatrāyamarthaḥ -- yatra gāyatryādau chandasi pādasyākṣarasaṃkhyā na pūryate tatreyādibhiḥ sā pūrayitavyā | yathā tatsaviturvareṇiyaṃ divaṃ gaccha suvaḥ patetyevamādaya iti halāyudhena vyākhyātam | "ghṛṇiriti dve akṣare | sūrya iti trīṇi | āditya iti trīṇi | etadvai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ pada śriyā'bhiṣiktam" | iti śrutirapi sādhikā'treti jñeyam | jape niyamamāha śaunakaḥ -- "kṛtvottānau karau prātaḥ sāyaṃ cādhomukhau tataḥ | madhye saṃmukhahastābhyāṃ japa evamudāhṛtaḥ" iti | smṛtyantare -- "hastau nābhisamau dhṛtvā prātaḥ saṃdhyājapaṃ caret | tdṛtsamau tu karau madhye sāyaṃ mukhasamau karau" iti | vṛddhamanuḥ -- "vastreṇā''cchādya tu karaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ yaḥ sadā japet | tasya tatsaphalaṃ japyaṃ taddhīnamaphalaṃ smṛtam" iti | ācchādana ārdravastraniṣedhaḥ smṛtyantare -- "ācchādyā''rdreṇa vastreṇa karaṃ yastu japedyadi | niṣphalaḥ syāttasya japo devatā na prasīdati" iti | vyāsaḥ -- "manaḥsaṃtoṣaṇaṃ śaucaṃ maunaṃ mantrārthacintanam | avyagratvamanirvedo japasaṃpattihetavaḥ" iti | mantrārtha ukto bṛhatparāśareṇa -- "tacchuddhaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotistadyadātmavido viduḥ | devasya saviturbhargo varaṇīyaṃ ca dhīmahi | tadasmākaṃ dhiyo yastu brahmatve ca pracodayāt" iti | tatsaviturjagatkāraṇasya śrīsūryasya vareṇyaṃ varaṇīyam | vṛña eṇyaḥ | bhargastejaḥ | andhakārabharjanāt | "avyañjiyujibhṛjibhyaḥ kuśca" iti bhṛjerasun | dhīmahi dhyāyema | yo no dhiyo'smākaṃ buddhīḥ pracodayātsvarūpe prerayet, prerayatītyarthaḥ | ityevaṃ gāyatrīmantrārthasya cintanaṃ manasā'nusaṃdhānaṃ kāryam | śabdasyāpyevam | uttamaṃ mānasaṃ jāpyamityanantarodāhṛtaviśvāmitrokteḥ | baudhāyanaḥ -- "nābheradhastātsaṃsparśaṃ karmayukto vivarjayet" iti | atriḥ -- "na ca kāmanna ca hasanna pārśvamavalokayan | nāpāśrito na jalpaṃśca na prāvṛtaśirāstathā || na padā pādamākramya na caiva hi tathā karau | na cāsamāhitamanā na ca saṃśrāvayañjapet" iti || vyāsaḥ -- "japakāle na bhāṣeta vratahomādikeṣu ca | eteṣvevāvasaktastu yathā gacchandvijottamaḥ || abhivādya tato vipraṃ yogaṃ kṣemaṃ ca kīrtayet" iti | yathā gamanavelāyāṃ tanmanaskaḥ sanneva gacchati tadvajjapādiṣvapi tanmanaska eva bhavedityarthaḥ | vipramabhivādya tena vipreṇa yogaṃ kṣemaṃ ca kīrtayedityarthaḥ | alabdhalābho yogaḥ | labdhasya rakṣaṇaṃ kṣemaḥ | yogayājñavalkyaḥ -- "yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syājjapādiṣu kadācana | vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam" iti | saṃvartaḥ -- "lokavārtādikaṃ śrutvā śrutvā tu paruṣaṃ vacaḥ | saṃkhyāṃ vinā ca yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet" iti | saṃkhyāṃ vinā gaṇanāṃ vinetyarthaḥ | aparimitatvapakṣe'pi gaṇanā kartavyaivānyathā japasya niṣphalatvāpatteḥ | tathā ca gautamaḥ -- gacchatastiṣṭhato vā'pi svecchayā karma kurvataḥ | aśucervā vinā saṃkhyāṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet" iti | bṛhatparāśaro'pi -- "asaṃkhyamāsuraṃ yasmāttasmāttadgaṇayeddhruvam" iti | gautamaḥ -- "krodhaṃ mohaṃ kṣutaṃ nidrāṃ niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe | darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi || ācāmetsaṃbhave caiṣāṃ smaredviṣṇuṃ surārcitam | jyotīṃṣi ca praśaṃsedvā kuryādvā prāṇasaṃyamān || jvalanaṃ gāśca viprāṃśca yatīnvā'pi viśuddhaye" iti | paśyediti śeṣaḥ | saṃgrahe -- "svaravarṇapadairvākyaiḥ śuddhamāvartayejjapam | na kampayecchiro grīvāṃ dantānnaiva prakāśayet || saṃspṛśeyurna cānyonyaṃ dīkṣitā jāpakā dvijāḥ | taireva bhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā prāṇāyāmaṃ samācaret || pādaprasāraṇaṃ vārtā bhūlekhanavijṛmbhaṇe | jihvāprasāraṇaṃ vāsonakhacchedanatāḍane || kṣutaniṣṭhīvane gātracālanaṃ keśabandhanam | śikhāvimokṣaṇaṃ caiva keśānāṃ caiva mārjanam || ākrandanaṃ paryaṭanaṃ tṛṇasūtrādibandhanam | adharaspandanaṃ dantagharṣaṇaṃ dehakampanam || āsphoṭanaṃ prahasanaṃ śayanaṃ parivīkṣaṇam | yūkānveṣaṇamaṅgulyā mukhavāyuprapūraṇam || śiraḥpracchādanaṃ śilpakaraṇaṃ coṣṭhacarvaṇam | bhavanti karmāṇyetāni yadi cetaḥpramādataḥ || prakṣālya caraṇau hastāvācamya ca yathāvidhi | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā savitāraṃ vilokya ca || namaskṛtya tato dhīmāñjapaśeṣaṃ samāpayet" iti | deśaniyamastu yogayājñavalkyenoktaḥ -- "agnyagāre jalānte vā japeddevālaye'pi vā | puṇyatīrthe gavāṃ goṣṭhe dvinakṣetre'thavā gṛhe" iti | śaṅkho'pi -- "gṛhe tvekaguṇaṃ japyaṃ nadyāṃ tu dviguṇaṃ smṛtam | gavāṃ goṣṭhe daśaguṇamagnyagāre śatādhikam || siddhatīrtheṣu kṣetreṣu devatāyāśca saṃnidhau | sahasraṃ śatakoṭīnāmanantaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau" iti | atra nadyāmiti padaṃ tīre lākṣaṇikaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra gaṅgāpadamiva | samīpasaptamī vā | ārdravāsoviṣayaṃ vā | "yadi syāklinnavastro vai gāyatrīmudake japet | anyathā tu śucau bhūmyāṃ kuśopari samāhitaḥ" iti yamokteḥ | kūrmapurāṇe'pi -- "guhyakā rākṣasāḥ siddhā haranti prasabhaṃ yataḥ | ekānte tu śubhe deśe tasmājjapyaṃ sadā''caret" iti | gāyatrījapaṃ praśaṃsati vyāsaḥ -- "daśakṛtvaḥ prajaptā sā tryahādyacca kṛtaṃ laghu | tatpāpaṃ nāśayatyāśu nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || śatajaptā tu sā devī pāpaughaśamanī smṛtā | sahasrajaptā sā devī upapātakanāśinī || lakṣajapyena ca tathā mahāpātakanāśinī | koṭijāpyena rājendra yadicchati tadāpnuyāt" iti || yamo'pi -- "gāyatryā na paraṃ jāpyaṃ gāyatryā na paraṃ tapaḥ | gāyatryā na paraṃ dhyānaṃ gāyatryā na paraṃ hutam" iti || manurapi -- "yo'dhīte'hanyahanyetāṃ trīṇi varṣāṇyatīndriyaḥ | sa brahma paramapyeti vāyubhūtaśca mūrtimān" iti || gautamo'pi -- "anena vidhinā nityaṃ japaṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ | prasanno vipulānbhogānbhuktvā muktiṃ ca vindati" iti || japasamāptau japanivedanamuktamācārapradīpe -- "prātaḥsaṃdhyāprayuktena gāyatrījapanena ca | adhyaṣṭaśatajapyena brahmātmā prīyatāṃ raviḥ" iti | evaṃ madhyāhnasaṃdhyāprayuktajape prātarbrahmapadayoḥ sthāne madhyarudraśabdohena, sāyaṃsaṃdhyāprayuktajape tu sāyaṃviṣṇuśabdohena | jaṭamallagranthe tu tathāvidhamantrāveva pradarśitau | tato gāyatrīṃ visarjayet | taduktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "uttame śikhara iti devīṃ japtvā visarjayet" iti | athopasthānam | tatra baudhāyanaḥ -- "brahmatdṛdayena vāruṇībhyāṃ rātrimupatiṣṭhata imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmīti dvābhyāmeva prātaḥ prāktiṣṭhanmaitrībhyāmaharupatiṣṭhate mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto mitro janānyātayati prajānanniti dvābhyām" iti | brahmahṛdayaṃ praṇavaḥ | prātaḥsaṃdhyopasthānaṃ kūrmapurāṇe'pi -- "athopatiṣṭhedādityamudaye su samāhitaḥ | mantraistu vividhairmaitrairṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃbhavaiḥ" iti | maitrairmitradevatyaiḥ | mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛta ityādibhirityarthaḥ | madhyāhnasaṃdhyopasthānaṃ brahmapurāṇe -- "prakṣipya cāñjaliṃ samyagudu tyaṃ citramityapi | taccakṣurdeva iti ca haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityapi | etajjapedūrdhvabāhuḥ sūryaṃ paśyansamāhitaḥ" iti | baudhāyanena tu gāyatrījapānantaramevopasthānamatrāpyuktam -- "apa ācamya darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ sāvitrīṃ sahasrakṛtva āvartayecchatakṛtvo'parimitakṛtvo vā bhojyaṃ ca vāmataḥ | saṃsthāpya odano madhye dakṣiṇe ghṛtapāyasam || odanasyāparārdhe tu dadyādupari sūpakam" iti | sūpakaṃ sūpam | svārthe kaḥ | balidānākaraṇaprāyaścittamāha jātūkarṇyaḥ -- "akṛtvā yaścitrabaliṃ bhuṅkte viprastvanāpadi | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet" iti | bhojanādau baliṃ muktaṃ samuddhāryaiva bhojanam | anuddhārya tu yo bhuṅkte prāṇāyāmāṣṭakaṃ caret" iti | samuddhāryeti ṇicprayogādanyakartṛkamuddharaṇam | na svakartṛkamiti gamyate | apośā(āpośa)nākaraṇaprāyaścittamāha saṃvartaḥ -- "apośā(āpośa)namakṛtvā tu bhuṅkte yo'nāpadi dvijaḥ | bhuñjānastu yadā || prayogadarpaṇe smṛtyantare tu -- "yadi bhojanakāle tu brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇaṃ spṛśet | tadannamatyajanbhuktvā gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet" ityuktam | yajñopavītaṃ vinā bhojane laghuhārītaḥ -- "vinā yajñopavītena bhuṅkte tu brāhmaṇo yadi | snānaṃ kṛtvā japaṃ caiva upavāsena śudhyati" iti | japo gāyatryāḥ | idaṃ ca jñānataḥ | ajñānatastu -- "brahmasūtraṃ vinā bhuṅkte brāhmaṇo yadyakāmataḥ | gāyatryaṣṭasahasreṇa prāṇāyāmena śudhyati" | iti saṃvartoktaṃ draṣṭavyam | aṣṭasahasramaṣṭottarasahasram | (smṛtyantare -- ) "nīlīkṣetrotpannānnādibhuktau cāndram | nīlīṃ dhṛtvā yadannādi dīyate tatra bhojanakāle retomūtrapurīṣotsarge brahmapurāṇe -- "retomūtrapurīṣāṇāmutsargaścetpramādataḥ | tadādau tu prakartavyā tena śuddhirmudā'mbubhiḥ | paścādācamya tu jale japtavyamaghamarṣaṇam" iti | etadanigīrṇagrāsaviṣayam | sakṛnnigīrṇagrāse tu, āpastambaḥ -- "bhuñjānasya tu viprasya kadācitsravate gudam | ucchiṣṭamaśucitvaṃ ca prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet | ādau kṛtvā tu vai śaucaṃ tataḥ paścādupaspṛśet | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti | yattu śātātapaḥ -- "kṛtvā mūtraviḍutsargaṃ mohādbhuṅkte'thavā pibet | trirātraṃ tatra kurvīta prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ tataḥ" iti | tadbhūyo grāsāśane | trirātramityanantaramupoṣaṇamiti śeṣaḥ | viḍutsargaḥ purīṣotsargaḥ | bhojanakāle'śucitāyāṃ śātātapaḥ -- "atha bhojanakāle cedaśucirbhavati dvijaḥ | bhūmau nikṣipya taṃ grāsaṃ snātvā vipro viśudhyati | bhakṣayitvā tu taṃ grāsamahorātreṇa śudhyati | aśitvā sarvamannaṃ tu trirātreṇa viśudhyati" iti | (etatsarvaṃ prāṇāhutyuttaraṃ jñeyam | duṣṭānnāśane brahmapurāṇe -- "bhakṣyaṃ etaccākāmataḥ | kāmatastu śaṅkhaḥ -- "vāgduṣṭaṃ bhāvaduṣṭaṃ ca bhājane bhāvadūṣite | bhuktvā'nnaṃ tu dvijaḥ paścātrirātraṃ tu vratī bhavet" iti | vratamatra yāvakam |) saṃvartaḥ -- "keśakīṭāvapannaṃ siddhānne keśakīṭādipāte tu pracetāḥ -- "annaṃ bhojanakāle tu makṣikākeśadūṣitam | anantaraṃ spṛśedāpastadannaṃ bhasmanā spṛśet" iti | brāhme'pi -- "caṇḍālapatitāmedhyaiḥ kunagvaiḥ kuṣṭhibhistathā | brahmaghnasūtikodakyākauleyakakuṭumbibhiḥ | du(vyu)ṣṭaṃ vā keśakīṭāktaṃ mṛdbhasmakanakāmbubhiḥ | śuddhamadyātsatdṛllekhaṃ praduṣṭaṃ duṣṭameva ca" iti | kauleyakaḥ śvā | kuṭumbī kīṭaviśeṣaḥ | vyuṣṭaṃ viśeṣaṇadānenāgnyādhānādīnāṃ sthālīpākānāṃ ca vyāvṛttiḥ kriyate | teṣāṃ hi kevalaṃ pratyavāyamātranivartakatvaṃ na tu dvijatvaniṣpādakatvam | kecidācāryāḥ 'mūkonmattau na saṃskāryau' iti vadanti | upanayanādyairiti śeṣaḥ | teṣāmadhyayanāsaṃbhavenādhyayanārthasyopanayanasyābhāvāt | upanayanavatkāṇḍavratādīnāmapyabhāvaḥ | unmatta unmādavānvikṣiptacitta iti yāvat | etayormūkonmattayoḥ karmasūpanayanādikarmasvanadhikārādadhikārābhāvāt | cakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | karmasvadhikārābhāvādeva pātityaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | dvitīyaścakāraḥ samuccayārthaḥ | upanayanādikarmāṇi na santi pātityaṃ ca nāstītyevaṃ samuccayaḥ | mūkonmattayoḥ karmasvanadhikārātpātityamiti nāsti kiṃtu'brāhmaṇyāṃ brāhmaṇājjāto brāhmaṇaḥ saḥ' iti śrutyā brāhmaṇādutpannayormūkonmattayorapyupanayanādisaṃskārārhatvapratipādanāttāvapi saṃskāryau tadapatyaṃ ca saṃskāryamityapare | anyathā 'na saṃskāryo' iti kaiścidācāryairuktaṃ tadviparītametādṛśamarthamāhuḥ | 'saṃskāramantrahomādīnkarotyācārya eva tu' ityatra kumāraṃ spṛṣṭveti śeṣaḥ | saṃskāramantrāḥ ku(ntrānku)mārakartṛkasaṃskāramantrapaṭhanaṃ homādikarmāṇi cā''cārya eva kuryāt | upanayane kumārakartṛkahomābhāvāddhomaśabdena samidabhyādhānaṃ gṛhyate | ādiśabdena mārjanopasthānādikāṇḍavratānāṃ lopa eva | teṣāmadhyayanāṅgatvāt | na caivamupanayanasyāpyadhyayanārthatvānmūkonmattaviṣaye lopo'stviti vācyam | tasya dvijatvasaṃpādanadvārā'dhyayanārthatvenādhyayanāsaṃbhave'pi dvijatvasaṃpādanāyāvaśyamapekṣitatvāt | evaṃ godānamapi bhavatyeva | tasyādhyayanāṅgatvābhāvāt | vivāhasaṃbhave samāvartanamapi kaṃcitkālaṃ vratācaraṇaṃ kṛtvottarāyaṇe kāryam | vidyāsnānobhayasnānayorabhāvādvratasnānameva tayoḥ | vivāhāsaṃbhave tu tasya naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryameva | kalau yo naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryaniṣedhaḥ sa mūkonmattatvadoṣarahitapuruṣaparaḥ | 'upaneyāṃstu vidhivadācāryaḥ svasamīpataḥ' ityasyārthaḥ -- upaneyānpūrvoktaṣaṇḍhādīnvidhivatsvagṛhyoktaprakāreṇā''cāryaḥ svasamīpataḥ svābhimukhānkuryāditi | 'ānīyāgnisamīpaṃ vā sāvitrīṃ spṛśya vā japet' ityasyārthaḥ -- agnisamīpaṃ vā'gnyabhimukhānvā kuryāt | pūrvatrā''cāryaḥ svābhimukhānkuryādityuktaṃ tatredaṃ pakṣāntaram | 'sāvitrīṃ spṛśya vā japet' ityatratyo vāśabdaḥ prasiddhena sāvitrīvācanena saha vikalpārthaḥ | sa ca yogyatānusāreṇa vyavasthito jñeyaḥ | kumārasya mūkatve sparśapūrvakaḥ sāvitrījapaḥ | unmattatve yadi paṭhati tadā vācanaṃ no cetspṛṣṭvā japa iti | ṣaṇḍhatvāndhatvādau tu vācanamiti vyavasthā | sāvitrīṃ spṛśya vā japedityatra spṛśya vā sāvitrīṃ japedityanvayaḥ | spṛśyetyatra kumāramiti śeṣaḥ | spṛśyetyatra samāsābhāve'pi ktvolyabādeśaśchāndasaḥ | evaṃ kumārakartṛkasaṃskāramantrapaṭhanavidhitadīyahomādikaraṇavidhī vyavasthitau jñeyau | pūrvavidhiḥ kumārasya mūkatve jñeyaḥ | uttaravidhistu kumārasyāṅgavaikalye | unmattatve pūrvavat | upaneyāṃstu vidhivadityādyagnisamīpaṃ vetyantaṃ sarveṣu samānam | mūkabadhirādau ko nāmāsīti nāmapraśno'pi nāstyayogyatvānna nāma pṛcchatīti bodhāyanokteśca | anyadaṅgajātaṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ kāryam | mūkonmattayorupanayane'sya dvijatvasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthamācāryapaitṛkasāvitrīmātṛkamupanayanākhyasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpavākyam | iti vikalāṅgopanayanam| atha punarupanayanam | tacca trividham | pratyavāyanimittaprāyaścittatvena vihitaṃ nimittaviśeṣeṇa kṛtopanayanasya vṛthāceṣṭātvāpattau tatphalārthatvena vihitaṃ vedāntarādhyayanacikīrṣāyāṃ tadarthatvena vihitaṃ ca | tatrā''dyaṃ prayogapārijāte śātātapaḥ -- "laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ jagdhvā palāṇḍuṃ ca tathā śunam | upanāyaṃ punaḥ kuryāttaptakṛcchraṃ tathaiva ca" iti || laśunaḥ prasiddhaḥ | (sa ca śveta eva niṣiddhaḥ | tathā ca parāśaraḥ -- "pīyūṣaṃ śvetalaśunaṃ vṛntākaphalagṛñjane" iti | śvetapadaṃ laśunavṛntākābhyāmapi saṃbadhyate | tena raktalaśunakṛṣṇavṛntākabhakṣaṇe na prāyaścittamiti mādhavaḥ |) gṛñjanaṃ laśunatulyaḥ kanda iti vijñāneśvaraḥ | yadīyaṃ cūrṇaṃ gāyakāḥ kaṇṭhaśuddhyai viṭāśca madārthamaśnanti sa patraviśeṣa iti mādhavaḥ| (mādhavīye śrāddhaprakaraṇe tu -- "śvetakandaḥ palāṇḍuviśeṣo gṛñjanam | 'laśuno dīrghapatraśca piṣṭagandho mahauṣadhaḥ || pharaṇyaśca palāṇḍuśca latārkaśca parārikā | gṛñjano yavaneṣṭaśca palāṇḍordaśa jātayaḥ' | iti suśrutenoktatvāt" ityuktam | mūlaviśeṣo vā gājarāparaparyāya ityapi mādhavenoktam | "gandhākṛtirasaistutyaḥ sūkṣmanālaḥ palāṇḍunā | sūkṣmanālāgrapatratvādbhidyate'sau palāṇḍutaḥ" | iti vāgbhaṭṭaṭīkāyāṃ hemādrau bāṣpacandravacanameva vinigamakaṃ tviha paribhāvanīyam | paraṃ tu gājarāparaparyāyatā vakṣyamāṇenaiva dūṣitā draṣṭavyā | hemādrāvapyuttaratra palāṇḍuviśeṣa evetyuktam | rājanighaṇṭau -- "rasebho hi mahākando gṛñjano dīrghapatrakaḥ | pṛthupatraḥ sthūlakando yavaneṣṭo balo hitaḥ || gṛñjanasya madhuraṃ kaṭukandaṃ nālamapyupadiśanti kaṣāyam | patrataśca yamuśanti ca tiktaṃ sūrayo lavaṇamasthi vadanti || gājaraṃ piṇḍamūlaṃ ca pītakandaḥ samūlakam | svādumūlaṃ supītaṃ ca nāgaraṃ pītamūlakam || gājaraṃ madhuraṃ rucyaṃ kiṃcitkaṭu kaphāpaham | ādhmānakṛmiśūlaghnaṃ dāhapittavināśanam" iti || vaidyake -- "gṛñjanaṃ śikhimūlaṃ ca yavaneṣṭaśca vartulam | granthimūlaṃ śikhākandaṃ kandaṃ ḍiṇḍīramodakam || gṛñjanaṃ kaṭu uṣṇaṃ ca kaphavātarujāpaham | rucyaṃ ca dīpanaṃ hṛdyaṃ durgandhi gulmanāśanam" iti ||) "viṣadagdhena śalyena yo mṛgaḥ parihanyate | abhakṣyaṃ tasya tanmāṃsaṃ taddhi gṛñjanamiṣyate" ityaparārkaḥ | yattu hemādriḥ -- gājarākhyaṃ mūlaṃ gṛñjanamityāha, yacca mādhavaḥ -- mūlaviśeṣo gājarāparaparyāyo gṛñjanamityāha, tadubhayamapi na | "gṛñjanaṃ cukrikāṃ cukraṃ gājaraṃ potikāṃ tathā" || iti brāhme pṛthaṅnirdeśānupapatteḥ | cukrikā 'cukkā' iti bhāṣayā prasiddhā | cukramatyamlaṃ dadhi | potikā 'poī' iti prasiddhā | etacca punarupanayanaṃ buddhyā bhakṣaṇe | abuddhyā bhakṣaṇe tu taptakṛcchramātram | "chatrākaṃ laśunaṃ caiva palāṇḍuṃ gṛñjanaṃ tathā | catvāryajñānato jagdhvā taptakṛcchraṃ careddvijaḥ" iti bṛhaspatyukteḥ | palāṇḍvādyekanāśyaroge tu naiṣa doṣaḥ | tathā ca palāṇḍvādyanuvṛttau sumantuḥ -- "etānyevā''turasya bhiṣakkriyāyāmapratiṣiddhāni" iti | gautamaḥ -- "uṣṭrīkṣīramānuṣīkṣīraprāśane punarupanayanaṃ taptakṛcchraṃ ca" iti | prāśanābhyāsa etaditi śūlapāṇiḥ | (avikharoṣṭrīkṣīraprāśane punarupanayanaṃ taptakacchraṃ ceti) | smṛtyantare -- "retomūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ gauḍīmādhvyośca bhakṣaṇe | kravyādapaśuviṣṭhānāṃ saṃskārācchuddhiriṣyate" iti | manuḥ -- "ajñānātprāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃsṛṣṭameva ca | punaḥsaṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ" iti || etadatītasurāsaṃparkaviṣayam | taptakṛcchrapūrvakaścaiṣa vidhirjñeyaḥ | taptakṛcchrapūrvakaṃ punaḥsaṃskāraṃ prakṛtya 'mūtrapurīṣakuṇaparetasāṃ prāśane caivam' iti gautamokteḥ | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "retomūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ śuddhyai cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" iti | retomūtrapurīṣāṇāmityanantaraṃ prāśana iti śeṣaḥ | atra cāndrāyaṇataptakṛcchrayorjñānājñānābhyāṃ vyavasthā jñeyā | saṃskārastūbhayatra tulya eveti śūlapāṇiḥ | pādme -- "pretaśayyāpratigrāhī punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" iti | smṛtyantare -- "sindhusauvīrasaurāṣṭrāṃstathā pratyantavāsinaḥ | aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgāṃśca gatvā saṃskāramarhati" iti | etacca tīrthayātrāṃ vinā gamane | "tīrthayātrāṃ vinā gatvā punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" iti baudhāyanokteḥ | mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- "kharamāruhya viprastu yojanaṃ yadi gacchati | taptakṛcchratrayaṃ proktaṃ śarīrasya viśodhanam || punarjanma prakurvīta ghṛtagarbhavidhānataḥ | jātakarmādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt" iti || śākalaḥ -- "yadi cedvai dvijo gacchedāruhyoṣṭraṃ kharaṃ vṛṣam | punastasya kriyāḥ kāryāḥ śikhāyā vāpanena ca || ādau tu vidhinā tryabdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret" iti | hemādrau prāyaścittakāṇḍe vṛddhagautamaḥ -- "kharamuṣṭraṃ ca mahiṣamanaḍvāhamaviṃ tathā || bastamāruhya mukhaje krośe cāndraṃ vinirdiśet" iti || mukhajo vipraḥ | cāndraṃ cāndrāyaṇam | manuḥ -- "cāṇḍālānnaṃ dvijo bhuktvā samyakcāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | buddhipūrve tu kṛcchrābdaṃ punaḥsaṃskārameva ca" iti || abhyāsaviṣayametaditi madanaratne | parāśaraḥ -- "yaḥ pratyavasito vipraḥ pravrajyāto vinirgataḥ | anāśakanivṛttaśca gārhasthyaṃ ceccikīrṣati || sa carettrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi trīṇi cāndrāyaṇāni ca | jātakarmādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ saṃskāraiḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt" iti || bhāradvājīyapitṛmedhasūtre -- "yadyetasminkṛta āgate ghṛtakumbhādunmagnasya jātakarmaprabhṛti dvādaśarātraṃ vrataṃ caritvā tayaiva jāyayā'gnīnādadhīta vrātyena paśunā vā yajeta giriṃ gatvā'gnaye kāmāyeṣṭiṃ nirvapedīpsitaiḥ kratubhiryajeta" iti | etasminkṛte, uttarakarmaṇi kṛte | vrātyena vrātyastomena | paśunaindrāgnena | vṛddhamanuḥ -- "jīvanyadi samāgacchedghṛtakumbhe nimajjayet | uddhṛtya snāpayitvā'sya jātakarmādi kārayet || vratacaryā dvādaśāhaṃ trirātramathavā'sya tu | snātvodvahettato bhāryāmanyāṃ vā tadabhāvataḥ || agnīnādhāya vidhivadvrātyastomena vai yajet | athaindrāgnena paśunā giriṃ gatvā ca tatra tu || iṣṭimāyuṣmatīṃ kuryādīpsitāṃśca kratūṃstathā" iti | tadabhāvatastadabhāva ityarthaḥ | mamaurdhvadehikajanitāniṣṭadoṣanibarhaṇapūrvakapunargṛhasthāśramasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ tāmeva striyamudvahiṣya iti saṃkalpaḥ | na vā punargṛhasthāśramasiddhidvāreti | devapitrarṇānapākaraṇe tu devapitrarṇāpākaraṇasiddhidvāretyapi vaktavyam | yadi pūrvastriyā abhāvastadā svodvāhaṃ kariṣya iti prītyarthamityanantaraṃ vadet | nātra pitrādikartṛkaṃ dānam | pūrvoḍhāyāmetasyāṃ bhāryāyāṃ madupabhogārhatāsiddhidvāraitasminnagnāvaupāsanatvasiddhidvārā ceti vivāhahomasaṃkalpavākyam | stryantarapariṇaye tu vivāhasaṃkalpaḥ prathamavivāhasaṃkalpavadeva | vivāhahomottaraṃ gṛhapraveśasthālīpākaścaturthīkarma ca | brahmacāriṇaṃ puraskṛtya paiṭhīnasiḥ -- "madhumāṃsāśane trirātramupavāsaḥ punarupanayanaṃ ca" iti | ayaṃ ca trirātropavāsaḥ prājāpatyāśaktasyetyuktaṃ madanaratne | 'etayoramatyā bhakṣaṇe kṛcchro matyā parākaḥ | abhyāse dviguṇaṃ punaḥsaṃskāraśca' iti smṛtyarthasāre | tathā tatraiva -- 'mātāpitṛgurvācāryopādhyāyebhyo'nyapretasaṃskāre brahmacāriṇaḥ punarupanayanaṃ kāryam' iti | aparārke'pyevam | tathā -- 'retoviṇmūtrakaranirmathitadadhibahirvedipuroḍāśabhakṣaṇānāmatyabhyāse'tikṛcchraḥ punarupanayanaṃ ca' iti | bahirvedipuroḍāśabhakṣaṇaṃ laukikapuroḍāśabhakṣaṇamiti kecit | ṛtvigvyatiriktakartṛkasaṃskṛtapuroḍāśabhakṣaṇameva laukikapuroḍāśabhakṣaṇam | tathā ca laukikaṃ ca tatpuroḍāśabhakṣaṇaṃ cetyevameva samāso'tretyanye | puroḍāśaśabdasya vihitasaṃskārapūrvakākāraviśiṣṭadravyavācitvāduttarakalpa eva śreyān | etacca jñānato'jñānatastūpavāsaḥ | tathā ca kaurme -- "śaṇapuṣpaṃ śālmalīṃ ca karanirmathitaṃ dadhi | bahirvedi puroḍāśaṃ jagdhvā nādyādaharniśam" iti || smṛtyantare -- "karmanāśājalasparśātkaratoyāvilaṅghanāt | gaṇḍakībāhutaraṇātpunaḥ saṃskāramarhati" iti || gauḍāstu -- "karatoyājalasparśātkarmanāśāvilaṅghanāt" || iti paṭhanti | tanna | dānadharmeṣu karatoyāsnāne prāśastyokteḥ | "karatoye sadānīre saricchreṣṭhe'tiviśrute | āplāvayasi paurāṇāṃ pāpaṃ harakarodbhave" || iti smṛtidarpaṇacandrikālikhitasnānamantrācca | smṛtimañjaryām -- "dvijo'kṛtopākaraṇaḥ samāvarteta mohataḥ | sa prājāpatyapūrvaṃ tu punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" iti || itthaṃ vihite prāyaścittārthe punarupanayane viśeṣaḥ pārijātamadanaratnayoḥ kaśyapenoktaḥ -- "cīrṇaprāyaścittaḥ prācyāmudīcyāṃ vā diśi gatvā yatra grāmyapaśūnāṃ śabdo na śrūyate tasmindeśe'gniṃ prajvālya brahmāsanamāstīrya prākpraṇītena vidhinā punaḥ saṃskāraṃ kuryāt" iti | brahmāsanamāstīryetivacanaṃ brahmaniyamārtham | tena nātra daṇḍādibhirbrahmasiddhiḥ | prākpraṇītena prāguktena vidhinetyarthaḥ | smṛtyantare -- "mekhalāma(cā)jinaṃ vāso daṇḍo bhikṣā vratāni ca | nivartante dvijātīnāṃ punaḥsaṃskārakarmaṇi" iti || atha dvitīyaṃ punarupanayananimittam -- tacca pāṇibhyāṃ kumārasyāṃsābhimarśanapūrvakasamīpānayanarūpapradhānopanayanavidhāyake sūtre mātṛdattenoktam -- "atrāthaśabda idaṃ pradhānakarmaitasya vismaraṇe sarvaṃ karmā''vartata iti khyāpanārthaḥ" iti | samayodyote smṛtyantare -- "vinartunā vasantena kṛṣṇapakṣe galagrahe | anadhyāye copanītaḥ punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" iti || vinartunā vasanteneti pṛthagekaṃ punaḥsaṃskāre nimittam | kṛṣṇapakṣagalagrahāparāhṇā iti nimittatrayaṃ ca tathā | vinartunā vasanteneti vasantalābhe satyanyatra karaṇe punaḥsaṃskāranimittaṃ nānyadā | anyathā māghaphālgunajyeṣṭhāṣāḍhānāṃ vidhānaṃ viruddhaṃ syāt | athavā vinartunā vasantenetyetasya saṃnihitatvātkṛṣṇapakṣaśabde'nvayaḥ | tathā cāyamartho bhavati | vasantartunā vinā kṛṣṇapakṣa upanayane punaḥsaṃskāro nānyadeti | kṛṣṇapakṣagalagrahaśabdayorapyanvaya iti kecit | galagrahaśabda evānvaya ityanye | smṛtidarpaṇe vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "pāpāṃśakagate candre arinīcasthite'pi ca | aparāhṇe copanītaḥ punaḥsaṃskāramarhati" iti || atrāparāhṇastredhāvibhaktadinatṛtīyāṃśa ityuktaṃ madanaratne | atha tṛtīyaṃ punarupanayananimittam -- etacca'sarvebhyo vai vedebhyaḥ sāvitryanūcyata iti hi brāhmaṇam' iti dharmasūtravyākhyānāvasara ujjvalākṛtoktam 'upanayane yatsāvitryā anuvācanaṃ tanmukhena sarve vedā anuktā bhavanti | ato'gṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvādekamevopanayanaṃ sarvārtham' iti | asminnarthe śāṭyāyanabrāhmaṇameva paṭhitam | atharvavedārthaṃ tu pṛthagupanayanaṃ vacanātkartavyam | tathā ca tatraiva śrutam 'nānyatra saṃskṛto bhṛgvaṅgiraso'dhīyīta' iti | anyatrānyavedārtham | bhṛgvaṅgiraso'tharvaveda iti | trividhe punarupanayane dvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ kvacidapi granthe viśeṣānukteravikṛtaṃ punarupanayanaṃ gārhapatyādhānātprāksūryodaye'vikṛtādhānavat | prāyaścittabhūtapunarupanayanaprayogaḥ | prāyaścittabhūtapunarupanayane tūktebhyo vacanebhyo'nekaviśeṣāvagatestatprayogo likhyate | tacca yatra prāyaścittasahitaṃ vihitaṃ tatra parṣadupadiṣṭavidhinā prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā kāryam | yathoṣṭrīkṣīrapānādau | yatra jātakarmādisaṃskārasahitaṃ vihitaṃ tatra nimittānantaraṃ karaṇapakṣa udagayanavasantādyanālocyaiva parṣadupadeśena caulāntānsaṃskārānkṛtvā kāryam | anyathodagayanavasantādyāvaśyakam | tithinakṣatrālocanamātrameva vā | kālāntare punarupanayanakartavyatāyāmapi tāvatparyantaṃ saṃdhyāvandanaṃ bhavatyeva | "saṃdhyāhīno'śucirnityamanarhaḥ sarvakarmasu" iti vacanāt | mahāpātakaprakaraṇe -- 'samyaksaṃdhyāmupāsīta' iti smṛteśca mahāpātakino'pi saṃdhyāvandanakartavyatāyāṃ siddhāyāṃ kimu vaktavyaṃ tadanyasya | brahmayajñādikaṃ tu na bhavatyaśucitvāttathāvacanābhāvācca | punaḥsaṃskārārhasya tu karmalopabhayādrātrāvapi saṃskāro vihito nānyasyeti muhūrtamārtaṇḍaṭīkāyām | kartā ca pitṛsattve sa eva | tadabhāve pitāmahapitṛvyādiḥ sapiṇḍaḥ | tadabhāve yaḥ kaścidvidvānsvaśākhāḍhyaḥ | punarupanayanaṃ yasmindeśe tatraiva jātakarmādayaḥ kāryāḥ | asya kṛtaurdhvadehikasya punaḥsaṃskārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ jātaka rmādīnyupanayanāntāni saṃskārakarmāṇi kariṣya iti saṃkalpaḥ | evaṃ nimittāntare'pi tattannimittohena saṃkalpaḥ | tataḥ sarvoddeśena svastivācanādi | śmaśrūpapakṣavāpanānantaraṃ caule keśavāpanamiti viśeṣo mahadva(hāva)yasaḥ | vivāhasaṃkalpatadarthasvastivācanādikaṃ tu saṃskāryeṇa svayameva pṛthakkartavyam | yatra tu punarupanayanamātraṃ prāyaścittatvena vihitaṃ tatra parṣadupadiṣṭavidhinā tadeva kāryam | tatrā''cāryaḥ kṛcchratrayamagnipavitramantrajapapūrvakaṃ dvādaśasahasraṃ dvādaśādhikasahasraṃ vā gāyatrījapaṃ kuryāt | saṃskāryo nimittānantaropanayana etatprāyaścittaṃ na kuryāditi kecit | tataḥ kṛtanityakriya ācāryaḥ patnīsattve sapatnīko grāmātprācyāmudīcyāṃ vā diśi gatvā yatra grāmyapaśuśabdo na śrūyeta tādṛśaṃ deśaṃ yāvatparyāptaṃ saṃmārjanopalepanābhyāṃ śodhayitvā tatropaviśya svasya dakṣiṇataḥ saṃskāryamupaveśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtyāmukaśarmaṇastīrthayātrāṃ vinā pratyantādideśagamanajanitadoṣanirasanapūrvakapunaḥsaṃskārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ punarupanayanaṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ tattannimittānusāreṇa saṃkalpaṃ kṛtvā gaṇapatipūjanapuṇyāhavācanādimaṇḍapadevatāpratiṣṭhāpanāntaṃ kuryāt | puṇyāhavācane tvagniḥ prīyatāmiti viśeṣaḥ | tato yugmānbrāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhasvastyayanardhīrvācayitvā kṛtamaṅgalasnānaṃ saṃskāryaṃ bhojayitvā vapanasnāne kārayet | mahadva(hāva)yasaḥ śmaśrūpapakṣavāpanānantaraṃ keśavāpanam | tataḥ sthaṇḍilakaraṇādi | anvādhāne prāyaścittabhūtapunarupanayanahomakarmaṇi yā ityādi prajāpatiṃ caikaikayā''jyāhutyā yakṣya ityantamuktvā'gniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣājyāhutyetyādi | pātrāsādane'hatavāsomekhalājinadaṇḍabhikṣāpātravyatiriktāni pātrāṇyāsādayet | tato brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśya pavitrakaraṇādikapakādiparidānāntam | tatrāhatavāsaḥparidhāpanamekhalābandhanājinottarīyakaraṇāni na santi | tattadvidhāyake sūtre'thaśabdena tattadabhāvasya jñāpitatvāt | nātra jayādyupahomāḥ | tato'pareṇāgniṃ kūrcamityādividhinā sāvitrīvācanaṃ kṛtvā saptapalāśasamiddhomādi | nātra vrataṃ, caritatvāt | bhikṣācaraṇamapi na | tadvidhāyakasūtre'thaśabdena tadabhāvasya jñāpitatvāt | daṇḍadānabhikṣāmantradānayoḥ parasparasaṃbandhitvenaikasaṃbandhinivṛttāvaparasaṃbandhinivṛtterapi siddheḥ | etayoḥ paraspara saṃbandhitvaṃ tu daṇḍaṃ pradāyetilyapā siddham | prathamavastradānamapi na | parihitatvāt | yadi brahmacāriṇaḥ samāpitavedasya punarupanayanaṃ tadā saṃdhyopāsanādirūpa eva karma kurvityatratyakarmaśabdasyārtha upadeṣṭavyaḥ | na tu guruśuśrūṣādirūpavedādhyayanādirūpāvapyarthāvupadeṣṭavyau | yadi tvabrahmacāriṇaḥ punarupanayanaṃ tadā samidha ādhehītyasya vākyasya lopaḥ | prathamopanayanavatryahamagnidhāraṇam | agnikāryādhikārī cettadā samidha ādhehītyastyeva | upanayanāgnāvagnikāryatrivṛdannahomo bhavataḥ | vāstubalirniyataḥ | yasminnāśrame punarupanayanaṃ prāptaṃ tadāśramadharmāḥ kāryāḥ | yatra tu punarupanayanānantaramāśramāntarasvīkārastatra jīrṇāni mekhalādīni vyudasya nūtanāni dhārayitvā brahmacārivratacaryāmucitakālena samāpya vidhinā''śramāntaraṃ svīkuryāt | iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ vikalāṅgopanayanapunarupanayanaprayogaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ paṣṭhaṃ prakaraṇam || 6|| <7> atha saptamaṃ prakaraṇam | atha saṃkṣepeṇa brahmacāridharmāḥ | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "etadvrata evāta ūrdhvamācāryakulavāsyaśnāti kṣāraṃ lavaṇa śamīdhānyamiti daṇḍī jaṭī mekhalī śikhājaṭo vā syātkāṣāyamajinaṃ vā vaste na striyamupaityaṣṭācatvāri śadvarṣāṇi caturvi śatiṃ dvādaśa yāvadgrahaṇaṃ vā na tvevāvrataḥ syāt" iti | etadityanena prakṛtaṃ sāvitrīvratamakṣāralavaṇabhojanādi pratinirdiśyate | etadvrataṃ yasya so'yametadvrataḥ | etadvrata evāta ūrdhvamapi syāt | evakāro vakṣyamāṇānyapi vratāni tryahe syurityetadartham | dvau brahmacāriṇau, ācāryakulavāsī naiṣṭhikaśca | tayoryo vidyārthamevā''cāryakule vasati tacchīla ācāryakulavāsī | yastvāśramārthyūrdhvamapi vidyākriyāyā brahmacaryaṃ carati sa naiṣṭhikaḥ | tayorācāryakulavāsyaśnāti kṣāraṃ lavaṇaṃ śamīdhānyaṃ ca | itiśabdaḥ samuccayārthaḥ | daṇḍī mekhalīti matvarthīya iniḥ | jaṭīti nityayoge | śikhaiva jaṭā yasya so'yaṃ śikhājaṭaḥ | śikhāmeva dhārayeditarānkeśānvāpayedityarthaḥ | kāṣāyaṃ kaṣāyeṇa raktaṃ vastramajinaṃ vā vaste paridadhāti | kāṣāyagrahaṇaṃ pradarśanamātram | māñjiṣṭhaṃ hāridramiti yathāvarṇaṃ bhavati | na striyamupaiti na maithunaṃ caratītyarthaḥ | kiyantaṃ kālametāni vratāni caratītyākāṅkṣāyāmaṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣāṇītyādi | aṣṭācatvāriṃśat, caturviṃśatiṃ, dvādaśa, yāvadadhyayanaṃ vā vratacaryā bhavati | yasya nāsti vrataṃ so'vrataḥ | avratastu naiva bhavet | atikrānte saṃkalpite kāle vidyāyāmagṛhītāyāṃ prāksamāvartanādavrato na syādvratavāṃstvevādhīyītetyetadarthaṃ tuśabdaḥ | samāvṛttenāpi prāṅniveśādadhyeyamiti vakṣyati dharme | so'pyācāryakule'dhīyāno naivāvrataḥ syādityetadarthamevakāraḥ | vratī tveva syādityetāvatā siddhe nāvrata iti niṣedhadvayavacanaṃ niviṣṭo'pi kṛcchrāpattau yena kenacidvikṣepeṇā''cāryakule vasankālādyapekṣayā'vrato naiva syādityetadartham | dharmasūtre -- 'na gāyenna rodenna nṛtyadarśī syāt' iti | gānaṃ sāmavyatiriktam | rodanamaśrumocanam | etadubhayaṃ na kuryāt | nṛtyadarśī nṛtyadarśanaśīlo na bhavedityarthaḥ | tathā -- 'na nagnāṃ striyaṃ prekṣedoṣadhivanaspatīnācchidya nopanighredupānahau chatraṃ yānamiti varjayet' iti | prekṣamāṇasya manaso vikāro bhavati | ato nagnāṃ striyaṃ na prekṣeta | oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāntāḥ | vanaspatayo ye puṣpairvinā phalanti | vīrudvṛkṣāṇāmapyupalakṣaṇam | teṣāṃ patrapuṣpe ācchidya nopajighret | ācchidyetivacanādyādṛcchike gandhagrahaṇe na doṣaḥ | upānahau prasiddhau(ddhe) | chatraṃ prasiddham | yānaṃ śakaṭādi | hiśabda evaṃprakārāṇāmupalakṣaṇārthaḥ | yamaḥ -- "mekhalāmajinaṃ daṇḍamupavītaṃ ca sarvadā | kaupīnaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca brahmacārī tu dhārayet || agnīndhanaṃ bhaikṣacaryāmadhaḥśayyāṃ gurorhitam | āsamāvartanātkuryātkṛtopanayano dvijaḥ" iti | agnīndhanamagnikāryasaṃjñakaṃ samidabhyādhānam | baudhāyanadharmasūtre -- "brāhmaṇo vai brahmacaryamupāyaṃścaturdhā tāni praviśantyagnipādaṃ mṛtyupādamācāryapādamātmanyevāsya caturthaḥ pādaḥ pariśiṣyate sa yadagnau samidhamādadhāti ya evāsyāgnau pādastameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyā''tmandhatte sa enamāviśatyatha yadātmānaṃ daridrīkṛtya bhikṣurbhūtvā bhikṣanbrahmacaryaṃ carati ya evāsya mṛtyau pādastameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyā''tmandhatte sa enamāviśatyatha yadācāryavacaḥ karoti ya evāsyā''cārye pādastameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyā''tmandhatte sa enamāviśatyatha yatsvādhyāyamadhīte ya evāsyā''tmani pādastameva tena parikrīṇāti taṃ saṃskṛtyā''tmandhatte sa enamāviśati" iti | anyaccātraiva -- "sa yadanyo bhikṣitavyāṃ na vindetāpi svāmevā''cāryajāyāṃ bhikṣetātho svāṃ mātaraṃ naina saptamyabhikṣitādiyādbhaikṣasyānācaraṇe doṣaḥ pāvakasyāsamindhane saptarātramakṛtvaitadavakīrṇivrataṃ caret | tamevaṃ vidvāṃsamevaṃ carantaṃ sarve vedā āviśanti yathā ha vā agniḥ samiddho rocata eva ha vā eṣa snātvā rocate ya evaṃ vidvānbrahmacaryaṃ caratīti hi brāhmaṇamiti hi brāhmaṇam" iti | vyāsaḥ -- "brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśaścareyurbhaikṣamanvaham | sajātīyagṛheṣveva sārvavarṇikameva vā" iti || bhaviṣye -- "sarvaṃ vā'pi caredgrāmaṃ pūrvoktānāmasaṃbhave | antyavarjaṃ mahābāho ityāha bhagavānvibhuḥ" iti || antyaḥ śūdraḥ | dharmasūtre -- sāyaṃprātaramatreṇa bhikṣācaryaṃ caredbhikṣamāṇo'nyatrāpapātrebhyo'bhiśastācca" iti | amatreṇa pātreṇa | apagatāni pākādyarthāni pātrāṇi cāturvarṇyaiḥ saha te'papātrāḥ pratilomarajakādayaḥ | abhiśastaḥ patitaḥ | etebhyo'nyatra bhikṣācaryaṃ caredityarthaḥ | sārvavarṇikasarvagrāmapakṣayorapi śūdrātpakvamannaṃ naiva grāhyaṃ, tadāhāṅgirāḥ -- "āmamevā''dadītāsmādavṛttāvekarātrakam | āmaṃ pūyati saṃskāro dharmyaṃ tebhyaḥ pratīcchatām || tasmādāmaṃ grahītavyaṃ śūdrādapi samāhitaiḥ | caṇḍālapatitādibhyo na bhikṣedāmamapyaṇu" iti || pūyati punāti | kvacittathaiva pāṭhaḥ | aviśeṣeṇa sajātīyeṣveva bhikṣācaraṇaṃ vyāsenoktaṃ, tatra viśeṣamāha manuḥ -- "vedayajñairahīnānāṃ praśastānāṃ svakarmasu | brahmacāryāharedbhaikṣaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato'nvaham" iti || ye vedairvedābhyāṃ vedena vā | evaṃ yajñaiśca hīnā ye na bhavanti | atha ca sveṣu varṇāśramavihitakarmasu praśastāśca bhavanti teṣāṃ gṛhebhyaḥ prayato niyamavān , brahma vedastadarthaṃ vrataṃ caratīti brahmacārī, anvahaṃ pratyahaṃ bhaikṣamāharedityarthaḥ | bhaikṣamityatra samūhārthe 'bhikṣādibhyo'ṇ' ityaṇpratyayaḥ | kvacidbhikṣāniṣedhamāha sa eva -- "guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta na jñātikulabandhuṣu | alābhe tvanyagehānāṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvamupāśrayet" iti || guroḥ kule | gṛha iti kecit | yattu tenaivoktaṃ -- "mātaraṃ vā svasāraṃ vā māturvā bhaginīṃ nijām | bhikṣeta bhikṣāṃ prathamaṃ yā cainaṃ nāvamānayet" || iti tadupanayanāṅgabhikṣāparamiti | prathamavāśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | mātrādayaḥ śabdāḥ prasiddhārthāḥ | nijā sodaryā | avamāno'vajñānaṃ na dīyata iti pratyākhyānaṃ yā na karoti tāmapi bhikṣetetyarthaḥ | tathā cā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "apratyākhyāyinamagre bhikṣetāpratyākhyāyinīṃ vā" iti | anyatrālābhe gurvādiṣvapi bhikṣitavyamityāha gautamaḥ -- "ācāryajñātiguruṣvalābhādanyatra" iti | ācāryajñātiguruṣvapi bhikṣitavyamanyatra bhaikṣālābha ityarthaḥ | yamaḥ -- "āhāramātrādadhikaṃ na kvacidbhaikṣamāharet | yujyate sa hi doṣeṇa kāmato'dhikamāharet" iti || yaḥ kāmata icchāto'dhikaṃ bhojanaparyāptito'dhikaṃ yadyāharettadā sa doṣeṇa pāpena yukto bhavedityuttarārdhārthaḥ | kāmata ityuktyā'kāmato'dhikāharaṇe na doṣaḥ | dharmasūtre -- "tatsamāhṛtyopanidhāya gurave prabrūyādbhaikṣamidaṃ bho iti tena pradiṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta" iti | tadbhaikṣaṃ gurusamīpamāhṛtya gurusamīpa eva saṃsthāpya tasmai prabrūyādbhaikṣamidaṃ bho iti | tatastena guruṇā pradiṣṭaṃ bhojanāyābhyanujñātamannaṃ bhuñjīteti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | tathā -- "vipravāse gurorācāryakulāyaitairvipravāse'nyebhyo'pi śrotriyebhyo nā''tmaprayojanaścaretproṣito bhaikṣādagnau kṛtvā bhuñjīta" iti | yadi gururviproṣito'saṃnihitaḥ syāttata ācāryakulāya, ācāryasya yatkulaṃ bhāryāputrādi tasmai prabrūyādbhaikṣamidaṃ bho iti tena pradiṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta | taiḥ sakulyaiḥ saha gurorvipravāse'nyebhyo'pi śrotriyebhyaḥ prabrūyāt | taiḥ pradiṣṭaṃ bhuñjītetivacanavipariṇāmenānvayaḥ | gautamo'pyāha -- "asaṃnidhau tadbhāryāputrasabrahmacāribhyaḥ" iti | ātmaiva prayojanaṃ yasya sa ātmaprayojanaḥ | evaṃbhūto bhikṣāṃ na caret | kevalamātmārthaṃ bhikṣāṃ na caredityarthaḥ | ātmaprayojanapadaṃ yadā śrotriyā api na labhyante tadā proṣito bhaikṣādagnau kṛtvā bhuñjīteti vakṣyamāṇo vidhiryathā syādityetadartham | proṣitaḥ śiṣya ācāryaprayojanaḥ svaprayojano vā''cāryakulaśrotriyābhāve bhikṣitādannātkiṃcidādāyāgnau prakṣipya bhuñjītetyarthaḥ | tathā -- "bhuktvā svayamamatraṃ prakṣālayenna cocchiṣṭaṃ kuryādaśaktau bhūmau nikhanedapsu vā praveśayedāryāya paryavadadhyādvā'ntardhine vā śūdrāya" iti | amatraṃ bhojanapātram | bhuktveti saṃnidhānādbhojanapātraṃ svayameva prakṣālayet | bhikṣāpātrasya tvanyenāpi prakṣālane doṣo na | ubhayorapi pātrayorgrahaṇamityanye | yāvacchaknoti bhoktuṃ tāvadeva bhojanapātre kṛtvā bhuñjīta | bhojane pravṛtto yadi bhoktuṃ na śaknuyāttadā tadannaṃ bhūmau nikhanet | athavā'psu praveśayetprakṣipet | āryastraivarṇikastasmā anupanītāya paryavadadhyāt | sarvamekasminpātre'vadhāya tatsamīpe bhūmau sthāpayet | antardhānamantardhiḥ so'syāstītyantardhī | vrīhyāditvādiniḥ | antardhī dāsaḥ | antarhitaṃ hi tasya śūdratvam | prakaraṇātsa ācāryasya | ācāryadāsāya śūdrāya vā paryavadadhyātprayacchedityarthaḥ | atraikānnāśitvaniṣedhamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "brahmacarye sthito naikamannamadyādanāpadi" iti | brahmacaryamaṣṭāṅgamaithunatyāgaḥ | tānyāha dakṣaḥ -- "brahmacaryaṃ sadā rakṣedaṣṭadhālakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak | smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam || saṃkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyāniṣpattireva ca | etanmaithunamaṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ || vaiparītye brahmacaryaṃ naṣṭaṃ prāha prajāpatiḥ | naṣṭamityatra bhavatīti śeṣaḥ| na dhyātavyaṃ na vaktavyaṃ na śrotavyaṃ kathaṃcana | etaiḥ sarvaiḥ suniṣṇāto yatirbhavati nānyathā" iti | abhilāṣapūrvakasmaraṇakīrtanaprekṣaṇāni niṣiddhāni | keliḥ parihāsādibāhyaceṣṭā | guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ saṃbhogārthaṃ rahomantraṇam | saṃkalpo mānasaṃ karma | adhyavasāyaḥ saṃbhoganiścaya iti | ekamekasvāmikam | smṛtyantare bhikṣāśane viśeṣa uktaḥ -- "pūjayedaśanaṃ nityamadyāccaitadakutsayan" iti | pūjanaṃ praṇāmarūpam | kutracitpraṇamedaśanaṃ nityamityeva pāṭhaḥ | akutsayannagarhayan | nityamityanenaitasya sārvatrikatvaṃ sūcyate | dharmasūtre -- "aṣṭau grāsā munerbhakṣaḥ ṣoḍaśāraṇyavāsinaḥ | dvātriṃśattu gṛhasthasyāparimitaṃ brahmacāriṇaḥ" iti || muneḥ saṃnyāsino bhakṣo'ṣṭau grāsāḥ | araṇyavāsī vānaprasthastasya ṣoḍaśa | dvātriṃśadgṛhasthasya | brahmacāriṇo vidyārthasya naiṣṭhikasya ca grāsaniyamo nāstītyarthaḥ | anyadapi tatraiva -- "āhitāgniranaḍvāṃśca brahmacārī ca te trayaḥ | aśnanta eva sidhyanti naiṣāṃ siddhiranaśnatām" iti | āhitāgnerapi gṛhasthatvena pūrvaślokena prāptasya grāsaniyamasya kālayo rbhojanamityasya kālaniyamasya ca niyamo nāstītyetena jñāyate | āhitāgnerbarhiḥsamidāharaṇāderāvaśyakatvādbrahmacāriṇaśca gurusevāyā avaśyakartavyatvāttadvivirodhiśarīranairbalyāpādakaṃ kāmyavratādikaṃ nānuṣṭhānārhamityarthaḥ | anaḍudgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntārtham | atra pātraniyamamāha hārītaḥ -- "lauhe mṛnmaye vā pātre bhuñjīta" iti | lohaṃ kāñcanam | lohaśabdasya kāñcananāmasu nighaṇṭau pāṭhāt | kāṃsyapātre bhojanaṃ tāmbūlābhyañjane ca niṣedhati pracetāḥ -- "tāmbūlābhyañjane caiva kāṃsyapātre ca bhojanam | yatiśca brahmacārī ca vidhavā ca vivarjayet" iti || niṣiddhānnamāhātriḥ -- "hastadattā tu yā bhikṣā lavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca | bhoktā hyaśucitāṃ yāti dātā svargaṃ na gacchati" iti || manuḥ -- "vrate vā devadaivatye pitrye karmaṇyathāpi vā | kāmamabhyarthito'śnīyādvratamasya na lupyate" iti || abhyarthitaḥ kāmamaśnīyādityanvayaḥ | abhyarthitaḥ prārthitaḥ | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "añjanābhyañjane kṣaudraṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatānvratī | varjayetpādukāchatrayānoṣṇīṣarathādikam" iti || kūrmapurāṇe -- "ādarśaṃ naiva vīkṣeta nā''careddantadhāvanam | gurūcchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ prayuñjīta na kāmataḥ" iti || vasiṣṭho'pi -- "cedvyādhitaḥ kāmaṃ gurorucchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ sarvaṃ prāśnīyāt" iti || vyādhita iti saṃjātārtha itacpratyayaḥ | sarvagrahaṇaṃ māṃsalaśunādyabhakṣyamātrasaṃgrahārtham | tadbhakṣaṇenāpagatavyādhirādityamupatiṣṭheta | tathā ca baudhāyano'bhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ prakṛtya -- "sa yadā'gado bhavati tadotthāyā''dityamupatiṣṭhate ha saḥ śuciṣat" iti | sa rogī | agada iti padacchedaḥ | ha saḥ śuciṣadityekā, ṛk | dharmasūtre -- "gurusamavāye bhikṣāyāmutpannāyāṃ yamanubandhastadadhīnā bhikṣā" iti | yadā dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ vā vedamadhīyānasya māṇavakasya gurusamavāyo bhavati guravaḥ samavetā bhavanti tadā bhikṣāyāmutpannāyāṃ yaṃ gurumidānīmanubandho yato'dhīte tadadhīnā bhikṣeti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | anyacca -- "samāvṛtto mātre dadyānmātā bhartāraṃ gamayedbhartā gurum" iti || kṛtasamāvartano vivāhātprāgarjitaṃ mātre dadyāt | mātā bhartāraṃ gamayetpatiṃ prāpayet | sa ca guruṃ māṇavakasyeti śeṣa iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "aṣṭau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ | havirbrāhmaṇakāmyā ca gurorvacanamauṣadham" iti || brāhmaṇakāmyā brāhmaṇecchā | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "madhumāṃsāñjanocchiṣṭaśuklastrīprāṇihiṃsanam | bhāskarālokanāślīlaparivādādi varjayet" iti || madhu kṣaudram | madyaniṣedhasya tu sāmānyaniṣedhenaiva siddhatvāt | māṃsaṃ prokṣitādyapyatra niṣidhyate | añjanaṃ kajjalādinā'kṣṇoḥ | etaccābhyañjanopalakṣaṇam | tena tailādinā gātrāṇāmabhyaṅgo'pi niṣiddhaḥ | etadapi vaidyopadeśādṛte | auṣadhasyāvrataghnatvāt | atrocchiṣṭaniṣedho vyādhirāhitye jñeyaḥ | sa cedvyādhita ityudāhṛtavasiṣṭhavākyāt | "gurūcchiṣṭaṃ bheṣajārthaṃ prayuñjīta na kāmataḥ" ityudāhṛtakūrmapurāṇavākyācca | śuklaṃ niṣṭhuravākyam | "śuklā vāco vivarjayet" iti gautamokteḥ | udaye'stamaye ca bhāskarāvalokanaṃ na kāryaṃ, taduktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "udyantamastaṃ yantamādityaṃ darśane vivarjayet" iti | udayasamaye'stasamaye cā''dityaṃ na paśyedityarthaḥ | manurapi -- "nekṣetodyantamādityamastaṃ yantaṃ kadācana | noparaktaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam" iti | aślīlaṃ marmabhāṣaṇam | parivādo nindā | ādiśabdena parihāsādi | yamaḥ -- "khaṭvāsane ca śayanaṃ varjayeddantadhāvanam | svapedekaḥ kuśeṣveva na retaḥ skandayetkvacit" iti | manuḥ -- "dyūtaṃ ca janavādaṃ ca parihāsaṃ tathā'nṛtam | strīṇāṃ ca prekṣaṇālambhāvupaghātaṃ parasya ca | khaṭvāsane ca śayanaṃ brahmacārī vivarjayet" iti | dyūtamakṣakrīḍā | janavādo deśavārtā | gautamaḥ -- "gurusamīpe kaṇṭhaprāvṛttyāvasakthikāpāśrayaṇapādaprasāraṇaniṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇahasitāvasphoṭanānīti varjayet" iti | kaṇṭhaprāvṛttirvastreṇa kaṇṭhācchādanam | āvasakthikā yogapaṭṭaḥ | tasyāpāśrayaṇaṃ kaṭhyādiṣu saṃśrayaṇam | niṣṭhīvanaṃ lālāvisarjanam | avasphoṭanaṃ bhujāsphālanādi | hārītaḥ -- "hayarathagajacaityavṛkṣavṛṣabhārohaṇamahānadyavataraṇamahāsāhasāni varjayet" iti | gobhilaḥ -- "avalekhanadantaprakṣālanapādaprakṣālanādi varjayet" iti | avalekhanaṃ kaṅkatādinā śirogatakeśaprasādhanam | pādaprakṣālanamudvartanapūrvakaṃ pādena vā pādasya | baudhāyanadharmasūtre -- "mūtrapurīṣe nāvekṣetāmedhyaṃ dṛṣṭvā japatyabaddhaṃ mano daridraṃ cakṣuḥ sūryo jyotiṣā śreṣṭho dīkṣe mā mā hāsīḥ" iti | etacca gṛhasthādisādhāraṇaṃ jñeyam | parāśarīyaprāyaścittakāṇḍe -- "guruṃ huṃkṛtya tuṃkṛtya vipraṃ nirjitya vādataḥ | araṇye nirjale deśe bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ" iti || tasya prāyaścittamāha baudhāyanaḥ -- "vādena brāhmaṇaṃ jitvā prāyaścittavidhitsayā | trirātropoṣitaḥ snātvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet" iti || atra vādagrahaṇaṃ huṃkāratuṃkāracchalopalakṣaṇam | chalalakṣaṇamakṣapādena gautamena nyāyasūtre prathamādhyāya uktam -- "vacanavighāto'rthavikalpopapattyā chalanam" iti | abhiprāyāntareṇa prayuktasya śabdasyārthāntaraṃ prakalpya dūṣaṇābhidhānam | yathā navakambalo'yaṃ devadatta iti vākyasya nūtanābhiprāyeṇa prayuktasyārthāntaraṃ kalpayitvā dūṣaṇadānam | nāsya navakambalāḥ santi daridratvāt | na hyasya dvitvamapi saṃbhāvyate kuto'sya naveti | vākchalaṃ sāmānyacchalamupacāracchalamiti traividhyaṃ chalasya | tallakṣaṇāni tatraiva draṣṭavyāni | śuśrūṣāyāḥ phalamāhaturdevalabaudhāyanau -- "yathā khanankhanitreṇa naro vāryadhigacchati | evaṃ gurugatāṃ vidyāṃ śuśrūṣuradhigacchati" iti || akaraṇe doṣamāha yamaḥ -- "yathā'nnaṃ viṣasaṃyuktaṃ viṣaṃ cānnena saṃyutam | tādṛśaṃ syādaśuśrūṣorbrahmādhītaṃ na saṃśayaḥ" iti || atropāyāntaramāha nāradaḥ -- "guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā | athavā vidyayā vidyā caturthaṃ nopalabhyate" iti || smṛtyantare -- "nityaṃ snātvā śuciḥ kuryāddevarṣipitṛtarpaṇam | devatābhyarcanaṃ caiva saṃdhyopāsanameva ca" iti || jaiminiḥ -- "yāvadbrahmopadeśastu tāvatsaṃdhyādikaṃ ca na | jāte brahmopadeśe tu karma saṃdhyādikaṃ caret" iti || brahma gāyatrī | saṃdhyādikamityādiśabdādbrahmayajño gṛhyate | so'pi tadahaḥprabhṛti saṃdhyopāsanānantaraṃ yāvatparyantaṃ kiṃcidadhītaṃ na bhavati tāvatparyantaṃ pratyahaṃ gāyatryā kartavya iti tātparyārthaḥ | brahmacāriṇā kasyāpi śavavāhanādikriyā na kartavyāḥ | karaṇe kṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ punarupanayanaṃ ca | tathā ca devalaḥ -- "brahmacārī na kurvīta śavavāhādikāḥ kriyāḥ | yadi kuryāccaretkṛcchraṃ punaḥsaṃskārameva ca" iti || ādipadamalaṃkārādergrāhakaṃ na tu dāhādeḥ | tatra prāyaścittasya gurutvāt | lobhahetukakriyāyāḥ sāmānyavacanenaiva niṣedhe siddhe brahmacāriṇaṃ prati punarniṣedho dharmārthakriyāyā api niṣedhārthaḥ | anyathā vaiyarthyāt | manurapi -- "ācāryaṃ svamupādhyāyaṃ mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum | nirhṛtya tu vratī pretaṃ vratena na viyujyate" iti || mitākṣarāyāṃ gālavaḥ -- "guroḥ pretasya śiṣyastu pitṛmedhaṃ samācaret | pretāhāraiḥ samaṃ tatra daśarātreṇa śudhyati" iti | etacca mātṛpitrupādhyāyācāryamātāmahavyatiriktaviṣayam | tathā ca kālādarśe -- "mātāpitrorupādhyāyācāryayoraurdhvadehikam | kuryānmātāmahānāṃ ca vratī na bhraśyate vratāt" || iti saṃvartaḥ | tasya karmalopo nāsti | tathā ca candrikāyām -- "pitrorgurorvipattau tu brahmacāryapi yo naraḥ | savrataścāpi kurvīta hyagnipiṇḍodakakriyām || tenāśaucaṃ na kartavyaṃ saṃdhyā caiva na lupyate | agnikāryaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sāyaṃ prātaśca nityaśaḥ" iti || yāvatparyantaṃ tadīyaṃ karma karoti tāvatparyantamāśaucamastyeva | "brahmacārī yadā kuryātpiṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ pituḥ | tāvatkālamaśaucaṃ syātpunaḥ snānena śudhyati" || iti prajāpativacanāt | aparārkamādhavādayastvekāhamāśaucamāhuḥ | udāharanti ca vacanam -- "ācāryaṃ vā'pyupādhyāyaṃ guruṃ vā pitaraṃ ca vā | mātaraṃ vā svayaṃ dagdhvā vratasthastatra bhojanam || kṛtvā patati no tasmātpretānnaṃ tatra bhakṣayet | anyatra bhojanaṃ kuryānna ca taiḥ saha saṃviśet" iti || anyatra dvitīyadinamārabhyetyarthaḥ | "ekāhamaśucirbhūtvā dvitīye'hani śudhyati" iti brāhmokteḥ | yattu -- "guroḥ pretasya śiṣyastu pitṛmedhaṃ samācaret | pretāhāraiḥ samaṃ tatra daśarātreṇa śudhyati" || iti vacanaṃ tattadannabhojanaviṣayam | pretāhāraistadannabhojanaiḥ | aurdhvadehikakarmakaraṇe kartrantarasadbhāve tu pitrādimaraṇe'pyāśaucābhāva eva | brahmacāriṇā mṛtasapiṇḍānāṃ samāvartanottaraṃ mṛtakrameṇodakadānaṃ sarvāśaucasthānāpannaṃ trirātramāśaucaṃ ca kāryam | na tu samāvartanātpūrvamudakadānāśauce | tathā ca manuḥ -- "ādiṣṭī nodakaṃ kuryādā vratasya samāpanāt | samāpte tūdakaṃ dattvā trirātramaśucirbhavet" iti || ādiṣṭī brahmacārīti mitākṣarāyāṃ vyākhyātam | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "na brahmacāriṇaḥ kuryurudakaṃ patitāstathā" iti | brahmacāriṇo mṛtoddeśenodakadānamapi naiva kuryuḥ | evaṃ patitā api naiva kuryuriti | patitāḥ pracyutadvijātikarmādhikārāḥ | tataśca brahmacaryadaśāyāṃ sapiṇḍamaraṇe sati samāvartanānantaraṃ trirātramaśucitvādvivāho mātāpitranujñāyāṃ satyāmapi na bhavati | udakadānasāhacaryānmṛtāśaucaviṣaya evaitat | iti saṃkṣepeṇa brahmacāridharmāḥ | atha kāṇḍavratāni | tatra śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ prathamamadhyāyopākarma kṛtvā tatpūrvamapi vā vakṣyamāṇe vidyārambhānukūle sumuhūrte homapūrvakaṃ prājāpatyakāṇḍavratamupākṛtya tatkāṇḍādhyayanaṃ kṛtvā tasyotsargaṃ kuryāt | evaṃ saumyādikāṇḍavrateṣvapi jñeyam | athavā tantreṇa sarvāṇi kāṇḍavratānyupākṛtya yathāśakti vratamācaransarvāṇi kāṇḍānyadhītya tantreṇa tāni vratānyutsṛjet | yadi tu sārasvatapāṭhenādhyayanaṃ tadā tantreṇaivopākaraṇaṃ kāryamutsarjanamapyevam | ārambhasamāptirūpe upākaraṇotsarjane kāṇḍādhyayanavratayoḥ pṛthaṅna bhavataḥ | kāṇḍavratānāṃ kāṇḍādhyayanāṅgatvenādhyayanārthābhyāmupākaraṇotsarjanābhyāmeva siddheḥ | asamāpte kāṇḍe'dhyāyotsargakāla āgate'dhyāyamutsṛjya viramya punaradhyāyamupākṛtya kāṇḍaṃ yathākālamupākṛtyādhītya kāṇḍaṃ yathākālamutsṛjya viramitavyam | kāṇḍānāṃ saṃkīrṇatvena yathākāṇḍamidānīmadhyayanāsaṃbhavātkāṇḍānukramaṇikāyāṃ sārasvatapāṭhasyāpyabhyanujñātatvācca sārasvatapāṭhenaivedānīmadhyayanamasti | upākaraṇotsarjanayorārambhasamāptirūpayostantraṃ naiva bhavati | svarūpavirodhāt | atra sarvamācāryakartṛkam | yāvaduktaṃ brahmacārī | atha sārasvatapāṭhenādhyayane'pi kāṇḍaparijñānasyā''vaśyakatvāttadarthaṃ kāṇḍānukramaṇyanusāreṇa kāṇḍānyucyante | kāṇḍaparijñānasyā''vaśyakatvaṃ tu -- "api sārasvate pāṭhe jñānamātramihocyate" ityanenoktaṃ, sārasvatapāṭhe'pi kāṇḍānukramaviṣayakamadṛṣṭārthaṃ jñānamātramiṣyata eva budhairiti tātparyārthaḥ | etasmādeva vacanātsārasvatapāṭho'pyastīti jñāyate | atha kāṇḍāni | tāni ca baudhāyanagṛhyakāṇḍānukramaṇasūtrayoruktāni | tatra prājāpatyaṃ kāṇḍam | iṣe tvetipraśna uttamānuvākavarjam | tṛtīyasyāṃ pratyuṣṭamiti praśnadvayam | mama nāmetyetasyānuvākasya payasvatīroṣadhaya ityādiḥ śeṣaḥ | saṃ tvā siñcāmīti praśna uttamānuvākavarjam | pākayajñamityādayo dvitīyānuvākavarjaṃ pañcānuvākāḥ | saśāntikāścittiḥ srugityādayastrayodaśānuvākāḥ | prajāpatirbrahmavādina iti dvitīyakāṇḍabrāhmaṇāntargataṃ praśnadvayam | satyaṃ prapadya iti praśnaḥ | devā vai narcinetyādayaścatvāro'nuvākāḥ | nivītaṃ manuṣyāṇāmityārabhya manuṣyalokaṃ cābhijayatītyanto'nuvākaḥ | sa śravā ityanuvākaḥ | manuḥ pṛthivyā ityādayaścatvāro'nuvākāḥ | viśvarūpo vai tvāṣṭra ityādayaḥ ṣaḍanuvākāḥ | devā vai sāmidhenīranūcyetyādirnivītamityetasyānuvākasya śeṣaḥ | samidho yajatītyādayaḥ ṣaḍanuvākāḥ | indro vṛtra hatvetyanuvākaḥ | saśāntikaḥ pare yuvā samiti praśnaḥ | iti prājāpatyakāṇḍam | atha saumyakāṇḍam | āpa undantu devasya tveti praśnadvayamuttamānuvākavarjam | pavamānaḥ suvarjana ityanuvākaḥ | brahma
