saṃdhattamityanuvākaḥ | ādade grāvetipraśna uttamānuvākavarjam | cittiḥ srugiti praśnāntargatastaraṇirityanuvākaḥ | prācīnava śamiti praśnaṣaṭkam | prajananamityādayastrayo'nuvākāḥ | devāsurāḥ sa prajāpatirindramityādayaścatvāro'nuvākāḥ | ubhaye vā ete brahmavādino vadanti kati pātrāṇītyanuvākadvayam | deva savitaḥ prasuvetyādayaḥ ṣaḍanuvākāḥ | devā vai yathādarśamityādayo'ṣṭānuvākāḥ | trivṛtstoma iti praśnaḥ | saśāntikau yuñjate mano devā vai satramāsateti praśnau | iti saumyakāṇḍam | athā''gneyakāṇḍam | gharmaḥ śira uddhanyamānamityanuvākau | kṛttikāsvagnimādadhītetyādayaḥ pañcā nuvākāḥ | ime vā eta ityādayastrayo'nuvākāḥ | bhūmirbhūmnetyanuvākaḥ | devāsurāste devā vijayaṃ parā vā eṣa bhūmirbhūmnā dyaurvariṇetyāhetyanuvākatrayam | devāsurā agnīṣomayorityanuvākaḥ | upa prayantaḥ saṃpaśyāmītyanuvākau | mama nāmetyanuvākastāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtenetyantaḥ | ayajñaḥ saṃpaśyāmi prajā ahamityāhāgnihotraṃ juhotīti trayo'nuvākāḥ | yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ mana ityādayaḥ sapta praśnāḥ | tatrā''dyapraśnacatuṣṭayasyottamānuvākāñjīmūtasyeva yadakrando mā no mitro ye vājinamagnermanva iti pañcānuvākāṃśca varjayet | mā no hi sījjanitetyanuvākādūrdhvaṃ saśāntika āpyāyasva madintametyanuvākaḥ | iyametyanuvākādūrdhvaṃ saśāntika īyuṣṭe ya ityanuvākaḥ | prajāpatirmanasetyanuvākādūrdhvaṃ saśāntiko jyotiṣmatīmityanuvākaḥ | āyuṣaḥ prāṇamindro dadhīca ityanuvākau | sāvitrāṇītyādayaḥ sapta praśnāḥ | tatra samiddho añjangāyatrī triṣṭubjagatī kastvā''cchyati prajāpaterakṣi pavasva vājasātaya ityanuvākān, indrāya rājñe sūkara iti caturdaśānuvākānrohito dhūmrarohita iti trayodaśānuvākānstegānda ṣṭābhyāmiti ṣoḍaśānuvākāṃśca varjayet | aṅgiraso vai satramāsateti praśnaḥ | udasthānni vā etasyetyanuvākau | saṃjñānaṃ loko'sīti praśnau | brahma vai caturhotāra ityādayaḥ pañcānuvākāḥ | ityāgneyakāṇḍam | atha vaiśvadevakāṇḍam | anumatyai puroḍāśamitisaṃhitāntargataḥ praśna uttamānuvākavarjam | ṛtameva parameṣṭhītyanuvākaḥ | brāhmaṇāntargatā anumatyādayastrayaḥ praśnāḥ | prajā vai satramāsatāgnirvāva saṃvatsara ityanuvākau | devā vai yadyajñe'kurvata tadasurā akurvata te surā ūrdhvamityanuvākaḥ | vāyavya śvetamityādayaścatvāraḥ praśnāḥ |tatrottamānuvākānvarjayet | prajāpatirakāmayata prajāḥ sṛjeyetīti tṛtīyakāṇḍam | tatra pañcapraśnānāmantimānanuvākānvarjayet | iṣe tvetyādiraśmirasītyantānāṃ praśnānāṃ krameṇottamānuvākā uśantastvetyetatpūrvaṃ yukṣvāhītyanuvākaśca | devasya tvetyādayaḥ prajananapraśnaśeṣā daśānuvākāḥ | ekasmā ityādaya ekādaśānuvākāḥ | arvāṅityādayo daśānuvākāḥ | meṣastvā pacatairavatvityādaya ekādaśānuvākāḥ | pṛthivyai svāhetyādayaścaturdaśānuvākāḥ | jīmūtasya yadakrando mā no mitro ye vājinamagnermanva iti pañcānuvākāḥ | indrāya rājñe sūkara ityādayaścaturdaśānuvākāḥ |rohito dhūmrarohita ityādayastrayodaśānuvākāḥ | stegānda ṣṭābhyāmiti ṣoḍa śānuvākāḥ | samiddho añjangāyatrī kastveti trayo'nuvākāḥ | prayāsāya svāhā citta saṃtāneneti dvāvanuvākau | prajāpaterakṣi pavasva vājasātaya ityanuvākau | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya śira ityanuvākaḥ | sāṃgrahaṇyā prajāpatiraśvamedhamasṛjateti praśnadvayam | aṅgiraso vai satramāsatetyādayaḥ prajananapraśnāntargatāḥ saptānuvākāḥ | sādhyā vai, ityārabhya daśānuvākāḥ | prajavaṃ vā ityārabhya daśānuvākāḥ | bṛhaspatirakāmayata śranme devā ityārabhyaikādaśānuvākāḥ | gāvo vā ityārabhya daśānuvākāḥ | navaitānyahāni bhavantītyādiḥ praśnaśeṣaḥ | yasya prātaḥsavana ityādayastrayo'nuvākāḥ | juṣṭo damūnā iti praśnadvayam | pīvonnāmiti praśnaḥ | bhartā sanhari harantamityanuvākau | agnirnaḥ pātviti praśnaḥ | agneḥ kṛttikā ityanuvākatrayam | svādvīṃ tvetipraśnaḥ | yuva surāmamityanuvākaḥ | sarvānvā iti praśnaḥ | añjantīti praśnaḥ | brahmaṇe brāhmaṇamiti praśnaḥ | tubhyaṃ tā ityādayaścatvāro'nuvākāḥ | iti vaiśvadevakāṇḍam | saśāntikaḥ saha vai devānāmiti praśnaḥ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ kāṇḍam bhadraṃ karṇebhiriti praśna āruṇaṃ kāṇḍam | śaṃ no mitra iti pūrvottaraśāntisahitaḥ śīkṣāṃ vyākhyāsyāma iti praśnaḥ sā hityo devatā upaniṣadaḥ | saśāntiko'mbhasya pāra iti praśno yājñikyo devatā upaniṣadaḥ | brahmavidbhṛgurvai vāruṇiriti praśnadvayaṃ saśāntikaṃ vāruṇyo devatā upaniṣadaḥ | mātṛdattena tu svāyaṃbhuvakāṇḍamātramadhikaṃ pākṣikatvena saṃgṛhītam | āruṇādikāṇḍāni tu naiva saṃgṛhītāni | tatkalpe bhadrapraśna āgneyakāṇḍe'ntarbhavati | kāṭhakatvasāmānyāt | avaśiṣṭāḥ pañca praśnā vaiśvadevakāṇḍasyāntyatvāttatraivāntarbhavanti | svāyaṃbhuvakāṇḍasya pṛthaktvapakṣe tasyaivāntyatvāttatrāntarbhāvo jñeyaḥ | etadyathākāṇḍamadhyayanam | rudra āraṇyake ca viśeṣo'nukramaṇikāyām -- "hotṛpravargyakāṇḍaṃ ca yāścopaniṣado viduḥ | aruṇāmnāyavidhī caiva kāṭhake parikīrtitau || rudro nārāyaṇaścaiva medho yaścaiṣa pitriyaḥ | rudramāraṇyakaṃ caiva nāvratī śrotumarhati" iti || hotā cittiḥ srugiti praśnaḥ | pravargyakāṇḍaṃ yuñjate devā vai satramāsateti praśnadvayam | upaniṣadaḥ śīkṣādayastrayaḥ praśnāḥ | aruṇo bhadrapraśnaḥ | āmnāyavidhiḥ sa ha vai praśnaḥ | rudro namaste rudreti praśnaḥ | nārāyaṇo'mbhasyeti praśnaḥ | pitriyo medhaḥ pare yuvā samiti praśnaḥ | etatsarvamavratyekabhaktabrahmacaryādiniyamarahitaḥ śrotumapi nārhati kutastasyādhyayanam | aruṇaścā''mnāyavidhiścāruṇāmnāyavidhī | tau kāṭhake parikīrtitau | kāṭhakasaṃjñayā samākhyātāvityarthaḥ | hotupravargyakāṇḍamityādi pitriya ityantaṃ saṃjñāpradarśanārtham | araṇye'dhyetavyatvādāraṇyakatvam | atha divākīrtyāni | "kārīryaścātha pitryāśca divākīrtyeti yatra ca | rudraḥ saṃtatirityetāvanuvākau ca sātrike || hotṛvidhyavasāne ca anuvākacatuṣṭayam | sūkteṣu sūktaṃ yatsauryaṃ medho yaścaiṣa pitriyaḥ || kāṭhakāni ca sarvāṇi sarvāṇyāraṇyakāni ca | divākīrtyāni śākhāyāmetāvantīti dhāraṇā" iti || kārīryo mārutamasi marutāmiti catvāro'nuvākāḥ | pitryāḥ somāya pitṛmate, uśantastvā havāmaha uśantaḥ, indro vṛtra hatvā, vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata tā varuṇapraghāsaiḥ, agnaye devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ, surāvantaṃ barhiṣada suvīram, uśantastvā havāmaha ā no agne suketunā, ityete'nuvākāḥ | divākīrtyeti padaṃ yasminnanuvāke sa cāsāvādityo'sminniti | rudro namasta iti praśnaḥ | sātrike'nuvākacatuṣṭaye saṃtatiriti dvāvanuvākau divākīrtyāvityarthaḥ | sātrike satrasaṃbandhini prakaraṇa ityarthaḥ | divākīrtyeti yatra cetyanenaiva siddhe saṃtatirityādivacanaṃ brāhmaṇasya parāyātatvāddivākīrtyeti yatra cetyasyāprāptirāśaṅkitā syātsā mā bhūdityetadartham | hotṛvidhiḥ prajāpatirakāmayata prajāḥ sṛjeyeti sa etaṃ daśahotāramiti praśnaḥ | brahmavādina ityasya praśnasyānuvākasaptakaṃ hotṛvidhiḥ | tasyāvasānaṃ virāmaḥ samāptiḥ | tasyāṃ satyāṃ yadanuvākacatuṣṭayaṃ prajāpatiḥ so'ntarvānityādikaṃ tacca divākīrtyamityarthaḥ | "garbhādayo'nuvākā ye tānanhyeva paṭheddvijaḥ" iti | "dvitīyakāṇḍasya bhavedbrāhmaṇe yastṛtīyakaḥ | praśnastasyāntyānuvākāṃścaturo vai paṭheddine" || itivacanadvayasaṃvādādayamartho labhyate | sūkteṣu madhye yatsūktaṃ sauryaṃ sūryadevatākaṃ sūryo devīmuṣasamityārabhya sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaścetyantam | yaśca pitriyo medhaḥ pare yuvā samiti praśnaḥ sa divākīrtya ityarthaḥ | kārīryaścāpi pitryaścetyanenaiva siddhe medho yaścaiṣa pitriya iti vacanaṃ pare yuvā samiti praśnasya pitriyo medha iti saṃjñāsiddhyartham | kāṭhakāni, kaṭhaśākhāpravartakena muninoktatvātkāṭhakānītyucyante | tāni cāṣṭau sāvitranāciketacāturhotravaiśvasṛjāruṇaketukākhyāḥ pañca citayaḥ | tatra saṃjñānamiti praśnaḥ sāvitracitiḥ | loko'sītipraśno nāciketacitiḥ | brahma vai caturhotāra ityanuvākaścāturhotracitiḥ | yaccāmṛtamityādayaścatvāro'nuvākā vaiśvasṛjacitiḥ | bhadraṃ karṇebhiritipraśna āruṇaketukacitiḥ | etāḥ pañca citayaḥ | divaḥśyenyākhyeṣṭisamudāya ekaḥ | apādyākhyeṣṭisamudāyo'paraḥ | tatra tubhyaṃ devebhya iti dvāvanuvākau divaḥśyenyākhyeṣṭisamudāyaḥ | tapasā devā devebhyo vā iti dvāvanuvākāvapādyākhyeṣṭisamudāyaḥ | iti dvāviṣṭisamudāyau | āmnāyavidhiḥ svādhyāyabrāhmaṇamaṣṭamam | tacca saha vai devānāmitipraśnātmakam | āmnāyasyā''mnāyādhyayanasya vidhirbāhmaṇaṃ yasminpraśne sa āmnāyavidhistam | anena kṛtsnasya praśnasya saṃgrahaḥ siddho bhavati | etānyaṣṭau kāṭhakāni bhadraṃ karṇebhirityādīni nārāyaṇāntānyāraṇyakāni ca divākīrtyāni | divaiva kīrtyāni kīrtitavyāni na tu rātrāvityarthaḥ | taittirīyaśākhāyāmetāvantyeva divākīrtyānītyavadhāraṇā kartavyetyantyārdhārthaḥ | eteṣāṃ kāṇḍarṣīṇāṃ pratyahaṃ tarpaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ, taduktaṃ tatraiva -- "atha kāṇḍaṛṣīnetānudakāñjalibhiḥ śuciḥ | avyagrastarpayennityamannaiḥ parvāṣṭamīṣu ca" iti || atha sarvakāṇḍādhyayanānantaram, avyagraḥ śuciśca sannityaṃ pratyahamudakāñjalibhiretānkāṇḍarṣīstarpayet | parvasvamāvāsyāpaurṇamāsīṣvaṣṭamīṣu ca |annairapi tarpayedityarthaḥ | etacca sūtrānuktatvātkṛtākṛtam | karaṇe phalādhikyamakaraṇe pratyavāyābhāva iti draṣṭavyam | sārasvatapāṭhenādhyayane'pi kāṇḍānukramajñānamapekṣitamevetyetadarthe vacanaṃ tu prāgevodāhṛtam | ko'yaṃ sārasvato nāma kaśca sārasvataḥ pāṭha ityākāṅkṣāyāmitihāsaḥ pradarśyate | brahmasabhāyāṃ durvāsāḥ sāma gāyannāsa | taṃ khalu tejasā krūraṃ dṛṣṭvā sabhāmadhye sarasvatyasmayata | tataḥ kruddho muniḥ sarasvatīṃ śaśāpa martyayonau prajāyasveti | tatastaṃ devī prasādayāmāsa bhagavanvipragṛhe prajāyeyamiti | tataḥ sa munistathetyuktvā jagāma | tato devyātreyagṛhe'jāyata | tato vedavidaṃ bhartāraṃ prāpya vidyānidhiṃ putraṃ sarasvatī prāsūta | tato vidyānidhiṃ kṛtopanayanaṃ putraṃ pitā sārasvataṃ vedamadhyāpayāmāsa yathāvṛddhakrameṇa | tatastaṃ bālatvādalpamedhasaṃ pitā tāḍayāmāsa pṛṣṭhe veṇudalena | tataḥ so'rodīt | sā'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā putramāliṅgyātiduḥkhitā babhūva | aśrupūrṇaṃ taṃ vāgīśā nivārya ca punaḥ punaḥ | tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa yasyāḥ kasyāḥ suto nahi || prāpya māṃ tāḍyate bālo mama prāṇapriyaḥ sutaḥ | tataścatuḥṣaṣṭikalāḥ sarvānvedānsāṅgānbrahmavidyāparyantānsārasvatāya sarasvatyupādiśat | kṣutpipāse nivartya vāyudhāraṇāṃ copādiśat | tataḥ saṃpūrṇavidyo'sau kurukṣetre vasanmuniḥ | tapastepe mahābhāgo devairapi suduṣkaram || tataḥ kālena mahatā hyanāvṛṣṭirabhūtkila | kurukṣetre sārasvataṃ hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭamantarvāyuṃ dhāryamāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ dadṛśuḥ | tamūcurmunayaḥ sarve śākaṃ dehīti naḥ prabho | alaṃ śākena bho viprā yadi śāko bhavedbhuvi || sārasvato muniḥ prāha tebhyo dehīti caṇḍikām | suta śākaṃ pradāsyāmi yadi śākena te hyalam || śākaṃbharīti muninā prasannā'kāri vai tadā | śākāhārāstataḥ sarve munayaḥ kṛtajīvitāḥ | durbhikṣe vinivṛtte'pyadhyayanaṃ nāsmaraṃstadā || anyonyamabhijagmusta uccaraṃśca na kaṃcana | tato vismṛtavedāstu babhūvurmunayo bhṛśam || tato'tiduḥkhiteṣu muniṣu nāradenoktaṃ sārasvataṃ kṛtasarvavedādhyayanaṃ gatvā'dhyayanaṃ kurudhvamiti | tataste sārasvataṃ prārthayāmāsuḥ | adhyāpanaṃ kuruṣva bhagavanniti | tataḥ sārasvataḥ prārthitaścatuḥṣaṣṭimunigaṇasahasrebhyaścatuḥṣaṣṭisahasrave dānadhyāpayāmāsa | tatastānvedāṃstacchākhinaḥ sākalyenādhītavantaḥ | taittirīyaśākhinastu sākalyenādhyayanaṃ kṛtvā sarvavedavilakṣaṇāṃ taittirīyaśākhāṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyonyamūcuḥ | aho, atīva vismayo'smākaṃ sarvavilakṣaṇāṃ śākhāmadhyāpayati smāsmānmūḍhānkṛtvā nirmitām | tataḥ sarve taittirīyaśākhinaḥ saṃbhūya sārasvatamūcuḥ -- nāyaṃ vedastvayā'dhyāpitaḥ sarvavedavilakṣaṇatvāditi | tataḥ sārasvataḥ sarvāñchreṣṭhānmunīnprāha vacaḥ -- yadyayaṃ na bhavedvedaḥ pratijñāṃ tu karomyaham | agnipraveśanaṃ kuryāṃ bhavanto vācamīritām || tamūcurmunayaḥ sarve vacanaṃ yattvayoditam | yadi vedakramaṃ vipra pratijñāṃ kurmahe vayam || tataḥ sārasvatena sahitāḥ sarve munayastatra tatra munīngatvā nirṇetuṃ na śaknumaḥ, iti tairuktā brahmāṇaṃ jagmuryathāyathaṃ pratijñā niveditāḥ | brahmā'pi muniṃ sārasvatamāha | satyaṃ pratijñātaṃ tatrabhavatā sārasvatena | sārasvato vedapāṭhaḥ sārasvatoktakrameṇaivādhyetavyo'nyathā'dhyayanaphalaṃ nāstīti | tata itarānmunīnprāha | satyaṃ na pāṭhakrameṇārthānuṣṭhānakramo bhavatīti | tasmātsarvairjitaṃ nāgnipraveśanaṃ kartavyamitītihāsaḥ | kāṇḍānukramaṇarītyā sārasvatapāṭhena vā vedādhyayanamavaśyaṃ kartavyam | tathā ca śrutiḥ -- "tasmātsvādhyāyo'dhyetavyo yaṃ yaṃ ṛtumadhīte tena tenāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati" iti | svaḥ svakīyo'dhyāyaḥ śākhā | taduktaṃ bhaṭṭapādaiḥ -- "atra svādhyāyaśabdena svaśākhaikā tu gṛhyate" iti | anena ca svādhyāyādhyayanasya prāthamyamāvaśyakatvaṃ coktaṃ na tu dvitīyavedādhyayanasya nivṛttiḥ | evaṃ ca -- "vedānadhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vā'pi yathākramam" ityaviruddham | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "veda eva dvijātīnāṃ niḥśreyasakaraḥ paraḥ | yaṃ yaṃ ṛtumadhīyīta tasya tasyā''pnuyātphalam" iti | smṛtisāramuccaye -- "vedo yasya śarīrastho na sa pāpena lipyate | vedātmā sa tu vijñeyaḥ śarīraiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || vedākṣarāṇi yāvanti paṭhitāni dvijātibhiḥ | tāvanti harināmāni kīrtitāni na saṃśayaḥ || yasya vedaśca vedī ca vicchidyete tripūruṣam | sa vai durbrāhmaṇo nāma sarvakarmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yaccānyatkarma vaidikam | anadhītasya viprasya sarvaṃ bhavati niṣphalam || anadhīto dvijo yastu śāstrāṇi tu bahūnyapi | śṛṇotyābrahmaṇo nāśaṃ narakaṃ sa prapadyate || nādhītavedo yo vipra ācārebhyaḥ pravartate | nā''cāraphalamāpnoti yathā śūdrastathaiva saḥ || anadhītasya viprasya putro vā'dhyayanānvitaḥ | śūdraputraḥ sa vijñeyo na vedaphalamaśnute || adhyayanānvito vedādhyayanānvitaḥ | anabhyāsācca vedānāmācārasya ca laṅnāt | ālasyādannadoṣācca mṛtyurviprāñjighāṃsati" iti | bṛhannāradīye -- "anadhītya tu yo vedāñśāstrāṇi paṭhate dvijaḥ | śūdratulyaḥ sa vijñeyo narakāyopapadyate" iti || anyacca -- "śabdabrahmamayo viṣṇurvedaḥ sākṣāddhariḥ smṛtaḥ | vedādhyāyī tu yo vipraḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt" iti || tasmādbrāhmaṇenāvaśyaṃ vedo'dhyetavyaḥ | tatra vedābhyāsaḥ pañcadhā | tathā ca smṛtiḥ -- "vedasvīkaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vicāro'bhyasanaṃ japaḥ | taddānaṃ caiva śiṣyebhyo vedābhyāso hi pañcadhā" iti | tatrāpyādau paramparāgato vedaḥ paṭhanīyaḥ | tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "pāramparyāgato yeṣāṃ vedaḥ saparibṛṃhaṇaḥ | prathamaṃ tamadhīyīta tacchākhaṃ karma cā''caret" iti || paribṛṃhaṇāni chandaādīnyaṅgāni mīmāṃsādīnyupāṅgāni ca | taiḥ sahitaḥ pāramparyāgato vedo yastaṃ prathamamadhīyītetyarthaḥ | vārāhe -- "svaśākhāṃ prathamaṃ yastu paṭhitvā'nyāṃ paṭhedyadi | pratyakṣaraṃ tu labhate gāyatryā dviguṇaṃ phalam" iti || vyāsaḥ -- "tapoviśeṣairvividhairvrataiśca śruticoditaiḥ | vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ sarahasyo dvijanmanā" iti || rahasyamupaniṣat | svaśākhātyāgapūrvakaparaśākhāśrayaṇe doṣamāha vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "yaḥ svaśākhāṃ parityajya paraśākhāṃ samāśrayet | sa śūdravadbahiḥ kāryaḥ sarvakarmasu sādhubhiḥ || na jātu paraśākhoktaṃ budhaḥ karma samācaret | ācaranparaśākhoktaṃ śākhāraṇḍaḥ sa ucyate || adhītya śākhāmātmīyāṃ paraśākhāṃ tataḥ paṭhet | tacchākhīyaistu saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛto brāhmaṇo bhavet" iti || jātu kadācidapītyarthaḥ | tacchākhīyaiḥ svaśākhāproktaiḥ | śābīyabrāhmaṇa uktatvādaṣṭau vikṛtīrapi sati sāmarthye paṭhet | tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni taittirīyabahvṛcyaprātiśākhyaśikṣādibhyo'vagantavyāni | taittirīyāṇāṃ svaprātiśākhye jaṭāntavikṛtiviṣaya eva pramāṇopalambhātsatyapi sāmarthye tāvadeva vā'dhyayanam | saṃhitāpadakramādhyanasya kāmyatvamapyuktaṃ bahvṛcāraṇyake -- "annādyakāmo nirbhujaṃ brūyātsvargakāmaḥ pratṛṇṇamubhayakāma ubhayamantareṇa" iti | dvayoḥ padayorakṣarayorvā yaḥ saṃdhistasyāvicchedenādhyayanaṃ tannirbhujaṃ saṃhitāpārāyaṇamucyate | dvayoḥ padayoḥ saṃdhirāhityenoccāraṇaṃ pratṛṇṇaṃ padapārāyaṇam | nirbhujaṃ pratṛṇṇaṃ caitadubhayamantareṇa na kevalaṃ nirbhujaṃ na kevalaṃ pratṛṇṇametādṛśaṃ kramapārāyaṇamityasyārthaḥ | śākhābhedastvadhyayanabhedātsūtrabhedādvā vaijayantīkārairupodghātagranthe prapañcitaḥ | etacchākhādhyetṛṛṣiparamparā, etacchākhāyāḥ śakunivṛṣabhavṛkṣasvarūpatvaṃ coktaṃ kāṇḍānukramaṇikāyām -- "vaiśampāyano yāskāyaitāṃ śākhāṃ prāha paiṅgaye | yāskaḥ paiṅgistittiraya ukhāya prāha tittiriḥ || ukhaḥ śākhāmimāṃ prāha ātreyāya yaśasvine | tena śākhā praṇīteyamātreyī iti procyate || yasyāṃ padakṛdātreyo vṛttikārastu kuṇḍinaḥ | tāṃ vidvāṃso mahāśākhāṃ bhadramaśnuvate mahat || triśīrṣāṇarkāṃsaṃ navātmānamaṣṭapuccham | dvātriṃśatpakṣaṃ samanvīkṣecchakuniṃ brahmasaṃmitam || uttamopaniṣado'sya śiro'rkāvaṃsau bhuvanasya paternava yānyātmā saḥ | kaṭhavihitāni viduḥ pucche'ṣṭau yadapi ca śeṣaṃ tau pakṣau || mantrātmā dharmaśṛṅgo'ṣṭāsya upaniṣatkakut | vidhyaṅga ṛṣabhaḥ svarviccaturhotṛlalāmavān || śākhādyādiṃ vipāpmānaṃ vidhimantramayaṃ sakam | samāntametaṃ panthānaṃ diva āhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || rahasyamūla ṛkparṇo yajuppuṣpapravālavān | sāmātharvaskandaśākho viprabhramarasevitaḥ || yajñakarmaphalaḥ śrīmānbrāhmo vṛkṣaḥ sākṣādeṣaḥ | yastaṃ vidyātsaharṣibhirvipraḥ sa svargacchedāptvā kīrtim" iti || pūrvamekībhūya sthitā vedāstattadvedādhyāyinaḥ sakala vedādhyayanaṃ kartumasamarthāndṛṣṭvā'dhītavedatvasiddhaye jagadupakārāya ca vedavyāsena vedā vyastāstattacchākhāparicchinnāḥ kṛtāḥ | tataḥ sa bhagavānvaiśaṃpāyananāmne svaśiṣyāya yajurvedaṃ prāha | tataḥ sa vaiśampāyano yāskanāmne munaya etāṃ taittirīyaśākhāṃ prāha | sa ca yāskaḥ paiṅgaye | paliṅgava ityapi pāṭhaḥ | sa cāsmatsūtrānuguṇaḥ | tataḥ paiṅgirṛṣistittiraye | sa cokhāya | sa cā''treyāya | yaśasvī tyātreyasya viśeṣaṇam | yaśasvitvamevā''ha -- "tena śākhā praṇīteyamātreyī iti procyate" ityanena | tenā''treyeṇeyaṃ śākhā'nyebhyaḥ praṇītā'dhyāpitā satyātreyīti saṃjñāṃ prāptavatī | etādṛśaṃ yaśa ātreyasya | yasyāḥ śākhāyā ātreya ṛṣiḥ padakṛdbhavati | vṛttikāraḥ kuṇḍina ṛṣirbhavati | etādṛśī tāṃ mahāśākhāmadhītavanto vidvāṃso mahadbhadraṃ kalyāṇamaśnuvate | athaitacchākhātmakasya vedasya śakunivṛṣabhasvarūpamāha -- triśīrṣāṇamityārabhya caturhotṛlalāmavānityantena | triśīrṣāṇamarkāṃsaṃ navātmānamaṣṭapucchaṃ dvātriṃśatpakṣametādṛśaṃ śakuniṃ samanvīkṣet, yo jānīyātsa brahmaṇaḥ saṃmataṃ brahmalokaṃ gacchedityarthaḥ | brahmasaṃmitamitipāṭhe śakunerviśeṣaṇam | uttamā upaniṣadaḥ śīkṣā brahmavidbhṛguriti praśnatrayam | etāsāmuttamatvaṃ tu bāhulyena brahmajñānopayogitvāt | arkau pravargyakāṇḍe aṃsau skandhau yasya | bhuvanasya patiḥ prajāpatiḥ "prajāpatirvai bhuvanasya patiḥ" iti śruteḥ | prajāpateryāni nava kāṇḍāni śākhādiṃ yājamānaṃ cetyādinā navā''huḥ kasya tadvida ityantenoktāni tāni tasyā''tmā | kaṭhaśākhāpravartakena muninā proktānyaṣṭau kāṭhakāni pucche pucchasthāne viduḥ | vedavida iti śeṣaḥ | yadapi ca śeṣaṃ kāṇḍaṃ śeṣabhūtāni kāṇḍāni dvātriṃśattāni pakṣau tasya śakuneḥ | iti śakunisvarūpam | atha vṛṣabhasvarūpam | mantrātmā mantrabhāga ātmā yasya | gharmau pravargyakāṇḍe te śṛṅge yasya | aṣṭau kāṭhakāni āsyaṃ mukhaṃ yasya so'ṣṭāsyaḥ | upaniṣadaḥ kakudyasya | vidhyaṅgo brāhmaṇānyavaśiṣṭānyaṅgāni yasya | caturhotāraścittiḥ srugityādayo mantrāḥ sabrāhmaṇā lalāmāni bhūṣaṇāni yasya | etādṛśamṛṣabhasvarūpaṃ yo veda sa svarvitsvargavidbhavedityarthaḥ | śākhā svaśākhā''dyā yeṣāṃ te svaśākhādyā anye vedāsta ādirmūlaṃ yasya tam | atra tadguṇasaṃvijñānabahuvrīhirjñeyaḥ | vipāpmānaṃ vigatakalmaṣam | vidhimantramayaṃ mantrabrāhmaṇātmakam | sakaṃ sukhasahitam | samo vaiṣamyarahito'ntaḥ prānto yasya | etādṛśaṃ divaḥ svargasya panthānaṃ mārgaṃ manīṣiṇa ṛṣaya āhuḥ | vedādhyayanataduktakarmācaraṇameva svargasya panthā iti tātparyāḥ | atha vṛkṣasvarūpam | rahasyamupaniṣado mūlaṃ yasya | ṛcaḥ parṇāni yasya | yajūṃṣi puṣpāṇi pravālāni ca yasya | sāmānyatharvāṇaḥ skandhāḥ śākhāśca yasya | viprā eva bhramarāstaiḥ sevitaḥ | yajñakarmāṇyeva phalāni yasya | śrīmāñśobhāvāneṣa brāhmo brahmarūpa eva sākṣādbhavati | yastaṃ vṛkṣaṃ vidyājjānīyātsa ṛṣibhiḥ sahito vipro'smim̐lloke kīrtiṃ puṇyāṃ kīrtimāptvā prāpya svaḥ svargaṃ gacchedityarthaḥ | sa harṣirvipra iti pāṭhe sa ṛṣirṛṣitulyo vipra ityarthaḥ | heti nipāto'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | ṛṣiparijñānaphalamapyuktamanukramaṇikāyām -- "etānṛṣīnyajurvedaṃ yaḥ paṭhanveda vedavit | ṛṣīṇāmeti sāyujyaṃ sālokyaṃ brahmaṇastathā" iti || yo vedavidyajurvedaṃ paṭhannetānuktānṛṣīnveda sa ṛṣīṇāṃ sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sālokyaṃ caitītyarthaḥ | sarvo'pi vedaḥ sārtho'dhyetavyaḥ | taduktaṃ parāśareṇa -- "jñātavyaḥ sarvavedārthaḥ sarvakarmaprasiddhaye | pāṭhamātramadhīyānaḥ paṅke gauriva sīdati" iti | paṅke kardame | yāsko'pi -- "yadgṛhītamavijñātaṃ nigadenaiva śabdyate | anagnāviva śuṣkaidho na tajjvalati karhicit | sthāṇurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham | yo'rthajña itsakalaṃ bhadramaśnute nākameti jñānavidhūtapāpmā" iti || mīmāṃsakairapi sārthavedādhyayanam 'athāto dharmajijñāsā' 'athāto brahmajijñāsā' iti pūrvottaramīmāṃsādibhūtayoḥ sūtrayorvyākhyāvasara uktam | yajurvedasvarūpaṃ tribhāṣyaratne -- "yajurvedaḥ piṅgalākṣaḥ kṛśamadhyo bṛhadgalaḥ | bṛhatkapolaḥ kṛṣṇāṅghristāmraḥ kaśyapagotrajaḥ" iti | caraṇavyūhe prādeśamātratvamapyuktam | athādhyayanamuhūrtaḥ saṃgrahe -- "uttarāyaṇage sūrye kumbhamāsaṃ vivarjayet | vidyārambhe vratoddeśe kṣaure caiva viśeṣataḥ" iti | smṛtisāre -- "vidyārambho vrataṃ kṣauraṃ na bhavettu galagrahe" iti | galagrahāstūpanayanakālanirūpaṇa uktāḥ | vārānāha mārkaṇḍeyo vidyārambhaṃ prakṛtya -- "vāre dineśabhṛgusujñabṛhaspatīnāṃ vidvānasau bhavati" iti | dineśaḥ sūryaḥ | bhṛguḥ śukraḥ | sujño budhaḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "ravivāre tu pūrvāhṇe vidyārambho vidhīyate | candravāre'parāhṇe tu vidyā gurvī vidhīyate" iti || nakṣatrāṇyāha maheśvaraḥ -- "hastāditritayaṃ tathā nirṛtibhe pūrvāntyabheṣvaśvibhe mitrarkṣe ca mṛgādipañcasu śubhaḥ prārambha ādyaḥ smṛtaḥ | vidyānāṃ haribhatraye ca divase sūrerbhṛgorvā dine'nadhyāyākhyatadādyavarjitatithau kendrasthitaiḥ sadgrahaiḥ" iti || hastāditritayaṃ hastacitrāsvātayaḥ | nirṛtibhaṃ mūlanakṣatram | pūrvā pūrvātrayam | antyabhaṃ revatīnakṣatram | aśvibhamaśvinīnakṣatram | mitrarkṣamanūrādhānakṣatram | haribhatrayaṃ śravaṇadhaniṣṭhāśatatārakāḥ | sūrirbṛhaspatiḥ | bhṛguḥ śukraḥ | anadhyāyadinānyanadhyāyādyadināni ca varjayitvā kendrasthānasthitaiḥ sadgrahaiḥ śubhagrahairyutairlagnairyutāsu tithiṣu ca vidyānāmādyaḥ prathamaḥ prārambhaḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ | anyacca rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "vidyārambhaḥ praśasto bhavati madhuripau prāptabodhe śaśāṅke śaste tīkṣṇadyutau ca tridaśapatigurāvudgate cātha śukre | svādhyāye siṃhasaṃsthaṃ kharakiraṇayutaṃ devapūjyaṃ vihāya śukrādityajñavāre tridaśapatigurau kendrasaṃsthe na pāpe" iti || madhuripurviṣṇuḥ | tasminprāptabodhe sati | śaśāṅkaścandrastasminpraśaste | tīkṣṇadyutiḥ sūryastasmiṃśca praśaste sati | tridaśapatigururbṛhaspatistasmiṃñśukre codgate'nastage sati | kharakiraṇaḥ sūryastena yutaṃ devapūjyaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ siṃhasthaṃ vihāya svādhyāye svādhyāyadivase | śukrādityabudhānyatamavārayute tridaśapatigururbṛhaspatistasminkendrasaṃsthe ca sati vidyārambhaḥ praśasto bhavatītyarthaḥ | na pāpe na niṣiddhasthānasthite | "anadhyāyāḥ pradoṣāśca ṣaṣṭhī riktāstathaiva ca | varjanīyāḥ prayatnena vidyārambhe tu sarvadā" iti || akṣarārambhe vakṣyamāṇo yo gaṇapatiharilakṣmīgurupūjādividhiḥ so'trāpi kāryaḥ | śāstraviśeṣe vāraviśeṣamāha nṛsiṃhaḥ -- "sarvavedāṃśca śāstrāṇi cābhyasetsūryavāsare | kāmaśāstraṃ mahātantraṃ rogaghnaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā || aṅgaśāstraṃ bhiṣakśāstraṃ cāndre'hni satataṃ labhet | kṣudraśāstraṃ kulaghnaṃ ca raṇavādāgniśastrakam || astraśastraprayogaṃ ca kujavārāṃśakodaye | yogaśāstraṃ mahātantramadvaitaṃ brahmanaiṣṭhikam || gītakādyaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca kāmaśāstraṃ ca somaje | sarvavedānṣaḍaṅgāni jīvavāre samārabhet || maṅgalaṃ nṛtyavāditraṃ śrīkāmaṃ śrīpratiṣṭhitam | pūjāṅgavedavedārthamārabhecchukravāsare || śubhaṃ vā'pyaśubhaṃ vā'pi na smarecchāstramarkaje | vidyārambho yadi syāttu mandavārāṃśakodaye | purāṇamapi nāśāya narāṇāṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ" iti || kāmaśāstraṃ prasiddham | mahātantraṃ mantraśāstram | rogaghnaṃ bhiṣakśāstram | vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇumantrapūjādipratipādakam | mahātantraśabdo gobalīvardanyāyena vaiṣṇavātiriktaparaḥ | tathāśabdaḥ sūryavāsarānvayārthaḥ | "kāmaśāstraṃ mantraśāstraṃ ravivāre samabhyaset" | iti vākyāntarasaṃvādāt | aṅgaśāstraṃ sāmudrikam | kṣudraśāstraṃ bauddhādiśāstram | kulaghnamābhicārikaśāstram | mahātantratvena sūryavāsare'bhyāsaḥ prāptaḥ sa etasminnaṃśe na bhavati | kiṃ tu kujavāsara etasyābhyāsaḥ kartavya iti | raṇaśabdena mallaśāstram | astraśastraprayogasyāgre pṛthagupādānāt | vādo vyavahāraśāstram | agniśāstramagniyantranirmāṇādiśāstram | etena śilpaṃ sarvamupalakṣaṇīyam | yogaśāstraṃ prasiddham | mahātantraṃ sāṃkhyaśāstranyāyaśāstradharmaśāstrādi | advaitaṃ vedāntaśāstram | brahmanaiṣṭhikaṃ yatyāśramadharmapratipādakam | gītakādyaṃ nāradādipraṇītaṃ saṃgītaśāstram | nṛtyaṃ bharatapraṇītam | maṅgalamalaṃkārādiśāstram | śrīkāmaṃ śrīpradāyakam | adhyayanārambhakāle kṣutaṃ na hānikṛdityuktaṃ pratāpamārtaṇḍe jyotirnibandhe ca -- "bhaiṣajye vāhanārohe āsane śayane'śane | vidyārambhe bījavāpe kṣutaṃ hānikaraṃ nahi" iti || ityadhyayanārambhakālaḥ | athādhyāpakadharmāḥ | tatra yamaḥ -- "satataṃ prātarutthāya kṛtanityakriyo guruḥ | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kuryācchiṣyamadhyāpayettataḥ" iti || manurapi -- "adhyāpayiṣyamāṇastu yathākālamatandritaḥ | adhīṣva bho iti brūyādvirāmo'stviti cā''ramet" iti | adhyāpayiṣyamāṇa ityatra gururiti śeṣaḥ | āramedityatrāntarbhāvito ṇic | tena śiṣyamāramayedityartho labhyate | athavā''ramediti yathāśrutameva | adhyāpanānnivartetetyarthaḥ | smṛtau -- "ekaḥ śrotā dakṣiṇato niṣīdeddvau vā bhūyāṃsastu yathāvakāśam" iti | asyārthaḥ -- ekaḥ śrotā'dhyetā dakṣiṇata upaviśedathavā dvau śiṣyau | athavā bhūyāṃso bahavaḥ śiṣyā yathāvakāśamaniyama upaveśana iti | smṛtyantare -- "āsane tu samāsīna ācāntaḥ prāṅmukho guruḥ | praṇavaṃ prāksamuccārya śiṣyamadhyāpayetsadā" iti || tatraiva -- "abhyāsārthe drutāṃ vṛttiṃ prayogārthe tu madhyamām | śiṣyāṇāmupadeśārthaṃ kuryādvṛttiṃ vilambitām" iti || abhyāsārthe vedābhyāsārthe drutāṃ tvaritāṃ vṛttiṃ jānīyāt | prayogārthe karmārthe mantrapāṭhe madhyamāṃ vṛttiṃ jānīyāt | śiṣyopadeśārthe śiṣyādhyāpanārthe vilambitāṃ vṛttiṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "kṛtajñādrohimedhāviśucikalpānasūyakāḥ | adhyāpyā dharmataḥ sādhu śaktāptajñānavittadāḥ" iti || kṛtamupakāraṃ jānantīti kṛtajñāḥ | adrohiṇo droharahitāḥ | medhāvino dhāraṇāvantaḥ | śucayaḥ śuddhāḥ | kalpā nīrogāḥ | anasūyakā guṇināṃ doṣānāviṣkaraṇaśīlāḥ | śaktāḥ śuśrūṣāyām | āptā apratārakāḥ | jñānadā vidyāpradāḥ | vittadā arpaṇapūrvamarthadātāraḥ | dharmagrahaṇamarthopalakṣaṇam | nanvarthato'pyadhyāpya iti na saṃgacchate | bhṛtādhyayanabhṛtakādhyāpanayoḥ prāyaścittasmaraṇāt | tathā ca parāśaraprāyaścittakāṇḍe viṣṇuḥ -- "bhṛtakādhyayanaṃ kṛtvā bhṛtakādhyāpinastathā | anuyogapradānena trīnpakṣānyāvakaṃ pibet" iti || maivam | bhṛtisaṃkalpapūrvakamadhyāpanaṃ pratiṣiddhamitarasya vṛttihetutvenāvirodhāt | ata eva manuḥ -- "dharmārthau yatra na syātāṃ śuśrūṣā vā'pi tadvidhā | tatra vidyā na vaktavyā nyuptaṃ bījamivokhare" iti || vihitānanuṣṭhātre nāstikāya vā vidyādāne dharmābhāva ityarthaḥ | yamo'pi -- "dharmārthau yatra na syātāṃ na śuśrūṣā'pi tadvidhā | vidyayā saha martavyaṃ na vidyāmukhare vapet" iti || anantarodāhṛtabhṛtakādhyāpanaṃ kṛtvetivākyagatasyānuyogaśabdasyārtho mitākṣarāyām -- "adhīyānasya viprādestiraskāro'nuyogaḥ" iti | manurjñānado'pyadhyāpya ityāha -- "ācāryaputraḥ śuśrūṣurjñānado dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ | āptaśākho'rthadaḥ sādhustvadhyāpyaḥ syāttu dharmataḥ" iti || asūyakādayo nādhyāpyā ityāha vidyaiva -- "vidyā ha vai brāhmaṇamājagāma gopāya mā śevadhiṣṭe'hamasmi | asūyakāyānṛjave'yatāya na mā brūyā vīryavatī tathā syām" iti | śrutyantare tu -- asūyakāyānṛjave śaṭhāyeti pāṭhāntaram | asūyakāyānṛjave'yatāyetyatrāyatāyeti padacchedaḥ | vidyā brāhmaṇaṃ pratyājagāma paścāttaṃ prārthayāmāsa | he brāhmaṇa tvaṃ māṃ gopāyānadhikārasakāśādrakṣa | te tava śevadhirnidhirahamasmi | nidhiryathā'bhīṣṭapradātā tathā'hamasmītyarthaḥ | prārthyamāha -- asūyakāyetyādinā | jātaṃ niścayaṃ gurave pradarśya taddūṣaṇārthamevaidaṃparyeṇa yatamāno hetvābhāsopanyāsaśīlo duṣṭo'sūyakaḥ | gurūktiḥ sarvā'pi yathārthaiveti jñānaṃ viśvāsaḥ | sa nāsti yasya so'viśvāso'nṛjuśca | gurūktisamanantarameva jātaniścayo'pi yaḥ pūrvamevaitajjñātacaramiti, idānīmapi na jñātamiti vā pradarśayituṃ yatate sa śaṭhaḥ | ayatāyetipāṭhe'śucaya ityarthaḥ | tena pāṭhadvayamapi saṃgrāhyam | etādṛśāya puruṣāya na māṃ brūyāḥ | tathā tathā sati vīryavatyabhīṣṭaphaladātrī syāṃ nānyatheti śrutyarthaḥ | nāradaḥ -- "guruśuśrūṣayā vidyā puṣkalena dhanena vā | athavā vidyayā vidyā caturthaṃ nopalabhyate" iti || caturthaṃ sādhanam | viṣṇuḥ -- "nāparīkṣitaṃ yājayennādhyāpayennopanayedyadi tu yaḥ prāha yastu pṛcchati tayoranyataraḥ praiti doṣaṃ cādhigacchati" iti | praitītyasya maraṇaṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ | dharmasūtre -- "śayānaścādhyāpanaṃ varjayenna tasyāṃ śayyāyāmadhyāpaye dyasyāṃ saha śayīta" iti | divā naktaṃ ca śayānasyādhyāpanapratiṣedhaḥ | svasya tu dhāraṇārthamadhīyānasya na doṣaḥ | yasyāṃ śayyāyāṃ bhāryayā saha rātrau śayīta tasyāṃ śayyāyāmāsīno'pi nādhyāpayediti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | anyacca tatraiva -- "pravacanayukto varṣāśaradantaṃ maithunaṃ na caret" iti | pravacanamadhyāpanaṃ tena yukto varṣāsu śaradi ca maithunaṃ varjayediti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "anadhyāyo niśāyāmanyatra dharmopadeśācchiṣyebhyo manasā vā svayamūrdhvamardharātrādadhyāpanaṃ nāpararātramupotthāyānadhyāya iti saṃviśet" iti | niśāyāmanadhyāyo'dhyayanamadhyāpanaṃ ca na kuryāt | śiṣyebhyastu dharmopadeśo'nujñāyate | niśāyāmanadhyāyasya pratiprasavo manasā vā svayaṃ cintayediti | ūrdhvamardharātrādadhyāpanamityayamapi pratiprasavaḥ | niśāyāḥ ṣoḍaśanāḍikā ārabhyādhyayanaṃ bhavati | rātrestṛtīyo bhāgo'pararātram | ūrdhvamardharātrādupotthāyotthāyādhyāpayet | nāpararātraṃ saṃviśenna śayīta | yadyapi tasminnaṣṭamyādiranadhyāyaḥ prāpto bhavati kiṃ punaḥ svādhyāye | tathā ca manuḥ -- "na niśāyāṃ pariśrānto brahmādhītya punaḥ svapet" iti | (vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva |) tathā -- "na samāvṛtte samādeśo vidyate" iti | samāvṛttaśiṣyaṃ pratyācāryeṇasamādeśo na deya idaṃ tvayā na kartavyamiti | yathā'samāvṛttadaśāyāṃ dīyata udakumbhamāhareti | naimittike svecchayā karaṇe na pratiṣedhya iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "tasmingurorvṛttiḥ putramivainamanukāṅkṣansarvadharmeṣvanapacchādayamānaḥ suyukto vidyāṃ grāhayenna cainamadhyayanavighnenā''tmakāryeṣvabhyu parundhyādanāpatsvantevāsyanantevāsī bhavati vinihitātmā gurāvanaipuṇyamāpadyamānaḥ" iti | tasminnantevāsini gurorvṛttiprakāro vakṣyate | enaṃ śiṣyaṃ putramivābhyāhitaḥ syādityanukāṅkṣansarveṣu dharmeṣu kiṃcidapyanapacchādayannavigūhayansuyuktaḥ suṣṭvavahitastatparo bhūtvā vidyāṃ grāhayet | na cainaṃ śiṣyamadhyayanavighnenā''tmaprayojaneṣūparundhyādanāpatsu | uparodho'svatantrīkaraṇam | anāpatsvitivacanādāpadyadhyayanavighātenāpyuparodhe na doṣaḥ | āpadyamāna ityantarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ | yo'ntevāsī vinihitātmā dvayorācāryayorvinihitātmā gurāvanaipuṇyamāpādayati nāyaṃ pradeyaḥ samyagukta iti so'ntevāsī na bhavati sa tyājya ityartha iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "aparādheṣu caina satatamupālabhetābhitrāsopavāsodakopasparśanānyadarśanamiti daṇḍo yathāmātramānivṛtteḥ" iti | aparādheṣu kṛteṣvenaṃ śiṣyaṃ satatamupālabheranni(te)damayuktaṃ tvayā kṛtamiti | abhitrāso bhayotpādanam | upavāso bhojane'nnālābhaḥ | udakopasparśanaṃ śīta udake snāpanam | adarśanaṃ yathā'sāvātmānaṃ na paśyati tathā karaṇaṃ gṛhapraveśanirodhaḥ | sarvatra ṇyantātpratyayaḥ | ityete daṇḍāḥ śiṣyasya yathāmātraṃ yathāparādhaṃ tadanurūpaṃ vyastāḥ samastāścā''nivṛtteḥ, yāvadasau nato'parādhānnivartate tāvadete daṇḍā iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva śiṣyatāḍanaprakāro manunoktaḥ -- "bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca śiṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ | prāptāparādhāstāḍyāḥ syū rajjvā veṇudalena vā" iti || atra sodaraviśeṣaṇādbhinnodare bhrātari tāḍanaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ bhavati | vṛddhagautamo'pi -- "śiṣyaśiṣṭiravadhenāśaktau rajjuveṇudalābhyāṃ tanubhyāmanyena ghnanrājñā śāsyaḥ" iti | śiṣṭiḥ śāsanam | avadhena prahāraṃ vinā | prahāraṃ vinā śāsanāsaṃbhave prahāreṇaiva śāsanam | tacca rajjuveṇudalābhyāṃ tanubhyāṃ sūkṣmābhyāṃ na tu sthūlā bhyām | tanubhūtarajjuveṇudalavyatiriktenānyena pāṣāṇakhaṇḍādinā yaḥ śiṣyaṃ hanti praharati rājñā sa śāsya ityarthaḥ | etacca śirasi na kāryam | tathā ca manuḥ -- "pṛṣṭhatastu śarīrasya nottamāṅge kathaṃcana | ato'nyathā tu praharaṃścorasyā''pnoti kilbiṣam" iti | uttamāṅgaṃ śiraḥ | yamaḥ -- "yo'rthārthī sandvijo'dhyāyānpāṭhayettu vidhānataḥ | anadhyāye ca taṃ prāhurvedaviplavikaṃ budhāḥ" iti || adhyāyā vedāḥ | anadhyāye cetyatra cakāraḥ pūrvārdhasthasya dvijo'dhyāyānpāṭhayedityasyānukarṣaṇārthaḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "yo hi vidyāmadhītyārthine na saṃpradadāti na sa dharmabhāgbhavati" iti | vidyādānasya phalamāha saṃvartaḥ -- "vidyādānena mahati brahmaloke mahīyate" iti | iti saṃkṣepeṇādhyāpakadharmāḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇādhyetṛdharmāḥ | tatra manuḥ -- "adhyeṣyamāṇastvācānto yathāśāstramudaṅmukhaḥ | kṛtabrahmāñjaliścaiva laghuvāsā jitendriyaḥ" iti | atra dvirācamanamuktaṃ kūrmapurāṇe -- "snānānte'dhyayanārambhe kāsaśvāsāgame tathā | catvaraṃ vā śmaśānaṃ vā samāgamya dvijottamaḥ | saṃdhyayorubhayostadvadācānto'pyācamettataḥ" iti || brahmāñjalisvarūpaṃ tu sa evā''ha -- "saṃhatya hastāvadhyeyaṃ sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ smṛtaḥ" iti | saṃhatya saṃhatau kṛtvetyarthaḥ | atrā''dāvupasaṃgrahaṇamuktaṃ dharmasūtre -- "udite tvāditya ācāryeṇādhyayanāya sametyopasaṃgrahaṇam" iti | tatprakārastūpanayanaprakaraṇa uktaḥ | etaccānte'pi kartavyam -- "brahmārambhe'vasāne ca pādau grāhyau guroḥ sadā" iti manūkteḥ | brahma vedastasyā''rambha ityarthaḥ | adhyayanārambha oṃkāro'pi vaktavyaḥ,"oṃkāraḥ svargadvāraṃ tasmādbrahmādhyeṣyamāṇa etadādi pratipadyate" itidharmasūtrāt | oṃkāraḥ praṇavaḥ | brahma vedaḥ | etadādi, oṃkārādi | pratipadyata ārabhate | anyatspaṣṭamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | bhāradvājaśikṣāyām -- "praśnānuvākādyārambhe savisargoccako hariḥ | na saṃdhiḥ praṇave nityaṃ virāme svarito bhavet" iti | praśnāścānuvākāśca praśnānuvākāḥ | teṣu ya ādyaḥ praśno'nuvāko vā tasyā''rambha ityarthaḥ | praśnānuvākārambha ityetāvaducyamāne sarvapaśnānuvākārambhe vakṣyamāṇo vidhiḥ syātsa mā bhūdityetadarthamādyagrahaṇam | savisargaścoccakaśca savisargoccakaḥ | savisargaḥ prathamaikavacanānta ityarthaḥ | ucca evoccakaḥ | udātta iti yāvat | etādṛśo hariśabdaḥ praśnānuvākādyārambhe vaktavyaḥ | praṇave'gre sati nityaṃ sadā hariśabde saṃdhirna kartavya ityarthaḥ | virāme'vasāne'dhyayanasamāptau tu hariśabda uccaka udātto na bhavati kiṃtu nityaṃ sadā svaritaḥ, antyasvarita eva bhavet | saṃdhyabhāvo'pyatrāstyeveti | praṇavānantaraṃ vyāhṛtīstadanantaraṃ sāvitrīṃ cānubrūyāt | "praṇavaṃ prākprayuñjīta vyāhṛtīstadanantaram | sāvitryāścānuvacanaṃ tato vṛttāntamārabhet" iti saṃvartokteḥ | vṛttānto'dhyayanam | praṇavātpūrvaṃ prākkūladarbhāsanopaveśanaṃ pavitraiḥ pāvanaṃ prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ cā''ha manuḥ -- "prākkūlānparyupāsīta pavitraiścaiva pāvitaḥ | prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ pūtastata oṃkāramarhati" iti | prākkūlāḥ prāgagrā darbhāḥ | pavitrapāvanaṃ gautama āha -- "prāṇopasparśanaṃ darbhaiḥ" iti | prāṇāḥ śīrṣaṇyāni cakṣurādīnīndriyāṇi teṣāmupasparśanaṃ darbhairmārjanamiti haradattaḥ | adhyayanānte'pyoṃkāro vācyaḥ | "praṇavaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kuryādādāvante ca sarvadā" iti manūkteḥ | brahmaṇo vedasya | bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā virāmaḥ kāryaḥ | taduktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "oṃkāraṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā tato brahma pravartayet | oṃkāraṃ ca punaḥ kṛtvā bhūmiṃ spṛṣṭvā samāpayet" iti | adhyayanamiti śeṣaḥ | adhyayanasamāptāvapyupasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyaṃ śiṣyeṇa brahmārambhāvasānayorguroḥ pādopasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kāryamiti viṣṇūkteḥ | (vyāsaśikṣāyām -- "kāṇḍapraśnānuvākānte daśāṣṭau pañca mātrikāḥ | granthānāṃ tu samāptau tattriguṇaḥ kāla ucyate" iti | kāṇḍādīnāṃ samāptau virāmakālāḥ kramāddaśādimātrā bhaveyuḥ | kāṇḍānte yathā -- janadusriyāsu | praśnānte yathā -- kalpayāti | anuvākānte yathā -- paśūnpāhi | granthānāṃ samāptau virāme tatkāṇḍavirāmastriguṇaḥ kālastriṃśanmātra ityarthaḥ | yathā samudro bandhuḥ | yebhyaścainatprāhuḥ | om, iti | sarvasaṃmataśikṣāyāmapi -- "samāptāvanuvākasya mātrāṇāṃ pañcakaṃ smṛtam | aṣṭau daśeti vijñeyaṃ praśne kāṇḍe yathākramam || tantrāṇāṃ tu samāptau tattriguṇaḥ kāla iṣyate | vedasyopakrame vidvānavasāne'pyatandritaḥ || uccaretpraṇavaṃ brahma rakṣāyai chandasāṃ sphuṭam | ādāvanukte sravati parastācca viśīryate || prārambhakaścaturmātro vedasthaḥ syāttadardhakaḥ | adhyayanānuvākāntyaḥ karmādyaśca trimātrakaḥ || prārambhādyāḥ kramānnādā mātrāṇudvyaṇumātrikāḥ | vedārambhe tu yo nādo makāro mātriko bhavet" iti || tantraṃ granthaḥ | sravati cyavate | viśīryata ityatra veda iti śeṣaḥ | kārīryādyadhyayane vrataviśeṣaḥ kāṇḍānukramaṇikāyām -- "akṣārālavaṇaṃ bhūmau mukhena paśuvaddvijaḥ | catūrātraṃ tu bhuñjīta kārīryadhyayane vratam || kārīrīvratavaccāpi kalāvratamihocyate | na tatra paśuvadbhuñjyānna ca bhūmāviti sthitiḥ || kalāvrataṃ tu yatproktamagnikāṇḍe taducyate | sāvitrebhyaḥ prabhṛtyūrdhvamau(mo)ṣadhyanuvākāditi | samitkalāpaṃ tryahamāharanti [ca] mṛgāreṣṭyām" iti || kārīryo mārutamasi marutāmoja ityādayaścatvāro'nuvākāstadadhyayana etadvrataṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | kārīrīvratavadeva kalāvrataṃ kalāsaṃjñakaṃ vrataṃ yaduktaṃ tadagnikāṇḍe'gnikāṇḍādhyayane bhavati | anena sarvasminnapyagnikāṇḍe prāptau niyamamāha -- sāvitrebhya ityanena | sāvitrāḥ, yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ mana ityādyā aṣṭau mantrāstebhya ārabhya yā jātā oṣadhaya ityanuvākaparyantānāmadhyayana etadvrataṃ bhavati | mṛgāreṣṭiḥ, agnermanva ityanuvākastasyādhyayana ityarthaḥ | vaiśvadevamantrādhyayane vrataviśeṣa ukto dharmasūtre -- "teṣāmupayoge dvādaśāhaṃ brahmacaryamadhaḥśayyā kṣāralavaṇamadhumāṃsavarjanaṃ cottamasyaikarātramupavāsaḥ" iti | teṣāṃ homānāṃ balīnāṃ ca ye mantrāsteṣāmupayoge niyamapūrvake grahaṇe dvādaśāhaṃ brahmacaryaṃ maithunavarjanamadhaḥśayyā sthaṇḍilaśāyitvaṃ kṣāralavaṇādivarjanaṃ ca bhavati | upayoktureva vratam | anye tu patnyā apīcchanti, upayogaḥ prathamaprayogaḥ | tatra patnyā api sahādhikāra iti vadantaḥ | uttamasyottamena vaihāyasamitivakṣyamāṇasya ye bhūtāḥ pracarantītyasyaikarātramupavāsaḥ kartavya iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | asminvyākhyāna upayoktureva vratamityārabhya vadanta iti matāntarapradarśanam | niyamapūrvakaṃ grahaṇaṃ guroḥ sakāśādvidyāgrahaṇaṃ tadarthamityarthaḥ | bhadraprapāṭhakādhyayane viśeṣaḥ saṃvatsarametadvrataṃ caredityanuvāka uktaḥ | pravargyaprapāṭhakādhyayane viśeṣaḥ pravargyasūtre -- "avāntaradīkṣāṃ vyākhyāsyāma udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre'parāhṇe keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvā prācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya khile'cchadirdarśe'gnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya catastra audumbarīḥ samidha ārdrā apracchinnāgrāḥ prādeśamātrīrghṛtānvaktā abhyādhāpayati pṛthivī samidityetaiḥ pratimantramagne vratapate vrataṃ cariṣyāmītyetairyathārūpaṃ devatā upatiṣṭhate'thaina sarveṣāmanuvākānāṃ prabhṛtīrabhivyāhārayati prathamottamayorvā tataḥ saṃmīlya vācaṃ yacchatyathāsyāhatena vāsasā pradakṣiṇa samukha śiro veṣṭayitvā'stamite grāmaṃ prapādayati vāgyata etā rātriṃ tiṣṭhatyāste vā śvobhūte prācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya khile'cchadirdarśe'gnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya vayaḥ suparṇā iti mukhaṃ viveṣṭya ya udagāttaccakṣurityādityamupatiṣṭhate'thaina ṣaṭtayamabhividarśayati saptatayamityeke'gnimādityamudakumbhamaśmāna hiraṇyaṃ vatsaṃ mahānagnyā saptamīṃ trīṇyādito'bhividarśyottarāṇyabhividarśayatyathāsya brahmacaryamadhi nityaṃ na naktaṃ bhuñjīta yadi bhuñjītāvajvalitaṃ bhuñjīta na mṛnmayaṃ pratidhayīta na striyā na śūdreṇa saṃbhāṣeta na cchatraṃ nopānahau dhārayenna cakrīvadārohenna samājamīkṣeta nāpapātraṃ na harmyāṇi na śavaṃ na snāyānnāñjīta nābhyañjīta || 15 || aṣṭamīṃ parvāṇi copavasenna ca saṃviśedetasminneva saṃvatsare'dhīyīta punaryāvadadhyayanametadvrataṃ caretsaṃvatsare paryavete prācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya khile'cchadirdarśe'gnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya dyauḥ samidityāvṛttaiḥ samidho'bhyādhāyā''ditya vratapata ityāvṛttairdevatā upatiṣṭhate gurave varaṃ dattvā keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate'thāsya svādhyāyamadhi nityaṃ nānutsṛṣṭādhyāyo'dhīyīta na naktaṃ nābhidoṣaṃ brahmacaryamāpadya na dattaḥ prakṣālya na mā saṃ bhakṣayitvā na keśānpravidhya na keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvā na snāto nānulipto na sragvī nākto nābhyakto nā''rdro nā''rdre nānapavṛṣṭe nābhre na cchāyāyāṃ na paryāvṛtta āditye na haritayavānprekṣamāṇo na grāmyasya paśorante nā''raṇyasya nāpāmante nāśṛtamutpatitaṃ na lohitaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāpapātraṃ na hārmyāṇi na śavaṃ na śarīrāṇi prācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya khile'cchadirdarśe'gnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇaḥ parācīnamadhīyīta varaṃ vā dattvaupāsane'dhyeṣyamāṇo nānyā vāco vadedadhyeṣyamāṇo madantīrupaspṛśya prathamenānuvākena śāntiṃ kṛtvā'dhīyītādhītya cottamenaivaṃ karmasu yatra kva cāśāntikṛtaṃ paśyetpunareva śāntiṃ kṛtvā'dhīyīta na pravargyāyopaniṣkramyāpraviśya grāmamanyadadhīyītānyadadhīyīta" iti | keśaśabdasyādantatvātpūrvanipāte'pi keśapūrvakavapanasyā''suratvena śrutau ninditatvānna tathā vapanaṃ kiṃ tu śmaśrupūrvakameva vapanam | khila āvṛtaḥ | acchadirdarśo yatra gṛhacchadīṃṣi na dṛśyanta etādṛśe deśa ityarthaḥ | saṃparistīryetyatratyasaṃśabdādbahuladarbhaiḥ paristaraṇaṃ na tu darbhasaṃkhyāniyamaḥ | yathārūpaṃ yathāliṅgam | athaśabdaḥ kālāvyavadhānārthaḥ | prabhṛtīḥ, ādīḥ | abhivyāhārayati pāṭhayati | aśaktau prathamottamayoranuvākayorādī vā pāṭhayati | tataḥ, abhivyāharaṇottaram | saṃmīlyetyatra netre iti śeṣaḥ | athaśabdaḥ kālāvyavadhānārthaḥ | ahatam -- "īṣaddhautaṃ navaṃ śvetaṃ sadaśaṃ yanna dhāritam" itilakṣaṇalakṣitam | paribhāṣayaiva prādakṣiṇye siddhe punarvacanaṃ śiroveṣṭanasya lokarītisiddhatvena paribhāṣāyā apravṛttiḥ, tathā cāprādakṣiṇyamapi kadācidityāśaṅkāṃ vārayitumanukūlavācī vā pradakṣiṇaśabdaḥ | prapādayati prāpayati | etāṃ rātrim | yasmindine etadantaṃ karma kṛtaṃ tadīyāṃ rātrimityarthaḥ | "kālādhvanoratyantasaṃ yoge" iti sūtreṇātyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā, tena kṛtsnāṃ rātriṃ tiṣṭhedityarthaḥ siddho bhavati | aśaktāvāste | atrāpi vāgyata etāṃ rātrimityanuvartate | mukhaṃ viveṣṭyeti vacanānmukhasyaiva viveṣṭanaṃ na tu śiraso'pi | ṣaṭtayamityatra saṃkhyāyā avayave tayap | evaṃ saptatayamityatrāpi | mahānagnyā vatsatarī kumārī vā | vatsaṃ mahānagnyāṃ cetyetāvataiva siddhe mahānagnyā saptamīmiti vacanaṃ ṣaṭtayapakṣe mahānagnyāyā evābhāva iti pradarśanārtham | āditaḥ krameṇa | abhyabhimukhaṃ saṃmukhamiti yāvat | enamiti śeṣaḥ | arthādeva krame siddha idaṃ vacanamaśmādiṣūttareṣu padārtheṣu kramaniyamo neti pradarśanārtham | aṣṭāṅgamaithunatyāgo brahmacaryaṃ tadācaranna naktaṃ bhuñjītetyādidharmānanutiṣṭhet | nityagrahaṇādyadā kadācidaśaktivaśena bhojane na doṣa iti gamyate | nityaṃ naktaṃ yadi bhuñjīta tadā darbholmukairuparyavajvālya bhuñjīta | na mṛnmayaṃ pratidhayīta mṛnmayapātreṇa jalapānaṃ na kuryāt | na striyā na śūdreṇa saṃbhāṣeta | na striyā śūdreṇa ca saṃbhāṣetetyekena nañaiva siddhau dvitīyanaño vacanādevaṃ jñāyate'nyatra striyā saha kadācitsaṃbhāṣaṇe nātīva doṣaḥ | atra tu kadācidapi striyā'pi saha bhāṣaṇaṃ naiva kāryamiti | cakrīvadgardabhādi nā''rohet | sāmānyaniṣedhādevātrāpi niṣedhe siddhe'tra vacanaṃ karmāṅgatvārthaṃ, tena bhrāntyādinā gardabhādyārohaṇe gadarbhādyārohaṇanimittakaprāyaścittena saha karmāṅgalopaprāyaścittamapyatra bhavati | evamanyatrāpi | samājo janasamūhaḥ | apapātrāścaṇḍālāḥ | tānapinekṣeta | harmyāṇi gṛhāṇi nekṣeta | na ca śavamīkṣeta | na snāyādityanena nimajjanarūpasnānaniṣedhaḥ | parvāṇi paurṇamāsyamāvāsyādīni | saṃveśanaṃ nidrā |etasminneva vatsare'dhīyīta | yasminsaṃvatsara etadvratamārabdhaṃ tasminneva saṃvatsare'nuvākādīnāmadhyayanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ | etadvrataṃ yāvadadhyayanaṃ tāvatparyantaṃ kartavyam | punaḥśabdādetasminneva vatsare kālāntare punaretadadhyayane yāvadadhyayanaṃ vrataṃ kartavyam | adhyayane kṛtsne kṛte madhye virāme na vratam | kiṃ tu, adhyayanasamānakālikameva vratamiti | saṃvatsare paryavete gate | āvṛttairviparītaiḥ | svādhyāyamadhītyatra nityaśabdo'nveti | svādhyāye nityaṃ sarvadā grahaṇadhāraṇādhyayanayorvakṣyamāṇā dharmā bhavanti | nānutsṛṣṭādhyāyo'dhīyīteti | utsarjanottaramevādhyayanametasya kartavyaṃ na tu tatpūrvamupākarmaṇi kṛte'pītyarthaḥ | utsarjanottaraṃ yāvadupākarma tāvadanadhyāyasattve'pi vacanādadhyayanam | athavā notsṛṣṭo'nutsṛṣṭaḥ | adhyāyo vedaḥ | anutsṛṣṭa utsarjanavidhinā'nutsṛṣṭo'dhyāya etadvyatirikto vedo yena so'nutsṛṣṭādhyāyaḥ | etādṛśaḥ sannādhīyīteti | etadvyatiriktavedabhāgasyotsarjane jāta evaitadadhyayanaṃ kartavyamiti | naktaṃ rātrau | abhi doṣaṃ, doṣā rātristasyā abhi pūrvatane ghaṭikādvayātmake dināntātmake kāle | pravidhya kaṅkatādinā prasādhya | nānulipto gandhādinā | na sragvī mālāvān | nā''rdre nānapavṛṣṭa ityetaddvayaṃ deśaviśeṣaṇam | abhra iti sati saptamī | abhre sati nādhīyītetyarthaḥ | na cchāyāyāṃ nā''dityānabhisaṃbaddhe deśe | paryāvṛtte'hno madhyabhāgāt | haritagrahaṇāditarayavaprekṣaṇe niṣedho na | na grāmyasya paśorante nāraṇyasyetyatra paśoranta ityanuvartate | ubhayatrādhīyīteti śeṣaḥ | dvitīyanañvacanaprayojanaṃ na śūdreṇa saṃbhāṣetetyatra yathoktaṃ tathā'trāpi draṣṭavyam | nāśṛtamityatra māṃsamiti śeṣaḥ| lohitaṃ raktam | utpatitamiti lohitaviśeṣaṇam | dṛṣṭvetyuttaratrāpyanuvartate | adhīyīteti śeṣaḥ | śarīraśabdenāsthi | etaddarśane'pyanadhyāyaḥ | eteṣāṃ niṣedhānāṃ janarahite mahāraṇya etasyādhyayanaṃ kartavyamiti phalam | parācīnamagrimamadhyayanapradeśam | prathamānuvākaprabhṛti krameṇa pūrvatra saṃvatsare paryaveta ityupakramāddvitīye saṃvatsare prathamasaṃvatsarādhītānuvākādīnāmuttarāṅgabhūtamagnyupasamādhānādike śmaśruvāpanānte kṛte nānutsṛṣṭādhyāyo'dhīyītetyādi niṣedhānparipālayannagrimapradeśādhyayanārthamagnimupasamādhāya saṃparistīrya darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇo'gnisamīpa evāgrimaṃ pradeśamadhīyītetyarthaḥ | darbheṣvāsīno darbhāndhārayamāṇa ityatra viśeṣavacanādatraitāvadeva, nānye keśaśmaśruvāpanāntāḥ prāguktā dharmāḥ | kalpāntaramāha | varaṃ vā dattvaupāsane varaṃ dattvā vaupāsane, aupāsanasamīpe'dhīyīta | etacca varadānamopāsanasamīpādhyayanaviṣaye | vāśabdasya varadāne'nvaye varadānasya vaikalpikatvam | aupāsanapadārthe'nvayo vā vāśabdasya | ayaṃ ca pakṣo dūre gantumaśaktasya | taccaupāsanaṃ guroreva svasya tadabhāvāt | athavā'traupāsanaśabdo jñāpanārthaḥ | upanayanamārabhyāpyagnidhāraṇamastīti | uktaṃ ca baudhāyanena -- "upanayanādiragnistamaupāsanamityācakṣate pāṇigrahaṇādirityeke" iti | upanayanamārabhya dhāraṇe vivāhahomastatraiva | agnāvaupāsanatvasiddhidvāretyetasya vivāhahomasaṃkalpavākye lopaḥ | upākarmotsarjane api tatraiva | aupāsanaśabdo gṛhalakṣako vā | adhyeṣyamāṇo'dhyayanaṃ kariṣyamāṇo'nyā vāco'dhyayanātiriktā vāco yāvadadhyayanaṃ na vadet | adhyeṣyamāṇo madantīstaptā apa upaspṛśya namo vāca iti prathamenānuvākena śāntiṃ kṛtvā'dhīyīta | adhītya cottamena śaṃ no vāta ityanuvākena śāntiṃ kuryāt | prapāṭhakamadhye virāme'pyuttamā śāntiḥ | upakrame prathamā | evaṃ śāntikaraṇametatprapāṭhakamantrakaraṇakakarmasvapi | nanvevaṃ karmasviti vacanaṃ pravargyaprapāṭhakoktamantrasādhyakarmasu pravargyasaṃbharaṇapracārodvāsanadharmeṣṭakākulāyinyupadhānādiṣu śāntiprāpaṇārtham | na caivaṃ pravargyapracāre punarvidhānaṃ vyarthamiti cetsatyam | saṃbharaṇodvāsanādiṣu śāntikaraṇasya kṛtākṛtatvadyotanārthatvena vaiyarthyābhāvāt | yatra kva ca yatra kutracidaśāntikṛtaṃ śāntirahitaṃ paśyet, śāntivirahitaṃ paṭhitaṃ karma vā kṛtamiti jānīyāt | tatra śāntiṃ kṛtvā punaradhīyīta karma ca kuryāt | yadyaśāntikṛtaṃ paśyedityetāvataiva siddhe yatra kva ceti vacanaṃ paribhāṣārtham | tena sarvāraṇyakaprapāṭhakādhyayanaviṣaye'pi punaradhyayanaṃ tacchāntipūrvakaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati | na pravargyāya pravargyaprapāṭhakādhyayanārthaṃ grāmādbahirupaniṣkramyāpraviśya grāmamanyadadhyayanāntaraṃ nādhīyītetyarthaḥ | anyadadhīyītetyasya dviruktiḥ prapāṭhakasamāptidyotanārthā | iti prapāṭhakādhyayane viśeṣaḥ | viṣṇuḥ -- )"nāpararātramadhītya śayīta" iti | smṛtyantare -- "pradoṣapaścimau yāmau vedābhyāsena yojayet | yāmadvayaṃ śayānastu brahmabhūyāya kalpate" iti || atra pradoṣaśabdenā''dyayāmo grāhyaḥ | paścimaśabdenāntyaḥ | uttaratra yāmadvayagrahaṇāt | gurvanujñayaivādhyeyamanyathā doṣa ityāha vyāsaḥ -- "ṛcamardharcamathavā pādaṃ vā padameva vā | gṛhṇāti yo'nanujñātaḥ parasmātpaṭhato dvijaḥ || sa brahmasteyakṛdvipro narakaṃ pratipadyate" iti || manuḥ -- "nāvispaṣṭamadhīyāta na śūdrajanasaṃnidhau | na niśānte pariśrānto brahmādhītya punaḥ svapet" iti || vedādhyayanakāle rajasvalāsaṃbhāṣaṇamavaśyaṃ prāptaṃ bhavati cettadā kiṃ kartavyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ dharmasūtre -- "brahmādhyeṣyamāṇo malavadvāsasecchansaṃbhāṣituṃ brāhmaṇena saṃbhāṣya tayā saṃbhāṣeta saṃbhāṣya tu brāhmaṇenaiva saṃbhāṣyādhīyīta" iti | yo vedamadhyeṣyamāṇo malavadvāsasā rajasvalayā saha saṃbhāṣitumicchati sa pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇena saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścāttayā saṃbhāṣeta, saṃbhāṣya punarbrāhmaṇenaiva saṃbhāṣyādhīyīteti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | vyāsaḥ -- "mekhalājinadaṇḍānāṃ dhāraṇairbrahmacāribhiḥ | vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigantavyaḥ sarvajñānādvijātibhiḥ" iti || sarvajñānāditi caturthyarthe pañcamī | sarvajñānārthamityarthaḥ | vidyādhigamopāyamāha nāradaḥ -- "aherivekṣaṇādbhītaḥ sauhityānnarakādiva | rākṣasībhya iva strībhyaḥ sa vidyāmadhigacchati" iti || sauhityaṃ pāpam | vighnahetūnapyāha sa eva -- "dyūtaṃ pustakaśuśrūṣā nāṭakāsaktireva ca | striyastandrā ca nidrā ca vidyāvighnakarāṇi ṣaṭ" iti || dyūtamakṣakrīḍādi | pustakaśuśrūṣā pustakasya purāṇādeḥ śuśrūṣā śrotumicchā pustakasevanamātraṃ vā | nāṭakāsaktirnāṭakaśāstre lolupatā | striyaḥ sarvadā strīṣu ratiḥ | tandrā''lasyam | nidrā prasiddhā | evamanyānyapi lokato vidyānāśakarāṇyavagantavyāni | smṛtyantare -- "pustakapratyayādhītaṃ nādhītaṃ gurusaṃnidhau | rājate na sabhāmadhye jāragarbha iva striyāḥ" iti || (anyacca -- "yatkīṭaiḥ pāṃśubhiḥ ślakṣṇairvalmīkaḥ kriyate mahān | na tatra balasāmarthyamudyogastatra kāraṇam || sahasraguṇitā vidyā śataśaḥ parikīrtitā | āgamiṣyati jihvāgre sthalaṃ nimnamivodakam || hayānāmiva jātyānāmardharātrādiśāyinām | na hi vidyārthināṃ nidrā citraṃ netreṣu tiṣṭhati || nānnapānavilambī syānna ca nārīnibandhanaḥ | sudūramapi vidyārthī prajedgaruḍahaṃsavat" iti || śuśrūṣayā rahitāyā vidyāyā niṣphalatvamuktaṃ nāradīyaśikṣāyām -- "śuśrūṣāvirahitā vidyā yadyapi medhāguṇaiḥ samupayāti | vandhyeva yauvanavatī na tasya vidyā saphalā bhavati" iti ||) adhyayanakartrā śūdrānnaṃ varjanīyamityāha parāśaraḥ -- "śūdrānnarasapuṣṭasya hyadhīyānasya nityaśaḥ | japato juhṛto vā'pi gatirūrdhvā vidyate" iti || ūrdhvā gatiḥ svargagatiḥ | āpatkāle'brāhmaṇādapyadhyetavyamityāha manuḥ -- "abrāhmaṇādadhyayanamāpatkāle vidhīyate | anuvrajyādiśuśrūṣā yāvadadhyayanaṃ guroḥ" iti || (abrāhmaṇātkṣatriyādvaiśyādvā | anuvrajyā śuśrūṣetyanugamanamātraṃ kāryaṃ na pādaprakṣālanādi | iyaṃ cā''padbrāhmaṇādhyāpakābhāvarūpā'dhyetuḥ | gautamo'pi -- "āpatkalpo'brāhmaṇādbrāhmaṇasya vidyopayogo'nugamanaṃ śuśrūṣā''samāpteḥ" iti | abrāhmaṇādā samāpterityubhayatra padacchedo draṣṭavyaḥ | garuḍapurāṇe -- "āhuḥ samastavidyānāṃ vedavidyāmanuttamām | atastaddāturastyeva lābhaḥ svargāpavargayoḥ" iti || mahābhārate -- "yo brūyāccāpi śiṣyebhyo dharmyāṃ brāhmīṃ sarasvatīm | pṛthivīgopradānābhyāṃ sa tulyaphalamaśnute" iti |) etadadhyayanamupākarma kṛtvā kartavyamityāha kārṣṇājiniḥ -- "nabhomāse nabhasye vā samupākṛtya sūtrataḥ | dvijaśchandāṃsyadhīyīta māsānpañcārdhasaṃmitān" iti || sūtrataḥ sūtroktaprakāreṇa | vedādhyayanaṃ kartumaśaktasyaikadeśādhyayanamapyanujānāti parāśaraḥ -- "agnikāryātparibhraṣṭāḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitāḥ | vedāṃścaivānadhīyānāḥ sarve te vṛṣalāḥ smṛtāḥ || tasmādvṛṣalabhītena brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ | adhyetavyo'pyekadeśo yadi sarvo na śakyate" iti | vṛṣalabhītena vṛṣalatvabhītena | laghuvyāsaḥ -- "ṛkpādamapyadhīyīta mārgeṇoktena dharmavit | na tveva caturo vedānanyāyena kathaṃ cana" iti || vedavismaraṇe doṣa ukto varāhapurāṇe -- "jātāyāmapi vidyāyāṃ vismaretpaṭhitāṃ śrutim | anadhītyā pramādena mṛto gardabhatāṃ vrajet || yāvadvedotthavarṇānāṃ paṭhitānāṃ ca vismṛtiḥ | tāvadvarṣāṇi bhuṅkte sa kharayoniṃ dvijottamaḥ" iti || jātāyāṃ vedavidyāyāmapi | anadhītyā'nadhyayanena hetunā yadi paṭhitāmapi śrutiṃ vismarettadā svācārasaṃpanno'pi dvijotta śrutyakṣarasaṃkhyavarṣaparyantaṃ kharayoniṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | iti saṃkṣepeṇādhyetṛdharmāḥ | adhyayanadharmāstu pāṇinīyaśikṣāprātiśākhyabhāradvājaśikṣādiṣu draṣṭavyāḥ | atha prasaṅgānmandabuddhitvaharaṃ vidhānam | tatra ṛgvidhānam -- "oṣṭhāpidhānāmantraṃ ca japeddaśadinaṃ prati | vāgdevī mātṛkā tasya jihvāgre vartate sadā || oṣṭhāmantreṇa juhuyādvidyāśrīstatkule sthirā | trimadhuṃ cāṣṭasāhasraṃ prativarṣaṃ tu phālgune" iti || trimadhumityatra puṃstvamārṣam | ājyaṃ kṣīraṃ madhu ceti madhutrayaṃ, tacca miśritameva na tu pṛthak | etaddravyatrayaṃ tolanena samapramāṇaṃ kṛtvaiva grāhyam | saṃbhava ājyakṣīre goreva mukhye | aṣṭasāhasramaṣṭasaṃkhyasāhasramaṣṭādhikasāhasraṃ vā | prativarṣamityatra varṣasaṃkhyāyā anuktatvādyāvacchakyam | asya mantrasya brahmā, ṛṣiḥ | anuṣṭupchandaḥ | nakulī sarasvatī devatā | dhyānam -- "vikāsabhāji hṛtpadme sthitāmullāsadāyinīm | paravākstambhinīṃ nityāṃ smarāmi nakulīṃ sadā" iti | mantrastu -- "oṃ oṣṭhāpidhānā nakulī dantaiḥ parivṛtā paviḥ | sarvasyai vāca īśānā cāru māmiha vādayet " iti | ayameva mantro bālāmantreṇa saṃyuktaḥ kāryaḥ | tatrā''dāvekaṃ bījam, pavirityanantaraṃ dvitīyam, ante tṛtīyam | dhāraṇābhivṛddhyarthaṃ namo brahmaṇa ityasya mantrasya nyāsapūrvakaṃ tripurāsiddhānte śrutadharīmāhātmye puraścaraṇamuktam | asya mantrasyānirākaraṇa ṛṣiḥ | bṛhatī chandaḥ | dhāraṇāsarasvatī devatā | "surāsuraiḥ sevitapādapaṅkajā kare virājatkamanīyapustakā | virañcipatnī kamalāsanasthitā sarasvatī nṛtyatu vāci me sadā" iti dhyānam | ayamapi mantro bālāmantreṇa saṃyukto japtavyaḥ (japitavyaḥ), śīghraṃ dhāraṇāprado bhavati | tatrā''dyapraṇavottaraṃ prathamaṃ bījam, bhūyāsamityanantaraṃ dvitīyam, antyapraṇavottaraṃ tṛtīyam | anenābhimantritaṃ jalaṃ prāśnīyātsārasvataprāptiḥ | gīrvāṇaindvyāṃ tu yaśchandasāmṛṣabha iti śīkṣāprapāṭhakasthamantrasya lakṣaṃ puraścaraṇamuktam | kalau caturguṇaṃ proktamitivacanāccaturguṇaṃ puraścaraṇam | tacca pañcātmakaṃ tryātmakaṃ dvyātmakaṃ veti tāntrikaparibhāṣāsiddham | vinā viśeṣavacanaṃ kāmyādiprayoge'pyetādṛśameva | yādṛśī syātpuraścaryā viniyogo'pi tādṛśa iti sthalaviśeṣe tantrāntare darśanāt | prakṛte viśeṣavacanābhāvātpuraścaraṇajapasaṃkhyaiva | atra yantrapūjānyāsādikasyā''kāṅkṣitatvena spaṣṭatayā vaktavyatve'pi "mantraśāstraṃ gopanīyam" iti kubjikātantravacanādanavasthābhayāccānuktiriti jñeyam | iti mandabuddhitvaharaṃ vidhānam | atha saṃkṣepeṇānadhyāyāḥ | tatrośanā -- "ayane viṣuve caiva śayane bodhane tathā | anadhyāyaṃ prakurvīta manvādiṣu yugādiṣu" iti | ayane dakṣiṇāyanamuttarāyaṇaṃ ca yasmindine tatretyarthaḥ | jātyabhiprāyaṃ vaikavacanam | evaṃ viṣuva ityatrāpi | viṣuve tulāmeṣau | śayanaṃ hareḥ śayanadinamāṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśī | bodhanaṃ hareḥ prabodhanadinaṃ kārtikaśuklaikādaśī | ayanaviṣuvaprayuktānadhyāye viśeṣaḥ smṛtyantare -- "niśādvayaṃ divā rātrau saṃkrame vāsaradvayam | anadhyāyaṃ prakurvīta ayane viṣuve tathā" iti || divā'yanaviṣuvasaṃkrāntau rātridvayam | rātrāvayanaviṣuvasaṃkrāntau dinadvayamanadhyāya ityarthaḥ | manvādayaḥ saṃgṛhītā hemādrau -- "tithyagnī na tithistithyāśe kṛṣṇebho'nalo grahaḥ | tithyarkau na śivo'śvo'mātithī manvādayo madhoḥ" iti || tithyagnī | na | tithiḥ | tithyāśe | kṛṣṇebhaḥ | analaḥ | grahaḥ | tithyarkau | na | śivaḥ | aśvaḥ | amātithī | manvādayaḥ | madhoḥ | iti padāni | tithiḥ pūrṇimā | agnistṛtīyā | madhoścaitrādārabhya kramaḥ | caitrasya pūrṇimāśuklatṛtīye ityarthaḥ | na, vaiśākhe manvādirnāsti | jyeṣṭhasya tithiḥ pūrṇimā | āṣāḍhasya tithyāśe pūrṇimāśukladaśamyau | śrāvaṇasya kṛṣṇebhaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī| bhādraśuklapakṣasyānalastṛtīyā | āśvinaśuklapakṣasya graho navamī | kārtikasya tithyarkau pūrṇimāśukladvādaśyau | na, mārgaśīrṣe manvādirnāsti | pauṣaśuklasya śiva ekādaśī | māghaśuklapakṣasyāśvaḥ saptamī | phālgunasyāmātithī darśapūrṇime | etā madhoścaitrādārabhya kramānmanvādayo jñeyā ityarthaḥ | padmapurāṇe'pi -- "aśvayukśuklanavamī kārtikī dvādaśī sitā | tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca | phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī sitā | āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī || śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā āṣāḍhasya ca pūrṇimā | kārtikī phālgunī caitrī jye(jyai)ṣṭhī pañcadaśī tathā || manvantarādayaścaitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ" iti || aśvayugāśvinaḥ | bhādrapadasya cetyatra cakāraḥ sitetyasyānuvṛttyarthaḥ | tathāśabdo bhādrapadasyetyatrāpi tṛtīyānvayārthaḥ | āṣāḍhasyāpītyatrāpiśabdaḥ sitetyasyānuvṛttyarthaḥ | ayamapiśabdo māghamāsasyetyatrāpi yojyaḥ | tenātrāpi sitetyasyānuṣaṅgaḥ sidhyati | yugādayo viṣṇupurāṇe -- "vaiśākhamāsasya sitā tṛtīyā navamyasau kārtikaśuklapakṣe | nabhasyamāsasya ca kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśī pañcadaśī ca māghe" iti | nabhasyo bhādrapadaḥ | manuḥ, anadhyāyaṃ prakṛtya -- "amāvāsyācaturdaśyoḥ paurṇamāsyaṣṭakāsu ca" iti | hārītaḥ -- "pratipatsu caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ parvaṇordvayoḥ | śvo'nadhyāye'dya śarvaryāṃ nādhīyīta kadācana" iti | pratipatsvityādipūrvārdhaṃ pratipadādiṣvanadhyāya itibhinnārthavidhāyakaṃ na tu śvo'nadhyāya ityuttarārdhenaikārthakam | anyathā sūryodayottaraṃ kiṃcitpratipadanantaraṃ dvitīyā | etādṛśe viṣaye tatpūrvarātrāvanadhyāye prāpta etanniṣedhasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ | śvo'nadhyāya iti yugādimanvādiprayuktānadhyāyaparam | tathā ca śva etādṛśānadhyāye pūrvarātrau nādhīyītetyarthaḥ | śva ityudayānantaramanadhyāyatithisattve | tadanantaraṃ svādhyāyatithisattve tu na pūrvaśarvaryāmanadhyāya iti śiṣṭāḥ | yamaḥ -- "aṣṭamī hantyupādhyāyaṃ śiṣyaṃ hanti caturdaśī | hanti pañcadaśī medhāṃ tasmādetā vivarjayet" iti | svādhyāya iti śeṣaḥ| ārṣe rāmāyaṇe rāmaṃ prati hanūmadvākyam -- "sā svabhāvena tanvaṅgi tvadviyogādvikarśitā | pratipatpāṭhaśīlasya vidyeva tanutāṃ gatā" iti | smṛtiratnāvalyām -- "caturdaśyāṃ yadā parva prāgastāddṛśyate raveḥ | anadhyāyaṃ prakurvīta trayodaśyāṃ tu dharmavit || abhitaścedanadhyāyastatrāpyeke prakurvate | saṃdehe'pi tvanadhyāyaṃ manvate hi dvijottamāḥ" iti | uktatithīnāmahorātrānadhyāyaniyāmakaparimāṇaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "udaye'stamaye vā'pi muhūrtatrayagāmi yat | taddinaṃ tadahorātramanadhyāyaṃ vido viduḥ || kecidāhuḥ kvaciddaśa yāvattu dinanāḍikāḥ | tāvadeva tvanadhyāyo na tasmiṃśca dināntare" iti || dinaṃ cāndraṃ tithiriti yāvat | yadyasmindina udaye'stamaye vā muhurtatrayagāmyanadhyāyadinaṃ tithirbhavettattasmindine tadahorātramanadhyāyamanadhyāyarūpameva vido budhā vidurityarthaḥ | (dināntare tithyantare | "pratipalleśamātreṇa kalāmātreṇa cāṣṭamī | dinaṃ dūṣayate sarvaṃ surā gavyaghaṭaṃ yathā" || iti vacanaṃ tatprācyācāramūlakaṃ jñeyam | kālādarśe smṛtiḥ -- "cāturmāsyadvitīyāsu vedādhyāyaṃ vivarjayet" iti || tā āha gārgyaḥ -- "śucāvūrje tapasye ca yā dvitīyā vidhukṣaye | cāturmāsyadvitīyāstāḥ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ" iti || vidhukṣaya ityatra bahuvrīhiḥ | vidhukṣayaḥ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ | āṣāḍhyuttarā kārtikyuttarā phālgunyuttarā cetyarthaḥ |) trayodaśyādipradoṣe tu nādhyeyamityasminnarthe paurāṇaṃ vākyam -- "medhākāmastrayodaśyāṃ saptamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | caturthyāṃ ca pradoṣeṣu na smarenna ca kīrtayet" iti | na smaredityanenānyānadhyāyebhyo'tra doṣādhikyaṃ dhvanyate | trayodaśyādidvaividhye nirṇayo brahmāṇḍapurāṇe -- "rātrau yāmadvayādarvāgyadi paśyettrayodaśīm | pradoṣaḥ sa hi vijñeyaḥ sarvasvādhyāyavarjitaḥ || ṣaṣṭhī ca dvādaśī caiva ardharātronanāḍikā | pradoṣe na tvadhīyīta tṛtīyā navanāḍikā" iti | ardharātronanāḍikā'rdharātrādghaṭikayaikayonetyarthaḥ | anenedṛśasthale pūrvadina eva pradoṣaprayukto'dhyayananiṣedho na tūttararātrimukhe saptamyādisattve'pīti niyamyate | bṛhanmanunā prakārāntareṇa pradoṣa uktaḥ -- "caturthyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ saptamyāmardharātrataḥ | arvaṅnādhyayanaṃ kuryādyadīcchettasya dhāraṇam " iti | smṛtyarthasāre viśeṣaḥ -- "caturthyāḥ pūrvarātre tu navanāḍīṣu darśane | nādhyeyaṃ pūrvarātre syātsaptamī ca trayodaśī | ardharātrātpurā cetsyānnādhyeyaṃ pūrvarātrake" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- "arkatarkatritithiṣu divasaiḥ syāttadagrimaiḥ | rātryardhasārdhapraharaiḥ sa pradoṣa iti smṛtaḥ" iti | agrimairarkatarkatritithyagrimairdinairityarthaḥ | arko dvādaśī | tarkaḥ ṣaṣṭhī | tristṛtīyā | dvādaśyā rātrau prathamaṃ rātryardhaṃ yāmadvayātmakaṃ tanmadhye trayodaśīsaṃbandhaścettadā pradoṣa ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ṣaṣṭhyā rātrau prathamasārdhapraharamadhye saptamīsaṃbandhe | tathā tṛtīyāyā rātrau prathamapraharamadhye caturthīsaṃbandha iti | śiṣṭāstvidānīmetadeva svī kurvanti || galagraheṣvapyanadhyāya ukto bṛhaspatinā -- "putrajīvitamiccheccennādhīyīta galagrahe" iti | putrajīvitamicchecceditivacanātputriṇa eva galagraheṣvanadhyāyo netarasyeti | galagrahāstūpanayanakālanirūpaṇa uktāḥ | jyotirnibandhe -- "aṣṭakāsu ca sarvāsu yugamanvantarādiṣu | anadhyāyaṃ prakurvīta ya(ta)thā sopapadāsvapi" iti | ayaṃ ca sopapadāniṣedho na yajurvedinām -- "vedavratopanayane svādhyāyādhyayane tathā | na doṣo yajuṣāṃ sopapadāsvadhyāpane'pi ca" | iti smṛtyantarokteriti kecit | mahānibandheṣvadarśanādidaṃ nirmūlamityanye | asminkalpe tvastyeva teṣāmapi niṣedhaḥ | tāstūpanayanaprakaraṇa uktāḥ | dharmasūtre -- "śrāvaṇyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmadhyāyamupākṛtya māsaṃ pradoṣe nādhīyīta" iti | pradoṣo'tra prathamo rātribhāga ityujjvalākṛtaḥ | pūrvarātririti mādhavaḥ | grahaṇādhyayanadhāraṇādhyayanayorayaṃ niṣedhaḥ | pradoṣagrahaṇādrātrāvapyūrdhvaṃ na doṣa ityujjvalākṛtaḥ | upākarmottaraṃ tryahamekāhaṃ vā'nadhyāyaḥ kāryaḥ | taduktaṃ gṛhye -- "tryahamekāhaṃ vā kṣamya yathādhyāyamadhyetavyamiti vadanti" iti | kṣamyādhyayanādviramyetyarthaḥ | ayamanadhyāyastvanitya ityatra jñāpakamutsarjanaprakaraṇe vakṣyate | dharmasūtre -- "taiṣīpakṣasya rohiṇyāṃ viramedardhapañcamā ścaturo māsānityeke" iti gṛhyoktena vikalpaḥ | anayoḥ pakṣayoḥ pañca māsānadhīte | ardhaḥ pañcamo yeṣāṃ te'rdhapañcamāḥ | ardhādhikāṃścaturo māsānadhīyītetyevameke manyante | asminpakṣe proṣṭhapadyāmupākaraṇaṃ śāstrāntaradarśanādutsarjanasya cāpratikarṣaḥ | utsarjane ca kṛte śrāvaṇyāḥ prākśuklapakṣeṣu dhāraṇādhyayanaṃ vedasya kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu vyākaraṇādyaṅgādhyayanaṃ śrāvaṇyāmupākṛtyāgṛhītasya grahaṇādhyayanamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | gautamaḥ -- "tisro'ṣṭakāstisro'bhi vārṣikam" iti | upākaraṇādūrdhvaṃ prāgutsarjanādyadadhyayanaṃ tadvārṣikaṃ tadabhi tasyā''dāvante ca yatkarma kriyate tatra trirātramityarthaḥ | auśanase vyakto'yamarthaḥ -- "upākaraṇe cotsarjane ca tryahamanadhyāyaḥ" iti | mānave ca -- "upākarmaṇi cotsarge trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam" iti | kṣapaṇamanadhyāyaḥ | gṛhye'pyevam | aṣṭakā āśvalāyanasūtre -- "hemantaśiśirayoścaturṇāmaparapakṣāṇāmaṣṭamīṣvaṣṭakāḥ" iti | mahālayāntargatāṣṭamyaṣṭakātvena saṃgṛhītā hārītena -- "tathā mahālayāṣṭamī" iti | mādhyāḥ paurṇamāsyā yo'parapakṣastasyāṣṭamīmekā'ṣṭaketyācakṣata ityetatsūtrasthaikagrahaṇena jñāpitāśvā''cāryeṇa | dharmasūtre -- "mātari pitaryācārya iti dvādaśāhāḥ" iti | mātrādiṣu mṛteṣu dvādaśāhamanadhyāya ityarthaḥ | ayaṃ vidhirgṛhasthānāmapi | kecidāśaucaṃ tāvantaṃ kālamicchanti | neti vayam | anadhyāyaprakaraṇāditi vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "tryahaṃ preteṣvanadhyāyaḥ śiṣyartvigurubandhuṣu | upākarmaṇi cotsarge svaśākhāśrotriye tathā || saṃdhyāgarjitanirghātabhūkampolkānipātane | samāpya vedaṃ dyuniśamāraṇyakamadhītya ca || pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ rāhusūtake | ṛtusaṃdhiṣu bhuktvā tu śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya ca" iti || nirghāta āntarikṣa utpātadhvaniḥ | dyuniśamahorātram | yattu -- "tryahaṃ na kīrtayedbrahma rājño rāhośca sūtake"| iti rāhusūtakaviṣaye tryahānadhyāyakīrtanaṃ tadgrastāstaviṣayam | ṛtusaṃdhiṣvṛtusaṃdhigatāsu pratipatsviti vijñāneśvaraḥ | śrāddhikaṃ pratigṛhya cetyetatpārvaṇaviṣayam | ekoddiṣṭabhojanādau manvādibhistryahokteḥ | anyacca sa eva -- "paśumaṇḍūkanakulaśvāhimārjāramūṣakaiḥ | kṛte'ntare tvahorātraṃ śakrapāte tathocchraye" iti || śakrapātocchrayakālastu -- "āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāmindradhvajotthāpanaṃ vijayadaśamyāṃ tadavaropaṇam" iti | dharmasūtre -- "śvagardabhanādāḥ salāvṛkyekasṛkolūkaśabdāḥ sarve vāditaśabdā rodanagītasāmaśabdāśca" iti | śunāṃ gardabhānāṃ bahūnāṃ nādā bahuvacananirdeśāt | salāvṛkī vṛkāvāntarajātiviśeṣaḥ | koṣṭrītyanye | liṅgasyāvivakṣitatvātpuṃso'pi grahaṇam | "indro yatīnsālāvṛkebhyaḥ prāyacchat" ityādidarśanāt | ekasṛka ekavacanaḥ, śṛgālaḥ | ulūko divābhītaḥ | eṣāṃ śabdāḥ | vāditāni vīṇāveṇumṛdaṅgādīni teṣāṃ ca śabdāḥ | rodanaśabdā gītaśabdāḥ sāmaśabdāśca | ete śrūyamāṇāstātkālikānadhyāyahetava iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | tathā -- "saṃdarśane cāraṇye śmaśāne sarvataḥ śamyāprāsācchmaśānavacchūdrapatitau" iti | araṇye ca yāvati pradeśe śavaścaṇḍālo vā dṛśyate tāvatkālamanadhyāyaḥ | śmaśāne'dhyayanaṃ varjayet | sarvataḥ sarvāsu dikṣu śamyāprāsādarvāgityarthaḥ | pañcamīnirdeśādarvāgiti gamyate | śūdrapatitasakāśe'pi śamyāprāsādarvāṅnādhyeyamiti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "prodakayośca pāṇyoḥ" iti | pūrvasūtrādbhuktvetyanuvartate | prodakāvārdau pāṇī yāvattāvannādhīyīteti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "pṛṣṭhārūḍhaḥ paśūnāṃ nādhīyīta tāvantaṃ kālam" iti | hastyaśvādīnāṃ paśūnāṃ pṛṣṭhārūḍhaḥ pṛṣṭhāsīnaḥ sannādhīyīta tāvantaṃ kālamityartha iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "śvakroṣṭṛgardabholūkasāmavāṇārtanisvane | amedhyaśavaśūdrāntyaśmaśānapatitāntike || deśe'śucāvātmani ca vidyutstanitasaṃplave | bhuktvā''rdrapāṇirambhontarardharātre'timārute || pāṃśuvarṣe ca digdāhe saṃdhyānīhārabhītiṣu | dhāvataḥ pūtigandhe ca śiṣṭe ca gṛhamāgate || kharoṣṭrayānahastyaśvanauvṛkṣeriṇarohaṇe | saptatriṃśadanadhyāyānetāṃstātkālikānviduḥ" iti || sāmānyāraṇyakasāmāni | vāṇo vaṃśa iti vijñāneśvaraḥ | śatatanturvīṇeti haradattaḥ | ārtaḥ pīḍitaḥ | amedhyāḥ sūtikādayaḥ | stanitaṃ garjitam | saṃdhyāgarjane vidyuti ca viśeṣo dharmasūtre -- "saṃdhāvanustanite rātriṃ svapnaparyā(rya)ntāṃ vidyutyupavyuṣaṃ yāvatā vā kṛṣṇāṃ rohiṇīmiti śamyāprāsādvijānīyādetasminkāle vidyotamāne sapradoṣamaharanadhyāyo dahre cāpararātre stanayitnunordhvamardharātrādityeke" iti | saṃdhau saṃdhyāyām | anustanite meghagarjite sarvāṃ rātriṃ nādhīyīta | saṃdhau vidyuti satyāṃ svapnaparyā(rya)ntāṃ rātrim | idaṃ ca sāyaṃsaṃdhyāyām | uṣaḥ samīpamupavyuṣaṃ tatra vidyuti satyāmaparedyuḥ sapradoṣamaharanadhyāyaḥ | pradoṣādūrdhvamadhyeyam | yāvatā kālena śamyāprāsādarvāgavasthitāṃ gāṃ kṛṣṇāmiti vā rohiṇīmiti vā vijānīyāttasminkāla upavyuṣe vā vidyotamāna ityanvayaḥ | rātrestṛtīyabhāgo'pararātrastasya tredhā vibhaktasyā''dyāṃśo mahārātraḥ | tadantyo dahraḥ | tasmindahre'pararātre stanayitnunā meghagarjananimittena sapradoṣamaharanadhyāyaḥ, ardharātrādūrdhvamanantararātrāvadhirityeka ācāryā manyante | svapakṣastu dahra eva | idaṃ ca varṣartau jñeyamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | hārītastu -- "sāyaṃsaṃdhyāstanite rātriḥ prātaḥsaṃdhyāstanite'horātram" ityāha | vidyuti viśeṣamāha gautamaḥ -- "vidyuti naktaṃ cāpararātrātribhāgādipravṛttau sarvam" iti | pūrvarātrau vidyutyapararātrāvadhiranadhyāyaḥ | dinatṛtīyāṃśottaraṃ tasyāṃ satyāṃ rātrisamāptiparyantam | ardharātre madhyayāmadvaya iti vijñāneśvaraḥ | madhyadaṇḍacatuṣṭaya iti nirṇayāmṛtaḥ | etadvarṣātiriktaviṣayam | varṣāsu tu tātkālika iti vyavasthā bodhyā | dharmasūtre -- "chardayitvā svapnaparyantam" iti | chardayitvā vamanaṃ kṛtvā svapnaparyantaṃ nādhīyīteti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | atrā''pastambena viśeṣa uktaḥ -- "chardayitvā svapnānte ghṛtaṃ vā prāśya" iti | viṣṇuḥ -- "na vāditraśabde na śūdrapatitayoḥ samīpe na devatāyatanaśmaśānacatuṣpatharathyāsu nodakānte na pīṭhopahitapādo na hastyaśvoṣṭranaugoyāneṣu na vānto na vira(ri)kto nājīrṇī na pañcanakhāntarāgamane" iti | pīṭhopahitapādaḥ pīṭhoparisthāpitapādatalaḥ | yāneṣvityatrā''sīna iti śeṣaḥ | vāntaḥ kṛtavamanaḥ | vira(ri)ktaḥ kṛtavirekaḥ | ajīrṇī bhuktapākaparyantam | pañcanakhāḥ śvādayaḥ | manuḥ -- "śayānaḥ prauḍhapādaśca kṛtvā caivāvasakthikām | nādhīyītā''miṣaṃ jagdhvā sūtakānnaṃ tathaiva ca" iti | prauḍhapādaḥ pādoparipādatalaḥ | āsanārūḍhapādo veti haradattaḥ | smṛtyantare -- "na vivāde na kalahe na senāyāṃ na saṅgare | na bhuktamātre nājīrṇe na vamitvā na sūtake || rudhire ca srute gātrācchastreṇa ca parikṣate" iti || adhīyīteti śeṣaḥ | hemādrau smṛtiḥ -- "yajñe cānūbandhyāntaṃ dīkṣitasyartvijāṃ ca" iti | manuḥ -- "tryahaṃ na kīrtayedbrahma sapiṇḍīkaraṇe tathā" iti | sapiṇḍīkaraṇe kṛte satyanantaraṃ tryahamanadhyāya ityarthaḥ | smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "udake madhyarātre ca viṇmūtre ca visarjite | ucchiṣṭe śrāddhabhuktau ca manasā'pi na cintayet" iti | smṛtisāre -- "sarvakutsitagandheṣu pariveṣe sabhāsu ca | abhyaṅge snānakāle ca mahāsvede'tikampane || goviprarodhane sarvaśrāddheṣu śrāddhapaṅktiṣu | śmaśāne śūdrasaṃparke malādīnāṃ nidarśane || rodane vyākule deśe japasthāne mahālaye | mahotpāteṣu ca tathā svādhyāyaṃ varjayedbudhaḥ" iti || sarvaśrāddheṣvityanena śrāddhakarturadhyayananiṣedhaḥ | śrāddhapaṅktiṣvityanena śrāddhabhokturadhyayananiṣedhaḥ | saptamīnirdeśāttattatkāle | dharmodyote -- "phalānyā(nya)pastilānbhakṣyānyaccānyacchrāddhikaṃ bhavet | pratigṛhyāpyanadhyāya iti baudhāyano'bravīt" iti || yamaḥ -- "āgataṃ cātithiṃ dṛṣṭvā nādhīyītaiva buddhimān | abhyanujñāpitastasminnadhyetavyaṃ prayatnataḥ" iti || tasminnatithyāgamanasamaye'bhyanujñāpito'tithinā | āraṇyamārjārādyantarāgamane viśeṣaḥ smṛtyarthasāre -- "āraṇyamārjārasarpanakulapañcanakhāderantarāgamane trirātram | āraṇyaśvaśṛgālavānarāderdvādaśarātraṃ, kharavarāhoṣṭracaṇḍālasūtikodakyādermāsam | śaśameṣaśvapākādeḥ ṣaṇmāsaṃ, gajasārasasiṃhavyāghramahāpātakikṛtaghnāderabdam" iti | anyacca -- "śobhanadine cānadhyāyo vivāhapratiṣṭhotthāpanādiṣvā samāpteḥ sagotrāṇām" iti | vivāha ityupanayanopalakṣaṇam -- tathā -- "śravaṇadvādaśīmahābharaṇyoḥ pretadvitīyāyāṃ rathasaptamyāmākāśe śavadarśane cāhorātram" iti | mahābharaṇī mahālayāntargatā | pretadvitīyā yamadvitīyā | kaurme -- "śleṣmātakasya cchāyāyāṃ śālmalermadhukasya ca | kadācidapi nādhyeyaṃ kovidārakapitthayoḥ" iti || śleṣmātakaṃ bhāṣayā "bhoṃkarī" iti prasiddham | śālmaliḥ "sāvarī" iti bhāṣayā prasiddhaḥ | madhuko bhāṣayā "mohā" iti prasiddhaḥ | kovidāraḥ kañcanāraḥ | āśvine śuklapakṣe mūlanakṣatre pustakasthāpane kṛte tadārabhya pustakavisarjanaparyantamanadhyāyaḥ | taduktaṃ devīpurāṇe -- "nādhyāpayenna ca likhennādhīyāta kadācana | pustake sthāpite devi vidyākāmo dvijottamaḥ" iti || evamanye'pyanadhyāyā dharmasūtrādau draṣṭavyāḥ | anadhyāyādhyayane doṣa ukto bṛhannāradīye -- "anadhyāyeṣvadhītānāṃ prajāṃ prajñāṃ yaśaḥ śriyam | āyuṣyaṃ balamārogyaṃ nikṛntati yamaḥ svayam || anadhyāye tu yo'dhīte taṃ vidyādbrahmaghātakam | na tena saha bhāṣeta na tena saha saṃviśet" iti || "caturdaśyaṣṭamīparvapratipatsveva sarvadā | durmedhasāmanadhyāyastvantarāgamaneṣu ca || tatra vismṛtiśīlānāṃ bahuvedaprapāṭhinām | caturdaśyaṣṭamīparvapratipadvarjiteṣu ca || vedāṅganyāyamīmāṃsādharmaśāstrāṇi cābhyaset" || iti hemādyuktānadhyāyaprakaraṇasthasmṛtivākyavaśena kalau puruṣāndurmedhaso manyamānāḥ śiṣṭā vedādhyayana etānevānadhyāyānniyamena svī kurvantīti | ityanadhyāyāḥ | athānadhyāyāpavādāḥ | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "vidyāṃ pratyanadhyāyaḥ śrūyate na karmayoge mantrāṇām" iti | vidyāṃ prati vedādhyayanaṃ pratyanadhyāyaḥ śrūyate na punaḥ karmayoge mantrāṇāmanadhyāyo heturityartha iti || sūtakānnaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ māsikānnaṃ tathaiva ca | brahmacārī tu yo'śnīyāttrirātreṇaiva śudhyati" iti || bṛhadyamastu -- "māsikādiṣu yo'śnīyādasamāptavrato dvijaḥ | trirātramupavāso'tra prāyaścittaṃ
