vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet" iti || anṛtavadanaprāyaścittamāha gargaḥ -- "anṛtaṃ yadi vai brūyāddvijo mohādanāpadi | trirātramekarātraṃ vā brahmacaryavrataṃ caret" iti || śaucākaraṇaprāyaścittamāpastamba āha -- "mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvā hyakṛtvā śaucamātmanaḥ | mohādbhuktvā trirātraṃ tu yavānpītvā viśudhyati || mūtraṃ kṛtvā dvijo mārge smṛtibhraṃśājjalaṃ pibet | ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti || mūtrapadaṃ purīṣāderupalakṣaṇam | viṇmūtrotsargakāle yadi karṇe yajñopavītaṃ pramādānna dhṛtaṃ tadā bharadvāja āha -- "upavītamadhṛtvā yo malamūtre samutsṛjet | upavītaṃ tadutsṛjya paścādanyannavaṃ tadā" iti || adhṛtvetyatra karṇa iti śeṣaḥ | "pavitraṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe kṛtvā viṇmūtramṛtsṛjet" iti smṛtyantarokteḥ | tadetyanantaraṃ dhārayediti śeṣaḥ | smṛtisāre -- "kṛtvā yajñopavītaṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ kaṇṭhalambitam | viṇmūtraṃ tu gṛhī kuryādyadvā karṇe samāhitaḥ" iti || etacca karṇe nidhānamekavastraviṣayam, yadyekavastro yajñopavītaṃ karṇe kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣotsargaṃ kuryāditiśaṅkhokteriti mādhavaḥ | anudakamūtrapurīṣakaraṇe sumantuḥ -- "anudakamūtrapurīṣakaraṇe sadyaḥ snānaṃ ghṛtakuśahiraṇyodakapānaṃ ca" iti | ghṛtayuktaṃ kuśasrāvitodakaṃ ghṛtayuktaṃ hiraṇyasrāvitodakaṃ ca pibedityarthaḥ | ghṛtakuśahiraṇyodakapānasya prāyaścittārthatvādbhojananivṛttiḥ | "purīṣamūtrotsargaṃ tu kuryādanudakaṃ yadi | ekāhaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ kṛtvā sacailaṃ snānamācaret" || iti jātūkarṇyavacanasaṃvādādayamartho labhyate | sacailaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvaikāhaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ caredityanvayaḥ | kṣapaṇamupoṣaṇam | athavā pānaśabdasya ghṛta udake cānvayaḥ | tena ghṛtaprāśanaṃ pṛthakkartavyaṃ bhavati | yattvaṅgirasoktam -- "anudakamūtrapurīṣakaraṇe sacailaṃ snānaṃ vyāhṛtihomaśca" iti | tadakāmato draṣṭavyam | marīciḥ -- "brahmasūtraṃ vinā bhuṅkte viṇmūtraṃ kurute'thavā | gāyatryaṣṭasahasreṇa prāṇāyāmena śudhyati" iti || sarvathā jalābhāve vegasya ca prāptau vegadhāraṇaṃ niṣedhati manuḥ -- "deśaṃ kālaṃ samāsādya avasthāmātmanastathā | dharmaśauce'nutiṣṭheta na kuryādvegadhāraṇam" iti || dharmaśauce'nutiṣṭhetetyatra prakṛtibhāvābhāva ārṣaḥ | athāvakīrṇiprāyaścittam | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "gardabhenāvakīrṇī nirṛtiṃ pākayajñena yajeta tasya śūdraḥ prāśnīyāt" iti | yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātso'vakīrṇī gardabhena nirṛtiṃ yajeta pākayajñena sthālīpākavidhānena | tasya gardabhasya sarpiṣmaddhavirucchiṣṭaṃ śūdraḥ prāśnīyāt | tena brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāvantaṃ pariveveṣṭītyasyāpavāda iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | vādhūlavaikhānasāvapi -- "yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātsa gardabhaṃ paśumālabheta bhūmau paśupuroḍāśaśrapaṇam" iti | manurapi -- "avakīrṇī tu kāṇena gardabhena catuṣpathe | pākayajñavidhānena yajeta nirṛtiṃ niśi" iti || prāyaścittasūtre'pi -- "yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātsa gardabhaṃ paśumālabheta bhūmāvekakapālaṃ paśupuroḍāśaṃ śrapayitvā'psvavadānaiścaranti nairṛtaḥ prājāpatyo vā rakṣodevata ityekeṣāṃ yamadevata ityekeṣām" iti | āhitāgnirbrahmacaryakāle striyamupeyāttasyāyaṃ vidhiḥ | āhitāgnyadhikārāt | athavā prasiddhabrahmacāriṇa eva grahaṇaṃ ruḍherbalīyastvāt | uktaṃ ca brahmacāridharmeṣu -- "gardabhenāvakīrṇī nirṛtiṃ pākayajñena yajeta" iti | na caivamasyā''narthakyaṃ devatāvikalpārthatvāt | na cā''hitāgnyadhikāre vacanānupapattiḥ | devatābhedaśrautaprayogavidhānārthatvenopapatteḥ | tasmādbrahmacaryārthatve'pi na doṣaḥ | taduktaṃ bharadvājena -- "yo brahmacārī striyamupeyāditi kasyāyaṃ vāda āhitāgnerityeke'nāhitāgnerityapare" iti | tatra tvāhitāgnervrātapatyādi prāyaścittaṃ draṣṭavyam | yathoktam -- "vratye'hani māṃsaṃ nāśnāti na striyamupaiti yadi dīkṣito'vakiret" ityādi | bhūmāvityanenāgnyāyatanamadhye prakṛtito haviḥśrapaṇaṃ prāptaṃ tadbādhitvā'nenāgnyāyatanādbahiḥśrapaṇaṃ vidhīyate | tenāgnyāyatanādbahirevaikaṃ kapālamaṅgāropari saṃsthāpya taduparyaṅgāraṃ nidhāya vedenāṅgārānadhyūhet | athavā''yatanamadhya eva bhūmau na bhasmanītyetadartham | na ca bhūmāviti kapālabādhanārthamiti vācyam | ekakapālapadavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | ekasminkapāle saṃskṛtaḥ puroḍāśa ekakapālastaṃ tasminkapāle śrapayet | śrapayitvā'svavadānairvapāpuroḍāśāṅgāvadānaiścareyuḥ | na caikādaśāvadānānyavadyatīti śrutyā'vadānaśabdenāṅgānāmeva bodhanena kathamatra taditarapuroḍāśapracāre'ṣāmadhikaraṇatvamiti vācyam | śrapaṇottarabhāvitvena puroḍāśapracāre'pyapāmadhikaraṇatve bādhakābhāvāt | na caivaṃ puroḍāśapracāra evāpsvastvaṅgapracārastu laukikāgnāviti vācyam | avadānairitibahuvacanavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | na caivaṃ puroḍāśāṅgapracārāvevāpsvāstām | vapāyāstu śrapaṇapūrvabhāvitvāllaukikāgnāveva pracāra iti vācyam | paśumālabhya puroḍāśaṃ nirvapatītiśrutivihitapakṣe vapāpracārasyāpi paśupuroḍāśaśrapaṇānantarabhāvitvasaṃbhavāt | vastutastu vapāyā avadānaśabdenāgrahaṇādagnāveva homaḥ | asti cātra sādhakam, yadi vapā haviravadānaṃ vā skandediti vapāyāḥ pṛthaggrahaṇaṃ ktvāpratyayasvarasaśca | apsviti vacanaṃ prakṛtiṃ prāptasyāgnau pracārasya bādhanārtham | prayājādīnāmapsveva pracāraḥ pradhānasadeśatvādaṅgānām | na cāvabhṛthavadyatrā''pastatra gacchantītivacanābhāvānna gamananiyamaḥ | tenottaravedisthāne'ṣaḥ saṃsthāpyāpi karma bhavati | tatrāvabhṛtha iva vededhmādīnāmarthaluptānāṃ nivṛttiyathārthaṃ mantrāṇāmūhaśca draṣṭavyaḥ | vapāyā agnau pracārapakṣe'pi prayājādīnyapsveva "vipratiṣiddhadharmāṇāṃ samavāye bhūyasāṃ syātsadharmatvam" iti jaiminīyasūtrāt | "mukhyatvādbhūyastvam" ityācāryokteśca | tathā ca virodhe'nekeṣāmanugraho nyāyya iti sidhyati | pañcadaśarātre'gniṣṭutprathamamahastatra nāmnaikāhāgniṣṭuddharmātideśādāgneyī subrahmaṇyā, tato jyotirāditryaha ekāhe jyotirādicodakādaindrī | sā'vaśiṣṭaikādaśasvahaḥsu dvādaśāhātideśādandyaiva | tatropasatkālīnasubrahmaṇyāyāṃ tantrabhūtāyāmaniyamaḥ | mukhyatvādvā'gniṣṭuddharmānugraha iti prāpte bhūyo'nugrahāyaindrīti bhāṣyakṛt | vārtikakārastu -- "anyadevatyayā'nyadevatāyāḥ saṃskārāsiddherbhedenā''hvānasyaiva yuktatvādato naitadudāharaṇaṃ kiṃtvagnaye dātre puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedindrāya pradātre puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānāstatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyaṃ paśukāma iti | tatrā''gneyasya dhānānāṃ cā''gneyavikāratvādavirodhaḥ | aindrasya dadhna aindrāgnasāṃnāyyavikāratvāddarśadharmatvam | madhughṛtāpāṃ tūpāṃśuyājavikāratvātpaurṇamāsīdharmakatvam | tatra sahaprayoge vārtraghnavṛdhanvanmantrayorājyabhāgayoranyatarānuṣṭhānaṃ mukhyatvādaindradadhnostaddharmānugraha iti prāpte bhūyasāṃ madhvādīnāṃ vārtraghnānugrahāya tāveva kāryau" ityāha | na ca "adhikaśca guṇaḥ sādhāraṇe'virodhātkāṃsyabhojivadamukhye'pi" ityetadadhikaraṇasya pravṛttiḥ, tathā caikasya dyāvāpṛthivīyaikakapālapuroḍāśīyapuṣpitabarhiṣaḥ sarvoddeśena grahaṇamivātra vaiparītyamastviti vācyam | etasya nyāyasya parasparāvirodha eva pravṛtteḥ, prakṛte virodhasyaiva sattvenaitasya nyāyasyāsaṃ bhavāt | sa ca nyāya ittham -- āgrayaṇa aindrāgnavaiśvadevadyāvāpṛthivyāni havīṃṣi | tatra dyāvāpṛthivye vaiśvadevikaparvagatadyāvāpṛthivyavikāratvātpuṣpitaṃ barhiḥ prāptam | itareṣāṃ tu barhirmātram | tatra mukhyatvādbhūyastvācca puṣpitameva barhirgrāhyamiti prāpte puṣpitabarhirgrahaṇe'pyanyeṣāmavaiguṇyādapuṣpitagrahaṇe dyāvāpṛthivyasya vaiguṇyātpuṣpitasyaiva niyamaḥ | yathā śiṣyasya kāṃsyagurūcchiṣṭabhojananiyamānurodhena guroḥ kāṃsyabhojananiyame na kaścidvirodha iti siddhāntaḥ | prakṛte tathātvābhāvānnātra kāṃsyabhojinyāyaḥ | avadhikaraṇakau pracārau dvāvagnyadhikaraṇaka eka ityastyavadhikaraṇakapracārasyānekatvamiti | athavā vapāpracāro nāstyevātra | tathā ca bharadvājaḥ -- "yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātsa raudraṃ gardabhamālabheta tasyāvadānairapsu pracaranti nāsya vapayā pracaranti na paśupuroḍāśo bhavatīḍānto bhavati śaṃyuvanto vā nairṛtaḥ prājāpatyo vā" iti | sūtrakṛtā nirṛtiprajāpatirakṣoyamānyatamadevatāyā eva vihitatvādrudradevatā nātreṣṭā | evaṃ paśupuroḍāśaniṣedho'pi na, bhūmāvekakapālaṃ paśupuroḍāśaṃ śrapayitveti tasya vihitatvāt | asminkarmaṇi nirṛtiḥ prajāpatī rakṣāṃsi yama ityetāsāṃ devatānāṃ madhye'nyatamā devatā | prāyaścittasūtra ālabhetetiprayogādyāgaḥ prāpyate | nirṛtidevatatvapakṣe dharmasūtre pākayajñasya vidhānātpākayajñavidhiḥ | prāyaścittasūtravidhānātpaśupakṣo'pi | prajāpatyādidevatātvapakṣe paśupakṣa eva | ayaṃ ca pākayajñavidhirlaukikāgnāvaveva | "pākayajñavidhau laukikāgnāvavakīrṇiprāyaścitam" iti mānavāt | prāyaścittasūtroktarītyā vidhyanuṣṭhāne'pi trīllom̐kikāgnīnsaṃsthāpya teṣveva yāgo na tvādhānam, niṣādarathakāravadācāryeṇā''dhānasyāvidhānāt | "avakīrṇipaśuśca tadvadādhānasyāprāpta[kāla]tvāt" iti jaiminisūtrāt | "vā'vakīrṇino gardabhejyā laukike" iti kātyāyanasūtrācca yo brahmacāryavakiretsa gardabhaṃ paśumālabheteti yāgo'pi lokika evāgnau | laukika ityekavacanaṃ jātau | ekasminnevāgnau sarvakāryāṇīti kecit | etadyāgena brahmacaryabhraṃśasamādhānaṃ vinā vivāho na saṃbhavati | aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramamāvaseditivacanāt | kātyāyanasūtre vāśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣavyāvṛttyarthaḥ | ayaṃ ca niśi catuṣpathe kartavyaḥ "avakīrṇī tu kāṇena" ityudāhṛtamanuvacanāt | pākayajñapakṣe niśyanuṣṭhānaṃ na yāgapakṣe, divākīrtyo vaṣaṭakāra ityāśva lāyanasūtre rātrau yāganiṣedhāt | na caitadeva niśi kartavyatāyāḥ prāpakamastviti vācyam | pākayajñavidhānenetyetadvirodhāpatteḥ | nirṛte rakṣodhipatitvāt | nirṛterdevatātvapakṣe cāpyevameva | rakṣodevatātvapakṣe'pi tathā | rakṣasāṃ rātrisaṃcāritvāt | manuvacane pākayajñaśabde sāhacaryādyajidhātoḥ prayogo gauṇaḥ | tatreti vihāya tasyetivacanena paśudharmapakṣe'pi śūdrakartṛkameva prāśanamiti bodhyate | yadi pākayajñatantra eva śūdrakartṛkaprāśanamiṣṭaṃ bhavettadā tatreti pākayajñatantrakameva karma nirdiśyeta | ataḥ pāśukatantrapakṣe'pi śūdrakartṛkameva prāśanam | hārītenātra viśeṣa uktaḥ -- "strīṣvavakīrṇī nirṛtyai catuṣpathe gardabhena paśunā yajeta pākayajñadharmeṇa bhūmau paśupuroḍāśaśrapaṇamapsvavadānaiḥ pracarya juhoti kāmāvakīrṇo'smyavakīrṇo'smi kāma kāmāya svāhā kāmābhidrugvo'smyabhidrugdho'smi kāma kāmāya svāheti" [iti |] avadānapracārottarametābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ homa uktaḥ | katidhā'vakīrṇītyasminkhaṇḍe tu, amāvāsyāyāṃ rātrāvagnipraṇayanopasamādhānapūrvakaṃ kāmāvakīrṇo'smi kāmābhidrugdho'smītyetābhyāmājyenā''hutidvayaṃ tadanantaraṃ prayatāñjalerīṣattiryagbhūtasya saṃ mā siñcantvityanena praṇītāgnestrirabhimantraṇaṃ varadānaṃ coktam | ityavakīrṇiprāyaścittam | atha śvadaṣṭaprāyaścittam | tatra parāśaraḥ -- "brahmacārī śunā daṣṭastryahaṃ sāyaṃ payaḥ pibet | gṛhasthastu dvirātraṃ vā'pyekāhaṃ cāgnihotravān || nābherūrdhvaṃ tu daṣṭasya tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet | syādetattriguṇaṃ vaktre mastake tu caturguṇam" iti || etatprāyaścittaṃ naiṣṭhikena sarvaṃ dviguṇaṃ kāryam | tathā ca hārītaḥ -- "upakurvaṃstu yaḥ kuryātkāmato'kāmato'pi vā | tadeva dviguṇaṃ kuryādbrahmacārī tu naiṣṭhikaḥ" iti || śātātapaḥ -- "ārūḍho naiṣṭhikaṃ dharmaṃ yastu pracyavate punaḥ | prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti yena śuddho bhavettu saḥ" iti || asminvākye punaritiśravaṇādabhyāse prāyaścittaṃ nāstyeva tasya kiṃtu sarvadā so'śucireveti | atha kāṇḍavratalopaprāyaścittam | kṛtanityakriyo brahmacārī prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mama kāṇḍavratalopajanitapratyavāyaparihāradvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ pratikāṇḍavrataṃ homapūrvakamekaikakṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittamahamācariṣye | aśaktau tvamukapratyāmnāyenāhamācariṣya iti saṃkalpyollekhanādividhinā sthaṇḍilasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya tatra viṇnāmānaṃ laukikamagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā kāṇḍavratalopaprāyaścittahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādi vyāhṛtyantaṃ prasādhanīdevyantaṃ voktvā pradhānahome pratikāṇḍavrataṃ savitāraṃ gāyatryā'ṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyābhiraṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyābhirvā''jyāhutibhiryakṣye | aṅgahome varuṇamityādi agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣājyāhutyā yakṣya ityādi voktvā'nvādhānotkīrtitapakṣānusāreṇa vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ vā kṛtvā pradhānahomaṃ kuryāt | gāyatryā viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ | savitā devatā | gāyatrī chandaḥ | kāṇḍavratalopaprāyaścittapradhānājyahome viniyogaḥ | "oṃ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayātsvāhā" iti pratikāṇḍavrataṃ gāyatryā yathoktasaṃkhyayā''hutīrjuhuyāt | savitra idamiti tyāgaḥ | tataḥ pratyekaṃ kṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ vidadhyāt | aśaktau godānādyanyatamapratyāmnāyena | tata imaṃ me varuṇetyādi sviṣṭakṛdādi vā homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | na trivṛdannahomaḥ | tato brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ vidhāya karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmṛtya karmeśvarāyārpayet | āpūrvikapakṣeṇa vā prayogaḥ | pūrvavatsaṃkalpaprabhṛti tāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmītyetadantaṃ kṛtvā pradhānahome pratikāṇḍavrataṃ savitāraṃ gāyatryā'ṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyābhiraṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyābhi rvā''jyāhutibhiryakṣya ityuktvā'nvādhānasamidho'bhyādhāyāgniṃ paristīrya yāvadupayuktāni pātrāṇyāsādya pavitrakaraṇādi pavitre agnāvādhāyetyantaṃ kṛtvā'dite'numanyasvetyādibhiragniṃ pariṣicya tūṣṇīmekāṃ samidhamabhyādhāyānvādhānotkīrtitasaṃkhyayā gāyatryā''hutīrhutvā pratikāṇḍavrataṃ kṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā paristaraṇāni visṛjyādite'nvama sthā ityādibhiḥ pariṣicya brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | tataḥ śubhe dine kāṇḍavratopākaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kāṇḍādhyayane jāte kāṇḍavratotsarjanaṃ kṛtvā samāvartanaṃ kuryāt | iti kāṇḍavratalopaprāyaścittam | atha yajñopavītanāśaprāyaścittam | yajñopavīte truṭite kaṭeradhastādgate'bhyaṅgodadhisnānapitṛmātṛkṣayāhānvinā kṣālanārthamapi kaṇṭhāduttārite mūtrapurīṣotsargakāle karṇe yajñopavītādhāraṇe raktaśleṣmasurāmāṃsaviṇmūtrādibhirupahate tasya tyāgaṃ kṛtvā prāyaścittahomaṃ kṛtvā nūtanaṃ yajñopavītaṃ dhārayet | sa ca yathā -- prāyaścittahomakartā trivṛtsūtraṃ vāso vā yajñopavītārthe dhṛtvā snātvā'hatavastraparidhānādi kṛtvā prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya yajñopavītanāśajanitapratyavāyaparihāradvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ prāyaścittahomaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya sthaṇḍilaṃ gomayenopalipyollekhanādividhinā saṃskāraṃ vidhāya laukikamagniṃ viṇnāmānamagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmīti pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā yajñopavītanāśaprāyaścittahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādi vyāhṛtyantaṃ prasādhanīdevyantaṃ voktvā pradhānahome gāyatryā savitāramaṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyābhiraṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyābhirvā ghṛtāktatilāhutibhiryakṣya ityuktvā'ṅgahome varuṇaṃ dvābhyāmityādyagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣāhutyā yakṣya ityādi voktvā'nvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇa vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ vā kṛtvā''jyaparyagnikaraṇakāle tilānāmapi paryagnikaraṇam | tato gāyatryāḥ pūrvavadṛṣyādi smṛtvā yajñopavītanāśaprāyaścittatilahome viniyoga iti viniyogaṃ ca smṛtvā vikaniṣṭhā tu haṃsī syādityevaṃrūpayā haṃsīmudrayā, ṛjvyau kaniṣṭhātarjanyāvitare sāṅguṣṭhe mīlite mṛgītimṛgīmudrayā vā ghṛtāktatilāngāyatryā'ṣṭottarasahasramaṣṭottaraśataṃ vā hutvā'ṅgahomādi sviṣṭakṛdādi vā sarvaṃ homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | nātra trivṛdannahomaḥ | karmaṇaḥ saṃpūrṇatāsiddhaye gurave gāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | athavā''pūrvikatantreṇa homaḥ | śākhāviśeṣeṇopavītasya kṣālanārthaṃ kaṇṭhāduttāraṇaniṣedhāpavādamāha devalaḥ -- "mantrapūtaṃ sthitaṃ kāye yasya yajñopavītakam | noddharecca tataḥ prājño ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || sakṛccottāraṇāttasya prāyaścittī bhaveddvijaḥ | taittirīyāḥ kaṭhāḥ kāṇvāścarakā vājaseyinaḥ || kaṇṭhāduttārya sūtraṃ tu kuryurvai kṣālanaṃ dvijāḥ | bahvṛcā sāmagāścaiva ye cānye yājuṣāḥ smṛtāḥ || kaṇṭhāduttārya sūtraṃ tu punararhanti saṃskriyām | abhyaṅge codadhisnāne mātāpitroḥ kṣaye'hani || kaṇṭhāduttārya sūtraṃ tu kuryurvai kṣālanaṃ dvijāḥ" iti || ātharvaṇānāṃ tūttāraṇaṃṃ kṛtākṛtamarthāt | saṃskriyāṃ mantreṇopavītāntaradhāraṇam | abhyaṅga ityetadvākyacoditaviṣayeṣvevaiṣā vyavasthā jñeyā | tato nūtanayajñopavītadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā dvirācamya saṃdhyopāsanādi nityaṃ karma kuryāt | gṛhasthāśramibhirvānaprasthaiścedameva prāyaścittaṃ kāryam | atra mūlaṃ smṛtiratnāvalyām -- "upavītavināśe tu gāyatryā juhuyāttilān | aṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vā" iti || hārītastu manovrātapatībhiścatasra ājyāhutīrhutvā punaḥ pratīyādityāha | 'oṃ manojyoti0 yā iṣṭā upa0 ghṛtena svāhā' ityanayaikā''hutiḥ | oṃ tvamagne vrata0 yadvo vayaṃ pra0 vratānubibhradvratapā adābhyaḥ0'ityetābhistisṛbhirvrātapatībhistisra āhutayaḥ | ityetā āhutīrhutvā punarnūtanaṃ yajñopavītaṃ samantraṃ dhārayedityarthaḥ | etaccāśaktasya jñeyam | yajñopavīte vāmaskandhāvarohite kūrparasthānaṃ gate maṇibandhasthānaṃ gate vā tadyajñopavītaṃ pūrvasthāne niveśya yathākramaṃ trivāraṃ ṣaḍvāraṃ dvādaśavāraṃ vā prāṇāyāmaṃ kuryāt | vāmahastavyatīte tu tadyajñopavītaṃ pūrvavadvisṛjyānyāni pūrvavaddhārayet | (kaṇṭhe yajñopavītāntarasattva etatprāyaścittaṃ neti kecit | vināśasya nimittatvātprāyaścittaṃ bhavatyevetyanye |) yaḥ kopena balātkāreṇa vā svadhṛtaṃ yajñopavītaṃ chinatti cetpūrvavannavatantumātraṃ dhṛtvā nadyādau snātvā'nyāni yajñopavītāni pūrvavaddhṛtvā chinnaṃ pūrvavadvisṛjet | chedanapāpaviśuddhyarthamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ gāyatrīṃ japet | atra mahāpātakayuktastu tatpātakaprāyaścittakaraṇaparyantaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ yajñopavītaṃ vihāya laukikaṃ sūtraṃ dhārayet | brāhmaṇabruvakānīnakuṇḍagolakavrātyakuṣṭhyavakīrṇinastvasaṃskṛtaṃ yajñopavītaṃ dhārayeyurityāhnikapārijāte | jīrṇasya parityāge viśeṣastatraiva -- "jīrṇaṃ saridabdhitaṭākādyanyatamodake samudraṃ gaccha svāhetimantreṇa praṇavena vyāhṛtitrayeṇa vā visṛjet" iti | atha kamaṇḍalubhaṅgaprāyaścittam | tatredaṃ baudhāyanadharmasūtram -- "bhagne kamaṇḍalau vyātdṛtibhiḥ śataṃ juhuyājjapedvā bhūmirbhūmimagānmātā mātaramapyagāt | bhūyāsma putraiḥ paśubhiryo no dveṣṭi sa bhidyatāmiti bhinnamabhimantrya kapālāni saṃgṛhyāpsu nikṣipya sāvitrīṃ daśāvarāṃ japitvā punarevānyaṃ gṛhṇīyādetatte varuṇa punaretu māmom" iti | atha samāvartanam | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "adhītya veda snānam" iti | vedo mantrabrāhmaṇātmakaḥ | "mantrabrāhmaṇayorvedanāmadheyam" iti sūtrāt | karmavidhānaṃ brāhmaṇam | arthavādādīnāṃ tu brāhmaṇaśeṣatvam | "karmavidhānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ taccheṣo'rthavādo nindā praśaṃsā parakṛtiḥ purākalpaśca" iti sūtrāt | bhadrādidaśapraśnānāmaraṇye'dhyetavyatvādāraṇyaka iti saṃjñā na tu pṛthakkaścana vedabhāgo'yam | snānaśabdena samāvartanam | dharmasūtre viśeṣaḥ -- "vidyayā snātītyeke tathā vratenāṣṭācatvāriṃśatparimāṇena vidyā vratena ca" iti vedavidyā vidyā tayā saṃpannaḥ snānaṃ kuryādityeke manyante | aṣṭācatvāriṃśadgrahaṇaṃ gṛhyoktasya caturviṃśatirityāderupalakṣaṇam | aṣṭācatvāriṃśadādiparimāṇena [vra]tena vā saṃpannaḥ snāyādasaṃpanno'pi vidyayā | vidyā vratena ca, vidyeti 'supāṃ suluk' ityādinā tṛtīyāntam | vidyayā vratena cobhābhyāṃ saṃpannaḥ snāyāditi caike manyante | evamadhītya veda snānaṃ tadvyākhyāsyāma ityatra vedamityupalakṣaṇaṃ vratasya atra yājñavalkyaḥ -- "vedaṃ vratāni vā pāraṃ nītvā hyubhayameva vā | aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahet" iti || atra vrataśabdenā''cāryakulavāsyaśnāti kṣāraṃ lavaṇamityādayo brahmacāridharmā ucyante | teṣu hi kālaparimāṇasya śrutatvāt | dṛśyate ca teṣu vrataśabdaḥ | yathā vrateṣu samarthaḥ syādyāni vakṣyāma iti | na tu vedavratāni | teṣāṃ tattatpradeśādhyayanaśeṣatayā tadabhāve'bhāvādvedaṃ vratāni vetivikalpānupapatteḥ | ataḥ kālaviśeṣāvacchinnāni vratāni vedamubhayaṃ vā pāraṃ nītvetyartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | "jātaputraḥ kṛṣṇakeśo'gnīnādadhīta" itiśrutivirodhaparihārāyāṣṭācatvāriṃśatamiti pakṣa ādhānānadhikāriṇi pakṣāntarāṇi tvadhikāriṇīti vyavasthāṃ kecidvadantītyapi tena mātṛdattena coktam | manuḥ -- "vedānadhītya vedau vā vedaṃ vā'pi samāhitaḥ | aviplutabrahmacaryo gṛhasthāśramamāviśet" iti || evaṃ cādhītya veda snānamityatra vedamityekavacanamavivakṣitam | etacca snānaṃ gurave varaṃ dattvā kāryam | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ -- "gurave tu varaṃ dattvā snāyīta tadanujñayā | vedaṃ vratāni vā pāraṃ nītvā hyubhayameva vā | aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahet" iti || atrāpi vedamityekavacanamavivakṣitam | varasvarūpe viśeṣo'tra manunoktaḥ -- "snāsyaṃstu guruṇā''jñaptaḥ śaktyā gurvarthamāharet | kṣetraṃ hiraṇyaṃ gāmaśvaṃ chatropānahamantataḥ || dhānyaṃ vāsāṃsi śākaṃ vā gurave prītimāvahan" iti | ājñaptaḥ samāvartanāyānujñātaḥ | kṣetraṃ sasyavat | chatropānaddravyayoḥ sahitayorevopādānaṃ dvaṃdvopādānāt | vāsāṃsi trīṇi | eteṣāṃ madhye yadeva guroḥ priyaṃ tadeva dadyādityāśayaḥ | gurave prītimāvahannityanena dānamantareṇaiva guroḥ prītau kevalaṃ tadanujñayaiva samāvartanaṃ kuryādityapi sūcyate | ata evoktaṃ saṃgrahe -- "tenoktaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā snānaṃ śiṣyaḥ samācaret | alamarthena me vatsa tvadguṇairasmi toṣitaḥ | gṛhāngacchānujānāmītyanujñāto'thavā''caret" iti || tenoktaṃ guruṇoktam | etaddānaṃ guruprītyarthaṃ na vidyāniṣkrayaḥ | vedavidyārhasya mūlyasyāsaṃbhavāt | tathā ca cchandogaśrutiḥ -- " yadyapyasmādilāmadbhiḥ parigṛhītāmannena pūrṇāṃ dadyādetadeva tato bhūyaḥ" iti | ilā pṛthivī | etadvidyāgrahaṇam | tāpanīyaśrutirapi -- "saptadvīpavatī bhūmirdakṣiṇārthaṃ na kalpate" iti | mādhavīye hārīto'pi -- "ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye niyojayet | pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā'pyanṛṇī bhavet" iti || āhitāgniścedguruḥ "yadyaśvaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāttadā niṣkrayasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ dvādaśāṃśaṃ vā brāhmaṇāya dattvā yāvato'śvānpratigṛhṇīyāttāvato vāruṇān catuṣkapālānnirvapet" itiśrutivihitāmaśvapratigraheṣṭiṃ kuryāt | gṛhyāgnimāṃstu tatsthāne sthālīpākānkuryāt -- "aśvapratigrahaṃ kṛtvā careccāndrāyaṇatrayam | lakṣatrayaṃ vā gāyatryā japedvidvānsamāhitaḥ || triguṇaṃ vācayedvedaṃ śataṃ viprāṃśca bhojayet" ityaruṇasmṛtyuktasya śaktau satyāṃ samuccayaḥ | dāturiyamiṣṭiriti mīmāṃsakamataṃ tu na satyāṣāḍhasūtrānusāriṇāmiṣṭam | "ṛtvijo'śvapratigrahe vāruṇī" iti kāmyeṣṭiprakaraṇa ṛtvija eva tasyā vidhānāt | ṛtvija iti ṣaṣṭhyekavacanam | ekatvamantrāvivakṣitamuddeśyagatatvāt | grahaṃ saṃmārṣṭītivat | vedādhyayanottaraṃ tadarthamadhigamyaiva samāvartanaṃ kartavyam | "vedānvedāṃstathā vedau vedaṃ vā'pi samāhitaḥ | adhītya cādhigamyārthaṃ tataḥ snāyāddvijottamaḥ" iti kaurmokteḥ | prathamaṃ vedānitivacanaṃ catuṣṭvābhiprāyaṃ, dvitīyaṃ tritvābhiprāyam | arthamadhigamyārthaṃ jñātvetyarthaḥ | uktaśca jaiminyādibhiḥ prathamasūtra evārthajñānaṃ vinā'dhyayanamātreṇa samāvartanādhikārābhāvaḥ | evaṃ ca vidyāsnātakavratasnātakayorubhayorapi snānātpūrvaṃ vedārthajñānamāvaśyakamiti siddham | tatra snātakastrividhaḥ | vidyāsnātako vratasnātako vidyāvatasnātakaśca | atra vrataśabdenākṣāralavaṇāśitvādirūpā brahmacāridharmā ucyante | etatkālastu "aṣṭācatvāriṃśadvarṣāṇi caturviṃ śatiṃ dvādaśa yāvadgrahaṇaṃ vā" iti gṛhya uktaḥ | "adhītya veda snānam" ityasminsūtre snānaṃ vyākhyāsyāma ityetāvatā siddhe'dhītya vedamitivacanamadhyayanapradhānaṃ snānaṃ na kālapradhānamitikhyāpanārtham | tenātikrānte'pi vratakāle sati saṃbhave'dhītyaiva snātavyamiti | atyantāśaktāveva vratamātreṇa snātavyamiti | vidyāsnānaṃ vidyāvratasnānaṃ ca praśastaṃ vratamātrasnānaṃ garhitamiti | brahmacaryasya vidyārthatvācchrutiviśeṣācca pūjāyāṃ phalaviśeṣa iti mātṛdattaḥ | gobhilagṛhye -- "trayaḥ snātakā bhavanti vidyāsnātako vratasnātako vidyāvratasnātaka iti teṣāmuttamaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ" iti | kāmaṃ tu yājñikasyetisūtravyākhyāvasare karkaḥ -- yajñaṃ vedeti yājñikastasya kāmaṃ snānaṃ bhavati ṣaḍaṅgamarthato'nadhigamyāpīti | hariharo'pi -- sāṅgaṃ vedamadhītyāvabudhya snāyādityekaḥ pakṣaḥ | mantrabrāhmaṇātmakaṃ vedamadhītyāvabudhya snāyāditi dvitīyaḥ | granthamadhītya yajñavidyāṃ cābhyasya snāyāditi tṛtīyaḥ | yajñavidyāviraheṇa granthamātre'dhīte na snāyāditi niṣedha iti ceti | athaitatkālaḥ | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe rohiṇyāṃ mṛgaśirasi tiṣya uttarayoḥ phalgunyorhaste citrāyāṃ viśākhayorvaiteṣu snāyāt" iti | udagayane makarādiṣu ṣaṭsu rāśiṣu śraviṣṭhārdhamārabhya sārdhacaturdaśasu nakṣatreṣu sthita āditya āpūryamāṇapakṣe yāni rohiṇyādīni viśākhāntānyanukrāntāni netarāṇi teṣu snāyāt | vāśabdaḥ snānasya vikalpārthaḥ snāyānna vā snāyāditi | tena yasya karmasvadhikāro nāsti tasya naiṣṭhikabrahmacaryameva vā syāt | anukramaṇādeva siddha eteṣvitivacanaṃ rohiṇyādiṣvasaṃbhave tādṛśeṣvanyeṣvapi puṇyeṣu snāyāditi vyākhyātametanmātṛdattena | baudhāyanasūtre -- "rohiṇyāṃ tiṣya uttarayoḥ phalgunyorhaste citrāyāmaindre viśākhayorvā snāyāt" iti | aindraṃ jyeṣṭhā | dakṣiṇāyane vivāhe'pi samāvartanamudagayana eva | madhye mātāpitranujñāvyavadhānasya sūtrakṛtaivoktatvāttenaivodagayanasya tasya vihitatvāt | "vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhasthasya prātarārambhaṇaṃ bhavet | snātakenāpi tatkāryaṃ pṛthakpāko bhavedyadi" iti | vaiśvadevaprakaraṇe vakṣyamāṇaprayogapārijātadhṛtaśaunakavacane gṛhasthasnātakatvarūpāvasthādvayapradarśanasya nirarthakatvāpatteḥ | bahūnāṃ snātakadharmāṇāṃ smṛtiṣu pradarśanasya svatantranakṣatrādikālavidhānasya ca vaiyarthyāpatteśca | "anāśramī na tiṣṭheta dinamekamapi dvijaḥ" | iti niṣedhastvavirāgiṇo vivāhanivṛttiniṣedhaparaḥ | mātāpitranujñāyāṃ satyāmasati virāge vivāhaḥ kartavya eva na tu vivāhānnivarteteti | uktaṃ caitacchrutyā "ācāryāya priyaṃ dhanamāhṛtya prajātantuṃ mā vyavacchetsīḥ" ityanayā | ācāryāyā''cāryārthaṃ priyamiṣṭaṃ dhanamāhṛtyā''nīya dattvā''cāryeṇa cānujñāto'nurūpāndārānāhṛtya prajāsaṃtānaṃ mā vyavacchetsīḥ prajāsaṃtatervicchittirna kartavyā | anutpadyamāne'pi putre putrakāmyādikarmaṇā tadutpattau yatnaḥ kartavya ityabhiprāya iti vidyāraṇyaśrīpādairvyākhyātā | mātāpitranujñā tu "samāvṛtta ācāryakulānmātāpitarau bibhṛyāttābhyāmanujñāto bhāryāmupayacchet" ityanena sūtreṇoktā | ata etasmātsūtrādvyavadhānasiddheḥ samāvartanavivāhayoravyavadhānaṃ dūrāpāstameva | pārijāte śrīdharaḥ -- "vāgīśāditipauṣṇasaumyadinakṛnmaitrottarārohiṇīgovindeṣu śaśāṅkabhānuguruvicchukrāṃśahorādiṣu | riktāṃ parva tathā'ṣṭamīṃ pratipadaṃ meṣaṃ ca kīṭaṃ hariṃ hitvā śuddhiyute'ṣṭame'hni vimale kuryātsamāvartanam" iti | vāgīśaḥ puṣyanakṣatram | aditiḥ punarvasū | pauṣṇaṃ revatī | saumyaṃ mṛgaśiraḥ | dinakṛddhastaḥ | maitramanūrādhāḥ | uttarā uttarātrayam | govindaḥ śravaṇaḥ | śaśāṅkaścandraḥ | vidbudhaḥ | aṃśahorā uktānāmeva | riktāścaturthīnavamīcaturdaśyaḥ | parva parvadvayam | kīṭo vṛścikaḥ | hariḥ siṃhaḥ | śuddhiyute grahaviśeṣākramaṇadoṣaśūnye | ahni vimale guruśukrāstādidoṣaśūnye | madanaratne nāradaḥ -- "athottarāyaṇe jīvaśukrayordṛśyamānayoḥ | dvijātīnāṃ gurorgehānnivṛttānāṃ yatātmanām || mitrottarāditījyāntyaharīnduravidhātṛṣu | bheṣvarkendujñāryaśukravāralagnāṃśakeṣu ca || athavā bījanakṣatravāralagnāṃśakeṣvapi | pratipatparvariktākhyā aṣṭamī ca dinakṣayam || hitvā'nyadivase kāryaṃ samāvartanamaṇḍanam" iti || bījanakṣatrāṇi bījāvāpanakṣatrāṇi | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "snānaṃ madhyāhnakāle tu rohiṇyāṃ kārayecchubham | pūrvāhṇe tadabhāve ca kuryātsnānaṃ yathāvidhi" iti || idaṃ tu brahmacārikartṛkameva | samāvartanātprākkarmāṇyācāryakartṛkāṇi yāvaduktaṃ brahmacārī karoti | samāvartanaṃ tu brahmacārikartṛkameva | adhītya veda snānamitisūtre'dhītyetiktvāpratyayenādhyayanasnānayoḥ samānakartṛkatvasyoktatvāt | atha prayogaḥ | brahmacārī sāṅgasārthavedādhyayanavratābhyāṃ saṃpannaḥ sāṅgasārthavedādhyayanamātrasaṃpanno vā vedādhyayanamātrasaṃpanno vā vratamātrasaṃpanno vā paripālitabrahmacāriniyamaḥ kṛtakāṇḍavratopākaraṇotsarjanagodānaḥ kṛtādhyāyopākaraṇo guruṃ dakṣiṇānnādinā saṃtoṣya tenānujñāta udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe riktāparvāṣṭamīpratipadvyatiriktadvitīyādyanyatamatithau bhānusomabudhaguruśukrānyatame vāre tadaṃśahorāyāṃ rohiṇīmṛgatiṣyottarāphalgunīhastacitrāviśākhānyatame sūtravihite nakṣatre tadasaṃbhave punarvasvanūrādhājyeṣṭhāśravaṇottarābhādrapadārevatyanyatame śāstrāntarokte nakṣatre meṣavṛścikasiṃhabhinnalagne guruśukrāstabālyavārdhakyamalamāsavakrāticāradinakṣayādidoṣaśūnye divase jyotirvitprokte sumuhūrta ācāryagṛha udakasamīpe vā goṣṭhe vā snānāparaparyāyaṃ samāvartanākhyaṃ karma kuryāt | yadā goṣṭhe tadā tṛṇavastrādibhirgoṣṭhaṃ pracchādya yathā sūryakiraṇānāmapi darśanaṃ na bhavati tathā samyakkaṭādinā pariśritya sūryodayātprāgeva tatra praviśya tatraiva sarvaṃ karma kṛtvā rātrau bahirgantavyam | kṛtanityakriya ubhayakāle'gnikāryakriyāṃpakṣe prātaragnikāryaṃ kṛtvā prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mama gṛha sthāśramādhikārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ samāvartanākhyaṃ karma kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ pitā putrasamāvartanāṅgabhūtaṃ gaṇapatipūjanamityādināndīśrāddhāntaṃ karmoktarītyā kuryāt | atra śrīḥ prīyatāmiti viśeṣaḥ | indraḥ prīyatāmiti vā | athavā nāndīśrāddhamātraṃ pitṛkartṛkaṃ gaṇapatipūjanapuṇyāhavācanamātṛkāpūjanāni tu svayameva kāryāṇi | mātṛkāpūjanasya nāndīśrāddhāṅgatvapakṣe tadapi pitṛkartṛkameva | pitṛsattve'pi svayameva vā gaṇapatipūjanādi nāndīśrāddhāntaṃ kuryāditi kecit | tato brahmacāryevollekhanādividhinā sthaṇḍilasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya tatra pāvakanāmānaṃ śrotriyāgārādāhṛtaṃ laukikamagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samitrayamādāya śraddha gṛha eva pūjākartā tadā vāhanārohaṇābhāvaḥ | sūryadarśanapratiṣedho goṣṭhakaraṇapakṣa eva | tataḥ -- 'oṃ sa sravantu diśo mayi samāgacchantu sūnṛtāḥ sarve kāmā abhiyantu naḥ priyā abhisravantu naḥ priyāḥ' iti sakṛnmantramuktvā diśa upatiṣṭhate | tato yatra pūjāṃ kariṣyanto bhavanti tatra gacchati | gacchannetra vā 'oṃ yaśo'si yaśo'haṃ tvayi bhūyāsamamukaśarman' [iti] yaḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyanbhavati tamābhimukhyena samīpaṃ gacchanyānādavaruhyānavaruhya vā samyagīkṣate | atha madhuparkaḥ | pūjakaḥ samāvartanadine svagṛhaṃ pratyāgatāya snātakāya śayanāsanādimadāvāsasthānaṃ kalpayitvā kṛtayānāvarohaṇaṃ pūjyaṃ prāṅmukhamupaveśya niyatasaṃkhyadarbhamayaṃ kūrcaṃ prakalpya pādyārthā apo hvasīyasi pātre saṃbhṛtya mahattareṇa pātreṇāpidadhyāt | evamarghyārthānāmācamanārthānāṃ ca pṛthakpātrayoḥ saṃbharaṇamapidhānaṃ ca | nātra kāṃsyapātraniyamaḥ | tato hrasīyasi kāṃsyapātre dadhyānīya madhvānayati | tato ghṛtamiti trivṛtaṃ madhuparkaṃ kṛtvā mahattareṇa pidhāya sūtreṇā''veṣṭayet | dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpaḥ saktava iti pāṅkto vā | asminpakṣe dadhyādīnāṃ miśraṇe nāsti kramaḥ | ghṛtaṃ tvantata evābhighāraṇarūpatvāt | pāṅktapakṣe'pi hrasīyasyānayanaṃ varṣīyasā'pidhānaṃ ca kṛtvā sūtraveṣṭanaṃ kāryam | trivṛtpāṅktayorasaṃbhave madhusaṃbhave madhusaṃsṛṣṭo madhuparkaḥ | payo vā madhusaṃsṛṣṭamabhāva udakamitidharmasūtroktaprakāreṇa vā prakalpayet | tato gāṃ vastraṃ yajñopavītadvayaṃ yathāvibhavamābharaṇāni mālyādīni copaka lpayet | sati saṃbhava udīcīnapratiṣīvaṇamerakāsanaṃ bahuguṇamuttaradaśavāsasā''cchāditaṃ pūjyasyopaveśanārthaṃ kalpayati | etadāsanakalpanaṃ gṛhasya madhye gṛhasyaiśānabhāge prāgagrāndarbhānāstīrya teṣu dravyāṇāmāsādanam | yāvantaḥ pūjyāstāvantyāsanādīni | pratipātramekaikaḥ kūrca āsādanārtham | pātrapradānakāle pātrasyādhastādupariṣṭācca parigrahaṇārthaṃ dvau kūrcau | etau ca sarvapātrārthau | ayaṃ ca baudhāyanokto viśeṣaḥ | vastrakuṇḍalasragādidānamapi baudhāyanīyameva | pūjakaḥ pūjyasya dakṣiṇa udaṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya, imaṃ snātakaṃ madhuparkeṇa pūjayiṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | uktakūrcādidravyajātena sahā''dāturabhiprāyānukūlo bhūtvoccairbhūtayā vācaikaikaṃ prāheti pradāne vidhiḥ | pūjakaḥ -- oṃ argha iti triḥ sakṛdvā pūjyaṃ prāha | kuruteti pūjyaḥ | pūjakaḥ oṃ kūrca iti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ -- sukūrca ityuktvā hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhya "oṃ rāṣṭrabhṛdasyācāryāsandī mā tvadyopam" ityudagagre kūrce prāṅmukha upaviśet | tataḥ pūjakaḥ -- oṃ pādyamiti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | supādyamiti pūjyaḥ | tataḥ pūjakasya dāso vā dāsī vā tadīyabrāhmaṇo vā pūjyasya pādau prakṣālayati | tatra brāhmaṇo dakṣiṇaṃ pādamagre prakṣālya savyaṃ prakṣālayati | kṣatriyavaiśyayostvaniyamaḥ | dāso dāsī vā cetsavyamevāgre tato dakṣiṇam | atra smārtaṃ dvirācamanam | yo'sya pādau prakṣālayatītyanena prakṣālane kartraniyamaḥ pradarśyate | tena brāhmaṇakartṛkamapi prakṣālanaṃ bhavati na tu śūdraḥ śūdrā veti dvayoreva kartṛtvaṃ niyatamiti siddhaṃ bhavati | prakṣālayitṛhastābhimarśanavidhānenedamapyavagamyate prakṣālanamanyakartṛkameveti | tataḥ pūjakaḥ -- 'oṃ virājo doho'si mayi dohaḥ padyāyai virājaḥ' [iti] prakṣālayiturhastāvabhimṛśati | 'oṃ mayi teja indriyaṃ vīryamāyuḥ kīrtirvarco yaśo balam' [iti]ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśyāpa upaspṛśet | tataḥ pūjako'rghyā apo gandhamālyavastrayajñopavītadvayālaṃkaraṇasahitā gṛhītvā, omarghyamiti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ -- svarghyamityuktvā 'oṃ ā mā ganyaśasā sa sṛja tejasā varcasā payasā ca taṃ mā kuru priyaṃ prajānāmadhipatiṃ paśūnām' [iti] gandhamālyavastrayajñopavītadvayālaṃkaraṇasahitamañjalau pūjakena kiṃcinninīyamānamarghyodakaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | tata ātmānaṃ gandhamālyavastrakuṇḍalasragādibhiralaṃkṛtyāvaśiṣṭamarghyajalaṃ pūjakāya pradāya 'oṃ samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi0 matpayaḥ' [iti] tajjalaṃ pūjakena ninīyamānamanumantrayate | gandhādīnāmarghyajalena saha dāne baudhāyanasūtramūlikā mātṛdattoktiḥ, rudraskandhabhāṣyakāroktiśca mūlam | tataḥ pūjakaḥ -- 'omācamanīyamiti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ svācamanīyamityuktvā, amṛtopastaraṇamasītyasya yājñikyo devatā upaniṣado jalaṃ yajuḥ | ācamane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ amṛtopastaraṇamasi' [iti] pūjakadattajalārdhenā''cāmati | nātra śuddhācamanam | pūjakaḥ -- oṃ madhuparka iti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ -- sumadhuparka ityuktvā devasya tvetyasya prajāpatiḥ savitā yajuḥ | madhuparkapratigrahaṇe viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi' [iti] ākāśavatā'ñjalinā pratigṛhya 'oṃ pṛthivyāstvā nābhau sādayāmīḍāyāḥ pade' [iti] taṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhāpya 'oṃ yanmadhuno madhavyaṃ paramamannādya rūpaṃ tenāhaṃ madhuno madhavyena parameṇa rūpeṇa paramo madhavyo'nnādo bhūyāsam' [iti] aṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayopakaniṣṭhikayā cāṅgulyā madhuparkamāloḍayati sakṛnmantreṇa dvistṛūṣṇīm | 'oṃ tejase tvā śriyai yaśase balāyānnādyāya prāśnāmi' [iti] mantrāvṛttyā'ṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayopakaniṣṭhikayā cāṅgulyā trirmadhuparkaṃ prāśnāti | hastaṃ prakṣālya rātaya ucchiṣṭaṃ prayacchati | tadabhāve sarvaṃ prāśnīyāt | lokavidviṣṭatvādidānīṃ sarvasyaiva prāśanam | tato'mṛtāpidhānamasītyasya yājñikyo devatā upaniṣado jalaṃ yajuḥ | ācamane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ amṛtāpidhānamāsi' [iti] sarveṇa pūrvācamanaśiṣṭajalenā''cāmati | tato mukhaṃ hastaṃ ca prakṣālya smārtamācamanaṃ laukikajalena | tataḥ pūjakaḥ -- oṃ gauriti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ -- sugaurityuktvā 'oṃ gaurdhenurbhavyā mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnā svasā''dityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | praṇuvocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa | pibatūdakaṃ tṛṇānyattu | omutsṛjata' iti paṭhitvā tāmutsṛjet | mantraliṅgādgauratra stryeva | tasyā hananapakṣe 'oṃ gaurasyapahatapāpmā'pa pāpmānaṃ jahi mama cāmuṣya ca hataṃ me dviṣantara hato me dviṣankuruta' iti paṭhitvā paricārakaiḥ saṃskṛtaṃ tanmāṃsaṃ bhuñjīyāt | utsargapakṣe'nyenāniṣiddhena māṃsena | kalau govadhasya niṣiddhatvādutsarga eva kartavyaḥ | anyamāṃsāśanamapi na bhavati | tasyāpi kalau niṣiddhatvāt | māṃsasthāne māṣasahitamannaṃ deyam | pūjako māṣasahitamannaṃ saṃskṛtya siddhe'nna oṃ bhūtamiti triḥ sakṛdvā prāha | pūjyaḥ -- 'oṃ tatsubhūtaṃ virāḍannaṃ tanmā kṣayi tanme'śīya tanma ūrjaṃ dhāstatsubhūtam' iti paṭhitvā brāhmaṇānbhojayateti pratyāha | tatra brāhmaṇāścatvāro nānāgotrāḥ | 'caturo nānāgotrānbrāhmaṇānbhojayatetyeva brūyāt' iti baudhāyanokteḥ | tataḥ pūjako brāhmaṇabhuktaśiṣṭamannaṃ snātakāya dadāti | pūjyaḥ -- 'oṃ dyauste dadātu pṛthivī pratigṛhṇātu pṛthivī te dadātu prāṇaḥ pratigṛhṇātu prāṇastvā'śnātu prāṇaḥ pibatu' iti pūjakena dattamannaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | indrāgnī ma ityasya soma indrāgnyādayo'nuṣṭup | annāśane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ indrāgnī me varcaḥ kṛṇutāṃ varcaḥ somo bṛhaspatiḥ | varco me viśve devā varco me dhattamaśvinā' [iti] yāvatkāmaṃ prāśnāti | yadi pātre śeṣo bhavettadā taṃ rātaye prayacchennikhanedvā | kalau rātaya ucchiṣṭadānasya lokagarhitatvānnikhananameva | tato mukhādikaṃ prakṣālya dvivāramācāmet | atra vā gandhādīnāṃ dānam | bhuktavadbhyo vastrayugāni(ṇi) kuṇḍalayugāni sragalaṃkaraṇamiti ca dadyādekadhanaṃ paṣṭhauhīṃ ca dadyādityeke | prāṅmadhuparkādalaṃkaraṇameke samāmanantīti baudhāyanoktam | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ gandhādīnām | ekadhanaṃ mukhyaṃ dhanam | paṣṭhauhī caturvarṣā prathamaprasūtā gauḥ | pūrvatra gandhamālyādidānapratiṣedhamuktvoktaṃ devatrātenāpi, tānyuparate karmaṇi dātavyānīti | uparate samāpte madhuparkākhye karmaṇi satītyarthaḥ | bhojanānto hi madhuparkaḥ | anenaiva prakāreṇartvigācāryaśvaśuravaivāhyādibhyo madhuparkadānam | yaṃ rātiṃ madadhīnaḥ syāditi yaḥ kāmayeta sa svayaṃ bhuktvā''camya tasya vratocchiṣṭasya(ṣṭaṃ) bhuktavata ācāntasya rāterdakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāti 'oṃ yasminbhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarve lokā iha śritāḥ | tena tvā'haṃ pratigṛhṇāmi tvāmahaṃ brahmaṇā tvāmahaṃ gṛhṇāmyasau' iti mantreṇa | atrāsāvityatra rāternāmno grahaṇam | idaṃ ca hastagrahaṇaṃ kāmyaṃ kāmayeneti vacanāt | tataḥ snātakaḥ kalpite tasminnāvasathe rātriścesthitvā svagṛhaṃ gacchet | yadā tu pitā'dhyāpayitā grāmādbahirnadyādau gṛhāddūrasthe goṣṭhe vā cetsnānaṃ tadā chatradhāraṇāntakarmānantaraṃ rathādyanyatamaṃ yānamāruhya pitṛgṛhamāgacchet | pitratirikte'dhyāpayitari tu tadgṛhe snānaṃ kṛtvā rathādyanyatamaṃ yānamāruhya pitṛgṛhaṃ gantavyam | pitrā'pi snātakasya putrasya svagṛhāgamane madhuparkapūjā kāryā | pitā madhuparkeṇārhayediti manuvacanāt | evamanyairapi snātakasya madhuparkapūjā kāryā | yadidaṃ yānārohaṇaṃ diśāmupasthānaṃ pūjakanirīkṣaṇaṃ ca samantramuktaṃ tatsamāvartanāṅgatvātsnātakasyaiva bhavati nartvigādīnām | ata evā''cāryeṇa pūjakanirīkṣaṇottaraṃ karmāntarādhikārārtho'thaśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ | tataḥ snātako brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ bhūyasīdakṣiṇādānaṃ ca vidhāya karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmṛtya karmeśvarāyārpayet | atha madhuparkaviṣaye kiṃciducyate | madhuparko dvividhaḥ | gosahitastadrahitaśca | tatra gosahito vedādhyāyyācāryādīnām | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram 'gomadhuparkārho vedādhyāyyācārya ṛtviksnātakaḥ śvaśuro rājā vā dharmayuktaḥ' iti | gauśca madhuparkaśca gomadhuparkau tābhyāmarho yogya ityarthaḥ | etādṛśe samāse madhuparkāntargatagorapekṣayā'dhikā gaurdeyā bhavati | vedādhyāyītyācāryādiviśeṣaṇam | yadyācāryādayaḥ kṛtsnavedādhyāyinastadaiva madhuparkādadhikā gaurdeyā nānyadeti | etena jñāyate vedaikadeśādhyāyino'pyācāryādayaḥ syuste'pi kevalena madhuparkeṇa pūjyā eveti | athavā gavā yukto madhuparko gomadhuparka ityevaṃ samāsaḥ | madhuparkaścātra mukhyavṛttyā madhuparkapradānāntaḥ | asminpakṣe madhuparkāntargatagorapyabhāvaḥ | adhikagodānābhāvastu sutarām | anyaśca dharmasūtre viśeṣaḥ -- 'ācāryāyartvije snātakāya śvaśurāya rājña iti parisaṃvatsarādupatiṣṭhadbhyo gaurmadhuparkaśca' iti | pūrvoktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭānāmācāryādīnāṃ saṃvatsarottaraṃ prāptānāmeteṣāṃ goyuktamadhuparkeṇa pūjā kāryetyarthaḥ | anena sūtreṇāvadhipradarśanaṃ kriyate | vidyāsnātakavidyāvratasnātakābhyāmeva gaurdeyā na kevalavratasnātakāya | uttarasūtrādidaṃ jñāyate -- pūrvasūtre dharmopadeṣṭṛtvādidharmasaṃpattiprayukto madhuparka iti | tatra dharmopadeṣṭurmadhuparka upanayanottaramṛtvijo varaṇottaraṃ snātakasya samāvartanānte śvaśurasya devakotthāpanānte rājño'bhiṣekānta iti draṣṭavyam | pratinimittaṃ naimittikamitinyāyāt, ṛtvijo vṛtvā madhuparkamāharedityāśvalāyanasūtrātpunaḥ punaryajña iti cchandogasūtrācca pratiyajñaṃ saṃvatsarottaraṃ devabhūtapitṛbhūtānāmṛtvijāṃ karmavyatiriktakāla upasthitiḥ saṃbhavati na manuṣyabhūtānāṃ karmavyatiriktakāla eteṣāmṛtviktvāsaṃbhavāt | anyānapi madhuparkārhānāha jābāliḥ -- "vivāhyamṛtvijaṃ caiva śrotriyaṃ gṛhamāgatam | arhayenmadhuparkeṇa snātakaṃ priyameva ca" iti || baudhāyano'pi -- "athaite'rghyā ṛtvikśvaśurapitṛvyamātulācāryā rājā snātakaḥ priyāgato'tithiriti saṃvatsaraṃ paryāgatebhya etebhya eva kuryādvivāhe varāyāthartvigbhyaḥ karmaṇi karmaṇi dadāti" iti | arghyā arghyārhā madhuparkapūjārhā iti yāvat | pitṛvyamātulavivāhyapriyā tithīnāṃ sūtra itiśabdena saṃgraho draṣṭavyaḥ | vivāhyasya tu kevalaṃ madhuparka eva na tu gauradhikā | ṛtvigbhyo deyānāṃ gavāṃ saṃkhyāviśeṣa ukto baudhāyanagṛhye -- 'nānāmahartvigbhyo gāḥ prāhaikāṃ hotrakebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vaikāṃ vibhavāt' iti | utsargapakṣe viśeṣa uktastenaiva -- "tasyāmutsṛṣṭāyāṃ meṣamajaṃ vā''labhata āraṇyena vā māṃsena na tvevāmāṃso'rghaḥ syādaśaktau māṣānnam' iti | anyacca tenaivoktaṃ -- 'mahayedṛtvijamācāryaṃ cā''tmānaṃ vā eṣa mahayati yaḥ svamṛtvijamācāryaṃ ca mahayati' iti | mahayati pūjayatītyarthaḥ | athātyāturasya samāvartanānukalpaḥ | tatrā''pastambaḥ -- 'athaitadaparaṃ tūṣṇīmeva tīrthe snātvā tūṣṇīṃ samidhamādadhāti' iti | vyākhyātametatsudarśanena -- "athāparametadvidhānamucyata iti śeṣaḥ | tīrthe puṇyanadyādau | samidhaṃ pālāśīm | evakārāccāsminvidhau nānyatkiṃcidanuṣṭheyam" iti | prayogastu -- brahmacāriliṅgāni mekhalādīni tyaktvā tīrthe tūṣṇīṃ snātvā vāsontaraparidhānādi kṛtvā śrotriyāgārādagnimāhṛtya yatra kva cāgniṃ vidhinopasamādhāya tatra prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyaṃstūṣṇīmeva samidhamādadhāti | keśaśmaśruvapanādikamanyadapyavirodhi tūṣṇīmeva kartavyamiti | atra kramaḥ -- saṃkalpya mekhalādīni tyaktvā vapanaṃ tatastīrthe snānamiti | paridhānādītyādipadena dvirācamanaṃ tilakadhāraṇaṃ ca | vapanādikamityādipadena nakhanikṛntanamiti | samāvartanasya phalamāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- 'mahābhūtaṃ snātako bhavatīti vijñāyate' iti | snātako hi mahadbhūtaṃ śrūyate | kathaṃ punaḥ snātakasya mahattvam | ucyate -- "devaiścāpi manuṣyaiśca tiryagyonibhireva ca | gṛhasthaḥ sevyate yasmāttasmājjyeṣṭho gṛhāśramī' iti smṛteḥ || " yaḥ snātakaḥ sa bhavati mahābhūtam" iti śrutirapi | smṛtyantaraṃ ca -- "pṛthivyādipañcakavadupakārānkaroti yat | devā manuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ sarve cainaṃ samāśritāḥ || vidyā vidyārthinaścāpi śiṣyāḥ śuśrūṣavastathā | āhurhi vedavijñānaṃ pūrvamanvādayo'pi ca || snātakasyaiva māhātmyaṃ mahābhūtamayaṃ yataḥ | yathā mātaramāśritya sarve jīvanti jantavaḥ | tathā gṛhasthamāśritya sarve jīvanti bhikṣukāḥ" iti || iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ samāvartanasaṃskāraprayogaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ navamaṃ prakaraṇam || 9 || <10> atha daśamaṃ prakaraṇam | atha saṃkṣepeṇa snātakadharmāḥ | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "mālyāliptamukha upaliptakeśaśmaśrurakto'bhyakto veṣṭinyapaveṣṭinī kāñcukyupānahī pādukī" iti | mālī mālyavān | āliptamukhaścandanādinā | mukhagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇam | 'mukhamagre brāhmaṇo'nulimpet' ityāśvalāyanokteḥ | sugandhibhiścandanādibhirdravyairupaliptāni saṃskṛtāni keśaśmaśrūṇi yasya sa upaliptakeśaśmaśruḥ | akto'ñjanenākṣṇoḥ | abhyaktastailenāṅgeṣu | veṣṭinī veṣṭitaśirāḥ | kaṭipradeśo dvitīyena vāsasā veṣṭito yasya so'paveṣṭinī | kañcukameva kāñcukaṃ tadvānkāñcukī | upānadvānupānahī | pāduke dārumaye pādarakṣaṇe tadvānpādukī | evaṃbhūto bhavedityartha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | atra yatpādukārohaṇamuktaṃ tajjīvatpitṛkasya jyeṣṭhabhrātṛmataśca niṣiddham | "pāduke cottarīyaṃ ca tarjanyāṃ raupyadhāraṇam | na jīvatpitṛkaḥ kuryājjyeṣṭhe bhrātari jīvati" iti smṛtyantaravacanāt | anyacca dharmasūtre -- "sarvānrāgānvāsasi varjayetkṛṣṇaṃ ca svābhāvikamanūdbhāsi vāso vasītāprakṛṣṭaṃ ca śaktiviṣaye" iti | sarvānkusumbhādīnrāgānvāsasi varjayet | na kenacidraktaṃ vāso bibhṛyāt | svābhāvikaṃ svabhāvataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kambalādi tadapi na vasīta | udbhāsanaśīlamudbhāsi tadanyadanūdbhāsi | chāndaso dīrghaḥ | evaṃbhūtaṃ vāso vasītāpakṛṣṭaṃ nikṛṣṭaṃ jīrṇaṃ malavatsthūlaṃ ca tadviparītamaprakṛṣṭaṃ, tādṛśaṃ ca vāso vasīta śaktiviṣaye śaktau satyāmiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | anyacca tatraiva -- "bāhubhyāṃ ca nadītaram" iti | pūrvasūtrādvarjayedityanuvartate | taraṃ taraṇaṃ bāhubhyāṃ nadītaraṇaṃ varjayedityarthaḥ | bāhubhyāmitivacanātplavādinā taraṇe na doṣa iti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | tathā -- "na naktaṃ snāyānna nagnaḥ snāyāt" iti, tathā -- "na nagnāṃ striyamīkṣeta" iti | etacca maithunādanyatra jñeyam | "anyatra maithunānna nagnāṃ striyamīkṣet" ityāśvalāyanokteḥ | tathā -- "upetaḥ strīṇāmupetasya cocchiṣṭaṃ varjayet" iti | upetaḥ kṛtopanayanaḥ samāvṛttaḥ strīṇāmupetasya cocchiṣṭaṃ na bhuñjīteti vyākhyātaṃ tenaiva | bāhubhyāṃ ca nadītaramitigautamasūtre nadīgrahaṇaṃ taḍāgādyupalakṣaṇārtham | bāhugrahaṇaṃ tu vivakṣitamiti haradattaḥ | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "varṣati na dhāvenna vṛkṣamārohenna kūpamavarohet" iti | dharmasūtre -- "vatsatantīṃ ca nopari gacchet" iti | vatsatantī vatsabandhanarajjuḥ | vatsaśabdo gojāterupalakṣaṇamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | evaṃ gautamoktivyākhyāvasare haradatto'pi | anyacca -- "agniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ cāntareṇa nātikrāmedbrāhmaṇāṃśca nāgnimapaśca yugapaddhārayedagnīnāṃ ca saṃnivāpaṃ varjayedavacanātpratimukhamagnimāhriyamāṇaṃ nāpratiṣṭhitaṃ bhūmau pradakṣiṇī kurvīta pṛṣṭhataścā''tmanaḥ pāṇī na saṃśleṣayet" iti | brāhmaṇāṃścetyatra cakāro'ntareṇa nātikrāmedityanukarṣaṇārthaḥ | vacanābhāva ekasminnagnāvagnyantarasya saṃnivāpo nivapanaṃ varjayet | pratimukhamabhimukhamāhiyamāṇamagniṃ bhūmāvapratiṣṭhitamasthāpitaṃ na pradakṣiṇī kurvīta | ātmanaḥ svasya pṛṣṭhataḥ pṛṣṭhe, cakārācchirasi pāṇī hastau na saṃśleṣayet | yugapanna yojayedityarthaḥ | devalaḥ -- "agnau na prakṣipedagnimadbhirna śamayetsadā" iti | sadetivacanādgṛhadāhādike nimitte na doṣa iti gamyate | dharmasūtre -- "padā pādasya prakṣālanaṃ varjayet" iti | tathā -- "nakhairnakhacchedanavādanasphoṭanāni ṣṭhīvanāni cākāraṇāt" iti | bṛhannāradīye -- "na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyetā''tmanaḥ śiraḥ | bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyādbhadramityeva vādayet || śuṣkavairaṃ vivādaṃ ca na kuryātkenacitsaha" iti | śuṣkaṃ phalaśūnyam | evaṃ vivādo'pi varjanīyaḥ | smṛtyantare -- "ṣṭhīvanāsṛkśakṛnmūtraretāṃsyapsu na nikṣipet | pādau pratāpayennāgnau na cainamabhilaṅghayet || jalaṃ pibennāñjalinā śayānaṃ na prabodhayet | nākṣaiḥ krīḍenna dharmaghnairvyādhitairvā na saṃviśet" iti || enamagnim | jalamiti peyamātropalakṣaṇam | nāñjalinā pibediti gautamena peyaviśeṣānupādānāditi kaścit | tanna | sāmānyasyāpi gautamīyasya viśeṣeṇa yājñavalkīyenopasaṃhartuṃ śakyatvāt | ato jalamevāñjalinā na peyaṃ na tu pānamātramiti | śayānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na prabodhayet | "naikaḥ svapyācchūdragṛhe śreyāṃsaṃ na prabodhayet" iti manūkteḥ | anyacca -- "nendradhanuriti parasmai prabrūyānna patataḥ saṃcakṣīta pleṅkhāvantareṇa nātikrāmedudyantamastaṃ yantamādityaṃ darśane varjayet" iti | patatastārādīni jyotīṃṣi na saṃcakṣīta na kathayetparasmai | anyacca -- "astamite snānaṃ pālāśamāsanaṃ pāduke dantaprakṣālanamiti varjayet" iti | anyacca -- "viṣamārohaṇāvarohaṇāni varjayet" iti | anyacca -- "nāvaṃ ca sāṃśayikīṃ tṛṇacchedanaloṣṭavimardananiṣṭhīvanāni cākāraṇāt" iti | majjanametasyā bhaviṣyati kimityevaṃ yadviṣaya āpannaḥ saṃśayaḥ sā sāṃśayikī | etādṛśīṃ nāvamārohaṇe varjayet | anyacca -- "na codake nirīkṣeta" iti | aṅgirāḥ -- "bhāryayā saha yo'śnīyāducchiṣṭaṃ vā kadācana | na tasya doṣamicchanti nityameva manīṣiṇaḥ" iti | idaṃ ca vivāhaviṣayaṃ doṣālpatvaviṣayaṃ vā | "na śūdrāya matiṃ dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ na haviṣkṛtam | na cāsyopadiśeddharmaṃ na cāsya vratamādiśet" iti | atra matirnītiśāstrādiviṣayā | dharmādyupadeśaniṣedhasya pṛthagāmnānāt | atra haradattaḥ -- na śūdrāyocchiṣṭaṃ dadyādityatra gṛhasthaśūdrāya nocchiṣṭaṃ dadyāditi vivakṣitam | "ucchiṣṭamannaṃ dātavyaṃ śūdrāyāgṛhamedhine | gṛhasthāya tu dātavyamanucchiṣṭaṃ dine dine" || iti vyāghravacanādityāha | śūdrāyopadeśaniṣedho'pi sākṣādupadeśaviṣayaḥ | "śrāvayeccaturo varṇānkṛtvā brāhmaṇamagrataḥ" | iti brāhmaṇadvārakopadeśasya vihitatvāt | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "snātakānāṃ dvitīyaṃ syādantarvāsastathottaram" iti | etaddhāraṇaṃ nityam | 'bahūni cā''yuṣkāmasya' iti devalavacanādbahūnyapyupavītāni dhāryāṇi | bahutvāvadhimāha kaśyapaḥ -- "trīṇi catvāri pañcāṣṭau gṛhiṇaḥ syurdaśāpi vā " iti | atra triprabhṛti daśaparyantamadhikadhāraṇe phalabhūmā kalpyaḥ | mādhavīye kaurme -- "yajñopavītadvitayaṃ sodakaṃ ca kamaṇḍalum | chatraṃ coṣṇīṣamamalaṃ pāduke cāpyupānahau || raukme ca kuṇḍale vedaṃ kṛttakeśanakhaḥ śuciḥ | svādhyāye nityayuktaḥ syādbahirmālyaṃ na dhārayet || śuklāmbaradharo nityaṃ sugandhapriyadarśanaḥ | na jīrṇamalavadvāsā bhavettu vibhave sati || na raktamulbaṇaṃ cānyadhṛtaṃ vāso na kanthikām" iti || pāduke dārumaye pādarakṣaṇe | raukme parimaṇḍalākṛtī kuṇḍale | vedo darbhamuṣṭiḥ | vedamityanantaraṃ vibhṛyāditi śeṣaḥ | kṛtaṃ kartanena hṛsvatāṃ nītaṃ na tu vapanena 'na samāvṛttā vaperan' iti niṣedhāt | keśagrahaṇaṃ śmaśrūpalakṣaṇam | 'kṛttakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ' iti manūkteḥ | svādhyāye vedādhyayane nityayukto bhavet | bahirmālyamityasya mālyaṃ nirmālyaṃ svaśarīrāduddhṛtaṃ candanapuṣpādi punarna dhārayet | kiṃtu bahistyajedityarthaḥ | ulbaṇaṃ śarīrapīḍāvahaṃ bahumūlyaṃ vā | anyadhṛtamanyena parihitam | kanthikā kanthā tāṃ ca na dhārayedityarthaḥ | asati bādhaka ete dharmā brahmacārigṛhasthādisādhāraṇā jñeyāḥ | snātakenāpi vaiśvadevaḥ kāryaḥ | "vaiśvadevaṃ gṛhasthasya prātarārambhaṇaṃ bhavet | snātakenāpi tatkāryaṃ pṛthakpāko gṛhe yadi" || iti prayogapārijāte śaunakokteḥ | evamanye'pi dharmā dharmasūtre gautamasūtre smṛtiṣu coktāstato'vagantavyāḥ | purāṇe -- "yenāsya pitaro yātā yena yātāḥ pitāmahāḥ | tena yāyātsatāṃ mārgamevaṃ gacchaṃstariṣyati || eṣoditā gṛhasthasya vṛttirviprasya śāśvatī" iti | eteṣāmullaṅghane jñānato'jñānato vā kṛte gautamādyuktaṃ tryahamekāhaṃ vopoṣaṇaṃ prāyaścittaṃ jñeyam | vivāhārthaṃ kāmyajapa ukta ṛgvidhāne -- "suṣuma prajapetsūktamatha samyakśivālaye| ayutaṃ prajapedbhāryāṃ ṣaḍbhirmāsairlabhennaraḥ" iti || prajāpatiḥ striyāṃ yaśa ityādīnyasau me kāmaḥ samṛdhyatāmityantāni trayoviṃśativākyāni vivāhārthaṃ japet | trayoviṃśatisahasraṃ japaḥ ṣaḍbhirmāsairvivāho bhavati | athavā viśvāvasugandharvarājamantraṃ japet | tasya saṃkṣepeṇa japaprakāraḥ | asya śrīgandharvarājaviśvāvasumantrasya saṃmohana ṛṣiḥ | gāyatrī chandaḥ | śrīgandharvarājo viśvāvasurdevatā | bhāryālābhārthe jape viniyogaḥ | asya śrīgandharvarājaviśvāvasumantrasya saṃmohanāya ṛṣaye nama iti śirasi | gāyatryai chandase nama iti mukhe | śrīgandharvarājāya viśvāvasave devatāyai nama iti hṛdi | bhāryālābhārthe jape viniyogāya nama iti sarvāṅge | sapraṇavena ṣaḍdīrghabhājā kāmena karaṣaḍaṅganyāsau | atha dhyānam -- hemāmbhoruhabhūṣite rathavare puṇḍrekṣubhiḥ kalpite kahrārasraji raktapāṇikamalaiḥ kanyājanaiḥ sevitam | gandharvādhipatiṃ prasannahṛdayaṃ viśvāvasuṃ yaḥ pumānmantraṃ tasya japellabheta niyataṃ kanyāmasau kāṅkṣitām | viśvāvasumityetadanantaraṃ dhyāyediti śeṣaḥ | iti dhyānam | "tāraṃ kāmaṃ gaṇeśaṃ ca dharaṇyādyaṃ śiroyutam | savahnikaṃ jalapaterbījaṃ tu śirasā yutam || āsyayugvahnibījaṃ ca javiśveti vaso tathā | mamābhidharaṇībījaṃ śiroyuktaṃ ṣitāṃ tathā | kanyāṃ bhāryāṃ prayaccheti dviṭhastvante prakīrtitaḥ" || itivacanasiddhaṃ mantraṃ tato japet | ante'pi kāmabījapraṇavapuṭitaścecchīghraphalapradaḥ | jalāśayanikaṭasthavaṭacchāyāyāṃ pratyaṅmukhaścatvāriṃśatsahasraṃ japet | tatrā''dau puraścaraṇaṃ pañcātmakaṃ tryātmakaṃ vā kṛtvā'nantaraṃ tathaiva prayogaṃ kuryāt | etadarthaṃ vivāhagauryādimantraprayogo'pi draṣṭavyaḥ | āgneye yajurvidhāne -- "viśvakarmanhaviṣeti sūcīṃ lauhā daśāṅgulām | kanyāyā nikhaneddvāri sā'nyasmai na pradīyate" iti || viśvakarmanhaviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasvetyekā, ṛk | asyā agnirṛṣiḥ | triṣṭupchandaḥ | viśvakarmā devatā | catuścatvāriṃśatsahasraṃ japaḥ | iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ saṃkṣepeṇa snātakadharmāḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ daśamaṃ prakaraṇam || 10 ||
<11> athaikādaśaṃ prakaraṇam atha samāvṛttasya kecana kāmyavidhayaḥ | yo'yamamātyamantevāsinaṃ karmakaraṃ vā kāmayeta nityo'napakramaṇīyo mama syāditi sa pūrvāhṇe snātaḥ śuddhavastraḥ kṛtsnamaharanaśnanbrāhmaṇenaiva saṃbhāṣamāṇo niśāyāmaṣṭame muhūrte pradoṣānte vā prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamāmātyasyāntevāsinaḥ karmakarasya vā'napakramaṇīyatvasiddhyarthaṃ gṛhyoktaṃ karma kariṣya iti saṃkalpya yaduddeśyakamanapakramaṇīyatvaṃ tasyā''vāsaṃ gatvā jīvataḥ paśoḥ śṛṅgaṃ udakaṃ gṛhītvā 'oṃ pari tvā gire ihamidaṃ paribhrātuḥ paripvasuḥ pari sarvebhyo jñātibhyaḥ pariṣīdaḥ kleṣyasi śaśvatparikupilena saṃkrāmeṇāvicchidākulena parimīḍho'si parimīḍho'sthūlena' iti mantrābhyāṃ śṛṅgacchidreṇodakaṃ prasrāvayannāvasathaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parikrāmati | sakṛnmantrābhyāṃ dvistūṣṇīm | tajjīvaśṛṅgaṃ gṛhādbahiḥ kenacidapyaparigṛhīte deśe guptaṃ nidhāpayati svayaṃ vā nidadhāti | yasyāmātyādaya ucchiṣṭanimittaṃ draveyuḥ saḥ -- 'anupauhvadanupahvayennivarto yonyavīvṛdhaḥ | aindro vaḥ parikrośaḥ parikrośatu sarvadā | yaditi māmiti manyāyadhvaṃ māyā devā avattaram | indraḥ pāśo navaḥ siktvā mahyaṃ punarudājatu' [iti] tānsarvata āhvayet | tataḥ svāgāraṃ praviśyollekhanādividhinā sthaṇḍilasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya tatra pāvakanāmānaṃ laukikāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā'mātyasyāntevāsinaḥ karmakarasya vā'napakramaṇīyatvasiddhyarthaṃ homakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatā tāṃ parigrahīṣyāmi | indramājyāhutyā yakṣye | etāṃ devatāṃ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā samidho'gnāvabhyādhāyāgniṃ paristīryāgneruttarato darbhānsaṃstīrya tatra pātrāṇyāsādayet | darvīṃ gartavatphalakaṃ vā''jyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānbahirājyaṃ saidhrakīṃ prādeśamātrīṃ samidhaṃ cetyāsādya pavitre kṛtvā prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya darvīṃ niṣṭapya saṃmṛjya punarniṣṭapya nidadhāti | yadi tu phalakamāsāditaṃ na tu darvī tadā tasyāpi niṣṭapanādi | tataḥ saṃmārgadarbhānabhyukṣyāgnāvanuprahṛtyā''jyavilāpanādi pavitre agnāvādhāyetyantaṃ kṛtvā'dite'numanyasvetyādibhiragniṃ pariṣicyā''sāditāṃ saidhrakīṃ samidhaṃ tūṣṇīmagnāvabhyādhāya, āvartana vartayetyasya soma indraḥ paṅktiḥ | anapakramaṇīyatvasiddhyarthaṃ home viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ āvartana vartaya ni nivartana vartayendra nartabuda | bhūmyāścatasraḥ pratiśastābhirāvartayā punaḥ svāhā' [iti] āsāditena darvīphalakānyatamenaikāmājyāhutiṃ juhoti | indrāyedamiti tyāgaḥ | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya sāṅgatāsiddhyarthaṃ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hutvā'dite'nvama sthā ityādyaiḥ pariṣicya saṃsthājapenopasthāyāgniṃ saṃpūjya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | athā''ghāravattantreṇa prayogaḥ | ullekhanādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā'napakramaṇīyatvasiddhyarthahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇetyādi prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ voktvā pradhānahome, indramājyāhutyā yakṣya ityuktvā'gniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśiṣṭājyāhutyā yakṣya ityādi, aṅgahome varuṇamityādi vā prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ vā'nvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇa kṛtvā saidhrakī(ka)samidabhyādhānānte pūrvavatpradhānāhutiṃ hutvā sviṣṭakṛdādi, imaṃ me varuṇetyādi vā karmaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | na trivṛdannahomaḥ | na vā'trā''ghāravattantram | athā''gnihotrikatantreṇa prayogaḥ | ullekhanādividhinā kevalena dharmasūtroktena vidhinaiva vā sthaṇḍilasaṃskāraṃ vidhāya laukikāgniṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā'gniṃ paristīryottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu sruksruvau vā phalakasruvau vā''jyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ saidhrakīṃ prādeśamātrīṃ samidhaṃ cā''sādya pavitrakaraṇādi pavitre agnāvādhāyetyantaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ tūṣṇīṃ pariṣicya sruci darvyāṃ phalake vā caturvāramājyaṃ sūtreṇa gṛhītvā saidhrakīṃ samidhamādhāya, āvartana vartayetyasya soma indraḥ paṅktiḥ | anapakramaṇīyatvasiddhyarthahome viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ āvartana vartaya0 rāvartayā punaḥ svāhā' iti juhoti | punaḥ sakṛdgṛhītvā 'oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' iti juhoti | agnaye sviṣṭa0 | tataḥ sthālīsthamājyaṃ pātrāntare gṛhītvā'gnihotravattriḥ prāśya homasādhanaṃ darbhaiḥ prakṣālayati | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | atha dāraguptiḥ | jārī dāraguptikarma kariṣya iti saṃkalpya jārī sthūlā(la)dṛḍhācūrṇāni kārayitvā tānyādāya 'oṃ indrāya yāsyaśephamalikamanyebhyaḥ puruṣebhyo'nyatra mat' iti mantreṇa suptāyā vyabhicāriṇyā yonyāmupavapet | deśāntare
