dṛśyate | "brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyo vā'pākuryādṛṇatrayam" ityādismṛtiṣviti śeṣaḥ | yadyapi jāyamāna iti śrutirbrāhmaṇatvapuraskāreṇaiva dṛśyate tathā'pi vedādhyayanavattvarūpasādharmyamādāya sarvavarṇebhyo bhavati | sarveṣāṃ phalavattvātphalecchāvattvāt | athavā jāyamāna iti śrutiḥ kevalaṃ sāmānye brāhmaṇatvajātimātrasāmānye nopadṛśyate naiva pravartate | kiṃtu brahma vedastadadhyayanavatsu triṣu | kutaḥ sarvavarṇebhyaḥ phalecchāvattvāditi | kā pariṇeyetyākāṅkṣāyāmāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahet | ananyapūrvikāṃ kāntāmasapiṇḍāṃ yavīyasīm | arogiṇīṃ bhrātṛmatīmasamānārṣagotrajām" iti | lakṣaṇyāṃ bāhyābhyantaralakṣaṇairyuktām | tānyagre vakṣyante | yā dānenopabhogena vā puruṣāntarapūrvikā na bhavati sā'nanyapūrvikā | apunarbhūriti yāvat | manodattā vācā dattā'gniṃ parigatā saptamaṃ padaṃ nītā bhuktā gṛhītagarbhā prasūtā ceti sapta punarbhvaḥ | tatrā''dyānāṃ tisṛṇāmanyena pariṇayanaṃ bhavatītyagre vakṣyate | kāntāṃ varasya cakṣurmanasorānandakāriṇīm | asapiṇḍāṃ sāpiṇḍyarahitām | tatra candrikāparārkamedhātithimādhavaprabhṛtayaḥ -- 'ekasyāṃ piṇḍadānakriyāyāṃ dātṛtvapiḍabhāktvalepabhāktvānyatarasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ sāpiṇḍyam' ityāhuḥ | tatra matsyapurāṇam -- "lepabhājaścaturthādyāḥ pitrādyāḥ piṇḍabhāginaḥ | piṇḍadaḥ saptamastveṣāṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ sāptapauruṣam" iti || mārkaṇḍeyavacanamapi -- "pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ | piṇḍasaṃbandhinastvete vijñeyāḥ puruṣāstrayaḥ || lepasaṃbandhinaścānye pitāmahapitāmahāt | prabhṛtyuktāstrayasteṣāṃ yajamānastu saptamaḥ || ityeṣa munibhiḥ proktaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sāptapauruṣaḥ" iti | ayamarthaḥ -- saptānāṃ puruṣāṇāmekapiṇḍakriyānupraveśaḥ sāpiṇḍye hetuḥ | tathā caikasya devadattasya svakīyaiḥ pitrādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ putrādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiśca saha sāpiṇḍyam | nanvevaṃ bhrātṛpitṛvyamātulabhāgineyādibhistadbhāryādibhiśca saha sāpiṇḍyaṃ na syāditi cet | na | uddeśyadevataikyena kriyaikyasyātra vivakṣitatvāt | tathā ca devadattakartṛkapiṇḍakriyāyāṃ ye devatātvenānupraviśanti teṣāṃ madhye yaḥ ko'pi bhrātṛpitṛvyamātulādikartṛkapiṇḍakriyāyāmapyanupraviśatītyasti taiḥ saha sāpiṇḍyam | bhāryāṇāmapi bhartṛkartṛkapiṇḍadānakriyāyāṃ sahādhikāritvātsāpiṇḍyasiddhiḥ| nanu sahādhikārasiddhāvidaṃ syāttatraiva kiṃ mānamiti cet | na | pāṇigrahaṇādi sahatvaṃ karmasu tathā puṇyaphaleṣu ceti dharmasūtravacanena, "tasmātsādhāraṇo dharmaḥ śrutau sarvaḥ sahoditaḥ "| iti manuvacanenodvāhakāla evānayorvacanena dravyasādhāraṇyaṃ pratipāditam | dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāticaritavyetyanena na hyubhayasādhāraṇamekena tyaktuṃ śakyate | tasmāddravyasādhāraṇyānna bhartrā saha vibhajediti vibhāgapratiṣedhānnāsti bhinnayoḥ kartṛtvamiti tatraratnena, sahatvaṃ karmasviti sahagrahaṇaṃ na balīvardavatsamānādhikāra itipradarśanārtham | tataśca bhartrā'sau vaktavyā'haṃ dānādi vartayāmi tvamapi saṃkalpaṃ kurviti tayā'pi tathaiva kartavyamanyathā doṣa ityaparārkeṇa, smṛticandrikāhemādrimādhavādibhiśca sahādhikārasya siddhāntitatvāt | na caivamapi bhaginīpitṛṣvasrādibhirna syāditi śaṅkyam | avibhaktabhrātṝṇāṃ jyeṣṭhasyaiva kartṛtvena kaniṣṭhānāṃ sāpiṇḍyasiddhyarthaṃ yogyatāyā ivātrāpi śaraṇīkartavyatvāt | nanu -- "yannāmnā pātayetpiṇḍaṃ taṃ nayedbrahma śāśvatam" | itivacanasiddhagayāśrāddhadevatātvavatāṃ mitrādīnām, tathā -- "sarvābhāve tu nṛpatiḥ kārayettasya rikthataḥ" | itimārkaṇḍeyapurāṇādrājño'pi śrāddhakartṛtvena sāpiṇḍyāpattiriti cetsatyam | 'saptamātpañcamādūrdhvaṃ pitṛto mātṛtastathā' ityādivacanānurodhena pitrādisaṃbandhiṣu keṣucideva sapiṇḍaśabdasya yogarūḍhyaṅgīkāreṇā''pattyabhāvāt | vijñāneśvaramadanapārijātakāraprabhṛtayastu -- ekaśarīrāvayavānvayarūpaṃ sāpiṇḍyamāhuḥ | bhavanti hi ekasya piturekasyā māturvā śarīrasyāvayavāḥ putrapautrādiṣu sākṣā tparamparayā vā śukraśoṇitādirūpeṇānusyatāḥ | vidhātravayavānvayātiprasaṅgaparihārastu pūrvavatkartavyaḥ | "saptamātpañcamādūrdhvaṃ pitṛto mātṛtastathā" ityetasya vacaso niṣkṛṣṭo'rthaḥ śāstrāntaravacanājjñeyaḥ -- "vadhvā varasya vā tātaḥ kūṭasthādyadi saptamaḥ | pañcamī cettayormātā sāpiṇḍyaṃ vinivartate" iti || yataḥ saṃtānabhedaḥ sa kūṭastho mūlapuruṣa iti yāvat | tamārabhya vadhvā varasya vā tātaḥ pitā saptamo yadi bhavettayorvadhūvarayoryadi kūṭasthātpañcamī mātā bhavettadā sāpiṇḍyaṃ nivṛttaṃ bhavatīti | nirgalitārthastu pitṛdvārakasāpiṇḍyavicāre saptamādūrdhvaṃ sāpiṇḍyanivṛttiḥ | mātṛdvārakasāpiṇḍyavicāre tu pañcamādūrdhvamiti | saṃgṛhīto'yamartho viśvarūpanibandhe -- "evamuktaprakāreṇa saptamātpitṛtastathā | ūrdhvameva vivāhyatvaṃ pañcamānmātṛtastathā || saṃtāno bhidyate yasmātpūrvajādubhayatra ca | tamādāyaiva gaṇayedvaraṃ yāvacca kanyakām" iti || atrodāharaṇaṃ yathā -- kūṭastho mūlapuruṣo devadattaḥ 1 tatputro brahmadattaḥ 2 tatputro viṣṇudattaḥ 3 tatputraḥ śivadattaḥ 4 tatputro mitradattaḥ 5 tatputro haradattaḥ 6 tatputro yajñadattaḥ 7 tatputraḥ śrīdatto'ṣṭama iti pitṛdvārakaṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ varaviṣaye | mūlapuruṣo devadatta eva 1 tatpuruṣo mātṛdattaḥ 2 tatpuruṣo rudradattaḥ 3 tatpuruṣo bhānudattaḥ 4 tatkanyā śrīdevī 5 tatkanyā śrīdattabhaktā | iti mātṛdvārakasāpiṇḍyaṃ vadhūviṣaye | atrāṣṭamaḥ śrīdattaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ śrīdattabhaktāmudvahet | mūlapuruṣamārabhya madhye kanyāsaṃtatāvapyevameva | vaiparītye'pyevam | yattu vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "pañcamīṃ saptamīṃ caiva mātṛtaḥ pitṛtastathā" iti | udvahediti śeṣaḥ | yacca viṣṇupurāṇam -- "pañcamīṃ mātṛpakṣācca pitṛpakṣācca saptamīm | gṛhastha udvahetkanyāṃ nyāyyena vidhinā nṛpa" iti || tatpañcamīṃ saptamīmatītyeti vyākhyeyam | saptamātpañcamādūrdhvaṃ, vadhvā varasya vā tāta ityādivacanānurodhāt | "pañcame saptame caiva yeṣāṃ vaivāhikī kriyā | kriyāparā api hi te vijñeyāḥ śūdratāṃ gatā" || ityaparārke marīcivacanācca | yattu ṣaṭtriṃśanmate -- "tṛtīyāṃ mātṛtaḥ kanyāṃ tṛtīyāṃ pitṛtastathā | vivāhayenmanuḥ prāha pārāśaryo'ṅgirā yamaḥ" iti || yadapi paiṭhīnasiḥ -- "trīnatītya mātṛtaḥ pañcātītya pitṛtaḥ" iti | yadapi smṛtyarṇave vacanaṃ -- "kanyā caturthī ca varaśca pañcamo varaścaturtho na tu pañcamīṃ vahet | pitrye vahetpañcamaṣaṣṭhayorvā kanyā tṛtīyā'pi tathā caturthī" iti || yadapi parāśaravacanaṃ -- "caturthīmudvahetkanyāṃ caturthaḥ pañcamo'pi vā | parāśaramate ṣaṣṭhīṃ pañcamo natu pañcamīm" iti || yānyapi śākalavacanāni -- "caturthīmudvahetkanyāṃ caturthaḥ pañcamīṃ ca vā | vahetsaṃbandhinīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ pañcamo na tu pañcamīm || bhavetāṃ pūrvajātputrau tayorapi ca saṃtatiḥ | pañcamaḥ pañcamīṃ kanyāṃ na tatra varayeddvijaḥ || kanye dve pūrvajātsyātāṃ saṃtatiḥ syāttayorapi | pañcamaḥ pañcamīṃ tatra varaḥ kanyāṃ samudvahet || kanyāputrau tu saṃbhūtau pūrvajātsaṃtatistayoḥ | yadi syādvarayettatra pañcamaḥ pañcamīmapi " iti || "daśabhiḥ puruṣaiḥ khyātācchrotriyāṇāṃ mahākulāt | udvahetsaptamādūrdhvaṃ tadabhāve tu saptamīm | pañcamīṃ tadabhāve tu pituḥ pakṣe tvayaṃ vidhiḥ || saptamīṃ ca tathā ṣaṣṭhīṃ pañcamīṃ ca tathaiva | evamudvāhayetkanyāṃ na doṣaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ | tṛtīyāṃ vā caturthīṃ vā pakṣayorubhayorapi | vivāhayenmanuḥ prāha pārāśaryo'ṅgirā yamaḥ" || iti caturviṃśatimate daśapuruṣavikhyātaśrotriyakulaviṣaya eva saptamyādīnāmapyudvāhyatvoktestatparāṇyetāni vacanānyatyantāpadviṣayāṇi veti jñeyam | saṃbandhaviveke śūlapāṇiḥ -- "pañcamātsaptamāccārvāgapi trigotrāntaritā vivāhyā | 'asaṃbandhā bhavenmātuḥ piṇḍenaivodakena vā | sā vivāhyā dvijātīnāṃ trigotrāntaritā ca yā' iti bṛhanmanūkteḥ | saṃnikarṣe'pi kartavyaṃ trigotrātparato yadi' iti devalokteśca" iti | asyodāharaṇam -- mūlapuruṣo yajñadattaḥ 1 tatputro viṣṇudattaḥ 2 tatputro rudradattaḥ 3 tatputro brahmadattaḥ 4 tatputro haradattaḥ 5 tatputro mitradattaḥ 6 tatputraḥ śivadattaḥ 7 tatputraḥ śrīdattaḥ 8 iti varaviṣaye | vadhūviṣaye mūlapuruṣo yajñadattaḥ 1 tatkanyā lakṣmī vāsiṣṭhā 2 tatkanyā sarasvatī nitundagotrā 3 tatkanyā gaurī kauṇḍinyā 4 tatkanyā śrīdattabhaktā 5 śrīdatteneyaṃ vivāhyā | etacca dākṣiṇātyā na manyanta iti navīnāḥ | vastutastu -- "pañcame saptame caiva yeṣāṃ vaivāhikī kriyā | kriyāparā api hi te vijñeyāḥ śūdratāṃ gatāḥ" iti niṣedhavākyavirodhādidamapyāpadviṣayameveti yuktam | caturviṃśatimate -- "asapiṇḍā ca yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ | sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune" iti || viśeṣaḥ smṛtyantare -- "sāpatnamāturbhaginīṃ tatsutāṃ ca vivarjayet | pitṛvyapatnībhaginīṃ tatsutāṃ ca vivarjayet || gāyatryā upadeṣṭuśca kanyāṃ naivodvaheddvijaḥ | gurośca kanyāṃ śiṣyastu nodvaheta kadācana" iti | anyo'pi viśeṣaḥ -- "dhātrīputrīṃ dhātrībhaginīmiṣṭaputrīmiṣṭabhaginīmiṣṭamātulasutāṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātṛbhāryābhaginīṃ svabhāryāsahodarāmiṣṭapitṛbhaginīmiṣṭamātṛbhaginīṃ pitṛvyapatnībhaginīṃ snuṣābhaginīṃ sāpatnamātṛbhaginīṃ ca nodvahet" iti | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe'pi -- atha vivāha ityupakramyāviruddhasaṃbandhāmupayacchetetyuktvā daṃpatyormithaḥ pitṛmātṛsāmye viruddhasaṃbandho yathā bhāryāsvasurduhitā pitṛvyapatnīsvasā ceti | asyārthaḥ -- yatra daṃpatyorvadhūvarayoḥ pitṛmātṛsāmyaṃ vadhvā varaḥ pitṛsthānīyo bhavati varasya vā vadhūrmātṛsthānīyā bhavati tādṛśo vivāho viruddhasaṃbandhaḥ | tatra yathākramamudāharaṇadvayam | bhāryāsvasurduhitā śālikāputrī, pitṛvyapatnīsvasā pitṛvyapatnībhaginī ceti | viruddhasaṃbandhaviṣaya udāharaṇāntaramapi draṣṭavyam | nāradaḥ -- "pratyudvāho naiva kāryo naikasmai duhitṛdvayam | na caikajanyayoḥ puṃsorekajanye tu kanyake" iti || svasya kanyā yasya putrāya dattā tatkanyakāyāḥ svaputreṇa pariṇayanaṃ pratyudvāhaḥ | sumantuḥ -- "pitṛpatnyaḥ sarvā mātarastadbhrātaro mātulāstadbhaginyo mātṛṣvasārastadduhitaraśca bhaginyastadapatyāni bhāgineyānyanyathā saṃkarakāriṇaḥ syuḥ" iti | atra ca yāvadvacanaṃ vācanikamiti nyāyātparigaṇiteṣveva sāpiṇḍyaṃ na tu saptamādiparyantamiti kecit | anye tūddeśyatāvacchedakānāṃ pitṛpatnītvatadbhrātṛtvādīnāṃ bhedena vākyabhedāttannivṛttyai lakṣaṇaṃyā sapatnamātāmahakule catuṣpuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyamātideśikaṃ vidhīyate | ataśca mātulādiduhitṛṣviva tatputraṣvepi sāpiṇḍyātkanyāyāḥ sāpatnamātulaputreṇa na vivāha ityāhuḥ | mātulakanyāpariṇayanaṃ tu yeṣāmācārasteṣāmevetaraḥ kurvanduṣyati | tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ -- "pañcadhā vipratipattirdakṣiṇatastathottarato yāni dakṣiṇatastānyanuvyākhyāsyāmo yathaitadanupetena saha bhojanaṃ striyā saha bhojanaṃ paryuṣitabhojanaṃ mātulapitṛṣvasṛduhitṛgamanamityathottarata ūrṇāvikrayaḥ sīdhupānamubhayatodadbhirvyavahāraḥ sāyudhīyakaṃ samudrayānamiti tatretara itarasminkurvanduṣyati tattaddeśaprāmāṇyāt" iti | itaro dākṣiṇātya itarasminnuttaradeśe mātulasaṃbandhaṃ kurvanduṣyati na svadeśe | tathetara udīcya itarasmindakṣiṇadeśa ūrṇāvikrayasīdhupānādikaṃ kurvanduṣyati na svadeśe | kutaḥ | deśaprāmāṇyāddeśanibandhanatvādācāraprāmāṇyasyetyarthaḥ | bṛhaspatirapi -- "udūhyate dākṣiṇātyairmātulasya sutā dvijaiḥ | matsyādāśca narāḥ pūrve vyabhicāraratāḥ striyaḥ | uttare madyapāścaiva spṛśyā nṝṇāṃ rajasvalāḥ | sajātāścāpi gṛhṇanti bhrātṛbhāryāmabhartṛkām || sarvadeśeṣvanācāro rathyātāmbūlacarvaṇam" iti || devalo'pi -- " yasmindeśe tvanācāro nyāyadṛṣṭaḥ sukalpitaḥ | sa tasminneva kartavyo nānyadeśe sa īritaḥ || yasmindeśe pure grāme traividye nagare'pi vā | yo yatra vihito dharmastaṃ dharmaṃ na vicārayet" iti || nanu śiṣṭācāraprāmāṇye svaduhitṛvivāho'pi prasajyeta prajāpaterācaraṇāt | tathā ca śrutiḥ -- "prajāpatirvai svāṃ duhitaramabhyadhyāyat" iti | maivam | "na devacaritaṃ caret" iti nyāyāt | ata eva baudhāyanaḥ -- "anuṣṭhitaṃ tu yaddevairmunibhiryadanuṣṭhitam | nānuṣṭheyaṃ manuṣyaistu taduktaṃ dharmamācaret" iti || pratyuta doṣo'bhihitaḥ śātātapena -- "mātulasya sutāmūḍhvā mātṛgotrāṃ tathaiva ca | samānapravarāṃ caiva tyaktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" iti || sagotrāvivāhe prāyaścittaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "itthaṃ sagotrasaṃbaddhavivāhaviṣaye sthite | yadi kaścijjñānatastāṃ kanyāmūḍhvopagacchati || gurutalpavratācchudhyedgarbhastajjo'ntyatāṃ vrajet | bhogatastāṃ parityajya pālayejjananīmiva || ajñānādaindavaiḥ śudhyetribhirgarbhastu ka(kā)śyapaḥ' iti || aindavāni cāndrāyaṇāni | bahuvacanāttrīṇyadhikāni vā | ka(kā)śyapa ityatra sa garbhaḥ ka(kā)śyapaḥ kaśyapagotro bhavati |"sarvāḥ kāśyapyaḥ prajāḥ" iti śruterityarthaḥ | etadarthameva pravarajñānamāvaśyakamityuktaṃ tenaiva -- "jñātavyāḥ pravarā brahmasāyujyaśrutito'nyathā | gurutalpamahādoṣacaṇḍālotpattiśaṅkayā" iti || tithitattve baudhāyanaḥ -- "sagotrāṃ cedamatyopayacchenmātṛvadenāṃ bibhṛyāt" iti || tasyāṃ prajotpādane prāyaścittamāha sa eva -- "prajā jātā cetkṛcchrābdapādaṃ caritvā yanma ātmano mindābhūtpunaragniścakṣuradādityetābhyāṃ juhuyāt" iti || etaccājñānataḥ pūrvamamatyetyupakramāt | jñānottaraṃ bhoge tāṃ parityajet | kṛcchrābdapādasyaindavānāṃ ca śaktāśaktatvena vyavasthā draṣṭavyā | matyā tu gurutalpavratācchuddhiḥ | sapiṇḍāyāmapatyotpādane bṛhadyamaḥ -- "sapiṇḍāpatyadāreṣu prāṇatyāgo vidhīyate" iti | apatyayuktā dārā apatyadārāḥ | sapiṇḍāśca tāśca tāḥ (te ca te) teṣu | maṇḍano'pyāha -- " sagotrāyāṃ prajāṃ jātāṃ caṇḍāleṣu vinikṣipet | gurutalpavrataṃ kṛtvā tāṃ rakṣejjananīmiva || udūhyājñānatastulyagotrāṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret | pariṇītasagotrāyāmajñānājjanitaḥ sutaḥ || ka(kā)śyapo na tu caṇḍālaḥ pituḥ kṛcchrābdapādataḥ | mindāhutī dve juhuyādvratānte dīptapāvake" iti || udūhyājñānata ityuttaravākye'jñānata iti śravaṇātpūrvatra jñānata ityarthataḥ sidhyati | pariṇītasagotrāyāmityasminvākye'pyajñānādityuktyā jñāne tu garbhaścaṇḍāla eva pituḥ prāyaścittaṃ nāstyeva kiṃ tu mṛtaprāya eva sa iti sūcitaṃ bhavati | yavīyasīṃ vayasā vapuṣā ca nyūnām | tacca nyūnatvaṃ vivāhakālakathane vakṣyāmaḥ | arogiṇīmacikitsyarogarahitām | bhrātṛmatīṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭho vā bhrātā vidyate yasyāḥ sā tām | anena putrikākaraṇaśaṅkā nirasyate | ata eva manuḥ -- "yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā na vijñāyeta vā pitā | nopayaccheta tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṅkayā" iti || yasyāḥ pitā putrikākaraṇābhiprāyavāniti na jñāyeta tāṃ nopayaccheta | yatra tu naivā''śaṅkā tāmabhrātṛkāmapyupayacchetetyabhiprāyaḥ | na vijñāyeta vā pitetyuktervareṇa saha saṃpratipattiṃ vinā'pi pituḥ saṃkalpamātrātkanyā putrikā bhavatīti gamyate | ata eva gautamaḥ -- "abhisaṃdhimātrātputriketyekeṣāṃ tatsaṃśayānnopayacchedabhrātṛkām" iti | abhisaṃdhigūḍhasaṃkalpaḥ | manurapi -- "aputro'nena vidhinā sutāṃ kurvīta putrikām | yadapatyaṃ bhavedasyāṃ tanmama syātsvadhākaram" iti || vareṇa saha saṃpratipattau putrikākaraṇaṃ spaṣṭameva vijñāyate | sā ca saṃpratipattirvasiṣṭhena darśitā -- "abhrātṛkāṃ pradāsyāmi tubhyaṃ kanyāmalaṃkṛtām | asyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa me putro bhavediti" iti || ayaṃ ca taddānamantraḥ | asyāśca putrikāyāḥ svapitrādibhiḥ saha sāpiṇḍyasagotratvānivṛttiḥ | ata eva laugākṣiḥ -- "mātāmahasya gotreṇa mātuḥ piṇḍodakakriyāḥ | kurvīta putrikāputra evamāha prajāpatiḥ" iti || tadevaṃ tātparyam -- putrikāṃ śaṅkamānaḥ putrārthī bhrātṛmatīmevopayaccheteti | etacca kalau niṣiddhaṃ kalivarjye pāṭhāt | asamānārṣagotrajāmiti | samāne ārṣagotre yasya tajjātā yā na bhavati sā'samānārṣagotrajā tām | ṛṣeridamārṣaṃ pravaraḥ | asamānapravarajāmasamānagotrajāṃ cetyarthaḥ | yasyā vadhvā yena vareṇa saha pravaraikyaṃ gotraikyaṃ vā nāsti sā vadhūstena saha vivāhamarhati | kvacidgotrabhede'pi pravaraikyamasti | tadyathā -- vādhūlamaunamaukādīnāṃ bhinnagotrāṇāṃ bhārgavavaitahavyasāvedaseti pravarasyaikyāt | tatra vivāhaprasaktau tadvyavacchedāyāsamānārṣajāmityuktam | kvacitpravarabhede'pi gotraikyam | tadyathā -- āṅgirasāmbarīṣayauvanāśveti māṃdhātrāmbarīṣayauvanāśvetyatrā''ṅgirasamāṃdhātṛpravarabhede'pi yauvanāśvagotramekam | atastatra vivāho mā bhūdityasamānagotrajāmityuktam | atha gotrapravaranirṇayaḥ | tatra baudhāyanaḥ -- "viśvāmitro jamadagnirbharadvājo'tha gautamaḥ | atrirvasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapa ityete sapta ṛṣayaḥ | saptānāmṛṣīṇāmagastyāṣṭamānāṃ yadapatyaṃ tadgotramityācakṣate" iti | atrāpatyapadaṃ kevalaputrāpatyaparaṃ na bhavati kiṃtu pautrādiparamapi | ata eva pāṇiniḥ -- ' 'apatyaṃ pautraprabhṛtigotram" ityāha | nanu kevalabhṛgugaṇeṣu yaskādiṣu kevalāṅgirogaṇeṣu haritādiṣu ca saptarṣyapatyatvābhāvādgotratvaṃ na syāditi cenna | "eka eva ṛṣiryāvatpravareṣvanuvartate | tāvatsamānagotratvamanyatra bhṛgvaṅgirasāṃ gaṇāt" || iti baudhāyanoktaparyudāsānupapattyā tatsiddheḥ | prāptisaṃbhāvanāyāṃ hi paryudāso bhavati | yathā yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karotīti sāmānyavākyādanūyājeṣu ye yajāmahaprāptisaṃbhāvanāyāṃ nānūyājeṣvityanenānūyājavyatirikteṣvityevaṃ paryudāsaḥ kriyate tathā'trāpīti | saptānāmṛṣīṇāmagastyāṣṭamānāṃ yadapatyaṃ tadgotramiti sūtraṃ tu na lakṣaṇapradarśakaṃ kiṃtu ayogavyāvṛttimātrapradarśakamiti na pūrvottarasūtravirodhaḥ | ata eva vijñāneśvaramādhavamadanapārijātādiṣu gotraṃ vaṃśaparamparāprasiddhamityuktam | uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭapādairapi -- samāne'pi brāhmaṇye kuṇḍino'triritismaraṇalakṣaṇaṃ gotramiti | evaṃ ca yatrābhiyuktānāṃ gotratvaprasiddhistadgotramityeva nirduṣṭaṃ gotralakṣaṇaṃ mantratvādivatsiddhaṃ bhavati | etena vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ gotratvānupapattiḥ, asmadādīnāṃ paramparayā tadapatyatvena gotratvāpattiśca parihṛtā bhavati | yānadhikṛtya pravarā āmnātāstādṛśā gaṇā ūnapañcāśat | tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ -- "gotrāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca | ūnapañcāśadevaiṣāṃ pravarā ṛṣidarśanāt" iti || atha pravarāḥ | tatra pravarasūtrasya prācīnavyākhyānānupalambhāttadvyākhyānasahitaṃ pravarasūtraṃ pradarśyate | tatra pratijñāsūtramidaṃ -- 'pravarānvyākhyāsyāmaḥ' iti | etacca pratijñānamagrimāṇāṃ bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānaurvajāmadagnyetyādīnāṃ pravara itisaṃjñāsiddhyartham | pravriyante'gnerviśeṣaṇatvenotkīrtyanta iti pravarāḥ | tānvyākhyāsyāma ekatra saṃgṛhya kathayiṣyāmaḥ | agnerviśeṣaṇatvenotkīrtanaṃ tu 'agne mahā asi brāhmaṇa bhārata' ityādīṣṭimantreṣu pratipāditam | vivāha utkīrtanaṃ tu svaviśeṣaṇatvenaiva | anyasyāsaṃbhavāt | vivāha ārṣagotroccāraṇaṃ tu vācanikaṃ, tacca sapravaratvasagotratvaśaṅkānivāraṇārthamadṛṣṭārthaṃ ca bhavati | śāntyādikarmasu tu vācanikaṃ kutracit | kutracidācāraprāptam | pravaraṇaṃ kartavyamityasminnarthe śrutiṃ pradarśayati -- 'ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte bandhoreva naityatho saṃtatyā iti vijñāyate' iti | ārṣeyamṛṣerapatyamāhavanīyamagniṃ yajamānenotpāditatvādyajamānasyarṣisaṃtānatvāttaṃ vṛṇīte prārthayate tadgotratvāyeti | evaṃ sati bandhoreva naiti pūrvarṣisaṃbandhānna cyavate | atho api ca saṃtatyai pūrveṣāṃ pūrvajānāmātmanaśca saṃtānāyeti vijñāyate, śrutiriti śeṣaḥ | devairmanuṣyaiścā''rṣeyavaraṇaṃ na kartavyaṃ kiṃ tu ṛṣibhirevetyetadarthe śrutiṃ darśayati -- "na devairmanuṣyairārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīta ṛṣibhirevā''rṣeyaṃ vṛṇīta iti vijñāyate" iti | na devaiḥ prajāpatyādibhirārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte na vā manuṣyairvidvadbhirdevadattādibhirārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte kiṃtu ṛṣibhirvasiṣṭhādibhirmantradṛgbhirevā''rṣeyaṃ vṛṇīta iti vijñāyate śrutiriti śeṣaḥ | ārṣeyoccāraṇakartavyatāviṣaye śrutiṃ darśayati -- "ārṣeyamanvācaṣṭa ṛṣiṇā hi devāḥ puruṣamanubudhyanta iti vijñāyate" iti | ārṣeyamanvācaṣṭe | kasmāt | ṛṣiṇā pūrvajena kīrtitena devaprasiddhena tadapatyaṃ puruṣaṃ devā anubudhyante bhojyānno'yaṃ tadapatyatvāditi jānanti hītyarthaḥ | svasyā''rṣeyavaraṇaṃ parityajyānyasyā''rṣeyavaraṇe doṣa ityetadarthe śrutiṃ darśayati -- "yo vā anyaḥ sannanyasyā''rṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte sa vā asya tadṛṣiriṣṭaṃ vītaṃ vṛṅkta iti vijñāyate" iti | yo vai yajamāno'nyagotraḥ sannanyagotrasyā''rṣeyeṇa pravṛṇīte sa vai sa eva ṛṣirasya yajamānasya tadiṣṭaṃ yāgaphalaṃ vītaṃ brāhmaṇatarpaṇādiphalaṃ vṛṅke gṛhṇātītyarthaḥ | ārṣeyasaṃkhyāniyamārthikāṃ caturvaraṇapañcātipravaraṇaniṣedhikāṃ ca śrutiṃ darśayati -- "ekaṃ vṛṇīte dvau vṛṇīte trīnvṛṇīte na caturo vṛṇīte na pañcāti pravṛṇīta iti vijñāyate' iti | ekamārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte, ekamṛṣiṃ saṃkīrtya tadapatyamagniṃ vṛṇīte | tathā dvau vṛṇīte trīnvṛṇīta ityatrāpi | caturo na vṛṇīte pañcātītya ṣaḍādīnna vṛṇīta ityarthaḥ | ātmīyānāmṛṣīṇāṃ bahūnāmaniyamena varaṇaprāptau satyāmekaṃ vṛṇīta ityādayaḥ saṃkhyāniyamavidhayaḥ | na caturo vṛṇīte na pañcāti pravṛṇīta ityetadvyāmuṣyāyaṇaviṣayam | dvyāmuṣyāyaṇasya gotradvayasyāpi dvyārṣeye caturṇāṃ varaṇaprasaktiḥ | tryārṣeyatve tu ṣaṇṇāṃ pañcārṣeyatve dvyārṣeyādisaṃnipāte saptādīnāmapi varaṇaprasaktiḥ | tanniṣedhārthamuktaṃ -- 'na caturo vṛṇīte na pañcāti pravṛṇīte' iti | 'trīnvṛṇīte mantrakṛto vṛṇīte yatharṣi mantrakṛto vṛṇīte' iti śrutimanusṛtya pravṛtte 'atryārṣeyasya hānaṃ syādadhikārāt' ityasminnadhikaraṇe mīmāṃsakāstu trīnvṛṇīta ityayameva vidhiḥ | ekaṃ vṛṇīte dvau vṛṇīta ityubhayamavayutyānuvādaḥ | anyathā vākyabhedāpatteḥ | na ca trīnvṛṇīta ityatrāpi vākyabhedatādavasthyādvidhitvāsaṃbhava iti vācyam | viśiṣṭavidhāne vākyabhedābhāvena vidhitvasaṃbhavāt | stutyartho'yamekaṃ vṛṇīta ityādiranuvādaḥ | ekavaraṇadvivaraṇe apraśaste api yadā kartavye tadā trivaraṇasya praśastasya kartavyatvaṃ kimu vaktavyamiti stutiḥ | caturniṣedhapañcātikramaniṣedhābhyāmapi tritvameva stūyate, na ca tayorniṣedho vidhātavyaḥ | prasaktyabhāvādeva tadapravṛtteḥ | caturādayo'tyantavilambakāritvādapraśastāḥ | tritvaṃ tu na tatheti praśastam | tasmātkarmaṇyadhikurvanyajamānastrīnevoccārayenna nyūnaṃ nāpyadhikamiti tātparyārtha ityāhuḥ | ekārṣeyādīnāmapi manuvatpakṣāśrayaṇenādhikāra iti tantraratne | asamānārṣagotrajāmitiyājñavalkyoktamavivāhaprayojakaṃ samānapravaratvāparaparyāyaṃ samānārṣatvaṃ dvividhamekapravarasāmyaṃ dvitripravarasāmyaṃ ceti | tatrā''dyaṃ bhṛgvaṅgirogaṇavyatiriteṣu | dvitīyaṃ bhṛgvaṅgirogaṇeṣu | tatra pañcapravarāṇāṃ tripravarasāmyaṃ tripravarāṇāṃ dvipravarasāmyamavivāhaprayojakamiti mantavyam | "pañcānāṃ triṣu sāmānyādavivāhastriṣu dvayoḥ | bhṛgvaṅgirogaṇeṣvevaṃ śeṣeṣveko'pi vārayet" iti vacanāt || śeṣeṣveko'pi pravaraḥ samānaścettadvivāhaṃ vārayedityarthaḥ | atha pravaragaṇanā | tatrā''dau bhṛgavaḥ | tatra sūtram -- "bhṛgūnevāgre vyākhyāsyāmo jāmadagnyā vatsāsteṣāṃ pañcārṣeyo bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānaurvajāmadagnyeti jamadagnivadurvavadapnavānavaccyavanavadbhṛguvaditi tryārṣeyamu haike bhārgavaurvajāmadagnyeti jamadagnivadurvavadbhṛguvadityeṣa evāvikṛto jāmālyaitiśāyanavirohitamāṇḍavyā vaṭamaṇḍubaidaretavāhaprācīnayogyānāmathā''rṣṭiṣeṇānāṃ pañcārṣeyo bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānārṣṭiṣeṇānūpetyanūpavadṛṣṭiṣeṇavadapnavānavaccayavanavadbhṛguvaditi tryārṣeyamu haike bhārgavārṣṭiṣeṇānūpetyanūpavadṛṣṭiṣeṇavavadbhṛguvadityatha vītahavyā yāskavādhūlamaunamaukarajatavāhāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo bhārgavavaitahavyasāvedaseti savedovadvītahavyavabhṛguvadityatha vainyāḥ pārthāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo bhārgavavainyapārtheti pṛthavadvenavadbhṛguvadityatha gārtsamadāḥ śunakāsteṣāmekārṣeyo gārtsamadeti hotā gṛtsamadavadityadhvaryuratha vāghryaśvā mitrayuvasteṣāmekārṣeyo vāghryaśveti hotā vaghryaśvavadityadhvaryuḥ" iti | evakāra itareṣāṃ vyāvṛttyarthaḥ | agra ādau vyākhyāsyāmo vakṣyāmaḥ prādhānyāditi śeṣaḥ | bhṛgoḥ prādhānyaṃ tu 'maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛguraham' iti bhagavadvākyānmokṣadharmeṣu bhṛgorvāsudevāṃśatāśravaṇādādhānamantreṣu bhṛgūṇāmevā''dau pārthakyena mantrakathanācca | athavā, evakāro'graśabdenānveti | agra ādāveva ye bhṛgutvaṃ prāptā bhṛgavastānvakṣyāmaḥ, na dvyāmuṣyāyaṇatvena paścādbhṛgutvamāpannāniti | dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāmuttaratra vakṣyamāṇatvāt | jāmadagnyā vatsā ityatra vatsānāṃ jāmadagnyā iti viśeṣaṇamajāmadagnyavatsanirākaraṇārthaṃ pañcāvattitvaprāptyarthaṃ jāmadagnyāprīprāptyarthaṃ ca | teṣāṃ jāmadagnyavatsānāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaraḥ, bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānaurvajāmadagnyeti | ayaṃ ca hoturamuto'rvāñco hotetivacanāt | amuto mūlabhūtādṛṣerārabhyārvāñco'rvāgjātānmantradṛśaḥ | krameṇa tadapatyasaṃbandhena prārthayate tamagnimityarthaḥ | jamadagnivadurvavadapnavānavaccyavanavadbhṛguvadityayaṃ pravaro'dhvaryorata ūrdhvānmantrakṛto'dhvaryurvṛṇīta itivacanāt | ato yajamānādūrdhvānmantradṛgbhiravyavahitānāṃ mūlabhūtāndṛṣṭakrameṇa saṃkīrtya tadvattadvaditisādṛśyasaṃbandhenāgniṃ vṛṇīte prārthayata ityarthaḥ | eṣa eva pravarakramaviśeṣo hoturadhvaryoścā''dhyāyaparisamāpteḥ sarvatropadeṣṭavyaḥ | tryārṣeyamu haike bruvata iti śeṣaḥ | tryārṣeyaṃ pravarameka ācāryā bruvata ityarthaḥ | u hetinipāto'vadhāraṇārtho vākyālaṃkārārtho vā | taṃ pravaraṃ darśayati -- bhārgavaurvajāmadagnyeti jamadagnivadurvavadbhṛguvaditīti | enameva pravaramanyeṣvatidiśati -- eṣa evāvikṛto jāmālyaitiśāyanetyādinā prācīnayogyānā mityantena sūtreṇa | eṣo'nantaroktaḥ pañcārṣeyastryārṣeyo vā jāmālyādīnāṃ navānāṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | athā''rṣṭiṣeṇānāmityatrāthaśabdaḥ pṛthagayaṃ gaṇa itijñāpanārthaḥ | evaṃ sarvatra | anyadgatārtham | atha vītahavyā ityārabhya pṛthavadvenavadbhṛguvadityantaṃ sūtraṃ spaṣṭārtham | caturvidhā hi śunakāḥ | kecicchunakādevajātāḥ | kecidgṛtsamadādevajātāḥ | kecidbhṛgorapatyaṃ gṛtsamadastato jātāḥ | kecidbhṛgorapatyaṃ śunagotrastadapatyaṃ gṛtsamadastato jātāḥ | tatra gṛtsamadādeva ye jātāsteṣāmevāyaṃ pravaro nānyeṣāmityetadarthaṃ gṛtsamadadṛṣṭāprīprāpaṇārthaṃ ca gārtsamadā iti viśeṣaṇam | itareṣāṃ tu sūtrāntaroktāḥ pravarā jñeyāḥ | tatrā''dyānāṃ śaunaketyekārṣeyaḥ pravaraḥ | tṛtīyānāṃ bhārgavagārtsamadeti dvyārṣeyaḥ | caturthānāṃ bhārgavaśaunahotragārtsamadeti tryārṣeya iti | ekārṣeye'muto'rvāñco hotā'ta ūrdhvānmantrakṛto'dhvaryurvṛṇīta ityanayorvidhyorvyavasthāpakatvābhāvādavyavasthāprāptau hotradhvaryugrahaṇaṃ taddhitānto hotuḥ pravaro vatpratyayānto'dhvaryorityevaṃ vyavasthetipradarśanārtham | mitrayuvāṃ vāghryaśvā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vāghryaśvadṛṣṭāprīprāptyartham | vāghryaśveti hotā vaghryaśvavadityadhvaryurityatra hotradhvaryugrahaṇamuktavyavasthāyāstatraiva prāptiśaṅkānirāsārtham | itīme bhṛgavo vyākhyātāḥ | uktānubhāṣaṇasyedaṃ prayojanamavidyamānabhṛguśabdānāmapi śunakamitrayuvāṃ bhṛgutvaṃ yathā syāditi | tena bhṛgūṇāṃ tveti yatharṣyādhāne bhārgavo hotā bhavatītyādau copapraveśasiddhiḥ | jāmadagnyavatsānāṃ jāmālyādīnāṃ ca parasparamavivāhaḥ | pravaraikyātsagotratvācca | evamārṣṭiṣeṇānāmapi tripravarasāmyāt | yadyapi tripravarārṣṭiṣeṇānāṃ nānyaiḥ saha dvipravarasāmyaṃ tathā'pi pañcārṣeyasaṃgatamapi pravarasāmyameṣvavivāhaprayojakam | vatsā vidā ārṣṭiṣeṇā ityeteṣāmavivāha iti baudhāyanokteḥ | ajāmadagnyavatsārṣṭiṣeṇābhyāṃ sapravaratvādavivāhaḥ | vītahavyādīnāṃ tu svaṃ svaṃ gaṇaṃ hitvā parasparaṃ pūrvaiśca saha vivāho bhavatyeva, dvitripravarasāmyābhāvāt | iti bhṛgugotrapravarakāṇḍam | atha gautamagotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "athāto'ṅgirasāmayāsyā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasāyāsyagautameti gotamavadayāsyavadaṅgirovadityathautathyā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasautathyagautameti gotamavadutathyavadaṅgirovadityathauśijā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasauśijakākṣīvateti kakṣīvadvaduśijavadaṅgirovadityatha vāmadevā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasavāmadevabārhaduktheti bṛhadukthavadvāmadevavadaṅgirovaditi"iti | atrātaḥśabdo hetvarthe | yato 'bhṛgūṇāṃ tvā'ṅgirasāṃ vratapate vratenā''dadhāmīti bhṛgvaṅgirasāmādadhyāt' iti śrutyaikasminneva vākye bhṛgugotriṇāmādhānamantraṃ pūrvamuktvā'nantaraṃ gautamādigotriṇāmādhānamantra uktaḥ | ato hetorityarthaḥ | aṅgirasāmiti nirdhāraṇe ṣaṣṭhī | aṅgirogaṇānāṃ madhye ye'yāsyā gautamā aṅgirasasteṣāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ pravaro bhavatītyarthaḥ | ayāsyā iti viśeṣaṇamayāsya udgātā bhavatītyatra ye'yāsyagaṇapaṭhitāsteṣāmeva grahaṇārtham | utathyā auśijā vāmadevā ityādīni gautamaviśeṣaṇāni sāṃkaryanivāraṇārthāni | anyatspaṣṭam | eṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ gautamāṅgirasāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ | gautamasya vriyamāṇatayā sattayā vā'nuvṛtteḥ sagotratvātprāyeṇa dvitripravarasāmyācca | iti gautamagotrapravarakāṇḍam | atha bharadvājagotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "atha bharadvājānāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājeti bharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovadityeṣa evāvikṛtastuthyāgniveśyaurjayānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca stambhastambaśabdānāmatharkṣāṇāṃ pañcārṣeya āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājavāndanamātavacaseti matavacovadvandanavadbharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovaditi tryārṣeyamu haika āṅgirasavāndanamātavacaseti matavacovadvandanavadaṅgirovadityatha dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ kulānāṃ yathā śauṅgaśaiśirayo bharadvājāḥ śuṅgāḥ katāḥ śaiśirayasteṣāṃ pañcārṣeya āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājakātyākṣiletyakṣilavatkatavadbharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovaditi tryārṣeyamu haika āṅgirasakātyākṣiletyakṣilavatkatavadaṅgirovadityatha gargāṇāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasagārgyaśainyeti śinivadgargavadaṅgirovaditi bhāradvājamu haike'ṅgirasaḥ sthāne bhāradvājagārgyaśainyeti śinivadgargavadbharadvājavadityatha kapīnāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasamāhāyyavaurukṣayyetyurukṣayyavanmahayyuvadaṅgirovaditi tarasvāstilo viduḥ śāluḥ patañjalirbhūyasīrdandvakīrjalandvaḥ kaperaṣṭavidhāḥ prajāḥ" iti | tutthya āgniveśya aurjayāna eteṣāṃ, stambhaśabdo yannāmasu vartate te stambha śabdāḥ | stambaśabdo yannāmasu vartate te stambaśabdāḥ | eteṣāṃ caiṣo'nantaroktastryārṣeya eva pravaro bhavedityarthaḥ | dvābhyāṃ gotrābhyāṃ vyapadeśādvyāmuṣyāyaṇāni kulāni | yathā śauṅgaśaiśiraya iti purātanaṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇakulam | idānīṃtanānāṃ dvigotrāṇāṃ dvayorapi gotrayoravivāhaṃ vaktuṃ dṛṣṭāntatvenodāhṛtaṃ śuṅgā bharadvājāḥ katāḥ śaiśirayo viśvāmitrāḥ | bhāradvājasya śuṅgasya bījādvaiśvāmitrasya śaiśireḥ kṣetra utpannāḥ śauṅgaśaiśiraya ityucyante | tatsaṃtatijātānāṃ pañcārṣeyaḥ pravaro draṣṭavyaḥ | āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājakātyākṣileti hotuḥ | akṣilavatkatavadbharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovadityadhvaryoḥ | tryārṣeyameka āṅgirasakātyākṣileti hotuḥ | akṣilavatkatavadaṅgirovadityadhvaryoḥ | asminpravare janayituḥ pūrvaḥ pravaraḥ pratigrahīturaparo yathoktastathā'nyeṣvapi putrikāputradattakakrītakṛtrimaputrādīnāmapi dvayorapi gotrayoḥ pravaro jñeyaḥ | śauṅgaśaiśirīṇāṃ dṛṣṭāntatvenopādānāt | sarveṣāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ gotradvayasaṃbandhivaraṇaprasaktau vyavasthāmāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "teṣāmubhayataḥ pravṛṇīta ekamitarato dvāvitarato dvau vetaratastrīnitarato na hi caturṇā pravaro'sti na pañcānāmatipravaraṇam" iti | ekamitarato dvāvitarata iti tryārṣeye dvau vetaratastrīnitarata iti pañcārṣeye | tatra pūrvaṃ kasya pravara ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ kātyāyanalaugākṣī āhatuḥ -- "pūrvaḥ pravara utpādayituruttaraḥ pratigrahītuḥ" iti | evaṃ vakṣyamāṇeṣu saṃkṛtyādiṣvapi draṣṭavyam | gargāṇāṃ bharadvājatvaṃ pākṣikabharadvājavaraṇādeva siddham | yadyapi kapīnāṃ pāṭhaḥ kevalāṅgirogaṇamadhye sarveṣu sūtrapustakeṣu dṛśyate tathā'pi sa nā''dartavyaḥ | gotrapravaramañjarīprayogapārijātasmṛtyarthasārādibahugranthavirodhādbahusmṛtipurāṇasūtravirodhāt, bhāradvājaiḥ saha vivāhaḥ kevalāṅgirobhiḥ saha vivāha ityetādṛśasya śiṣṭābhimatācārasyānyathātvāpatteśca | athavā dvau kapī jñeyau | eko bharadvājagaṇasthaḥ | aparaḥ kevalāṅgirogaṇasthaḥ | tathāca maṇḍanaḥ -- "bhāradvājapravaraṇe kecidāhuḥ kapī pṛthak" iti | athātrigotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "athātrīṇāṃ tryārṣeya ātreyārcanānasaśyāvāśveti śvāvāśvavadarcanānasavadatrivadityatha gaviṣṭhirāṇāṃ tryārṣeya ātreyārcanānasagāviṣṭhireti gaviṣṭhiravadarcanānasavadatrivadityeṣa evāvikṛto vāmarathyasumaṅgalabījavāpānām" iti | gatārtham | atrīṇāṃ sarveṣāmavivāhaḥ sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | ityatrigotrapravarakāṇḍam | atha viśvāmitragotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "atha viśvāmitrāṇāṃ devarātāścikitakālabavamanutantubabhruyajñavalkaulontyermaribṛhadagnisāṃśityavārakitārakitārakāyaṇaśālāvatāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo vaiśvāmitradaivarātaudaletyudalavaddevarātavadviśvāmitravadityatha śraumatakāmakāyanāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo vaiśvāmitramādhucchandasadhānaṃjayyeti dhanaṃjayavanmadhucchandovadviśvāmitravadityathāṣṭakā lohitāsteṣāṃ dvyārṣeyo vaiśvāmitrāṣṭaketyaṣṭakavadviśvāmitravadityatha pūraṇāḥ pāridhāpayantyasteṣāṃ dvyārṣeyo vaiśvāmitrapauraṇeti pūraṇavadviśvāmitravadityatha katāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo vaiśvāmitrakātyākṣiletyakṣilavatkatavadviśvāmitravadityathāghamarṣaṇāḥ kuśikāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo vaiśvāmitrāghamarṣaṇakauśiketi kuśikavadaghamarṣaṇavadviśvā mitravaditi" iti | gatārtham | viśvāmitragaṇānāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | iti viśvāmitragotrapravarakāṇḍam |
atha kaśyapagotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "atha kaśyapānāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ kāśyapāvatsāranaidhruveti nidhruvavadavatsāravatkaśyapavadityeṣa evāvikṛto dhaumyābhiṣeṇyamāṭharāṇāmatha rebhāṇāṃ tryārṣeyaḥ kāśyapāvatsāraraibhyeti rebhavadavatsāravatkaśyapavadityatha śaṇḍilānāṃ dvyārṣeyo daivalāsitetyasitavaddevalavaditi tryārṣeyamu haike kāśyapadaivalāsitetyasitavaddevalavatkaśyapavaditi dvyārṣeyāstvevaṃ nyāyena" iti | sarve'pi dvyārṣeyā evamanena prakāreṇa tryārṣeyā eva bhavitumarhanti na śaṇḍilā eva | tasmādaṣṭakānāṃ lohitānāṃ ca dvyārṣeyāṇāṃ tryārṣeyatvameva draṣṭavyam | dvyārṣeyā eva sarve śaṇḍilā bhavitumarhanti na tryārṣeyā iti kecidvyācakṣate tadanupapannam | "atryārṣeyasya hānaṃ syādadhikārāt" itijaiminīyanyāyavirodhāt | anyadgatārtham | kaśyapānāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ | kaśyapasya vriyamāṇatayā sattayā vā'nuvṛtteḥ sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | iti kaśyapagotrapravarakāṇḍam | atha vasiṣṭhagotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- "ekārṣeyā vāsiṣṭhā anyatropamanyuparāśarakuṇḍinebhyo vāsiṣṭheti hotā vasiṣṭhavadityadhvaryurathopamanyūnāṃ tryārṣeyo vāsiṣṭhaindrapramadābharadvaso ityābharadvasuvadindrapramadavadvasiṣṭhavadityatha parāśarāṇāṃ tryārṣeyo vāsiṣṭhaśāktyapārāśaryeti parāśaravacchaktivadvasiṣṭhavadityatha kuṇḍinānāṃ tryārṣeyo vāsiṣṭhamaitrāvaruṇakauṇḍinyeti kuṇḍinavanmitrāvaruṇavadvasiṣṭhavadityatha saṃkṛtipūtimāpataṇḍināṃ tryārṣeyaḥ śāktyasāṃkṛtyagaurivīteti gurivītavatsaṃkṛtivacchuktivaditi" iti | uttaratra vidhānādevopamanyuprabhṛtīnāṃ tryārṣeyatve siddhe'nyatropamanyuparāśarakuṇḍinebhya iti vacanaṃ kevalaṃ vasiṣṭhabhedā na saṃkṛtyādayasteṣāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇatvāditipradarśanārtham | vāsiṣṭhamaitrāvaruṇakauṇḍinyetyasminpravare mitrāvaruṇasaṃjñakau kaucidṛṣī mantradṛśau draṣṭavyau na prasiddhau devatāviśeṣau | na devairna manuṣyairārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīta iti niṣedhāt | tayośca mitrāvaruṇayoḥ saṃhatayorevarṣitvamatra draṣṭavyaṃ na pratyekam | na caturo vṛṇīta iti caturṇāṃ varaṇapratiṣedhāt | matsyapurāṇe mitrāvaruṇayorbadaryāśrame tapasyatorāgatāmurvaśīṃ dṛṣṭavatoḥ śukraṃ skannaṃ kvacittoyapūrṇe kalaśe gṛhītaṃ tato vasiṣṭho jāto vasiṣṭhācca kuṇḍino jāta iti dṛṣṭatvāttayoḥ saṃhatayorevarṣitvaṃ pitṛtvaṃ ceti draṣṭavyam | eṣāṃ vāsiṣṭhānāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | saṃkṛtyādīnāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ vasiṣṭhatvaṃ tu vasiṣṭhagaṇamadhye pāṭhādvāsiṣṭhasya śaktervaraṇācca | iti vasiṣṭhagotrapravarakāṇḍam | athāgastyagotrapravarakāṇḍam | [tatra sūtram -- ]"athāgastīnāmekārṣeya āgastyeti hotā'gastivadityadhvaryustryārṣeyamu haika āgastyadārḍhacyutaidhmavāhetīdhmavāhavaddṛḍhacyutavadagastivaditi" iti | agastīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | ityagastigotrapravarakāṇḍam | atha kṣattriyapravarakāṇḍam | [tatra sūtram -- ]"atha kṣattriyāṇāṃ tryārṣeyo mānavaiḍapaurūravaseti purūravovadiḍavanmanuvadityatha yadi ha sārṣāḥ pravṛṇīranneka evaiṣāṃ pravaro yadyu vai pṛthakpravṛṇīranyeṣāmu ha mantrakṛto na syuḥ sapurohitapravarāste'tha yeṣāṃ syurapurohitapravarāste sapurohitapravarāstvevaṃ nyāyenaikārṣeyā viśo vātsapreti hotā vatsapravadityadhvaryuḥ" iti | dvividhāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sārṣā anārṣāśca | tatra yadi sārṣā ārṣeyavanto rājānaḥ pravṛṇīraṃstadaiṣāṃ pravara ukta eka eva bhavati | yadyete pṛthageva pravṛṇīranpurohitapravarāneva pravṛṇīran | yeṣāṃ rājñāṃ mantrakṛta ṛṣaya ārṣeyā iti yāvat, na syurna bhaveyuste sapurohitapravarā jñeyāḥ | yeṣāṃ rājñāṃ yadi mantrakṛtaḥ syurapurohitapravarāste jñeyāḥ | mantrakṛto rājānaḥ sapurohitapravarāstvevametatprakāreṇa nyāyena bhavanti nānyathā | ko'sau nyāyo'bhimataḥ | ucyate -- sarveṣāṃ purohitasya vidyamānatvāttena ca vinā karmānadhikārātpura enaṃ hitametatsarvaṃ nayatīti purohitaśabdavyutpatteḥ | ātmīyapravarapakṣe sarveṣāṃ samānapravaratvādavivāhaḥ prasajyeteti nyāyaḥ | ayameva nyāyo vaiśyānāmapi draṣṭavyaḥ | (mantrakṛdvatāṃ sarvarājñāmapurohitapravarāṇāmapi vivāhamātre sapurohita[pravara]tvameveti phalito'rthaḥ|) rājabhyo'rpitānāṃ dattānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājñāṃ ye pravarāsta eva teṣām | evaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo'rpitānāṃ rājñāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ye pravarāste teṣāmiti | tathā ca sūtram -- "tathā brāhmaṇānā rājārpitānāṃ rājñāṃ vā brāhmaṇārpitānām" iti | athānājñātabandhūnāṃ gotrapravarakāṇḍam | tatra sūtram -- 'athānājñātabandhoḥ purohitapravareṇā''cāryapravareṇa vā' iti | na, āsamyagjñāto bandhuryena so'nājñātabandhustasyānājñātabandhoḥ | asaṃprajñātabandhoriti darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇasthasya pravaravidhāyakasya sūtrasya pāṭhaḥ | na samyakprajñāto bandhuryena so'saṃprajñātabandhuriti tadvigrahaḥ | arthastu sa eva | tasya purohitasya pūrvoktasya pravareṇa dharmopadeṣṭā''cāryastasya vā pravareṇa pravaraṇamityarthaḥ | nanu -- "yo vā anyaḥ sannanyasyā''rṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte sa vā asya tadṛṣiriṣṭaṃ vītaṃ vṛṅke' | iti niṣedhasya jāgarūkatvātkathaṃ purohitācāryapravarapravaraṇamiti cenna | etasya pravarajñānasattva eva pravṛtteḥ | sārvavarṇikamārṣeyaṃ darśayati -- 'atha ha tāṇḍina ekārṣeya sārvavarṇika samāmananti mānaveti hotā manuvadityadhvaryurmānavyo hi prajā iti hi brāhmaṇamiti hi brāhmaṇam' iti | tāṇḍina ācāryā ekārṣeyaṃ mānavetyevaṃrūpaṃ pravaraṃ sārvavarṇikaṃ sarveṣāṃ varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ samāmananti tatra hetubhūtāṃ śrutimudāharanti -- 'mānavyo hi prajā iti hi brāhmaṇam' iti | hi yasmādevaṃ taittirīyaśākhāyāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pratyakṣameva paṭhyate'gnicayana ukhāprakaraṇe -- 'mānavyo hi prajāḥ' iti tasmādityarthaḥ | dviruktiḥ praśnasamāptidyotanārthā | etatsūtraṃ vaiśeṣikapravaraniṣedhaparaṃ na bhavati kiṃ tu sārvavarṇikapravarastutiparam | nanvevaṃ kṛtsnamekeṣāṃ pravaraṃ pratiṣidhya manuvadityetadvidadhātītyetatsūtravirodha iti cenna | atra pratiṣedhaśabdenāprāśastyasyaivoktatvāt | evaṃ ca kṛtsnavaiśeṣikapravarāṇāmaprāśastya ukte sārvavarṇikasya praśastatvamarthātsiddhaṃ bhavati | vaiśeṣikāḥ pravarā durvijñeyā bahuprayāsalabhyāśca tasmānna kāryāḥ | ayaṃ tu laghutaraprayatnalabhyatvātkartavya ityevaṃ sārvavarṇikasya pravarasya praśastatvam | kathaṃ puna rayamabhiprāyo gamyata iti cet | anyathā pravarādhyāyānārambhaprasaṅgāt | ārabhyate cāyam | ayaṃ ca pravaraḥ śrautakarmavaraṇābhivādādiṣveva na vivāhe | anyathā samānapravaratvādvivāhābhāvaprasaṅgāt | purohitagotrapravarayorācāryagotrapravarayoścājñāne tu smṛtyantare -- "ācāryagotrapravarānabhijñastu dvijaḥ svayam | dattvā''tmānaṃ tu kasmaicittadgotrapravaro bhavet' iti | atrā''cāryagrahaṇaṃ purohitopalakṣaṇam | ācāryaśabdena niṣekādikriyākartā dvija itiśravaṇādbrāhmaṇakṣattriyavaiśyānāṃ vidhiḥ | yattu -- 'gotrasya tvaparijñāne kāśyapaṃ gotramucyate' | iti tatpurohitācāryayorgotrājñāne satyeva vivāhātiriktaviṣayam | iti sūtroktaḥ pravaranirṇayaḥ | atha smṛtyanusāreṇa pravarāstadgaṇāśca | tatra bhṛgavo dvividhāḥ | jāmadagnyāḥ kevalāśca | jāmadagnyau dvau, vatsabidau | kevalāḥ ṣaṭ | vatsā vainyā vītahavyā ārṣṭiṣeṇā vāghryaśvā gārtsamadā iti | tatra dvividhā api vatsāstattreṇocyante | mārkaṇḍeyā māṇḍūkeyā māṇḍavyāḥ kāṃseyā ālekhanā dārbhāyaṇāḥ śārkarākṣyā daivatāyanā śaunakāyanā mādhukeyāḥ pārṣikāḥ sākāḥ prāttāyanāḥ pailāḥ paiṅgalāyanā dārdhvepakayo bāhyakayo vaiśvānarayo vaihīnarayo vairohitā bāhyā brādhrā goṣṭhāyanāṣṭīkayaḥ kāśakṛtsnā vādbhutakāḥ kṛtabhāgā aitiśāyanā jñānāyanāḥ pāṇinayo vālmīkiḥ sthaulapiṇḍāyanaḥ saivātavā jihītayaḥ sāvarṇikāyanā vālāyanāḥ saukṛtayo maṇḍavaḥ sauvipvayo hastāgrahaḥ śauddhakayaḥ śaurdvakayo vaikarṇā droṇakajihvaya aurasayaḥ kambalodarayo vākārakṛto vaihalayaḥ sāṅkavāḥ kāstambarāḥ kāravāstāmasā virūpākṣā vṛkāśvā uccairmanyavo dvaimatyā āryāyaṇāḥ pākāyaṇāḥ kāhvāyanā vānayaścāyaninaḥ śārṅgaravāścāndramasā gāṅgeyā naudheyā yājñiyā jābālirbāhumitrāyaṇā āpiśalayo vaiśvapurayo lohitāyanā uṣṭrākṣā mālāyanāḥ śāradvatāyanā rajatavāhā vatsā vātsāyanāḥ.| etāvanto baudhāyanoktāḥ | atha kātyāyanalaugākṣyuktāḥ | nālāyanā vāgāyanā anumātakayo jaihmatayo jīvantayaḥ kāmbalodarayo vaihāyanā rekhāyanayaḥ pārṣatayaḥ pārṇilaya uccayamānāḥ sātyakarṇayaḥ kālākayastālakeśina ṛtabhāgā ārtabhāgā ājīhitā ātithayaḥ sthaumāṅgirayaḥ sthaulāḥ sauravā barhiṣo devamatayo gārgyāyaṇā gehyāyanā goṣṭhāyanā vaiśampāyanā gālavāḥ sāṃkṛtayo vāṇakeyā aitikāyanā bhrāṣṭreyā bhāstreyā lākṣeyā lākucayo lālāṭaya āvaya āṅgāvayaḥ saiṣpikayaḥ sātyakāyanā naikarṣayaḥ śākalyāḥ pākānumatayaḥ kaniṣṇayo jaihmāśinaya āśmakramāḥ kaucahastaya ānulominaḥ krauñcāścekṣāḥ krauñcākṣayaḥ sauradhvajayo vādhyātkeyā nirīṇayo vāsayaḥ sādanāḥ syoyāḥ syandanayaḥ kaṭeraṇayo laveraṇayo yaugolayo mādhyodā mātsyā nāḍāyanā vairāyaṇā vainyā rauhityāyaniḥ kṛpānīluḥ sāvarṇiḥ pikasvaro viṣṇustaulakeśirjahino vītinaḥ phenayāstalinaḥ śikhāpattirjaladhiḥ senājitkṛtsnaḥ paiṅgalāyanirdivaḥpatirṛṣabhaḥ sutaḥ palataḥ palavaḥ kopiyajño mitrayajña āmilāyanā hāpattirvaikarṇinirbhāllakāyanirlākṣmaṇaḥ śālyāyanirmālyāyaniḥ kauṭaliḥ sauktiḥ koṭaraḥ sākṣī sāndramaṇirnaikajihvo jihvāśūnyaḥ kelaleṭirhikaśvariḥ sāradhvajirnaimiśyo loṣṭākṣirgaraveṇiḥ paurṇasaigandhiḥ kāśakṛdvilabhṛtsaumadāyanāḥ svānumatayo maṇḍacitrāḥ śaukrāyaṇāstvāṣṭreyāḥ kovahuṇḍayaḥ śaunāyanāḥ śākapauṇayo vrīhimatayo māyāmatī rādhrevakiḥ kośano maudgalyaḥ kāravacaḥ sāṃtapanāyanā gehvi rbhehriḥ kiruṣaḥ stanvata aulandhirvāyargirāyaṇiḥ śyenayāgatirnaikaṭyiḥ śaukakarṇirniḍāyanaḥ | ityete vatsāḥ | tatra ye parasparamavivāhaḥ, sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | iti vasiṣṭhāḥ | athāgastyāḥ(stayaḥ) | ta ekādaśa, agastaya idhmavāhāḥ sāmbhavāhāḥ somavāhā yajñavāhā darbhavāhāḥ sāravāhāḥ pūrṇamāsāḥ pāraṇino himodakāḥ pāṇikāśca | agastayaḥ karambhayaḥ kauśalyāḥ sumedhaso mayobhuvo gādharāyaṇāḥ phulastayaḥ pulahāḥ ṛtavaḥ kārṇāṭā mahendrāḥ | ityagastayaḥ | teṣāmekaḥ | āgastyeti | trayo vā | āgastyadārḍhacyutaidhmavāheti | āgastyamāhendramāyobhuveti vā | idhmavāhā viśālādyāḥ sphālāyanā aupadahanayaḥ kalmāṣā daṇḍayo lāva ṇayo lavyāradaṇḍayo vairaṇayo muṇḍodarayaḥ saivapathayaḥ śālmātapā mauñjilatāḥ pādohatā hārigrīvī rohiṣyā mausalayaḥ saivagaḥ sāmbharāyaṇāḥ kaikarṇāyanā mārgāyaṇā ācaryāḥ śālaṅkāyanaya upakalmakāyanayo vāriṇayo yavātyāyanayaḥ kṣauminayo lāśayaḥ sākākṣayastaṇḍayo lājyāyanayo hṛdogayo mādurākṣayaḥ paṇḍoddhanāḥ kuṇḍyākṣaya upakūlā arbudāḥ śaivāyudhāḥ parahatā vaityorandaya aukulā vairaṇḍayo govyādayo dāmāḥ somyānayā brāhmaṇyāḥ putrayo vāsiṣāyaṇāḥ śāragaraḥ sphāṇṭāvacanāḥ | itīdhmavāhāḥ | teṣāṃ trayaḥ | āgastyadārḍhacyutaidhmavāheti dārḍhyeti vā pāṭhaḥ | eko vā''gastyeti | sāmbhavāhānāṃ sāmbhavāhāntyau pūrvāveva | āgastyadārḍhacyutasāmbhavāheti | evaṃ somavāhādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ tattannāmāntyau pūrvāveva | pūrṇamāsānāṃ pāraṇināṃ ca trayaḥ | āgastyapaurṇimāsapāraṇeti | himodakāḥ | akrāḥ śaktāḥ śuktā haṃsāḥ śvāsā hemacarcayaḥ | iti himodakāḥ | teṣāṃ trayaḥ | āgastyahaimacarcihaimodaketi | pāṇikā vimitelayaḥ | māmitekalayaḥ | pināmakāḥ | nandayoniyaḥ | vilayaḥ | iti pāṇikāḥ | teṣāṃ trayaḥ | āgastyapaināmakapāṇiketi | agastīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parasparamavivāhaḥ, sagotratvātsapravaratvācca | ityagastayaḥ | atha digotrāḥ | śauṅgaśaiśirayaḥ saṃkṛtayo laugākṣayaśca | tatra bharadvājācchuṅgādvaiśvāmitrasya śaiśireḥ kṣetre jātaḥ śauṅgaśaiśirināmā vadgotrāṇāṃ pañca | āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājakātyātkīleti | āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājaśauṅgaśaiśireti vā | trayo vā, āṅgirasakātyātkīleti | ādyo bharadvājo vā | bhāradvājakātyātkīleti | kātyākṣileti vā pāṭhaḥ | eṣāṃ viśvāmitrabharadvājābhyāṃ nānvayaḥ | saṃkṛtayaḥ pūtimāṣāstaṇḍayaḥ śambavo bhaimagavāḥ saupavanā jānakayaḥ sairādhā ratavyā ṛṣanayo vārāyaṇayaḥ sahayo gāṅgayo laukṣayastālā nāgahayā bhillātayo vibhītakāstailayaḥ paribhavā vaiyāghrapadyāḥ śrautāyanāścāndrāyaṇā mallakāḥ śālāyanā ārṣaṇyā hāriniyāḥ paulā āghrayaḥ | iti saṃkṛtayaḥ | teṣāṃ trayaḥ | śāktyasāṃkṛtyagaurivīteti | antyayorvyatyayo vā | śāktyagaurivītasāṃkṛtyeti | āṅgirasagaurivītasāṃkṛtyeti vā | eṣāṃ saṃkṛtīnāṃ vasiṣṭhatvamasti, satyāṣāḍhāpastambādibhirvasiṣṭhagaṇamadhye pāṭhāt | vāsiṣṭhaśakteḥ pākṣikavaraṇācca | tenaiṣāṃ sarvairvāsiṣṭhairaharvāsiṣṭhairlogākṣibhiśca sahāvivāhaḥ, sagotratvātkiṃcitpravarasāmyācca | kevalāṅgirobhirapyavivāhaḥ | baudhāyanena kevalāṅgirobhirviśvāmitrairvasiṣṭhaiśca saha saṃkṛtibhiravivāha ityuktam | kecittu kevalāṅgirogaṇairvivāha eva sagotratvābhāvāddvitri(tra)pravarasāmyābhāvāḍacceti vadanti | prayogapārijāte tu kāśyapairapyeṣāmavivāha ityuktaṃ, tatra hetuścintya iti navyāḥ | laugākṣayo dārbhāyaṇā maitravādayo drehakāleyāḥ kāpuṭayaḥ kalayāḥ kaṃsapātrāścālakāyanayo nityarāḥ, tādaya odakayaḥ kaunāmayaḥ sautayaḥ saitikayaḥ ṣṭebharā niśayaḥ ṣṭaiṣikayaḥ sausukhikayaḥ sairandhrayo voṣaṇayaḥ kālakayaḥ saurandhrayo rājabāhavo'naśvayo migurayo rājavannayaḥ sairayaḥ svirodavāhayo rājasavakayaḥ sauraṅghrayaḥ piṅgākṣayaḥ kākulayaḥ śākulayo rāvaphālayaḥ saikayaḥ sāsudhayaḥ śaradvantā aupapatyakayaḥ sautapāḥ | iti laugākṣayaḥ | teṣāṃ trayaḥ | kāśyapāvatsāravāsiṣṭheti | kāśyapāvatsārāsiteti vā | vāsiṣṭhāvatsārakāśyapeti vā | ete'harvasiṣṭhāḥ | naktaṃ kaśyapāḥ | eṣāṃ vasiṣṭhakaśyapābhyāṃ saṃkṛtibhiścāvivāhaḥ sagotratvātkaiścitsapravaratvādapi | pārijātadhṛtasaṃgrahasmṛtyarthasārayostvanye ṣaḍuktāḥ | devarātānāṃ trayaḥ | vaiśvāmitradaivarātaudaleti | eṣāṃ jamadagniviśvāmitrābhyāmavivāhaḥ | "jamadagnigaṇasyāpi viśvāmitragaṇasya ca | na devarātagotreṇa vivāhaḥ syātparasparam" iti saṃgrahokteḥ || baudhāyanādibhirjāmadagnyeṣu devarātasyāpaṭhitatvājjāmadagnyatvaṃ cintyamiti kecit | anye tu -- "aurvasyaivamṛcīkasya satyavatyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ | jamadagnistapovīryo jajñe brahmavidāṃ varaḥ || madhyamaśca śunaḥśepaḥ śunaḥpucchaḥ kaniṣṭhakaḥ" | ityuktvā -- "devairdattaḥ śunaḥśepo viśvāmitrāya bhārgavaḥ | devairdattaḥ sa vai yasmāddevarātastato'bhavat" || iti harivaṃśe devarātasya jamadagnisaṃbandhakathanājjāmadagnyatvamupapannamityāhuḥ | dharmapradīpe tu -- "mātāmahaiḥ śuddhajāmadagnyairdevarātānāṃ na vivāhaḥ" ityuktam | dhanaṃjayānāṃ vaiśvāmitramādhucchandasadhānaṃjayyeti | eṣāmatriviśvāmitrābhyāmavivāhaḥ | jātūkarṇyānāṃ vāsiṣṭhātreyajātūkarṇyeti | eṣāmatrivasiṣṭhābhyāmavivāhaḥ | vāmarathyādīnāṃ pūrvoktānāmatriputrikāputrāṇāmatrivasiṣṭhābhyāmavivāhaḥ | atriviśvāmitrābhyāmiti kecit | kapilānāṃ pañca | āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājavāndanamātavacaseti | eṣāṃ viśvāmitrabhāradvājābhyāmavivāhaḥ | na ca kapilasya viśvāmitrasaṃbandhe mānābhāvaḥ | vaiśvāmitraṃ devarātaṃ prakṛtya tasyaite kāpileyavābhravā ityaitareyi(ya)brāhmaṇagatakāpilokterliṅgavidhayā mānatvāt | kapilānāṃ viśvāmitratvābhāve kāpilānāṃ vaiśvāmitratvānupapatteḥ | katānāṃ trayaḥ | vaiśvāmitrakātyātkīleti | eṣāṃ viśvāmitrabhāradvājābhyāmavivāhaḥ | evamidānīṃtanānāmapi dattakādīnāmutpādakapālakayoḥ pitrorgotrapravarāvarjyā iti pravaramañjaryādayaḥ | maṇḍanaḥ -- "āviśvāmitramātreyā nodvahanti ca te mithaḥ | dvigotrā vāmarathyādyā atreste putrikāsutāḥ || viśvāmitrairatribhiśca na vivāhyo dhanaṃjayaḥ | yadvā dhanaṃjayau bhinnau śabdamātraṃ na bhidyate || viśvāmitrāḥ kaśyapāntāsteṣāṃ nānyasamanvayaḥ | kaśyapāḥ syurvasiṣṭhāntāste'nyonyamavivāhinaḥ || vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapairnāsti laugākṣīṇāṃ vivāhitā | vasiṣṭhāḥ syuragastyāntā nopayacchanti te mithaḥ || viśvādyairaṅgirobhiśca vasiṣṭhairapyaśeṣataḥ | saṃkṛtīnāṃ dvivaṃśatvānnāsti vaivāhikī kriyā || tathaiva jātūkarṇyānāṃ vasiṣṭhairatribhiḥ saha | taṇḍyādivarjaṃ sarvairvā saṃkṛtīnāṃ vivāhitā || nānyonyamapyagastīnāṃ rājādiṃ gurugotrataḥ | svagotrādyanabhijñānāṃ viprāṇāmiyameva dik || guruvaṃśāvidanyasmai svaṃ dattvā tatkulo bhavet | yadvā svapravarājñāne jamadagnīnupāśrayet || gotrakāryeṣu sarveṣu kiṃtu naivodvahetkvacit | mānaveti tu sarveṣāṃ yadyapi pravaraḥ samaḥ || tathā'pi tena sāmyena na vivāho niṣidhyate | pravare ye vikalpāśca te codvāhyā vyavasthitāḥ || tayā vyavasthayā cintyau samānapravaretarau | ye svayaṃ kalpitaṃ yakṣaṃ kumārā na smaranti hi || teṣāṃ tadanusāreṇa sagotratvādicintanam | satyāṣāḍho vadatyetadanye tulyavikalpanam || ācāryāntarapāṭhānāmīṣadbhede'pyabhinnatā" iti || iyaṃ vyavasthā kṣattriyaviṣayiṇyeva pūrvatra tasyaivopakramāt | ayameva nyāyo vaiśyānāmapi | gaṇasaṃdehe tvavivāha eva | iti pravaranirṇayaḥ | atha mātṛgotranirṇayaḥ | tatra smṛtivacanam -- "mātulasya sutāmūḍhvā mātṛgotrāṃ tathaiva ca | samānapravarāṃ caiva tyaktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" iti || ayaṃ ca mātṛgotrāvivāhaniṣedho gāndharvādivivāhoḍhāsutānāṃ sarveṣāmeva | brāhmādivivāhoḍhāsutānāṃ sarveṣāṃ na, kiṃtu mādhyaṃdinīyānāmeva 'mātṛgotraṃ mādhyaṃdinīyānām' iti vacanāt | śiṣṭācāro'pyevameva | kecittvetasya vacanasya nirmūlatvātsarveṣāṃ mātṛgotravarjanamityāhuḥ | yuktaṃ tu śiṣṭācārasahakṛtavacanānmādhyaṃdinīyānāmeva tadvarjanam | iti mātṛgotranirṇayaḥ | atha dattakasya vivāhādyupayogigotrādinirṇayaḥ | tatra yadyapi yaśca pratigrahītrā jātakarmādibhiścūḍādibhirvā saṃskṛtaḥ sa ekagotraḥ | etadabhipretyaiva -- "gotrarikthe janayiturna bhajeddattimaḥ sutaḥ" | iti śāstramapi pravṛttam | etadanyastu pratigrahītropanayanamātrasaṃskṛtastaduttaraṃ pratigṛhīto vā devarātavaddvigotra eveti vyavasthā nibandhakārairuktā, tathā'pyeṣā vyavasthā'bhivādanaśrāddhādigatagotranirdeśārthā | vivāhe tu dattakamātreṇa vījipratigrahītroḥ pitrorgotrapravaravarjanaṃ kāryam | pravaramañjaryādinibandheṣu tanniṣedhokteriti kaustubhe | dattakamīmāṃsākārastu dattakamātre gotradvayavarjanaṃ na, kiṃtu dvyāmuṣyāyaṇe dattakaviśeṣe [ityāha] | tathāhi | dvividhā dattakādayaḥ| nityadvyāmuṣyāṇā anityadvyāmuṣyāyaṇāśca | tatra nityadvyāmuṣyāyaṇā nāma ye janakapratigrahītṛbhyāmāvayorayaṃ putra iti saṃpratipannāḥ | anityadvyāmuṣyāyaṇāstu ye cūḍāntaiḥ saṃskārairjanakena saṃskṛtā upanayanādibhiśca pratigrahītrā, teṣāṃ gotradvayenāpi saṃskṛtatvāddvyāmuṣyāyaṇatvaṃ paraṃ tvanityam | jātamātrasyaiva parigrahe gotradvayena saṃskārābhāvāttasya parigrahītṛgotrameva | tadidaṃ sarvamabhipretyā''ha satyāṣāḍhaḥ -- "nityānāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ dvayoḥ" iti sūtreṇa nityadvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ gotradvaye pravarasaṃbandhamuktvā tamevānityeṣvatidiśati, "dattakādīnāṃ taddvyāmuṣyāyaṇavat" iti sūtreṇa | vyākhyātaṃ caitacchabarasvāmibhiḥ -- "dvyāmuṣyāyaṇaprasaṅgenānityānāha dattaketi | tāvadeva nottarasaṃtatau | prathamenaiva saṃskārāḥ parigrahītrā cettadottarasya pūrvatvāttenaivottaratra, tathā pitṛvyeṇa caikārṣeyeṇa ye jātāste parigrahītureva" iti | asya bhāṣyasyāyamarthaḥ | yo gotradvayena saṃskṛtastasyaiva gotradvayasaṃbandho nottarasaṃtateḥ | janakagotrasaṃbandhe kiṃ kāraṇamityāha -- prathameneti | prathamo janakastenaiva saṃskṛtatvāt | saṃskārāśca caulāntāḥ | "piturgotreṇa yaḥ putraḥ saṃskṛtaḥ pṛthivīpate | ācūḍāntaṃ na putraḥ sa putratāṃ yāti cānyataḥ" || iti kālikāpurāṇāt | vyākhyātaṃ caitatprāgeva | anyasyāsādhāraṇīṃ putratāṃ na yāti kiṃtu dvyāmuṣyāyaṇo bhavatīti | prathamenāsaṃskāre kathamityata āha | parigrahītrā cediti | parigrahītraiva jātakarmādisarvasaṃskārakaraṇe caulādisaṃskārakaraṇe'pi vottarasya parigrahītureva gotram | tatra hetuḥ pūrvatvātsaṃskārakaraṇe prathamatvāt | dvyāmuṣyāyaṇasaṃtatau cāpekṣitagotramāha -- tenaiveti | parigrahītṛgotreṇaivottarasaṃtatergotramubhayatrāpi | sagotraparigrahamāha -- tatheti | janakaparigrahītrorekagotratve'pi parigrahītraiva vyapadeśaḥ parigrahasaṃskārakaraṇāditi | yattu -- "gotrarikthe janayiturna bhajeddattimaḥ sutaḥ" iti, tatparigrahītraiva jātakarmādisarvasaṃskārakaraṇapakṣe veditavyam | ye tvanityadvyāmuṣyāyaṇā dattakādayasteṣāṃ gotradvayam, "dvyāmuṣyāyaṇakā ye syurdattakakrītakādayaḥ | gotradvaye'pyanudvāhaḥ śuṅgaśaiśirayoryathā" iti pārijātasmaraṇāt | gotradvaye janakagotre parigrahītṛgotre ca | dattakādīnāṃ ca dvyāmuṣyāyaṇatve | "idaṃ nityānāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ dattakādīnāṃ dvyāmuṣyāyaṇavat" iti satyāṣāḍhavacanaṃ pramāṇam |pravaramañjaryāmapyanenaivābhiprāyeṇoktam | dattakrītakṛtrimaputrikāputrādīnāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ gotradvayaṃ sapravaramastyeveti | etāvatā dvigotrāṇāṃ gotradvayaṃ sapravaraṃ vivāhe varjyamityāha | tatra yuktaṃ grāhyam | na cedānīṃtanasūtrapustaka etatsūtrasyaivādarśanātkathametasya satyāṣāḍhīyatvamiti vācyam | atiprāmāṇikena mīmāṃsābhāṣyakṛtā śabarasvāminā satyāṣīḍhayatvena dhṛtvaiva vyākhyātatvenaitadanurodhenedānīṃtanasūtrapustaka etatsūtrasyocchinnatāyā eva kalpanāt | saṃkarṣakāṇḍamucchinnamityabhiyuktapravādo'pyasti | dvigotrasya janakapitṛgotravarjanāvadheḥ kvacidapīdānīmanupalambhādyāvadvijñānaṃ varjanam | iti dattakagotranirṇayaḥ | atha dattakasāpiṇḍyanirṇayaḥ | gautamaḥ -- " ūrdhvaṃ saptamātpitṛbandhubhyo vījinaśca mātṛbandhabhyaḥ pañcamyāḥ" iti | uktaṃ ca -- " vasudevāṅgajātā ca kaunteyasya virudhyate" | itivārtikavyākhyānāvasare nyāyasudhākṛtā dattakaviṣayametadityaṅgīkṛtya kuntyā janakakule sāptapuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyamiti | vyākhyātaṃ tadviṣayatvenaiva sāpiṇḍyamīmāṃsāyām | ataḥ kuladvaye'pi sāptapuruṣasāpiṇḍyaṃ pratīyate | paiṭhīnasistu -- "trīnmātṛtaḥ pañca pitṛtaḥ puruṣānatītyodvahet" ityāha | vyākhyātametadaparārke -- dattakādiputrānpitṛpakṣato nivṛttapiṇḍagotrārṣeyānpratyetaducyate pañca pitṛta itīti | ataśca pratigrahītṛpitṛkule sāptapuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyaṃ pratīyate | pratigrahītṛmātāpitṛkulayostripuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyamiti prāñcaḥ | atra vyavasthoktā sāpiṇḍyadīpikāyām -- dattakrītādīnāṃ janakagotreṇopanayane kṛte janakakule sāptapuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyam | pratigrahītṛmātāpitṛkule nirvāpyapiṇḍalakṣaṇaṃ tripuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyam | pratigrahītṛgotreṇopanayane tatkule sāptapuruṣamiti | upanayanamātre kṛte pāñcapuruṣam | jātakarmādyupanayanānte kṛte sāptapuruṣamiti paiṭhīnasivacaḥsāphalyāya vyākhyeyam | na kevalaṃ dattakasya pariṇayanārthamevaiṣa sāpiṇḍyopanyāsaḥ, kiṃtu tatsaṃtatestatpitrādikulotpannaiḥ saha saṃbandhasaṃbhavanirṇayārthamapi | anyathā pārthasubhadrayāradattayoḥ saṃbandhāsaṃbhavaśaṅkāyā ācāyakartṛkopanyāsasya tadupapattye sudhāyā gautamīyopanyāsasyālagnakatāpatteḥ | yādṛśasya dattakasya yathā sāpiṇḍyamuktaṃ tatsaṃtaterapi tathaiva tadbodhyam | ata eva yanmadanapārijāte'pyuktaṃ dattaputryāḥ sutasya mātuḥ pratigrahītṛpitṛmātṛkule tripuruṣaṃ sāpiṇḍyam | dattaputrasutasya svajanakakule pañcapuruṣamiti, tadapi pūrvoktarītyā dattakaviśeṣasaṃtativiṣayatvena vyākhyeyam | iti kaustubhoktadattakasāpiṇḍyanirṇayaḥ | atha prasaṅgāddattakasyā''śaucanirṇayaḥ | dattakaputrasya janmamaraṇayoḥ pūrvāparapitrostrirātraṃ sapiṇḍānāmekāham [āśaucam] | yadyasapiṇḍaḥ putrīkṛtaḥ -- "baijikādabhisaṃbandhādanurundhyādaghaṃ tryaham" iti vacanāt , "parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu putreṣu kṛtakeṣu ca | bhartṛmātrostrirātraṃ syādekāhastu sapiṇḍagaḥ" || iti mādhavīye hārītavacanācca | tādṛśena dattakena pitrādimaraṇe trirātraṃ kāryam -- "dattakaśca svayaṃ dattaḥ kṛtrimaḥ krīta eva ca | sūtake mṛtake caiva tryahāśaucasya bhāginaḥ" || iti śuddhitattve brāhmavacanāt | sapiṇḍasya putrīkaraṇe tu sapiṇḍamaraṇādinimittaṃ dattakasya tanmaraṇādinimittaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ daśarātrameva nirvivādam | sāpiṇḍyaṃ ca pūrvoktarītyā vyavasthitamāśaucahetuḥ | dattakaputrasya jananamaraṇayoḥ pūrvāparapitrostrirātraṃ sapiṇḍānāmekāhamiti kaustubhīyavākyasyāyamarthaḥ | dattakaputrasyetyatra saṃskārānantaraṃ gṛhītasya dattakasya putro dattakaputra iti tatpuruṣeṇa pūrvāparapitrorjananāśaucasya saṃśayanivṛttirbhavatītyarthaḥ | tathā''ha marīciḥ -- "sūtake mṛtake caiva trirātraṃ parapūrvayoḥ | ekāhastu sapiṇḍānāṃ trirātraṃ yatra vai pituḥ" iti || yadā tu pitustrirātraṃ tadā sapiṇḍānāmekāha ityarthaḥ | "anauraseṣu putreṣu jāteṣu ca mṛteṣu ca | parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu prasūtāsu mṛtāsu ca || trirātrādiṣyate śuddhiḥ"| ityasyāyamarthaḥ -- anauraseṣvitīyamadhikaraṇasaptamī | anauraseṣu dattakādiṣu tatra jāteṣūtpanneṣu putreṣūtpannabālakeṣu satsu mṛteṣu satsu ca paraḥ pūrvaḥ patiryāsāṃ tāḥ parapūrvāstāsu jārāsaktāsviti yāvat | tathā ca prajāpatiḥ -- "anyāśriteṣu dāreṣu parapatnīsuteṣu ca | gotriṇaḥ snānaśuddhāḥ syustrirātreṇaiva tatpitā" iti || ityāśaucanirṇayaḥ | atha janakapratigrahītruddeśyakadattakakartṛkapiṇḍadānanirṇayaḥ | manuḥ -- "gotrarikthe janayiturna bhajeddattimaḥ sutaḥ | gotrarikthānugaḥ piṇḍo vyapaiti dadataḥ svadhām" iti || etacca janakasya putrasattve | pravaramañjaryāṃ kātyāyanalaugākṣibhyāṃ spaṣṭaṃ caitaduktam -- "atha ye dattakakrītakṛtrimaputrikāputrāḥ paraparigraheṇā''rṣeyā jātāste dvyāmuṣyāyaṇā bhavanti yathā śauṅgaśaiśirīṇāṃ yāni cānyāni samutpannāni kulāni bhavanti"| ityādinā dvayoḥ pitroḥ pravarānuktvoktam -- "atha yadyeṣāṃ svāsu bhāryāsvapatyaṃ na syādrikthaṃ hareyuḥ piṇḍaṃ caibhyastripuruṣaṃ dadyuryadyubhayorna syādubhābhyāmeva dadyurekasmiñśrāddhe pṛthaguddiśyaikapiṇḍe dvāvanukīrtayetpratigrahītāraṃ cotpādayitāraṃ cā''tṛtīyātpuruṣāt" iti | hemādrau kārṣṇājiniḥ -- "yāvantaḥ pitṛvargāḥ syustāvadbhirdattakādayaḥ | pretānāṃ yojanaṃ kuryuḥ svakīyaiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha || dvābhyāṃ saha pituḥ putrāḥ pautrāmtvekena tatsamam | caturthapuruṣe chandastasmādeṣā tripūruṣā || sādhāraṇeṣu kāleṣu viśeṣo nāsti vargiṇaḥ" iti | asyārthamāha hemādriḥ -- dattakādayo janakapālakayoḥ kulapretānāṃ svavargīyaiḥ sapiṇḍanaṃ kuryuḥ | dattakānāṃ putra(trā)stu piturdattakasya pitṛbhyāṃ janakapālakābhyāṃ svapitāmahābhyāṃ sapiṇḍanaṃ kuryuḥ | teṣāṃ pautrāḥ svapitaraṃ dattakena pitāmahena tajjanakena ca sapiṇḍayeyuḥ | caturtho'pi tatkulastha eva, teṣāṃ prapautrastu dattakasya prapitāmahasya pālakakulasthaṃ caturthaṃ yojayenna vā | chanda icchā | darśamahālayādau tu dvayoḥ pitroḥ pināmahayoḥ prapitāmahayorvā śrāddhaṃ deyam | tatra dvayoḥ pitrādyoḥ pṛthakpiṇḍadānaṃ, dvayoddeśenaiko veti | śrāddhe gotraṃ tu pālakasya, vivāhādau tūbhayorityādi pravaradarpaṇādiṣu jñeyam | atha vivāhakālaḥ | tatra madanaratne nāradaḥ -- "yugme'bde janmataḥ strīṇāṃ prītidaṃ pāṇipīḍanam | etatpuṃsāmayugme'bde vyatyaye nāśakṛttayoḥ" iti | puṃsāṃ yugme'bde strīṇāmayugme'bda ityevaṃrūpe vyatyaye | tayorvadhūvarayoḥ pāṇipīḍanaṃ nāśakṛdbhavatītyarthaḥ | parāśaramādhavīye smṛtyantare tu -- "garbhādhānājjanmato vā pañcamābdātparaṃ śubham | kumārīvaraṇaṃ dānaṃ mekhalābandhanaṃ tathā" ityuktam | pañcamābdātparamiti | pañcamābdātparaṃ yadayu(dyu)gmaṃ varṣaṃ tatra kumārīvaraṇādi śubhaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | tena yugme'bde janmata ityanena na virodhaḥ | baudhāyanaḥ -- "dadyādguṇavate kanyāṃ nagnikāṃ brahmacāriṇe | api vā guṇahīnāya noparundhyādrajasvalām" iti | yattu manunoktam -- "kāmamāmaraṇāttiṣṭhedgṛhe kanyartumatyapi | na caivaināṃ prayaccheta guṇahīnāya karhicit" | iti tadguṇavati saṃbhavati guṇahīnāya na dadyādityevaṃparaṃ na tu sarvathā gaṇahīnaniṣedhaparam | no cedapi vā guṇahīnāyeti baudhāyanoktaḥ kalpo nirviṣayaḥ syāt | ṛtumatyapi tiṣṭheditivacanamuktarītyā na svārthe tātparyavat | ato noparundhyādrajasvalāmityanena na virodhaḥ | ata eva vasiṣṭho'pi -- "prayacchennagnikāṃ kanyāmṛtukālabhayātpitā | ṛtumatyāṃ hi tiṣṭhantyāṃ doṣaḥ pitaramṛcchati" iti | kanyāśabdena lajjādyabhimānarahitavayoyuktā vivikṣatā | tathā ca mādhavīye purāṇam -- "yāvanna gūhate'ṅgāni kanyā puruṣasaṃnidhau | yonyādīnnāvagūheta tāvadbhavati kanyakā" iti | amarastu nagnikā'nāgatārtavetyāha| smṛtyantare -- "ṣaḍabdamadhye nodvāhyā kanyakā vatsaradvayam | somo bhuṅkte yatastadvadgandharvaśca tathā'nalaḥ" iti | etanmūlabhūtā śrutirapi -- "somaḥ prathamo vivide" ityārabhya "tṛtīyo'gniṣṭe patiḥ" ityantā | nanvasya virodho brahmapurāṇe gautamīmāhātmye bhānutīrthavarṇane viṣṭibhānusaṃvāde dṛśyate -- "caturthādvatsarādūrdhvaṃ yāvanna daśamātyayaḥ | tāvadvivāhaḥ kanyāyāḥ pitrā kāryaḥ prayatnataḥ" iti | satyam | etatpurāṇavākyaṃ śudrāviṣayaṃ na brāhmaṇyādiviṣayamityavirodhaḥ | saptamavarṣaṃ viṣamatvānnāradādibhiḥ strīvivāhe nāṅgīkṛtaṃ tasmātsarvavarṇānāmaviruddhamaṣṭamanavamadaśamavarṣeṣu stryudvahanam | nanu navamavarṣasya grahaṇaṃ viruddhaṃ yugme'bde janmataḥ strīṇāmitināradavacanavirodhāditi cetsatyam | "navavarṣā tu rohiṇī" iti navavarṣāyā rohiṇyāḥ "vaikuṇṭho rohiṇīṃ dadan"iti vakṣyamāṇamarīcivacane rohiṇīpradāne phalaviśeṣoktyā navamavarṣasyāpi vivāhakālatvenoktatvāt | vayoviśeṣeṇa dātuḥ phalaviśeṣamāha marīciḥ -- "gaurīṃ dadannākapṛṣṭhe vaikuṇṭhe rohiṇīṃ dadan | kanyāṃ dadanbrahmaloke raurave tu rajasvalām" iti | vasatīti śeṣaḥ | gauryādiśabdārtho yamena darśitaḥ -- "aṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu rohiṇī | daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā" iti | saṃvarto'pi -- "aṣṭame tu bhavedgaurī navame nagnikā bhavet | daśame kanyakā proktā'ta ūrdhvaṃ syādrajasvalā" iti || devalaḥ -- "kulaśīlavayovṛttarūpāḍhyāṃ nagnikāṃ śubhām | vidhinā tu varaḥ kanyāmudvahedātmanaḥ samām || saptābdātkanyakānāmnī śaiśavī syācchubhānvitā | tāmaṣṭādaśavarṣīyo vivahedvidhivatpumān || yā'ṣṭavarṣā bhavedgaurī putrapautrapravardhinī | pañcaviṃśativarṣīyastāṃ kanyāmudvaheddvijaḥ || rohiṇī navavarṣā syāddhanadhānyavivardhinī | tāmudvaheta matimānsarvakāmārthasiddhaye || ūrdhvaṃ daśābdādyā kanyā prāgrajodarśanāttu sā | gāṃdhārī syātsamudvāhyā ciraṃ jīvitumicchatā" iti || iti vivāhakālaḥ | atha vivāhe māsādinirṇayaḥ | tatra māsā uktā vātsyena -- "māghamāse bhavedvyūḍhā kanyā saubhāgyasaṃyutā | phālgunoḍhā bhavetsādhvī vaiśākhe pūtriṇī bhavet || dharmayuktā bhavejjyeṣṭhe dhaninī kārtike bhavet | devapūjāratā nityaṃ māse syātsomadevate" iti || dhaninī svātantryeṇa dhanasaṃgrahavatī | nityamityanena bhartrādiśuśrūṣāvyāvṛttiḥ sūcyate | somadevato mārgaśīrṣaḥ | madanaratne nāradaḥ -- "māghaphālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭhamāsāḥ śubhapradāḥ | kārtiko mārgaśīrṣaśca madhyamāvitare'dhamāḥ || na kadāciddaśarkṣeṣu bhānorārdrāpraveśanāt | vivāhadevatānāṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ copanāyanam" iti || atra yadyapi śeṣā ninditāstathā'pi bhānorārdrāpraveśanāditi punaḥśrutyā''ṣāḍho'bhyanujñāta iti navīnāḥ | atra ca vidhiniṣedhāḥ sauramāsābhiprāyeṇa | yathoktaṃ gargeṇa -- "sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti | kaśyapena cāndramānamapyuktam -- "upavāsavratodvāhayātrākṣauropanāyanam | tithivarṣādilikhitaṃ cāndramānena gṛhyate" iti || itare caitrāṣāḍhaśrāvaṇabhādrapadāśvinapoṣāḥ | jyotiṣprakāśe vyāsaḥ -- "māghaphālgunavaiśākhe yadyūḍhā mārgaśīrṣake | jyeṣṭhe cā''ṣāḍhamāse ca subhagā vittasaṃyutā || śrāvaṇe vā'pi pauṣe vā kanyā bhādrapade tathā | caitrāśvayukkārtikeṣu yāti vaidhavyatāṃ dhruvam" iti || pṛthvīcandrodaye bharadvājaḥ -- "māghaphālgunavaiśākhajyeṣṭhāṣāḍhamṛgābhidhāḥ | ṣaḍete pūjitā māsāścāturvarṇyasya nityaśaḥ" iti || atra vihitapratiṣiddhānāmāṣāḍhādīnāṃ vyavasthāmāha madanaratne vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "pauṣe'pi kuryānmakarasthite'rke caitre bhavenmeṣagato yadā syāt | praśastamāṣāḍhakṛtaṃ vivāhaṃ vadanti gargā mithunasthite'rke" iti || deśācārādvyavasthā | āpastambaḥ -- "sarva ṛtavo vivāhasya śaiśirau māsau parihāpyottamaṃ ca naidāgham" iti | śaiśirau māsau māghaphālgunau | naidāgha uttamo māsa āṣāḍhaḥ | etadvarjaṃ nava māsā mukhyaḥ kāla iti sudarśanabhāṣye'ṇḍavilāyāṃ brahmavidyātīrthaiścoktam | baudhāyanasūtre'pi -- "sarva māsā vivāhasya śucitapastapasyavarjamityeke" iti | śucirāṣāḍhaḥ | tapā māghaḥ | tapasyaḥ phālgunaḥ | atra smṛtyuktānāṃ māsānāṃ sūtroktānāṃ māsānāṃ ca parasparavirodhāddeśācārādvyavasthā | sūtre vihitānāṃ śrāvaṇādīnāṃ tvāsurādiviṣayatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | deśācārādvyavasthā | caṇḍeśvaraḥ -- "mārge māsi tathā jyeṣṭhe kṣauraṃ pariṇayo vratam | jyeṣṭhaputraduhitrostu yatnena parivarjayet || kṛttikāsthaṃ raviṃ tyaktvā jyeṣṭhaputrasya kārayet" iti | "jyeṣṭhamāsyādyaputrasya śubhaṃ varjaṃ striyā api" | itiniṣedho vadhūvarayoranyatarajyeṣṭhatve na pravartate | "jyeṣṭhasya jyeṣṭhakanyāyā vivāho na praśasyate | tayoranyatare jyeṣṭhe jyeṣṭhamāsaḥ praśasyate || dvau jyeṣṭhau madhyamau proktāvekajyeṣṭhaṃ sukhāvaham | jyeṣṭhatrayaṃ na kurvīta vivāhe sarvasaṃmatam" iti mihirokteḥ || jyeṣṭhā kanyā jyeṣṭho varo jyeṣṭhamāsa iti jyeṣṭhatrayam | jyeṣṭhānakṣatreṇāpi jyeṣṭhatrayam, jyeṣṭhānakṣatraṃ jyeṣṭho māso jyeṣṭhā kanyā varo vā jyeṣṭha ityevaṃ vā jyeṣṭhatrayam | jyeṣṭhacatuṣṭaye jyeṣṭhatrayasya sadbhāvānniṣedhapravṛttirastyeva | jyeṣṭhasya varasya jyeṣṭhakanyāyāśca jyeṣṭhamāse vivāho na praśasyate | tayormadhye'nyatarajyeṣṭhatve tu praśasyata ityarthaḥ | nāradaḥ -- "janmamāse ca janmarkṣe na janmadivase'pi ca | ādyagarbhasutasyātha duhiturvā karagrahaḥ" iti || karagraho vivāhaḥ | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre caulakarmopanayanagodānavivāhāḥ sārvakālameke vivāham" iti | kalyāṇaṃ jyotiḥśāstrāvirodhīti vṛttikṛt | jyotirnibandhe -- "sārvakālikamicchanti vivāhaṃ gautamādayaḥ" iti | etacca sārvakālikatvamāsurādyadharmyavivāhaviṣayamiti kecit | āsannartukālakanyāviṣayamityanye | kātyāyanaḥ -- "udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe puṇyāhe kumāryāḥ pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīyāt" iti | nāradaḥ -- "śuklapakṣaṃ praśaṃsanti vivāhe gautamādayaḥ" iti | atra śuklapakṣaprāśastyoktyā'saṃbhave kṛṣṇapakṣasyāpi grahaṇamiti sūcyate | sarva ṛtavo vivāhasyetyāpastambasūtravyākhyāvasare sudarśanenāpi pūrvapakṣaniyamābhāva uktaḥ | tithaya uktā bharadvājena -- "pratipadduḥkhajananī dvitīyā prītivardhinī | saubhāgyadā tṛtīyā syāccaturthī cārthanāśinī || pañcamyāṃ sukhavittāni ṣaṣṭhī vighnapradāyinī | vidyāśīlasukhāptiḥ syātsaptamyāmaphalā'ṣṭamī || navamī śokaphaladā ānando daśamīdine | sukhadaikādaśī jñeyā saphalā dvādaśī smṛtā || mānaputrau trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ tu duḥkhadaḥ | vivāha iti śeṣaḥ | phalaṃ bahuvidhaṃ pañcadaśyāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ" iti | pañcadaśī pūrṇimā | "vivāhamārabhya caturthimadhye śrāddhaṃ dinaṃ darśadinaṃ yadi syāt | vaidhavyamāpnoti tadā''śu kanyā jīvetpatiścedanapatyatā syāt" || iti jyotirnibandhavacanādamāyā vivāhadivasāntarbhāvaniṣedhe siddhe sutarāṃ tatra vivāhaniṣedhasyāpi siddheḥ | caturthīśabdasya hṛsvatvamārṣam | śrāddhaṃ tadyuktaṃ dinamiti vivāhamadhye śrāddhasyaiva niṣedho na tu tadrahitatattithimātrasya | anyathā -- "vṛtte vivāhe paratastu kuryācchrāddhaṃ svadhābhirna tu dūṣayettam" | iti śāstrasya nirviṣayatvāpatteḥ | taṃ vivāhavidhim | darśadinamiti svarūpeṇa tithiniṣedhaḥ | tathā satyeva pṛthagupādānasya sārthakyāt | ayameva viṣaya upanayanādiṣvapi jñeyaḥ "ye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ" iti śrutau sāmānyata ukteḥ | etatsarvamatisaṃkaṭe jñeyam | jyotirnibandhe prayogacintāmaṇau ca lallaḥ -- "atrāpi kṛṣṇapakṣasya daśamīmavivāhikām | vadantyanye tu daśamīmubhayoravivāhikām" iti || atrāpyuktāsu tithiṣvapi | avivāhikāṃ vivāhānarhām | ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ | vihitapratiṣiddhatvāddaśamyā vikalpaḥ | atha nakṣatrāṇi | tatra -- "ahnaḥ pañcasu kāleṣu prātaḥ saṃgave madhyaṃdine'parāhṇe sāyaṃ vaiteṣu yatkārī syātpuṇyāha eva kurute" ityetatsūtravyākhyānāvasare mātṛdattaḥ -- "puṇyāni tithivāranakṣatrāṇi kālajñānavihitānyupādeyāni pradarśanārthatvāccaitasya vidhānasyeti | nakṣatreṣvapi yānyeva devanakṣatrāṇi | teṣu kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute | yatpuṇyaṃ nakṣatram | tadvaṭkurvītopavyupamityādiśruteśca devanakṣatrāṇi jyotiḥśāstravihitavivāhanakṣatrāvirodhīni praśastāni draṣṭavyāni | devasya savituriti prakṛtyasamānasyāhnaḥ pañca puṇyāni nakṣatrāṇīti śruteṣvantarāleṣu caturo'ślīlānkālānrātriṃ ca varjayitvā yatkartavyaṃ karma tatkartuṃ śīlaṃ yasya sa yatkārī sarvāṇi karmāṇi teṣveva kāleṣu kartavyānītyarthaḥ | sa puṇyāha eva praśasta eva dine kurute | tatra prāgudayādekā nāḍikordhvaṃ caikā prātarityucyate | prākprathamāhaścaturbhāgāntādekā nāḍikordhvaṃ caikā sa saṃgavaḥ | prāgdvitīyāhaścaturbhāgāntādekā nāḍikordhvaṃ caikā sa madhyaṃdinaḥ | prāktṛtīyāhaścaturbhāgāntādekā nāḍikordhvaṃ caikā so'parāhṇaḥ | prāgastamayādekā nāḍikordhvaṃ caikā sa sāyam | ayaṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ kālo na vivāhasyaiva | yatkārītivacanāddhorāṇāmevāyaṃ vikalpa iti vāśabdo jyotirjñānaprasiddhakālavikalpārthaḥ" iti vyākhyātavān | caturtho bhāgaścaturbhāgaḥ | ahnaścaturbhāgo'haścaturbhāgaḥ | prathamaścāsāvahaścaturbhāgaśca prathamāhaścaturbhāgaḥ | prathamāhaścaturbhāgasyāntaḥ prathamāhaścaturbhāgāntaḥ | tasmāt | ityevaṃ samāsaḥ | evamagre'pi | āpastambo vivāhaṃ prakṛtyā''ha -- "sarvāṇi puṇyoktāni nakṣatrāṇi" iti | yāni jyotiṣe puṇyoktāni śubhaphalapradatvenoktāni nakṣatrāṇi tāni grāhyāṇi | nakṣatragrahaṇasya pradarśanārthatvāttithyādīnyapi puṇyoktāni sarvāṇyupasaṃhartavyānīti sudarśanena vyākhyātam | āśvalāyano'pi -- "kalyāṇe nakṣatre" iti | chandogasūtre'pi -- "puṇyanakṣatre dārānkurvīta" iti | nakṣatragrahaṇāttithyādyapekṣayā nakṣatramāvaśyakamiti tadbhāṣyam | tānyuktāni kātyāyanena -- "triṣūttarādiṣu svātau mṛgaśirasi rohiṇyāṃ vā" iti | "uttarāphalgunīhastacitrā iti trīṇi | utarāṣāḍhāśravaṇadhaniṣṭhā iti trīṇi" uttarāproṣṭhapadārevatyaśvinya iti trīṇi iti hariharaḥ | pārijāte bṛhaspatirapi -- "saumyapaitṛkahastāśca maitramūlāśvivāsavāḥ | trīṇyuttarāṇi pauṣṇaṃ ca rohiṇī ca śubhapradāḥ || anyāśca sarvā varjyāḥ syustārāḥ pāṇigrahe sadā" iti | hemādrāvapi -- "hastottarāṇi vāyavyaṃ bhaitraṃ mūlaṃ ca revatī | rohiṇī saumyapitrye ca śubhaṃ pāṇigrahe sadā" iti | vasiṣṭho'pi -- "mūlottarāpaitṛkapauṣṇamaitraprājeśacandrārkasamīraṇeṣu | sadā praśastaḥ khalu kanyakānā pāṇigraho vedhavivarjiteṣu" iti | uttarottarātrayam | paitṛkaṃ maghāḥ | pauṣṇaṃ revatīnakṣatram | prājeśaṃ rohiṇī | candro mṛgaśiraḥ | arko hastaḥ | samīraṇaḥ svātī | āpastambabaudhāyanau -- "yāṃ kāmayeta duhitaraṃ priyā syāditi tāṃ niṣṭyāyāṃ dadyātpriyaiva bhavati neva tu punarāgacchatīti brāhmaṇāvekṣo vidhiḥ" iti | iyaṃ bhartuḥ priyā syāditi yāṃ duhitaraṃ pitā kāmayeta tāṃ niṣṭyāyāṃ svātau varāya dadyāt | sā tasya priyaiva bhavati | neva tu naiva ca rogadāridryādinā pīḍyamānā'pi na punaḥ pitṛgehamāgacchatīti svagṛha evāsyāḥ sarve'rthāḥ saṃpadyanta iti brāhmaṇāvekṣo vidhiḥ | atrāpi pūrvavatsmārtapuṇyoktanakṣatrairvikalpa iti sudarśanena vyākhyātam | invakāniṣṭyāśabdapravṛttinimittāmāhaturbodhāyanāpastambau -- "invakāśabdo mṛgaśirasi | niṣṭyāśabdaḥ svātau" iti | vāsarādi jyotirnibandhe -- "guruśukrenduputrāṇāṃ dineṣu pariṇīyate | yā kanyā sā bhavennityaṃ bhartuścittānuvartinī | arkārkibhaumavārāṇāṃ dineṣu kalahapriyā | sāpatnyaṃ samavāpnoti tuṣārakaravāsare | kṣīṇenduḥ phalanāśāya strīvināśāya bhārgavaḥ | jīvaḥ puruṣanāśāya yadi pāṇigraho bhavet" iti | jīvabhārgavāvapi kṣīṇau niṣiddhau parijñeyau | atra dinaṣvityabhidhānādrātrāvabhyanujñā gamyate | tathā ca smaranti -- "na vāradoṣāḥ prabhavanti rātrau" iti madanapārijāte | nirṇayāmṛte smṛtyantare -- "śanaiścaradine prāpte yadā riktā tithirbhavet | tasminvivāhitā kanyā patisaṃtativardhinī" iti | nṛsiṃhaḥ -- "budhaśukrendujīvānāṃ vāreṣu śubhadaṃ bhavet | śubhānāmaṃśakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vargādi ca vivāhake" iti || jyotirnibandhe gargaḥ -- "strīṇāṃ gurubalaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ raverbalam | tayoścandrabalaṃ śreṣṭhamiti gargeṇa bhāṣitam || janmatridaśamāristhaḥ pūjayā śubhado guruḥ | vivāhe'tha caturthāṣṭadvādaśastho mṛtipradaḥ" iti || jyotirnibandhe -- "vivāhe garbhasaṃskāre strīṇāṃ vidhubalaṃ bhavet | itaratra tu bhartuḥ syāditi vidvatprabhāṣitam" iti || muhūrtacintāmaṇāvapyevam | jyotiḥsāgare -- "kanyācāpe tathā siṃhe karke śukro yadā bhavet | na doṣaḥ ṣaṣṭhaśukrasya pāṇigrahe śubhāvahaḥ" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- "prāyeṇa sarvatra vilokayanti cāndraṃ balaṃ gocarato viśuddham | loke yataścandrabalaṃ pradhānaṃ śāstreṣu mukhyaṃ khalu lagnameva || ekatastu grahāḥ sarve ekataḥ śaśalāñchanaḥ | tato'dhikataraścandrastasmāccandraṃ parīkṣayet" iti || tatastasmāt | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "jhaṣacāpakulīrastho jīvo'pyaśubhagocaraḥ | atiśobhanatāṃ dadyādvivāhopanayādiṣu" iti || lallaḥ -- "dvādaśadaśamacaturthe janmani ṣaṣṭhāṣṭame tṛtīye ca | prāpte pāṇigrahaṇe jīve vaidhavyamāpnoti" iti || gargaḥ -- "sarvatrāpi śubhaṃ dadyādvādaśābdātparaṃ guruḥ | pañcaṣaṣṭhābdayoreva śubhagocaratā matā || saptamātpañcavarṣeṣu svoccasvarkṣagato yadi | aśubho'pi śubhaṃ dadyācchubhadarkṣeṣu kiṃ punaḥ || rajasvalāyāḥ kanyāyā guruśuddhiṃ na cintayet | aṣṭame'pi prakartavyo vivāhastriguṇārcanāt || arkagorbalaṃ gauryā rohiṇyarkabalā smṛtā | kanyā candrabalā proktā vṛṣalī lagnatobalā" iti || madanaratne gargaḥ -- "candratārābalaṃ mukhyaṃ daṃpatyoḥ pāṇipīḍane | mukhyaṃ gurubalaṃ vadhvā varasyeṣṭaṃ raverbalam" iti || vivāhe mukhyakāle tayorbalālābhe pūjā kāryā | "vivāhe balamāvaśyaṃ daṃpatyorgurusūryayoḥ | cetpūjāṃ yatnataḥ kuryāddurbalapradatā tayoḥ" | iti tatraiva nāradokteḥ | cedityasya durbaletyatrānvayaḥ | gurupūjāprakāraṃ tu śāntiratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyāmaḥ | raverapi pūjāṃ tatraiva | lallaḥ -- "bṛhaspatau śobhanagocarasthe vivāhamicchanti hi dākṣiṇātyāḥ | ravau śubhasthe pravadanti gauḍā na gocarā mālavake pramāṇam" iti || jyotirnibandhe vṛddhagārgyaḥ -- "mīne dhanuṣi siṃhe ca sthite saptaturaṃgame | kṣauramatra na kartavyaṃ vivāhaṃ gṛhakarma ca" iti || saptaturaṃgamaḥ sūryaḥ | jyotirgranthe -- "siṃhasthaṃ makarasthaṃ ca guruṃ yatnena varjayet | siṃhasthe'pi maghāsaṃsthaṃ guruṃ yatnena varjayet || anyatra siṃhabhāge tu vivāhādi vidhīyate" iti | lallaḥ -- "narmadāpūrvabhāge tu śoṇasyottaradakṣiṇe | gaṇḍakyāḥ paścime tīre makarastho na doṣabhāk" iti || parāśaraḥ -- "godābhāgīrathīmadhye nodvāhaḥ siṃhage gurau | maghāsthe sarvadeśeṣu tathā mīnagate ravau" iti || kālanirṇaye -- "śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ yātrāpratiṣṭhodvāhapūrvakam | na kuryātsarvamāṅgalyaṃ siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau" iti | māṇḍavyaḥ -- "iṣṭāpūrtaṃ ca caulādisaṃskārā vāstukarma ca | anyāni śubhakarmāṇi na kuryātsiṃhage gurau" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- "siṃhe gurau siṃhanavāṃśakordhvaṃ godāvarīdakṣiṇakūlajātaiḥ | udvāhakālātyayadoṣabhītaiḥ kāryo vivāhaścyavano bravīti" iti | jyotiḥsaṃgrahe -- "māgadhe gauḍadeśe ca sindhudeśe ca koṅkaṇe | vrataṃ cūḍāṃ vivāhaṃ ca varjayenmakare gurau" iti | makarasthatāyāṃ vivāhe viśeṣo devīpurāṇe -- "makarastho yadā jīvo varjayetpañcamāṃśakam | śeṣeṣvapi ca bhāgeṣu vivāhaḥ śobhano mataḥ" iti | evaṃ guroḥ siṃhasthatve'pi vivāhaviṣaye viśeṣamāha rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "siṃharāśau tu siṃhāṃśe yadā bhavati vākpatiḥ | sarvadeśeṣvayaṃ tyājyo daṃpatyornidhanapradaḥ" iti | siṃhāṃśa ityatra navāṃśakrameṇa siṃhāṃśo bodhyaḥ | ata eva -- "siṃhe'pi bhagadaivatye gurau putravatī bhavet" ityuktam | bhagadaivatyaṃ pūrve phalgunyau | bhagadaivatyaprathamapādasya siṃhāṃśatvena parityājyatvāttadvyatiriktaṃ bhagadaivatyaṃ grāhyam | tathā ca māṇḍavyaḥ -- "maghā(gha)ṛkṣaṃ parityajya yadā siṃhe gururbhavet | tatrābde kanyakā coḍhā subhagā supriyā bhavet" iti | atraitairvacanaiḥ siṃhasthagurau maghānakṣatraparityāgena yatpariṇayanaṃ pratipāditaṃ tanmāghyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tadvarṣe maghānakṣatrābhāve bodhyam | anyathā siṃhe gurau pariṇītetivakṣyamāṇavacanena virodhaḥ syāditi | tathā ca jyautiṣe -- "gurau haristhe na vivāhamāhurhārītagargapramukhā munīndrāḥ | maghāyutā syādyadi naiva māghī tadā ca kanyodvahanaṃ vadanti" iti || tathā -- "māghyāṃ yadā maghā na syuḥ siṃhe gururakāraṇam" iti | akāraṇaṃ vivāhe'niṣedhaka ityarthaḥ | ata eva -- "siṃhe gurau pariṇītā patimātmānamātmajānhanti | kramaśasttriṣu pitrādiṣu vasiṣṭhagargādayaḥ prāhuḥ" ityādi rājamārtaṇḍādau maghādinakṣatratraye'pi vivāhe prokto doṣo'viruddhatayāsaṃgacchata iti vibhāvanīyam | atra ca godāvaryuttaratīramārabhya bhāgīrathīdakṣiṇakulaṃ maryādīkṛtya yo godāvarībhāgīrathyorantarālavartī deśastatraiva siṃhastho gururvarjya ityāha lallaḥ -- "godāvaryuttarato yāvadbhāgīrathyāsta(thīta)ṭaṃ yāmyam | tatra vivāho neṣṭaḥ siṃhasthe devapatipūjye" iti || arthādgodāvarīdakṣiṇataṭe bhāgīrathyuttaradeśe ca vivāhe siṃhasthagurudoṣo nāstīti | tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "bhāgīrathyuttare kūle gautamyā dakṣiṇe tathā | vivāho vratabandho vā siṃhasthejye na duṣyati" iti || kūlaṃ tīram | ijyo guruḥ | evaṃ meṣasthe sūrye siṃhasthagurudoṣo nāstīti dākṣiṇātyasaṃgrahe jyotirnibandhe paṭhanti -- "maṅgalānīha kurvanti siṃhastho vākpatiryadā | bhānau meṣagate samyagityāhuḥ śaunakādayaḥ" iti || tathā nāradena deśabhedena samasaptakadoṣo'pi vivāha uktaḥ -- "samadṛṣṭiguroḥ śukrastanmāse tu prayatnataḥ | vivāhādi na kurvīta narmadātīra uttare" iti || śaunakaḥ -- "ekarāśigatau sūryajīvau syātāṃ yadā punaḥ | vratabandhavivāhādi śubhakarmākhilaṃ tyajet" iti || etaccaikanakṣatrāvacchedenaikarāśigatatve bodhyam | "ekarāśigatau syātāmekarkṣaviṣaye yadi | gurvādityau tadā tyājyā yajñodvāhādikāḥ kriyāḥ" itivacanaikavākyatvāt | ata eva -- "gurvāditye daśāhe tu vratodvāhādi varjayet" ityanena yatkarmavarjanamuktaṃ tadbhinnanakṣatraviṣayaṃ bodhyamiti | yadi caikarkṣaghaṭitaviśeṣavacanasahakāreṇa munyantaroktasāmānyavacanasyāpyekasyaiva niṣedhavidheḥ kalpanālāghavāttadekavākyatvānurodhena viśeṣavidhiparatvaṃ kalpyate tadā vibhinnanakṣatraviṣaye tayorekarāśisthatvaṃ bodhyamiti navīnāḥ | vātsyaḥ -- "gurubhārgavayormauḍhye bālye vai vārdhake'pi ca | vratodvāhapratiṣṭhādi śubhaṃ karma vivarjayet" iti || jyotirvasiṣṭhaḥ -- "yātrodvāhau pratiṣṭhāṃ ca gṛhacūḍāvratādikam | varjayedyatnataścaiva jīve vakrāticārage" iti || kṛtyacintāmaṇau -- "tathā malimluce māsi surācārye'ticārage | vāpīkūpataḍāgādikriyāḥ prāguditāstyajet || aticāragate jīve vakre caiva bṛhaspatau | kāminī vidhavā proktā tasmāttau parivarjayet" iti || tatraiva -- "aticāragato jīvaḥ pūrvabhaṃ naiva gacchati | samacāre'pi karmāṇi naiva tatraiva saṃsthite" iti || tathā -- "aticāragato jīvastaṃ rāśiṃ naiti cedyadi | luptaḥ saṃvatsaro jñeyo garhitaḥ sarvakarmasu" iti || pūrvarāśiśeṣamatikramya rāśyantarasaṃcāro'ticārastaṃ prāpto guruḥ punastaṃ rāśiṃ yadi naiti tadā luptaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ sarvakarmasu garhito jñeya ityarthaḥ | asya sarvarāśisādhāraṇyena prāptau kvacidapavādamāha cyavanaḥ -- "yadi bhavedaticāragato gururna punareti nijaprathamasthitim | bhavati luptasamā jhaṣakumbhayorvṛṣabhavṛścikayoryadi na sthitaḥ" iti | madanaratne'pi -- "yadā'ticāraṃ hi guruḥ karoti kumbhālisaṃstho vṛṣamīnasaṃsthaḥ | nā''yātyasau yadyapi pūrvarāśiṃ śubhāya pāṇigrahaṇaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ" iti | daśamāsabhogānantaramekādaśamāsabhogānantaraṃ vetareṣvapyaticāre luptābdadoṣo nāsti | taduktaṃ cyavanena -- "māsāndaśaikādaśa vā prabhujya rāśeryadā rāśimupaiti jīvaḥ | bhuṅkte na pūrvaṃ ca punastathā'pi na luptasaṃvatsaramāhurāryāḥ" iti || ayaṃ ca luptābdadoṣo deśabhedenaivātrimatena | tathā ca smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "luptābdadoṣo'trimatena madhye somodbhavāyāḥ suranimnagāyāḥ" iti | somodbhavā narmadā | suranimnagā gaṅgā | vakrāticārayorapavādamāha rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "vakrāticārage jīve varjayettadanantaram | vratodvāhādicūḍāyāmaṣṭāviṃśativāsarān" iti || vakrāticārayoraṣṭāviṃśativāsaravarjanamatyantasaṃkaṭaviṣayakaṃ bodhyam | "prāgrāśigatajīvasya cāticārasttripakṣakaḥ" ityanena gurostādṛśāticāre pakṣatrayaparyantameva tatkarmavarjanasyoktatvāt | hārītaḥ -- "aticāragate jīve vṛṣe'lau mīnakumbhayoḥ | yajñodvāhādikaṃ kuryāttatra kālo na lupyate" iti || dīpikāyām -- "trikoṇajāyādhanalābharāśau vakrāticāreṇa guruḥ prayātaḥ | yadā tadā prāha śubhe vilagne hitāya pāṇigrahaṇaṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ" iti || trikoṇetyādikamarthātpāṇigrahītureva | trikoṇaṃ navamaḥ pañcamaśca rāśiḥ | jāyā saptamarāśiḥ | dhanaṃ dvitīyo rāśiḥ | lābha ekādaśo rāśiḥ | tatretyarthaḥ | trayodaśadinapakṣaniṣedhamāha vyāsaḥ -- "trayodaśadine pakṣe vivāhādi na kārayet | gargādimunayaḥ prāhuḥ kṛte mṛtyustadā bhavet" iti || ādiśabdenopayanādi | vivāhe daṃpatyoḥ, ādipadopātta upanayana upanetuḥ, caule śiśoḥ, ityādi draṣṭavyam | kṣayapakṣaḥ kadā patatītyapekṣāyāṃ madanaratne -- "pakṣasya madhye dvitithī ite yadā tadā bhavedrauravakālayogaḥ | pakṣe vinaṣṭe sakalaṃ vinaṣṭamityāhurācāryavarāḥ samastāḥ || trayodaśadine pakṣe nūnaṃ saṃharate jagat | api varṣasahasreṇa kālayogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ" iti || ite gate | 'pakṣasya madhye dvitithī patetāṃ tadā bhavedrauravakālayogaḥ' ityevamapi kutracitpāṭhaḥ | patetāṃ kṣayaṃ gacchata ityarthaḥ | kṣayamāsaniṣedho dīpikāyām -- "kāmyādiṣvakhileṣu karmasu parityājyau kṣayākhyottarāsaṃkrāntī" iti | pañcakaniṣedho vyavasthā ca jyotirnibandhe -- "gatatithyā yutaṃ lagnaṃ navabhaktāvaśeṣakam | tripañcādrikhasaṃkhyaṃ cetpañcakaṃ na tadā bhavet || ekāvaśeṣe mṛtyuḥ syāddvayorvahniḥ prakīrtitaḥ | caturṣu tu bhavedrājā ṣaṭsu coraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || rogo'ṣṭasu samākhyātaḥ śeṣaṃ niṣpañcakaṃ smṛtam | mṛtyuṃ vivāhavicchukrasaṃdhyāsu parivarjayet || vahniṃ parityajedbhaumagṛhārambhadineṣu tu | rājānaṃ svāmisevendumandadyuṣu parityajet || dharājaguruyātrāsu coraṃ tu parivarjayet | rogaṃ parityajedarke rātrau mauñjīnibandhane || mṛtyuḥ sarvatra varjyaḥ syāditi kecinmanīṣiṇaḥ | vartamānā tithirlagnaṃ harmyayātrāvrateṣu tu || anyatretā tithirlagnaṃ meṣādīnyapi kecana | baliṣṭhaṃ yadi lagnaṃ syāttadaitaddoṣakṛnna hi" iti || etatpañcakam | (balaṃ tu laghujātake -- ) "adhipayuto dṛṣṭo vā budhajīvanirīkṣitaśca yo rāśiḥ | sa bhavati balavānyadā yukto dṛṣṭo'pi vā śeṣaiḥ" iti | atha vistareṇa candrasūryayorgrahaṇaśuddhiḥ kampādiprayuktā śuddhiśca vicāryate | tatra graste'ste grahaṇātpūrvaṃ dinatrayaṃ varjyam | graste'bhyudite tu grahaṇātparato dinatrayaṃ varjyam | grastāstagrastodayayorabhāve'pi candrasūryayoḥ khaṇḍagrāse pūrvaṃ tridinaṃ paścāttridinaṃ ca militvaikaikasminsthale ṣaḍdināni varjyāni | etasminneva viṣaye saṃpūrṇagrāse tu pūrvaṃ sapta dināni parastācca sapta dinānīti militvā caturdaśa dināni varjyāni | tathā ca jyotiḥsaṃgrahe bṛhaspatiḥ -- "grastāste tridinaṃ pūrvaṃ paścādgastodaye tathā | khaṇḍagrāse tritridinaṃ niḥśeṣe sapta sapta ca" iti | tatheti tridinamityarthaḥ | tathā kaśyapaḥ -- "grastodaye paro doṣo grastāste'rvākśaśīnayoḥ | dyuniśārdhe tūbhayaṃ tatkhaṇḍākhaṇḍavyavasthayā" iti | dyuniśārdha ityanena divākhaṇḍe niśākhaṇḍe ca sūryasya candrasya ca grastāstābhyudayayorasaṃbhavenaiva tayorabhāvaḥ sūcita iti | ubhayaṃ tadityādi | dineṣu khaṇḍagrāsa ekaikasminsthale pūrvatra paratrāpi dinatraye dinatraye doṣaḥ, saṃpūrṇagrāse tu pūrvaṃ parastācca saptadineṣu saptadineṣu doṣa ityubhayaṃ tadityetadartho bodhyaḥ, bṛhaspativacanaikavākyatvāt | ata eva -- "candrasūryoparāgeṣu tryahaṃ prāktu śubhaṃ tyajet | saptāhamaśubhaṃ paścātsmṛtaṃ grahaṇasūtakam" | iti vacanena yatpūrvaṃ tryahe śubhavarjanamuktaṃ tatsaṃkaṭaviṣayakaṃ sarvagrāsaviṣayakaṃ ca bodhyam | paratra saptarātrotkīrtanāt | śaktiviṣaye pūrvārdhaṃ khaṇḍagrāsaviṣayakam | tadviṣaya eva pūrṇagrāsaviṣayakaṃ parārdhamiti | tryahaṃ prāgaśubhaṃ tyajeditipāṭhe prāktryahamaśubhaṃ bhavati tasminnaśubhe tryahe tyajet | kimityākāṅkṣāyāṃ yogyatayā śubhamiti śeṣaḥ | tryahaṃ prāktu śubhaṃ tyajeditipāṭhe tvagrimamaśubhapadaṃ tryahamityatrāpyanveti | śubhapadaṃ tvastyeveti jñeyam | atra ca karmabhedena śaktabhedena ca dinamaryādāmāha bhojarājaḥ -- "aniṣṭe trividhotpāte siṃhikāsūnudarśane | saptarātraṃ na kurvīta yātrodvāhādi maṅgalam || ekarātraṃ parityajya kuryātpāṇigrahaṃ grahe | prayāṇe saptarātraṃ tu trirātraṃ vratabandhane" iti || trividheti | divyabhaumanābhasetyarthaḥ | ayaṃ cotpātādau saptarātraniṣedhaḥ sa kṣattriyavaiśyaviṣayakaḥ | tathā ca bhṛguḥ -- "kampādau kṣattre vaiśye ca saptāhaṃ brāhmaṇe tryaham | śūdre tvardhadinaṃ proktaṃ sarvakāryeṣu vai bhṛguḥ" iti || aniṣṭa itikīrtanācchubhotpāte saptarātraṃ na kiṃ tu tatraikarātram, śubhotpātapraduṣṭaṃ dinamitivacanāt | tatra śubhotpāto yathā varāhasaṃhitāyām -- "caṇḍāśanimahīkampasaṃdhyānirghātanisvanāḥ | pariveṣarajodhūmaraktārkāstamayodayāḥ || drumebhyo'nurasasnehamadhupuṣpaphalodgamāḥ | gopakṣimadavṛddhiśca śubhāya madhumādhave" ityādayaḥ || grahe candrasūryagrahaṇe | atra saptarātraṃ sarvagrāse saṃkaṭaviṣayakaṃ bodhyam | aṅgirāśca grāsabhedena varjyadinamāha -- "sarvagrāse tu saptāhamardhagrāse dinatrayam | tridvyekāṅgulato grāse dinamekaṃ vivarjayet" iti | vasiṣṭhaḥ punarāha -- "sarvagrāse dinānyaṣṭau sarvakāryeṣu varjayet |
