ṣaḍdināni tribhāgone ardhagrāse caturdinam || caturthāṃśe trirātraṃ syādgrahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ" iti | kāryasyā''vaśyakatve tu rāhudūṣitasthale varjyadinamuhūrtā uktā munimatabhedena jyotirnibandhe -- "pañca dināni vasiṣṭhastridinaṃ gargaśca kauśikastvekam | yavanācāryasya muhūrtaṃ pañca muhūrtāni dūṣayati rāhuḥ" iti | atra grahakāle bhūkampādisamāhāre'dhikadināni varjyānyāha bhojarājaḥ -- "grahe ravīndvoravaniprakampe ketūdgamolkāpatanādidoṣe | vrate daśāhāni vadanti tajjñāstrayodaśāhāni vadanti kecit"iti | vrata ityupalakṣaṇaṃ vivāhādīnām | atra grahaṇasamaye bhūkampādīnāṃ bhūyasāṃ samāhāre trayodaśāhamaśuddhaṃ, tadalpasamāhāre daśāhamiti bodhyam | gargaḥ -- "digdāhe dinamekaṃ tu grahe sapta dināni ca | bhūkampe ca samudbhūte tryahāṇi parivarjayet || ulkāpāte ca tridinaṃ dhūme pañca dināni ca | vajrapāte dinaṃ tvekaṃ varjayetsarvakarmasu" iti || atra cāniṣṭe trividhotpāta ityanena sapta dināni vānyuktāni | gargeṇa tu digdāhotpātavajrapātayorekadinavarjanamuktam | yatra ca pūrvaṃ matabhedena nyūnādhikamuktaṃ tatra virodhastu tattatkarmaṇāṃ sāpekṣanirapekṣatvena pariharaṇīyaḥ | tathā ca rājamārtaṇḍaḥ -- "uktāni pratiṣiddhāni punaḥ saṃbhāvitāni ca | sāpekṣanirapekṣāṇi mīmāṃsyānīha kovidaiḥ" iti | asyārthaḥ -- uktāni sāmānyavidhinā tatkāle kartavyatvena pratipāditāni tānyeva karmāṇi viśeṣato niṣedhavidhinā kāleyattādinā niṣiddhāni | atha punarapi tānyeva tatkālanyūnakāleyattādinā saṃbhāvitāni kartavyatvena pradipāditāni | sāpekṣetyādi | sāpekṣāṇi nirapekṣāṇi kālāntarāpekṣāviśiṣṭāni kālāntarāpekṣāśūnyānītyarthaḥ | apekṣā cātra kālāntarakartavyayogyatāniścayaḥ | so'pi svasāmarthyādhīnaḥ | sāmarthyamapyatra kālāntaratattatkarmau payogikasāmagrīsamavadhānakartṛyogyatābalavadvighnopasthityabhāvayoranyatararūpaṃ paryavasannam | mīmāṃsyāni vicāraṇīyāni, kālāntarakartavyatvayogyatāniścayaviṣayatvarūpasāpekṣatvena tādṛśābhāvarūpanirapekṣatvena ca vicāraṇīyānīti yāvat | tathā ca yadi kartavyakarmaṇāṃ sāpekṣatvena jñānaṃ tadā'dhikaviṣayaniṣiddhetarasmindine teṣāmanuṣṭhānaṃ, yadi ca nirapekṣatvena jñānaṃ tadā svalpaviṣayaniṣiddhetarasmin | atha ca vyāpakaniṣiddhamadhye'nuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | tathāhi -- "udagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe kalyāṇe nakṣatre caulakarmopanayanagodānavivāhāḥ | ityādyāśvalāyanagṛhyādyuktopanayanādikarmaṇāṃ yathāvidhivihitottarāyaṇe kvacidapi divase trividhotpātādyanyatamatve'pi tathāvidhasāmānyataḥ prāptau pūrvoktena "aniṣṭe trividhotpāte siṃhikāsūnudarśane" ityādinā vacanena tattatkarmaṇāṃ saptadinaparyantaṃ niṣedhamuktvā punaḥ "ekarātraṃ parityajya" ityādivākyāntareṇa muninā vivāhopanayanayorekarātratrirātraniṣedhamukhenaikarātrādyatiriktadinānāṃ saptāhābhyantaravartināmapyabhyanujñānaṃ kṛtaṃ sāpekṣatvanirapekṣatvavicāreṇaiveti | evamanyatrāpyūhyamiti dik | adbhutasāgara etadapavādaḥ -- "atha divasatrayamadhye mṛdu pānīyaṃ yadā bhavati | utpātadoṣaśamanaṃ tadaiva śaṃ prāhurā[cā]ryāḥ" iti | saṃbandhatattve -- "bhūkampāderna doṣo'sti vṛddhiśrāddhe kṛte sati" iti | deśabhedena vivāhādiṣu holikāṣṭadinavarjanamapyuktaṃ jyotirnibandhe -- "irāvatyā vipāśāyāḥ śatadvāstīrabhūmiṣu | tathā tripuṣkare deśe vivāhādiṣu varjayet | holikāprāgdinānyaṣṭau śubhārthaṃ matimāñjanaḥ" iti | irāvatyādinadyaśca paścimadeśe prasiddhāḥ | holikā phālgunapūrṇimā, tataḥ prāgdināṣṭakaṃ varjayedityarthaḥ | tathā'rvācīnagranthasthaṃ padyamapi -- "vipāśerāvatītīre śatadrvāśca tripuṣkare | vivāhādi śubhaṃ neṣṭaṃ holikāprāgdināṣṭakam" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- " cūḍāvratavivāhādi gṛhārambhapraveśanam | janārdane prasupte tu na prakurvīta sarvathā" iti || (kālāmṛtasaṃgrahe -- abdeṣu kṣayavatsaro na śubhakṛtpakṣo'bdasaṃdhau tathā pañcāhāni tu māsayordivasayornakṣatrayoryogayoḥ || yāmārdhaṃ ghaṭikādvayaṃ karaṇayorlagnadvaye nāḍike saṃdhyāyāṃ ghaṭikātrayaṃ tu ghaṭike tyājye tu saṃdhau niśaḥ ||) sarvatrāmṛtasiddhiyogasya grāhyatāyāṃ vivāhādiṣu kasyacinniṣedha ukto jyotirnibandhe -- "vivāhe gurupuṣyau ca prayāṇe śanirohiṇī | bhaumāśvinyau praveśe ca ṣaṇmāsānmaraṇaṃ dhruvam" iti || jyotiṣprakāśe -- "arvākṣoḍaśa nāḍyaḥ saṃkrānteḥ puṇyadāḥ parataḥ | upanayanavratayātrāpariṇayanādau vivarjyāstāḥ" iti || atra vrataśabdena vedavratam | ādiśabdena sarvaṃ śubhakarma gṛhyate | nāradaḥ -- "bhū1bāṇa5nava9hastā2śca rasa6dikha10hni3parvatāḥ7 | vedā4 vasu8śivā11dityā12 ghātacandro yathākramam || yātrāyāṃ yuddhakāryeṣu ghātacandraṃ vivarjayet | vivāhe sarvamāṅgalye caulādau vratabandhane || ghātacandro naiva cintya iti pārāśaro'bravīt" iti | vivāhabhedāḥ | atha vivāhabhedāḥ saviśeṣā ucyante | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "bandhuśīlaśrutārogyāṇi buddhvā prajāṃ sahatvakarmabhyaḥ pratipādayedbrāhme vivāhe śaktiviṣayeṇālaṃkṛtya dadyādārṣe duhitṛmate mithunau gāvau deyau deve yajñatanttra ṛtvije pratipādayenmithaḥ kāmānsāṃ(tsāṃ)varteta sa gāndharvo yathāśakti dravyāṇi dattvā vaheransa āsuro duhitṛmataḥ prothayitvā vaheransa rākṣasaḥ" iti | brahmaṇā sṛṣṭo brāhmastasminvivāhe varasya bandhvādīnvuddhvā parīkṣya prajāṃ duhitaraṃ sahatvakarmabhyaḥ saha kartavyāni yāni karmāṇi tebhyastāni kartuṃ pratipādayet | śaktivipayeṇeti vibhaktipratirūpako'yaṃ nipāto yathāśaktītyasyārthe draṣṭavyaḥ | yathāśaktyalaṃkṛtya dadyādityeṣa brāhmo vivāhaḥ | prajāsahatvakarmabhya itipāṭhe prajārthaṃ sahatvakarmārthaṃ ceti | ṛṣibhirdṛṣṭe vivāhe mithunau gāvau deyau strīgauḥ puṃgauśca duhitṛmate deyau, eṣa ārṣo vivāhaḥ | devairdṛṣṭe vivāhe yajñatantre vitata ṛtvije karma kurvate kanyāṃ dadyādeṣa daivo vivāhaḥ | yatra kanyāvarau mitho rahasi kāmādrāgātparasparaṃ sāṃvarteta mithunī bhavataḥ sa gāndharvo vivāhaḥ | samo dīrghaśchāndasaḥ | atra saṃyogāduttarakālaṃ vivāhasaṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ | yatra vivāhe kanyāvate yathāśakti dravyāṇi dattvā vaherankanyāṃ sa āsuro vivāhaḥ | kanyāyai gṛhakṣetrādidānena vivāho nā''suraḥ | pramathya yatra vaheransa rākṣaso vivāhaḥ | "hatvā bhittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatīṃ rudadbhyo haretsa rākṣasaḥ" ityāśvalāyanaḥ | atrāpi vivāhasaṃskāraḥ | dvau cāparau vivāhau śāstrāntareṣūktau | tatrā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "saha dharmaṃ carata iti prājāpatyaḥ suptānāṃ pramattānāṃ vā'paharetsa paiśācaḥ" iti | tāviha pṛthaṅnoktau brāhmarākṣasayorantarbhāvāditi vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | bandhuśīletyārabhya pratipādayedityantaṃ brāhmārṣadaivavivāheṣu niyatamāsure tvaniyataṃ tasyecchādhīnatvāt | itareṣu tu naitat | pratipādanābhāvena parīkṣāyā apyabhāvāt | alaṃkṛtya dadyādityatra dadātiḥ pratipādanārtha eva | pūrvatra pratipādayedityasyaivopakrāntatvāt | duhitṛmate mithunagodānaṃ vivāhahomānantaram | tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ -- "pūrvaṃ lājāhutiṃ hutvā gomithunaṃ kanyāvate dadyāt" iti | daive yajña ṛtvije pratipādayedityetāvataiva siddhau tantragrahaṇasvarasānmahataḥ saumikakarmaṇa evātra grahaṇaṃ naiṣṭhikapāśukayoriti | pratipādayeditivacanādṛtvija ityekasmā eva pratipādanācca neyaṃ tantrasaṃbandhidakṣiṇā | ṛtvija ityatrāsagotrāsapiṇḍo yaḥ kaścanartviksaṃpradānatvena jñeyaḥ | etacca pratipādanaṃ pradhānadakṣiṇādānānantaram | tathā ca baudhāyanaḥ -- "dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsvantarvedyṛtvije dadyāt" iti | atra pratigrahe mantraviśeṣa ukto baudhāyanena -- "atha yadi dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha dattā syāttāṃ pratigṛhṇīyātprajāpatiḥ striyāmiti ṣaḍbhiranucchandasam" iti | dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha datteti vacanamapi kanyāpratipādanasya yāgadakṣiṇātvaṃ netyatra liṅgam | ayaṃ ca pratigrahamantraviśeṣo'smākamapyaviruddhaḥ | na ca tāntrīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ darśayatītisūtravirodha iti vācyam | etasya pratigrahamantraviśeṣasya dakṣiṇāpratigrahaprakaraṇe sūtrakāreṇāpaṭhitasya tāntrīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ darśayatītisūtraviṣayakatvāsaṃbhavena virodhābhāvāt | dīkṣito na dadātīti niṣedho yajñatantre kanyāpratipādane na pravartate vidhānabalāt | pratipādanaṃ tu kṛtsnena kanyādānoktavidhinā kāryam | kanyāpratipādanāṅgabhūtahiraṇyādidānasya tu dadātivihitatvānniṣedho'styeva | (puṇyāhavācanādikaṃ kanyāvaraṇaṃ vāgdānaṃ madhuparkaśca nivartate |) eteṣāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ viśve devā ṛṣayaḥ prajāpatyādayo devatā ādyāḥ pañcānuṣṭubha āpastatsatyamābharanniti gāyatrī kanyāpratigrahe viniyoga ityṛṣyādi draṣṭavyam | āśvalāyanena tvaṣṭau bhedā uktāḥ | ādyānāṃ caturṇāṃ phalaviśeṣaścoktāḥ -- "alaṃkṛtya kanyāmudakapūrvā dadyādeṣa brāhmo vivāhastasyāṃ jāto dvādaśāvarāndvādaśa parānpunātyubhayata ṛtvije vitate karmaṇi dadyādalaṃkṛtya sa daivo daśāvarāndaśa parānpunātyubhayataḥ saha dharmaṃ carata iti prājāpatyo'ṣṭāvarānaṣṭa parānpunātyubhayato gomithunaṃ dattvopayaccheta sa ārṣaḥ saptāvarānsapta parānpunātyubhayato mithaḥ samayaṃ kṛtvopayaccheta sa gāndharvo dhanenopatoṣyopayaccheta sa āsuraḥ suptānāṃ pramattānāṃ vā'paharetsa paiśāco hatvā bhittvā ca śīrṣāṇi rudatīṃ rudadbhyo haretsa rākṣasaḥ" iti | tatrā''dyāstrayaḥ praśastāḥ | uktaṃ ca dharmasūtre -- "teṣāṃ traya ādyāḥ praśastā yathā yukto vivāhastathā yuktāḥ prajā bhavanti" iti | teṣvapi pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ śreyānuttareṣūttaraḥ pāpīyāniti | āpastambo'pi -- "pūrvaḥ pūrvo'tiśayena praśastaḥ" iti | varṇānupūrvyeṇa vivāhaniyama uktaḥ smṛtyantare -- "catvāro brāhmaṇasyā''dyāḥ śastā gāndharvarākṣasau | rājñastathā''suro vaiśye śūdre cāntyastu garhitaḥ " iti || antyaḥ paiśācaḥ | garhito na kasyāpi praśasta ityarthaḥ | etatsarvaṃ baudhāyano'pyāha -- "aṣṭau vivāhāḥ śrutaśīle vijñāya brahmacāriṇe'rthine dadāti sa brāhma ācchādyālaṃkṛtyainayā saha dharmaścaryatāmiti prājāpatyaḥ pūrvaṃ lājāhutiṃ hutvā gomithunaṃ kanyāvate dadyātsa ārṣo dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsvantarvedyṛtvije sa daivaḥ sakāmena sakāmāyāṃ mithaḥ saṃgamātsa gāndharvo dhanenopatoṣyā''suraḥ prasahya haraṇādrākṣasaḥ suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vopayacchediti sa paiśācasteṣāṃ catvāraḥ pūrve brāhmaṇasya teṣvapi pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ śreyānuttareṣāmuttaraḥ pāpīyānatrāpi ṣaṣṭhasaptamau kṣattriyadharmānugatau tatpratyayatvātkṣattriyasya pañcamāṣṭamau vaiśyaśūdrāṇāmayantritakalatrā hi vaiśyaśūdrā bhavanti karṣaṇaśuśrūṣādhikṛtatvādgāndharvamapyeke praśaṃsanti sarveṣāṃ snehānugatatvādyathā yuktovivāhastathā yuktāḥ prajā bhavantīti vijñāyate" iti | tatpratyayatvāttadadhīnatvāt | ayantritakalatrā aniyatakalatrā vidhivirahi taparigṛhītakalatrā iti yāvat | hirapyarthe | karṣaṇādhikṛtā vaiśyāḥ śuśrūṣādhikṛtāḥ śūdrāḥ | paiśācasyāntyatvaṃ tu manuvākyasiddham | anyavivāhāsaṃbhave brāhmaṇādīnāṃ paiśācamapyanujānāti vatsaḥ -- "sarvopāyairasādhyā syātsukanyā puruṣasya yā | cauryeṇāpi vivāhena sā vivāhyā rahaḥsthitā" iti || yattuḥ -- "āsuravadārṣo'pi pāpīyānkrayakrītatvāviśeṣāt | ata eva kaśyapaḥ -- "krayakrītā tu yā nārī na sā patnyabhidhīyate | na sā daive na sā pitrye dāsīṃ tāṃ kavayo viduḥ" iti || yamo'pi -- "kanyāvikrayiṇo mūrkhā rahaḥkilviṣakāriṇaḥ | patanti narake ghore dahantyāsaptamaṃ kulam" iti || etaccā''tmārthaṃ dhanagrahaṇe | kanyārthe tu na doṣaḥ | yathā''ha manuḥ -- "yāsāṃ nā''dadate śulkaṃ jñātayo na sa vikrayaḥ | arhaṇaṃ tatkumārīṇāmānṛśaṃsyaṃ tu kevalam" iti || ānṛśaṃsyamapāpitvam | manuḥ -- "brāhmo daivastathaivā''ṣaḥ prājāpatyastathā''suraḥ | gāndharvo rākṣasaścaiva paiśācaścāṣṭamo'dhamaḥ" || ityaṣṭau bhedānuktvā teṣāṃ lakṣaṇānyabhidhāya teṣvārṣasya krayakrītatvādadharmyatvamityabhipretyā''ha -- "pañcānāṃ tu trayo dharmyā dvāvadharmyau smṛtāviha | paiśācaścā''suraścaiva na kartavyau kathaṃcana" iti || brāhmādīnāmāsurāntānāṃ madhye brāhmadaivaprājāpatyāstrayo dharmyāḥ krayābhāvāt | ārṣāsurau dvāvadharmyau krayakrītatvāttayorapyāsuraḥ paiśācavadāpadyapi na kartavyaḥ" iti | tanna | pañcānā mitivacanasya matāntaropanyāsaparatvāt | kuta etat | yataḥ svayamevottaratra gomithunasya śulkatvaṃ matāntareṇānūdya niṣedhati -- "ārṣe gomithunaṃ śulkaṃ kecidāhurmṛṣaiva tat | alpo vā'pi mahānvā'pi kriyate tāvataiva saḥ" iti | gomithunaṃ śulkamiti yatkecidāhustanmṛṣaiva | nahi tasya śulkatvaṃ saṃbhavati | śulkaṃ mūlyamiti paryāyau | krayasādhanaṃ hi mūlyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā'lpaṃ vā mahadvā bhavati | prakṛte tu parimāṇaṃ niyatam | ataḥ sa ārṣastāvataiva gomithunenaiva saṃpadyate na tvanyathā'taḥ krayavikrayatvābhāvāddharmya evā''rṣaḥ | ata eva devalaḥ -- "pūrve vivāhāścatvāro dharmyāstoyapradānikāḥ | aśulkā brāhmaṇārhāśca tārayanti dvayoḥ kulam" iti || ārṣavivāhe nakṣatramāhā''pastambaḥ -- "maghābhirgāvo gṛhyante" iti | ārṣe duhitṛmate mithunau gāvau deyāviti vacanādārṣe vivāhe vareṇa dīyamānau gāvau duhitṛmadbhirmaghāsu gṛhyante | etaduktaṃ bhavati | ārṣavivāhaṃ maghāsveva kuryāt, na brāhmādivannakṣatrāntare'pīti | phalgunībhyāṃ vyū(vyu)hyata iti, tatra vadhūḥ phalgunyoreva vyū(vyu)hyate nīyate svagṛhānnatu tāṃ tata iti vacanādbrāhmādivattadānīmeveti sudarśanena vyākhyātam | durvivāhe bhojanādiniṣedhastatprāyaścittaṃ coktaṃ pārijāte -- "adharmyeṣu vivāheṣu bhojanaṃ cānumodanam | tāmbūlaṃ vāhanaṃ caiva varjayetsarvathā dvijaḥ || āsure tūpavāsaḥ syādgāndharve ca trirātrakam | rākṣase caiva paiśāce careccāndrāyaṇaṃ tathā" iti || pratikūlanirṇayaḥ | atha pratikūlanirṇayaḥ smṛtyantare -- "vadhūvarārthe ghaṭite suniścite varasya gehe'pyatha kanyakāyāḥ | mriyeta kaścinmanujo'tha nārī tadā na kuryuḥ khalu maṇḍanaṃ te" iti || ghaṭitaṃ saṃbandhaḥ suniścito vācā niścitaḥ | vāgdānavidhinā niścita iti govindārṇave | idaṃ ca suśabdāllabhyate | jyotiḥsāgare -- "vāṅniścaye kṛte paścātpitarau nidhanaṃ gatau | tayostatpratikūlaṃ syānnānyeṣāṃ tu kadācana" iti || vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ -- "varavadhvoḥ pitā mātā pitṛvyaśca sahodaraḥ | eteṣāṃ pratikūlaṃ syānmahāvighnapradaṃ bhavet || pitā pitāmahaścaiva mātā caiva pitāmahī | pitṛvyaḥ strī suto bhrātā bhaginī cāvivāhitā || ebhireva vipannaiśca pratikūlaṃ budhaiḥ smṛtam | anyairapi vipannaistu kecidūcurna tadbhavet" iti || (cakārātprapitāmahaḥ | dvitīyacakāraḥ prapitāmahīsamuccayārthaḥ |) māṇḍavyaḥ -- "vāgdānānantaraṃ mātā pitā bhrātā vipadyate | vivāho naiva kartavyaḥ svavaṃśahitamicchatā" iti || tena tayā vā saheti śeṣaḥ | varapakṣe pratikūle varārthaṃ tāṃ na svī kuryāt | vadhūpakṣe pratikūle tasmai varāya na dadyāditi vivāho naiva kartavya ityasyārthaḥ | na tu vivāha eva na kartavya iti | saṃkaṭe pravṛttiprakāramāha medhātithiḥ -- "vāgdānānantaraṃ yatra kulayoḥ kasyacinmṛtiḥ | tadā saṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ vivāhaḥ śubhado bhavet || puruṣatrayaparyantaṃ pratikūlaṃ svagotriṇām | praveśanirgamau tadvattathā muṇḍanamaṇḍane || pretakarmāṇyanirvartya carennābhyudayakriyām | ācaturthaṃ tataḥ puṃsi pañcame śubhadaṃ bhavet" iti || smṛtiratnāvalyām -- "piturabdamihā''śaucaṃ tadardhaṃ mātureva ca | māsatrayaṃ tu bhāryāyāstadardhaṃ bhrātṛpūtrayoḥ || anyeṣāṃ tu sapiṇḍānāmāśaucaṃ māsasaṃmitam | tadante śāntikaṃ kṛtvā tato lagnaṃ vidhīyate" iti || pitrorabdamihā''śaucamiti kvacitpāṭhaḥ | atra mātṛpadaṃ sāpatnamātṛparamiti kecit | etanmate pitrorabdamityayameva pāṭho'bhimata iti gamyate | dvayorapītyanye | aviśeṣādityāśayaḥ | etanmate piturabdamityeva pāṭhaḥ | pitrorabdamitipāṭhe mukhyamāturabdaṃ sāpatnamāturabdārdham | piturabdamitipāṭha ubhayorapyabdārdhameveti bhedaḥ| jyotiṣprakāśe -- "pratikūle'pi kartavyo vivāho māsamantarā | śāntiṃ vidhāya gāṃ dattvā vāgdānādi caretpunaḥ" iti | smṛtyantare -- "pratikūle na kartavyaṃ lagnaṃ yāvadṛtutrayam | pratikūle'pi kartavyaṃ ke'pyāhurbahusaṃplave | pratikūle sapiṇḍasya māsamekaṃ vivarjayet | vivāhastu tataḥ paścāttayoreva vidhīyate" iti | tayorniścitaghaṭitayorvadhūvarayoḥ | vadhvā varālābhe varasya vadhvalābhe saṃkaṭe sati nānyāṃ vadhūmanyaṃ varaṃ vā prekṣedi(te)ti tātparyārthaḥ | jyotiḥsāgare -- "durbhikṣe rāṣṭrabhaṅge ca pitrorvā prāṇasaṃśaye | prauḍhāyāmapi kanyāyāṃ nānukūlya pratīkṣyate" iti | anyatrāpi -- "dīrgharogābhibhūtasya dūradeśasthitasya ca | udāsīnasthitasyāpi prātikūlyaṃ na vidyate | saṃkaṭe samanuprāpte yājñavalkyena yoginā | śāntiruktā gaṇeśasya kṛtvā tāṃ śubhamācaret | akṛtvā śāntikaṃ yastu niṣiddhe sati dāruṇe | prakaroti śubhaṃ karma vighnastasya pade pade" iti | asminvākye sāmānyataḥ śubhaṃ karmetiśravaṇādupanayanasyāpi vināyakaśāntipūrvakamevānuṣṭhānamiti kecit | anye tu śubhakarmaśabdo vivāha evopasaṃhriyate tena śāntipūrvako vivāha eva bhavati | upanayanaṃ tu naiva bhavatītyāhuḥ | upanayanaṃ tu śāntimantareṇāpi bhavatīti pare | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "pratikūle tu saṃprāpte vivāhaṃ naiva kārayet | ante doṣavināśāya kuryācchāntimimāṃ śubhām" iti | smṛticandrikāyām -- "kṛte vāṅniścaye paścānmṛtyurmartyasya gotriṇaḥ | tadā na maṅgalaṃ kāryaṃ nārīvaidhavyadaṃ dhruvam" iti | anyatrāpi -- "vāgdānānantaraṃ yatra kulayoḥ kasyacinmṛtiḥ | tadodvāho naiva kāryaḥ svavaṃśakṣayado yataḥ" iti | atra yadyapi kaściditi mṛtirbhavati kasyacidityaviśeṣeṇoktaṃ tathā'pi pitāmahyādīnāmiva mātāmahyādīnāmapi maraṇasya pratikūladoṣanimittatvena kvacidakīrtanāt, avivāhitāyā bhaginyā iva vivāhitāyā maraṇasya tathātvānukteḥ, medhātithivākye svagotriṇāmiti candrikāvākye martyasya gotriṇa iti ca kīrtanāt, vadhvā varasya vā sagotrasapiṇḍeṣu tripuruṣāntargate martye mṛte pratikūladoṣa iti mantavyam | strī varasya dvitīyādivivāhasamaye pūrvoḍhā | sutastasyāṃ pūrvotpannaḥ | etatpautropalakṣaṇam | evaṃ pitṛvyagrahaṇaṃ tatputrasya | evaṃ ca varamārabhya janakatripuruṣī janyā tripuruṣī kūṭasthamārabhya saṃtānabhede ca tripuruṣyatra boddhavyā | vadhūvarayoḥ samānagṛhe tanmaraṇe kaṃcitkālaṃ pratīkṣyaiva vivāha iti tadā na kuryurityādiśabdairbodhyate | tayostatpratikūlaṃ syāditi kālapratīkṣāśāntibhyāmasamādheyo doṣo dvayoryugapanmaraṇaja ityāśayaḥ | ata evoktaṃ nānyeṣāṃ tu kadācaneti | anyeṣāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ tayorapyekaikamaraṇajastu samādheya ityāśayaḥ | vṛddhavasiṣṭhavākye caturṇāṃ maraṇasya mahāvighnapradatvakathanaṃ tatra pratīkṣāsahitā kevalā vā vināyakaśāntiritikathanārtham | ata eva tadvidhivākyaśeṣe śāntyakaraṇe pade pada iti vighnasya mahattvaṃ pradarśitam | ebhireva vipannairiti kālapratīkṣāsahitāyāḥ śrīpūjanādiśānternimittametanmaraṇamevetyāśayaḥ | ata eva māṇḍavyavākye naiva kartavyo nimittānantaramiti vyākhyeyam | evaṃ vṛddhavasiṣṭhavākyamapi | pratīkṣā ca sāmānyataḥ saṃvatsaramṛtutrayaṃ māsamātraṃ veti pakṣatrayaṃ medhātithivākyasahitasmṛtyantaravākyādboddhavyam | ratnāvalīvākya āśaucaśabdena pratikūlakṛtaṃ vivāhānadhikāramātraṃ pratīkṣātātparyakaṃ bodhyam | mahāguruvyatiriktamaraṇakṛtapratikūlābhāve prathamābde'pi sapiṇḍīkaraṇamā sikāpakarṣaṃ kṛtvā vivāho bhavati | mahāgurumaraṇakṛtapratikūlābhāve tu vṛddhinimittamantareṇa sapiṇḍīkaraṇāpakarṣe vṛddhidaivapitryeṣvanadhikāra eveti draṣṭavyam | tatra piturmaraṇe saṃkaṭatāratamyenānantaroktaṃ pakṣatrayam | māturmaraṇe saṃvatsarārdhaṃ māsamātraṃ veti pakṣadvayam | bhāryāmaraṇe māsatrayaṃ māsamātraṃ veti | bhrātṛmaraṇe putramaraṇe ca sārdhamāsaṃ māsamātraṃ vetyevaṃ pakṣadvayam | pitāmahyādisapiṇḍāntaramaraṇe tu māsameva pratīkṣeti vyavasthā | yadi guṇavattaramātṛmaraṇa ṛtutrayapratīkṣayā na paritoṣastadā saṃvatsarapratīkṣā'pi kāryā | evaṃ guṇavattarabhāryādimaraṇa ṛtutrayapratīkṣā'pītyāśayena tayorapi pakṣayoḥ sāmānyavidhyupapattiḥ | pitṛmātṛpitṛvyasodarāṇāṃ caturṇāṃ maraṇa uktavyavasthayā pratīkṣānte vināyakaśāntiḥ | anyamaraṇe tadante śāntyantaram | etacca śāntidvayaṃ śāntiratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyate | yadā tvatisaṃkaṭavaśena sarvatra nimitte māsādikapratīkṣāyā asaṃbhavastadā tanmadhye'pi kiṃcitkālaṃ pratīkṣyoktavyavasthayā'lpatarāṃ śāntiṃ kṛtvā gāṃ dattvā vāgdānādi punaścarediti jyotiṣprakāśavākyakṛto viśeṣaḥ | na tu kvacidapi pratikūle pūrvāśaucādinimittena nivṛttāśaucasyāpi sadyo vivāhe pravṛttirucitā | yathā sagotrasapiṇḍe puruṣatrayaparyantameva pratikūlasya niṣedhanimittatvam | evaṃ praveśamuṇḍanayornirgamamaṇḍananiṣedhanimittatvamapi teṣvetāvatparyantameveti puruṣatrayetimedhātithivākyārthaḥ | svagotriṇāmācaturthamityanuṣaṅgalabhyārthasiddhyai pretakarmāṇyanirvartyetyasya bhinnārthakasyāpi vākyasyānantaraṃ pāṭhaḥ | kule catuṣpuruṣaparyantaṃ pretoddeśena vihitāni karmāṇyanirvartyāsamāpyā''bhyudayikaṃ nā''caredityarthaḥ | pretaśabdoddeśaviśiṣṭāni karmāṇītyetādṛśārthastu sapiṇḍīkaraṇottaramāsikāsaṃgrahāpattigrastatvātparityaktaḥ | eteṣāmutpattivelāyāṃ pretoddeśena vihitānāmapi tacchandodeśarahitā punarāvṛttiḥ śāṭyāyaninoktā -- "sapiṇḍīkaraṇādarvāgapakṛṣya kṛtāni tu | punarapyapakṛṣyante vṛddhyuttaraniṣedhanāt" iti || vṛddhyuttaraniṣedhanāditi yadyapi hetustathā'pi savyaṃ hi manuṣyāḥ prathamamañjata itivadaprāptaprāpakatvādvidhiḥ kalpanīya iti navīnāḥ | kātyāyanaḥ -- "nirvartya vṛddhitantraṃ tu māsikāni na tantrayet | ayātayāmaṃ maraṇaṃ na bhavetpunarasya tu" iti || vṛddhikarmottaraṃ māsikānuṣṭhāne mṛtasya maraṇamayātayāmaṃ bhavet | nūtanamiva bhavet | tacca māṅgalikakarmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ mṛtasya māṅgalikakarmottaramāpadyamānamanucitamiti bhāva iti navīnāḥ| kecinnavīnāḥ -- "bhrātā vā bhātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā | sahapiṇḍakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ" iti laghuhārītavākye bhrātṛśiṣyādyukterna nāndīśrāddhejyadevatāmātraparo'pakarṣa iti | asminmate bhrātrādimaraṇe tatsapiṇḍanamāsikānāmapakarṣaṃ vinā na nāndīśrāddhamiti | anye navīnāstu yasyā''bhyudayikaśrāddhāntargatadevatābhūtasya sapiṇḍanaṃ vinā na tannirvahati tasyaiveha vākye sapiṇḍanaṃ vidhīyate, ākāṅkṣitavidhānāt | anyathā bhinnajātīyagurorapi sapiṇḍanaṃ śiṣyeṇa kāryaṃ syādityāhuḥ | etasminmate tu tadvinā'pi bhavatīti bhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | sakaladākṣiṇātyaprabhṛtyanekaśiṣṭācārasaṃvādānnāndīśrāddhejyadevatāmātraparo'pakarṣa iti dvitīyamatameva yuktam | pretakarmāṇyanirvartyetyatra yadyapi pretakarmabhiḥ sahā''bhyudayikakriyāyā maṅgalāparaparyāyāyāḥ samānakartṛkatvaṃ pratīyate tathā'pi tadasati kartrantare mukhyaṃ sati tu pretakarmasu prayojakakartṛkatāmādāyopapādanīyam | itthameva hi -- "vadhvañjalāvupastīrya bhrātā bhrātṛsthānīyo vā dvirlājānāvapati" ityāśvalāyanasūtre vṛttikṛdādibhistu tadupapādyate, vivāhahoma upastaraṇasya varakartṛkatvaṃ lājāvapanasya bhrātrādikartṛkatvaṃ vicchinnasaṃdhānārthe tu tasmaॅiṃllājahomasyāpi varakartṛkatvaṃ vadadbhiḥ | evaṃ nāndīśrāddhadevatātvasiddhyarthaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇāpakarṣaparatvena parābhimatavacane'pi samānakartṛkatvamitthameva svīkāryam | tadyathā śāṭyāyaniḥ -- "pretaśrāddhāni sarvāṇi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā | apakṛṣyāpi kurvīta kartuṃ nāndīmukhaṃ dvijaḥ" iti || laghuhārīto'pi -- "bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā | sahapiṇḍakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ" iti || mṛtasya kanyādāne hi tasya jyeṣṭhakaniṣṭhabhrātarāvadhikāriṇau kanyāyāḥ pitṛpitāmahabhrātrabhāvātsaṃbhavataḥ | "pitā pitāmaho bhrātā sakulyo jananī tathā | kanyāpradaḥ pūrvanāśe prakṛtisthaḥ paraḥ paraḥ" itiyājñavalkyavacanāt | tasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇe tu kaniṣṭhasyaivādhikāro na jyeṣṭhasya | "na putrasya pitā dadyānnānujasya tathā'grajaḥ | api snehena kuryātāṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā" iti sapiṇḍīkaraṇasya taṃ prati viśiṣya niṣedhāt | ato jyeṣṭhasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇe prayojakakartṛkatvaṃ kaniṣṭhasya mukhyakartṛkatāmaṅgīkṛtyaivoktavacanayoḥ samānakartṛkatvamupapādanīyam | evaṃ cānayorvacanayordevatātvasiddhiprayojanāsaṃkīrtanādvidheyāthaikyācca mūlaikyalāghavānurodhena pretakarmāṇyanirvartyeti kṛṣṇabhaṭṭīprayogodāhṛtavacanārthaparatvaṃ svīkartumucitamiti kaustubhe | anyacca tatraiva | pitāmahe prapitāmahe vā'kṛtasapiṇḍane sati pitari mṛta aucityena tayoḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇottaraṃ pituḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇakartavyatāyāṃ prāptāyāmapi yadā tathā'nuṣṭhānena pituḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇakālātikramo bhavati tadā nyāyataḥ kālātikrameṇa tathaiva tatkartavyatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ vacanenākṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇābhyāmapi tābhyāṃ pituḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kartavyatayā vihitam | yathā''ha kātyāyanaḥ -- "asaṃskṛtau na saṃskāryau pūrvau pautraprapautrakaiḥ | pitaraṃ tatra saṃskuryāditi śātātapo'bravīt || pāpiṣṭhamapi śuddhena śuddhaṃ pāpakṛtā'pi vā | pitāmahena pitaraṃ saṃskuryāditi niścayaḥ" iti || asaṃskṛtāvakṛtasapiṇḍīkaraṇau | pūrvau pitāmahaprapitāmahau | pāpiṣṭhamakṛtasapiṇḍanaṃ pitaraṃ śuddhena kṛtasapiṇḍanena pāpakṛtā'kṛtasapiṇḍanena vā pitāmahena saha śuddhaṃ nivṛttapretāvasthaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | evaṃ kṛte darśaśrāddhamapi tādṛśābhyāṃ saha kartavyamityapi tenaivoktam -- "pituḥsapiṇḍatāṃ kṛtvā kuryānmāsānumāsikam" iti | evaṃ ca darśaśrāddhavikṛtitvānnāndīśrāddhe'pi tādṛśayordevatātvasaṃbhave'pi māṅgalikavivāhādyanurodhena tayoḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvaiva māṅgalikaṃ karma kāryaṃ tayoścatuṣpuruṣāntaragatatvāt | ata eva śubhāgama eva sapiṇḍīkaraṇāpakarṣanimittatvena kālādarśe paṭhyate -- "ekādaśe dvādaśe'hni tripakṣe vā trimāsi vā | ṣaṣṭhe vaikādaśe vā'bde saṃpūrṇe vā śubhāgame || sapiṇḍīkaraṇasyetthamaṣṭau kālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | sāgnau kartaryubhāvādyau prete sāgnāvanantaraḥ || anagnestu dvitīyādyāḥ sapta kālāḥ prakīrtitāḥ" iti || "anantarastripakṣaḥ" iti "śubhasya vivāhāderāgama upasthite sati" iti ca tatraiva vyākhyāya mūlavākyodāharaṇamitthaṃ kṛtam -- "mahābhārate -- 'sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ kuryādyajamānastvanagnimān' | ityupakramya 'ekādaśe'pi vā māsi maṅgale syādupasthite' iti" [iti |] "atra ca śubhamaṅgalaśabdābhyāṃ vivāhādyevoktamiti pratīterna nāndīśrāddhapratītirna sutarāṃ taddevatātvasya" ityapi tatraiva | sapiṇḍanāpakarṣe tatpūrvatanamāsikānāmavaśiṣṭānāmapi nivṛttiḥ | taduttarakartavyamāsikānāmapyavaśiṣṭānāṃ nivṛttirvacanāditi draṣṭavyam | "pretakarmāṇyanirvartya" iti vākyāt, "bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā | sahapiṇḍakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ" || iti vākyācca catuṣpuruṣaparyantaṃ yasya kasyāpi sagotrasapiṇḍasya tatputre proṣite'pi vyavahito'pi sapiṇḍaḥ pretasya pretaśrāddhasapiṇḍīkaraṇamāsikāni kṛtvaiva vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | "pretaśrāddhāni sarvāṇi sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ tathā | apakṛṣyāpi kurvīta kartuṃ nāndīmukhaṃ dvijaḥ" || iti hemādrilikhitaśāṭyāyanivaco'pyetadarthakameva, pretakarmaṇāṃ yāvataḥ puru ṣāprati nāndīmukhānurodhenāvaśyakartavyatā vihitā tānpratyevāpakarṣavidhāvapi śabdasāmañjasyāt | sapiṇḍīkaraṇasya satyapi pretaśrāddhatva āhitāgnyādiviṣayatvena vyavasthāpitatripakṣādikālabādhenāpyapakarṣasiddhyarthaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam | "sapiṇḍīkaraṇādarvāgapakṛṣya kṛtāni tu | punarapyapakṛṣyante vṛddhyuttaraniṣedhanāt" iti śāṭyāyanivaco'pi tāvatpuruṣaviṣayameva punarapītyuktestānpratyeva saṃbhavāditi kaustubhe | jvaritasya yāvatsvāsthyaṃ maṅgalaṃ na kāryam | tathā ca gargaḥ -- "jvarasyotpādanaṃ yasya śubhaṃ tasya na kārayet | doṣanirgamanātpaścātsvastho dharmaṃ samācaret" iti || kasyacitkulajasya śarīre'tidāruṇajvarotpattau niścayo'pi na kāryaḥ | tathā ca sa eva -- "kecidūcurgṛhasthasya kasyaciddāruṇo jvaraḥ | tāvanmaṅgalakāryasya na kāryo niścayo budhaiḥ" iti | iti pratikūlavidhiḥ | atha rajodoṣanirṇayaḥ | mādhavīye -- "prārambhātprāgvivāhasya mātā yadi rajasvalā | nivṛttistasya kartavyā sahatvaśruticodanāt" iti || tasya rajodoṣasya nivṛttiḥ kartavyā karmārthaṃ śuddhiḥ pratīkṣaṇīyetyarthaḥ | vivāhārambhātprāgyadi mātā rajasvalā bhavettadā tasyāḥ śuddhau satyāmeva vivāhaḥ kartavyo na tu tāṃ parityajyeti tātparyārthaḥ | atra hetumāha -- sahatvaśruticodanāditi | yadyapyatra sāmānyato nivṛttistasya kartavyetyuktyā caturthadivase rajonivṛttau satyāṃ caturthadine'pi vivāhaḥ kartavya iti prāptaṃ tathā'pi -- "daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śudhyati" | iti vacanena pañcamadina eva sarvakarmādhikārasyoktatvāttaddinamārabhyaiva vivāhe'dhikāro na tu caturthadinamārabhyāpīti jñeyam | prārambhaśabdārtho viṣṇunoktaḥ -- "prārambho varaṇaṃ yajñe saṃkalpo vratasatrayoḥ | nāndīmukhaṃ vivāhādau śrāddhe pākaparikriyā" iti || nāndīmukhaṃ nāndīśrāddham | vivāhādāvityādipadenopanayanādi gṛhyate | pākaparikriyā pākārambhaḥ | pākaprokṣaṇamiti kecit | "prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syāt" itivacane sūtakamiti mṛtakasyāpyupalakṣaṇam | medhātithiḥ -- "caule ca vratabandhe ca vivāhe yajñakarmaṇi | bhāryā rajasvalā yasya prāyastasya na śobhanam || vadhvā varasya vā mātā bhavedyadi rajasvalā | tasyāḥ śuddheḥ paraṃ kāryaṃ māṅgalyaṃ manurabravīt || udvāhavratacūḍāsu mātā yadi rajasvalā | tadā na maṅgalaṃ kāryaṃ śuddhau kāryaṃ śubhepsubhiḥ" iti || gargo'pi -- "yasyodvāhādimāṅgalye mātā yadi rajasvalā | tadā na tatprakartavyamāyuṣkṣayakaraṃ yataḥ" iti || eteṣu vacaneṣvaviśeṣātsāpatnamāturapi grahaṇam | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "vaidhavyaṃ ca vivāhe syājjaḍatvaṃ vratabandhane | cūḍāyāṃ ca śiśormṛtyurvighnaṃ yātrāpraveśayoḥ" iti || yadi vivāhādipārambhottaraṃ rajaḥ, prārambhātprāgapi rajasi sarvathā muhūrtāntarālābho vā, tadā śāntiṃ kṛtvā'nantaraṃ karma kāryameva | yathoktaṃ kapardikārikāyām -- "sūtikodakyayoḥ śuddhyai gāṃ dadyāddhomapūrvakam | prāpte karmaṇi śuddhā syāditarasminna śudhyati || alābhe sumuhūrtasya rajodoṣa upasthite | śriyaṃ saṃpūjya tatkuryātpāṇigrahaṇamaṅgalam || haimīṃ māṣamitāṃ padmāṃ śrīsūktavidhinā'rcayet | pratyṛcaṃ pāyasaṃ hutvā'bhiṣicya śubhamācaret" iti || ślokabhedena prāptapadoktārambhasya muhūrtāntarālābhasya ca śravaṇānna parasparasāpekṣatvamiti kaustubhe | sūtikodakyayoḥ śuddhyai gāṃ dadyāddhomapūrvakamitivacanapratipāditā śuddhiścaturthadivasaviṣayiṇī draṣṭavyā | atra śuddhiśabdenādhikāra ucyate | tathā ca -- adhikārāya gāṃ dadyāddhomapūrvakamityartho bhavati | homapūrvakamiti vihito homaḥ kuśmā(ṣmā)ṇḍaireva, kapardikārikāsu pūrvatra tasyaivopakramāt | rajasvalāviṣaye -- "daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śudhyati" | iti vacanasiddhasya caturthadivase'nadhikārasya bādho'nena kriyate | sūtikāviṣaye tu "viṃśatirātraṃ putraprasūrmāsena strījananī" ityanena pratipāditasyānadhikārasyātra bādhaḥ | iyaṃ vaidhī śuddhiḥ saṃkaṭaviṣaye draṣṭavyā | rajodarśanādisaṃbhāvanāyāṃ nāndīśrāddhasyāpakṛṣyānuṣṭhāne vidhiḥ smṛtyantare -- "ekaviṃśatyaharyajñe vivāhe daśa vāsarāḥ | triṣaṭcaulopanayane nāndīśrāddhaṃ vidhīyate" iti || caule trayo vāsarā upanayane ṣaḍvāsarā ityarthaḥ | iti rajodoṣanirṇayaḥ | atha vivāha āśaucapāte nirṇayaḥ | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "dāne vivāhe yajñe ca saṅgrāme deśaviplave | āpadyapi ca kaṣṭāyāṃ sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate" iti || viṣṇuḥ -- "vratayajñavivāheṣu śrāddhe home'rcane jape | prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe tu sūtakam" iti || prārambhaśabdārthastu prāgevoktaḥ | vivāhe sadyaḥ śaucaṃ keṣāmityapekṣāyāṃ brahmapurāṇe sadyaḥśaucaṃ prakṛtya -- "dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca kanyādāne ca no bhavet | vivāhayiṣṇoḥ kanyāyā lājahomādikarmaṇi" iti || atra dātṛpratigrahītṛgrahaṇaṃ saṃskāryasaṃskārakayorupalakṣaṇam | cakārāddātṛpatnīkanyayorgrahaṇam | ārambhābhāve'pyagre muhūrtāntarālābhe sāmāyāṃ ca kṛtāyāṃ sūtakino'pyadhikāropāyamāha pārijāte viṣṇuḥ -- "anārabdhaviśuddhyarthaṃ kūṣmāṇḍairjuhuyādghṛtam | gāṃ dadyātpañcagavyāśī tataḥ śudhyati sūtakī" iti || anārabdhaviśuddhyarthamityanenaiva siddhe tataḥ śudhyatīti punarvacanamatisaṃkaṭe vivāhādyupayogipākapariveṣaṇādāvapi śuddhijñāpanārthamiti navīnāḥ | sūtakīti jananāśaucavantaṃ pratyevedaṃ pravartata ityapi kecinnavīnāḥ | saṃgrahe -- "saṃkaṭe samanuprāpte sūtake samupasthite | kūśmā(ṣmā)ṇḍībhirghṛtaṃ hutvā gāṃ ca dadyātpayasvinīm || cūḍopanayanodvāhapratiṣṭhādikamācaret | yadaiva sūtakaprāptistadaivābhyudayakriyā" iti || evaṃ śuddhipūrvakavivāhādyanuṣṭhāne tadaṅgatvena saṃkalpitānnabhojane na doṣa ityāha bṛhaspatiḥ -- "vivāhotsavayajñeṣu tvantarā mṛtasūtake | pūrvasaṃkalpitānneṣu na doṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ" iti || mṛtakasūtakamadhye vivāhādyanuṣṭhāna uktaśuddhipūrvakamārabdha iti pūrvārdhārthaḥ | nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ sūtakādau vivāhādyārambhottaramapi saṃkalpitānne viśeṣaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate -- "vivāhotsavayajñeṣu tvantarā mṛtasūtake | parairannaṃ pradātavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ ca dvijottamaiḥ" iti || parairasagotraiḥ | smṛtikaumudyāmapi -- "vivāhotsavayajñeṣu ārabdhe sūtakaṃ yadi | sāṅgaṃ tatkarma kartavyamannadānādikaṃ paraiḥ" iti || pūrvasaṃkalpitānnabhojanasamaye sūtakaprāptau viśeṣaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmate -- "bhuñjāneṣu tu vipreṣu tvantarā mṛtasūtake| anyagehodakācāntāḥ sarve te śucayaḥ smṛtāḥ" iti || bhoktṛbhirbhuktaśeṣastyājyaḥ pakvaśeṣaḥ sūtakibhirbhoktavya ityāśayaḥ | "bhojanārdhe tu saṃbhukte yadi kaścinmriyeta vai | sarvaṃ bhuktocchiṣṭaśeṣaṃ parityajya samāhitāḥ || ācamya parakīyeṇa toyena śucayo dvijāḥ" iti brahmapurāṇāt | bahvannasaṃbharaṇasaṃpādināṃ dhāraṇāśaktāvāha viṣṇuḥ -- "na devapratiṣṭhāvivāhayoḥ pūrvasaṃbhṛtasaṃbhārayoḥ" iti | devapratiṣṭhāvivāhayoḥ pūrvasaṃbhṛtasāmagrīkayorupakramātprāgapi tatkarturāśaucaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ | etaduktaṃ bhavati, yāvati kāle saṃbhṛtabahusaṃbhāradhāraṇaṃ kartuṃ śakyate tāvatkālamadhye pratiṣṭhāvivāhāṅgabhūtaṃ kālāntaraṃ yatra na labhyate tadviṣaya evāyaṃ saṃkalpātprāgāśaucābhāva iti | siṅgābhaṭṭīye baudhāyanaḥ -- "sthālīpākātpūrvaṃ vadhvā yadi mṛtiḥ syāttāmanvārabhya sthālīpākaṃ kṛtvaupāsanāgninā dāhayedvarasya mātāpitroryadi mṛtiḥ syāduttaraśeṣaṃ samāpya paścātpaitṛmedhikamācaredasāveva jyeṣṭhaścetkaṅkaṇaṃ kanyāhaste baddhvā tadviparītamācaret" iti | iti vivāha āśaucanirṇayaḥ | atha samānakriyāvicāraḥ | sārāvalyām -- "ekodaraprasūtānāmekasminvatsare sadā | vivāhaṃ naiva kurvanti kurvanti tu tato'nyathā" iti || jyotirvivaraṇe -- "ekodarayorvarayorekadinodvāhato bhavennāśaḥ | nadyantara ekadine ke'pyāhuḥ saṃkaṭe ca śubham" iti | śārṅgadharīye'pi -- "nadyantare'pi śubhadaṃ pṛthaśailarodhe" iti | smṛtyantare -- "vivāhastvekajātānāmekasminnudaye kule | nāśaṃ karotyekavarṣe syādekā vidhavā tayoḥ" iti | udayo lagnam | pārijāte gargaḥ -- "bhrātṛyugme svasṛyagme bhrātṛsvasrośca yugmake | na jātu maṅgalaṃ kāryamekasminmaṇḍape'hani" iti | bhātṛyugmasya svasṛyugmasya bhātṛsvasṛyugmasya caikasminnahanyekasminmaṇḍape maṇḍanaṃ na kuryādityarthaḥ | etacca vacanaṃ sārāvalīvacanena samānodaraviṣayaniṣedhasya prāptatvāttadbhinnaviṣayam | madaratne nāradaḥ -- " ekamātṛjayorekavatsare puruṣastriyoḥ | na samānakriyāṃ kuryānmātṛbhede vidhīyate" iti | na samānakriyāmityanena dvayoścaule dvayovratabandhau dvayorvivāhau vā na kuryāditi bodhyate | mātṛbhede vidhīyata ityetenaikasya puṃso vivāhadvayamapyekadine niṣiddhaṃ mātṛbhedābhāvāt | anyacca jyotirgranthe -- "naikasminvatsare kāryau gehodvāhau kathaṃcana" iti | gehaśabdena gehārambhaḥ praveśaśca gṛhyate | viśeṣamāha sa eṣa -- "putrodvāhātparaṃ putrīvivāho na ṛtutraye | na kāryaṃ vratamudvāhānmaṅgale nāpyamaṅgalam | vivāhaścaiva kanyānāṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yadi | asaṃśayaṃ tribhirvarṣaistatraikā vidhavā bhavet" iti | maṅgalaṃ vivāhādi | amaṅgalaṃ śrāddhādi | jyotirnibandhe -- "mātṛyajñakriyāpūrvaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā tu maṅgalam | ṛtutrayaṃ punaryāvanna kuryāllaghumaṅgalam" iti | jyeṣṭhamaṅgalaṃ(le) vivāhopanayane | laghumaṅgalaṃ caulādi | anena vacanena samāvartanamapi niṣidhyate tasyāpi laghumaṅgalatvāditi kecit | anye tu pitrādikartṛkaputrādisaṃskāraparaṃ na tu svakartṛkasvasaṃskāraparam | samāvartanasya svakartṛkatvānnāyaṃ niṣedhastatreti prāhuḥ | atra pramāṇābhāvāccintyametat | evaṃ ca vivāhottaramupanayanottaraṃ vā, ṛtutrayādarvākcaulaṃ na kāryamityuktaṃ bhavati | tathā ca madanaratne'triḥ -- "kule ṛtutrayādarvāṅmaṇḍanānna tu muṇḍanam | praveśānnirgamaṃ caiva na kuryānmaṅgalatrayam | putrīpariṇayādūrdhvaṃ putrasyodvāhanakriyā | na duṣṭā syānmātṛbhede gṛhabhede'pi caiva hi" iti | atra kulaṃ puruṣatrayaparyantameva | tathā ca medhātithiḥ -- "puruṣatrayaparyantaṃ pratikulaṃ svagotriṇām | praveśanirgamau tadvattathā muṇḍanamaṇḍane" iti | maṇḍanamuṇḍanaśabdārthaḥ kātyāyanenoktaḥ -- "muṇḍanaṃ caulamityuktaṃ vratodvāhau tu maṇḍanam | caulaṃ muṇḍanamityuktaṃ varjayedvaraṇātparam | mauñjī cobhayataḥ kāryā yato mauñjī na muṇḍanam" iti | caulasya muṇḍanapradhānatvāditi tadāśayaḥ | mauñjyāṃ muṇḍanamaṅgaṃ na pradhānamiti mauñjī na muṇḍanamityasyā''dhāyaḥ | varaṇātparaṃ kanyāvarayorvaraṇottaraṃ kanyāvarayorvaraṇaprabhṛtīti yāvat | praveśānirgamaśabdārthaḥ kātyāyanenoktaḥ -- "putrodvāhaḥ praveśākhyaḥ kanyodvāhastu nirgamaḥ" iti | saṃhitāsārāvalyām -- "na maṇḍanānmuṇḍanamūrdhvamiṣṭaṃ na putrayormaṇḍanamekavarṣe | na puṃvivāhordhvamṛtutraye'pi vivāhakāryaṃ duhituḥ prakuryāt" iti | madanaratne vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "na puṃvivāhordhvamṛtutraye'pi vivāhakāryaṃ duhituḥ prakuryāt | na maṇḍanāccāpi hi muṇḍanaṃ ca gotraikatāyāṃ yadi nābdabhedaḥ | ekodarabhrātṛvivāhakṛtyaṃ svasurna pāṇigrahaṇaṃ vidheyam | ṣaṇmāsamadhye munayaḥ samūcurna muṇḍanaṃ maṇḍanato'pi kāryam" iti | mihiraḥ -- "putropanayanādūrdhvaṃ ṣaṇmāsābhyantaraṃ tathā | putrodvāhaṃ na kurvīta vivāhādvratabandhanam" iti | etadapavādastatraiva -- "ṛtutrayasya madhye cedanyābdasya praveśanam | tadā hyekodarasyāpi vivāhastu praśasyate" iti | atra tuśabdena vivāhabhinnamekodaraviṣayaṃ maṅgaladvayamabdabhede'pi na bhavatīti jñāpyate | sārāvalyām -- "phālgune caitramāse tu putrodvāhopanāyane | bhedādabdasya kurvīta nartutrayavilaṅghanam" iti | saṃkaṭe gargaḥ -- "putrīpariṇayādūrdhvaṃ yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam | putryantarasya kurvīta nodvāhamiti sūrayaḥ" iti | pariṇayo vivāhaḥ | kapardikārikā'pi -- "udvāhya putrīṃ na pitā vidadhyātputryantarasyodvahanaṃ kadā'pi | yāvaccaturthaṃ dinamatra sarvaṃ samāpya cānyodvahanaṃ vidadhyāt" iti | atra caturthadine kaśyapaḥ -- "mauñjībandhastathodvāhaḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare'pi vā | putryudvāhaṃ na kurvīta vibhaktānāṃ na doṣakṛt" iti | atrottaratra putryudvāhaṃ na kurvīteti śravaṇātpūrvatrodvāhaḥ putrasya draṣṭavyaḥ | atraivamarthaḥ -- mauñjībandhastathodvāhaḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyantare'pi kartavyaḥ, paraṃ tu ṣaṇmāsābhyantare putrodvāhātparaṃ putryudvāhaṃ na kurvīta, yadi vibhaktā bhrātarastadā ṣaṇmāsābhyantare putrodvāhottaraṃ putryudvāhakaraṇe na doṣa iti | etaccātisaṃkaṭe draṣṭavyam | yattu jyotirnibandhe medhātithiḥ -- "pṛthaṅmātṛjayoḥ kāryo vivāhastvekavāsare | ekasminmaṇḍape kāryaḥ pṛthagvedikayostathā | puṣpapaṭṭikayoḥ kāryaṃ darśanaṃ na śirasthayoḥ | bhaginībhyāmumābhyāṃ ca yāvatsaptapadī bhavet" iti, tatkartṛbhedābhiprāyam | kārya iti karmapratyaye dvābhyāṃ tribhirityanvayasaṃbhavāt | udāhṛtagargavākyayoḥ kapardivākye caikakartāraṃ prati niṣedho jñāyate | kuryātkurvīta na pitā vidadhyāditiśabdaistathaiva pratīteḥ | ataśca dvābhyāṃ kartṛbhyāmekasminnapi lagna ekasminnapi gṛhe bhinnodarayorvivāhaḥ kāryaḥ | kartṛbhedenaiva maṇḍapapratiṣṭhādibhedaḥ | ekaḥ kartā tu dinacatuṣṭayena pūrvaṃ vivāhaṃ samāpyottaraṃ kuryāt | atisaṃkaṭe tvekasminnapi dine maṇḍapadevatāpratiṣṭhādyabhede'pi gṛhabhedena veti vyavasthā bodhyā | tathā ca vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "dviśobhanaṃ tvekagṛhe'pi neṣṭaṃ śubhaṃ tu paścānnavabhirdinaistu | āvaśyakaṃ śomanamutsavo vā dvāre'thavā''cāryavibhedato vā" iti | atrottarārdhaṃ bhinnodarasādhāraṇaṃ jñeyam | caturthadinādarvāgviṣaye vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "ekalagne dvilagne vā dve gṛhe yatra śobhane | tayoreko vinaṣṭaḥ syādvardhate na yathāsthitam" iti | yatra gṛhe dve śobhane dvau vivāhāvityartha iti cintāmaṇau | atisaṃkaṭa ekodarayorapyekāhe kartavyatoktā jyotirvivaraṇe -- "na pratiṣiddhaṃ lagnaṃ saṃprāpte saṃkaṭe mahati | ekodarasaṃbhavayorekāhe bhinnamaṇḍape kāle" iti | yamayostu viśeṣaḥ smṛtyantare -- "ekasminvatsare caiva vāsare maṇḍape tathā | kartavyaṃ maṅgalaṃ svasrorbhrātroryamalajātayoḥ" iti | gāryaḥ -- "ekasminvāsare prāpte kuryādyamalajātayoḥ | kṣauraṃ caiva vivāhaṃ ca mauñjībandhanameva ca" iti | etaccābhyanujñāparaṃ na tu niyamavidhiriti draṣṭavyam | iti samānakriyāvicāraḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇa kanyādātṛnirṇayaḥ | tatra yājñavalkyaḥ -- "pitā pitāmaho bhrātā sakulyo jananī tathā | kanyāpradaḥ pūrvanāśe prakṛtisthaḥ paraḥ paraḥ | aprayacchansamāpnoti bhrūṇahatyāmṛtāvṛtau | gamyaṃ tvabhāve dātṝṇāṃ kanyā kuryātsvayaṃ varam" iti | bhrātā kanyāyāḥ | sa ca saṃskṛtaḥ | "asaṃskṛtāstu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ | bhaginyaśca nijādaṃśāddattvāṃ'śaṃ tu turīyakam" iti tenaivoktatvāt | yajjātīyā kanyā tajjātīyasya putrasya yāvānbhāgastasya caturthamaṃśaṃ pratyekaṃ bhaginībhyo dattvā tāḥ saṃskartavyā ityarthaḥ | bhaginyaścetyatra cakāro bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtairityasyānuvṛttyarthaḥ | pūrvasaṃskṛtairityanenānupanītasya bhrāturadhikāro vyāvartyate | atra śūlapāṇiḥ -- pūrvasaṃskṛtairbhrātrādibhiḥ piturardhaṃ(rthe) paitṛkādeva dhanādasaṃskṛtā bhrātaro jātakarmādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskāryāḥ | bhaginyo'pi svāddhanāccaturthabhāgaṃ dattvā tenaiva dhanena vivāhākhyasaṃskāreṇa saṃskuryāt (skāryāḥ) [iti] | bṛhaspatinā tu -- "samāṃśā mātarastveṣāṃ turīyāṃśāśca kanyakāḥ" | ityanena pitṛdhanāccaturthāṃśaharatvamuktaṃ tadapi saṃskārārthameva | caturthāṃśena vivāhāsaṃbhave yāvatā dhanena saṃbhavati tāvaddeyam | yathā devalaḥ -- "kanyābhyaśca pitṛdravyāddeyaṃ vaivāhikaṃ vasu | aputrakasya kanyā vā dharmajā putravaddharet" iti | svavittānusāreṇetyāha viṣṇuḥ -- 'anūḍhānāṃ tu kanyānāṃ svavittānusāreṇa saṃskāraṃ kuryāt' iti | sakulyo dāyādaḥ | dāyādeṣvapi saṃnihita evādhikārī | prakṛtisthaḥ pātityonmādādidoṣarahitaḥ | atra prakṛtisthagrahaṇādaprakṛtisthena pitrādinā kṛtamapyakṛtameva | "svatantro yadi tatkāryaṃ kuryādaprakṛtiṃ gataḥ | tadapyakṛtameva syādasvātantryasya hetutaḥ" || ityaparārke nāradavacanāt | pitṛtvādinā svatantro'pi sannaprakṛtisthatvena hetunā paratantro yadi bhavati tadā tatkṛtaṃ vāgdānādikāryamakṛtameva veditavyaṃ yadi tasminvare patanīyadoṣā acikitsyarogā vā bhaveyuḥ | vare patanīyadoṣādyabhāve tu tathaivoparitanaṃ karma prakṛtisthaḥ kuryāt | yadā tvaprakṛtisthadattāyā vivāhasaṃskāro nirvyūḍhastadā pradhānakarmaṇo niṣpannatvenādhikārimātravaikalyāttatrāpi na sarvātmanā pratyāvartanīyā kanyā | evaṃ tarhyanadhikāriṇā kṛtamapyakṛtamevetyetadvirudhyeteti cetsatyam | tadvirodha sthūlākṣaraiḥ yuktaḥ bhāgaḥparihārāya parivettṛvivāha iva tāṃ pratyāhṛtya punastasmā evādhikārī dadyāt | tatra ca punarvivāho'pi parivettṛvivāhavadeva jñeya iti madanapārijāte | yadi tu saptapadīkramaṇāntaṃ jātaṃ bhavettadā'dhikāridātṛrūpāṅgavaikalye'pi nā''vṛttirvivāhasya | aṅgānurodhena pradhānāvṛtteranyāyyatvāditi kecit | nārado'pi dātṝnāha -- "pitā dadyātsvayaṃ kanyāṃ bhrātā vā'numateḥ pituḥ | pitāmaho mātulaśca sakulyā bāndhavāstathā || mātā tvabhāve sarveṣāṃ prakṛtau yadi vartate | tasyāmaprakṛtisthāyāṃ kanyāṃ dadyuḥ svajātayaḥ" iti || atra pitṛgrahaṇaṃ pitāmahopalakṣaṇam | atra pitrabhāve pitāmahastadabhāve bhrātetyevaṃ kramo draṣṭavyaḥ | udāhṛtayājñavalkyavaconurodhāt | sakulyā dāyādā bāndhavā mātṛpakṣīyāḥ svajātayo brāhmaṇādayaḥ | yasya varṇasya yā kanyā tajjātīyā adhikāriṇa ityarthaḥ | madanapārijāte kātyāyanaḥ -- "svayamevaurasīṃ dadyātpitrabhāve svabāndhavāḥ | mātāmahastato'nyāṃ hi mātā vā dharmajāṃ sutām" iti | tato'nyāmaurasībhinnām | dharmajāṃ niyogātkṣetrajāṃ mātāmaho mātā mātulo vā dadyāt | tenaurasīdāne pitṛbandhuṣu satsu mātāmahādīnāṃ nādhikāraḥ | asyāpavādastatraiva -- "dīrghapravāsayukteṣu paugaṇḍeṣu ca bandhuṣu | mātā tu samaye dadyādaurasīmapi kanyakām" iti || paugaṇḍo vyavahārādyasamarthaḥ | samaye rajodarśanocitasamayātpūrvakāle | manuḥ -- "yadā tu naiva kaścitsyātkanyā rājānamāvrajet" iti | uktasakalādhikāryabhāve svayaṃ varayet | "gamyaṃ tvabhāve dātṝṇāṃ kanyā kuryātsvayaṃ varam" itivacanāt | "putri pradānakālaste na ca kaścidvṛṇoti mām | svayamanviccha bhartāraṃ guṇaiḥ sadṛśamātmanaḥ" || iti bhārate sāvitryupākhyāne pitranujñayā'pi svayaṃvaraṇamuktaṃ tatkṣattriyādhikāratvāttadviṣayam | gamyaṃ gamanārhaṃ sāvarṇyādiguṇayuktamityarthaḥ | anāthāyāḥ kanyāyā dharmārthavivāhakaraṇaṃ tatphalaṃ coktaṃ purāṇāntare -- "ātmīkṛtya suvarṇena parakīyāṃ tu kanyakām | dharmyeṇa vidhinā dātumasagotro'pi yujyate | anāthāṃ kanyakāṃ dṛṣṭvā yo dadyātsadṛśe vare | dviguṇaṃ phalamāpnoti kanyādāne yadīritam" iti || ato'nyadīyā kanyā'nyenāpi dharmārthaṃ deyā | kanyāyā rajaḥprāptyanantaraṃ dāne doṣamāha śāṭyāyaniḥ -- "mātā ca janakaścaiva jyeṣṭho bhrātā tathaiva ca | trayaste narakaṃ yānti dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ rajasvalām" iti || marīcirapi -- "yastāṃ vivāhayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo madamohitaḥ | asaṃbhāṣyo hyapāṅkteyaḥ sa ukto vṛṣalīpatiḥ" iti || hārīto'pi -- "piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā | sā kanyā vṛṣalī jñeyā tatpatirvṛṣalīpatiḥ" iti || asaṃskṛtā'vivāhitā | tatra prāyaścittapūrvakaṃ vivāhamāha śaunakaḥ -- "kanyāmṛtumatīṃ śuddhāṃ kṛtvā niṣkṛtimātmanaḥ | pitā ṛtūnsvaputryāstu gaṇayedāditaḥ sudhīḥ || dānāvadhi gṛhe yatnātpālayecca rajovatīm | dadyāttadṛtusaṃkhyā gāḥ śaktaḥ kanyāpitā yadi || dātavyaikā'pi yatnena dāne tasyā yathāvidhi | dadyādvā brāhmaṇeṣvannamatinisvaḥ sadakṣiṇam || tasyātītartusaṃkhyeṣu varāya pratipādayet | upoṣya tridinaṃ kanyā rātrau pītvā gavāṃ payaḥ || adṛṣṭarajase dadyātkanyāyai ratnabhūṣaṇam | tāmudvahanvaraścāpi kūśmāṇḍairjuhuyādghṛtam" iti || niṣkṛtimātmanaḥ kṛtvā kanyāṃ cartumatīṃ śuddhāṃ kṛtvā varāya pratipādayedityanvayaḥ | svaputryāḥ svakanyāyāḥ | tasyāḥ kanyāyā dāne kartavye yathāvidhi godānavidhinā śaktena tadṛtusaṃkhyā gāvo dātavyāḥ | aśaktena tvavaśyamekā'pi gaurgodānavidhinā deyetyarthaḥ | upoṣyeti ślokena dṛṣṭarajaskaka nyāyā upavāsatrayānte gavyapayaḥpānapūrvakaṃ godānaṃ vidhīyate | adṛṣṭarajase kumāryai saratnabhūṣaṇadānena vivāhayogyatocyate | tāmudvahannityanena varasya kuśmāṇḍahomena tadudvāhayogyatā pratipādyate | kanyayā godānottaraṃ pādakṛcchramapi kartavyam | "kanyakā tu vivāhātprāgrajasā cetpariplutā | pādakṛcchreṇa śuddhā syātpāṇigrahaṇakarmaṇi" || iti hemādrau smṛtyantarokteḥ | baudhāyanastu -- "atha yadi kanyopasādyamānā vohyamānā vā rajasvalā syāttāmanumantrayate -- pumāṃsau mitrāvaruṇau pumāṃsāvaśvināvubhau | pumānindraśca sūryaśca pumāṃsaṃ vardhayatviyamityatha dvādaśarātramalaṃkṛtya prāśayetpañcagavyaṃ tataḥ śuddhā bhavati" ityāha | upasādyamānā dātrā dīyamānā | uhyamānā vareṇa pāṇigrahaṇena | vāśabdadvayamubhayoḥ prādhānyaṃ dyotayitum | tasyā upasādyamānāyā uhyamānāyā vā patane sa evā''ha -- "atha yadi kanyopasādyamānā vohyamānā vā patettāmutthāpayedudasthāddevyaditirviśvarūpyāyuryajñapatāvadhāt | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya ca" iti | homakāle rajodarśane tu yajñapārśvaḥ -- "vivāhe vitate tantre homakāla upasthite | kanyāmṛtumatīṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ kurvanti yājñikāḥ || snāpayitvā tu tāṃ kanyāmarcayitvā yathāvidhi | yuñjānāmāhutiṃ hutvā tatastantraṃ pravartayet" iti || yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ mana ityekenarjmantreṇa sādhyā''hutiryuñjānāhutistāṃ hutvetyarthaḥ | yadā tu dātrabhāvena rajodarśanaṃ tadā viśeṣamāha baudhāyanaḥ -- "trīṇi varṣāṇyṛtumatī kāṅkṣeta pitṛśāsanam | tataścaturthe varṣe tu vindeta sadṛśaṃ patim || avidyamāne sadṛśe guṇahīnamapi śrayet" iti | manurapi -- "trīṇi varṣāṇyudīkṣeta nārī ṛtumatī satī | ūrdhvaṃ tu kālādetasmādvindeta sadṛśaṃ patim || adīyamānā bhartāramadhigacchedyadi svayam | nainaḥ kiṃcidavāpnoti na ca yaṃ sā'dhigacchati" iti | adīyamānā dātrabhāvāddātrupekṣaṇācca | sā yaṃ bhartāramadhigacchati so'pi naino'dhigacchatīti mādhavena vyākhyātam | yattu viṣṇuvacanam -- "ṛtutrayamapāsyaiva kanyā kuryātsvayaṃ varam" iti | tadguṇavadvaralābhe veditavyam | svayaṃvaraṇe viśeṣamāha manuḥ -- "alaṃkāraṃ nā''dadīta pitṛdattaṃ svayaṃvarā | mātṛdattaṃ bhrātṛdattaṃ steyaṃ syādyadi taṃ haret" iti || kanyādānaphalamāha sa eva -- 'nāgnihotrādibhistatsyādrakṣāto brāhmaṇasya vā | yatkanyāṃ vidhivaddattvā phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ' iti | rakṣāto rakṣaṇena | sālaṃkārakanyādāne phalaviśeṣamāha saṃvartaḥ -- 'kūkudaścāśvamedhī ca prāṇadātā bhayeṣu ca | samaṃ yānti rathā eṣāṃ trayo vai nātra saṃśayaḥ' iti | kukudaśabdaḥ -- 'satkṛtyālaṃkṛtāṃ kanyāṃ yo dadāti sa kūkudaḥ' iti kośātsatkārapūrvakālaṃkārayutakanyādātari rūḍhaḥ | kūpada iti pāṭhe'pyarthaḥ sa eva | vaivāhikapradānamuktaṃ skandapurāṇe -- 'vaivāhikapradānaṃ hi yo dadāti dayāparaḥ | vimānenārkavarṇena kiṅkiṇījālamālinā | mahendrabhavanaṃ yāti sevyate hyapsarogaṇaiḥ' iti | vaivāhikaṃ vivāhopayogi dravyavastrālaṃkārādi | na cedaṃ phalaśravaṇātkāmyameveti vācyam | 'vaivāhikapradānaṃ yo na karoti narādhamaḥ | pāpīyānsa hi jāyeta sarvalokavigarhitaḥ' ityapradāne doṣaśravaṇāt | ato darśapūrṇamāsavannityaṃ kāmyaṃ ca | anyasya dharmārthaṃ vivāhakaraṇe phalamuktaṃ mahābhārate -- 'jñātvā svavittasāmarthyamekamudvāhayeddvijam | tenāpyāpnoti tatsthānaṃ śivabhakto naro dhruvam' iti | aparārke dakṣo'pi -- 'mātāpitṛvihīnaṃ tu saṃskārodvāhanādibhiḥ | yaḥ sthāpayati tasyeha puṇyasaṃkhyāṃ na vidyate' iti | kanyāgṛhe bhojananiṣedho bhaviṣye -- 'aprajāyāṃ tu kanyāyāṃ na bhuñjīta kadācana | dauhitrasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kimarthamanuśocati' iti | na bhuñjītetyatra kanyāgṛha iti śeṣaḥ | aparārka āditya purāṇe'pi -- 'aprajāyāṃ tu kanyāṃ nāśnīyātkanyakāgṛhe | brāhmadeyāṃ na vai kanyāṃ dattvā'śnīyātkadācana | atha bhuñjīta mohāccetsa yāti narakaṃ dhruvam' iti | brāhmavivāhavidhinā dātuṃ yogyāṃ kanyāṃ dattvā kadāpi tasyā gṛhe naivāśnīyādityarthaḥ | atrāpyaprajāyāmityanuṣañjanīyam | śākalakārikāsvapi -- 'duhitrannaṃ na bhuñjīyādyāvattasyā bhavetsutaḥ | anyathā yastu bhuñjīta dānaṃ tasya vṛthā bhavet | kanyāyāstvaprasūtāyā yastvannaṃ bhuñjate yadi | aghaṃ sa kevalaṃ bhuṅkte prājāpatyena śudhyati' iti | atha dattāpahāraḥ | tatra yājñavalkyaḥ -- 'dattāmapi haretpūrvaṃ śreyāṃścedvara āvrajet' iti | pūrvavarāpekṣayā śreyānguṇairvariṣṭho vara āvrajedāgaccheccetpūrvavarāya dattāṃ vācā dattāmapi kanyāṃ haret | tasmai na dadyādityarthaḥ | ata eva pratiśrutyavasare smaryate śiṣṭaiḥ -- 'avyaṅge'patite'klībe daśadoṣavivarjite | imāṃ kanyāṃ pradāsyāmi devāgnidvijasaṃnidhau' iti | daśa doṣāḥ saṃgraha uktāḥ -- 'unmattā vṛttihīnāśca tathā'pasmāradūṣitāḥ | dūrasthāḥ kuṣṭhino mūrkhā mokṣamārgānusāriṇaḥ | śūrā avedyā nivṛttā daśadoṣayutā varāḥ | tathā ṣaṇḍhāśca patitāścakṣuḥśrotravivarjitāḥ | varjanīyāḥ prayatnena kanyādātrā na saṃśayaḥ' iti | nivṛttā vivāhāt | yattu manuvacanam -- 'etattu na pare cakrurnāpare jātu sādhavaḥ | yadanyasyābhyanujñāya narasyānyasya dīyate' iti | yacca nāradavacanaṃ -- 'sakṛdaṃśo nipatati sakṛtkanyā pradīyate' iti | taddoṣarahitavaraviṣayam | doṣarahitavarataḥ kanyāyā apahāre daṇḍa ukto yājñavalkyena -- 'sakṛtpradīyate kanyā haraṃstāṃ coradaṇḍabhāk' iti | tāṃ kanyāṃ harataścorasya yathā daṇḍastathaiva daṇḍa ityarthaḥ | nārado'pi -- 'dattāṃ nyāyena yaḥ kanyāṃ varāya na dadāti cet | aduṣṭaścedvaro rājñā sa daṇḍyastatra coravat' iti | aduṣṭaścedityanena duṣṭāya na deyeti gamyate | uktaṃ ca gautamena -- 'pratiśrutyāpyadharmasaṃyuktāya na dadyāt' iti | duṣṭenāpi yadi pāṇigrahaṇaṃ saptapadyantaṃ kṛtaṃ tadanantaraṃ tato naiva grāhyā | ata eva nāradaḥ -- 'strīpuṃsayostu saṃbandhādvaraṇaṃ prāgvidhīyate | varaṇādgrahaṇaṃ pāṇeḥ saṃbandho'yaṃ trilakṣaṇaḥ | tayoraniyataṃ proktaṃ varaṇāddoṣadarśanāt | pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrā niyataṃ dāralakṣaṇam | teṣāṃ niṣṭhā ca vijñeyā vidvadbhiḥ saptame pade' iti | asyārthaḥ -- strīpuṃsayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ saṃbhogastasmātprāgvaraṇaṃ tadanantaraṃ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ ca bhavati | evaṃ saṃbandhastrilakṣaṇaḥ | varaṇaṃ pāṇigrahaṇamupabhogaśceti trīṇi lakṣaṇāni yasya sa saṃbandhastrilakṣaṇaḥ | strīpuṃsayorityatrācatureti sūtreṇākārāntatā | gāndharvādiṣu nāyaṃ kramaḥ | tayoḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ kanyāvarayoriti yāvat | aniyatamaniyamaḥ, vṛto'pi na pariṇīyate vāgdattā'pi na dīyata ityevaṃrūpaḥ | tatra hetuḥ -- varaṇāddoṣadarśanāditi | varaṇādūrdhvaṃ kanyāvarayoranyonyaṃ doṣadarśanāt | anena vivāhādūrdhvaṃ nāniyama ityuktaṃ bhavati | tatra niyame hetumāha pāṇigrahaṇikā mantrā iti | tairmantrairutpāditasaṃskārayorna parityāga ityarthaḥ | pāṇigrahaṇamantrotpādyasaṃskārāvadhimāhateṣāmiti | niṣṭhā niyatā sthitiḥ | "varaṇādgrahaṇaṃ pāṇeḥ saṃskāro hyagnilakṣaṇaḥ | tayoraniyataṃ proktaṃ varaṇaṃ doṣadarśanāt" | iti pāṭhe tu pāṇergrahaṇaṃ yatso'gnilakṣaṇaḥ saṃskāraḥ, agnicihnito homādiniṣpādyaḥ saṃskāraḥ | tayorvaraṇapāṇigrahaṇayormadhye varaṇameva doṣadarśanādaniyataṃ, na pāṇigrahaṇaṃ, tasmādarvākpatitvānupapatterityarthaḥ | yamaḥ -- "nodakena na vā vācā kanyāyāḥ patirucyate | pāṇigrahaṇasaṃskārātpatiḥ syātsaptame pade" iti | anena saptapadyākramaṇātprāgvaramaraṇe vaidhavyaṃ neti gamyate | uktaṃ ca vasiṣṭhena -- "adbhirvācā ca dattāyāṃ mriyate yadi vai varaḥ | na ca mantropanītā syātkumārī pitureva sā" iti || sā pitureva na pratigrahīturityarthaḥ | sā ca devarāya pradeyā | tadabhāve tadgotrāya | tadabhāve'nyasmai | etatsarvaṃ deśācārānusāreṇa bhavati | balādapahṛtāyāṃ tu viśeṣamāhaturyamavasiṣṭhau -- "balādapatdṛtā kanyā mantrairyadi na saṃskṛtā | anyasmai vidhivaddeyā yathā kanyā tathaiva sā" iti || devalaḥ -- "gāndharvādivivāheṣu punarvaivāhiko vidhiḥ | kartavyaśca tribhirvarṇaiḥ samarthenāgnisākṣikaḥ" iti || gāndharvādivivāheṣvanuṣṭhitamapi vivāhahomapūrvatanaṃ vidhiṃ punaḥ kṛtvā'gnisādhyaṃ vivāhahomādikaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ | homādisaptapadyantā mantrā vivakṣitāḥ | tatraiva bhāryātvotpatteriti mādhavaḥ | bahubhyo vāgdāne kātyāyanokto viśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ -- "anekebhyo hi dattāyāmanuḍhāyāṃ tu yatra vai | varāgamaśca sarveṣāṃ labhetā''divarastu tām" iti || sarveṣāṃ guṇavatāṃ varāṇāmāgame satyādya eva varastāṃ kanyāṃ labhetetyarthaḥ | ādyavaravyatiriktānāṃ sarveṣāmāgame yo dūrādāgataḥ sa tāṃ labheta | tathā ca candrikāyām -- "paścāddūrādāgato yaḥ sa hi pratilabheta tām" iti | paścādādyavaralābhāsaṃbhavanirṇayānantaraṃ dūrastho varastāṃ kanyāṃ pratilabhetetyarthaḥ | ādyasya doṣavattve parasya guṇavattve parasprā eva deyā -- "kulaśīlavihīnasya paścāddhi patitasya ca | apasmārividharmasya rogiṇāṃ vepadhāriṇām || dattāmapi haretkanyāṃ sagotroḍhāṃ tathaiva ca" iti vasiṣṭhokteḥ | "dattāmapi haretpūrvaṃ śreyāṃścedvara āvrajet" | iti yājñavalkyokteśca | paścādvāgdānottaraṃ patitasyetyarthaḥ | sagotroḍhā sapravareṇoḍhā | varaṇottaraṃ varasya deśāntaragamane nāradaḥ -- "pratigṛhya tu yaḥ kanyāṃ varo deśāntaraṃ vrajet | trīnṛtūnsamatikramya sā cānyaṃ varayedvaram" iti || pratigṛhya varayitvetyarthaḥ | śulkadāturdeśāntaragamane kātyāyanaḥ -- "pradāya śulkaṃ gacchedyaḥ kanyāyāṃ strīdhanaṃ tathā | dhāryā sā varṣamekaṃ tu deyā'nyasmai vidhānataḥ" iti || śulkaṃ kanyāmūlyam | strīdhanaṃ kanyāprītaye dattamalaṃkāradravyādi | śulkadamaraṇe manuvasiṣṭhau -- "kanyāyāṃ dattaśulkāyāṃ mriyeta yadi śulkadaḥ | devarāya pradātavyā yadi kanyā'numanyate" iti | yājñavalkyā -- "mahādoṣe tu vijñāte pūrvaṃ saptapadīvidheḥ | maraṇaṃ vā vijāyeta deyā'nyasmai na doṣabhāk || balādudvāhitā kanyā dātavyā'nyavarāya ca" iti || mahādoṣāḥ kārikānibandhe -- "andho mūkaḥ kriyāhīnaścāpasmārī napuṃsakaḥ| dūrasthaḥ patitaḥ kuṣṭhī dīrgharogī varo na san" iti || dūrastho'pi guṇavattvena bahubhiḥ parijñātaścettadā na dūrasthatvaṃ doṣaḥ | taduktaṃ smṛtyantare -- "guṇavāniti vijñāto dūrastho'pi hi sanvaraḥ" iti | vasiṣṭhaḥ pāṇigrahaṇottaramapyanyasmai deyetyāha -- "pāṇigrahe kṛte kanyā kevalaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtā | sā cedakṣatayoniḥ syātpunaḥ saṃskāramarhati" iti || etacca kalau niṣiddham -- "devarācca sutotpattirmadhuparke paśorvadhaḥ | akṣatāyāśca kanyāyāḥ punardānaṃ parasya ca" || iti kalivarjyaprakaraṇe bṛhannāradīyavacanāt | parasya parasmā ityarthaḥ | vāgdānottaraṃ kanyādoṣopalambhe gṛhītāyā api tyāga ukto manunā -- "vidhivatpratigṛhyāpi tyajetkanyāṃ vigarhitām" iti | vigarhitāṃ duṣṭām | nāradaḥ -- "nāduṣṭāṃ dūṣayetkanyāṃ nāduṣṭaṃ dūṣayedvaram | doṣe sati na doṣaḥ syādanyonyaṃ tyajatordvayoḥ" iti || kanyādoṣāstenaiva darśitāḥ -- "dīrghakutsitarogārtā vyaṅgā saṃspṛṣṭamaithunā | dhṛṣṭā'nyāhitabhāvā ca kanyā duṣṭā prakīrtitā" iti || anyasminpuruṣa āhitaḥ kṛto bhāvo'bhilāṣo yayā sā | aduṣṭātyāge doṣamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "aduṣṭāṃ ca tyajandaṇḍyo dūṣayaṃstu mṛṣā śatam" iti | yastu kanyādoṣamanabhidhāya prayacchati sa rājñā daṇḍya ityāha nāradaḥ -- "yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāmanākhyāya prayacchati | tasya kuryātnṛpo daṇḍaṃ pūrvasāhasacoditam" iti || paṇaśatadvayaṃ saptatyadhikaṃ pūrvasāhasam | yattu yājñavalkyenoktam -- "anākhyāya dadaddoṣaṃ daṇḍya uttamasāhasam" iti | taddoṣabhūyastvābhiprāyam | uttamasāhasaṃ sāśītipaṇasāhasram | uktaṃ ca prāyaścittaprakaraṇe tenaiva -- "sāśītipaṇasāhasro daṇḍa uttamasāhasam" iti | iti dattāpahāranirṇayaḥ | atha kulaparīkṣā | tatrā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "kulamagre parīkṣeta ye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaśceti yathoktaṃ purastāt" iti | ye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaśca daśapuruṣaṃ samanuṣṭhitavidyātapobhyāṃ puṇyaiśca karmabhiryeṣāmubhayato nābrāhmaṇyaṃ ninayeyuḥ pitṛta ityeka ityasminsūtre yathoktaṃ tathā''dau kulaṃ parīkṣetetyarthaḥ | manuḥ -- "uttamairuttamo nityaṃ saṃbandhānācarediha | ninīyuḥ kulamutkarṣamapamānavatāṃ tyajet" iti || uttamalakṣaṇaṃ tenaivoktam -- "viśuddhāḥ karmabhiścaiva śṛtismṛtinirśinaḥ | aviplutabrahmacaryā mahākulasamanvitāḥ || saṃtuṣṭāḥ sajjanahitāḥ sādhavastattvadarśinaḥ | rāgadveṣāmarṣalobhamānamohavivarjitāḥ || akrodhanāḥ suprasādāḥ kāryāḥ saṃbandhinaḥ sadā" iti | varjyakulānyuktāni devalena -- "agrajā yeṣu vaṃśeṣu strīprajāprasavāstathā | patighnyaśca striyo yatra tāni yatnena varjayet" iti || agrajā iti strī[prajā] prasavaviśeṣaṇam | yatra yeṣu kuleṣu, tāni kulāni | manurapi -- "mahāntyapi samṛddhāni gojāvidhanadhānyataḥ | strīsaṃbandhe daśaitāni kulāni parivarjayet || hīnakriyaṃ niṣpuruṣaṃ niśchando romaśārśasam | kṣayāmayāpasmārīṇi śvitrikuṣṭhikulāni ca" iti || hīnakriyaṃ vihitakriyāvirahitam | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ niṣiddhavarjanasya | niṣpuruṣaṃ puṃsprasavarahitam | niśchando vedādhyayanarahitam | romaśaṃ prarūḍharomasarvāṅgam | arśasamityādipadaistattadrogavanti kulānyucyante | smṛtyantare -- "kuvivāhaiḥ kriyālopairvedānadhyayanena ca | kulānyakulatāṃ yānti brāhmaṇātikrameṇa ca || śilpena vyavahāreṇa śūdrāpatyaiśca kevalaiḥ | gobhiraśvaiśca yānaiśca kṛpyā rājopasevayā || ayājyayājanaiścaiva nāstikyena ca karmaṇā | kulānyakulatāṃ yānti yāni hīnāni mantrataḥ" iti || dārasaṃgrahaphalabhūtasaṃtatau doṣānuvṛttiparihārāyaiṣā kulaparīkṣā | "kulānurūpāḥ prajāḥ saṃbhavanti" iti hārītavacanāt | iti kulaparīkṣā | atha kanyālakṣaṇāni | tatrā''pastambabaudhāyanau -- "bandhuśīlalakṣaṇasaṃpannāmarogāmupayaccheta" iti | atra saṃpannāmiti pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate | bandhusaṃpannā praśastābhijanā | śīlasaṃpannā''stikyādiguṇānvitā | lakṣaṇasaṃpannā gūḍhagulphatvādilakṣaṇayuktā | arogā kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭhādyacikitsyarogarahitā | etādṛśīṃ kanyāmupayacchetodvahediti sudarśanena vyākhyātam | prayogapārijāte śaunako'pi -- "labdhābhyanujño guruto dvijo lakṣaṇasaṃyutām | buddhiśīlaguṇopetāṃ kanyakāmanyagotrajām || ātmano'varavarṣāṃ ca vivahedvidhipūrvakam" iti | avaravarṣāmiti padacchedaḥ | avaravarṣā nyūnavarṣā | tatra lakṣaṇāni dvividhāni | bāhyānyābhyantarāṇi ca | bāhyalakṣaṇānyāha manuḥ -- "avyaṅgāṅgīṃ saumyanāmnīṃ haṃsavāraṇagāminīm | tanulomakeśadatīṃ mṛdvaṅgīṃ striyamudvahet" iti || lomānyurogatāni tanūni sūkṣmāṇi lomāni, tanavaḥ keśā dantāśca yasyāḥ sā tanulomakeśadatī | śātātapaḥ -- "haṃsagatirmeghavarṇā madhupiṅgalalocanā | tādṛśīṃ varayetkanyāṃ gṛhasthaḥ sukhavṛddhaye" iti || nārado'pi -- "mṛgākṣī mṛgaguhyā ca mṛgagrīvā mṛgodarī | haṃsahastigatirnārī rājapatnī bhaviṣyati || mṛdubhāṣā ca yā nārī mṛdupādatalā tathā | nārī kumudavarṇābhā rājapatnī bhaviṣyati" iti || evamanyānyapi bahūni lakṣaṇāni sāmudrikatilakahastasaṃjīvanādisāmudrikaśāstragrantheṣu draṣṭavyāni | varjanīyakanyā āhā''pastambaḥ -- "suptāṃ rudatīṃ niṣkātāṃ varaṇe parivarjayeddattāṃ guptāṃ dyotāmṛṣabhāṃ śarabhāṃ vinatāṃ vikaṭāṃ muṇḍāṃ maṇḍūṣikāṃ sāṃkārikāṃ ratāṃ pālīṃ mitrāṃ svanujāṃ varṣakārīṃ ca varjayennakṣatranāmā nadīnāmā vṛkṣanāmāśca garhitāḥ sarvāśca rephalakāropāntyā varaṇe parivarjayet" iti | baudhāyano'dhikamāha -- "nakṣatranāmānadīnāmāvṛkṣanāmāparvatanāmāpreṣyanāmāpakṣināmāpiśācanāmāśca garhitāḥ" iti | suptāṃ nidritām | rudatīṃ rodanakāriṇīm | niṣkāntāṃ malināṃ parivarjayet, atyantaṃ varjayet | dattāmanyasmai vācā pratiśrutāmudakapūrvaṃ vā pratipāditām | guptāmadarśanārthaṃ kañcakādibhirāvṛtām | rakṣyamāṇāṃ vā dauḥśīlyādiśaṅkayā | dyotāṃ piṅgalākṣīṃ babhrukeśīṃ vā viṣamadṛṣṭiṃ vā | ṛṣabhāmṛṣabhapradhānāmṛṣabhasyeva śarīraṃ gatiḥ kakucchīlaṃ vā yasyāḥ [tām] | śarabhāṃ śīrṇadīptiṃ savargātreṣu nīlalomnīṃ vā'rūpāṃ vā niṣprabhā vā | vinatāṃ kuñcitāṅgīm | vikaṭāṃ vikaṭajaṅghāṃ vā | muṇḍāmapanītakeśāṃ vā | maṇḍūṣikāmalpakāyāmaruṇadantāṃ vā maṇḍūkatvacaṃ vā | kecittu vāmanāṃ dagdhāṅgāṃ veti vadanti | sāṃkārikāṃ garbhasthāyāṃ yasyāṃ mātā bhartrasthisaṃcayanaṃ karoti tāṃ kulāntarasya duhitṛtvaṃ gatāṃ vā | ratāṃ ramaṇaśīlāṃ kandukādikrīḍāpriyāmityarthaḥ | ṛtusnātāmiti kecit | pālīṃ vatsakṣetrādipālikāmityarthaḥ | mitrāṃ bahumitrām | svanujāṃ śobhanā anujā yasyāḥ | kecittu varajanmasaṃvatsara eva paścājjātāmiti vadanti | varṣakārīṃ varādvarṣeṇādhikāmatyantaṃ sravantīṃ vā| parivarjayedityanuṣaṅge satyapi punarvarjayediti vacanaṃ brāhmādiṣu sarveṣvāsāṃ pratiṣedhārthaṃ dattetarāsāmaniṣedhārthaṃ vā | nakṣatranāmaiva nāma yāsāṃ tā nakṣatranāmāḥ | ekasya nāmaśabdasya lopa uṣṭramukhaśabdavat | evamuttarayorapi vigrahaḥ | rohiṇī citretyevamādayo nakṣatranāmāḥ | gaṅgetyevamādayo nadīnāmāḥ | śiṃśupetyādayo vṛkṣanāmāḥ | garhitā varjanīyāḥ | repho vā lakāro vā yāsāṃ nāmnyupāntya upadhetyarthaḥ | yathā gaurī śāletyādi | vyaktaṃ śiṣṭam | atra cakāreṇa garhitā ityanukarṣaṇādāsāṃ varjanīyatve siddhe varaṇe parivarjayediti punarvacanaṃ vyarthaṃ, na, sugrahatvārtham | athavā yā etā rephalakāropāntyā gaurī śāletyādayaḥ | yāśca prakārāntareṇāpi rephalakāropāntyāḥ smṛtyantareṇoktāḥ sagotrā samānapravarā puṃścalīti tāstā varaṇe parivarjayeditijñāpanārthamiti vyākhyātaṃ sudarśanena | yadyapi vigrahe śobhanā anujā yasyā iti sāmānyataḥ svanujaśabdārtho bhāṣyakṛtā pradarśitastathā'pyatra svanujaśabdaḥ strīliṅgaḥ sāvadhāraṇa eva draṣṭavyaḥ | tena śobhanā anujā bhaginya eva ityartho niṣpadyate | nāto yasyāstu na bhaveddhātā tāṃ nopayacchetetyanena virodhaḥ | manurapi -- "nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṅgīṃ na rogiṇīm | nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na vācālāṃ na piṅgalām | narkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nāntyaparvatanāmikām | na pakṣyahipreṣyanāmnīṃ na ca bhīṣaṇanāmikām" iti | udvahediti śeṣaḥ | kapilāṃ raktataṇḍulavarṇām | piṅgalāmagnivarṇām | antyāṃ mlecchanāmnīm | ābhyantaralakṣaṇānyapyāpastambenoktāni -- "śaktiviṣaye dravyāṇi praticchannānyupanidhāya brūyādupaspṛśediti nānābojāni saṃsṛṣṭāni vedyāḥ pāṃsūnkṣetrālloṣṭaṃ śakṛcchmaśānaloṣṭamiti pūrveṣāmupasparśane yathāliṅgamṛddhiruttamaṃ paricakṣate" iti | śaktiḥ sāmarthyam | viṣayo'vakāśaḥ | asyāmṛddhiparīkṣāyāṃ varatatpakṣīyāṇāṃ sāmarthyasyāvakāśa(śe)saṃbhave sati yadīyakanyā tadīyāścemāṃ parīkṣāmupagaccheyurityarthaḥ | yata evātra śaktiviṣaya ityāha, ata eveyamṛddhiparīkṣā jyautiṣādibhirvaikalpikī na tu nityā | dravyāṇi vakṣyamāṇāni mṛtpiṇḍeṣu pracchannānyekaikasminbhājane nidhāya kanyāsamīpe ca kṛtvā tāṃ brūyāt, eṣāṃ mṛtpiṇḍānāmekamupaspṛśeti | kāni tānītyāha nānābījāni vrīhiyavādibījāni, saṃsṛṣṭāni ekasminpiṇḍe prakṣiptāni, vedyāḥ saumikyā āhṛtāpāṃsūnkṣetrātsasyasaṃpannādāhṛtaṃ loṣṭam | avaśiṣṭe prasiddhe | pūrveṣāṃ caturṇāmupasparśane yathāyogyamṛddhiḥ | nānābījānāmupasparśane prajāsamṛddhiḥ | vedyāḥ pāṃsūnāmupasparśane yajñasamṛddhiḥ | kṣetraloṣṭasparśane sasyānāṃ samṛddhiḥ | śakṛta upasparśane paśūnāṃ samṛddhiḥ | ṛddhiniścayādvivāhakartavyatāniścaya ityarthaḥ | uttamaṃ śmaśānaloṣṭaṃ paricakṣate garhante śiṣṭāḥ | jāyāpatyoranyatarasya vā maraṇaliṅgatvādityartha iti vyākhyātaṃ sudarśanena | etāvatkartumaśaktaṃ pratyāhaturāpastambabaudhāyanau -- "yasyāṃ manaścakṣuṣornibandhastasyāmṛddhirnetaradādriyatetyeke " iti | yasyāṃ kanyāyāṃ varasya manasaścakṣuṣośca nibandho nitarāṃ bandhanaṃ, yasyāmāsaktyatiśayānmanaścakṣuṣī nibaddhe iva tiṣṭhete ityarthaḥ | tasyāṃ jāyāyāṃ satyāmṛddhirdharmādīnāṃ, netaradguṇadoṣānudarśanamādriyetetyeka ācāryā bruvata iti vyākhyātaṃ sudarśanena | netaradādriyetetyayaṃ niṣedhaḥ suptādirephalakāropāntyāntānāmeva, na tu dharmasūtroktānāṃ sagotrasapravarasapiṇḍānāmapi | etadarthameva dharmasūtre sagotrādivivāhaniṣedhaḥ kṛto na tu gṛhyasūtre | tathā ca sagotrādivivāhaniṣedho'styeva | evaṃ ca yo niṣedhaḥ svasūtroktaṃ sagotrādivivāhaniṣedhaṃ bādhituṃ nārhati sūtrāntaroktaṃ sagotrādivivāhaniṣedhamīkṣitumapi nārhati kutastaṃ bādhitum | ataḥ satyāṣāḍhādisūtroktasagotrādivivāhaniṣedhabādhanaśaṅkaiva na | mātuśca yonisaṃbandhebhya iti satyāṣāḍhāpastambasūtrayoścakāraḥ sapravarapitṛsapiṇḍayoḥ samuccayārthaḥ | tenaitayorapi niṣedho'styeva | lakṣaṇānyavaśyaṃ parīkṣaṇīyānyanyathā doṣa ityuktaṃ baudhāyanena -- "varjayetsarvathā kanyā aśubhā lakṣaṇaiśca yāḥ | bharturāyurharantyetā ālasyādaparīkṣitāḥ" [iti] | iti kanyālakṣaṇāni | atha varalakṣaṇāni | tatrā''pastambaḥ -- "śrutavāniti" iti | śrutamadhyayanaṃ tena saṃpannaḥ | viduṣa evoktakarmādhikārāt | ityevaṃbhūtā varasaṃpat | evaṃbhūtāya varāya dadyādityartha iti sudarśanaḥ | baudhāyanaḥ -- "bandhuśīlalakṣaṇasaṃpannaḥ śrutavānaroga iti" iti | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "buddhimate kanyāṃ prayacchet" iti | yamaḥ -- "kulaṃ ca śīlaṃ ca vayaśca rūpaṃ vidyāṃ ca vittaṃ ca sanāthatāṃ ca | etānguṇānsapta parīkṣya deyā kanyā budhaiḥ śeṣamacintanīyam" iti | nāthaśabdena poṣakāḥ pitrādaya ucyante | yattu candrikāyām -- "brāhmaṇasya kulaṃ grāhyaṃ na vedāḥ sapadakramāḥ | kanyādāne tathā śrāddhe na vidyā tatra kāraṇam" iti | tatkanyādānādau brāhmaṇasya kulaprādhānyapratipādanaparaṃ na tu lakṣaṇāntaraniṣedhaparam | laiṅge -- "dātavyā śrotriyāyaiva brāhmaṇāya tapasvine | sākṣādadhītavedāya vidhinā brahmacāriṇe" iti | atra brahmacāriṇa ityasyāyamarthaḥ -- askhalitabrahmacaryeṇaiva prathamavivāhaḥ kāryaḥ | brahmacarye skhalite yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātsa gadarbhaṃ paśumālabhetetyādinā vihitaṃ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtvā kanyāmudvahediti | kātyāyanaḥ -- "unmattāḥ patitāścaiva kuṣṭhiṣaṇḍhasvagotrajāḥ | cakṣuḥśrotravihīnāśca tathā'pasmāradūṣitāḥ | avedyāścaiva dūrasthā mokṣamārgānusāriṇaḥ | śūrā nivṛttāścaitebhyo na deyā kanyakā budhaiḥ" iti | parāśaro'pi -- "kanyāṃ dadāti vṛddhāya nīcāya dhanalipsayā | kurūpāya kuśīlāya sa preto jāyate naraḥ" iti | (brahmavaivarte'pi -- "varāya guṇahīnāya vṛddhāya jñānine tathā | daridrāya ca mūrkhāya rogiṇe kutsitāya ca | atyantakopayuktāya cātyantadurmukhāya ca | paṅgulāyāṅgahīnāya cāndhāya badhirāya ca | jaḍāya caiva mūkāya klībāyātyantapāpine | brahmahatyāṃ labhetso'pi yaḥ svakanyāṃ prayacchati | śāntāya guṇine caiva yūne ca vidūṣe'pi ca | vaiṣṇavāya sutāṃ dattvā daśavāpīphalaṃ labhet | yaḥ kanyāpālanaṃ kṛtvā karoti vikrayaṃ yadi | vipadā dhanalobhena kumbhīpākaṃ sa gacchati | kanyāmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca tatra bhakṣati pātakī | kṛmibhirdaśitaḥ kākairyāvadindrāścaturdaśa | tadante vyādhayonau ca labhejjanma suniścitam | vikrīṇāti māṃsabhāraṃ vahatyeva divāniśam" iti | vṛddhapadamatyaśaktaparatālakṣakam | jñānipadaṃ vivāhānicchuparatālakṣakam | paṅgulaḥ pādahīnaḥ | atyantapāpine mahāpātakayuktāyetyarthaḥ| apiśabdātpratigrahīturapi doṣaḥ| vaiṣṇavāya viṣṇubhaktāya | viṣṇuśabdaḥ śivādyupalakṣakaḥ | vipadā vipadrūpahetunā dhanalobhena cetyarthaḥ |) yājñavalkyaḥ -- "etaireva guṇairyuktaḥ savarṇaḥ śrotriyo varaḥ | yatnātparīkṣitaḥ puṃstve yuvā dhīmāñjanapriyaḥ" iti | atra bhrātṛmattvānanyapūrvatvayavīyastvarūpaguṇatrayabhinnāḥ sarve guṇā atidiśyante | savarṇaḥ samānavarṇaḥ | asapiṇḍādiguṇātideśādubhayataḥsāpiṇḍyanivṛttirabhipretā | tena varanirūpitaṃ kanyāyāṃ kanyānirūpitaṃ ca vare pṛthageva sāpiṇḍyaṃ na tu vyāsajyavṛtti ubhayanirūpitamekamiti navīnāḥ | puṃstvaparīkṣoktā nāradena -- "yasyāpsu plavate bījaṃ hrādi mūtraṃ ca phenilam | pumānsyāllakṣaṇairetairviparītastu ṣaṇḍhakaḥ" iti | bījaṃ retaḥ | hrādi dhvanimat | phenilaṃ phenavat | parīkṣākāraṇamapi tenaivoktam -- "apatyārthaṃ striyaḥ sṛṣṭāḥ strīkṣetraṃ bījamarhati | kṣetraṃ hi bījine deyaṃ nābījī kṣetramarhati" iti | sāmudrikaśāstre -- "pūrvamāyuḥ parīkṣeta paścāllakṣaṇamādiśet | āyurhīnanarāṇāṃ hi lakṣaṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam" iti | evamanyānyapi lakṣaṇāni sāmudrikatilakādau draṣṭavyāni | iti varalakṣaṇam | atha parivittyādisvarūpaṃ tatprāyaścittaṃ ca | tatra manuḥ -- "parivittiḥ parivettā yayā ca parivindati | sarve te narakaṃ yānti dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ" iti | yayā kanyayā parivindati puruṣaḥ sā kanyā'pi narakaṃ yātītyarthaḥ | dātṛyājakapañcamā ityatra dātā ca yājakaśca dātṛyājakau tau pañcamau pañcasaṃkhyāpūrakau yeṣāṃ parivittiparavettṛkanyānāṃ te dātṛyājakapañcamā iti samāsaḥ | dātā ca yājakāśca dātṛyājakāḥ | te pañcasaṃkhyāpūrakā yeṣāmityevaṃ vā samāsaḥ | yājaka ṛtvik | athavā yājakaścāsau pañcamaśca yājakapañcamaḥ | dātā ca yājakapañcamaśca dātṛyājakapañcamau tau yeṣu te dātṛyājakapañcamāḥ | dātṛyājakau sarve'pi te pūrvopāttāśca narakaṃ yānti gacchantītyarthaḥ | parivittyādisvarūpaṃ tenaivoktam -- "dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo'graje sthite | parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ" iti || ata eva gargaḥ -- "sodarye tiṣṭhati jyeṣṭhe na kuryāddārasaṃgraham | āvasathyaṃ tathā''dhānaṃ patitastvanyathā bhavet" iti || sodarye jyeṣṭhe'nūḍhe tiṣṭhati satītyarthaḥ | tathā ca manuḥ -- "agraje brahmacaryasthe yo'nujo dārasaṃgraham | kurute parivettā sa parivittistu pūrvajaḥ" iti || pitṛvyaputrabhinnodarādīnāṃ na doṣa ityāha śātātapaḥ -- "pitṛvyaputrasāpatnaparanārīsuteṣu ca | jyeṣṭheṣvapi ca tiṣṭhatsu bhrātṝṇāṃ tu kanīyasām | dārāgnihotrasaṃyoge na doṣaḥ parivedane" iti | sāpatnāḥ sāpatnamātṛjāḥ | paranārīsutā vyabhicārādutpannā dattakādayo vā | gautamo'pi -- "bhinnodare dattake ca pitṛvyatanaye'graje | dārāgnihotrasaṃyoge na doṣaḥ parivedane" iti || idamapi prathamavivāhāgnyādhānādau | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "darśeṣṭiṃ paurṇamāseṣṭiṃ somejyāmagnisaṃgraham | agnihotraṃ vivāhaṃ ca prayoge prathame sthitam || na kuryājjanake jyeṣṭhe sodare vā'pyakurvati" iti | anujñayā''dhānaṃ bhavatītyāha sumantuḥ -- "tiṣṭhedbhrātā yadi jyeṣṭha ādhānaṃ naiva cā''śrayet | anujñātastu kurvīta śaṅkhasya vacanaṃ yathā" iti || ājñayā''dhānādyeva bhavati na vivāhaḥ | tadāha hārītaḥ -- "sodarāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ parivettā kathaṃ bhavet | dāraistu parividyante nāgnihotreṇa nejyayā" iti || dāraistvityatra tuśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | kanyāviṣaye gargaḥ -- "ekamātṛprasūtānāṃ putriṇīparivedane | doṣaḥ syātsarvavarṇeṣu na doṣo bhinnamātṛṣu" iti || sodaryabhrātṛviṣaye kātyāyanaḥ -- "deśāntarasthānklībāṃśca śūdratulyānsahodarān | veśyāsaktānkuvṛṣaṇānpatitānatirogiṇaḥ || jaḍamūkāndhabadhirakubjavāmanakhelakān | ativṛddhānabhāryāṃśca kṛṣisaktānnṛpasya ca || dhanavṛddhiprasaktāṃśca kāmato'kāriṇastathā | kuhakonmattarogāṃśca parivindanna duṣyati" iti || klībāḥ strīsaṃbhogaviṣaye'dhṛṣṭāḥ | śūdratulyāḥ śūdradharmiṇaḥ | veśyāsaktā veśyāsvabhiratāḥ | kuvṛṣaṇāḥ kutsitavṛṣaṇāḥ | patitā brāhmaṇyāccyutāḥ | atirogāḥ kṣayāpasmārakuṣṭhādayastadvantaḥ | jaḍādayo vāmanāntāḥ prasiddhāḥ | khelakā bhagnapādāḥ | ativṛddhāḥ prasiddhāḥ | abhāryā naiṣṭhikabrahmacāriṇaḥ | kāmato'kāriṇo vivāhādicchayā nivṛttāḥ | kuhakāḥ paravañcanāya vṛthodyogaparāḥ | kuhakapadasthāne kuṭila iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ | atra ye sarvātmanā vivāhānadhikāriṇaḥ klībādayasteṣu satsu kālaviśeṣamantareṇāpi parivedanānna doṣaḥ | ye tu kālāntare saṃbhāvitavivāhādhikārā deśāntarasthaviraktaveśyātisaktaśūdratulyakṛṣisaktarājaparatantradhanavṛddhiprasaktakāmatokārikuhakataskarāsteṣu satsu vakṣyamāṇakālapratīkṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā parivedanaṃ kurvatāṃ na doṣo'stīti hemādriḥ | deśāntaragatajyeṣṭhasodaraviṣaye pratīkṣāvadhimāha vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "dvādaśāṣṭau vā varṣāṇi jyeṣṭhabhrātaramaniviṣṭamapratīkṣamāṇaḥ prāyaścittī bhavati" iti | atra hemādriḥ -- dharmārthamarthārthaṃ vā deśāntaragatasya jyeṣṭhasya dvādaśavarṣaṃ pratīkṣā | tathā ca smṛtiḥ -- "dvādaśaiva tu varṣāṇi jyāyāndharmārthayogataḥ | nyāyyaḥ pratīkṣituṃ bhrātrā śrūyamāṇaḥ punaḥ punaḥ" iti | dharmārthayogata iti vidyāyā apyupalakṣaṇārtham | ata eva gautamena 'naṣṭe bhartari' iti prakramya 'dvādaśa varṣāṇi brāhmaṇasya vidyāsaṃbandhena' iti bhāryāyābhartṛpratīkṣaṇakālamuktvā'bhihitam -- 'bhrātari caivaṃ jyāyasi yavīyānkanyāgnyādheyeṣṭiṣu' iti | naṣṭe bhartari kutra gata ityajñāte bhartari | atyantadūradeśāntaragata iti yāvat | vidyāsaṃbandhena vidyāgrahaṇārthaṃ deśāntaragate bhartari brāhmaṇabhāryayā dvādaśa varṣāṇi pratīkṣya tatkriyādi kāryam | evaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kaniṣṭho jyeṣṭhe bhrātari vidyāgrahaṇārthaṃ deśāntaragate dvādaśa varṣāṇi pratīkṣya vivāhāgnyādhāneṣṭīḥ kuryāt | kāryāntarārthaṃ deśāntaragamane tu daśāṣṭau veti pakṣadvayam | atredaṃ vivakṣitam | deśāntaragatasya svābhimataṃ kāryaṃ nirvartya pratyāgamanasaṃbhāvanānivṛttau taduttarakālaṃ kaniṣṭhena dārāgnihotrasaṃyoge kriyamāṇe parivettṛtvarūpo doṣo na bhavatīti | evameva viraktaveśyātisaktādiṣvapi ca kiyantamapi kālaṃ tathaivāvasthiteṣu tatsvabhāvatvāvadhāraṇena vivāhasaṃbhāvanānivṛttau taduttarakālaṃ kaniṣṭhena vivāhādau kriyamāṇe na doṣaḥ | anenaivābhiprāyeṇa sumantunā'pyuktam -- "vyasanāsaktacitto vā nāstiko vā'thavā'grajaḥ | kanīyāndharmakāmastu ādhānamatha kārayet" iti || ādhānagrahaṇaṃ vivāhasyāpyupalakṣaṇārtham | klībādayastu svabhāvataḥ sarvathā vivāhānarhatvātkiyantamapi kālaṃ na pratīkṣaṇīyāḥ | dvādaśeti mukhyaḥ pakṣaḥ | aṣṭāvityanukalpaḥ | gargo'tra viśeṣamāha -- "proṣitaṃ tu pratīkṣeta varṣatrayamapi tvaran | proṣitaṃ yadyaśṛṇvānastryabdādante samācaret || āgate tu punastasminpādaṃ vā śuddhaye caret" iti || pādaṃ pādakṛcchram | kārṣṇājiniḥ -- "unmattaḥ kilviṣī kuṣṭhī patitaḥ klība eva vā | rājayakṣmāmayāvī ca na nyāyyaḥ syātpratīkṣitum" iti || athaitatprāyaścittam | tatra vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "parivettā ca dātā ca kṛcchrātikṛcchrau caritvā tasmai tāṃ dattvā punarniviśettāṃ caivopayaccheta" iti | atrāparārke kaniṣṭhenoḍhāṃ jyeṣṭha udvahet | aśāstrīyavivāhena kaniṣṭhanirūpitabhāryātvānutpatterjyeṣṭhodvāhayogyatvāt | kaniṣṭhastvanyāmudvahediti | hārītena jyeṣṭhasyābdavratamuktvā'nyodvāha evoktaḥ -- "jyeṣṭhasya samāpte'bde tāṃ kanyāṃ jyeṣṭhāyopapādayeyuḥ, sa tāmanumānyānyayā niviśedevaṃ dharmo na lupyate" iti | tasmātparivettā kṛcchrātikṛcchrottaraṃ svoḍhāṃ jyeṣṭhāya brahmacāryāhṛtabhaikṣavadguruparibhavaparihārārthaṃ nivedya tenānujñātāṃ tāmevodvahediti vāsiṣṭhārthaḥ | atraivaṃ vyavasthā | saṃnidhāvakāmataḥ kṛcchrātikṛcchrau yājñavalkīyaṃ vratacatuṣṭayaṃ ca varṇaśaktyādyapekṣayā yojanīyam | kāmataḥ saṃnidhau kanyāpitrādyanujñātodvāhe tu mānavaṃ traimāsikamiti | yattu sumantuḥ -- "parivittiparivettṛkanyādātṛyājakānāṃ dvādaśarātraṃ saktuprāśanaṃ brāhmaṇatarpaṇaṃ ca punarbhuvamācakṣate na bhūyaścaināmabhigacchet" iti tacchūdraparam | yattu yamaḥ -- "kṛcchrau dvayoḥ pārivedye kanyāyāḥ kṛcchra eva ca | atikṛcchraṃ careddātā hotā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" || iti tadajñānataḥ kṣattriyaviṣayam | dvayoḥ parivettṛparivittyoḥ pratyekaṃ dvau kṛcchrau | agredidhiṣūsvarūpaṃ devalenoktam -- "jyeṣṭhāyāṃ yadyanūḍhāyāṃ kanyāyāmuhyate'nujā | yā sā'gredidhiṣūrjñeyā pūrvā tu didhiṣūḥ smṛtā" iti || etatprāyaścittamāha vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "agredidhiṣūpatiḥ kṛcchraṃ dvādaśarātraṃ caritvā niviśettāṃ caivopayaccheddidhiṣūpatiḥ kṛcchrātikṛcchrau caritvā tasmai dattvā punarniviśet" iti | agredidhiṣūpatiḥ prājāpatyaṃ caritvā tāmeva jyeṣṭhāṃ paścādanyenoḍhāmudvahet | didhiṣūpatistu kṛcchrātikṛcchrau caritvā svoḍhāṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ kanīyasyāḥ pūrvavivoḍhre dattvā'nyāmudvahediti mitākṣarāyāṃ kalpatarau ca | vyākhyāntaramapi smṛtyasāre -- "kaniṣṭhāpatirdvādaśarātraṃ kṛtvā tāṃ svoḍhāmeva jyeṣṭhodvāhe jāta udvahet | jyeṣṭhāpatistu kṛcchrātikṛcchrau kṛtvā svoḍhāṃ kaniṣṭhāpataye brahmacāryātdṛtabhaikṣavannivedya tadanujñātāṃ tāṃ jyeṣṭhāmevodvahet" iti | aparārke tu -- agredidhiṣūpatisthāne didhiṣūpatiriti paṭhitam | didhiṣūpatisthāne tvagredidhiṣūpatiriti | tathā ca prāyaścittavikalpaḥ | iti parivittyādisvarūpaṃ tatprāyaścittaṃ ca | atha kūṭāni | tatra matkṛtāḥ ślokāḥ -- kūṭānvicāryaiva kṛto vivāhaḥ śubhado bhavet | anyathā'niṣṭakṛdyasmādatastānvakṣyate'(nbrūmahe')dhunā ||1|| gajakṣmāsaṃkhyakāḥ kūṭā yadyapyṛṣibhirīritāḥ | tatrāpyāvaśyakāḥ kūṭāstairevāṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || 2 || varṇo vaśyaṃ ca nakṣatraṃ yoniḥ khagagaṇau tathā | rāśirnāḍīti kūṭāḥ syurbalino'tra yathottaram || 3 || gajakṣmordhvaṃ guṇaikatvaṃ śubhakṛtsyādyathottaram | jhaṣakarkālayo viprāḥ kṣattrā ajamṛgau dhanuḥ || 4|| vaiśyā vṛṣāṅganānakrāḥ śūdrā yugmatulāghaṭāḥ | varo varṇottama iha bhaveccecchubhadastathā || 5 || varṇottamā varātkanyā cetsyādaśubhadaṃ tadā | nṛrāśerjalajā bhakṣyāḥ śeṣā vaśyā hariṃ vinā || 6 || siṃhasya sarve vaśyāḥ syū rāśayo vṛścikaṃ vinā | nṛrāśeḥ karkamakaramīnasiṃhā arātayaḥ || 7 || vaśyabhakṣyādikaṃ sarvaṃ jñeyaṃ lokaprasiddhitaḥ |
vadhūbhādvarabhaṃ gaṇyaṃ varabhātkanyakarkṣakam || 8 || kārye ubhe navahṛte śeṣā vahnīṣuparvatāḥ | vasiṣṭhātriprabhṛtibhiraniṣṭāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 9 ||
aśvebhameṣasarpāhiśvautvajākhubhugundurāḥ | unduro gauśca mahiṣīpaśubhuṅmahiṣāstathā || 10 || vyāghraiṇaiṇaśvakapayaḥ sarpāryahiripū kapiḥ | siṃhāśvasiṃhā gaurhastītyaśvibhādyonayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 11 kramādibhadvisaṃkhyākā vairabhāvo'dhunocyate | siṃhebhau mahiṣāśvau cautūndurau śvamṛgau tathā || 12 || kapimeṣau ca govyāghrau nakulāhī mithastvarī | varavadhvoridaṃ vairaṃ vicāryaṃ sarvathā budhaiḥ || 13 || bhaumaśukrabudhābjārkabudhaśukrakujā guruḥ | śaniḥ śanirguruśceti meṣādrāśyadhipāḥ smṛtāḥ || 14 || kujendvijyārātayo'rī śaniśukrau samo budhaḥ | himāṃśostvarkasaumyau ca mitre śeṣā grahāḥ samāḥ|| 15 || kujasya suhṛdo jñeyā himaraśmyarkasūrayaḥ | śatrurbudhaḥ śukraśanī udāsīnau prakīrtitau || 16 || budhasya mitre śukrārkau rajanīśo'sya vai ripuḥ | bṛhaspatiśanikṣmājā udāsīnāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 17 || sūrermitrāṇi dinakṛdrajanīkṛtkujāḥ smṛtāḥ | ripū saumyasitau hyasya samaḥ syāddinakṛtsutaḥ || 18 || kaveḥ saumyaśanī mitre śatrū śaśiravī smṛtau | udāsīnau samākhyātāvaṅgārakabṛhaspatī || 19 || śanermitre śukrabudhau dveṣṭāro'rkābjabhūmijāḥ | bṛhaspatirudāsīno mandacārasya kīrtitaḥ || 20 || aśvayuṅmṛgasāvitrasvātīpuṣyāḥ punarvasū | maitraśravaṇarevatya etā devagaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ || 21 || bharaṇī rohiṇī caiva raudraṃ pūrvātrayaṃ tathā | bhāni trīṇyuttarākhyāni(ṇi) manuṣyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 22 || jyeṣṭhāmūlamaghāśleṣāviśākhātvāṣṭravāruṇāḥ | kṛttikā ca dhaniṣṭhā ca rākṣasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 23 || svagaṇe tūttamaṃ vidyānmadhyamaṃ daivamānuṣam | daivāsure tu kalaho mṛtyurmānuṣarākṣase || 24 || bhaveddvivyayake naiḥsvaṃ ṣaḍaṣṭasu viṣadbhavet | anapatyatvamarthāṅke śeṣe tu śubhadaṃ bhavet || 25 || śeṣe'pyasti viśeṣaḥ so'dhunā sarva udīryate | vedabhedā ekabhasya jyotirvidbhirudīritāḥ || 26 || bhinnarkṣamekarāśi syādekarkṣaṃ bhinnarāśikam | ekarāśyṛkṣabhinnāṅghri tvekarāśyṛkṣapādakam || 27 || antyaṃ tu ninditaṃ jñeyamavaśiṣṭe śubhaṃ bhavet | samabhaṃ satyṛtugaje vṛṣakarkāṅganādi cet || 28 || yadi syātṣaṣṭhasahitaṃ tadaitacchubhadaṃ smṛtam | vṛṣastu samabhastasmātṣaṣṭhī bhavati vai tulā || 29 || tayā tu sahitaṃ grāhyaṃ tatpatyormitrabhāvataḥ | aṣṭame sannasamabhaṃ tatpatyoraribhāvataḥ || 30 || dvirdvādaśe tu samabhaṃ dvitīyasahitaṃ yadi | tadā bhavecchobhanadaṃ viparītamasatsmṛtam || 31 || viṣamo'pyaṅganāyuktaḥ siṃhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ hasta ārdrā śatatārā punarvasū || 32 || pūrvā bhādrottarā(ra)phalgunyaśvinyau nāḍikā''dimā | puṣyo mṛgaśiraścitrā'nūrādhā bharaṇī tathā || 33 || dhaniṣṭhā''dyā tathā''ṣāḍhā pūrvā phālgunikā tathā | uttarā bhādrakāśceti madhyamā nāḍikā smṛtā || 34 || kṛttikā rohiṇī svātī maghā''śleṣāviśākhike | antyā''ṣāḍhā vaiṣṇavaṃ ca revatītyantyanāḍikā || 35 ekanāḍyāṃ vivāhaścettadā maraṇamīritam | vadhvā bhavedyadyalābho varṇairviprādibhistadā || 36 || pārśvanāḍyāṃ prakartavyaṃ godādakṣiṇadeśake | sarvathā madhyamā nāḍī varjanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 37 || bāṇanandaṃ dvivyayaṃ tu grahamaitryā śubhaṃ smṛtam | ṣaḍbhirvaśyādibhiḥ proktaṃ śubhadaṃ tu ṣaḍaṣṭakam || 38 || yadā vadhūrnaragaṇā varo rakṣogaṇo bhavet | satyoḥ satkūṭamaitryostanmelanaṃ śubhadaṃ tadā || 39 || yadā rakṣogaṇā strī syātpumānnaragaṇastadā | śubhavaśyādikaiḥ ṣaḍbhirnṛdūramadhunocyate || 40 || strībhātpuruṣanakṣatraṃ samīpe syāttadā na sat | kheṭoḍumaitryoḥ śubhakṛdetadeva prakīrtitam || 41 || dvyarke tāmraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca gaurvṛṣaśca ṣaḍaṣṭake | bāṇāṅke raupyakāṃsye tu nāḍyekatve gavādikam || 42 || nuḥ śreṣṭhye varṇayoraikye guṇastatraika ucyate | puruṣasya kaniṣṭhatve guṇābhāvaḥ samīritaḥ || 43 || vaśyabhakṣye tvardhaguṇo jātyā jñeyā tu bhakṣyatā | guṇadvayaṃ mitho maitrye vairabhakṣye guṇo nahi || 44 || arivaśye guṇastveko manuṣyāṇāmalī ripuḥ | lokaprasiddhitaḥ siṃhasyāpyeṣa ripurīritaḥ || 45 || bhavedubhayataḥ sadbhaṃ tadā jñeyāstrayo guṇāḥ | ekataścettadā tryardhaṃ tārābhāve guṇo nahi || 46 || yonikūṭe'tisuhṛdorguṇāścatvāra īritāḥ | mitrayostu trayaḥ proktāḥ svabhāve dvau guṇau smṛtau || 47 || samayorguṇa ekaḥ syānmahadvai(hāvai)re guṇo nahi | siṃhebhayormahadvairaṃ tathā babhrudvijihvayoḥ || 48 || govyāghrayormṛgaśunorotūndurukayostathā | ajakapyoraśvakālyoḥ svabhāvaguṇamīritam || 49 || kadācidekayoniṣvapyaritvaṃ syātparasparam | gajayoḥ siṃhayorotvoḥ śunormūṣakayorapi || 50 || evamūhyaṃ maitryamapi lokarītyā vicakṣaṇaiḥ | aikādhipatye maitrye ca mithaḥ pañca guṇā iha || 51 || catvāraḥ samamaitre syurdvayoḥ sāmye guṇāstrayaḥ | mitravaire guṇaścaikaḥ samavaire guṇārdhakam || 52 || parasparaṃ kheṭavairaṃ guṇābhāvaṃ vinirdiśet | nā devo manujā strī syātsaṃgrāhyāstatra ṣaḍguṇāḥ || 53 || vaiparītye pañca guṇā gaṇasāmye tu ṣaḍguṇāḥ | daityo nā devatā strī cettatraiko guṇa īritaḥ || 54 || avaśiṣṭe guṇābhāvo vasiṣṭhādyaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ | duṣkūṭe cedyonimaitraṃ strīdūraṃ syāttadā'bdhayaḥ || 55 || etaddvayaṃ na cettatra guṇābhāvaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | anayormadhya ekaṃ syāttadaiko guṇa iṣyate || 56 || bhaikapāde guṇābhāvo jyotirvidbhirihoditaḥ | sati nakṣatrakūṭe tu varadūraṃ bhayonijam || 57 || vairaṃ ca syāttadā jñeyā guṇā rasamitā budhaiḥ | nakṣatraikye bhinnarāśau guṇāḥ pañca prakīrtitāḥ || 58 || avaśiṣṭe sukūṭe tu grāhyāḥ sapta guṇā budhaiḥ | nāḍībhede guṇā aṣṭāvanukte tu guṇo nahi || saṃkṣepeṇa mayoktāni kūṭānyaṣṭau yathāmati || 59 || iti kūṭāni | atha janmarāśināmarāśyornirṇayaḥ | jyotirnibandhe -- "vivāhe sarvamāṅgalye yātrādau grahagocare | janmarāśeḥ pradhānatvaṃ nāmarāśiṃ na cintayet | deśe grāme gṛhe yuddhe sevāyāṃ vyavahārake | nāmarāśeḥ pradhānatvaṃ janmarāśiṃ na cintayet | kākiṇyāṃ vargaśuddhau ca dāne dyūte jvarodaye | mantre punarbhūvaraṇe nāmarāśeḥ pradhānatā" iti | yadi vadhūvarayormadhya ekasya janmarkṣaṃ jñātamekasya na jñātaṃ tadā śuddhimelanādikaṃ kathamavalokanīyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ śārṅgadharīye -- "vivāhaghaṭanaṃ caiva lagnajaṃ grahajaṃ balam | nāmarkṣāccintayetsarvaṃ janma na jñāyate yadi" iti | nāmādyākṣarasiddhaṃ yadṛkṣaṃ nakṣatraṃ tasmādityarthaḥ | nāmādyākṣareṇa nakṣatraparijñānaṃ tu vakṣyamāṇāvakahaḍācakrāditi jñeyam | atha maṇḍapādi | tatra vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "ṣoḍaśāratnikaṃ kuryāccaturdvāropaśobhitam | maṇḍapaṃ toraṇairyuktaṃ tatra vediṃ prakalpayet | aṣṭahastaṃ tu racayenmaṇḍapaṃ vā dviṣaṭkaram" iti | dviṣaṭkaro dvādaśakaraḥ | anyatrāpi -- "maṅgaleṣu ca sarveṣu maṇḍapo gṛhamānataḥ | kāryaḥ ṣoḍaśahasto vā nyūnahasto daśāvadhiḥ | stambhaiścaturbhirevātra vedirmadhye pratiṣṭhitā" iti | gṛhamānata ityasya mahati gṛhe mahānmaṇḍapaḥ | alpe nyūna ityarthaḥ | daśāvadhiriti nyūnatāyā avadhiḥ | ato vasiṣṭhokto'ṣṭahasto maṇḍapo'tyantāpadviṣayaḥ | daśahastaṃ tu racayedityapi kutracitpāṭhaḥ | asminpāṭhe saṃnihitavacanavirodhābhāvaḥ spaṣṭa eva | stambhaiścaturbhirityatra yukteti śeṣaḥ | idaṃ ca vediviśeṣaṇam | iyaṃ ca vedirdevakasthāpanārthā | pārijāte nāradaḥ -- "hastocchritāṃ caturhastaiścaturaśrāṃ samantataḥ | stambhaiścaturbhiḥ suślakṣṇāṃ vāmabhāge ca sadmani | samāṃ caiva caturdikṣu sopānairatiśobhitām | prāgudakpravaṇāṃ rambhāstambhairhastiśukādibhiḥ |
