vicitreṇāṅkitaiḥ kumbhairvividhaistoraṇāṅkuraiḥ | śṛṅgārapuṣpanikarairvarṇakaiḥ samalaṃkṛtām | viprāśīrvacanaiḥ puṇyastribhirdīpairmanoramām | vāditragītanṛtyādyairhṛdayānandinīṃ śubhām | evaṃvidhāmārurukṣenmithunaṃ sāgnivedikām" iti | atra pramāṇaṃ saṃskāryāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ | "kanyāhastaiḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhirvā kāryā vediḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhonnatā sā | harmye ramye nirgamādvāmabhāge jāyāpatyorāśiṣaiḥ stambhayuktā" iti | āśiṣairiti cchāndasam | etena varapramāṇasyātra kaiścidgrāhyatoktā sā nirastā draṣṭavyā | prāgudakpravaṇā prāgudaṅnimnā | sarveṣāṃ tṛtīyāntānāṃ padānāṃ samalaṃkṛtāmityanenānvayaḥ | dhātumayaiḥ kāṣṭhamayairmārtikairvā hastiśukādibhiḥ samaḥ ntātsthāpitairalaṃkṛtāmityarthaḥ | vicitreṇa varṇenāṅkitāścihnitāḥ kumbhāstairalaṃkṛtāmityarthaḥ | śṛṅgārasaṃpādakāni mālatīprabhṛtisugandhipuṣpāṇi teṣāṃ nikarāḥ samūhāstaiḥ śobhitām | varṇakairnānāvarṇaiḥ śobhitām | puṇyairviprāśīrvacanairityanena daṃpatyorvedyārohaṇakāle viprairāśiṣo deyā iti dyotyate | tribhirdīpairvedyāḥ purobhāge sthāpitairmanoramām | vāditragītanṛtyādyairhṛdayānandadāyinīmityanena daṃpatyorvedyārohaṇakāle vāditragītanṛtyādikaṃ kāraṇīyamiti sūcyate | sāgnivedikāmityanena daṃpatyorvedyārohaṇātpūrvaṃ homopayogināmagnyādīnāmupakalpanaṃ vedyāṃ kāryamiti sūcyate | etacca sāgnītyasya vedikāyā viśeṣaṇatvapakṣe | mithunasya sāgnīti viśeṣaṇaṃ bhinnaṃ padaṃ vedikāpadāt | etasminpakṣa ārohaṇasamaye'gnervedikāyāmupakalpanaṃ jñeyam | evaṃvidhāmuktaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāṃ vediṃ mithunamārurukṣet | vadhvā sahaiva vara ārohaṇaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | keśavārko'pi -- "vedikāṃ viracayedyathā tathā syādiyaṃ praviśataḥ pradakṣiṇā | syurjanāśrayayavoptivarṇakāḥ ṣaṇnavatridivaseṣu nāgrataḥ" iti | yavoptiraṅkurāropaṇākhyaṃ karma | janāśrayo maṇḍapaḥ | 'maṇḍapo'strī janāśrayaḥ' ityamaraḥ | maṇḍapādinirmāṇe dinānyāha nāradaḥ -- "navatriṣaṣṭho navavārakaḥ śubho na varṇakenāpi vivāhamaṇḍapaḥ" iti | navame tṛtīye ṣaṣṭhe ca divase navavārako na śubhaḥ | navavārako'ṅkurāropaṇam | varṇakenānukalpatayā vivāhamaṇḍapanirmāṇamapi navamādidineṣu na śubham | mukhyakalpena tannirmāṇe tveteṣu dineṣu sutarāṃ na kāryamityāśayaḥ | vivāhārtho maṇḍapo varṇakenaiva kriyamāṇo na śubho'nyārthastu varṇakenaiva kriyamāṇo'pi śubha iti kecit | daivajñamanoharaḥ -- "citrā viśākhā śatatārakā'śvinī jyeṣṭhābharaṇyau śivabhāccatuṣṭayam | hitvā praśastaṃ phalatailavedikāpradānakaṃ kaṇḍanamaṇḍapādikam" iti | śivabhamārdrānakṣatraṃ tadārabhyā''śleṣāntaṃ nakṣatracatuṣṭayaṃ hitvetyarthaḥ | hemādrau vyāsaḥ -- "kaṇḍanadalanayavārakamaṇḍapamṛdvedivarṇakānyakhilam | tatsaṃbandhi gatāgatamṛkṣe vaivāhike kuryāt" iti | yavārakaṃ bhāṣayā 'cikasā' iti | jyotirnibandhe nāradaḥ -- "kartavyaṃ ma ṅgaleṣvādau maṅgalāyāṅkurārpaṇam | navame saptame vā'pi pañcame divase'pi vā | tṛtīye bījanakṣatre śubhavāre śubhodaye | samyaggṛhāṇyalaṃkṛtya vitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ | saha vāditranṛtyādyairgatvā prāguttarāṃ diśam | tatra mṛtsikatāḥ ślakṣṇā gṛhītvā punarāgataḥ | mṛtsikatā mṛtpāṃsavaḥ | mṛnmayeṣvatha pātreṣu vaiṇaveṣvatha vā kṣipet | anekabījasaṃyuktāṃ toyapuṣpopaśobhitām" iti | jyotirnibandhe viśeṣaḥ -- "yasyāṅgaṃ yadado'ṅgino gaditabhe kuryādihendorbalaṃ nā''lokyaṃ tu vivāhatastrya3ri6navā9hni prāṅna kuryādidam" iti | asyārthaḥ -- yasya karmaṇo yadaṅgam, ada idamaṅgino mukhyasya gaditabha uktanakṣatre kuryāt | ihāsminnaṅgabhūte karmaṇi, indoścandrasya balaṃ nā''lokyaṃ na vicāraṇīyam | tatra vivāhe viśeṣaḥ | vivāhato vivāhadinātprāktryarinavāhni tṛtīyaṣaṣṭhanavame'hni, idamaṅgaṃ vivāhāṅgaṃ na kuryāt | tatra vivāhāṅgaṃ navavidham | taduktaṃ jyotirnibandhe -- "dalanaṃ kaṇḍanaṃ caiva vyañjanaṃ modakāni ca | yavāraṃ maṇḍapo vediḥ kuṅkumaṃ varṇakaṃ tathā" iti | "kāryaṃ vivāhāṅgamidaṃ vivāhabhairyuñjanti nātrendubalābalaṃ budhāḥ | ṣaṣṭhe tṛtīye navame'hni lagnataḥ pūrvaṃ na varṇo na yavāramaṇḍapau" iti | śārṅgadharīye -- "dalanakaṇḍanamaṇḍanavedikāgṛhasaṃmārjanavārakamaṇḍapāḥ | karatalagrahamadhyagatāgataṃ tadakhilaṃ vidadhīta vivāhabhe | vivāhakṛtyaṃ nikhilaṃ vivāhabhe vilokayennātra balaṃ himadyuteḥ | navatriṣaṣṭhe'hni vivāhapūrvato na varṇako maṇḍapatailamaṅgalam" iti | dalanaṃ godhūmādeḥ piṣṭakaraṇam | kaṇḍanaṃ taṇḍulādermuśalāghātādinā śodhanam | vyañjanaṃ parpaṭādi | modakāni ghṛtapācitānnāni | yavāro(raṃ) yavārakaḥ(kaṃ) 'cikasā' iti | vāraka ityapi pāṭhaḥ | vārako maṅgalakalaśaḥ | maṇḍapo janāśrayaḥ | vedirvadhūvarayorupaveśanārthaṃ catvaram | kuṅkumaṃ gandhādi | varṇakaṃ cūrṇagairikacitralekhanādi | anena mārjanopalepanādikamapi saṃgrāhyam | nikhilamanantaroktam | atha kanyāyā janmakālikagrahādisūcitavaidhavyaparihāropāyaḥ karmavipāke -- "brāhmaṇaṃ sādhumāmantrya saṃpūjya vividhārhaṇaiḥ | tasmai dadyādvidhānena viṣṇumūrtiṃ caturbhujām || śuddhavarṇāṃ suvarṇena vittaśaktyā'thavā kṛtām | rucirāṃ nirmitāṃ śaṅkhagadācakrābjasaṃyutām || dadhānāṃ vāsasī pīte kumudotpalamālinīm | sadakṣiṇāṃ ca tāṃ dadyānmantrametamudīrayet || yanmayā prāci januṣi ghnantyā(tyā) patisamāgamam | viṣopaviṣaśastrādyairhato vā'tiviraktayā || prāpnuvantyā(tyā) mahāghoraṃ yaśaḥsaukhyadhanāpaham | vaidhavyādyatiduḥkhaughanāśāya sukhalabdhaye || bahusaubhāgyalabdhyai ca mahāviṣṇorimāṃ tanum | suvarṇanirmitāṃ śaktyā tubhyaṃ saṃpradade dvija || anaghā'dyāhamasmīti trivāraṃ prajapettataḥ | evamastviti tasyoktiṃ gṛhītvā svagṛhaṃ viśet" iti || suvarṇaśabdo'tra jātivācī | parimāṇaṃ tu palatadardhatadardhānyatamaṃ śaktyā jñeyam | atha prayogaḥ | kanyā snānācamane kṛtvā deśakālau saṃkīrtya vaidhavyaharaṃ mahāviṣṇumūrtidānaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya sādhuṃ vinītamadhyayanasaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇamāhūya tamācāryatvena vṛtvā vividhairupacārairyathāvibhavaṃ saṃpūjya taddhastenāgnyu ttāraṇaṃ prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ pūjanaṃ ca kārayet | vastrārpaṇakāle pīte vāsasī dāpanīye | puṣpārpaṇakāle kumudotpalamālā'pi dāpanīyā | pūjānte devaṃ praṇamya -- "yanmayā prāci januṣi ghnantyā(tyā) patisamāgamam | viṣopaviṣaśastrādyairhato vā'tiviraktayā || prāpnuvantyā(tyā) mahāghoraṃ yaśaḥsaukhyadhanāpaham | vaidhavyādyatiduḥkhaughanāśāya sukhalabdhaye || bahusaubhāgyalabdhyai ca mahāviṣṇorimāṃ tanum | suvarṇanirmitāṃ śaktyā tubhyaṃ saṃpradade dvija" || iti paṭhitvā tāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyāt | tataḥ suvarṇaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā'naghā'dyāhamasmīti trirvadet | evamastvityācāryastrivāraṃ pratibrūyāt | tato yathāśakti brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā karmeśvarāyārpayet | evaṃ kṛte vivāhayogyā bhavati | iti vaidhavyaharapratimādānavidhiḥ | atha kumbhavivāhaḥ | athavā vaidhavyaparihārāya kumbhavivāhaḥ kāryaḥ | sa coktastatraiva -- "vivāhātpūrvadivase candratārābalānvite | vivāhokte tathā lagne kanyāṃ kumbhena codvahet || sūtreṇa veṣṭayetpaścāddaśatantuvidhānataḥ | kumbhamālaṃkṛtaṃ dehaṃ tayorekāntamandire || tataḥ kumbhaṃ ca niḥsārya prabhajya salilāśaye | tato'bhiṣecanaṃ kuryātpañcapallavavāribhiḥ" iti || ā samantāccandanapuṣpādibhiralaṃkṛtaṃ kumbhaṃ kanyādehaṃ ca veṣṭayedityanvayaḥ | tayostadubhayasaṃbandhini mandire | atha prayogaḥ | kanyāvivāhakartā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau sakīrtya mamāsyāḥ kanyāyā vaidhavyaharaṃ kumbhavivāhaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśapūjanādināndī śrāddhāntaṃ kṛtvā varuṇaviṣṇupratimayoragnyuttāraṇaṃ kṛtvā mahī dyaurityādividhinā kumbhasthāpanam | tasminkumbhe varuṇapratimāyāṃ kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭhāyāṃ varuṇapūjanaṃ ca vidhāya kṛtaprāṇapratiṣṭhāyāṃ kalaśe sthāpitāyāṃ viṣṇupratimāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya prārthayet -- "varuṇāṅgasvarūpāya jīvanānāṃ samāśraya | patiṃ jīvaya kanyāyāścitraṃ putrasukhaṃ kuru || dehi viṣṇo varaṃ deva kanyāṃ pālaya duḥkhataḥ" iti || tato viṣṇurūpiṇe kumbhāyemāṃ kanyāṃ śrīrūpiṇīṃ samarpayāmīti samarpya pari tvetyādibhirvakṣyamāṇairveṣṭanamantrairadhastādupariṣṭācca mantrāvṛttyā kumbhaṃ kanyāṃ ca pariveṣṭya kumbhaṃ niḥsārya salilāśaye prabhañjayitvā(ñjya) pañcapallavaiḥ śuddhajalena samudrajyeṣṭhā ityādimantraiḥ kanyāmabhiṣicya brāhmaṇānbhojayet | iti kumbhavivāhavidhiḥ | atha vāgdānavidhiḥ | kaśyapasaṃhitāyām -- "athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kanyāvaraṇamuttamam | samyaktasyāḥ pradānaṃ ca putrapautrapravardhanam || pañcāṅgaśuddhidivase candratārābalānvite | vivāhokteṣu ṛkṣeṣu kujavarjitavāsare || māsādyadivasaṃ riktāmaṣṭamīṃ navamīṃ tathā | tyaktvā'nyadivase gandhasraktaṇḍulaphalādibhiḥ || sahavṛddhadvijagaṇo varayetkanyakāṃ satīm | tatheti tatpitā kanyāvaraṇoktarkṣavāsare || kuryātpradānaṃ kanyāyāḥ svastivācanapūrvakam | kulaśīlaguṇopetāṃ surūpāya varāya vai || tatastasmai kanyakāṃ ca śuklāmbaravibhūṣaṇām | dadyānmaṅgalaghoṣaiśca viprāśīrvacanaiḥ saha || ādau kṛtvā śacīpūjāṃ paścātsarvaṃ samācaret | suvarṇāṃ padmapatrākṣīṃ divyasragvastraśobhitām || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | anarghyamaṇimālābhirbhāsayantīṃ digantaram || vilāsinīsahasraughaiḥ sevyamānāmaharniśam | dhyātvā praṇamya tāṃ devīṃ kumārīṃ(rī) prārthayettataḥ || devendrāṇi namastubhyaṃ devendrapriyabhāmini | vivāhaṃ bhāgyamārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dehi me" iti || nakṣatrāṇyuktāni jyotirnibandhe -- "viśvapūrvātrayakarṇayugmāśvinyagnimaitraiśca vivāhabhairvā | pratyaṅmukhastāṃ varayetkumārīṃ phalādibhiḥ prāgvadanāṃ suveṣām" iti | viśvarkṣamuttarāṣāḍhāḥ | pūrvātrayaṃ pūrvā(rva)phalgunīpūrvāṣāḍhāpūrvā(rva)proṣṭhapadāḥ | karṇayugmaṃ śravaṇaṃ dhaniṣṭhāśca | agniḥ kṛttikāḥ maitramanurādhāḥ | smṛtyantare -- "kuryādvaivāhike māsi vāgdānaṃ dvijasattamaḥ | dhiṣṇye vaivāhike caiva maṇḍapādi samācaret" iti || dhiṣṇyaṃ nakṣatram | varasyāpi varaṇamāha caṇḍeśvaraḥ -- "upavītaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca | deyaṃ varāya varaṇe kanyāpitrā dvijena vā" iti || atha tatprayogaḥ | jyotirvidādiṣṭe śubhe muhūrte varapitrādiriṣṭabandhuvṛddhamānyajanapurandhrībhirmāṅgalikatūryaghoṣaiśca sahitaḥ śakunadarśanapūrvakaṃ kanyāgṛhametya prāṅgaṇa upaviśet | tato vṛddhaḥ kaścitkanyāpitaraṃ prati brūyāt | asya putro varo'sti tadarthaṃ bhavatkanyāṃ yācituṃ suhṛdbhiḥ sahāyamāgataḥ | bhavadbhiḥ svīyaiḥ saha vicārya kanyāpūjanārthametebhyo'nujñā deyeti | tataḥ kanyāpitā mānyajaneṣṭabandhvādyanujñāṃ gṛhītvā dattā mayā pūjanārthamanujñeti tebhyo'nujñāṃ dadyāt | tataḥ kanyāyāḥ purohitādiścatuṣpāde śubhravastrācchādite pīṭhe "oṃ anṛkṣarā ṛja0 stu devāḥ" "oṃ devīṃ vācamaja0 suṣṭutaitu" itimantrābhyāṃ prāṅmukhīṃ śuklavastrāṃ sālaṃkārāṃ suveṣāṃ kanyāmupaveśayet | tato varapitā kanyāyāḥ purobhāge pratyaṅmukha upaviśya kanyāpitrādisamīpe gaṇapatyādismaraṇapūrvakamamukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāyāmukaprapautrāyāmukapautrāyāmukaputrāyāmukaśarmaṇe varāya, amukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāmamukaprapautrīmamukapautrīmamukaputrīmamukanāmnīṃ kanyāṃ bhāryātvāya vṛṇīmaha iti kanyāpitaraṃ prati vadet | dātā bhāryeṣṭabandhvādyanumatiṃ gṛhītvā pūrvoktamanūdyānanūdya vā vṛṇīdhvamiti vadet | evaṃ punardviḥ | tataḥ pradāsyāmīti dātoccaistrirvadet | tato varapitā kanyāñjaliṃ kuṅkumagandhenānulipyeṣṭabandhvādibhyaḥ prārthayet | te ca mahālakṣmīriyamiti brūyuḥ | tato varapitā kanyābhālaṃ candanenānulipya svapakṣīyasuvāsinībhirnīrājanaṃ kārayet | tatastaṇḍulākṣatāṃstasyā bhāle saṃyojya yuvaṃ vastrāṇīti vastrāṇi dattvā'gne retaścandra hiraṇyamiti bhūṣaṇāni dadyāt | tato yāḥ phalinīriti phalaiḥ saṃpūjya tasyā haste phalatāmbūlādi dattvā sumukhaścetyādideśakālasaṃkīrtanānte kanyāpūjanaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāditi śiṣṭāḥ | naiva saṃkalpa iti tu yuktam | kanyāpitustu kanyāyā vāgdānamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaḥ | nāyamapi saṃkalpa iti tu yuktam | tata ubhau gaṇapatipūjanaṃ yathācāraṃ kalaśe varuṇapūjanaṃ ca kuryātāṃ visarjanaṃ ca | atrā''cāraścetsvastivācanamapi | tato varapitā kanyāyā dakṣiṇata udaṅmukho vāmataḥ prāṅmukho vopaviśya kanyāṃ gandhākṣatapuṣpavastrādibhiḥ pūjayet | tataḥ kanyādātā varapitaraṃ prāṅmukhamupaveśya svayaṃ tasya purataḥ pratyaṅmukha upaviśya taṃ gandhatāmbūlādibhiḥ pūjayet | sa ca dātāram | tato dātā''cārāddharidrākhaṇḍaṃ gandhākṣatayutāni pañca dṛḍhāni pūgīphalāni ca gṛhītvā'mukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāyāmukaprapautrāyāmukapautrāyāmukaputrāyāmukaśarmaṇe varāya,amukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāmamukaprapautrīmamukapautrīmamukasya mama putrīmamukanāmnīṃ kanyāṃ jyotirvidādiṣṭe muhūrte dāsya iti vācā saṃpradada ityuktvā, -- "avyaṅge'patite'klībe daśadoṣavivarjite | imāṃ kanyāṃ pradāsyāmi devāgnidvijasaṃnidhau" | iti varapitrādivastraprānte nikṣipya narya prajāmiti pratiṣṭhāpanamantreṇa vastraprānte baddhvā granthiṃ candanena carcayedityācāraprāptam | pitāmahakartṛke vāgdāne pautrīmityataḥ pūrvameva mameti vadet | evaṃ sakulyatvena prapitāmahakartṛke prapautrīmityataḥ pūrvaṃ mameti | bhrātrādikartṛke tu mameti naiva kutrāpi | tato haridrākhaṇḍaṃ gandhākṣatayutāni pañca dṛḍhapūgīphalāni ca tathaiva varapitrādirgṛhītvā'mukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāmukaśarmavaraviṣaye bhavanto niścitā bhavantu, iti kanyāpitrādivastraprānte pūrvavatprakṣipya granthiṃ candanena carcayet | tato dātā -- "vācā dattā mayā kanyā putrārthaṃ svīkṛtā tvayā | kanyāvalokanavidhau niścitastvaṃ sukhī bhava" | iti varapitaraṃ prati vadet | "vācā dattā tvayā kanyā putrārthaṃ svīkṛtā mayā | varāvalokanavidhau niścitastvaṃ sukhī bhava" | iti varapitā kanyāpitaraṃ prati vadet | pautrādivivāhe pautrārthaṃ bhrātrarthaṃ mitrārthaṃ sakulyārthamityubhayatra yathāyathamūhaḥ | athavā varārthaṃ svīkṛtetyeva sarvatra | tato brāhmaṇāḥ śivā āpaḥ santu | saumanasyamastu | akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstu | dīrghamāyuḥ śreyaḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiścāstu | etadvaḥ satyamastviti vadeyuḥ | tato dātā vivāhasaubhāgyādyabhivṛddhyarthaṃ śacīpūjanaṃ kārayet | saṃkalpamapyatrecchanti kecit | "suvarṇāṃ padmapatrākṣīṃ divyasragvastraśobhitām | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām | anarghyamaṇimālābhirbhāsayantīṃ digantaram | vilāsinīsahasraughaiḥ sevyamānāmaharniśam" | itīndrāṇīṃ dhyātvā sitataṇḍulapuñja āvāhanādyupacāraiḥ pūjanaṃ vadhvā kārayet | tataḥ -- "devendrāṇi namastubhyaṃ devendrapriyabhāmini | vivāhaṃ bhāgyamārogyaṃ putralābhaṃ ca dehi me" iti prārthanāṃ kārayet | tataḥ purandhrībhirnīrājanādimāṅgalikaṃ kāryam | viprāśca gandhatāmbūlādibhiḥ pūjitā āśīrmantrānpaṭheyuḥ | te ca -- oṃ samiddhasya śraya0 mahate saubhagāya | oṃ vanaspate śatavalśo0 ya mahate saubhagāya 2 oṃ saṃdivye nadī0ṣṭa mahate saubhagāya 3 oṃ narya prajāṃ me0 ṣṭhitām | oṃ tadastu mitrā0 sādanāya | oṃ gṛhā vai pratiṣṭhā sūktaṃ tatprati0" iti ca paṭhet | iti vāgdānaprayogaḥ | atha varasya vadhūgṛhaṃ prati gamanam | tadvidhiḥ śaunakenoktaḥ -- "puṇye muhūrte kurvīta vivāhaṃ vidhivaddvijaḥ | tatrā''bhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryātsvasti ca vācayet | aparedyuḥ kṛtasnāno dhṛtadhautāmbaro varaḥ | bhūṣito gandhamālyādyaiḥ śakunena samanvitaḥ | brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā'nte kṛtapuṇyāhavācanaḥ | kṛtakautukabandhaśca mitrabandhvādisaṃyutaḥ | yānaṃ yathārhamāruhya gantavyaṃ ca vadhūgṛham | tasya dvārādbahiḥ sthitvā prāṅmukho'bhimukhāgataiḥ | tasya vadhūgṛhasya | gṛhītapūrṇakumbhādipāṇibhirvanitājanaiḥ | kṛtābhyudgamano gehaṃ praviśetsaha bandhubhiḥ" iti | ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryāt | svasti vācayedityatrāntarbhāvito ṇijjñeyaḥ | anyathā nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitā kuryādityanena virodhāpatteḥ | nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitā kuryādityatra nāndīśrāddhagrahaṇaṃ svastivācanāderupalakṣaṇam | tathaiva śiṣṭasamācārāt | nāndīśrāddhamātraṃ pitṛkartṛkaṃ svastivācanaṃ tu varakartṛkamevetyasminmata ābhyudayikaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryādityekatraiva ṇijjñeyaḥ | kṛtapuṇyāhavācana itivacanādvadhūgṛhagamanakāle vareṇa pañcavākyaiḥ puṇyāhavācanaṃ kāryamiti kecit | anuvādo'yamityanye | iti varasya vadhūgṛhaṃ prati gamanam | atha gaurīharapūjanavidhiḥ | saṃgrahe -- "lagnāhe mātṛkāḥ pūjyāḥ pūjyā gaurī harānvitā | pīṭhe vai tadalābhe tu suślakṣṇe taṇḍulānvite | paṅkajaṃ kārayitvā tu tatra gaurīharau yajet | kalaśaiḥ kalaśaiḥ kāryāḥ pidhānottarapaṅktikāḥ || diśāṃ caturṣu koṇeṣu sthāpayettaṇḍulopari | pratimāṃ palahemnā tu kuryādgaurīharau tataḥ || tatra -- paladvayena raupyeṇa kuryānnandinamagrataḥ | aśaktastu tadardhena pādena śaktito'thavā || alābhe kuṅkumādyaistu lekhayitvā prapūjayet | dhyātvā mantreṇa devau dvau bhaktyā saṃpūjayetsudhīḥ || siṃhāsanasthāṃ deveśīṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutām | pītāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharam || kareṇādhaḥ sudhāpūrṇaṃ kalaśaṃ dakṣiṇena tu | varadaṃ cābhayaṃ vāmenā''śliṣya ca tanupriyām || evaṃ dhyātvā''pūjya gaurīṃ puṇyabhājastathā striyaḥ | kanyāṃ samudvahetpaścādyathoktavidhinā dhruvam" iti || pūjāmantrastatraiva -- "gaurīharau maheśānau sarvamaṅgaladāyakau | pūjāṃ gṛhṇītāṃ deveśau maṅgalaṃ kurutāṃ sadā" iti || tathā -- "kanyādehapramāṇena saptaviṃśatitantubhiḥ | vartikāṃ dīpayetpaścādvratasaṃpattihetave || bhojanīyā brāhmaṇāśca suvāsinyaḥ supūjitāḥ | daśāṣṭau pañca yugmaṃ vā hiraṇyenātha toṣayet" iti || vivāhe vadhūvarayoḥ saha bhojanamāha saṃgrahakāraḥ -- "mātrā sahopanītasya vivāhe bhāryayā saha| bhuñjītānyatra saha cetpātityaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ" iti || hemādrau prāyaścittakāṇḍe gālavo'pi -- "ekayānasamāroha ekapātre ca bhojanam | vivāhe pathi yātrāyāṃ kṛtvā vipro na doṣabhāk || anyathā doṣamāpnoti tatra cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" iti | smṛtiratnākare śākalaḥ -- "parirakṣanbrahmacaryaṃ saha śayyāsanāśanaiḥ | vadhvā saha vasettatra yāvaddinacatuṣṭayam" iti || saṃgrahe -- "ekāsanaṃ caikaśayyā ekapātre ca bhojanam | ekatra maṅgalaṃ snānamekavāhanarohaṇam || kurvanvivāha etāni bhavedvipro na doṣabhāk" iti | vipragrahaṇaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayorupalakṣaṇam | atrāhatavastre viśeṣamāha kaśyapaḥ -- "ahataṃ yantranirmuktaṃ vāsaḥ proktaṃ svayaṃbhuvā | śastaṃ tanmāṅgalikyeṣu tāvatkālaṃ na sarvadā" iti || atha lagnaghaṭīsthāpanam | "prāgudakpravaṇe deśe gomayenopalepite | mṛnmayaṃ kuṇḍikāyugmaṃ sthāpayedavraṇaṃ śubham || kuṅkumāktena sūtreṇa pariveṣṭya parasparam | svacchena vāriṇā pūrṇaṃ taṇḍulānāmathopari || niścale salile paścātkuḍikāyāṃ jalopari | sthāpayeddhaṭikāyantraṃ sūryabimbānudarśanāt" iti || ghaṭikālakṣaṇamāha vāmanaḥ -- "daśapalasiddhakamale susūkṣmānte paḍaṅgulocchrāye | dvādaśāṅgulapariṇāhe ṣaṣṭyā palaiḥ pūritā ghaṭikā || caturaṅgulaśalākāvṛttaṃ kuryātsuvarṇapādena | tatparimityā chidre talasthite śobhanā ghaṭikā" iti || susūkṣmo'nto yasya tat | ṣoḍaśamāṣaparimitaṃ suvarṇaṃ tasya pādaścaturthāṃśo māṣacatuṣṭayaparimitaḥ | nārado'pi -- "ṣaḍaṅgulamitotsedhaṃ dvādaśāṅgulamāyatam | kuryātkamalavattāmrapātraṃ taddaśabhiḥ palaiḥ || māṣatrayatryaṃśayutasvarṇavṛttaśalākayā | vedāṅgulaiḥ saṃmitayā tayā viddhamatisphuṭam" iti || "tāmrapātre vāripūrṇe mṛtpātre'pyathavā śubhe | maṇḍalārdhodayaṃ vīkṣya ravestatra vinikṣipet" iti[ca] | tatra jale| "mukhyaṃ tvamasi yantrāṇāṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā | bhāvābhāvāya daṃpatyoḥ kālasādhanakāraṇam" || iti ghaṭikāpātranikṣepaṇamantraḥ | iti ghaṭikāsthāpanam | atha ghaṭīyantrabhramaṇaphalam | jyotirnibandhe -- "yadrūpaṃ prathamaṃ karoti ghaṭikā pūrvādidikṣu kramātsaubhāgyaṃ nidhanaṃ yaśovirahitaṃ yuktaṃ ca rogaiḥ kramāt | kanyā vallabhatāmupaiti niyataṃ yā niścalā sarvadā syātsādhvī sutavittabandhusahitā nandatyalaṃ bhūtale" iti || granthāntare -- "prārthitā sā ghaṭī toye yāṃ diśaṃ prati gacchati | pūrvāśādiphalaṃ kuryātsthitā madhye dhanapradā || saubhāgyaṃ nidhanaṃ nāryā apamṛtyurujānvitā | bhartuḥ priyā ca vaśyā ca mānyā vittasukhānvitā" iti || prārthitā mukhyaṃ tvamasi yantrāṇāmiti mantreṇa prārthitā | anyacca -- "uttareśānapūrvāsu ghaṭī pūrṇā śubhapradā | dikṣu śeṣāsu kanyāyā magnā vaidhavyadāyinī" iti || saptarṣimate vivāhapaṭale -- prapūjayeddaivavidaṃ svaśaktyā gandhādipuṣpāmbaradakṣiṇābhiḥ | saṃpūjite daivavidi pratuṣṭe tuṣyanti sarvā grahadevatāśca" iti || daivavillagnapradātā | tallakṣaṇaṃ vyatirekeṇā''ha saṃvartaḥ -- "andhaḥ śvitrī ca kunakhī hīnāṅgaḥ paṅgureva ca | lagnaprado bhavedyatra kulakṣayakaraṃ hi tat" iti || yatra lagnapradāne | tallagnapradānam | lagnakālalakṣaṇamuktaṃ nāradena -- "svasthe nare sukhāsīne yāvatspandati locanam | tasya triṃśakṣamo bhāgastatparaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || tatparācchatamo bhāgastruṭirityabhidhīyate | truṭeḥ sahasrabhāgo yo lagnakālaḥ sa ucyate || devo'pi taṃ na jānāti kiṃ punaḥ prākṛto janaḥ | sa kālo'pyanyakālo vā pūrvakarmavaśādbhavet || nimittamātraṃ daivajñastadvaśācca śubhāśubham" iti | bṛhaspatistu -- "śubhagrahodayarkṣā vā śubhaṣaḍvarga eva vā | vedavijñānavākyaṃ ca mahāntaḥ śubhadā guṇāḥ" iti || vedavijñānavākyaṃ cetyetaddvedhā vyākhyātaṃ pārijāte -- vedasya vijñānaṃ yeṣāṃ te vedavijñānāḥ, vedavedāṅgatattvajñānāsteṣāṃ vākyam | athavā vijānantīti vijñānāḥ | 'kṛtyalyuṭo bahulam' iti nimittakartari lyuṭ | vedasya vijñānā vedavijñānā iti sa evārthaḥ | teṣāṃ vākyaṃ tu sumuhūrtamastvityevaṃrūpamityarthaḥ | api ca -- vedairvijñāyata iti vedavijñāno vedavedyo lakṣmīpatiḥ | bahulagrahaṇātkarmaṇi lyuṭ | tasya lakṣmīpateścaraṇasmaraṇarūpaṃ vākyaṃ tadeva lagnamityādi | etaduktaṃ bhavati | muhūrtakāle sumuhūrtamastu | "tadeva lagnaṃ sudinaṃ tadeva tārābalaṃ candrabalaṃ tadeva | vidyābalaṃ daivabalaṃ tadeva lakṣmīpate te'ghriyugaṃ smarāmi" iti coktvā muhūrtaṃ dadyāditi | gandhādītyatrā''diśabdenālaṃkāragrahaṇam | saṃkaṭe godhūlikalagnapravṛttiruktā jyotirnibandhe -- "ghaṭīlagnaṃ yadā nāsti tadā godhūlikaṃ śubham | śūdrādīnāṃ budhāḥ prāhurna dvijānāṃ kadācana || lagnaśuddhiryadā na syādyauvane samupasthite | tadā vai sarvavarṇānāṃ lagnaṃ godhūlikaṃ śubham" iti || prathamavivāhe nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitṛkartṛkameva -- "nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitā kuryādādye pāṇigrahe punaḥ | ata ūrdhvaṃ prakurvīta svayameva tu nāndikam" iti || pitrabhāve pitāmahādyanyatamaḥ | sarveṣāmabhāve svayameveti nibandhakṛtaḥ | reṇukārikāsu viśeṣaḥ -- "ukte kāle vivāhāṅgaṃ kuryānnāndīmukhaṃ pitā | deśāntare vivāhaścettatra gatvā bhavedidam" iti || grāmāntare vivāhaścedityapi kvacitpāṭhaḥ | nāndīmukhamiti svastivācanamaṇḍapadevatāsthāpanādyupalakṣaṇam | gṛhapraveśasthālīpākādikaṃ tu svagṛhaṃ gatvaiva | idānīṃ tu tatraiva kurvanti tacchithilam | atha vivāhaprayogaḥ | kanyādātā sumuhūrte gṛhāṅgaṇa uktalakṣaṇaṃ toraṇādiyuktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā tatra vadhūhastacatuṣṭayaparimāṇāṃ hastasaptakahastapañcakānyataraparimāṇāṃ vā samacaturaśrāṃ hastamātrocchrāyāṃ sopānayutāṃ suślakṣṇāmuktalakṣaṇāṃ vediṃ kuryāt | varapitrā tu svagṛha uktalakṣaṇo maṇḍapa eva kāryo na vediḥ | tato yathākālaṃ vaivāhike jyotirvidādiṣṭe śubhe muhūrte kanyāpakṣīyapurandhryo vadhūṃ sugandhitailayavārakaharidrādimaṅgaladravyairudvartanapūrvakamuṣṇodakena yathācāraṃ saṃsnāpya tacchiṣṭadravyairudvartanapūrvakaṃ tathaiva varaṃ saṃsnāpayeyurityācāraḥ | tataḥ kanyādātā vivāhadine tatpūrvadine vā pūrvāhṇe kṛtamāṅgalikasnāno dhṛtamāṅgalikaveṣa upalipte raṅgavallikāyukte prāṅgaṇe śubhravastrācchādite pīṭhāsane prāṅmukha upaviśya svasya dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtamāṅgalikasnānāṃ dhṛtamāṅgalikaveṣāṃ patnīṃ tasyā dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtamāṅgalikasnānāṃ dhṛtamāṅgalikaveṣāṃ kanyāṃ copaveśyā''camya prāṇānāyamyeṣṭadevatāgurvādīnnamaskṛtya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamāsyā amukanāmnyāḥ kanyāyā brāhmavivāhavidhinā vivāhasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | mamāsyāḥ kanyāyā bhartrā saha dharmaprajotpādanadravyaparigraheṣvadhikārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ brāhmavivāhavidhinā vivāhasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ vā saṃkalpaḥ | pitāmahastu mamāsyā amukanāmnyāḥ pautryā ityevaṃ vadet | prapitāmahastu prapautryā iti | bhrātṛpitṛvyādayastu bhaginyā bhrātṛkanyāyā ityādi saṃbandhānusāreṇa vadet | athavā -- amukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpanno'mukaśarmā'haṃ mama samastapitṝṇāṃ niratiśayasānandabrahmalokāvāptyādikanyāpratipādanakalpoktaphalāvāptaye mayā parikalpitena vareṇāsyāṃ kanyāyāmutpādayiṣyamāṇasaṃtatyā dvādaśāvarāndvādaśa parānpuruṣānpavitrīkartumātmanaśca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprītyarthamamukanāmnyā asyāḥ kanyāyāḥ pratipādanarūpaṃ vivāhaṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ saṃkalpaḥ | asminpakṣe kanyāpratipādane saṃkalpo na kāryaḥ | varapitā tu -- asyāmukaśarmaṇaḥ putrasya vivāhasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | asyāmukaśarmaṇaḥ putrasya daivapitryarṇāpākaraṇasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ vivāhasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ saṃkalpaḥ | pitāmahastu pautrasyeti vadet | prapitāmahastu prapautrasyeti | bhrātṛpitṛvyādistu bhrāturbhrātṛputrasyetyādisaṃbandhānusāreṇa | vastutastu svasya vivāhasaṃskāraṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ varakartṛka eva saṃkalpa iti yuktam | na ca pituḥ svastivācanādyaṅgakartṛtvātsaṃkalpo'pi tatkartṛka eveti vācyam | pradhānānuṣṭhāturvarasyaiva pradhānasaṃkalpakartṛkatāyā ucitatvāt | pāṇigrahaṇaṃ hi pradhānam | tacca varakartṛkam | ato varakartṛka evāyam | "nāndīśrāddhaṃ pitā kuryādādye pāṇigrahe punaḥ" | itivacanānnāndīśrāddhamātraṃ pitṛkartṛkam | nāndīśrāddhaśabdena 'svastivācanamapyupalakṣyata iti kecit | svastivācanādīnāṃ bahirbhūtatvapakṣe pradhānasaṃkalpo vāgdānātpūrvaṃ kanyādānātpūrvaṃ vā kanyādātrā kartavyaḥ | vareṇa vadhūgṛhagamanātpūrvaṃ kartavyaḥ | svastivācanādīnāṃ bahirbhūtatvapakṣe kanyāvivāhaṃ kartumādau puṇyāhavācanamityādisaṃkalpaḥ kanyādātrā kartavyaḥ | varapitrā tu matputravivāhārthaṃ puṇyāhavācanamityādisaṃkalpaḥ kāryaḥ | kanyāvivāhasya varapakṣasaṃpādyavaivāhikasāmagrīdānasahitakriyāyāṃ caritānyatyutkaṭānyācarandevo harṣayatīśvarau sa bhagavānkuryātsadā maṅgalam || 3 || yo'parṇāṅkasutalpake sthita ubhau pītvā stanau satvaraṃ śuṇḍāgreṇa mukhena vā''śu yugapadbālo vibhurvighnarāṭ | smerāsyaḥ kutukāddhimācalasutotsaṅgāddharotsaṅgake gacchannāśu haranmanaḥ sa śivayoḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 4 || yo devasya śivasya tāṇḍavavidhau harṣānmadāyā''gataiḥ kūjadbhirbhramarairyutaṃ kamamalaṃ svīyaṃ dhunāno vibhuḥ | kurvanvalgu subhāṣaṇaṃ skhaladatho hāsyaṃ tanotīśvaro nāṭyaṃ caiva mudāvahaṃ sa bhagavānkuryātsadā maṅgalam || 5 || yo vighnoḍupanāyanābhidhavidhau datte'driputryā śubhe pātre bhikṣitumāhṛteṣu vibudhairbrahmāravīndvādibhiḥ | nānopāyanakeṣu tatra surarāḍdarpaṃ vi(vya)pāsya kramāddharmānvarṇina ācaratyaharahaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 6 || śrīmānkāśyapagotrajo'ruṇaruciryaḥ siṃharāśīśvaraḥ ṣaṭtryāśāsthasuśobhano gurukujābjānāṃ ca mitraṃ raviḥ | daityeṇmandaripuḥ kaliṅgajananaścāgnīśvarau devate | madhye vartulagaindrikāsuvadanaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 1 || candraḥ karkaṭakaprabhuḥ sitaruciścā''treyagotrodbhavaścā''gneyyāṃ caturaśrago'ppatidiśāsyaścābumādaivataḥ | ṣaṭsaptāgnidaśaikaśobhanaphalo jñāriḥ kujārkapriyaḥ kālindītaṭadeśajo himakaraḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 2 || bhaumo yāmimukho'ruṇo yamadiśi tryasre sthito'vantijaḥ svāmī vṛścikameṣayoḥ suragurorarkasya cendoḥ priyaḥ | jñāriḥ ṣaṭtriphalapradaśca vasudhāskandau kramāddaivate bhāradvājakulodbhavaḥ kṣitisutaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 3 || jñaḥ pīto magadheśa uttaramukhaścā''treyagotrodbhavo bāṇasthottaragaḥ priyau ravisitau śatruḥ sa vai śītagoḥ | kanyāyugmapatirdaśāṣṭagacatuḥṣaṇnetragaḥ śobhano viṣṇū dvāvadhidaivate ca śaśijaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 4 || jīvaḥ sindhupatirvidhiḥ surapatirdevau dhanurmīnayoḥ svāmī tvāṅgirasastathottaramukho dīrghe sthitaścottare | sūryendukṣitijapriyo budhasitau śatrū ca patiprabho bāṇadvyadriṣu cāṅkake ca śubhadaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 5 || śukro bhārgavagotrajaḥ sitaruciḥ prācīmukhaḥ pūrvataḥ pañcāsre vaṇijo vṛṣasya ca patirbhojākhyadeśodbhavaḥ | indrāṇīndrasudaivato jñaravijau rātī arātiḥ śaśī sūryaḥ saptadaśartuke ca śubhadaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 6 || mandaḥ kṛṣṇaruciśca vāruṇimukhaḥ saurāṣṭrajaḥ kāśyapaḥ svāmī vai mṛgakumbhayorbhṛgubudhau mitre ravīndū ripū | sthānaṃ paścimadikprajāpatiyamau devau sthitaḥ kārmuke ṣaṭtristhaḥ śubhakṛcchanī ravisutaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 7 || rāhū rāṭhinapūrbhavo'tha ditijaḥ kṛṣṇaśca śūrpāsano yaḥ kālāhisudaivato yamadiśāvaktraśca nīlaprabhaḥ | rakṣodiksthakarālarukkuṭilahṛtpaiṭhīnaservaṃśajaḥ ṣaṭtristhaḥ śubhakṛcca barbarapatiḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 8 || keturjaiminigotrajo'niladiśāsaṃsthaḥ kujendupriyaścitratviḍdhvajapīṭhago yamadiśāvaktraḥ karālāsyaktraḥ | brahmā caiva tu citraguptasahito yasyādhidevaḥ kadaḥ ṣaṭtristhaśca suvedideśajananaḥ kuryātsadā maṅgalam || 9 || evamanyānapi maṅgalaślokānavakāśānurodhena paṭheyuḥ | tataḥ -- "tadeva lagnaṃ sudinaṃ tadeva tārābalaṃ candrabalaṃ tadeva | vidyābalaṃ daivabalaṃ tadeva lakṣmīpate te'ṅghriyugaṃ smarāmi | oṃ pratiṣṭhā" iti jyotirvidā paṭhite viprāḥ sadyo'ntaḥpaṭamudagapasārya vadhūvarābhyāṃ parasparaṃ sumuhūrte nirīkṣaṇaṃ kārayeyuḥ | tato vadhūvarābhyāṃ parasparamañjalisthataṇḍulajīrakāvakiraṇaṃ kanyāpūrvakaṃ kārayeyurācārāt | tato dvijā ṛkca vetyādīni khaṇḍāni prajāpatiḥ soma rājānamasṛjate tyanuvākaṃ si he vyāghra ityanuvākamasme devāsa iti caturo mantrāṃśca paṭheyuḥ | tattadante'kṣatāropaṇaṃ cā''cārāt | atha kanyādānam | atra rātrāvapi snānamāha vṛddhayājñavalkyaḥ -- "grahaṇodvāhasaṃkrāntiyātrārtiprasaveṣu vai | snānaṃ naimittikaṃ jñeyaṃ rātrāvapi tadiṣyate" iti || vyāsaḥ -- "mahāniśā tu vijñeyā madhyayāmadvayaṃ niśi | tasyāṃ snānaṃ na kurvīta kāmyanaimittikādṛte || pradoṣe paścime yāme dinavatsnānamācaret" iti || madhyayāmayostu viśeṣamāhātriḥ -- "rātrau snānaṃ yadi bhavetpaśyannagniṃ samācaret | svarṇāṅgulikaro vipro vahninā vā vinā caret" iti || prayogadarpaṇe smṛtyantare -- "kanyādānaṃ niśīthe ceddivā bhojanamiṣyate | kāle snānaṃ prakurvīta kanyāṃ dadyādvarāya tu" iti || vivāhe pradhānadvayaṃ kanyādānaṃ pāṇigrahaṇaṃ ca | ādyaṃ kanyāpitaraṃ prati | kanyādānasya prādhānyaṃ tu -- "brāhme vivāhe śaktiviṣayeṇālaṃkṛtya dadyāt" iti dharmasūtrāt "alaṃkṛtya kanyāmudakapūrvāṃ dadyādeṣa brāhmo vivāhaḥ" | ityāśvalāyanasūtrācca dānavivāhaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyapratīteḥ | pāṇigrahaṇasya tu -- "pāṇigrahaṇādiragnistamaupāsanamityācakṣate" iti sūtrāt "pāṇigrahaṇādadhi gṛhamedhinorvratam" | iti dharmasūtrācca prādhānyaṃ jñeyam | caulakarmopanayanagodānavivāhakālānabhidhāya teṣāṃ purastāccatasra ājyāhutīrjuhuyādityetadāśvalāyanasūtramapyatra mānam | anyathā tacchabdena parāmṛṣṭādvivāhātpūrvamuktasya homasyāsaṃgatyāpateḥ | na hi kanyādānātpurastādeva tā āhutayaḥ santi | smṛtyarthasāre vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ -- "nāndīmukhe vivāhe ca prapitāmahapūrvakam | nāma saṃkīrtayedvidvānanyatra pitṛpūrvakam" iti || nāndīmukhe prapitāmahapūrvakatvaṃ yacchākhāyāṃ vihitaṃ bhavati tadviṣayaṃ nāsmatsūtraviṣayam | asmatsūtre tasya vidhānābhāvādyajñatantracauṇḍapācāryarāmāṇḍārādibhirānulomyasyaivoktatvācca | kecittu nāndīmukha iti vivāhaviśeṣaṇam | pitrādiprayojakatvena harṣasaṃpādaka iti tadarthaḥ | castvartha ityāhuḥ | anayā rītyā nāndīmukhe prapitāmahapūrvakatvasyāprāptireva | asminmate rākṣasādivivāhasya harṣasaṃpādakatvābhāvānna tatra prapitāmahapūrvakatvam | vyāsaḥ -- "bhuktvā samudvahetkanyāṃ sāvitrīgrahaṇaṃ tathā | upoṣitaḥ sutāṃ dadyādarcitāya dvijāya tu" iti || bhuktveti madhuparkāṅgabhojanaparam | madanaratna ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ -- "varagotraṃ samuccārya prapitāmahapūrvakam | nāma saṃkīrtayedvidvānkanyāyāścaivameva hi || tiṣṭhetpūrvamukho dātā varaḥ pratyaṅmukho bhavet | madhuparkārcitāyaināṃ tasmai dadyātsadakṣiṇām || udapātraṃ tato gṛhya mantreṇaināṃ pradāpayet | gaurīṃ kanyāmimāṃ vipra yathāśakti vibhūṣitām || gotrāya śarmaṇe tubhyaṃ dattāṃ vipra samāśraya | bhūmiṃ gāṃ caiva dāsīṃ ca vāsāṃsi ca svaśaktitaḥ || mahiṣīṃ vājinaścaiva dadyātsvarṇamaṇīnapi | tataḥ svagṛhyavidhinā homādyaṃ karma kārayet || yathācāraṃ pradeyāni maṅgalaṃ karakāṇi ca" iti || sarvatra pitṛpūrvakatvasyaiva dṛṣṭatvātprapitāmahapūrvakatvavidhānam | evamevetyanena gotroccārādikaṃ kanyāyāmapyatidiśyate | prāṅmukho dātā, udaṅmukhaḥ pratigrahītetidānaparibhāṣāprāptasya bādhanārthaṃ tiṣṭhetpūrvamukha ityādikam | gṛhyetyatra samāsābhāve'pi ktvo lyabādeśaśchāndasaḥ | dāpayedityatra svārthe ṇic | maṅgalaṃ maṅgalasūtram | karakāṇi mṛnmayapātrāṇi | cakārātsaubhāgyadravyāṇi suvāsinībhyo deyānītyarthaḥ | prayogadarpaṇe smṛtyantare -- "svārṣagotre samutkīrtya varasyāpi tathaiva ca | nāma saṃkīrtayedvidvānprapitāmahapūrvakam || kanyāyāścaivamevoktvā madhuparkārcitāya tu | svayaṃ pūrvamukhastiṣṭhanpratyaṅmukhavarāya tu || kanyāṃ sadakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbhūmiṃ vāsāṃsi vājinaḥ | mahiṣīṃ gāṃ ca dāsīṃ ca dadyātsvarṇamaṇīnapi" iti || smṛtyantare tu -- "tiṣṭhedudaṅmukho dātā prāṅmukhastu varo bhavet" ityuktam | nātra pratigrahamantraḥ | ayajñasaṃbandhitvāt | tantrasaṃbandhidakṣiṇānāmeva pratigrahaḥ samantrako nānyāsāmiti darśitaṃ cāsti sūtrakṛtā -- "tāntrīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ darśayati" ityanena | tantraṃ yāgaḥ | "devā vai varuṇamayājayan" iti śrutau tasyaivopakramāt | manave talpamiti pratigrahamantrastu vājapeye dāsīpratigraha upayujyate | tantrasaṃbandhitvāt | na tu daive vivāhe'pyupayujyate'tantrasaṃbandhitvāt | atrāpi pratipādayeditivacanasattve yanmātṛdattena daive dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha dattāyāṃ manave talpamiti pratigraha ityuktam, taduttaragranthaviruddhamiti pratibhāti | na mametyapi na bhavati | dharmasūtre pratipādayediti vacanāt | evaṃ ca -- oṃ svastīti oṃ tatheti vetyuktvā pratigṛhṇīyāt | atha prayogaḥ | kanyādātā varadattavastrābharaṇādirahitāṃ svadeyavastrābharaṇādyalaṃkṛtāṃ kṛtapītavastraparidhānāṃ kanyāṃ varāya dadyāt | aśmānaṃ niṣkāśya pīṭhe kanyāmupaveśya vadhūvarayormadhyapradeśasya dakṣiṇata udaṅmukha upaviśya dakṣiṇataḥ patnīmupaveśyā''camya pavitrapāṇiḥ prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtyāmukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpanno'mukaśarmā'haṃ mama samastapitṝṇāṃ niratiśayasānandabrahmalokāvāptyādikanyāpratipādanakalpoktaphalāvāptaye'nena vareṇāsyāṃ kanyāyāmutpādayi ṣyamāṇasaṃtatyā dvādaśāvarāndvādaśa parānpuruṣānpavitrīkartumātmanaśca lakṣmīnārāyaṇaprītaye brāhmavivāhavidhinā kanyāpratipādanaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | yadyayaṃ saṃkalpo vivāhārambhe kṛtastadā nātra kāryaḥ | tataḥ sapatnīka utthāyodaṅmukha eva tiṣṭhantīṃ pratyaṅmukhīṃ kanyāṃ dakṣiṇahaste dhṛtvā -- "kanyāṃ kanakasaṃpannāṃ kanakābharaṇairyutām | dāsyāmi viṣṇave tubhyaṃ brahmalokajigīṣayā || viśvaṃbharaḥ sarvabhūtāḥ sākṣiṇyaḥ sarvadevatāḥ | imāṃ kanyāṃ pradāsyāmi pitṝṇāṃ tāraṇāya ca" || iti paṭhitvā kāṃsyādyanyatame taijase pātre prāṅmukhena tiṣṭhatā vareṇa gṛhīte tiṣṭhantyāḥ pratyaṅmukhyāḥ kanyāyā dakṣiṇe haste hastadvaye vā satyavākṣatatulasīpatrakuśasahitamudakaṃ kṣipaṃstrayodaśa vākyāni paṭhet | āśvalāyano varo dātā yājuṣo viparītaṃ vā tadā vadhvā hasto'dha upari varahasta ityevamāśvalāyanarītyā varahasto'dho vadhūhasta uparītyevaṃ yājuṣarītyā voparyadhobhāvo draṣṭavyaḥ | tataḥ kanyā tārayatu, puṇyaṃ vardhatāṃ, śivā āpaḥ santu, saumanasyamastu, akṣataṃ cāriṣṭaṃ cāstu, dīrghamāyuḥ śreyaḥ śāntiḥ puṣṭistuṣṭiścāstu, tithikaraṇamuhūrtanakṣatrasaṃpadastu, yacchreyastadastu, yatpāpaṃ tatpratihatamastu, puṇyāhaṃ bhavanto bruvantu, svasti bhavanto bruvantu, ṛddhiṃ bhavanto bruvantu, śrīrastviti bhavanto bruvantu, iti | tato'mukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpanno'mukaśarmā'haṃ mama samastapitṝṇāmityādi prītaya ityantaṃ pūrvavaduktvā'mukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāyāmukaprapautrāyāmukapautrāyāmukaputrāyāmukaśarmaṇe kanyārthine śrīdhararūpiṇe varāya, amukapravarānvitāmukagotrotpannāmamukaprapautrīmamukapautrīmamukasya mama putrīmamukanāmnīṃ kanyāṃ varārthinīṃ śrīrūpiṇīṃ yathāśaktyalaṃkṛtāṃ prajāpatidaivatyāṃ prajāsahatvakarmabhyastubhyamahaṃ pratipādaya ityuktvā sayavākṣatatulasīpatrakuśayutaṃ jalaṃ varahaste kṣipet | gāndharvarākṣasapaiśāceṣu naivaṃ pratipādanaṃ teṣāṃ dātṛvyāpāranirapekṣatvāt | tato vara oṃ svastīti oṃ tatheti vā pratigṛhṇīyāt | atra dāturna mameti na bhavati | evaṃ varasya pratigrahamantraśca na | evaṃ kanyā tārayatvityādyoṃ svastī tyantaṃ vāradvayaṃ punaḥ kāryam | pitāmahastu dānaṃ kurvanpautrīmityataḥ pūrvaṃ mameti vadet | sakulyatvena prapitāmahaḥ kurvanprapautrīmityataḥ pūrvaṃ mameti vadet | bhrātrādirdānaṃ kurvanpuruṣatrayasaṃkīrtanameva kuryāt | mameti na kvāpi vadet | jananī ceddānaṃ kuryāttadā['muka]gotrā'mukanāmnyahamiti vikāraḥ | bhartṛgotramevetthaṃ sā vadenna gotrotpanneti | pitṛgotraṃ naiva vadet | mātāmahamātulādiḥ saṃbandhyanyo vā yaḥ kaścidbrāhmaṇo gotrāntarīyaḥ kanyādānaṃ kurvansvagotraṃ svaviśeṣaṇatvena saṃkīrtyāmukaśarmaṇaḥ kanyāpituḥ samastapitṝṇāṃ niratiśayetyādi vadet | ātmanaścetyatra kanyāpituśceti | jananī ceddānakartrī tadā madbhartuḥ samastapitṝṇāṃ niratiśayetyādi vadet | ātmanaścetyatra madbhartuśceti | ātmanaśceti dvitīyābahuvacanāntamiti kalpe kanyāpitṝṃśceti kanyāpitaraṃ ceti vā | atra kanyāviśeṣaṇatvena kanyāpitṛgotrasaṃkīrtanameva kāryam | amukasya prapautrīmityādiṣu kanyāpitrādināmānyuccāraṇīyāni | mama vaṃśakule jāteti vakṣyamāṇe śloke'pi mametyetasya sthāne kanyāpitṛnāmaiva ṣaṣṭhyantaṃ vadecca | yadi dattakaḥ kanyāyā dānaṃ kuryāttadā pratigṛhīto yena tadgotrameva svasya kanyāyāśca viśeṣaṇatvena vadet | pratigrahītṛpitṛtatpitṛpitāmahānāṃ nāmāni kīrtayet | dattakanyādāne'pi svagotrasyaiva kanyāviśeṣaṇatvena saṃkīrtanam | śloke jātetyatra datteti vadet | evaṃ dattakavarāya kanyādāne'pi yena pratigṛhītastadīyameva gotrādi | tataḥ -- "gaurīṃ kanyāmimāṃ vipra yathāśakti vibhūṣitām | gotrāya śarmaṇe tubhyaṃ dattāṃ vipra samāśraya | kanye mamāgrato bhūyāḥ kanye me devi pārśvayoḥ | kanye me pṛṣṭhato bhūyāstvaddānānmokṣamāpnuyām | mama vaṃśakule jātā pālitā vatsarāṣṭakam | tubhyaṃ vipra mayā dattā putrapautrapravardhinī" iti kanyāṃ nivedayet | nyūnavārṣikyāṃ tu gaurīmityasya padasya lopaḥ | mayā kanyāmimāṃ vipra yathāśaktivibhūṣitāmityeva vā prayogaḥ | pālitā varṣasaptakaṃ pāliteyaṃ ṣaḍabdakamityūhaśca yathāyatham | navavārṣikyāṃ tu gaurīmitipade rohiṇīmityūhet, rohiṇīṃ kanyāmimāṃ vipreti pālitā navavarṣakamiti ca | daśavārṣikyāṃ tu gaurīrohiṇīpadasthāne kanyāmityūhet, kanyāṃ kanyāmimāṃ vipreti pālitā daśavarṣakamiti ca | gaurīpadalopaḥ pūrvavadatrāpi | atra varṣaṃ janma ta eva | tato dharme cārthe ca kāme ca nāticaritavyā tvayeyamiti śrāvayet | tato varo vākyārthamaṅgī kuryānnāticarāmīti | tato dātā kṛtasya kanyādānakarmaṇaḥ sāṅgatāsiddhyarthaṃ yathāvibhavakalpitamidamagnidaivatyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇātvena tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradada iti varahaste dattvā na mameti vadet | varastu saptadaśakṛtvo'pānya, devasya tvetyasya prajāpatiḥ savitā yajuḥ | hiraṇyapratigrahe viniyogaḥ |'oṃ devasya tvā savituḥ0 ṇe'gnaye hiraṇyaṃ te0 tu' iti pratigṛhṇīyāt | yajñiyadakṣiṇāpratigraha eva sāvitramantro nānyatretyetatkalpe tu na saptadaśakṛtvo'pānanaṃ tatra pratigṛhṇāmītyeva pratigrahaḥ | tato dātā jalapātrabhojanapātragomahiṣyaśvagajadāsīdāsabhūśayyālaṃkārādi yathāvibhavaṃ saṃkalpapūrvakaṃ varāya dadyāt | tatra dānamantrāḥ -- "parāpavādapaiśūnyādabhakṣyasya ca bhakṣaṇāt | utpannaṃ pāpaṃ dānena tāmrapātrasya naśyatu" iti tāmrapātrasya jalapānārthasya | "yāni kāni ca pāpāni kāmotthāni kṛtāni tu | kāṃsyapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā"| iti kāṃsyapātrasya bhojanādyarthasya | "agamyāgamanaṃ caiva paradārābhimarśanam | raupyapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā" | iti raupyapātrasya jalapānārthasya bhojanārthasya ca | "janmāntarasahasreṣu yatkṛtaṃ pātakaṃ mayā | svarṇapātrapradānena tāni naśyantu me sadā" iti svarṇapātrasya | "yajñasādhanabhūtāyā viśvasyāghaughanāśinī | viśvarūpadharo devaḥ prīyatāmanayā gavā" iti goḥ | "indrādilokapālānāṃ yā rājyamahiṣī priyā | mahiṣāsurasya jananī sā'stu me sarvakāmadā" iti mahiṣyāḥ | "mahārṇavasamutpanna uccaiḥśravasa putraka | sat(n) " iti | veśaḥ praveśaḥ | dinakṣayādilakṣaṇamuktaṃ śrīpatinā -- "yaścaikaḥ spṛśati dinatrayaṃ ca vāro daivajñairavamadinaṃ taduktamāryaiḥ | yaḥ sparśādbhavati tithistrayeṇa cāhnāṃ tridyuspṛksa punaridaṃ dvayaṃ ca neṣṭam" iti || yugmadine praveśastu ṣoḍaśadinamadhya eva | taduktaṃ tatraiva -- "vivāhamārabhya vadhūpraveśo yugme tithau ṣoḍaśavāsarāntāt | tadūrdhvamāseṣu ca pañcamāntāttataḥ parastānniyamo na cāsti" iti || tatrāpi viśeṣamāha nāradaḥ -- "same varṣe same māsi yadi nārī gṛhaṃ vrajet | āyuṣyaṃ harate bhartuḥ sā nārī mṛtimāpnuyāt" iti | atrāpi varjyamāsā uktā bṛhaspatinā -- "kulīrakanyakākumbhe dineśe na viśedgṛham | grāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vā'pi pattanaṃ vā narādhipa" iti || jyotiṣprakāśe -- "pṛṣṭhasthaṃ dakṣiṇasthaṃ vā bhṛguṃ kṛtvā viśetsadā | purato vāmataścāpi pratiśukraṃ na vai viśet || nirgamānnavame māsi tathaiva navame dine | riktāsu nindyayogeṣu bhānubhānujavārayoḥ || agradakṣiṇabhāgasthe candre śastaṃ na veśanam" iti | navamadinanavamamāsaniṣedhasya deśavyavasthoktā kālapadīpe -- "gavyūtihīne tvatha naiva nirgamānmāse dine vā navame punarviśet" iti | gavyūtiḥ krośadvayam | pratiśukrāpavādamāha lallaḥ -- "svabhu(bha)vanapurapradeśe deśānāṃ viplave tathodvāhe | navavadhvā gṛhagamane pratiśukravicāraṇā nāsti" iti || bhartrā saha gamane pratiśukradoṣo na | taduktaṃ bhīmaparākrame -- "svāminā nīyamānāyāḥ pratiśukro na vidyate" iti | matsyapurāṇe -- "catuḥśālaṃ caturdvāramalindaiḥ sarvatoyutam | nāmnā tatsarvatobhadraṃ na tatra pratiśukratā || kāśyapeṣu vasiṣṭheṣu bhṛgvatryāṅgiraseṣu ca | bhāradvājeṣu vātsyeṣu pratiśukro na vidyate" iti || jyotiḥsāgare -- "pauṣṇādivahnipādeṣu yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ | tāvacchukro bhavedandhaḥ saṃmukhaṃ gamanaṃ śubham" iti || tatraiva vacanāntaram -- "revatyādimṛgānteṣu yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ | tāvacchukro bhavedandhaḥ saṃmukhaṃ gamanaṃ śubham" iti || atra bhṛgugurvastāpavāda ukto māṇḍavyena -- "nityayāne gṛhe jīrṇe prāśanānteṣu saptasu | vadhūpraveśamāṅgalye na mauḍhyaṃ bhṛgujīvayoḥ" iti || bhṛguḥ śukraḥ | jīvo guruḥ | ācāraḥ paraṃ nāsti | jyotiṣprakāśe -- "vāme śukre navoḍhāyāḥ sukhaṃ hāniśca dakṣiṇe | dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ ca pṛṣṭhasthe sarvanāśaḥ puraḥsthiteḥ || navoḍhāyāstu vaidhavyaṃ yaduktaṃ saṃmukhe bhṛgau | tadevaṃ vibudhairjñeyaṃ kevalaṃ tu dvirāgame || pūrvato'bhyudite śukre prayāyāddakṣiṇāpare | paścādabhyudite caiva yāyātpūrvottare diśau" iti || tathā bhādrapadamārabhya pūrvādidikṣu pratidiśaṃ māsatrayaṃ kapāṭaṃ jñeyam | caitramārabhya pūrvādyaṣṭadikṣu mukhyadiśi māsadvayaṃ vidikṣvekaṃ māsaṃ krameṇa kaṇṭakaṃ jānīyāt | etaddvayaṃ grāmāntare navavadhūgamane varjyam | jyotirnibandhe -- "kavijñavāre svagṛhāddhruvarkṣe kāntāprayāṇaṃ na kadācideva | dhanasya nāśaḥ kavivāsare syātputrasya nāśo dhruvasaumyavāsare" iti || anyaśca -- "vivāhātprathame pauṣe āṣāḍhe vā'dhimāsake | bharturgṛhe vasennaiva caitre tātagṛhe tathā" iti || jyotirnibandhe -- "udvāhātprathame śucau yadi vasedbhartṛrgṛhe kanyakā hanyāttajjananīṃ kṣaye nijatanuṃ jyeṣṭhe patijyeṣṭhakam | pauṣe ca śvaśaraṃ patiṃ ca maline caitre svapitrālaye tiṣṭhantī pitaraṃ nihanti na bhayaṃ teṣāmabhāve bhavet" iti | jayantaḥ -- "mārgaśīrṣe tathā māghe mādhave jyeṣṭhasaṃjñake | supraśasto bhavedveśmapraveśo navayoṣitām" iti || atha dvirāgamanam | ṛkṣoccaye -- "māghaphālgunavaiśākhe śuklapakṣe śubhe dine | gurvādityaviśuddhau syānnityaṃ patnyā dvirāgamaḥ" iti || bādarāyaṇaḥ -- "nīhārāṃśudinottarāditigurubrahmānurādhāśvinīśakre bhāskaravāyuviṣṇuvaruṇatvāṣṭre praśaste tithau | kumbhājāligate ravau śubhakare prāptodaye bhārgave devejyenavidāṃ dine navavadhūveśmapraveśaḥ śubhaḥ" iti || devejyo guruḥ | inaḥ sūryaḥ | vidbudhaḥ | atha gṛhapraveśaprayogaḥ | vivāhahomānantaraṃ vadhūbāndhavāḥ pitṛgṛhājjyotirvidādiṣṭe sumuhūrte tāṃ bhāryāṃ varaṃ ca rathādiyānena varagṛhaṃ grāmaṃ vā nayeyuḥ | yadi grāmaṃ prati gacchatordaṃpatyormārge homapātraṃ śakaṭaṃ vā bhidyeta tadā'nvārabdhāyāṃ vadhvāmāpūrvikatantreṇā''ghāratantreṇa vā 'oṃ yadṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ, iḍāmagne pu0 imaṃ me varuṇa, tattvā yāmi, tvaṃ no agne, sa tvaṃ no agne, tvamagne ayāsi' iti saptāhutīrjuhuyāt | ādyasyendro magha vāndevatā | dvitīyasyāgniḥ | itareṣāṃ prasiddhā devatāḥ | tatastasya saṃdhānaṃ kṛtvā rajjvādergranthiṃ baddhvā svastipadavato mantrāñjapet | 'oṃ abhivyayasva khadirasya sāram' iti saṃdhāne mantra uktaḥ śāṅkhāyanena | 'oṃ tyañcidaśvaṃ na vājinam' iti granthibandhane | svasti no mimītāmiti pañcarcasūktajapo'pi tenoktaḥ | vivāhāgniṃ sarvamekasminpātre bhasmanā saha nikṣipya jāyāpatyoḥ pṛṣṭhato haranti | ayaṃ cāgnirvivāhahomamārabhya yāvajjīvaṃ dhāryaḥ | sūtre nityagrahaṇenaiva yāvajjīvaṃ dhāraṇe siddhe dhārya iti vacanaṃ prayāṇavyatiriktasthale sthalāntare kenacinnimittenāgnernayanaṃ cetpratyakṣameva nayanaṃ na tu samāropa ityetadartham | āpastambānāmapyevam | prayāṇe tu yadi prayāyādavyākhyātamātmannaraṇyorvā samidhi vā samāropaṇamitisūtrātsamāropa eva na tu pratyakṣanayanam | khaṇḍasya kṣepakatvakalpe śakaṭādinā pratyakṣanayanameva kāryaṃ samāropo'pi vā | samitsamāropo'tra paraṃ nāstyeva | dhāraṇaṃ tu yajñiyaiḥ kāṣṭhairgomayapiṇḍairvā kāryaṃ na tu tuṣaiḥ | taduktaṃ saṃgrahe -- "dhāryo'gnimayaiḥ piṇḍaiḥ kāṣṭhairvā yajñiyardṛḍhaiḥ | sarvathā na tuṣairdhārya iti vidvatprabhāṣitam" iti || pārijāte -- "na tuṣairdhārayedagnim" iti | sa cedanugatastadā tadanantarameva mathitavyaḥ | śrotriyāgārādvā''haraṇīyaḥ | yadi pūrvaṃ mathito bhavati tadā'vakṣāṇebhyo'dhimathitavyaḥ | avakṣāṇaṃ tadagnisthaṃ kiṃciddagdhaṃ kāṣṭham | yadyasamarthānyavakṣāṇāni syustadā tadbhasmanā'raṇī saṃspṛśya mathitavyaḥ | yadyāhṛtastadā''haraṇīyaḥ | prāyaścittasūtre'vakṣāṇānīti bahuvacanaṃ yadyekasmādavakṣāṇādagnirnotpadyate tadā'nyasmānmathitavyaḥ | tato'pyanāgamane parasmāditi na tu yāvantyavakṣāṇāni tebhyo mathitavya iti | sarvebhyo'vakṣāṇebhyo'nutpattāvevāraṇīmanthanaṃ na tvekāvakṣāṇamanthanādanutpattāvanantaramaraṇīmanthanamiti | yadyapi gṛhyasūtra idaṃ noktaṃ tathā'pyaviruddhatvādgrāhyam | avirodhināmapekṣitaśrautavidhīnāṃ prāptistu śrautasūtramadhye gṛhyāmnānavalāllabhyate | "anugato manthyaḥ śrotriyāgārādvā''hārya upavāsaścānugate bhāryāyāḥ patyurvā" ityanugamanaprāyaścittasūtram | caśabdo manthanāharaṇābhyāmupavāsasamuccayārthaḥ | anugatādhikāre punaranugatavacanaṃ prāgūrdhvaṃ ca vivāhaparisamāptaretatprāyaścittaṃ bhavedityetadartham | tasmātsarvatrānugate manthanenā''haraṇena votpādyopava stavyamiti | naitadasti | nityagrahaṇādeva siddhatvāt | idaṃ tarhi prayojanamanugata idameva prāyaścittaṃ syānnānyaditi | tenāstyanyadapyanyatra prāyaścittamiti gamyate | kiṃ tat, api vottarayā juhuyānnopavasedityāpastambenoktam | uttarā'yāścāgna ityeṣā | tatrānabhiśastīścetyetāvānvikāra iti mātṛdatto vyākhyātavān | etadbhāṣyasvarasānnaṣṭāpahārādinā'gniviccheda upavāsāhutyātmakameva prāyaścittaṃ na kevalamupavāsa āhutirveti | atra bhāṣye -- anugamanavyatiriktasthala upavāsāhutyātmakaprāyaścittapradarśanenānyasyāṣṭādaśāhutyādyātmakaprāyaścittasya kṣepakatvaṃ pradarśitamanyathedamapi pradarśitaṃ bhavet | sarvasya prāyaścittātiriktabhāgasya kṣepakatvaṃ neti tu tasmingṛhyāṇi karmāṇi kriyanta ityetasya pāṇigrahaṇādiragnistamaupāsanamityācakṣata ityetatkhaṇḍasya pratīkamadarśanājjñāyate | tasyaupāsanenā''hitāgnitvaṃ pārvaṇena caruṇā darśapūrṇamāsayājitvaṃ ceti kaścidācāryo vakṣyatīti vaijayantīkṛduktisvarasāttu sarvasya khaṇḍasya kṣepakatā jñāyate | evaṃ ca punaḥsaṃdhānavidhireva kṣepako'nyo na kṣepaka iti bhāṣyakṛdgranthāt | vaijayatīkṛdgranthāttu sarvamapi khaṇḍaṃ kṣepakamiti | ubhayagranthataḥ punaḥsaṃdhānavidhereva kṣepakatvam | etatsūribhirnipuṇataraṃ vibhāvya yadyuktaṃ tadgrāhyam | tato'nyataramagniṃ gomayopalipte saṃskṛtāyatane sthāpayitvā patirupavaset, bhāryā vā | proṣite patyau bhāryāyā upavāsaḥ | ahanyanugata āsāyamupavāsaḥ | rātrāvanugata āprātarupavāsaḥ | upavāsāsāmarthyādāvupanayanaprakaraṇoktamayāścetyāhutyātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ sarvaprāyaścittahomaśca kartavyaḥ | divopavāse sāyameva luptahomaḥ kāryaḥ | rātrāvupavāse prātareva | upavāsamātrameva vā na tu homaḥ | āhutipakṣe tu prāyaścittahomānantarameva | yadi patiḥ proṣitaḥ svasyāścopavāsāsāmarthyaṃ tadā homārthamṛtvijaṃ vṛtvā tenāyāścāgna ityāhutiṃ hāvayet | ṛtvigabhāve svayameva juhuyāt | atha varaḥ svagṛhadvāraṃ prāpya dakṣiṇaṃ pādamagre'tihara dehaliṃ mā'dhiṣṭhā iti bhāryāṃ saṃśāsti | sā dakṣiṇaṃ pādamagre kṛtvā dehalīmanadhiṣṭhāyaiva gacchati | tato gṛhaṃ praviśya tatpūrvārdhyaśālāyāmagnyāyatanaṃ parikalpya tatpaścātsabhāryaḥ prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mama vivā hāgnergṛhyatvotpādanadvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ gṛhapraveśākhyaṃ karma kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | na vā saṃkalpaḥ | tato gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjyoddhananādisaṃskṛta āyatane vivāhāgniṃ tūṣṇīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prajvalitaṃ kuryāt | tato'pareṇāgniṃ lohitamānaḍuhaṃ carma prācīnagrīvamuttaralomā''stīrya "oṃ iha gāvo niṣīdantvihāśvā iha pūruṣāḥ | iho sahasradakṣiṇo'pi pūṣā niṣīdatu" | iti tasmiñjāyāpatī prāṅmukhāvudaṅmukhau vopaviśataḥ | prāṅmukhatvapakṣe patyurdakṣiṇato bhāryā | udaṅmukhatvapakṣe tasya pṛṣṭhato vāmabhāge vā | ubhayormantraḥ| ata ārabhya nakṣatrodayaparyantaṃ vāgyatāvāsāte | ānaḍuhacarmābhāve tārṇatalpo grāhyaḥ | tathā cā''śvalāyanasmṛtiḥ -- "gṛhapraveśe'naḍuhaścarmāstaraṇamiṣyate | tasyābhāve tu tārṇasya talpasyā''staraṇaṃ bhavet" iti | talpo'trā''sanam | uditeṣu nakṣatreṣu vadhvā saha prācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramya tayā sahaiva prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā, devīḥ paḍurvīrityasyārdhasyāgnirdiśastriṣṭup | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ devīḥ ṣaḍurvīruruṇaḥ kṛṇuta viśve devāsa iha vīrayadhvam' iti diśa upatiṣṭhate | bahuvacanaliṅgātsakṛnmantraḥ | mā hāsma hītyasya pādasyāgnirnakṣatrāṇi triṣṭup | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ mā hāsma hi prajayā mā tanūbhiḥ' iti nakṣatrāāṇi sakṛnmantramuktvaivopatiṣṭhate | sarveṣāṃ nakṣatrāṇāmupasthānāsaṃbhavādyāvanti dṛṣṭigocarāṇi bhavanti teṣāmupasthānam | aśakyatvātsakṛnmantraḥ | māradhāmetyasya pādātmakasya mantrasyāgniścandramāstriṣṭup | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ māradhāma dviṣate somarājan' iti candramasam | "oṃ saptarṣayaḥ prathamāṃ kṛttikānāmarundhatīṃ ye dhruvatā ha ninyuḥ | ṣaṭkṛttikāmukhyayogaṃ vahantīyamasmākaṃ bhrājatvaṣṭamī" | iti saptarṣīnarundhatīsahitānupatiṣṭhate | bahuvacanaliṅgātsakṛnmantraḥ | "oṃ dhruvakṣitirdhruvayonirdhruvamasi dhruvatasthitaṃ tvaṃ nakṣatrāṇā methyesi sa mā, pāhi pṛtanyataḥ | namo brahmaṇe dhuvāyācyutāyāstu namo brahmaṇaḥ putrāya prajāpataye namo brahmaṇaḥ putrebhyo devebhyastrayastri śebhyo namo brahmaṇaḥ putrapautrebhyo'ṅgirobhyo yastvā dhruvamacyuta suputra sapautraṃ brahma veda dhruvā asminputrāḥ pautrā bhavanti preṣyāntevāsino vasanaṃ kambalāni ka sa hiraṇya striyo rājāno'nnamabhayumāyuḥ kīrtirvarco yaśo balaṃ brahmavarcasamannādyamityetāni mayi sarvāṇi dhruvāṇyacyutāni santu | dhruvaṃ tvā brahma veda dhruvo'hamasmillām̐ke'smiṃśca janapade bhūyāsamacyutaṃ tvā brahma veda mā'hamasmāllokādasmācca janapadāccyoṣi dviṣanme bhrātṛvyo'smādasmāllokādasmācca janapadāccyavatāmaceṣṭaṃ tvā brahma veda mā'hamasmāllokādasmācca janapadācceṣṭiṣi dviṣanme bhrātṛvyo'smāllokādasmācca janapadācceṣṭatāmavyathamānaṃ tvā brahma veda mā'hamasmāllokādasmācca janapadādvyathiṣi dviṣanme bhrātṛvyo'smāllokādasmācca janapadādvyathatāṃ nabhyaṃ tvā sarvasya veda nabhyamahamasya janapadasya bhūyāsaṃ madhyaṃ tvā sarvasya veda madhyamahamasya janapadasya bhūyāsaṃ tantiṃ tvā sarvasya veda tantirahamasya janapadasya bhūyāsaṃ methīṃ tvā sarvasya veda methyahamasya janapadasya bhūyāsaṃ nābhiṃ tvā sarvasya veda nābhirahamasya janapadasya bhūyāsaṃ yathā nābhiḥ prāṇānāṃ viṣūvānevamahaṃ viṣūvānekaśataṃ taṃ pāpmānamṛcchatu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmo bhūyā si māmekaśatānpuṇyānyāgacchantu" iti dhruvamupatiṣṭhate | nakṣatrādīnāmabhrādipratibandhenādarśane'pi tasyāṃ tasyāṃ diśi taṃ tamupastheyapadārthamanulakṣīkṛtyopasthānaṃ kāryam | tata upasthānadeśa eva manasa āhlādakena vacasā bhāryāṃ saṃbhāṣya punaḥ śālāṃ praviśyā''stṛtamānaḍuhaṃ carmābhyukṣya nirasyāpa upaspṛśya bhāryayā sahāpareṇāgniṃ prāṅmukha upaviśati | atha gṛhapraveśasthālīpākaḥ | varaḥ sabhārya ācamya prāṇānāyamyāgniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samitrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā gṛhapraveśāṅgabhūtāgneyasthālīpākayāgakarmaṇi ye yakṣyamāṇe devate te parigrahīṣyāmi | agnimekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtamekayā hutaśeṣacarvāhutyā yakṣye | ete devate sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā vyāhṛtibhiragnau samidho'bhyādhāyāgniṃ paristīryottareṇāgniṃ darbhānāstīrya teṣu śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ carusthālīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ taṇḍulapraskandanārthaṃ pātraṃ darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātraṃ havirāsādanārthaṃ darbhānupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ cā''sādayet | vrīhīṇāṃ tatpratinidhitvena vihitānāṃ satuṣāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ ca sarvathā'bhāvena siddhataṇḍulagrahaṇe patnī, avahananakāle taṇḍulānspṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇājināstaraṇādi triṣphalīkaraṇāntaṃ karma manasā krameṇa vibhāvayedaṅgatvanirvāhāya | athavā sarvā bāhyāśceṣṭā api kartavyāḥ | pūrvakalpe kṛṣṇājinālūkhalamusalānāṃ nā''sādanaṃ, dvitīyakalpe tvastyeva kṛṣṇājinādyāsādanam | tataḥ pavitre kṛtvā'pareṇāgniṃ śūrpaṃ nidhāya tasminpavitre nidhāya tṛṣṇīṃ caturo muṣṭīnnirū(ru)pyaikabrāhmaṇabhojanaparyāptānvrīhīnanvopyottareṇāgniṃ niruptavrīhimacchūrpaṃ nidhāya prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya śūrpasthānvrīhīnprokṣya pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā prokṣati | (ṛṣabhaṃ ca mūlyadāne mūlyam |) tataḥ patnyagneruttarataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ bahi rviśasanaṃ triravadhūya pratyaggrīvamupariṣṭālloma tadāstīrya tasya bhasatpradeśamupasamasya tatrolūkhalaṃ saṃsthāpya tasminvrīhīnopyā''sīnena musalenāvahatyolūkhalasya purastācchūrpaṃ nidhāyolūkhalasthāṃstaṇḍulāñśūrpe nikṣipya kṛṣṇājinasyottaratastrirniṣpūya tuṣānpradhvaṃsayitvā(sya) tāṃstupāndakṣiṇahastena kṛṣṇājinasyādhastādupavapatyanirīkṣan(māṇā)| tato dakṣiṇahastenaiva nikṣiptāṃstupānniṣpīḍyāpa upaspṛśya vivicya praskandanārtha āsādite pātre praskandayitvā(ndya) tānādāyolṛkhale prakṣipya triṣphalīkṛtya triṣphalīkaraṇāni kṛṣṇājinasyottarato nikṣipya taṇḍulānprakṣālyāgneḥ paścānnivapati | tato varaḥ prakṣālitāṃstaṇḍulāṃścarusthālyāmopya mekṣaṇenā''loḍyāgnau śrapayitvā darvīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ ca saṃmṛjyā''jyavilāpanādipavitrābhyādhānāntaṃ kuryāt | tatrā''jyena saha carorapi paryagnikaraṇaṃ, carusthālyāṃ taṇḍulanikṣepātpūrvameva vā darvīsaṃmārgādipavitrābhyādhānāntam | agneḥ paścāddarbhāstaraṇapakṣe tadantaṃ kṛtvā darbheṣvājyaṃ nidadhyāt | yajidhātoḥ prayogo yakṣya ityevaṃrūpāgūraṇamātraprāptyarthaṃ ityetasminkalpe homabrāhmaṇapariveṣaṇaparyāptānvrīhīngṛhītvā patnyā'vaghātena niṣpāditānvrīhitaṇḍulānsodakāyāṃ sthālyāṃ nikṣipyāgnau śrapayati | nātra nirvāpaprokṣaṇakṛṣṇājināvadhūnanādiśrautadharmāḥ | kṛṣṇājināsādanaṃ kṛtākṛtam | āstaraṇābhāve pātreṣvāsādanamapi na | paryāgnikaraṇaṃ tu kartavyameva | tata āsāditāndarbhānagneḥ paścādāstīrya tatrā''jyaṃ nidhāya śṛtaṃ caruṃ darvyā''jyenābhighāryodagudvāsyāgneḥ paścādāstṛte barhiṣyājyasyottarata āsādyāgniṃ pariṣicya tūṣṇīṃ sāditāṃ samidhamādhāya mekṣaṇenopahatya pradīpte'gnau juhoti | 'oṃ agnaye svāhā' iti bhāryānvārabdho juhoti | agnaya idaṃ na mama | punarbhūya upahatya 'oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' iti bhāryānvārabdho'saṃsaktāṃ pūrvāhutyottarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti | agnaye sviṣṭakṛta idaṃ na mama | atra yadyapyathaśabdo nāsti tathā'pi ktvāpratyayāccaruṇā sviṣṭakṛddhomo bhavati | tato mekṣaṇamagnau prakṣipet | na vā mekṣaṇaprakṣepaḥ | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya vyastasamastavyāhṛtibhiścatasraḥ prāyaścittāhutīrhutvottaraṃ pariṣekaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthājapenāgnimupasthāya taṃ saṃpūjya lalāṭe vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvā haviḥśeṣeṇa brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāvantaṃ bhojayet | haviḥśeṣanāśe brāhmaṇabhojanābhāvaḥ | tataḥ kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ sāṅgatāsiddhaya ācāryāyā''sāditamṛṣabhaṃ tanmūlyaṃ vā dattvā'nyebhyo bhūyasīṃ ca dattvā yathāvibhavaṃ brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | patnyeva kartrī mukhyetikalpe patnī varāddānārthamṛṣabhaṃ tanmūlyaṃ vā saṃpādya tvamāgneyasthālīpākena māṃ yājayeti taṃ prārthayet | tato varo'nvādhānādipātraprokṣaṇāntaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ kṛṣṇājināvadhūnanāditaṇḍulakṣālanāntaṃ patnī | tataḥ śrapaṇādityāgadānavarjaṃ samāptyantaṃ karma varaḥ kuryāt | tyāgadāne patnī kuryāt | iti patnyā mukhyakartṛtvapakṣe prayogaḥ | athavā pātrāsādanānte kṛṣṇājinamāstīryānāstīrya vā patnyavahananaṃ kṛtvā triṣphalīkṛtya phalīkaraṇānyuttarato nirasyet | tato varo darvīsaṃmārgādipavitrābhyādhānāntaṃ darbhāstaraṇapakṣe tadantaṃ kṛtvā śṛtaṃ caruṃ darvyā''jyenābhighāryodagudvāsyāgneḥ paścāddarbheṣu darbhāstaraṇābhāvapakṣe bhūmāveva nidhāya pariṣekādi samānam | tataḥ patiputravatībhiḥ suvāsinībhiḥ kṛtanīrājanau daṃpatī dvijebhya āśiṣo gṛhītvā muditau tiṣṭhetām | tato mahālakṣmīpūjanādikamācāraprāptaṃ yadyadasti tatsarvaṃ purandhrībhiḥ kāraṇīyam | iti gṛhapraveśasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | athaitadviṣayakaṃ sūtraṃ vyākhyāyate | tatra sūtramittham -- "athaināmāgneyena sthālīpākena yājayati patnyavahanti śrapayitvā'bhighāryodvāsyāgnaye hutvā'gnaye sviṣṭakṛte juhoti tena brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāvantaṃ pariveveṣṭi yo'syāpacito bhavati tasmā ṛṣabhaṃ dadāti" iti | atheti praveśānantaraṃ pūrvarātrāveva kriyā syādardharātrottaraṃ mā bhūdityetadartham, yatra digādyupasthānānantaramāgneyena sthālīpākena yāgaṃ karoti tatraivaināṃ patnīṃ yājayati patnyāmanvārabdhāyāṃ juhoti nānyeṣu sthālīpākeṣvityetadarthaṃ ca | yājayatītyetadanantaraṃ vara iti śeṣaḥ | athavaināṃ yājayatīti vacanādevaṃ jñāyate patnyeva yaṣṭrī varastu ṛtvigbhūta iti | tena tyāgadāne strīkartṛke eva | ata evāsyetīdamaḥ prayogaḥ saṃgacchate | na ca tasyā bhartṛdhanadāne'dhikārābhāvātkathametaditi vācyam | anujñayā dāne'pyadhikārasya sarvatantrasiddhatvāt | nanvenāṃ yājayatītyeva vaktavyaṃ yata uttaratrāgnaye hutveti vidhānādāgneyatvaṃ siddhaṃ, sthālīpākeneti tvavahanti śrapayitveti vidhānātsiddhamataḥ kimarthamidamadhikamārabhyata āgneyena sthālīpākeneti | ucyate -- āgneya evātra pradhānadevatā nāgniḥ sviṣṭakṛditikhyāpanārtham | tena prathamadevatāhomānantaraṃ havirdoṣe sviṣṭakṛdrūpadvitīyadevatārthaṃ na havirutpattiḥ kiṃ tvājyenaiva homa iti sidhyati | uttarārdhapūrvārdhe'saṃsaktāmitarābhirāhutibhirjuhoti pradhānāvadānato jyāyo'vadānamityete dharmāśca siddhā bhavanti | sthālīpākeneti vacanaṃ sūtrāntare'gnidevatoddeśenāsminsthālīpākayāgakarmaṇyājyenāpi homa uktaḥ sa mā bhūdityetadartham | athavā sthālīpākenetyeva vidhāyakaṃ śrapayitveti tu śrapaṇābhidhāraṇayoravyavadhānāyānuvādaḥ | tena suśṛtāvasthātaḥ pūrvameva pavitrapraharaṇāntaṃ karmeti sidhyati | caruṇetyetāvataiva siddhe sthālīpākeneti vacanaṃ yatra sthālīpākaśabdena vidhānaṃ tatraivā''pūrvikatantravidhiritijñāpanārtham | tenānyatrārthādāghāravattantraṃ sidhyati | prāyaścitteṣṭisthānīyacaruhome tvāpūrvikatantrameva | tatrāpi ya āhitāgneḥ puroḍāśāste'nāhitāgneḥ sthālīpākā iti śāstrāntare'pi sthālīpākaśabdena vidhānāt | athavā sthālīpākenaiva yatra homo na dravyāntareṇāpi tatraivā''pūrvikatantravidhiritijñāpanārtham | tena caruśabdena vihite kevalacaruhome'pyāpūrvikaṃ tantrameva bhavati | hudhātuṃ parityajya yajidhātoḥ prayogo yāvadupayuktaśrautadharmaprāptyarthaḥ | tena nirvāpādīnāṃ kṛṣṇājināvadhūnanādīnāmavahananadharmāṇāṃ prāptiḥ siddhā bhavati | athavā yajidhātoḥ prayogo yakṣya ityevaṃrūpāgūraṇamātraprāptyarthaḥ | patnyavahanti sthālīpākārthānvrīhīn | sā'vahantīti vaktavye patnyavahantīti vacanaṃ patnyeva kṛṣṇājināvadhūnanāditaṇḍulaprakṣālananinayanāntaṃ karoti na tu śrautavattriṣphalīkaraṇamātrāvaghātamityetadartham | śrapaṇādikaṃ tu varakartṛkameva na tu patnīkartṛkam | etadarthameva patnyavahatyeti lyappratyayaṃ parityajya patnyavahantīti prayogaḥ kṛtaḥ| athavā patnyavahantītivacanamanantaroktena dhruvādyupasthānāntena vidhinā yā svīkṛtā saiva patnī, anyathā netyetadartham | tenā''surādivivāhoḍhāyā na yajñayuktatvamiti siddhaṃ bhavati | asti cātra smṛtiḥ -- "krayakrītā tu yā nārī na sā patnyabhidhīyate | na sā daive na sā pitrye dāsīṃ tāṃ kavayo viduḥ" iti | " adharmyoḍhā tu yā nārī na sā patnyabhidhīyate | daive pitrye na sā yogyā dāsīvatkavayo viduḥ" iti | adharmyoḍhā'dharmyeṇa vivāhenoḍhā | sviṣṭakṛtaṃ juhotīti parityajyāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte juhotītyevaṃ vacanānnāmnaivātra homo na yadasyetyanena | tena sthālīpākaśeṣeṇa, brāhmaṇaṃ vidyāvantaṃ śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ pariveveṣṭi bhojayatītyarthaḥ | brāhmaṇagrahaṇaṃ kṣattriyavaiśyanivṛttyartham | pariveveṣṭītivacanabalāddhomabrāhmaṇabhojanaparyāptaścaruḥ kāryaḥ | athavaināṃ yājayatīti vacanamanvārambhasiddhyartham | asminpakṣe vara eva tyāgadānakartā | yo'syāpacito bhavati tasmā ṛṣabhaṃ dadātīti sūtramasminkalpa itthaṃ vyākhyeyam | yo'sya sthālīpākayāgasya karturapacitastasmā etadyāgasya kartā, ṛṣabhaṃ dadāti na tu sthālīpākayāgāntarāṇāṃ kartā | athavā'syetiṣaṣṭhyā ayamiti vipariṇāmaḥ | yo'yaṃ loke vidyābhijanasaṃpattyā'pacitastasmā ayametatsthālīpākakartā, ṛṣabhaṃ dadātīti | kecittu tena brāhmaṇamityādi yo'syāpacito bhavati tasmā ṛṣabhaṃ dadātītyetadantaṃ sūtramekaṃ kurvanti, teṣāṃ mate'pacita eva bhojayitavyaḥ | tasmā eva ṛṣabho dātavya iti | yadā tvatisaṃkaṭe śāstrāntaravaśena rātrau vivāhastatrāpyardharātrātprākcettadā''naḍuhe carmaṇyupaviśyānantarameva digādyupasthānādisthālīpākāntaṃ sarvaṃ karma kāryam | yadyardharātrottaraṃ tadopaveśanapūrvakaṃ digādyupasthānādi kṛtvā śvobhūta eva sthālīpākaḥ kārya iti draṣṭavyam | tadāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "ardharātre vyatīte tu paredyuḥ prātareva hi | gṛhapraveśanīyaḥ syāditi vedavido viduḥ" iti | grāmāntare vadhūgṛhaṃ cettadā tadgrāmaṃ gatvā tatra svīyaṃ gṛhamasti cettatraiva maṇḍapādi kāryam | abhāve svatvasaṃpādanapūrvakamanyagṛhe vā | ayaṃ ca sthālīpākaḥ prayāṇādividhipūrvakaḥ svagṛha eva kartavyaḥ | na śvaśuragṛhānyagṛhayoḥ | śiṣṭāstvidānīmetayorapi kurvanti | gṛhapraveśasthālīpākottaraṃ prathamadarśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākānuṣṭhānātprāksamāropo na kāryaḥ | carusvarūpaṃ sārasaṃgrahe -- "agnirgatoṣmā susvinno hyadagdho'kaṭhinaścaruḥ | na cātiśithilaḥ pācyo na ca vītaraso bhavet" iti | ayameva sarvasthālīpākānāṃ prakṛtiḥ | darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākau tvetadvikṛtibhūtāveva | iti gṛhapraveśavidhiḥ | athairiṇīpūjanaṃ dānaṃ ca | maṇḍapapratiṣṭhādinātpāṇigrahaṇadinādvā caturthe divase rātrau tatra bhadrādisaṃbhave dine vā śiṣṭācāraprāptaṃ varamātre'bhāve tatsamāyai vā kanyādātrairiṇyākhyavaṃśapātradānaṃ kāryam | "savastraphalatāmbūlaṃ daṃpatyorvaṃśavardhanam | airiṇyākhyaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ pakvānnaiḥ paripūritam || karakai rudrasaṃkhyaistu suvarṇena samanvitaiḥ | etāvadairiṇīrūpaṃ kartavyaṃ kila sūribhiḥ" iti | rudrasaṃkhyairekādaśasaṃkhyaiḥ | evaṃ saṃpādya sabhārya ācamya prāṇānāyamya vivāhasaṃpūrṇaphalāvāptaye varasya tatpitṛmātrādīnāṃ tatpakṣīyāṇāṃ ca yathāvibhavaṃ gandhapuṣpavastrādibhiḥ pūjanaṃ kuryāt | atrāpi saṃkalpaṃ kurvanti | gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya varatatpitṛmātṛpakṣīyebhyo yathāvibhavaṃ gandhapuṣpasamarpaṇapūrvakaṃ paṭṭapaṭṭīdukūlavastrādi dattvā kṛtakanyādānasaṃpūrṇaphalāvāptivaṃśābhivṛddhidvāromāmaheśvaraprītyarthamairiṇīpūjanaṃ varamātre tatsamāyai vairiṇyākhyavaṃśapātradānaṃ ca kuryāt | tadyathā -- "airiṇi tvamumā devī maheśo girijāpatiḥ | atastvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi airiṇīṃ sarvakāmadām || savastrāṃ ca sadīpāṃ ca śūrpaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutām | varamātre pradāsyāmi kanyādānasya siddhaye" || ityuktvā tasminvaṃśapātra umāmaheśvarau saṃpūjya tadvaṃśapātraṃ varamātre tatsamāyai vā dadyāt | tatra mantrāḥ -- "vaṃśo vaṃśakaraḥ śreṣṭho vaṃśo vaṃśasamudbhavaḥ | anena vaṃśadānena tuṣṭo vṛddhiṃ karotu me || vaṃśapātramidaṃ puṇyaṃ vaṃśajātisamudbhavam || vaṃśānāmuttamaṃ dānamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me || vaṃśapātrāṇi sarvāṇi mayā saṃpāditāni vai | umākāntāya dattāni mama gotrābhivṛddhaye || vaṃśavṛddhikaraṃ dānaṃ saubhāgyādisamanvitam | vastreṇā''cchāditaṃ pūrṇaṃ phalahemasamanvitam || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ nānādravyaistu pūritam | dānānāmuttamaṃ dānamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me" iti | tataḥ sadīpaṃ vaṃśapātraṃ varatatpitṛmātrādīnāṃ śirasi svayaṃ dhārayet, svasti no mimītāṃ svasti na indra iti dvābhyāṃ pratimantram | tato dātaiva kanyāṃ gṛhītvā varapitrādyutsaṅge pṛthakpṛthagupaveśya prārthayet -- "saptavarṣā tviyaṃ kanyā putravatpālitā mayā | idānīṃ tava putrāya dattā snehena pālyatām" iti || ṣaḍvārṣikyāṃ tu ṣaḍvatsarā tviyaṃ kanyetyūhaḥ | aṣṭavārṣikyādiṣu tu -- aṣṭavarṣā tviyaṃ kanyā navavarṣā tviyaṃ kanyā daśavarṣā tviyaṃ kanyetyevaṃ yathāyatham | evaṃ putrāyetyatrāpi pautrāya bhrātre bāndhavāya mitrāyeti | varamātrādyutsaṅge vadhūmātā kanyāṃ tathaivopaveśya prārthayet | tato varamātrā vadhūmātrāditatpakṣīyasuvāsinībhyaḥ sakañcukakṣudravaṃśaśūrpavāyanāni vadhvā dāpanīyānyācārāt | evamanyadapi yathā''cāraprāptamasti tathā kāryam | tato dātā karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | etacca sarvaṃ sapatnīkenābhuktvaiva kāryam | etadakaraṇe doṣa ityetadarthe vacanaṃ paṭhanti -- "vaṃśadānaṃ vinā yastu maṇḍapodvāsanaṃ yadi | ajñānātkurute mūḍho daṃpatyoḥ kṣayamāyuṣaḥ" iti || vastutastu mahānibandheṣvadarśanādanākaramidam | anyacca śākalakārikāsu -- "daṃpatyorvāsasī dattvā pūjayedairiṇīṃ tataḥ | vaṃśapātraṃ tathā kanyāṃ varamātre nivedayet || vaṃśadānaṃ caturthe'hni kanyādānāṅgamiṣyate | rātrau kuryāttṛtīyeṃ'śe kuyoge'pi na duṣyati || pāto vā vaidhṛtirvā syāccaturthe'hani cedyadi | tatraivāpararātre syādairiṇīpūjanādikam" iti | caturthe'hanyeva pātavaidhṛtī syātāṃ cedapi tadā kāryameva nānyatretyetattātparyārthaḥ | vastutastu prācīnanavīnagrantheṣvetasyādarśanādanādaraṇīyam | ityairiṇīpūjanaṃ dānaṃ ca | atha caturthīkarma | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "caturthyāmapararātre'gnimupasamādhāya prāyaścittiparyantaṃ kṛtvā nava prāyaścittīrjuhotītyādi prāyaścittiparyantaṃ kṛtvā sa tvaṃ no agne, ityetadantaṃ kṛtvā'gne prāyaścitta ityetā nava prāyaścittīrjuhoti" iti | mātṛdattaḥ -- prāyaścittiparyantaṃ kṛtveti vacanaṃ samastavyāhṛtīnāmanādiṣṭaprāyaścittitvabodhanārtham | tenānukte prāyaścitte samastavyāhṛtibhirhoma iti sidhyati | ata eva sarvaprāyaścittamiti saṃjñā | tena samastavyāhṛtiparyantameva kṛtvā nava prāyaścittīḥ pradhānībhūtā āhutīrjuhuyāt | atra prāyaścittitvabodhanaṃ caturthīkarmaṇaḥ prāyaścittakarmatvena prāyaścittakarmamadhya eva prāyaścittisaṃjñājñāpanasya yuktatvātkṛtam | caturthīkarmaṇaḥ prāyaścittakarmatvaṃ tu -- agne prāyaścitta ityādimantraliṅgājjñeyam | pūrvavyākhyāne prasiddhavyāhṛtihomānantarya parityāgaḥ, imaṃ ma ityādīnāṃ caturṇāmeva prāyaścittasaṃjñetyatra vinigamakābhāvaḥ, aṅgahomasya madhye pradhānānuṣṭhānasyāśrutasya kalpanaṃ ceti doṣāḥ | asmadīyavyākhyāne tu naite doṣāḥ | pratyuta śāstrāntaraprasiddhāyā yājñikaprasiddhāyāśca svaśāstre samastavyāhṛtihomasya sarvaprāyaścittitvasaṃjñāsiddhiradhiketi draṣṭavyamiti yuktaṃ pratibhāti | atha prayogaḥ | pāṇigrahaṇadinamārabhya yā caturthī rātristasyāṃ tribhāgāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ varaḥ sapatnīkaḥ snātvā prāṅmukha upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamāsyā bhāryāyāḥ somagandharvāgnyupabhuktatvadoṣaparihāradvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ caturthīhomaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | ayaṃ ca saṃkalpo na caturthīkarmānto vivāha ityetasminkalpe | tato gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya śikhināmā'yamagnirityabhidhyāyannagniṃ prajvālya catvārīti dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā caturthīhomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādivyāhṛtyantamuktvā'gniṃ prāyaścittiṃ vāyuṃ prāyaścittimādityaṃ prāyaścittimādityaṃ prāyaścittiṃ vāyuṃ prāyaścittimagniṃ prāyaścittimagniṃ prāyaścittiṃ vāyuṃ prāyaścittimādityaṃ prāyaścittiṃ caikaikayā''jyāhutyā yakṣye | aṅgahome varuṇaṃ pūrvamaṅgahomakaraṇapakṣe tatpūrvaṃ vā draṣṭavyam | pātrāsādane saṃpātāvanayanārthaṃ pātramudakumbhaṃ darvīmājyasthālīṃ praṇītāpraṇayanaṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānidhmaṃ barhiravajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ cetyāsādya brahmavaraṇādivyāhṛtihomāntaṃ kṛtvā nava pradhānāhutīrjuhuyāt | "oṃ agne prāyaścitte tvaṃ prāyaścittirasi brāhmaṇastvā nāthakāma upadhāvāmi yā'syai ghorā tanastāmito nāśaya svāhā" agnaye prāyaścittaya idaṃ na mama |' "oṃ vāyo prāyaścitte tvaṃ prāyaścittirasi brāhmaṇastvā nāthakāma upa dhāvāmi yā'syai ninditā tanūstāmito nāśaya svāhā" vāyave prāya'ścittaya idaṃ0 | "oṃ āditya prāyaścitte tvaṃ prāyaścittirasi brāhmaṇastvā nāthakāma upadhāvāmi yā'syai patighnī tanūstāmito nāśaya svāhā" ādityāyaprāyaścittaya idaṃ | etā eva punaryutkrameṇa -- "oṃ āditya prā0 vāyo0 agne prā0" | punaḥ pūrvānukrameṇa -- "oṃ agne prā0 vāyo prā0 āditya prā0" | navapradhānāhutīnāṃ homānta ājyabindūnpūrvāsādite saṃpātāvanayārthe pātre prakṣipet | navāhutihomānantaraṃ tatsaṃpātājyaṃ darvyā bhāryayā mūrdhni juhoti -- "oṃ bhūrbhagaṃ tvayi juhomi svāhā" agnaya idaṃ0 | "oṃ bhuvo yaśastvayi juhomi svāhā" vāyava idaṃ0 | "oṃ suvaḥ śriyaṃ tvayi juhomi svāhā" sūryāyedaṃ0 | "oṃ bhūrbhuvaḥ suvastviṣiṃ tvayi juhomi svāhā" prajāpataya idaṃ0 | ityāhuticatuṣṭayaṃ mūrdhni hutvemaṃ ma ityādi sviṣṭakṛdādi vā saṃsthājapāntaṃ samānam | nātra trivṛdannahomaḥ | tata āsāditaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ kumbhamagneḥ samīpe nidhāyodakumbhasahitaṃ taṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtyāpareṇāgniṃ śayanasthānaṃ kalpayitvā pariśritya tatra prākśiraskāmudakśiraskāṃ vā bhāryāṃ śāyayet | atra vācanikamudakśiraskaṃ śayanam | tataḥ -- "oṃ abhi tvā pañcaśākhena śivenābhidviṣāvatā | sahasreṇa yaśasvinā | hastenābhimṛśāmasi suprajāstvāya" | [iti] tasyā yoniṃ dakṣiṇena hastenābhimṛśati | "oṃ saṃ nāmnaḥ sa hṛdayāni saṃ nābhiḥ saṃ tvacaḥ saṃ tvā kāmasya yoktreṇa yuñjānyavimocanāya" iti saṃgamaṃ karoti | "oṃ māmanuvratā bhava sahacaryā mayā bhava | yā te patighnī tanūrjāraghnīṃ tvetāṃ karomi śivā tvaṃ mahyamedhi kṣurapavirjārebhyaḥ" | [iti] tāṃ paryāliṅgati | "madhu he madhvidaṃ madhu jihvā me madhuvādinī | mukhe me sāraghaṃ madhu datsu saṃva[na]naṃ kṛtam || cākravāka saṃvananaṃ yannadībhya udāhṛtam | yadyukto devagandharvastena saṃvaninau svake" || iti dvābhyāṃ tasyā mukhena mukhaṃ juṣati(te) | idamupagamanamāvaśyakaṃ strīsaṃskāratvāt | tataḥ karmaṇaḥ sāṅgatāsiddhyarthamācāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā'nyebhyo bhūyasīṃ dattvā karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | prācīnarītyā prayoge tu -- anvādhāne vyāhṛtyanantaramaṅgahome varuṇaṃ dvābhyāmājyāhutibhyāṃ yakṣye, agniṃ varuṇaṃ caikayā''jyāhutyā yakṣye, agniṃ varuṇaṃ caikayā''jyāhutyā yakṣye, ityuktvā pradhānadevatollekhaḥ | anantaramayāsamagnimityādi | etadanusāreṇa homaḥ, ityetāvānviśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ | anyatsamānam | iti caturthīkarma | atha devakamaṇḍapodāsanam | tatra devakotthāpanasya kālaḥ -- "same ca divase kuryāddevakotthāpanaṃ budhaḥ | ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca viṣamaṃ neṣṭaṃ muktvā pañcamasaptamau" iti | sameṣu ṣaṣṭhaṃ viṣameṣu pañcamasaptamātiriktaṃ dinaṃ nātreṣṭamityarthaḥ | divasasaṃkhyā jyotirnibandhe -- "pratiṣṭhādinamārabhya yāvatṣoḍaśa vāsarāḥ | devakotthāpanaṃ kāryamudvāhe ca vrate daśa" iti || udvāhe ṣoḍaśadināni, mauñjībandhe daśa dināni kāla ityarthaḥ | eteṣu divaseṣu pañcamasaptamātiriktaṃ viṣamaṃ dinaṃ sameṣu ṣaṣṭhaṃ dinaṃ ca varjayitvā'vaśiṣṭe'nyatamadivase sthāpitadevatānāmudvāsanaṃ puṇyāhādivācanaṃ copanayanavatkuryāt | maṇḍapavisarjanaṃ tu vivāhadinamārabhya yāni navatriṣaṣṭhadināni tāni varja yitvetaradine kāryam | puṇyāhavācanābhiṣekānte purodhāstacchākhādikaṃ vaṃśapātre nidhāya tadupari prakṣiptābhiṣekajalaṃ sakuṭumbasya kartuḥ śirasi kiṃcitkiṃcitsrāvayet | "oṃ preti ceti ce0 rāgacchati" iti srāvaṇakāle paṭhet | evaṃ punardviḥ | etaccā''cārāt | tataḥ kartā śirasi baddhāñjaliḥ, asmadgotre ṣaṭasu ṣaṭsu māsesu śobhanāni santviti bhavanto bruvantviti dvijānvadet | te ca tvadgotre ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu māseṣu śobhanāni santviti pratibrūyuḥ | tato dvijāngandhapuṣpaphalatāmbūladakṣiṇābhiḥ saṃpūjya tadāśiṣo gṛhṇīyāt | evaṃ varapitrā'pi devakotthāpanaṃ kāryam | yattu muhūrtamārtaṇḍaṭīkāyāṃ vivāhadinamārabhya navatriṣaṣṭhadivaseṣūdvāsanamapi na kāryamityuktaṃ tanmaṇḍapasya natu devakāderiti draṣṭavyam | iti maṇḍapodvāsanam | atha vivāhanimittena varjyāni | tatra mātṛkāsthāpanamārabhya mātṛkodvāsanaparyantaṃ kānicidvarjyāni kānicittaduttaramapi varjyāni | tatrā''dyāni vṛddhamanuḥ -- "apasavyaṃ svadhā yātrā śītādbhiḥ snānameva ca | sapiṇḍā naiva kurvīranyāvanmātṛvisarjanam" iti || atrāpasavyasvadhāśabdābhyāṃ tadvatkāryaṃ lakṣyate | apasavyamityanenaiva siddhe svadhāśabdopādānaṃ svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ svāheti pitṛyajñasahacaritavaiśvadevaniṣedhārtham | ācārasaṃvādalābhāt | "pretadāho dadhisnānaṃ snānaṃ śītena vāriṇā | vaiśvadevaḥ svadhākṛtyaṃ brahmayajña upoṣaṇam || vedasyādhyayanaṃ caiva vedasyādhyāpanaṃ tathā | sīmātikramaṇaṃ naiva devakotthāpanāvadhi" || iti dharmapradīpavacanācca | yadyapi svadhā pitṛbhya ūrgbhavetisvadhāśabdavatpitṛkarmeṣṭyādāvapi vartate tathā'pi tatra niṣedho na pravartate śrautasya prābalyāt | evamāhitāgnikartṛkapiṇḍapitṛyajñe'pi | yadyapi devakotthāpanāvadhikakarmaṇyamāntarbhāvasyaiva niṣedhena devakotthāpanasyāmādivasātprāgeva jāyamānatvena niṣedhāvasaro nāsti tathā'pi kenacitpratibandhena devakotthāpanamātraṃ na jāyate tadaitaddraṣṭavyam | saṃgrahe -- "nityaśrāddhaṃ cādhyayanaṃ snānaṃ śītena vāriṇā | prārabdhe maṅgale naiva maṇḍapodvāsanāvadhi" iti || nityaśrāddhaṃ prātyahikaṃ śrāddham | gārgyaḥ -- "nāndīśrāddhe kṛte paścādyāvanmātṛvisarjanam | darśaśrāddhaṃ kṣayaśrāddhaṃ snānaṃ śītodakena ca || apasavyaṃ svadhākāraṃ nityaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca | brahmayajñaṃ cādhyayanaṃ nadīsīmāvilaṅghanam || upavāsaṃ vrataṃ caiva śrāddhabhojanameva ca | naiva kuryuḥ sapiṇḍāśca maṇḍapodvāsanāvadhi" iti || (saṃskāradarpaṇe smṛtyantare -- "mṛtpuṇḍraṃ bhasmapuṇḍraṃ ca snānaṃ śītodakena ca | naiva kuryuḥ sapiṇḍāśca maṇḍapodvāsanāvadhi" iti || vedāntaśravaṇagītāpāṭhādikamapi śiṣṭā varjayanti |) smṛtyantare -- "vivāhe mekhalābandhe varṣamardhaṃ tadardhakam | gehārambhapraveśau ca varjayetsarvadā budhaḥ" iti || nātra yathāsaṃkhyamiti kecit | bṛhaspatiḥ -- "tīrthe vivāhe yātrāyāṃ saṅgrāme deśaviplave | nagaragrāmadāhe ca spṛṣṭāspṛṣṭirna duṣyati" iti || (saṃgrahe -- "vivāhādikamāṅgalye pratiṣṭhāyāṃ mahotsave | āsamāpti na gantavyaṃ sūtake mṛtake'pi ca" iti ||) atha taduttaraṃ varjyāni | yogayājñavalkyaḥ -- "na snāyādutsave'tīte māṅgalyaṃ vinivartya ca | anuvrajya suhṛdbandhūnarcayitveṣṭadevatām" iti || kārṣṇājiniḥ -- "vivāhavratacūḍāsu varṣamardhaṃ tadardhakam | piṇḍadānaṃ mṛdā snānaṃ na kuryāttilatarpaṇam" iti || vratamupanayanam | hemādrau jyotiṣparāśaraḥ -- "vivāhe vihitānmāsāṃstyajeyurdvādaśaiva hi | sapiṇḍāḥ piṇḍanirvāpe mauñjībandhe ṣaḍeva hi" iti || kvacitpratiprasavamāha sa eva -- "mahālaye gayāśrāddhe mātāpitroḥ kṣaye'hani | yasya kasyāpi martyasya sapiṇḍīkaraṇe tathā | kṛtodvāho'pi kurvīta piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ sadā" iti | gayāśrāddhapadaṃ sarvatīrthaśrāddhopalakṣaṇam | kṣayāhagrahaṇaṃ nityānāmaṣṭakādiśrāddhānāmupalakṣaṇam | nanvevaṃ mahālaye'pi piṇḍanirvapaṇasiddhau mahālayagrahaṇasya vyarthatvāpattiḥ | ataḥ kṣayāhagrahaṇamupalakṣaṇamiti vaktumaśakyamiti cenna | mahālaye piṇḍadānaniṣedhena kālāntarasadbhāvātkālāntare mahālayānuṣṭhānaṃ syāttanmābhūtkiṃ tu svakāla eva sapiṇḍako mahālayaḥ kartavya ityevaṃ tasya sārthakyasaṃbhavāt | sapiṇḍīkaraṇagrahaṇaṃ navaśrāddhaṣoḍaśaśrāddhopalakṣaṇam | mātāpitroriti kṣayāhaviśeṣaṇaṃ havirubhayatvavadavivakṣitaṃ tena bhrātṛpitṛvyādivārṣike'pi piṇḍadānaṃ kāryameva | baudhāyano'pi -- "vivāhe copanayane caule caiva yathākramam | varṣamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ ca netyeke tilatarpaṇam" iti | etatpratiprasavastu tarpaṇaprakaraṇe vakṣyate | madanaratne smṛtyantare -- "piṇḍānsapiṇḍā no dadyuḥ pretapiṇḍaṃ vinā'tra tu | pitṛyajñe ca yajñe ca gayāyāṃ dadyureva te" iti | pitṛyajñe piṇḍapitṛyajñe | yajñe pitryeṣṭyāṃ saumike makhe ca | te sapiṇḍāḥ | satyavrataḥ -- "pitroreva mṛtāhe tu gayāyāṃ ca mahālaye | kṛtodvāho'pi kurvīta piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ sutaḥ" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- "abhyaṅge sūtake caiva vivāhe putrajanmani | māṅgalyeṣu ca sarveṣu na dhāryaṃ gopicandanam" iti | etacca māsaparyantam, -- "vivāhādau māsamekaṃ na dhāryaṃ gopicandanam" | iti jyotirnibandhavacanāt | smṛtyantare -- "kṛtvā vivāhaṃ vratabandhanaṃ ca varṣaṃ tadardhaṃ na ca tīrthayātrām | kṣauraṃ ca piṇḍāṃstilayuktakarma na caiva kuryurhi narāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ" iti | jyotiṣpradīpe -- "snānaṃ sacailaṃ tilamiśrakarma pretānuyānaṃ kalaśapradānam | apūrvatīrthāmaradarśanaṃ ca vivarjayenmaṅgalato'bdamekam | māsaṣaṭkaṃ vivāhādau vrataprārambhaṇe(ṇaṃ) na ca | vratasyodyāpanaṃ naiva naiva kuryādupoṣaṇam | jīrṇabhāṇḍādi na tyājyaṃ gṛhasaṃmārjanaṃ tathā | ūrdhvaṃ vivāhātputrasya tathā ca vratabandhanāt | ātmano muṇḍanaṃ naiva varṣaṃ varṣārdhameva ca" iti | putragrahaṇenātra putryapi gṛhyate | muṇḍanaṃ kṣauram | kartanaṃ tu bhavatyeva, "muṇḍanasya niṣedhe tu kartanaṃ vai vidhīyate" | iti smṛtyantaravacanāt | (smṛtiratnākare saṃgrahe -- "vivāhopanayordhvaṃ tu varṣaṃ varṣārdhameva ca | vrataprārambhaṇaṃ naiva vratasyodyāpanaṃ tathā | na kuryātpiṇḍanirvāpaṃ na dadyātkarakāṇi ca | devotsavaṃ tathā kṛtvā varṣaṃ varṣārdhameva ca | maṅgalātparato gehacchādanaṃ caiva varjayet" iti | vivāhābde putrasya putryā vā vivāhakartuḥ pitrāderbhāryā garbhiṇī cettadā doṣa uktaḥ smṛtyantare -- "udvāhābde garbhiṇī cetsvabhāryā hānirmṛtyurgarbhanāśo bhramaśca | tacchāntyarthaṃ svarṇaniṣkatrayeṇa kṛtvā mṛtyorākṛtiṃ pūjya dadyāt" iti | pūjyetyatra samāsābhāve'pi ktvo lyabādeśaśchāndasaḥ | dadyādityatra brāhmaṇāyeti śeṣaḥ |) iti varjyāni | atha prasaṅgātpunarvivāhaḥ | tatra vivāhe kṛte paścāllagnaṃ pañcāṅgaśuddhirāhityādinā duṣṭamiti jñātaṃ cettadā jyotiḥśāstroktakālaviśeṣe punarvivāhaṃ kuryāt | śrīdharīye nṛsiṃhaḥ -- "punarvivāhaṃ vakṣyāmi daṃpatyoḥ śubhavṛddhidam | lagnendulagnayordoṣe grahatārādisaṃbhave || anyeṣvaśubhakāleṣu duṣṭayogādisaṃbhave | vivāhe tvatha daṃpatyorāśaucādisamudbhave || atrā''śaucaśabdena grahaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ tatrāpyāśaucasya sattvāt | bhrāntyaitat | ādiśabdenotpātā gṛhyante | gurvāśaucaviṣayaṃ vā | tasya doṣasya śāntyarthaṃ punarvaivāhyamiṣyate | ayanaṃ cottaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vardhate tu viśeṣataḥ || āṣāḍhamārgaśīrṣau dvau varjyau śeṣāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | vivāhoktarkṣatithyaṃśarāśivārādivargakāḥ || karaṇā yogasaṃjñāni grahagocarayogakāḥ | tasminvivāhasamaye śumadāṃśca tathaiva tu || pūrvāhṇe pūrvarātre ca vivāhaḥ śubhado bhavet" iti | iti punarvivāhaviṣayaḥ | atha dvitīyādivivāhanimittāni | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "dharmaprajāsaṃpanne dāre nānyāṃ kurvītānyatarābhāve kāryā prāgagnyādheyādādhāne satī karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyate yeṣāmetadaṅgam" iti | śrauteṣu gārhyeṣu smārteṣu ca karmasu śraddhā śaktiśca dharmasaṃpattiḥ prajāsaṃpattiḥ putravattvamevaṃbhūte dāre sati nānyāṃ kurvīta, anyāṃ nodvahet | anyāmiti strīliṅganirdeśānusāreṇa bhāryāmityanuṣajyate | dharmaprajayoranyatarābhāve kāryodvāhyā | tatrāpi prāgagnyādheyānnordhvamādhānāt | etadarthamevedaṃ vacanam | ubhayasaṃpattau na kāryetyukte'nyatarābhāve kāryetyasyāṃśasya prāptatvāt | yadā cānyatarābhāve kāryā tadā kā śaṅkā | ubhayābhāve kāryetyatra prāgagnyādheyādityatra hetuḥ | ādhāne satītyādiḥ | ādhāne satī vidyamānā karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyate'dhikriyate | kairyeṣāmagnihotrādīnāmetadādhānamaṅgamupakārakaṃ taiḥ | atra dāre satītivacanānmṛte tasminprāgūrdhvaṃ cā''dhānātsatyāmapi putrasaṃpattau dharmasaṃpattyarthaṃ dāraparigrahaṇaṃ kartavyameva | tathā ca manuḥ -- "bhāryāyai pūrvamāriṇyai dattvā'gnīnantyakarmaṇi | punardārakriyāṃ kuryātpunarādhānameva ca" iti || yājñavalkyo'pi -- "āharedvidhivaddārānagnīṃścaivāvilambayan" iti | nanu prāgagnyādhānātkarmabhiḥ saṃbadhyate gārhyaiḥ smārtaiśca tatkimucyata ādhāne satī karmabhiḥ saṃbadhyata iti | satyam | asmādeva hetunirdeśādanumīyate prāga gnyādhānātsatyāmapi dharmasaṃpattau prajāsaṃpattau ca rāgāndhasya kadāciddāragrahaṇe nātīva doṣa iti | yadyāhitāgnerbhāryā karmasu śraddadhānā śaktā vā na bhavati putrāśca mṛtā anutpannā vā tadā kartavya eva vivāha iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | ratyarthe vivāhāntare viśeṣaḥ -- "ekāmutkramya kāmārthamanyāṃ voḍhuṃ ya icchati | samarthastoṣayitvā'rthaiḥ pūrvoḍhāmaparāṃ vahet" iti || yājñavalkyaḥ -- "ājñāsaṃpādinīṃ dakṣāṃ vīrasūṃ priyavādinīm | tyajandāpyastṛtīyāṃśamadravyo bharaṇaṃ striyai" iti || sadhano dhanatṛtīyāṃśam, adhano'śanācchādanātmakaṃ bharaṇaṃ dāpya ityarthaḥ | yā tvetāvatā bharaṇenāparituṣṭā gṛhānnirgacchettāṃ pratyāha manuḥ -- "adhivinnā tu yā nārī nirgacchedroṣitā gṛhāt | sā sadyaḥ saṃniroddhavyā tyājyā na kulasaṃnidhau" iti || adhivedanīyoktā yājñavalkyena -- "surāpī vyādhitā dhūrtā vandhyā'rthaghnyapriyaṃvadā | strīprasūścādhivettavyā puruṣadveṣiṇī tathā || adhivinnā'pi bhartavyā mahadeno'nyathā bhavet" iti | adhivedanaṃ bhāryāntaraparigrahaḥ | surāpī madyapī | surāpāne'dhivedanamātraṃ na kiṃtu tyāgo'pi, "tathā mahati pātake" iti tyāgahetutvena tasya smṛtāvabhidhānāt | "patatyardhaṃ śarīrasya yasya bhāryā surāṃ pibet" iti vacanācca | ata eva manuḥ -- "madyapā'satyavṛttā ca pratikūlā ca yā bhavet | vyādhitā cādhivettavyā hiṃsārthaghnī ca sarvadā" iti || vyādhitā dīrgharogiṇī | asatyavṛtteti padacchedaḥ | karmaṇaḥ prātarāprātaḥ sāyaṃ karmaṇa āhutirnātipadyeta pārvaṇaṃ pārvaṇāntarāt" iti | yacca nidānasūtram -- "sarvamahaḥ prātarāhuteḥ sthānaṃ sarvā rātriḥ sāyamāhuteḥ pūrṇaḥ pakṣo darśasya kṛṣṇaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrṇamāsasya" iti | tadrāṣṭrabhraṃśādimahāpattiviṣayam | prathamaupāsanahome viśeṣamāha śaunakaḥ -- "yadi rātrau vivāhāgnirutpannaḥ syāttathā sati | upakramyottarasyāhnaḥ sāyaṃ paricaredamum" iti | sudarśanabhāṣye tu yadi rātrau navanāḍikāmadhye'gnyutpattistadā tadaiva homārambhaḥ | taduttaraṃ cetparadine sāyamārambha ityuktam | atha homadravyāṇi | tatra vrīhayo yavā vā mukhyāḥ | "nitya sāyaṃprātarvrīhibhiryavairvā hastenate āhutī juhoti" iti gṛhyoktatvāt | |candrikāyāṃ smṛtyantare -- "havistu trividhaṃ proktaṃ kṛtaṃ caiva kṛtākṛtam | akṛtaṃ ca kramādeṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samyagucyate | kṛtamodanasaktvādi taṇḍulādi kṛtākṛtam | vrīhyādi cākṛtaṃ proktamiti havyaṃ tridhā budhaiḥ" iti | akṛtaṃ prakṣālya hotavyam | tathā ca cchāndogyagṛhyam -- ' a kṛtaṃ cetprakṣālya juhuyāt' iti | smṛtyantare -- "śāliśyāmākanīvārā vrīhigodhūmayāvakāḥ | eteṣāṃ taṇḍulā homyā yāvanālāḥ priyaṃgavaḥ" iti | smṛtyantare -- "nīvārāḥ śālayaścāpi godhūmā vrīhayo yavāḥ | svarūpeṇaiva homyāḥ syuḥ svarūpeṇaiva te tilāḥ" iti | gṛhyapariśiṣṭe -- 'payo dadhi sarpiryavāgūrodanastaṇḍulāḥ somastailamāpo vrīhayo yavāstilā iti homyāni' iti (taṇḍulā nīvāraśyāmākayāvanālānāṃ, vrīhiyavagodhūmapriyaṃgavaḥ svarūpeṇāpi homyāḥ, tilāḥ svarūpeṇaiva, tailaṃ ca tilajartilātasīkusumbhānāmiti |) yāvanālāḥ 'joṃdhalā' iti hemādriḥ | smṛtibhāskare -- "yavābhāve tu godhūmāstato veṇuyavādayaḥ | chandogavacanāccaiva juhuyāddhaviratyaye || phalaṃ vā yajñavṛkṣasya tatpatramathavā jalam" iti | vrīhiyavau varjayitvā sarvāṇyanukalpadravyāṇi | tatrā''dau vrīhiyavayormadhye yaddravyaṃ prathamaprayoge gṛhītaṃ tadeva sarveṣu prayogeṣu grāhyam | tadalābhe pratinidhireva grāhyo na tu vihitaṃ dravyāntaramiti pratinidhiprakaraṇe'bhiyuktairuktatvāt | "parigṛhītaviṣaye prakramāttu niyamyate" iti sūtraṃ pramāṇam | abhiyuktodāhṛtaṃ vacanamapi -- "rūpaṃ kālo'nunirvāpo devatāśrapaṇaṃ tathā | ādau ye vidhṛtāḥ pakṣāsta eva syuḥ sadaiva hi" iti || rūpaṃ rūpavaddravyamityarthaḥ | kvaciddravyamityeva pāṭhaḥ | āgrayaṇe dyāvāpṛthivya ekakapāla ājyaṃ veti | vāyavyaṃ payo yavāgūrvetyādīni rūpodāharaṇānīti kecit | rūpaṃ dākṣāyaṇadarśapūrṇamāsasvarūpādītyanye | rūpaṃ kriyārūpam | agniṣṭa ityadbhirabhimṛśati sakṛttrirvetyādi, iti pare | prathamamate -- vrīhibhiryavairvetyādīni smārtānyudāharaṇāni | dvitīyamate -- āpūrvikatvāghāravattvādi | tṛtīyamate tu bahūnyetādṛśānyudāharaṇāni | paśvijyāsaṃvatsare prāvṛṣyāvṛttimukhayorvetyādīni śrautāni kālodāharaṇāni | ubhau kālau sāyaṃ sāyaṃ vetyādīni smārtāni | sadyaskālā paurṇamāsī dvyahakālā vodite'nudite vā juhotītyubhayodāharaṇāni | anunirvāpodāharaṇaṃ tu śrautameva | paurṇamāsānantaraṃ vaimṛdhānunirvāpyapakṣo'ṅgīkṛtaścetkartavya eveti | upāṃśuyājadevatā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiragnīṣomau vā sāṃnāyyamaindraṃ māhendraṃ vā nirūḍhaḥ paśuraindrāgnaḥ sauryaḥ
