prājāpatyo vetyevamādīni śrautāni devatodāharaṇāni | agnaye svāhā sūryāya svāheti vetyevamādīni smārtāni | āgrayaṇa indrāgnī agnīndrau veti tūbhayodāharaṇam | śrapaṇodāharaṇaṃ tu śrautameva | haviḥśrapaṇamāhavanīye gārhapatye veti | evamādivikalpasthale yaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvamaṅgīkṛtaḥ sa evā''ntaṃ svīkārya ityarthaḥ | atra kecit -- idamupalakṣaṇam | tena vyāhṛtībhirvā'nvādadhātītyādiṣu vikalpasthaleṣu sarveṣvapi niyamaḥ sidhyatītyāhuḥ | asminmate smārtodāharaṇaṃ jayābhyātānarāṣṭrabhṛdupahomādikaṃ jñeyam | anye tu pramāṇābhāvenopalakṣaṇaparatāmanyāyyāṃ manyamānaḥ parigaṇiteṣvevāyaṃ niyamo nānyatreti vadanti | sāyaṃhomadravyeṇaiva prātarhomaḥ | ekaphalakatvāt | maṇḍano'pi -- "sāyaṃhome tu yaddravyaṃ tadeva prātariṣyate" iti | evaṃ kartṛniyamo'pi sarvathāsaṃbhave yajamānaṃ vinā | tathā ca gadādharabhāṣye -- "śrautāgnimathavā smārtaṃ sāyaṃprātarhuneddvijaḥ | eka eveti bahavo juhuyurlaukiko bhavet" [iti |] madanaratne -- "eka eva hunedagniṃ sāyaṃprātardvijottamaḥ | sāyamanyaḥ prātaranyo juhuyāllaukiko bhavet" [iti ||] smṛtisāre -- "sāyaṃ prātaśca juhuyādeka eva hutāśanam | yadanyo juhuyātprātaḥ sa vṛthā'gnirbhaveddhruvam || sāyaṃ prātaśca juhuyādāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayam | eka evāgnihotraṃ ca smārtāgniṃ ca viśeṣataḥ" [iti |] gadādharabhāṣye smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "yajamānaṃ vinā nānyo juhuyātprātarāhutim" iti | etadatikrame samastavyāhṛtibhiḥ praṇavena cā''jyāhutirhotavyā -- "kapālanāśane caiva ṛtvigdravyaviparyaye | pavitranāśe vede ca yatkiṃcitpātrabhedane || ājyāhutiśca hotavyā vyāhṛtyā praṇavena ca" iti || ṛtvijāṃ ca viparyaya iti vyāhṛtyā praṇavena cetyevaṃ pāṭhadvayāṅgīkāre dravyaviparyaye samastavyāhṛtihomamātram | vyāhṛtyā praṇavena vetipāṭhāṅgīkāre'pi samastavyāhṛtihoma evātra niyataḥ | 'ayaṃ ca dravyakartṛniyamaḥ samudāyasaṃkalpapakṣa eva' iti prayogārṇave | prātarhome yajamāne kartari nāyaṃ niyama iti kecit | homadravyasya saṃskāra ukto baudhāyanagṛhye -- "homadravyamavadyotya darbhāgre pratyasya paryagni kṛtvā'gneḥ paścātkūrce nidadhyāt" iti | homātpūrvaṃ samidādhānamavaśyaṃ kartavyam | "nāsamitke juhuyādyadasamitke juhuyādahutameva tadbhavati" iti śrutau "nāsamitke juhuyādyadasamitke juhuyādyathā hyajihve'nnaṃ dadyāttādṛktattasmātsamidvatyeva hotavyam" iti baudhāyanagṛhye ca doṣaśravaṇāt | anantaramapi samidādhānaṃ pākṣikamuktaṃ chandogapariśiṣṭe -- "upariṣṭādapi samindhanameke" iti | eka itivacanātpākṣikatvam | avadānapramāṇamuktaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "prasthadhānyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭerāhuteḥ parikīrtitam | tilānāṃ ca tadardhaṃ tu taṇḍulā vrīhayaḥ samāḥ" iti || prasthaparimitadhānyasya catuḥṣaṣṭyaṃśa ityarthaḥ | prasthalakṣaṇaṃ saṃgrahe -- "palaṃ ca kuḍavaḥ prastha āḍhako droṇa eva ca | dhānyamāneṣu boddhavyāḥ kramaśo'mī caturguṇāḥ" iti || palalakṣaṇamapi tatraiva -- "paladvayaṃ tu prasṛtaṃ muṣṭirekapalaṃ smṛtam" iti | baudhāyanastu -- "vrīhīṇāṃ vā yavānāṃ vā śatamāhutiriṣyate" ityāha | śatasaṃkhyadhānyasyaikā''hutirityarthaḥ | uttarāhutistu kiṃcidadhikā kāryā śrautabhaktatvādasya | agastyaḥ -- "dravadravyasya mānaṃ syāddhārā gokarṇadīrghikā" iti | chandogapariśiṣṭe -- "dhānyāhutirdvādaśaparvapūrikā ghṛtādinā cetsruvavaktrapūrikā | daivena tīrthena ca hūyate haviḥ svaṅgāriṇi svarciṣi tatra pāvake" iti || dvādaśaparvapūrakadravyāsaṃbhave ṭoḍarānande śaṅkhaḥ -- "ārdrāmalakamātrā vai grāhyā(sā) induvrate smṛtāḥ | tathaivā''hutayo'gnau ca śaucārthe yā ca mṛttikā" iti || home viśeṣaḥ saṃgrahe -- "aṅgulyagrairna hotavyamakṛtvā'ṅgulibhedanam | aṅgulyuttarapārśvena hotavyamiti tu smṛtiḥ" iti || baudhāyano'pi -- "nirvapaṇasaṃstravaṇalājahomanityahomānkāyatīrthena kuryāt" iti | nityahoma aupāsanādiḥ | gobhilīye viśeṣaḥ -- "na muktakeśo jahayānnānipātitajānakaḥ | anipātitajānostu rākṣasairhriyate haviḥ" iti || etacca sarvahomaviṣayam | ācāraratne yājñavalkyaḥ -- "hutvā'gnisūryadaivatyāñjapenmantrānsamāhitaḥ" iti | smṛtipradīpe tu -- "upatiṣṭhedagnisūryau tattanmantraiḥ samāhitaḥ" ityupasthānamuktam | tena vikalpaḥ | sāyaṃhome'gnidaivatyamantrajapo'gnidaivatyairupasthānaṃ vetyetadanyataratkāryam | prātarhome tu sūryadaivatyamantrajapaḥ sūryadaivatyairupasthānaṃ vetyetadanyataraditi | asminhome kartā svayameva | ācāryeṇānyeṣāmavidhānādāśvalāyanena spaṣṭatayā svasyaiva mukhyakartṛtvābhidhānācca | aśaktāvasāṃnidhye kāryavyāsaktau vā, ṛtvigādayaḥ | tathā ca dakṣaḥ -- "ṛtvikputro gururbhrītā bhāgineyo'tha viṭpatiḥ | etaireva hutaṃ yattu taddhutaṃ svayameva tu" iti || putrasthāne patnītyapi pāṭhaḥ | sa cā''śvalāyanānāmanukūlaḥ | "svayaṃ patnyapi vā putraḥ kumāryantevāsī vā" iti tatsūtrāt | na satyāṣāḍhasūtrānusā riṇāmanukūlaḥ "na strī juhuyānnānupetaḥ" iti dharmasūtre niṣedhāt | ata eva kumārīkartṛkahomo'pi na | ayaṃ ca niṣedho dvijaniyamārtha iti vyākhyātāraḥ | viṭpatirjāmātā | mādhavīye hotṛtāratamyamuktam -- "anyaiḥ śatahutāddhomādekaḥ śiṣyahuto varam | putraiḥ śatahutāddhomādeko hyātmahato varam" iti || kātyāyanaḥ -- "nātivṛddho bhaveddhotā nālpavidyo na bāliśaḥ | nā''rto nāsaṃskṛtaścaiva agnihotrādikarmasu || narakaṃ hi patantyete juhvataḥ sa ca yasya tat | tasmādvaitānakuśalo hotā syādvedapāragaḥ" iti || vaitāna ityupalakṣaṇaṃ smārtakarmaṇaḥ | gopālaḥ -- "alpavidyairavidyairvā hute patnyā hute'pi vā | juhuyādagnihotraṃ ca laukikāgnāvanāpadi || vitdṛtya tānvyātdṛtibhiḥ kārye pūrṇāhutīṣṭike" iti || pūrṇāhutīṣṭyoratra samuccaya iti vyākhyākṛt | iṣṭiratra tantumatī | baudhāyanokteḥ | smārte tu, iṣṭisthāne caruḥ | etaccānāpadviṣayam | āpadi tu brāhmaṇamātrasyā''rtvijyārthaṃ varaṇe'nādiṣṭaprāyaścitteṣu ājyasthālyāḥ sruveṇopahatya juhoti prajāpataye svāhā hiraṇyagarbhāya svāhā bhṛgūṇāṃ pataye svāhā'ṅgirasāṃ pataye svāheti sarvaprāyaścittaṃ ca | bhṛgūṇāṃ pataye svāhā'ṅgirasāṃ tapase svāhetyevamapi pāṭhaḥ | kāryavyāsaktāvapi parvaṇi tu svayameva 'parvaṇi yajamānaḥ svayamagnihotraṃ juhoti' iti parvaṇi svakartṛkatvaniyamāt | yadyapīdaṃ śrautaṃ tathā'pi śrautamadhye smārtāmnānabalātsmārte'pi labhyate | na caivaṃ vapanamapi parvaṇi prāpnotīti vācyam | 'yajvanaḥ parvaṇoḥ kṣauram' iti vacane yajvagrahaṇenā''hitāgnereva parvaṇi kṣauraṃ na smārtāgnimata ityetādṛśārthasyaiva bodhanāt | yadi tvaśaktirasāṃnidhyaṃ vā tadā'nyo juhuyādeva na tu sarvathā lopo nityatvāt | śaktau sāṃnidhye vā parvaṇi svayamajuhvataḥ prāyaścittaṃ bṛhaspatirāha -- "āhitāgnirupasthānaṃ na kuryādyastu parvaṇi | ṛtau na gacchedbhāryāṃ vā so'pi kṛcchrārdhamācaret" iti || atropasthānagrahaṇaṃ homopalakṣaṇam | ṛtvigādibhirayaṃ homo daṃpatyoḥ saṃnidhāne satyeva kāryaḥ | abhāve'nyatarasaṃnidhāne | ubhayorapyasaṃnidhāne hutamapyahutaṃ bhavati | taduktaṃ smṛtyarthasāre -- "asamakṣaṃ tu hotavyaṃ daṃpatyornartvigādibhiḥ | dvayorapyasamakṣaṃ cedbhaveddhutamanarthakam" iti || smṛtyantare -- "saṃnidhau yajamānaḥ syāduddeśatyāgakārakaḥ | tadabhāve tu patnī syāduddeśatyāgakāriṇī || tadabhāve tu putraḥ syāduddeśatyāgakārakaḥ" iti | yajamānasyonmāde patnyāṃ cartumatyāṃ prasūtāyāṃ vā nānujñā patnyāḥ | "asaṃnidhau tu patnyāḥ syādadhvaryustadanujñayā | unmāde prasave cartau kurvītānujñayā vinā" || iti madanapārijāte smṛteḥ | etasmādeva vacanājjñāyata ṛtvigādīnāṃ homārthamanujñāpekṣā'stīti | asti ca spaṣṭaṃ kaurmaṃ vacanam -- "ṛtvikputro'thavā patnī śiṣyo vā'pi sahodaraḥ | prāpyānujñāṃ viśeṣeṇa juhuyāttu yathāvidhi" iti || viśeṣeṇeti vacanaṃ mamā''vaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ kiṃcidasti mama kācidāpadasti tvayā homaḥ kārya iti viśeṣato'nujñāpekṣaṇārtham | anyacca smṛtyarthasāre -- "nopavāsī pravāse syātpatnī dhārayate vratam | sarvathā yajamāno hi tyajettaddiṅmukhaḥ śuciḥ" iti || taddiṅmukho yasyāṃ diśyagnayo bhavanti taddigabhimukha ityarthaḥ | ṛtviglakṣaṇamāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "ṛtvijo vṛṇīte'nyūnānatiriktāṅgānye mātṛtaḥ pitṛtaśceti yathoktaṃ purastādyūna ṛtvijo vṛṇīta ityeke" iti | lāṭyāyanadrāhmāyaṇāvapi -- "ṛtvigārṣeyo'nūcānaḥ sādhucaraṇo vāggmyanyūnāṅgo'natiriktāṅgo dvayasato'(mo')natikṛṣṇo'natiśvetaḥ" iti | pramāṇe dvayaṃ dvayaṃ samaṃ yasya sa dvayasata(ma) ityagnisvāmidhanvibhyāṃ vyākhyātam | vādhūlo'pi -- "ārṣeyaṃ vṛṇīte yaḥ svānṛṣīñjānāti" iti | etenāprajñātabāndhavānāṃ nivṛttiḥ | baudhāyano'pi -- "athartvijāṃ varaṇaṃ vijñāyate brāhmaṇā ṛtvijo yonigotraśrutavṛttasaṃpannā agniguṇāṅgā atrikiṇino na parikhātikrāntā nāntagā nāntajā nānanūcānā nahāleyavāleyaputrikāputraparakṣetrasahoḍhakānīnānujāvaradvipravarāḥ" iti | tathā -- "yonivṛttavidyāḥ pramāṇamityeka iti tāṃścedvṛṇītāvyāpannāṅgāneva vṛṇīta" iti | yoniḥ pariśuddhayoniḥ | gotraṃ sadvaṃśaḥ | śrutamadhyayanam |vṛttamācāraḥ | taiḥ saṃpannā yuktāḥ | aviguṇāṅgā avyāpannāṅgāḥ | atrikiṇinaḥ, trayaḥ kiṇā yeṣāṃ te trikiṇinaḥ | kiṇā āghātādinā dehagatāni cihnāni | atratyatrikiṇaśabdena mallayuddhasaṃnāhārthāsphoṭanajyāghātabhārādivahanairutpannāḥ kiṇā vivakṣitāḥ | etādṛśakiṇatrayamadhya ekenāpi kiṇena yuktā na bhaveyurityarthaḥ |idamupalakṣaṇam | avihitakāryeṣu bhūyobhyāsajanitacihnayuktā na bhaveyuriti bodhyam | na parighā(khā) tikrāntāḥ parighā(khā) maryādā samudravelā tāmatikrāntāḥ samudrayāyino na bhaveyurityarthaḥ | nāntagāḥ| antaṃ deśaṃ pratyantadeśaṃ mlecchadeśamiti yāvat | taṃ gacchantītyantagāste na bhaveyuḥ | antavarṇaṃ gacchanti śūdrastriyaṃ gacchantīti yāvat | te na bhaveyurityanye | antamityupalakṣaṇam | agamyāṃ striyaṃ ye gacchanti te'pi na bhaveyuriti draṣṭavyam | nāntajāḥ | antajāḥ pūrvoktadeśajātāste na bhaveyuḥ | śūdrastriyāmutpannā na bhaveyurityanye | nānanūcānā anadūcānā aśrotriyāste na varaṇīyāḥ | halena kṛṣiṃ kṛtvā ye jīvanti te hāleyāḥ | vālamūrṇāprakīrṇakādikaṃ vikrīya ye jīvanti te vāleyāḥ | kanyādānasamaye -- "asyāṃ yo jāyate putraḥ sa me putro bhaviṣyati" ityabhisaṃdhānena dattāyāṃ putrikāyāṃ jātāḥ putrikāputrāḥ | parakṣetre jāreṇotpannāḥ parakṣetrāḥ | vivāhasamaya eva garbhasthatvena mātrā saha dattaḥ sahoḍhaḥ | kanyāyāmavivāhitāyāṃ jātaḥ kānīnaḥ | anujasya guṇabhūto jyeṣṭho'nujāvaraḥ | ekasmingotra utpanno'parasmingotre datto dvipravaraḥ | etānhāleyādīnṛtviktvena na vṛṇīta ityarthaḥ | yoniḥ pariśuddhayoniḥ | vṛttamācāraḥ | vidyā vaidikavidyā ca pramāṇaṃ varaṇaprayojakamityeka ācāryā vadantītyarthaḥ | tānyonivṛttavidyāsaṃpannānyadi vṛṇīta tadā'vyāpannāṅgāneva vṛṇītetyartha iti vyākhyātaṃ bhāṣyakṛtā | dharmasūtre'pi -- "nānanūcānamṛtvijaṃ vṛṇīte na paṇamānam" iti | sāṅgasya vedasyādhyetā pravaktā cānūcānaḥ | nānūcāno'nanūcānaḥ | etādṛśamṛtvijaṃ na vṛṇīte | nāpyetāvaddeyamiti paribhāṣamāṇamiti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | dharmasūtre vacanamaupāsanahomapārvaṇasthālīpākavaiśvadevādiṣu ṛtvikkartṛkatā'pi pakṣe'stīti pradarśayitum | āpastambo'pi -- "brāhmaṇānārṣeyānṛtvijo vṛṇīte yūnaḥ sthavirānvā'nūcānānūrdhvavāco'naṅgahīnān' iti | brāhmaṇānāmārtvijyamityanenaiva siddhe punarbrāhmaṇavacanamādarārtham | athavā tasmādvājapeyayājyārtvijīna iti śruteḥ kṣattriyasyāpi vājapeyayājinaḥ prāptiratra śaṅkitā nirasyate | bālavṛddhayoḥ prāyaḥ kriyāsu pāṭavaṃ na syāditi yuvasthaviragrahaṇam | ūrdhvavācaḥ paṭusthānakaraṇā iti rudradattaḥ | brāhmaṇavacanamāpadyapi kṣattriyādinivṛttyarthamiti mīmāṃsakāḥ | "dvijottamānāmārtvijyaṃ na tu kṣattriyavaiśyayoḥ | brāhmaṇārtvijyaniyamaḥ kratvarthenāpi hi smṛtaḥ" iti miśrāḥ | rāmāyaṇe'pi -- "kṣattriyo yājako yasya caṇḍālaḥ sa viśeṣataḥ | kathaṃ sadasi bhoktāro havistasya surarṣayaḥ" iti | etena kṣattriyādivṛttyupajīvino'pi nirākṛtā iti navīnāḥ | garbhiṇīrajasvalāpativaraṇaṃ na kartavyam | tathā ca prāyaścittadarpaṇe smṛtiḥ -- "rajasvalā'ṅganā yasya garbhiṇī vā yadā bhavet | na yajñe varaṇe yogyo gālavo munirabravīt" iti | yajñaśabdenā''dhānādikarmāṇi gṛhyante | etacca smārtakarmopalakṣaṇam | rudraskandhabhāṣye -- "rajasvalāyāṃ bhāryāyāmārtvijyaṃ śrāddhabhojanam | yātrāmambunidhisnānaṃ varjayettatpatiḥ sadā | gargaḥ -- kṣurakarma tathā''rtvijyaṃ yātrāma(cā)bhyaṅgameva ca | devatārcāṃ(rcā) paragṛhe sāgarasnānameva ca | śrāddhabhuktiṃ ca(ktiśca) varjyaṃ syādyadi patnī rajasvalā | śāṭyāyaniḥ -- rajasvalāpatiryātrāmārtvijyaṃ śrāddhabhojanam | sindhusnānaṃ tathā'bhyaṅgaṃ kṣurakarma ca varjayet | tatra ṛtvijastrividhā devabhūtāḥ pitṛbhūtā manuṣyabhūtāśca | tatra svenaiva karmaṇi karmaṇi vṛtāste devabhūtāḥ | ye tu pūrvairvṛtā eva karmaṇi pravartante te pitṛbhūtāḥ | ye tu svenaiva sarvakarmārthaṃ sakṛdeva vṛtāste manuṣyabhūtāḥ" iti | tatredānīṃ manuṣyabhūtā evartvijaḥ | āśaucaṃ tu pitṛbhūtadevabhūtānāmevartvijāṃ na manuṣyabhūtānāmiti draṣṭavyam | home patnyā api sāṃnidhyamapekṣitam | 'patyurno yajñasaṃyoge' iti pāṇinismṛtyā patnīśabdasya yajñasaṃyoga evotpannatvāt | 'asamakṣaṃ tu hotavyaṃ daṃpatyornartvigādibhiḥ ' itivacanācca | asaṃnidhāne sarvaprāyaścittaṃ hotavyam | anālambhukā cenna doṣaḥ | pravasati yajamāne yadā'nālambhukā tadā tayā gṛhāntarāntaritayā na sthātavyaṃ kiṃ tvaupāsanāgnigṛhasamīpe bahirevetyagnihotrahomaprāyaścittaprakaraṇe vyākhyātāraḥ | śrautasmārtahomayoḥ pūrvāparabhāve pakṣadvayamāha bharadvājaḥ -- "homaṃ vaitānikaṃ kṛtvā smārtaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | smṛtīnāṃ vedamūlatvātsmārtaṃ kecitpurā viduḥ" iti | u(au)pāsanapraśaṃsā bharadvājasūtre -- "yathaiśvaryabalādīśvarāḥ svāndehānparityajyānyeṣāṃ dehānpraviśya punarātmadehānpratyāgacchanti, na ca tena durjñāyate, aupāsane'gnayo vini(nivi)ṣṭā aupāsanau(no) yajamāne tasmādaupāsanānna pramaditavyaṃ yatha ṛṣabha ṛṣa bhāyāṃ vatsaṃ janayatyevamaupāsane'gnihotraṃ vyāpannaṃ bhūyo janayati, aupāsanasyaivaiṣā saṃtatiryadagnihotraṃ tadu tathā na kuryānna vidyata aupāsanāgnihotrayorvivecanamubhayaṃ juhuyādaupāsanamagnihotraṃ cāthāpi vijñāyate sapta pākayajñasaṃsthā aupāsane caturdaśāgnihotre" [iti] | aupāsanahomaṃ praśaṃsatyaṅgirāḥ -- "yaddadyātkāñcanaṃ meruṃ pṛthivīṃ ca sasāgarām | tatsāyaṃprātarhomasya tulyaṃ bhavati vā na vā" iti | akaraṇe pratyavāyamāha gargaḥ -- "kṛtadāro na tiṣṭheta kṣaṇamapyagninā vinā | tiṣṭheta ceddvijo vrātyastathā ca patito bhavet | yathā snānaṃ yathā saṃdhyā vedasyādhyayanaṃ yathā | tathaivaupāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na sthitistadviyogataḥ | yo hi hitvā vivāhāgniṃ gṛhastha iti manyate | annaṃ tasya na bhoktavyaṃ vṛthāpāko hi sa smṛtaḥ | yatra nāśnanti vai devāḥ pitaro'tithayastathā | vṛthāpākaḥ sa vijñeyo na tasyādyātkathaṃcana | vṛthāpākasya bhuñjānaḥ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati" iti | pratiprasavamāha sa eva -- "pitṛpākopajīvī ca bhrātṛpākopajīvakaḥ | jñānādhyayananiṣṭho vā na duṣyetāgninā vinā" iti | baudhāyanena vidhurasya vivāhāsāmarthye'nāśramitvadoṣaparihārāyopāya uktaḥ -- "athāto mṛtapatnīkasya vivāhāsamarthasya homavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ praṇavena laukikāgniṃ parigṛhyānvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadityānīya pṛṣṭo divīti pratiṣṭhāpya tatsavitustā savituradyā no deva savitarviśvāni deva savitariti catasṛbhiścatasraḥ samidho'bhyādhāyāgnimalaṃkṛtyaupāsanaṃ juhuyādevamaharahaḥ kāle praṇavādihomāntaṃ kuryādāvivāhādāsaṃnyāsādvā maraṇādanāśramadoṣo nāstītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | śākalena tu pārvaṇasthālīpākāgrayaṇakarmaṇorapi kriyoktā -- "sthālīpākadvayaṃ kuryāttathaivā''grayaṇaṃ ca hi | kuryādityāhurācāryāstasminneva hutāśane" iti | bhāradvājīyapitṛmedhasūtre'pi -- "dārakarmaṇi yadyaśakta ātmārthamagnyādheyaṃ kuryāddarśapūrṇamāsāvāgrayaṇaṃ ca śeṣāṇi karmāṇi na bhavanti" iti | ardhādhāninā'pi darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākaupāsanahomā na kartavyā iti kecit | kartavyā ityanye | atha prayogaḥ | pāṇigrahaṇottaraṃ gṛhapraveśanīyātprāganantaraṃ vā yāvajjīvamastamitanakṣatradarśanapradoṣānyatame mukhyakāle caturdhā vibhaktāyā rātrerādyabhāgātmake gauṇakāle vā sāyaṃhomaḥ |prātarhomastūṣaḥpurodayoditapakṣivākpravadanakālānyatame mukhyakāle pañcadhā vibhaktadivasasya prathamabhāgadvayātmake gauṇakāle vā | mukhyakāla eva prathamārambha iti kecit | gauṇakāle'pītyanye | vastutastu gauṇakālo viśeṣato vihita eva grāhyaḥ | anyathā tṛtīyādiṣu prathamapārvaṇasthālīpākānuṣṭhānāpatteḥ | na hyatra gauṇakālasya viśeṣato vidhānaṃ kiṃ tu svakālāduttaro gauṇa iti sāmānyato vidhānam | aupāsanahomādau tvasti viśeṣato gauṇakālasya vidhānam -- "pradoṣānto homakālaḥ sāyaṃ saṃgavāntaḥ prātaḥ" iti | ataḥ prathamopāsanahomaḥ pradoṣasaṃgavātmake vihite gauṇakāle'pi bhavati | sudarśanenāpyetadabhipretyaivetthamuktam -- yadi nava nāḍyo nātītāḥ syustadā prathamaupāsanārambha iti | sāyamevopakramaḥ | sāyaṃprātarekameva dravyameka eva kartā | parvaṇi svayameva juhuyāt | sapatnīkaḥ kartā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ satyadhikāre yāvajjīvaṃ sāyaṃprātaraupāsanahomau hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | agnihotrahomārambhottaramardhādhāninā'pyaupāsanahomo na kārya ityetanmatameva mayā svī kriyata iti niścite tu agnihotrahomārambhapūrvatanakālaparyantaṃ sāyaṃprātaraupāsanahomau hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpe viśeṣaḥ | vastutaḥ karaṇapakṣa eva yuktaḥ | tato gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya puṇyāhādi vācayitvā'gnisūryaprajāpatayaḥ prīyantāmiti vadet | prātarapyagnerdevatātvapakṣe'gniprajāpatī prīyetāmityūhaḥ | etadantaṃ prathamaprayoga eva na tu pratiprayogam | tataḥ punarācamanaprāṇāyāmadeśakālasaṃkīrtanāni kṛtvā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ sāyaṃprātaraupāsanahomau hoṣyāmi | idānīṃ sāyamaupāsanahomaṃ vrīhibhirhoṣyāmīti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | yavairiti yavapakṣe | athavā sāyamaupāsanahomaṃ vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmi prātaraupāsanahomaṃ vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmīti bhinnau saṃkalpau | asminpakṣe na dravyaikyakartraikyaniyamaḥ | ubhayapakṣe'pi saṃkalpavākye dravyollekho na vā kartavyaḥ | tataścatvāri śṛṅgeti dhyātvā'gniṃ paristīrya homadravyamagneruttarato nidhāya tadupari prāgagrāṃ prādeśamātrīmekāṃ samidhaṃ dve vā prāgagre prādeśamātryau samidhau nidhāya dakṣiṇena hastenaupāsanāgnau prajvalitairdarbhairavācīnajvālairupari jvalayitvā jvalitāndarbhānsavyahaste gṛhītvā dakṣiṇena darbhāgre aṅguṣṭhaparvamātre tasminprakṣipya prajvalitāndarbhāndakṣiṇena hastena bahirnirasyāpa upaspṛśyānyāndarbhānādāyaupāsanāgnau prajvalitaiḥ paryagni kṛtvā tānapi darbhānbahirnirasyāpa upaspṛśyāgneḥ paścātkūrce homadravyaṃ nidadhāti | na vā darbhāgrapratyasanaṃ sūtrāntarīyatvāt | asminpakṣa uparijvalanottaraṃ savyahaste grahaṇaṃ na | śrautabhaktatvātparyagnikaraṇaṃ tu bhavatyeva | evaṃ kūrce nidhānaṃ ca | tataḥ pūrvapariṣekaṃ kuryāt | tato vivāhahoma uktena prakāreṇa dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ saṃmṛjya yastvā hṛdetyagnimabhyarcya tūṣṇīṃ homadravyoparisthāṃ samidhaṃ prāgagrāmagnāvādhāya dvādaśaparvaparimitaṃ homadravyaṃ saṃspṛṣṭāṅgulidakṣiṇahastatale gṛhītvā'gnaye svāheti jvalantyāṃ samidhi mūlāddvyaṅgulaparimitaṃ pradeśaṃ tyaktvottarapārśvena juhoti | agnaya idaṃ na mama | tataḥ pūrvāhutito'dhikamavaśeṣitaṃ homadravyaṃ sarvamādāya prajāpatiṃ manasā dhyāyanprajāpataye svāheti manasā mantramuccārayanpūrvāhutito dvyaṅgulaparimitaṃ pradeśaṃ tyaktvottarapārśvenaiva juhoti | prajāpataya idaṃ na mama | dravadravyahome tu darvyā sruveṇa vā homaḥ | tato dvitīyāṃ samidhamādadhyāt | na vā dvitīyasamidādhānam | asminpakṣe paryagnikaraṇakāla ekaiva samit | tataḥ paristaraṇānyagneruttarato visṛjyottarapariṣekaṃ kuryāt | na vā paristaraṇapūrvapariṣekaparistaraṇavisargottarapariṣekāḥ | tato'gnirmūrdhetyādimantratrayasyāgnirṛṣiragnirdevatā | gāyatrī chandaḥ | prajāpata ityasya viśve devā ṛṣayaḥ | prajāpatirdevatā | triṣṭupchandaḥ | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ agnirmūrdhā di0 tvāmagne0 ayamagniḥ0' iti tribhirmantrairagnimupasthāya 'oṃ prajāpate na0' iti prajāpatimupatiṣṭhate | (japa eva vā | asminpakṣe jape viniyoga iti viniyogavākye viśeṣaḥ|) tataḥ saṃsthājapaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ saṃpūjya bhasma dhṛtvā śraddhāṃ medhāmiti saṃprārthya namaskṛtyānena sāyamaupāsanahomena śrīparameśvaraḥ prīyatāmiti karmeśvarāyārpayet | prātaraupāsanahome tu prātaraupāsanahomaṃ vrīhibhirhoṣyāmīti saṃkalpaḥ | yavairiti yavapakṣe | agnaye svāhā sūryāya svāheti veti pūrvāhutau devatāvikalpaḥ | agnerdevatātvapakṣe sāyaṃhomavadevopasthānam | sūryasya devatātvapakṣe tu -- udvayamudu tyaṃ citramiti mantratrayasya soma ṛṣiḥ | sūryo devatā | prathamasyānuṣṭup | dvitīyasya gāyatrī | tṛtīyasya triṣṭup | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ udvayaṃ0 udu tyaṃ0 citraṃ0' iti tribhirmantraiḥ sūryopasthānaṃ kṛtvā prajāpatyupasthānādi samānam | tatra prātaraupāsanahomena śrīparameśvaraḥ prīyatāmitīśvarārpaṇavākye viśeṣaḥ | payohome tu payodhiśrapaṇārthaṃ bahiraṅgāranirūhaṇaṃ kṛtvā tatrādhiśritya sruvaparimitajalapratyasanaṃ kāryameva svasūtroktatvāt | śrautabhaktatvādatra prāptiḥ | dadhisomataṇḍulānāṃ tu aṅgāreṣvadhiśrayaṇaṃ pratiṣekaśca na | 'yadanyadadhiśrayaṇātpratiṣekācca taddadhnastaṇḍulānā somasya ca kriyate' iti vacanāt | dadhyatra laukikam | taṇḍulāstu vrīhīṇāṃ tatraiva sārvajanīnaprasiddheḥ | somasya rasa eva na vallī | pūtīkāstu yāgārtha eva pratinidhirvācaniko na sarvatra | eteṣu darbhāgradvayapratyasane vikalpo vrīhiyavavat | yavāgvāṃ tu pūrvaṃ pratiṣekaḥ paścādavekṣaṇam 'pratiṣekaṃ yavāgūṃ śrapayati' iti sūtravyākhyāvasare vaijayantīkārokteḥ | evamevaudane | yavāgūśabdena śithila odana ucyate | taṇḍulavadyavagodhūmapriyaṃguvrīhitileṣu | taile darbhāgradvayapratyasane vikalpaḥ | ājye tu darbhāgradvayapratyasanaṃ niyatamiti draṣṭavyam | svasyāsāmarthye'sminnaupāsanahoma ṛtvijaṃ tvāmahaṃ vṛṇa iti homārthamṛtvijaṃ vṛtvā tena kārayet | tyāgastu svakartṛka eva patnyā vā | patnyā anadhikāre tu tadanujñābhāve'pyṛtvijo veti draṣṭavyam | atra madhye prāyaścittahomaḥ patati cettadā homasthāne homamantrajapa eva | anājyavati karmaṇi japaḥ | ājyavati homa iti vyākhyātṛbhiruktatvāt | dīkṣāyāṃ gṛhītāyāṃ na dīkṣito juhotīti niṣedhātkratusamāptiparyantaṃ na homaḥ | ityaupāsanahomaḥ | atha prasaṅgātsamasyahomaḥ | tatra prajāpatiḥ -- "sāyaṃprātastanau homāvubhau sāyaṃ samasya tu | āpanno jahuyāttatra samidekā'thavā dvayam || sāyaṃhomasya mukhyatvāttadīyaṃ tantramiṣyate | catastra āhutīḥ kuryāttatra dve sāyamāhutī || dve prātarāhutī sāyaṃhome caikā samidyadi | samitkṛtā dvitīyā cetsā bhavetprātarāhutau || dviḥ sāyaṃhomavanmṛjyāddviḥ prātarhomavatsrucam | upasthānaṃ sakṛtkāryaṃ śeṣaṃ prakṛtivadbhavet || keciddve āhutī hutvā saṃveśyaiva nimīlya vā | vicchidyaivaṃ tu tau homau kuryāddve āhutī tataḥ || gurvāpadi samasyante prātaḥ sarve kadācana | yāvanto'tra samasyante sarve sāyamupakramāḥ || prātaḥkālāpavargāśca na tu prātarupakramāḥ" iti | atha pakṣahomavidhiḥ | tatra maṇḍanasmṛtyarthasārau -- "āmayāvyārtimānāpadgato vā'dhvagato'pi vā | rāṣṭrabhaṅge dhanābhāve gurugehe vasannapi || anyeṣvevaṃprakāreṣu nimitteṣvāgateṣu ca | samāsamagnihotrāṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamācaret || nimittānāmihaiteṣāṃ nirdiśyaikaṃ yaducyate | tatsarveṣu nimitteṣu jānīyātpratipāditam || pakṣahomānaśeṣānvā śeṣahomānathāpi vā" iti | agnihotrāṇāmityanenāgnihotrahomatulyatvādaupāsanahomānāmapi grahaṇam | 'ya āhitāgnerdharmaḥ syātsa aupāsanikasya tu' ityukteḥ | aśeṣānpakṣatyādīnpakṣāntāvadhikān | śeṣānyatkiṃcitpūrvāvadhikān | yattu -- "tṛtīyāyāṃ caturthyāṃ vā pañcamyāṃ vā paratra ca | tadādīnāṃ tadantānāṃ homānāṃ śeṣasaṃjñitā" || iti trikāṇḍīvacanāttṛtīyāyā evaṃ pūrvāvadhitvaṃ na tu dvitīyāyā iti vadanti tatpāmarapratāraṇamātram | etasya vacanasya trikāṇḍyāmanupalambhāt | marīciḥ -- "śarīrāpadbhavedyatra bhayārtaśca prajāyate | yathā'nyāsvapi cā''patsu pakṣahomo vidhīyate || huteṣu pakṣahomeṣu madhye tasmānnivartate | homaṃ punaḥ prakuryāccenna cāsau doṣakṛdbhavet" iti || cedityanena vikalpaḥ sūcyate | pakṣahomagrahaṇaṃ śeṣahomopalakṣaṇamityācāraratne | baudhāyano'pi -- "athā''padyagnihotrāṇāṃ samāso rāṣṭravibhrame vyādhipīḍāyāmadhvagamanaprasaṅge gurukulavāsāpekṣāyāṃ mātṛpitṛkalatraputrādyatyaye balavato nirodhādau deśakāladravyānupapattau cātyantāpatsu" iti | agnihotrāṇāmagnihotrasaṃbandhināṃ homānām | rāṣṭravibhramo rāṣṭravikṣobhaḥ | viśiṣṭa ādhirvyādhirmānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ, pīḍā bāhyaṃ dukham | atyayo nāśaḥ | balavato nirodho balavatkartṛko nirodhaḥ | balavati nirodhādāvitipāṭhe balavattvaviśeṣaṇaṃ nirodhādīnāṃ draṣṭavyam | maṇḍano'pi -- "āpadevāvadhistatra na pakṣagaṇanāvadhiḥ" iti | ālasyādinā samasyahome doṣamāha gopālaḥ -- "naitajjāmitayā kāryaṃ na rāgānna ca lobhataḥ | naitacchaktiṃ dadhānastu kuryācchraddhālurāpadi || anāpadyācaranniṣṭyā tantumatyā yajeta saḥ" iti | jāmitā''lasyam | śaktimāñjāmitayā rāgeṇa lobhena vā naitatsamasyahomavidhimanutiṣṭhet | āpadi tvanutiṣṭhedeva | anāpadi yadyanutiṣṭhettadā tantumatyeṣṭyā yajedityarthaḥ | atra tantumatīṣṭisthāne tāntumataḥ sthālīpākaḥ | "ya āhitāgneḥ puroḍāśāste'nāhitāgneścaravaḥ" | iti śāstrāntarāt | yajñapārśve tu -- "anāturo'pravāsī ca niścinto nirupadravaḥ | pakṣahomaṃ tu yo dadyātsa caretpatitavratam" iti || pūrvaṃ prāyaścittamanabhyāsaviṣayam | yajñapārśvoktaṃ tvabhyāsaviṣayamiti vyavasthā | samuccaya iti kecit | evaṃ saṃtataṃ pakṣatrayaṃ na kartavyam | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "tṛtīye'nantare pakṣe samāsaṃ na samācaret" iti | tathā -- "kṛcchreṇāpi vinirvṛtya tatra homāndine dine | pakṣāntare punaḥ kāmaṃ pakṣahomādimācaret" iti || sarvathaitadasaṃbhave sa evā''ha -- "āpaccedanuvarteta yāvajjīvaṃ kathaṃcana | yāvajjīvamavicchinnānpakṣahomānsamācaret" iti || yattu candrikāyāṃ -- "yadi pakṣahomena pakṣatrayamatīyātpunarādhānam" iti tadanāpattiparam | viśeṣaḥ smṛtibhāskare -- "sarvathaupavasathyāhe sāyaṃ homaḥ pṛthagbhavet | tathaiva yajanīye'hni prātarhomo bhavetpṛthak" iti || maṇḍanaḥ -- "parvopavāsaśūnyaṃ cetprāptaṃ kenāpi hetunā | tadā tatsāyaṃhomo'pi pūrvaiḥ saha samasyate" iti || atha prayogaḥ | āpannimittaṃ pratipatsāyaṃkālamārabhya caturdaśīsāyaṃkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānsāyamaupāsanahomānāpannimittaṃ dvitīyāprātaḥkālamārabhya paurṇamāsīprātaḥkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānprātaraupāsanahomāṃścāpakṛṣya tantreṇa hoṣyāmi | tatredānīmāpannimittaṃ pratipatsāyaṃhomamārabhya caturdaśīsāyaṃkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānsāyamaupāsanahomāṃstantreṇa vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmīti sāyam | āpannimittaṃ dvitīyāprātaḥkālamārabhyāmukaparvaprātaḥkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānprātaraupāsanahomāṃstantreṇa vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmīti prātaḥ | bhinnasaṃkalpapakṣe tatredānīmityantaṃ nāsti | śeṣahomavidhau tu amukadinasāyaṃkālamārabhya caturdaśīsāyaṃkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyānsāyamaupāsanahomāṃstantreṇa vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmīti sāyam | amukadinaprātaḥkālamārabhyāmukaparvaprātaḥkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānprātaraupāsanahomāṃstantreṇa vrīhibhiryavairvā hoṣyāmīti prātaḥ | athavā''rabhyetyantaṃ na kutrāpi vadet | yadā tu kenacinnimittena bhāviparvaṇyanvādhānābhāvaniścayastadā tatsāyaṃhomasyāpi pūrvaiḥ saha samāsa iti kecit | evamapyāpattirna gaccheccetpunaḥ pakṣāntare'pi tathaiva kuryāt | tṛtīye pakṣa āpattau satyāmapi na pakṣahomasamāsaḥ | kiṃtu śeṣahomasamāsa eva | evaṃ śeṣasamasyayorapi | yadi kadācitpakṣahomadvayānantaramatyāvaśyakatayā gamanaprasaktistadā dvyāhikatryāhikasamasyahomau pratipaddine kṛtvā grāmāntaraṃ gatvā śeṣahomāḥ kāryā iti kecit | yadi sāyaṃpakṣahomānantarameva śeṣahomānantarameva vā tasyāmeva rātrau prātaḥkālādarvāgeva mahadā(hā)pattistadā tatkāla eva nimīlanena dinavyavadhānaṃ bhāvayitvā'gnīnpunaḥ prātaḥkālavadvihṛtya prātarhomāḥ samasya kāryāḥ | sāyaṃ mahatyāpattiścetsāyameva kāladvayahomānkuryāt | mahadā(hā)pattinimittamamukadinasāyaṃkālamārabhya caturdaśīsāyaṃkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānsāyaṃhomānamukadinaprātaḥkālamārabhyāmukaparvaprātaḥkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānprātarhomāṃśca sāyameva samāsenāmukadravyeṇa hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpya yathoktavidhipūrvakaṃ sāyaṃkālikamāhutidvayaṃ hutvā kaṃcitkālaṃ viramya nimīlyānantarameva prātaḥkālikamāhutidvayaṃ hotavyam | agnerdevatātvapakṣe saṃpratipannadevatākatve'pi nimīlanadharmeṇa vyavadhānātpṛthagevā''hutidvayam | prātarmahatyāmāpattau tu mahadā(hā)pattinimittamamukaprātaḥkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānprārhomānamukadinasāyaṃkālamārabhya caturdaśīsāyaṃkālaparyantamamukasaṃkhyākānsāyaṃhomāṃśca prātareva samāsenāmukadravyeṇa hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpya yathoktavidhipūrvakaṃ prātaḥkālikamāhutidvayaṃ pūrvaṃ hutvā kaṃcitkālaṃ viramya sāyaṃkālikamāhutidvayaṃ hotavyam | atrāpi virāmeṇa vyavadhānātpṛthageva prātarāhutidvayam | yadā tu dīrghakāla mahattarāpattisaṃbhāvanā tadā yāvajjīvamavicchinnānpakṣahomānkuryāt | sarvatrā''pattyavasānamevāvadhirna pakṣagaṇanāvadhiḥ | pakṣahome śeṣahome vā kṛte yadyantarāla āpannivarteta tadā prāgghutānāṃ vaikalpikī kartavyatā | pakṣahomādau kṛte satyudayāstamayayoḥ prāduṣkaraṇābhāve'pi na prāyaścittaṃ tasya homārthatvāditi vṛddhāḥ | iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāmaupāsanahomapakṣahomaśeṣahomaprayogaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ trayodaśaṃ prakaraṇam || 13 || <14-15> atha caturdaśaṃ prakaraṇam | atha pārvaṇasthālīpākaṃ vaktumādau parvanirṇaya ucyate | tatra tayoḥ kramaḥ śrautasūtre -- 'pūrvā paurṇamāsyuttarā'māvāsyā' iti | sarvatra darśapūrṇamāsau nirdiṣṭau darśapūrvau, tatra pāṭhakrameṇaivobhayoranuṣṭhāne prāpta idaṃ sūtramārabhyate | 'alpāctaram' iti darśaśabdasya pūrvanipāte'pi pūrvā paurṇamāsyevetyarthaḥ | śrutāvapyārambhaṇīyāprakaraṇe sārasvatahomārthavāde 'ya enayoranulomaṃ ca' ityādinā 'tatpratilomam' ityantenānulomapratilomayoḥ svarūpaṃ pradarśya 'yatpaurṇamāsīṃ pūrvāmālabheta pratilomamenāvālabheta' ityādinā pūrṇamāsasya pūrvā[na]nuṣṭhāne doṣamabhidhāya taddoṣaparihārāya sārasvatahomavidhiriti kṛtvā pūrvā paurṇamāsyuttarā'māvāsyetyeva kramaḥ pradarśitaḥ | atrānumantraṇasūktavākadevatāyājyādīni bahūni liṅgānyapi | pārvaṇasthālīpākayorapyevameva | taduktaṃ śaunakabaudhāyanābhyām -- "paurṇamāsī tu saṃprāptā yā vivāhādanantaram | tadopakramya kurvīta sthālīpākaṃ tu parvasu | tatra yadyapyamāvāsyā vivāhānantaraṃ patet | tathā'pi paurṇamāsyādisthālīpākakriyā smṛtā" iti | smṛtyantaramapi -- "caturthīhomataḥ pūrvaṃ prāpyate yadi pūrṇimā | tatraiva yāgaḥ kartavyo hyanvādhānapuraḥsaraḥ" iti | tatra vivāhahomānantaraṃ sthālīpākārambhātpūrvamadhimāsādikaṃ cettatrāpi kartavyatoktā saṃgrahe -- "pārvaṇeṣṭiṃ cā''grayaṇaṃ saṃdhyopāsanakarma ca | agnihotraṃ pākayajñānanyānyapi malimluce | kuryānnityāni karmāṇi na prārambha iti sthitiḥ' iti | smṛtyantare'pi -- "malimluce māsi pauṣe nānvārambhaṇamiṣyate | gurubhārgavayormauḍhye candrasūryagrahe tathā" iti | etadvacanadvayamālasyādinā svakālānupakrāntasthālīpākādiprārambhaviṣayam | kālaprāptasyā''rambhe na doṣaḥ | tathā ca gargaḥ -- "nāmakarma ca darśeṣṭiṃ yathākālaṃ samācaret | atipāte sati tayoḥ praśaste māsi puṇyabhe" iti | nāmakarmagrahaṇaṃ nityanaimittikasmārtakarmopalakṣaṇam | darśeṣṭigrahaṇaṃ nityanaimittikaśrautakarmopalakṣaṇamiti prayogapārijātahemādyādayaḥ | maṇḍanastu -- "ādhānānantaraṃ paurṇamāsī cenmalamāsagā | tasyāmārambhaṇīyādi na kurvīta kadācana" ityāha || 'nityamata ūrdhvaṃ parvasvāgneyena sthālīpākena yajate' iti sūtreṇa paurṇamāsyamāvāsyātmakeṣu parvasvāgneyasthālīpākānuṣṭānamuktam | tatra tayoḥ paurṇamāsyamāvāsyayoḥ svarūpaṃ gobhila āha -- "yaḥ paramo viprakarṣaḥ sūryācandramasoḥ sā paurṇamāsī, yaḥ paramaḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ sā'māvāsyā" iti | darśaśabdo dṛśyate yogibhireva candramā yatreti vyutpattyā manuṣyairna dṛśyate candramā yatreti viparītalakṣaṇayā vā'māvāsyāyā eva vācakaḥ | 'darśaḥ sūryendusaṃgamaḥ' itikośāt | sūryendvoḥ saṃgamo yatretyarthaḥ | tatra pūrṇimānirvacanaṃ matsyabrahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ -- "kalākṣaye vyatikrānte divā pūrṇau parasparam | candrādityau parāhṇe tu pūrṇatvātpūrṇimā smṛtā" iti || parāhṇe sūryāstamayakāle yathā''dityaḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ sannastameti tathottarakṣaṇe candraḥ saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaḥ sannudetītidṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvavivakṣayā candrādityayorupanyāsaḥ | amāvāsyānirvacanaṃ matsyavāyubrahmāṇḍapurāṇeṣu -- "amā vasetāmṛkṣeṣu yadā candradivākarau | eṣā pañcadaśī rātriramāvāsyā tatastu sā" iti || amā sahetyarthaḥ | śrutau tu nirvacanāntaramuktam -- "amā vai no'dya vasu vasatītīndro hi devānāṃ vasu tadamāvāsyāyā amāvāsyatvam" iti | te ca paurṇamāsyamāvāsye pratyekaṃ dvividhe anumatī rākā ca sinīvālī kahūśceti | etatsvarūpaṃ kaṭhaśākhāyāmaitareyabrāhmaṇe ca -- "yā pūrvā paurṇamāsī sā'numatiryottarā sā rākā yā pūrvā'māvāsyā sā sinīvālī yottarā sā kuhūḥ" iti | etāsāṃ lakṣaṇamuktaṃ bṛhadvasiṣṭhena -- "rākā saṃpūrṇacandrā syātkalonā'numatiḥ smṛtā | paurṇamāsī divā dṛṣṭe śaśinyanumatiḥ smṛtā || rātridṛṣṭe punastasminsaiva rāketi kīrtitā | dṛṣṭacandrāmamāvāsyāṃ sinīvālīṃ pracakṣate || etāmeva kuhūmāhurnaṣṭacandrāṃ maharṣayaḥ" iti || tatra kuhūbhinnānāṃ tisṛṇāṃ laghvakṣaroccāraṇaparimitaḥ kālaḥ saṃdhirityucyate | kuhvāstvakṣaradvayaparimitaḥ | tathā ca hemādrau bhagavatīpurāṇam -- "anumatyāśca rākāyāḥ sinīvālyāḥ kuhūṃ vinā | etāsāṃ dvilavaḥ kālaḥ kuhūmātrā kuhūḥ smṛtā" iti || lavasvarūpaṃ mādhavīye smṛtyantare -- "laghvakṣaracaturbhāgastruṭirityabhidhīyate | truṭidvayaṃ lavaḥ prokto nimeṣastu lavadvayam" iti || tathā ca lavadvayaṃ laghvakṣaraṃ bhavati | laghvakṣaroccāraṇaparimite kāla ekaḥ parvaṇo bhāgo dvitīyaḥ pratipadastadubhayaṃ militaṃ saṃdhirbhavati | kuhūpratipadoḥ saṃdhistu 'kuhū' ityakṣaradvayaparimitaḥ | tathā ca matsyabrahmāṇḍapurāṇayoḥ -- "kuhviti kokilenokte yāvānkālaḥ samāpyate | tatkālasaṃjñitā caiṣā amāvāsyā kuhūḥ smṛtā" iti || iti saṃdhisvarūpe jñāte saṃdhau yajetetiśruteḥ saṃdhau yāgaḥ prāptastasya cātisūkṣmatvena karmānuṣṭhānāyogyatvātsaṃdhiśabdaḥ saṃdhipārśvadvayaṃ lakṣayati | tathā ca saṃdhipārśvadvaye saṃdhau yajetetiśrutiryāgaṃ vidhatte | ata eva śrutyantaram -- 'saṃdhimabhito yajeta' iti | hemādrau baudhāyano'pi -- "sūkṣmatvātsaṃdhikālasya saṃdherviṣaya ucyate | sāmīpyaṃ viṣayaṃ prāhuḥ parveṇātha pareṇa ca" iti || atra pūrvaparaśabdābhyāṃ krameṇa saṃdheḥ pūrvaṃ parvadinaṃ paraṃ pratipaddinaṃ ca krameṇābhidhīyate | tatra kṛtsnasya parvaṇaḥ pratipadaśca grahaṇe prāpte niyamamāha vṛddhaśātātapaḥ -- "parvaṇo yaścaturthoṃ'śa ādyāḥ pratipadastrayaḥ | yāgakālaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prātarukto manīṣibhiḥ" iti || yāgakālavivekamāha gobhilaḥ -- "āvartane yadā saṃdhiḥ parvapratipadorbhavet | tadaharyāga iṣyeta parataścetpare'hani" iti || tathā -- "parvapratipadoḥ saṃdhirarvāgāvartanādyadi | tasminnahani yaṣṭavyaṃ pūrvedyustadupakramaḥ" iti || laugākṣiḥ -- "pūrvāhṇe vā'tha madhyāhne yadi parva samāpyate | upoṣya tatra pūvedyustadaharyāga iṣyate" iti || smṛtyantare'pi -- "āvartane yadā saṃdhistataḥ pūrvamathāpi vā | tasminnahani yaṣṭavyaṃ parataścetpare'hani || āvartanātparaḥ saṃdhiryadi tasminnupakramaḥ | paredyuriṣṭirityeva parvadvayavinirṇayaḥ" iti || tathā -- "aparāhṇe'tha vā rātrau yadi parva samāpyate | " upoṣya tasminnahani śvobhūte yāga iṣyate" iti || pūrvāhṇa āvartane vā saṃdhau tasminnevāhani yāgaḥ | pūrvedyuranvādhānādi | āva rtanādūrdhvaṃ saṃdhau tu tasminnahanyanvādhānādi paredyuryāga iti niṣkṛṣṭo'rthaḥ | āvartanaśabdenāṅgo madhyatanasaṃdhirūpaḥ kāla ucyate | "āvartanāttu pūrvāhṇo hyaparāhṇastataḥ paraḥ | madhyāhnastu tayoḥ saṃdhiryadāvartanamucyate" || iti madanaratnodāhṛtavacanāt | tayoḥ pūrvāhṇāparāhṇayoḥ | sa ca saṃdhirmuhūrtaparimita iti kecit | niśīthanyāyenetyeteṣāmāśayaḥ | śrautasūtre'pi parvanirṇaya uktaḥ -- "pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīmupavasetsaṃpūrṇāṃ vā pūrvāmamāvāsyāṃ yadaharvā na dṛśyate" iti | arthatasya sūtrasya smṛtiparvanirṇayānurodhenārtho varṇyate | pūrvāṃ caturdaśīyuktāmupavasedyadi paredyurasaṃpūrṇetyagrimasūtraparyālocanayā'rthātsidhyati | saṃpūrṇāṃ veti | yasyāḥ sāmyena vihitayā pratipadā saṃyuktāmityarthātsyāt | dvedhā vibhaktasya divasasya prathamārdhavyāpitvena sthitāmityarthaḥ | tathācā(ca) saṃpūrṇā cetparā | itarathā pūrvetyarthādavagamyate | atraivāvāntarabhedena sadyaskālo jñeyaḥ | evaṃ pūrvāmamāvāsyāmityatrāpi samānam | yadaharvā na dṛśyata ityatrāpi pūrvayuktā yasmindine [na] dṛśyate'māvāsyā tatra saṃpūrṇāmamāvāsyāmityākṛṣya yojyaṃ pūrvavat | atropavāsaśabdena nāśanābhāvaḥ | daṃpatī aśnīta ityanena virodhāt | kiṃtūpavāsaśabdena jāyāpatyorekavāraṃ bhojanamucyate | dharme vakṣyamāṇatvāt | athavā -- "upāvṛttastu pāpebhyo yastu vāso guṇaiḥ saha | upavāsaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ" || iti smṛtisiddha upavāsaśabdārtho grāhya iti vaijayantīkṛtā vyākhyātam | tatra 'parvaṇo yaścaturthāṃśaḥ' ityanena vacanena parvaṇaścaturthoṃ'śaḥ pratipadastrayoṃ'śāśca yāgakālatvena vihitāḥ | tatra yadyāvartane tataḥ purā vā saṃdhirbhavati tadā parvaṇaścaturthāṃśo yāgakālaḥ | uṣaḥkāle saṃdhau pratipadaḥ prathamāṃśo yāgakālaḥ| niśīthasaṃdhau dvitīyāṃśaḥ, rātriprārambhe saṃdhau tṛtīyāṃśa iti | nanvanena nyāyenāparāhṇe saṃdhau pratipaccaturthāṃśasyāpi yāgakālatvaṃ syāditi cenna | "na yaṣṭavyaṃ caturtheṃ'śe yāgaiḥ pratipadaḥ kvacit | rakṣāṃsi tadvilumpanti śrutireṣā sanātanī" || iti caturthāṃśe yāgasya niṣedhāt | etādṛśe viṣaye yāga eva lupyeteti cenmaivam | vṛddhaśātātapena pratiprasavābhidhānāt -- "saṃdhiryatrāparāhṇe syādyāgaṃ prātaḥ pare'hani | kurvāṇaḥ pratipadbhāge caturthe'pi na duṣyati" iti || evaṃ tarhi pratiṣedho nirviṣayaḥ syāditi cenmaivam | saghaskālaviṣaye caritārthatvāt | taṃ ca viṣayaṃ darśayati kātyāyanaḥ -- "saṃdhiścetsaṃgavādūrdhvaṃ prākparyāvartanādraveḥ | sā paurṇamāsī vijñeyā sadyaskālavidhau tithiḥ" iti || saṃgavāvartanayorantarā paurṇamāsīpratipadoḥ saṃdhau sati pūrvodāhṛtairvacanaiḥ saṃdhidinātpūrvedyuranvādhānādikaṃ prāptaṃ tacca sadyaskālavākyena saṃdhidina utkṛṣyate | 'sadyo vā sarvaṃ karoti sadyaskālāyām' ityetatsūtramapyatrānukūlaṃ jñeyam | vaijayantīkāraistathaiva vyākhyānāt | tatra sadyaskālavidhiranvayarūpaḥ | pratipaccaturthāṃśaniṣedho vyatirekarūpaḥ | evaṃ ca sati niṣedhavākyaṃ sāvakāśaṃ bhavati | ayameva nyāyo'māvāsyāyāmapi | paraṃ tu sadyaskālatā tatra nāsti | saṃdhiścedityasminvākye paurṇamāsyā eva grahaṇāt | candradarśanadine yāganiṣedhastvāvartanātpūrvaṃ tasminvā saṃdhau sati draṣṭavyaḥ | etacca yathāśrutamādhavagraṃthādvaijayantīkāragranthācca draṣṭavyam | hemādristu -- "aparāhṇasaṃdhāvapi paradine pratipaccaturthāṃśe candrodaye ca sati dvitīyādiṣvatyantakṣaye sati pūrvedyuryāgaḥ" ityāha | āvartane tatpūrvaṃ vā saṃdhau bhramādyadi yāgo na kṛtaḥ kiṃtu śuklapratipadi kṛtastadā prāyaścittamāha kātyāyanaḥ -- "yajanīye'hni somaścedvāruṇyāṃ yadi dṛśyate | tatra vyāhṛtibhirhutvā daṇḍaṃ dadyāddvijātaye" iti || saṃdhikalpanaprakārastu mādhavenoktaḥ -- "vṛddhiḥ pratipado yā'sti tadardhaṃ parvaṇi kṣipet | kṣayasyārdhaṃ tathā kṣiptvā saṃdhirnirṇīyatāṃ sadā" iti || kātyāyano'pi -- "parehni ghaṭikā nyūnāstathaivābhyadhikāśca yāḥ | kṛtvā tadardhaṃ pūrvasminhrāsavṛddhī prakalpayet" iti || yadā pūrvedyuramāvāsyā yāvaddhaṭikā paredyuḥ pratipadapi tāvaddhaṭikā tatra yathāsthita eva saṃdhirjñeyaḥ | yadā tu pratipadaḥ kṣayaḥ parvaṇo vṛddhistadā vṛddhyardhaṃ pratipadi saṃyojya saṃdhirjñeyaḥ | yadā tu parvaṇaḥ kṣayaḥ pratipado vṛddhistadā vṛddhyardhaṃ parvaṇi prakṣipya saṃdhiṃ kalpayet | tatra hrāsavṛddhisamīkaraṇenā''vartane tatpūrvaṃ vā yadi saṃdhistadā tasminnahanyeva yāgaḥ | parataḥ saṃdhiścetpare'hani yāga iti | parvamadhya iṣṭisamāpananiṣedha ukto manunā -- "pratipadyapraviṣṭāyāṃ yadi tviṣṭiḥ samāpyate | punaḥ praṇīya kṛtsneṣṭiḥ kartavyā yāgavittamaiḥ" iti || viśeṣo nirṇayapradīpe gobhilenoktaḥ -- "āvartane'thavā tatprāgyadi parva samāpyate | tantraṃ pūrvāhṇa eva syātsaṃdherūrdhvaṃ dvijāśanam" iti || etasmādvacanājjñāyate | āvartanādūrdhvaṃ saṃdhau naitat | tathā ca pūrvameva dvijāśanaṃ bhavati | gṛhyāgnernāyaṃ niyama iti madanapārijāte | atha sthālīpākaviṣaye gṛhyasūtram -- "nityamata ūrdhvaṃ parvasvāgneyena sthālīpākena yajate" iti | ato gṛhapraveśasthālīpākādūrdhvamanantaraṃ nityaṃ parvasu āgneyena sthālīpākena yajate | ata ūrdhvamitivacanaṃ dīrghatvādadhvano'nyathā vā prāgāgate'pi parvaṇi sthālīpāko mā bhūditi | etenedamapi jñātaṃ bhavati prāgapi caturthīhomādāgate parvaṇi tu bhavedeveti | antareṇāpi nityatve siddhe nityamitivacanaṃ yāvajjīvārthaṃ dvātriṃśadvarṣāṇi kṛtvotsargo mā bhūditi | kaḥ prasaṅga utsargasyeti cet | darśapūrṇamāsabhaktatvādasya[dvā]triṃśadvarṣatā yāvajjīvikatayā vikalpata ityāśaṅkyeta | etacca prajñāpayati parvaṇyupoṣya pratipadi kriyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmārambhaṃ ca | taduktaṃ bahvṛcaiḥ -- "tasya darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmupavāsa idhmābarhiṣośca saṃnahanam" iti | dharmeṣu caitadeva vakṣyati -- "parvasu cobhayorupavāsaḥ" iti prakṛtya "śvobhūte sthālīpākaḥ" iti | nityamata ūrdhvamevaṃ parvasvityetāvataiva siddha āgneyena sthālīpākena yajata iti vacanamāgneyena sthālīpākena yajata eva narṣabhadānamitiniyamārtham | athetikartavyatā dharmasūtre -- "parvasu cobhayorupavāsa aupavastameva kālāntare bhojanaṃ tṛptiścānnasya yaccainayoḥ priyaṃ syāttadetasminnahani bhuñjīyātāmadhaśca śayīyātāṃ maithunavarjanaṃ ca śvobhūte sthālīpākaḥ" iti | pakṣasaṃdhiḥ parva | iha tadyuktamahargṛhyate | teṣu parvasūbhayordaṃpatyorupavāso bhojanalopaḥ | kālayorbhojanamityetatpūrvatanasūtrāt -- "sāyaṃ prātardvijātīnāmaśanaṃ śruticoditam" iti śruteścāviśeṣeṇobhayorapi kālayorbhojanaprāptāvāha -- aupavastamiti | yatkālāntara ekakāle bhojanaṃ tadapyaupavastamevopavāsa eva | tadapi divā na rātrau | śraute tathā darśanāt | "naitāṃ rātrimaśnāti" iti | cakāro'nuktasamuccayārthaḥ | parvasu yadekakāle bhojanaṃ tatra yāvattṛptyannaṃ bhuñjīyātām | dhānyavyañjanādiṣu māṃsalavaṇādivarjaṃ yadenayordaṃpatyormanasaḥ priyaṃ syāttadetasminnahani parvadine bhuñjīyātām adho bhūmau na khaṭvādau | maithunavarjanamapyetasminnahani kuryātām | śvobhūte dvitīye'hani pātrāsādanamārabhya sthālīpākaḥ kārya iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | pātrāsādanamārabhyetyanena pātrāsādanapūrvatanaṃ karma pūrvasminnahani kartavyamiti bodhyate | chāndogyagobhilagṛhye viśeṣaḥ -- "na pravasannupavasedityāhuḥ patnyā vrataṃ bhavatīti yathā kāmayeta tathā kuryāt" iti | etadapyaśaktau svīkāryam | parvaṇi varjyānpadārthānāha bharadvājaḥ -- "vivarjayedyakṣyamāṇaḥ strītailāmiṣavṛkṣajam | kalahaṃ vikrayaṃ caiva prahāsaṃ bahubhāṣaṇam || tauryatrikaṃ vṛthāśayyāṃ parānnamanṛtaṃ tathā" iti || āmiṣaṃ māṃsaṃ māṣādikaṃ ca | vṛkṣajo niryāsaḥ | sa ca śveto'pyatra niṣiddhaḥ | 'ya eva lohito yo vā vraścanānniryeṣati tasya nā''śyaṃ kāmamanyasya' iti śrutistu vratātiriktāśane śvetaniryāsābhyanujñāparā | tauryatrikaṃ vādyam | anṛtavadanasya sāmānyato niṣedhe siddhe punarniṣedhaḥ karmāṅgatvārthaḥ | tena śrautaṃ prāyaścittamatra kāryam | jābāliḥ -- "śākaṃ māṃsaṃ masūraṃ ca caṇakānkodravāṃstathā | māṣānmadhu parānnaṃ ca varjayedaupavastake" iti || madhuśabdenātra kṣaudraṃ gṛhyate | madyasya tu -- "na madyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pibet" ityanenaiva niṣedhasiddheḥ | aupavastakaṃ parvadinam | kātyāyano'pi -- "lavaṇaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca kṣārā yena ca hūyate | aupavaste na bhuñjīta dhānyaṃ rātrau na kiṃcana" iti || kṣāraśabdena yasya bhakṣaṇe lālotpadyate taddravyamucyate | yena hūyata ityanena yāgasādhanatvena svīkṛtaṃ dravyamapi na bhakṣaṇīyamityuktaṃ bhavati | vādhūlabaudhāyanavaikhānasāḥ -- "sarvamevaitadahaḥ kośīdhānyaṃ varjayedanyatra tilebhyaḥ" iti | tilavanmudgānāmapi grāhyatvamuktaṃ kātyāyanena -- tilamudgādṛte śaibyaṃ sasye godhūmakodravau | caṇakaṃ devadhānyaṃ ca sarvaśākaṃ tathaikṣavam || sarjikṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ ṭaṅkaṇakṣārameva ca | vratastho varjayennityaṃ sāmudraṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā" iti || atra sāmudrasyopādānātsaindhavamānasāderaniṣedhaḥ pratīyate | tasya haviṣyatvāt | tathā coktam -- "munyannāni payaḥ somo māṃsaṃ yaccānupaskṛtam | akṣāraṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva prakṛtyā havirucyate" iti || akṣāralavaṇaṃ saindhavamiti sarvanibandhakārāḥ | brahmapurāṇe'pi -- "saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva yacca mānasasaṃbhavam | pavitre parame hyete pratyakṣamapi sarpiṣā" iti || chandogapariśiṣṭe kātyāyanaḥ -- "pūrṇamāsyāmamāyāṃ ca adhaḥsvāpo vidhīyate | anāhitāgnerapyeṣa paścādagnervidhīyate" iti || baudhāyanaḥ -- "parvasu na cādhīyīta na striyamupeyātparvasu rakṣaḥpiśācānyabhicāravanti bhavanti" iti | sūtre -- "paurṇamāsyāṃ prātarāśe jāyāpatī sarpirmiśramaśnīto yadanyanmāṣebhyaśca na suhitau syātāṃ prāgvatsāpākaraṇādamāvāsyāyāṃ kāmaṃ suhitau syātām" iti | suhitau tṛptau | paurṇamāsyāṃ na suhitau syātāmamāvāsyāyāṃ tu suhitāvapi syātāmitītthaṃ yo viśeṣaḥ sa na sthālīpāke | tṛptiścānnasyetyaviśeṣeṇoktatvāt | sarpirmiśritamevāśanaṃ kartumaśaktena dadhimiśritaṃ vā'pyaśitavyam | dadhnā payasā vetyāpastambavacanāt | ayaṃ ca rāgaprāpta eva nitye'śane sarpirādiniyamaḥ kratvartho vidhīyate | aśanaṃ tu puruṣārthameva | tenāsāmarthyādinā yadyaśanaṃ kartuṃ na śakyate tadā niyamānugrahārthamaśanaṃ na kartavyamiti pitṛbhūtiḥ | bhartṛsvāmyapyāha -- "aśanaṃ kṣutpratighātārthaṃ, tasyāsminkāle niyamaḥ satyāmicchāyāmato nā''vartata iṣṭibahutve" iti | bahvīnāṃ patnīnāmamukhyā'nālambhukā cettadā yāgaḥ kartavya eva | jyeṣṭhā cedanālambhukā tadā na yāgaḥ kartavyaḥ | taduktaṃ hemādrau gautamena -- "yajanīye'hni saṃprāpte yasya bhāryā rajasvalā | yāgaṃ tatra prakurvīta jyeṣṭhā cainnevamācaret" iti || vasiṣṭho'pi -- "bahvīnāmapi patnīnāṃ jyeṣṭhā cedrajasā'nvitā | nāparudhya prakurvīta yajanaṃ hi vicakṣaṇaḥ" iti | kaniṣṭhāmaparudhya yāgaḥ kartavya iti tvarthātsiddhaṃ bhavati | asti ca pādmaṃ vacanam -- "bahvīnāmekapatnīnāṃ kaniṣṭhā rajasā'nvitā | aparudhyāpi kurvīta yajanaṃ vidhipūrvakam" iti || jyeṣṭhāto'nyāḥ sarvā api kaniṣṭhaśabdena grāhyāḥ | na tvantimaiva | ata eva -- "bahvīnāmapi patnīnāmamukhyā rajasānvitā | aparudhyāpi kurvīta yajanaṃ vidhipūrvakam" || iti smṛtyantare'mukhyetyuktam | jyeṣṭhapatnyā mukhyatvaṃ tu pādma uktam -- "jyeṣṭhā patnī tu mukhyā syādyajñe dāne'rcane gṛhe | tathā karmāṇi kurvastu yathoktaphalabhāgbhavet" iti || kaurme'pi -- "jyeṣṭhapatnyā virahitaṃ kṛtaṃ yattu janādhipa | tatsarvaṃ viphalaṃ yāti gajabhuktakapitthavat" iti || vasiṣṭho'pi -- "jyeṣṭhayā saha karmāṇi kuryādyatnena bhūpate | tayā saha kṛtaṃ karma saphalaṃ jāyate nṛṇām" iti | jyeṣṭhapatnyā rāhityena karmakaraṇe yo doṣa uktaḥ sa tasyā vidyamānatve draṣṭavyaḥ | jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ vidyamānāsu yā jyeṣṭhā sā mukhyatvena draṣṭavyā | evaṃ ca vidyamānajyeṣṭhāvyatiriktāḥ patnīraparudhyāpi yāgaḥ kartavya iti siddhaṃ bhavati | etena bahvīnāṃ patnīnāmekā'pyṛtumatī cenna yāgaḥ kārya iti parāstam | etacca prathamaprayogavyatirikte -- "prakrāntamagnihotrādi karma yacchruticoditam | ārtavābhiplutāṃ nārīṃ vihāya kurute dvijaḥ" iti kātyāyanavacane prakrāntamiti śravaṇāt | "jyeṣṭhā vā'tha kaniṣṭhā vā patnī yadi rajasvalā | prathame cetprayoge syānnoparodhastadā mataḥ" iti smṛtyantare'bhidhānācca | prakrāntamārabdhamekavāramanuṣṭhitamiti vyākhyātāraḥ | ye tu prārabdhaṃ saṃkalpādinā prakrāntamityarthaṃ vadanti tanmate saṃkalpottaraṃ prathamaprayoge'pyuparodha iti draṣṭavyam | atha prayogaḥ | kartā śuklacaturdaśyāṃ prātaraupāsanahomānantaramaupāsanāgneḥ paścātsapatnīka upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya satyadhikāre yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākābhyāṃ yakṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | darśapūrṇamāseṣṭyārambhottaraṃ na pārvaṇasthālīpākāvityetanmatameva strī kriyata iti niścite sati satyadhikāre darśapūrṇamāseṣṭyārambhapūrvatanakālaparyantaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākābhyāṃ yakṣya iti saṃkalpe viśeṣaḥ | tato gaṇapatipūjanādināndīśrāddhāntaṃ kuryāt | atrāgniḥ prīyatāmiti viśeṣaḥ | athavā pradhānasaṃkalpātpūrvameva gaṇapatipūjanapuṇyāhādivācanamātṛkāpūjananāndīśrāddhāni kṛtvā'nantaraṃ pradhānasaṃkalpaḥ kāryaḥ | tata ārambhārthaṃ caturhotṛsārasvatahomāvanvārambhaṇasthālīpākaṃ ca kuryāt | yadyapi caturhotṛhomādikaṃ gṛhye noktaṃ tathā'pi darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākayordarśapūrṇamāseṣṭinyāyasāmyātkeṣāṃciddarśapūrṇamāsadharmāṇāṃ mātṛdattenoktatvāttadupalakṣaṇena caiteṣāmapyatra prāptiḥ | śiṣṭācāraścāpyatrāsti | ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākāvārabhamāṇaścaturhotāraṃ sagrahaṃ hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpyottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu srucaṃ darvīṃ vā sruvamājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ cā''sādya pavitrakaraṇādi pavitre agnāvādhāyetyantaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ paristīrya tūṣṇīṃ pariṣiñcet | na vā paristaraṇapariṣekau | tato'gnimalaṃkṛtya sruci darvyāṃ vā sakṛdgṛhītvā''sāditāṃ samidhamabhyādhāya, pṛthivī hotetyasya caturhotṛmantrasya vācaspate vāco vīryeṇetigrahasaṃjñakamantrasahitasya prajāpatirvācaspatirbrahmā yajuḥ | home viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ pṛthīvī hotā0 bṛhaspatirupavaktā' iti manasoktvā 'oṃ vācaspate vāco0 mindriyāya svāhā' ityagnerdakṣiṇatastiṣṭhañjuhoti | vācaspataye brahmaṇa idaṃ na mama | tataḥ paristaraṇasattve tānyuttare visṛjet | ṛṣyādismaraṇe vikalpaḥ | tataḥ sārasvatahomau darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākāvārabhamāṇaḥ sārasvatau homau hoṣyāmīti saṃkalpyottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu srucaṃ darvīṃ vā sruvamājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānsamiddvayamājyaṃ cā''sādya pavitrakaraṇādi pavitre agnāvādhāyetyantaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ paristīrya tūṣṇīṃ pariṣiñcet | na vā paristaraṇapariṣekau | tato'gnimalaṃkṛtya sruveṇa sruci darvyāṃ vā'ṣṭavāraṃ dvirvā gṛhītvā''sāditaṃ samiddvayamagnāvabhyādhāya, pūrṇā paścādityasya somaḥ pūrṇamāsastriṣṭup | home viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ pūrṇā pa0 mādayantā svāhā' ityardhājyenāgnerdakṣiṇatastiṣṭhañjuhoti | pūrṇamāsāyedaṃ na mama | yatte devā adadhurityasya somo'māvāsyā triṣṭup | home viniyogaḥ |'oṃ yatte devā a0 suvīra svāhā' ityavaśiṣṭenā''jyena tathaiva juhoti | amāvāsyāyā idaṃ na mama | ṛṣyādismaraṇe vikalpaḥ | paristaraṇasattve tānyuttare visṛjet | athānvārambhaṇasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākāvārabhamāṇo'nvārambhaṇasthālīpākaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpyāgniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā'nvārambhaṇasthālīpākakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi | agnāviṣṇū ekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | sarasvatīmekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | sarasvantamekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | agniṃ bhaginamekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | vaiśeṣikajayopahome -- cittaṃ cittimityādi prajāpatiṃ caikaikayā''jyāhutyā yakṣya ityantamuktvā, sviṣṭakṛddhome -- agniṃ svīṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣeṇa yakṣya ityādi samidabhyādhānāntaṃ kṛtvā'gniṃ paristīryottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu sruvaṃ darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ havirāsādanārthāndarbhāñśūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ carusthālīcatuṣṭayaṃ mekṣaṇacatuṣṭayaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ cā''sādayet | "samopya vyuddhāraṃ juhuyāt" ityāśvalāyanasūtrācchūlagave carutrayasya payasi sthālīpākaṃ śrapayitvetyekatraiva śrapaṇadarśanāccaikaiva vā carusthālī, ekameva mekṣaṇamuddharaṇārthaṃ pātracatuṣṭayamekameva vā mahaditi pātrāsādane viśeṣaḥ | tato'gneḥ paścātsvasya purataḥ śūrpaṃ nidhāya tasminpavitre saṃsthāpya dakṣiṇahastena pratidaivataṃ tūṣṇīṃ caturaścaturo muṣṭīṃstāṃ tāṃ devatāmabhidhyāyannirupyānvāvāpaṃ kṛtvā'gneruttarato haviḥ saṃsthāpya prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya pavitreṇa pāṇinā havistriḥ prokṣya pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā triḥ sarvābhiḥ prokṣati | tata patnyagneruttarataḥ kṛṣṇājināvadhūnanādi phalīkaraṇāntamāgneyasthālīpākavatkuyāt | tato homakartā niruptahaviṣaḥ samaṃ bhāgacatuṣṭayaṃ kṛtvā'yamagnāviṣṇubhyāmayaṃ sarasvatyai, ayaṃ sarasvate'yamagnaye bhagine, iti krameṇābhimṛśya catasṛṣu sthālīṣūdakamānīya tatra krameṇa bhāgacatuṣṭayamopyāgnau sthālīradhiśrayati | yadyekaiva sthālyāsāditā syāttadā tasyāmeva śrapaṇaparyāptamudakamānīya sarvaṃ havistasyāmopyāgnāvadhiśrayati | na vā nirvāpādi kiṃtu patnyā'vaghātamātraṃ kāraṇīyam | paryagnikaraṇaṃ tu kartavyameveti pakṣāntaram | tataḥ sruvaṃ darvīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ ca saṃmṛjyā''jyasaṃskāraṃ kuryāt | tatra havivā sahā''jyasya paryagnikaraṇamiti viśeṣaḥ | tata āsāditāndarbhānagneḥ paścādāstīrya tatrā''jyaṃ nidhāya śṛtāṃścarūnkrameṇābhighāryottarata udvāsyāgneḥ paścādudaksaṃsthaṃ barhiṣyāsādayati | ekatra śrapaṇapakṣa ekasyaiva caroḥ sattvāttamekavāramevābhighāryā''sāditeṣu caturṣūddharaṇapātreṣūpastīrya teṣu taṃ samaśa uddhṛtya, ayamagnāviṣṇubhyām | ayaṃ sarasvatyai | ayaṃ sarasvate | ayamagnaye bhagine, iti krameṇodaksaṃsthamidānīṃ devatā nirdiśet | yadā tūddharaṇapātramekamevā''sāditaṃ tadaikasminneva pātre deśabhedenopastaraṇamuddharaṇaṃ ca | tato'dite'numanyasvetyādibhiḥ pariṣicya tūṣṇīṃ samidhamādhāya pradhānahomaṃ kuryāt | prathamena dhṛṣṭyākāramekṣaṇena prathamacarorupahatyāgnāviṣṇubhyāṃ svāheti juhoti | agnāviṣṇubhyāmidaṃ na mama | tato dvitīyena mekṣaṇena dvitīyacarorupahatya sarasvatyai svāheti prathamāhuteḥ purastājjuhoti | sarasvatyā idaṃ na mama | tatastṛtīyena mekṣaṇena tṛtīyacarorupahatya sarasvate svāheti dvitīyāhuteḥ purastājjuhoti | sarasvata idaṃ na mama | tataścaturthena mekṣaṇena caturthacarorupahatyāgnaye bhagine svāheti tṛtīyāhuteḥ purastājjuhoti | agnaye bhagina idaṃ na mama | ekasthālīpakṣa ekasyaiva mekṣaṇasyā''sāditatvāttenaiva grahaṇam | tato darvyā vaiśeṣikajayopahomaṃ kuryāt | tatra viśeṣaḥ | sruveṇa darvyāṃ dvādaśagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā dvādaśa jayāñjuhoti | te ca sāmānyaprayoga uktāḥ | punaḥ sakṛdgṛhītvā 'oṃ prajāpatirja0 bhūva svāhā' iti juhoti | prajāpataya idaṃ na mama | tatastena tena mekṣaṇena tasya tasya caroruttarārdhātsakṛdupahatyāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhetīśānyāmasaṃsaktāmitarābhirāhutibhirjuhoti | agnaye sviṣṭakṛta idaṃ na mama | eka mekṣaṇaṃ cettenaiva grahaṇam | tato mekṣaṇapraharaṇaṃ kṛtākṛtam | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya samastavyāhṛtībhiḥ prāyaścittahomaṃ kṛtvottarapariṣekaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthājapenopasthāyāgniṃ saṃpūjya bhasma dhṛtvā''cāryāya mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā'nyebhyo bhūyasīṃ dattvā brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | ete ca caturhotṛhomasārasvatahomānvārambhaṇasthālīpākāḥ kṛtākṛtāḥ | sūtre'nuktatvāt | ityanvārambhaṇasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | atha pārvaṇasthālīpākayoḥ prayogaḥ | anvādhānadine'nāhitāgniraupāsanahomānantaramāhitāgniścopavasathīyadivasakarmasamāptyanantaraṃ sapatnīka ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ satyadhikāre yāvajjīvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākābhyāṃ yakṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | darśapūrṇamāseṣṭyārambhottaraṃ pārvaṇasthālīpākau na kāryāvityetanmatameva svī kriyata iti niścite sati darśapūrṇamāseṣṭyārambhapūrvatanakālaparyantaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākābhyāṃ yakṣya iti saṃkalpe viśeṣaḥ | vastutastu karaṇapakṣa eva yuktaḥ | tato gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya puṇyāhādi vācayitvā'gniḥ prīyatāmiti vadet | etadantaṃ prathamaprayoga eva na tu pratiprayogam | tataḥ punarācamanaprāṇāyāmadeśakālasaṃkīrtanāni kṛtvā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākābhyāṃ yakṣye | tatredānīṃ pūrṇamāsasthālīpākena śvo yaṣṭāha iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | sadyaḥpakṣe sadyo yakṣya iti | darśe tu darśasthālīpākena śvo yaṣṭāha ityetāvāneva saṃkalpaḥ | darśasthālīpākastu dvyahakāla eva | pūrṇamāsasthālīpākena yaṣṭāhe darśasthālīpākena yaṣṭāha iti bhinnau vā saṃkalpau | evaṃ saṃkalpyāgniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇamāsasthālīpākayāgakarmaṇi ye yakṣyamāṇe devate te parigrahīṣyāmi | agnimekayā carvāhutyā yakṣye | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtamekayā hutaśeṣāhutyā yakṣye | ete devate śvo yaṣṭāha ityuktvā vyāhṛtibhiranvādhānasamidho'bhyādadhyāt | sadyaḥpakṣe sadyo yakṣya iti | evaṃ darśe | tatra darśasthālīpākayāgakarmaṇīti viśeṣaḥ | tato'gniṃ paristīrya pātrāsādanādyarthadarbhāṃśchittvā muṣṭiṃ baddhvaupāsanāgnerupari yathā na patati tathā nidadhāti | śraute dṛṣṭatvātsāyaṃhomottaraṃ vā paristaraṇam | asmindine daṃpatī māṣamāṃsalavaṇakṣārādivarjaṃ sarpirmiśramaśaktau dadhimiśraṃ payomiśraṃ vā yena dhānyena yakṣyamāṇastaddhānyavarjaṃ cāśnītaḥ | aśaktāvetadapyaśnītaḥ | tataḥ śvobhūte prātaraupāsanahomānantaraṃ śrautāgnimāṃścediṣṭyuttaramuttareṇāgniṃ darbhānāstīrya teṣu darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātraṃ taṇḍulapraskandanārthaṃ pātraṃ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ carusthālīṃ mekṣaṇamupaveṣaṃ havirāsādanārthaṃ darbhānsaṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhamityāsādya pavitre kṛtvā'pareṇāgniṃ śūrpaṃ nidhāya tasminpavitre nidhāya tūṣṇīṃ caturo muṣṭīnnirupyottareṇāgniṃ vrīhimacchūrpaṃ nidhāya prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya śūrpasthānvrīhīnprokṣya pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā prokṣati | tataḥ patnyagneruttarataḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ bahirviśasanaṃ triravadhūya pratyaggrīvamupariṣṭālloma tadāstīrya tasya bhasatpradeśamupasamasya tatrolūkhalaṃ saṃsthāpya tasminvrīhīnopyā''sīnaiva musalenāvahatyolūkhalasya purastācchūrpaṃ nidhāyolūkhalasthāṃstaṇḍulāñchūrpe nikṣipya kṛṣṇājinasyottaratastrirniṣpūya tuṣānpradhvaṃsayitvā (sya) tāṃstuṣāndakṣiṇahastena kṛṣṇājinasyādhastānnikṣipatyanirīkṣan(māṇā)| tato dakṣiṇahastenaiva nikṣiptāṃstuṣānnipīḍyāpa upaspṛśya taṇḍulānvivicya praskandanārtha āsādite pātre praskandayitvā(ndya) tānādāyolūkhale prakṣipya triṣphalīkṛtya phalīkaraṇāni kṛṣṇājinasyottarato nikṣipya taṇḍulānprakṣālyāgneḥ paścātprakṣālanodakaṃ ninayati | tataḥ ka rtā prakṣālitāṃstaṇḍulāṃścarusthālyāmopya mekṣaṇenā''loḍya śrapayitvā darvīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ ca saṃmṛjyā''jyavilāpanādi pavitrābhyādhānāntaṃ kuryāt | tatrā''jyena saha carorapi paryagnikaraṇam | tata āsāditāndarbhānagneḥ paścādāstīrya tatrā''jyaṃ nidhāya śṛtaṃ caruṃ darvyā''jyenābhighāryodagudvāsyāgneḥ paścādāstṛte bahiṣyājyasyottarata āsādyāgniṃ pariṣiñcet | athavā pātrāsādanānte kṛṣṇājinamāstīryānāstīrya vā patnyā'vahananamātraṃ kārayitvā triṣphalīkṛtya phalīkaraṇānyuttarato nirasyet | tato darvīsaṃmārgādi pavitrābhyādhānāntaṃ darbhāstaraṇapakṣe tadapi kṛtvā śṛtaṃ caruṃ darvyā''jyenābhighāryodagudvāsyāgneḥ paścāddarbheṣu darbhāstaraṇābhāvapakṣe bhūmāveva nidhāyāgniṃ pariṣiñcet | etatprayogadvayaṃ sarveṣu sthālīpākeṣu jñeyam | tatastūṣṇīṃ sāditāṃ samidhamādhāya mekṣaṇenopahatya pradīpte'gnau juhoti | 'oṃ agnaye svāhā' iti bhāryānvārabdho juhoti | agnaya idaṃ na mama | punarbhūya upahatya, 'oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' iti bhāryānvārabdho'saṃsaktāṃ pūrvāhutyo ttarārdhapūrvārdhe juhoti | agnaye sviṣṭakṛta idaṃ na mama | anvārambho na vā | tato mekṣaṇamagnau prakṣipet | na vā prakṣepaḥ | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya vyastasamastavyāhṛtibhiścatasraḥ prāyaścittāhutīrhutvottaraṃ pariṣekaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthājapenāgnimupasthāya taṃ saṃpūjya lalāṭe vibhūtiṃ dhṛtvā bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dattvā brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | nātrarṣabhadānam | samidabhyādhānādiḥ prayogaḥ pradarśitaprayogaprakāradvaye'pi samānaḥ | "āgneyena sthālīpākena yajate" iti punarvacanājjñāpakāt | "ata ūrdhvaṃ dakṣiṇāvarjamupoṣitābhyāṃ parvasu kāryaḥ" ityāpastambokteśca | evameva darśe | atra saṃkalpātpūrvaṃ cetstrīrajasvalā tadā dvitīyādiniṣiddhavyatiriktapañcamādidivase dvyahakālaṃ sadyaskālaṃ vā'ntaritaṃ paurṇamāsasthālīpākaṃ kuryāt | prathamadarśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākayorāśauca ārambho na bhavati | na cāsagotreṇa kāraṇīyāvetāviti vācyam | prathamaprayoge mukhyadravyālābhenānārambha iva mukhyakarturadhikārābhāvavaśenānārambhasyaiva yuktatvāt | darśasthālīpākastvantarito'pi dvyahakāla eva kāryaḥ | anekabhāryasya vidyamānāsu bhāryāsu madhye jyeṣṭhā cedbhāryā saṃkalpātpūrvaṃ rajasvalā tadā sthālīpākaḥ pañcamādidivaseṣveva kāryaḥ | saṃkalpottaraṃ rajasvalā cettadā tāṃ gṛhāntare saṃsthāpya sthālīpākaḥ svakāla eva kartavyaḥ | prathame prayoge tu saṃkalpāduttaramapi sarvāsāmasarvāsāṃ vā patnīnāṃ rajodarśane darśapūrṇamāsau naiva bhavata iti kecit | bhavata ityanye | yadi vivāhottaraṃ darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākayoranuṣṭhānaṃ na kṛtamanantaramagnivicchedaḥ, bahukālottaraṃ punaḥ saṃdhānaṃ yadā kriyate tadā darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākayorārambhakāle rajodoṣaprasaktiḥ | yadā vā daśavārṣikyādivadhūlābhe vivāhakāle'pi rajodoṣaprasaktistatra prathamārambho na bhavati | evamāgrayaṇasthālīpākādiṣvapi | yadi svakāle darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākāvanārabdhau tadā vibhraṣṭeṣṭidevatoddeśena sthālīpākāñśrapayet | śrapaṇakāle prathamatṛtīyacarvorupari gataṃ maṇḍamādāyaindre carau prakṣipet | tata āpūrvikatantreṇaivā''jyasaṃskārādi pariṣekāntaṃ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ samidhamādhāya, 'oṃ agnaye svāhā | oṃ indrāya svāhā | oṃ somāya svāhā' ityāhutitrayaṃ hutvā sviṣṭakṛdādyuttaraṃ tantramāpūrvikadharmeṇa kuryāt | prathame darśasthālīpāke'tipanna āgāmidarśe vibhraṣṭasthālīpākaṃ kṛtvā svakāle sthālīpākaṃ kuryādityeke | vibhraṣṭasthālīpākaṃ kṛtvā gauṇakāle'pi prathamadarśasthālīpākānuṣṭhānamityanye | pathikṛdvaiśvānaryāveva kuryānna tu vibhraṣṭasthālīpākamityapare | mama tu paurṇamāsasthālīpākārambheṇa darśasthālīpākasyā''rabdhatvānna vibhraṣṭasthālīpāka iti yuktaṃ pratibhāti | anyathā pṛthaganvārambhaṇasthālīpāko'pyārambhanimittaḥ syāditi | piṇḍapitṛyajñārambhātpūrvaṃ yadi patnī rajasvalā tadā'grimadarśe saptahotāraṃ hutvā piṇḍapitṛyajña ārabdhavya iti śatadvayīvyākhyāyām | evamāśauce'pi | iti darśapūrṇamāsasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | athā''grayaṇam | tacca yadyapi gṛhye noktaṃ tathā'pi "catuḥśarāvamodanaṃ paktvā''grayaṇadevatābhyaḥ sviṣṭakṛccaturthībhyo hutvā tadvyañjanaṃ bhojayati" itiśrautasūtroktānukalpāśritagṛhyoktasāmānyasthālīpākavidhinā kartavya e(me)va | ācārāt | sūtrakāreṇānuktatvātkṛtākṛtaḥ(m) | karaṇapakṣe pratisaṃvatsaraṃ śrotāgrayaṇārambhaparyantaṃ kartavya e(me)va na tu tadanantaram | akaraṇapakṣe navānnabhakṣaṇe doṣo'pi nāsti | vidhānābhāvāt | ācārānurodhātkaraṇaṃ varam | tasya kālaḥ śrautasūtre -- "yadīṣṭyā yadi paśunā yadi somena tairamāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vaiva yajeta" iti | atrāmāvāsyāpaurṇamāsīśabdābhyāṃ taduttaravartinyoḥ pratipadorapi grahaṇamiti vaijayantīkāraḥ | etatsamānārthaka āpastambasūtre rāmāṇḍārastvamāvāsyāpaurṇamāsīśabdābhyāṃ tadantyakṣaṇo gṛhyate, tena tadvatyahorātre bhavatītyāha | mādhavo'pi -- "iṣṭyādivikṛtiḥ sarvā parvaṇyeveti nirṇayaḥ" iti | atra devanakṣatrāṇi revatīṃ cā''ha baudhāyanaḥ -- "api vā devanakṣatre revatyāṃ vā''grayaṇeṣṭiṃ kurvīta" iti | devanakṣatre karmakartavyatāviṣaye śrutirapi -- "yānyeva devanakṣatrāṇi | teṣu kurvīta yatkārī syāt | puṇyāha eva kurute" iti | revatīnakṣatre karmakartavyatāviṣaye'pyasti śrutiḥ -- "tasmādrevatyāṃ paśūnāṃ kurvīta | yatkiṃcārvācīna somātpraiva bhavati" iti | devanakṣatrāṇi kānītyapekṣāyāṃ tatraivoktam -- "kṛttikāḥ prathamam | viśākhe uttamam | tāni devanakṣatrāṇi" iti | etāni nakṣatrāṇyāpūryamāṇapakṣāntarvartīnyeva grāhyāṇi na tu kṛṣṇapakṣāntarvartīnyapi | tena śuklapakṣāntarvartinakṣatreṣveva vikṛtirbhavati | tatra parvaṇaḥ saṃpūrṇatve'parāhṇasaṃdhau vā taddine prakṛtipradhānānuṣṭhānābhāvādvikṛtiṃ kṛtvā prakṛterupakramaḥ kāryaḥ | yadīṣṭyetivākyavihitakālalābhāditi mīmāṃsakānāṃ yājñikānāṃ ca saṃpratipannameva | pūrvāhṇasaṃdhau tvaudayikaparvaṇaḥ prakṛtyavaruddhatvātpūrvaparvaṇyevopadiṣṭaparvakālatvānurodhenātideśaprāptaṃ prātaḥkālaṃ dvyahakālatāvadbādhitvā vikṛtyanuṣṭhānaṃ yuktamiti mīmāṃsakāḥ | yājñikāstu -- āvartanatatpūrvasaṃdhyoḥ prakṛtyanuṣṭhānānantaraṃ saṃdhidina eva vikṛtyanuṣṭhānaṃ kartavyamiti vadantīti kālatattvavivecane | āgrayaṇe viśeṣaḥ śrutāvukta āgrayaṇeṣṭiṃ prakṛtya -- "yasminkāle'māvāsyā sapadyeta tayeṣṭvā'thaitayā yajeta yadi paurṇamāsī syāttayeṣṭvā'tha paurṇamāsyā yajeta" iti | āvartanātpūrvamiti śeṣaḥ | saṃpadyeta prāpnuyāt | tayā'māvāsyayā | etayā''grayaṇeṣṭyā | yadi paurṇamāsyāvartanakālātpūrvaṃ prāpnuyāttayā''grayaṇeṣṭyeṣṭvā paurṇamāsyā yajeteti | maṇḍano'pi -- "āvartanātprāgyadi parvasaṃdhiḥ kṛtvā tu tasminprakṛtiṃ vikṛtyāḥ | tadaiva yāgaḥ parato yadi syāttasminvikṛtyāḥ prakṛteḥ paredyuḥ" iti || asyārthaḥ -- āvartanātpūrvaṃ yadi parvasaṃdhistasminsaṃdhidine prathamataḥ prakṛtiṃ kṛtvā paścādvikṛtiṃ kuryāt | yadā tvāvartanātparaḥ saṃdhistadā saṃdhidine vikṛtireva bhavati prakṛtistu paredyureveti | dhurtasvāmikapardisvāmyādayo'pyevamāhuḥ | tatrā''grayaṇaṃ trividhaṃ vrīhyāgrahaṇaṃ yavāgrayaṇaṃ śyāmākāgrayaṇaṃ ceti | tatra sūtram -- "vrīhīṇāmagrapākasya yajate tathā śyāmākānāṃ yavānāmagrapākasya yajate" iti | agrapākastatkālapākaḥ | eteṣāṃ kālā vaikhānasāpastambabharadvājairuktāḥ -- "śaradi vrīhibhirvasante yavairvarṣāsu śyāmākaiḥ" iti | tatra yavāgrayaṇaṃ kṛtākṛtam | taduktaṃ vaijayantyāṃ bāhvṛcye -- 'yavāgrayaṇaṃ kṛtākṛtam' iti | etacca navānnāśanādhikārārtham | tathā ca sūtram -- "āgrayaṇeṣṭiṃ vyākhyāsyāmastayā nāniṣṭvā navānāmoṣadhīnāṃ phalānyaśnāti grāmyāṇāmāraṇyānāṃ ca" iti | tayā''grayaṇeṣṭyā'niṣṭvā navānāṃ grāmyāṇāmāraṇyānāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ phalāni nāśnātītyarthaḥ | etatsarvaṃ maṇḍanena spaṣṭamuktam -- "śyāmākānvaiṇavānvrīhīnyavānvā''grayaṇātpurā | na bhuñjīteti vispaṣṭaṃ yajñapārśve nirūpitam || kośīdhānyāni śākāni vṛkṣādīnāṃ phalāni ca | aniṣṭvā''grayaṇenāpi kāmametāni bhakṣayet || kośīdhānyeṣu vā kiṃcidabhojyamavagamyate | bharadvājādisiddhāntānmudgamāṣatilānyapi || naveṣu ca navānnāni nādyādāgrayaṇātpurā | vrīhiśyāmākanīvārānyavānveṇuyavānapi | śālīnmudgāṃśca godhūmānkaṅgūniti vivarjayet | anyāni kāmamamaśnīyāditi gargeṇa bhāṣitam || harimanthakalāyānāṃ phalaṃ nāśnanti kecana| yāni cānyāni bhakṣyāṇi proktāni samanantaram || tānyapyapakvāvasthāyāmaśnīyātkāmataḥ sudhīḥ | apakvadhānyamātropalakṣaṇaṃ haritā yavāḥ" iti || saṃkarṣakāṇḍasya bhāṣyakāreṇa varṇitam -- "dhānyāntaraṃ yavaprakhyaṃ bhāradvājīyabhāṣyakṛt | abravīddharitayavaṃ na punarhītaraṃ yavam || tena tadvarjamanyāni phalānyapi na bhakṣayet" iti | haritamanthāścaṇakāḥ | kalāyāḥ satīnāḥ | etāsāmoṣadhīnāṃ phalaṃ caṇakakalāyarūpaṃ kecanā''cāryā nāśnantītyarthaḥ | āgrayaṇātpūrvaṃ navānnāśananiṣedha ubhayoḥ samaḥ | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "navāśananiṣedho'yaṃ daṃpatyorubhayoḥ samaḥ" iti | navasvarūpamapyuktaṃ tenaiva -- "navasyāvadhyapekṣatvādadhunā'vadhirucyate | kiyaddūre purāṇatvaṃ navatvaṃ kiyadantike || sasyānāmavadhirjye(rjyai)ṣṭhī paurṇamāsī prasiddhitaḥ | āśvinī paurṇamāsī tu bhavedatrottarāvadhiḥ || tādṛśyorubhayoḥ paurṇamāsyormadhye yadudbhavet | dhānyaṃ tannavamityāhustakālāgrayaṇaṃ prati || tadeva ca purāṇaṃ syādūrdhvaṃ svāgrayaṇeṣṭitaḥ | yathā''grayaṇaśāstreṣu navatvaṃ tadapekṣaṇe || ye kālāstasya buddhisthāḥ svānyonyāvadhayo matāḥ | prāvṛṭkālātparaṃ pakvaṃ śaradyāgrayaṇena ca || ūrdhvaṃ vasantānniṣpannaṃ prāvṛḍāgrayaṇena ca | yasminnāgrayaṇaṃ kuryādṛtau tadṛtusaṃbhavam || dhānyaṃ tannavamityāhuradhaḥ pakvaṃ purātanam" iti | idaṃ cārdhādhānina āhitāgnerapi na bhavati | śrautenaiva siddheḥ | maṇḍano'pi -- "iti bruvadbhiḥ saṃkarṣakāṇḍibhirnyāyasāmyataḥ | arthādidamapi proktamardhādhāne kṛte sati | śrotāgrayaṇamevāsya na smārtāgrayaṇaṃ bhavet" iti | svasya karaṇāśaktau kṛtāgrayaṇena ṛtvijā kāraṇīyaḥ | tadāha maṇḍanaḥ -- "akṛtāgrayaṇo nāsya ṛtvigāgrayaṇe bhavet | agnimāniti śaṅkhena dharmaśāstre nirūpitam" iti | navānnāśanākaraṇe'pi karaṇapakṣa idaṃ kāryameva | "pratisaṃvatsaraṃ somaḥ paśuḥ pratyayanaṃ tathā | kartavyā''grayaṇeṣṭiśca cāturmāsyāni caiva hi | eṣāmasaṃbhave kuryādiṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ dvijaḥ" iti yājñavalkyokteḥ | tatra prathamāgrayaṇaṃ tu parvaṇyeva | dvitīyādau tvaniyamaḥ | atha prayogaḥ | uktakāle prātaraupāsanaṃ hutvā'gneḥ paścātsapatnīka upaviśyā''camya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mama sapatnīkasya navānāṃ vrīhyādidhānyānāṃ prāśanādhikārasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ vrīhyāgrayaṇasthālīpākaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpaṃ kuryāt | yadi tu kenāpi nimittena navānnaprāśanaṃ na karoti tadā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ vrīhyāgrayaṇasthālīpākaṃ kariṣya ityevaṃ saṃkalpaḥ | yadi tu yasminvarṣe yasya dhānyasyānutpattistadā tasminvarṣe tadīyāgrayaṇasya lopaḥ | prathamāgrayaṇaṃ guruśukrāstamalamāsādiṣu na bhavati | dvitīyādiprayogeṣvapi śuddhakālalābhe'stādau na kāryam | tato gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya puṇyāhādivācanaṃ mātṛkāpūjanaṃ nāndīśrāddhaṃ ca kuryāt | tatrendrāgnyādayaḥ prīyantāmiti vadediti prathame prayoge viśeṣaḥ | tato'gniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā''grayaṇasthālīpākakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi | indrāgnī viśvāndevāndyāvāpṛthivyau caikaikayā navavrīhyekacarvāhutyā yakṣye | sviṣṭakṛddhome -- agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣacarvāhutyā yakṣye | etā devatāḥ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā vyāhṛtibhiranvādhānasamidabhyādhānaṃ kuryāt | purastātsviṣṭakṛto'jyānīhoma ityasminpakṣe'nvādhāne pradhānadevatollekhānantaramajyānīhomadevatollekhaḥ kāryaḥ | sa yathā | ajyānīhome -- indramājyāhutyā yakṣye | dyāvāpṛthivyāvājyāhutyā yakṣye | grīṣmaṃ hemantaṃ vasantaṃ śaradaṃ varṣāścā''jyāhutyā yakṣye | iduvatsaraṃ parivatsaraṃ saṃvatsaraṃ cā''jyāhutyā yakṣye | devānpituṃ cā''jyāhutyā yakṣya ityuktvā'gniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣacarvāhutyā yakṣya ityādi samidabhyādhānāntaṃ kuryāt | tato'gniṃ paristīryetyādi | pātrāsādane darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ catuḥśarāvaparimitacaruśrapaṇaparyāptāṃ carusthālīṃ mekṣaṇaṃ nirvāpārthamekaṃ śarāvaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ cetyāsādayet | mekṣaṇapraharaṇapakṣe śarāvāsādanottaraṃ mekṣaṇāsādanam | tataḥ pavitre kṛtvā'gneḥ paścācchūrpaṃ nidhāya tasminpavitre prāgagre saṃsthāpyā''sāditaṃ śarāvamādāya vrīhibhiḥ pūrayitvā tena śūrpe sarvā devatā abhidhyāyannirvapati | evaṃ punastrivāram | tata uttareṇāgniṃ niruptavrīhimacchūrpaṃ nidhāyājyānīhomaṃ kuryāt | sa yathā | uttareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu srucaṃ sruvamājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānhomaparyāptamājyaṃ pañca samidhaścā''sādya pūrvakṛte eva pavitre gṛhītvā prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtyājyānīhomārthāni pātrāṇyuttānāni kṛtvā prokṣya sruvasrucorniṣṭapanādi punarāhāramājyaṃ trirutpūyetyetadantaṃ kṛtvā pavitre prajñāte nidadhyāt | anyakaraṇapakṣe'styeva praharaṇaṃ nāgneḥ paristaraṇaṃ pūrvakṛtaparistaraṇenaiva siddheḥ | tatastūṣṇīṃ pariṣicya sruci sruveṇa pañca gṛhītvā pañca samidho'bhyādhāya śatāyudhāyetyādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ mantrāṇāmagnirṛṣiḥ | prathamasyendro devatā | dvitīyasya dyāvāpṛthivyau | tṛtīyasya grīṣmo hemanto vasantaḥ śaradvarṣāśca | caturthasyeduvatsaraḥ parivatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraśca | pañcamasya devāḥ pituśca | sarveṣāṃ jagatī chandaḥ | home viniyogaḥ | ityṛṣyādi smaret | na varṣyādismaraṇamatra | 'oṃ śatāyudhāya0 viśvā svāhā' | indrāyedaṃ na mama | 'oṃ ye catvāraḥ0 sarve svāhā' dyāvāpṛthivībhyāmidaṃ na mama | 'oṃ grīṣmo hemanta0 syāma svāhā' | grīṣmāya hemantāya vasantāya śarade varṣābhyaścedaṃ na mama | 'oṃ iduvatsarāya0 hatāḥ syāma svāhā' iduvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya cedaṃ na mama | 'oṃ bhadrānnaḥ śreyaḥ0 syonaḥ svāhā' | devabhyaḥ pitave cedaṃ na mama | iti pañcājyānīragnerdakṣiṇatastiṣṭhanhutvā sthālīpākapātrataḥ prokṣaṇīpātramādāya prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya haviṣprokṣaṇādi catuḥśarāvaparimitacaruśrapaṇāntaṃ kuryāt | tataścarvabhighāraṇādi barhiṣyāsādanāntaṃ kṛtvā'dita ityādibhiragniṃ pariṣicyā''sāditāmekāṃ samidhamabhyādadhyāt | tato mekṣaṇena carorupahatya 'oṃ indrāgnibhyā svāhā' iti juhoti | indrāgnibhyāmidaṃ na mama | tataḥ punastathaivopahatya 'oṃ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā' iti juhoti | viśvebhyo devebhya idaṃ na mama | punastathaivopahatya 'oṃ dyāvāpṛthivībhyā svāhā' iti |dyāvāpṛthivībhyāmidaṃ na mama | atra vā'jyānīhomaḥ | asminpakṣe nā''jyasaṃskāraḥ | saṃskṛtājyasya sattvāt | pratyāhutisamidabhyādhānaṃ bhavatyeva | idhmasyābhāvāt | ajyānīhomasyākaraṇameva vā | tato mekṣaṇenottarārdhādbhūya upahatya 'oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' itīśānyāmitarāhutibhirasaṃspṛṣṭāṃ juhoti | agnaye sviṣṭakṛta idaṃ na mama | tato mekṣaṇamanupraharenna vā praharaṇam | tataḥ paristaraṇāni visṛjya darvyā vyastasamastavyāhṛtibhiścatasraḥ prāyaścittāhutīrhutvā'dite'nvama sthā ityādibhiruttarapariṣekaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthājapenāgnimupasthāyāgniṃ saṃpūjya bhasma dhṛtvā''cāryāya dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | tato hutaśeṣamiśritena savyañjanena navānnena brāhmaṇānsaṃbhojya svayaṃ prāṇāhutibhyaḥ prāk, bhadrānna iti mantrasya viśve devāḥ pitustriṣṭup | navavrīhyannāśane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ bhadrānnaḥ śreya0 syonaḥ' iti mantramuktvā prāṇāhutyādividhinā navānnamiṣṭabandhvādiyuto bhuñjīta | hutaśeṣamiśrānnasya bhuktasya vamane bhakṣiteḍābhāgavamanaprāyaścittameva kāryam | taccā''dhānadīpikāyām -- "iḍābhāge bhakṣite tu vamanaṃ vai bhavedyadā | ābhirgīrbhirimaṃ mantraṃ daśavāraṃ japettadā || snānaṃ kṛtvā mārjanaṃ ca tasya doṣapraśāntaye" iti || pūrvaṃ snānaṃ śuddhyarthaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kṛtvā''bhirgīrbhiriti mantreṇa punaḥ snānaṃ mārjanaṃ ca kṛtvā daśavāramābhiritimantrajapaḥ kāryaḥ | "anena mārjanaṃ kṛtvā tasya doṣapraśāntaye" iti pāṭhe tu -- ābhiriti mantreṇa mārjanaṃ kṛtvaitasyaiva mantrasya daśavāraṃ japaḥ kārya iti prayogo draṣṭavyaḥ | pūrvaṃ snānaṃ tvarthasiddham | ayameva pāṭho yuktaḥ | iti vrīhyāgrayaṇasthālīpākaḥ | atha yavāgrayaṇam | tacca vasante | tatra yavāgrayaṇasthālīpākaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpavākyam | nūta nayavamayaścaruḥ | etamu tyaṃ madhunā saṃyutaṃ yavam' iti 'bhadrānnaḥ śreyaḥ' ityasya sthāne mantra iti viśeṣaḥ | anyatsamānam | etamu tyamityasya mantrasya viśve devā yavānnaṃ jagatī | nūtanayavānnaprāśane viniyoga iti ṛṣyādikaṃ jñeyam | etacca yavāgrayaṇaṃ kṛtākṛtam | atha śyāmākāgrayaṇam | śyāmākāgrayaṇasthālīpākaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpavākyam | nūtanaśyāmākamayaścaruḥ | somo devatā | sviṣṭakṛddvitīyam | agniḥ prathamaḥ prāśnātvityasya mantrasya viśve devāḥ śyāmākānnamanuṣṭup | nūtanaśyāmākānnāśane viyogaḥ | 'oṃ agniḥ prathamaḥ prā0 carṣaṇiḥ' iti nūtanaśyāmākānnāśanamantra iti viśeṣaḥ | samānamanyat | athavā śyāmākāgrayaṇasiddhyarthaṃ pārvaṇasthālīpāke vā śyāmākatṛṇamayaṃ barhiḥ kartavyam | athavā nūtanaśyāmākāngave dattvā tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa sāyaṃprātaraupāsanahomau hotavyau | tenaiva tatsiddhiḥ | vrīhyāgrayaṇasthālīpākakaraṇāśaktau navairvrīhibhireva pārvaṇasthālīpākau kāryau | athavā navānvrīhīngave dattvā tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa sāyaṃprātaraupāsanahomau hotavyau | anukalpāntaramapyāha maṇḍanaḥ -- "gṛhye baudhāyanenoktaṃ naveṣṭiścenna saṃbhavet | brāhmaṇe bhojanaṃ dadyātkuryādvā vaiśvadevikam" iti || idaṃ ca sūtroktānukalpāsaṃbhave jñeyam | idaṃ cā''grayaṇaṃ malamāsāstādiṣu na bhavati | śuddhakālasya saṃbhavāt | purātanadhānyābhāve tvatrāpi bhavati | yadi daivānmānuṣādvā pratibandhāccharatkāla āgrayaṇaṃ na jāyeta tadā hemante śiśire vā'tītamāgrayaṇaṃ kuryāt | ityāgrayaṇasthālīpākaḥ | atha garbhādhānam | tatrā''dau prathamarajodarśane māsapakṣādīnāṃ phalamucyate | tatra māsaphalaṃ vidhānamālāyāṃ vārāhe -- "ādyartau vidhavā nārī caitramāse bhaveddhruvam | vaiśākhe bahuputrā syājjyeṣṭhe rogāturā bhavet || āṣāḍhe tvanapatyā syācchrāvaṇe dhaninī bhavet | bhādre tu durbhagā klībā hyāśvine ca tapasvinī || kārtike vidhavā bālā mārgaśīrṣe bahuprajā | pauṣe syātpuṃścalī nārī māghe putrasukhānvitā || phālgune sukhasaṃpannā prathamartau phalaṃ smṛtam" iti | pakṣaphalaṃ smṛticandrikāyām -- "śuklapakṣe suśīlā syātkṛṣṇe sā kulaṭā bhavet | kṛṣṇasya daśamī yāvanmadhyamaṃ phalamādiśet || ekādaśyādiṣu phalamadhamaṃ parikīrtitam" iti | tithiphalamapi tatraiva -- "vaidhavyadā hi pratipaddvitīyā putravardhinī | saubhāgyadā tṛtīyā ca caturthī sukhanāśinī || pañcamī sukhadā caiva ṣaṣṭhī saṃtatināśinī | saptamī dhananāśāya putrasaubhāgyadā'ṣṭamī || navamī kleśadā strīṇāṃ daśamī ca sukhapradā | ekādaśyarthanāśāya dvādaśī rativardhinī || trayodaśī tu śubhadā durbhagā ca caturdaśī | paurṇamāsī tvamāvāsyā duḥkharogavivardhinī" iti || jyotirgranthāntare tu -- "ādyartau subhagā nārī pratipatsu rajasvalā" iti | tathā -- "saptamī dhanavardhinī" iti | tathā -- "aṣṭamyāṃ rākṣasī nārī" iti | tathā -- "ekādaśyāṃ sukhānvitā | dvādaśyāṃ durbhagā nārī" iti | tathā -- "paurṇamāsyāṃ suputriṇī" iti pratipadādidvādaśyantatithiṣu viparītaphalamuktam | atra pratipatpūrṇimāsamīpasthaiva grāhyā | "vaidhavyadā hi pratipat" ityatra tvamāsamīpasthā pratipadgrāhyā | tasyāścandrakṣayāviśeṣeṇāmātulyatvāt | saptamīniṣedhe kṛṣṇā grāhyā | evamaṣṭamyekādaśīdvādaśīṣvapi jñeyam | paurṇamāsīniṣedhastu paurṇamāsīpūrvārdhaparaḥ | tasya bhadrārūpatvāt | vidhistvitarāṃśa iti jñeyam | vāraphalaṃ vidhānamālāyāṃ vārāhe -- "āditye vidhavā nārī some caiva mṛtaprajā | ātmano ghātinī bhaume budhe kanyāprasūrbhavet || gurau putravatī nārī kanyāputraprasūrbhṛgau | rpauścalyakāriṇī mande bharturagre mriyeta sā" iti || sā rajovatī | nāradīye tu -- "rugṇā pativratā duḥkhī putriṇī bhogabhāginī | patipriyā kleśabhāgī sūryavārādiṣu kramāt" ityuktam | mṛtaprajeti kṛṣṇapakṣasomavāraviṣayam | pativrateti śuklasomavāraviṣayam | nāto virodhaḥ | nakṣatraphalaṃ vārāhe -- "aśvinī sukhadā strīṇāṃ bharaṇī kāmavardhinī | kṛttikā dainyadā jñeyā rohiṇī sukhadā bhavet | mṛgastu kāmabhogāya sukhadaṃ rudradaivatam | adityṛkṣaṃ sukhaṃ dadyādgurubhaṃ sukhavardhanam | āśleṣāḥ sukhanāśāya maghā vaidhavyadāḥ smṛtāḥ | pūrvā phalgunikā putrakanyāsukhavivardhinī | uttarā hyarthanāśāya hastaḥ putrapravardhanaḥ | citrā citratanuṃ nārīṃ kurute nātra saṃśayaḥ | svātī śubhāya nārīṇāṃ viśākhā sukhanāśinī | anūrādhā'rthabhogāya jyeṣṭhā bhartṛviyogadā | śubhaṃ vā'pyaśubhaṃ mūlaṃ pūrvāṣāḍhā'rthanāśinī | sukhadā cottarāṣāḍhā śravaṇaḥ sukhavardhanaḥ | dhaniṣṭhāpañcakaṃ strīṇāṃ prathamartau sukhapradam" iti | ratnamālāyāṃ tu -- "karādipañcottaramūlapūṣaviṣṇutrayāśvījyavidhīndubheṣu | ādyaṃ rajaḥ saukhyayutāyurarthaṃ saubhāgyavṛddhiṃ kurute'ṅganānām | pūrvātraye yāmyabhujaṃgadhiṣṇye vaidhavyamasyā vidadhīta nūnam | magheśayoḥ śokamathāditerbhe vandhyā tathaindre'pyanale daridriṇī" ityuktam | karādipañcakaṃ hastacitrāsvātīviśākhānūrādhānakṣatrāṇi | uttaraśabdenottarātrayam | īśa ārdrā | aindraṃ jyeṣṭhā | analaḥ kṛttikā | granthāntare viśeṣaḥ -- "ādyaṃśe dasramaghāmūlānāṃ sarpaśakrapauṣṇānām | carame yadi puṣpavatī kulaṭā vandhyā mṛtaprajā bhavati" iti | dasrāvaśvinī | sarpa āśleṣāḥ | śakro jyeṣṭhā | poṣṇaṃ revatī | atra keṣucinnakṣatreṣu parasparaṃ phalavirodho'sti sa śuklakṛṣṇapakṣāntargatatvena vyavasthāpanīyaḥ | śubhaṃ phalaṃ śuklapakṣāntargatanakṣatraviṣayaṃ, niṣiddhaṃ phalaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāntargatanakṣatraviṣayam | iti nakṣatraphalam | atha yogaphalam | jyotirnibandhe vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "ādyartau durbhagā nārī viṣkambhe cedrajasvalā | vandhyā syādatigaṇḍe ca śūle śūlavatī bhavet | gaṇḍe tu puṃścalī nārī vyāghāte cā''tmaghātinī | vajre ca svairiṇī proktā pāte ca patighātinī | parighe mṛtavandhyā ca vaidhṛtau patimāriṇī | śeṣāḥ śubhāvahā yogā yathānāmaphalapradāḥ" iti | granthāntare viśeṣaḥ -- "amāsaṃkrāntiviṣṭyādau vyatīpāte ca vaidhṛtau | parighasya tu pūrvārdhe ṣaṭṣaḍgaṇḍātigaṇḍayoḥ | vyāghāte nava śūle ca nāḍyaḥ pañcartudarśane" iti | varjanīyā iti śeṣaḥ | eteṣāṃ phalāni tatraiva -- "vaidhavyamarthahāniṃ ca sutanāśaṃ mahadbhayam | vaidhavyaṃ śatruvṛddhiṃ ca dāridryaṃ kṣīṇajīvanam | tejohāniṃ durbhagatvameṣu puṣpavatī kramāt" iti | iti yogaphalam | atha karaṇaphalam | "bave puṣpavatī nārī vandhyā vā vidhavā bhavet | bālave putriṇī nārī kaulave pramadā bhavet | taitile saṃmatavatī gare nārī vinaśyati | naṣṭaprajā vaṇiksaṃjñe viṣṭyāṃ dhanavivarjitā | śakune(nau) ca catuṣpāde nārī vaidhavyamāpnuyāt | nāge na ramate nārī kiṃstughne vidhavā bhavet" iti | iti karaṇaphalam | atha lagnaphalam | jyotirnibandhe vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "vyabhicāravatī meṣe vṛṣabhe parabhoginī | mithune dhanabhogāḍhyā karkaṭe vyabhicāriṇī || putrāḍhyā siṃharāśau syātkanyāyāṃ śrīmatī tathā | vicakṣaṇā tulāyāṃ tu vṛścike tu pativratā || duścāriṇī dhanuṣpūrve pare caiva pativratā | makare mānahīnā ca kumbhe nirdhanavandhyatā || mīne vilakṣaṇe lagne grahasaṃsthā vivāhavat" iti || dhanuṣaḥ pūrvabhāge duścāriṇī parabhāge pativratetyarthaḥ | grahasaṃsthā grahapūjā vivāhavat | śaktyā dvitriguṇā bhavatītyarthaḥ | jyotirnibandhe vārāhe tu -- "ātmaghnī bhrūṇahā meṣe vṛṣe putravatī bhavet | dvaṃdve kanyā prasūrnārī mṛtāpatyā ca karkaṭe || siṃhe vaidhavyamāpnoti kanyāyāṃ strīprasūrbhavet | tulāyāṃ bahuputrāḍhyā duṣṭakarmaratā'lini || cāpe putradhanāḍhyā syānmṛge duścāriṇī bhavet | sakṛtprajāvatī kumbhe mīne cālpaprajā bhavet" ityuktam || alirvṛścikaḥ | alinītyārṣaprayogaḥ | atrāpi śuklakṛṣṇapakṣāntargatatvena pūrvavadvyavasthā jñeyā | iti lagnaphalam | athartudarśanalagne saptamasthānasthitagrahāṇāṃ phalāni | nārasiṃhīye -- "lagnasya saptamasthāne sūryo vaidhavyakārakaḥ | candraḥ satputrado jñeyaḥ saubhāgyaṃ ca labheddhruvam || putrahānikaro bhaumo budhaḥ satputrado bhavet | bṛhaspatirdhanāyuṣyaṃ śukraḥ sāpatnakārakaḥ || śanaiścare tu vandhyā syādrāhau tu maraṇaṃ dhruvam" iti | ityṛtudarśanalagne saptamasthānasthitagrahāṇāṃ phalāni | atha velāphalam | tatraiva -- "prātakāle rajaḥ strīṇāṃ prathamaṃ śokavardhanam | saṃgave sukhasaṃtatyai madhyāhne dhanasaṃtatī | aparāhṇe dhanāvāptiḥ sāyāhne madhyamaṃ phalam | pūrvarātre sukhāyālaṃ madhyarātre dhanakṣayaḥ || pararātre'rthanāśaśca prathamartau phalaṃ smṛtam | mahadbhayaṃ saṃdhyayoḥ syādarthahānistathaiva ca" iti || anyatra tu -- "lābhaṃ caiva tu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne madhyamaṃ phalam | aparāhṇe tu vaidhavyaṃ pūrvarātre śubhaṃ bhavet || madhyarātre madhyamaṃ syātpararātre śubhānyakam" ityuktam || śubhānyakamaśubham | iti velāphalam | atha grahaṇaphalam | bhārgavaḥ -- "prasūtiryadi jāyeta grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | saṃkrāntau ca tadā strīṇāmādau ca ṛtudarśane | itthaṃ saṃjāyate yastu tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ | vyādhiḥ pīḍā ca dāridryaṃ śokaśca kalaho bhavet" iti || yasya prasūtistasya yasya striyā ṛtudarśanaṃ tasya cetyarthaḥ | etannimittakaśāntistu śāntiratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyate | iti grahaṇaphalam | atha draṣṭṛphalam | "puraṃdhryā dṛśyate yattu rajaḥ strīṇāṃ sukhāya tat | viśastayā tu yaddṛṣṭaṃ rajo vaidhavyadaṃ smṛtam || rajaḥ paśyati cetkanyā pumānvā tatsukhaṃ bhavet | svayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tathā strīṇāmātmaghātāya kalpate" iti || puraṃdhrī saubhāgyavatī strī | viśastā vidhavā | iti draṣṭṛphalam | atha praṣṭṛphalam | "mātā pṛcchati cedvyarthaṃ pitā pṛcchati cetsukham | śyālo dāridryamāpnoti svasā cedāyuṣaḥ sukham || pisṛṣvasā dhanaṃ yāti sodarā vipulaṃ dhanam | praṣṭā bhrātā''yuṣaḥ kṣaṇyamityevaṃ labhate'ṅganā" iti || śyālaḥ pṛcchati cettadā rajovatī dāridryamāpnotītyarthaḥ | pitṛṣvasā pitṛbhaginī pṛcchati cettadā dhanaṃ yāti dhanaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | atha parihitavastraphalam | "subhagā śvetavastrā syānnavavastrā pativratā | durbhagā jīrṇavastrā syātsubhagā kṣaumavatriṇī || lohite tu bhavedvandhyā citravarṇe tu putriṇī | kṛṣṇe tu vidhavā nārī rajasyetattu lakṣaṇam" iti || iti parihitavastraphalam | atha rajaḥphalam | "prathamartau phalaṃ strīṇāmucyate rajaso'dhunā | subhagā putrasaṃyuktā śuklavarṇe tathā''rtave || śaśaśoṇitasaṃkāśe yadvā'laktakasaṃnibhe | putrakanyāprasūtiḥ syānnīle tu syānmṛtaprajā || karpūre mriyate sadyaḥ piṅgale ca mṛtaprajā | kṛṣṇe tu vidhavā nārī rajasyevaṃ vinirdiśet || śoṇite bindumātre tu svairiṇī tvalpaśoṇite | varā madhyasravā syāttu durbhagā bahuśoṇitā || rakte rakte bhavetputraḥ kṛṣṇe ca mṛtaputrikā | picchalābhe bhavedvandhyā kākavandhyā ca pāṇḍure || pīte ca svairiṇī proktā subhagā guñjavarṇake | sindūrābhe bhavetkanyā rajaḥśoṇitalakṣaṇam" iti || rakte lohite rakte raktavarṇe satītyarthaḥ | iti rajaḥphalam | athotpātaphalam | "saṃdhyāsūpaplave viṣṭyāmaśubhaṃ prathamārtavam" iti | ityutpātaphalam | atha bindusaṃkhyāphalam | "prāpnoti bindunaikena saubhāgyaṃ tu rajovatī | dvibindunā bhavedbhogo bhavedrogastribindubhiḥ || dāridryamadhikeṣu syādrajasyetattu lakṣaṇam" iti | iti binduphalam | atha kāryakaraṇasamayaphalam | devarātaḥ -- "saṃmārjanīkāṣṭhatṛṇāgniśūrpānhaste dadhānā kulaṭā tadā syāt | talpopabhoge tapasi sthitā ceddṛṣṭaṃ rajo bhāgyavatī tadā syāt" iti | granthāntare -- "śuṣkakāṣṭhatuṣaiḥ śūrpamārjanyādyaśubhairyutam | deśe śubhe yathā dṛṣṭe tathā syātprathamārtave || bhuktau talpe ca yāne ca tapanīye ca dhārmike | śubhopakaraṇairyukte śubhairlagnagrahairyute ||
