śubhaṃ syādanukūlarkṣe rāśau syātkhagasaṃyutā" iti || iti kāryakaraṇasamayaphalam | atha sthānaphalam | jyotirnibandhe -- "gṛhamadhye sukhāvāptirgṛhadvāre viyogatā | śayyotthā sukhadā bhūyāddhanaṃ cāpatyasaṃtatiḥ || pitugṛhe rajo dainyaṃ vidadhāti pituḥ kule | devasthāne pituḥ sthāne nindyasthāne'nyaveśmani || mārge bhartṛviyogaṃ ca bandyāgāre mṛtaprajā" iti | devasthānaṃ devālayam(yaḥ)| pitṛsthānaṃ śmaśānam | nindyasthānaṃ kutsitasthānam | anyaveśma bhartṛgṛhādanyadgṛham | iti sthānaphalam | tithyādiphaleṣūttarottaraṃ viśeṣamāha devarātaḥ -- "tithirekaguṇā proktā nakṣatraṃ ca caturguṇam | vārastu ṣaḍguṇo jñeyo māsaścāṣṭaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || vastraṃ daśaguṇaṃ vidyāddarśanaṃ ca tato'dhikam | aśubhaṃ cedrajaḥ strīṇāṃ prathamartau hi dṛśyate || vidhānaṃ tatra kartavyamariṣṭaghnaṃ viśeṣataḥ" iti | vidhānaṃ śāntiḥ | sā ca śāntiratnamālāyāṃ vakṣyate | atha sarvartuniyamāḥ | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "trirātraṃ malavadvāsasā brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni vratāni carati" iti | malavadyadvastraṃ tena sahitā vrataṃ caratītyarthaḥ | athavā malavadvāsasā rajasvalā malavadvāsaseti tṛtīyā prathamārthe | malavadvāsā iti pāṭhastu yukta eva | "tasmānmalavadvāsasā na saṃvadeta" ityādīni brāhmaṇoktāni vratāni caratītyarthaḥ | malaḥ, rajo vidyate yasmiṃstanmalavat | etenaiva jñāyata ekavastraiva rajasvalā snānaparyantaṃ bhavediti | śrutau parṇena pānasyaiva niṣedhanātparṇe bhojanasya niṣedho nāstītyavagamyate | etanmūlamagre pradarśayiṣyate | tacca palāśādiyajñiyavṛkṣavyatiriktamācārājjñeyam | (smṛtimañjaryām -- "tasmādudakyayā sārdhamekagehe na saṃviśet | pratigrahaṃ ca saṃvādamasyā annaṃ ca varjayet || rajasvalāṃ patirgaccheccaṇḍālo jāyate sutaḥ | araṇye tāṃ yadā gacchettajjaḥ stenastadā bhavet || parāṅmukhīṃ tāṃ gaccheccettajjo(jjā) hrītamukhī bhavet | parāṅmukhyā udakyāyā jātaḥ so'pyapagalbhakaḥ || ārtave yadi sā snāti tajjāto'psu mariṣyati | tailenābhyañjanaṃ kuryātkuṣṭharogī prajāyate || ārtave pralikhedbhūmimalpāyurjāyate khalaḥ | netrayorañjanaṃ kuryātkāṇo vā'ndhaḥ prajāyate || dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ kuryājjāyate śyāvadantakaḥ | nakhānāṃ kṛntanaṃ kuryātkunakhī jāyate sutaḥ || rajjvādikacchedanaṃ cetkuryātklībaḥ prajāyate | tantubhiḥ sṛjate rajjumudbandhanamṛto bhavet || ṛtau pātre'nnamaśnīyādunmādī jāyate sutaḥ | kharve śarāve bhuñjīta vāmano'sau prajāyate" iti || "ṛtau pātre'paḥ sā'śnīyādunmādī jāyate sutaḥ | kharvapātre'paḥ sā'śnīyādvāmano'sau prajāyate" ityapi kvacitpāṭhaḥ | ayameva pāṭhaḥ śrutyanuguṇatvādyuktaḥ | etasmādbrāhmaṇavākyātsaubhāgyavatyā rajasvalāyā eva snānapralekhanadantadhāvananakhanikṛntanatṛṇādicchedanarajjusargaparṇasādhanakapānakharvapātrasādhanakapānarūpā dharmā niṣiddhāḥ | na vidhavāyā rajasvalāyāstatra prajotpatterevābhāvena prajāgatadoṣāṇāmasaṃbhavāt | abhyaṅgādikaṃ tu vidhavātvenaiva niṣiddhamiti yadyapi prāptaṃ tathā'pi -- "vidhavāyā rajovatyā api snānādayo nahi" iti smṛtidarpaṇasthagālavavacanāttasyā api snānādayo dharmā niṣiddhā eveti jñeyam | ādiśabdena pralekhanādi | bhojanakutūhale bhāvaprakāśe -- "ārtavasrāvadivasādbhavetsā brahmacāriṇī | śayīta darbhaśayyāyāṃ paśyedapi patiṃ na ca | kare śarāve parṇa vā haviṣyaṃ tryahamācaret | aśrupātaṃ nakhacchedamabhyaṅgamanulepanam | netrayorañjanaṃ snānaṃ divāsvāpaṃ pradhāvanam | atyuccaśabdaśravaṇaṃ hasanaṃ bahubhāṣaṇam | āyāsaṃ bhūmikhananaṃ pravāsaṃ ca vivarjayet" iti |) vasiṣṭho'pi -- "trirātraṃ rajasvalā'śucirbhavati sā nāñjyānnābhyañjyānnāpsu snāyādadhaḥ śayīta na divā svapyānnāgniṃ spṛśenna rajjuṃ sṛjenna dantāndhāvayenna māṃsamaśnīyānna grahānnirīkṣeta na hasennāślīlaṃ kiṃcidācaredakharveṇa pibedañjalinā vā pibellauhenā''yasena vā vijñāyate" iti | aśuciriti padacchedaḥ | nāpsu snāyāt | naimittike snāne prāpte nimajjanarūpaṃ snānaṃ naiva kuryāt | ata eva parāśaraḥ -- "snāne naimittike prāpte nārī yadi rajasvalā | pātrāntaritatoyena snānaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret" ityuddhṛtodakena snānamāha | akharveṇa mahatetyarthaḥ | lauhena tāmreṇa | dakṣaḥ -- "añjanābhyañjane snānaṃ pravāsaṃ dantadhāvanam | na kuryātsārtavā nārī grahāṇāmīkṣaṇaṃ tathā | divānidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ tālavṛntādibandhanam | evamuktaprakāreṇa tisro rātrīrvrataṃ caret" iti | (atra nityasnānaṃ nipidhyate |) gargaḥ -- "āhāraṃ gorasānāṃ ca puṣpālaṃkāradhāraṇam | añjanaṃ kaṅkataṃ gandhānpīṭhaśayyādhirohaṇam | agnisaṃsparśanaṃ caiva varjayetsā dinatrayam" iti | kaṅkataṃ keśaprasādhanam | pīṭhaṃ ca śayyā ca pīṭhaśayye tayoradhirohaṇamiti vigrahaḥ | atra pīṭhaśayyayorgrahaṇātsopānārohaṇe niṣedho na | sā rajasvalā | smṛtyantare -- "bhūmau kārṣṇāyase pāṇau śarāve dagdha eva vā | rajasvalā tu bhuñjīta lauhena tu jalaṃ pibet" iti | atriḥ -- "varjayenmadhu māṃsaṃ ca pātre kharve ca bhojanam | gandhamālyaṃ divāsvāpaṃ tāmbūlaṃ cā''syaśodhanam | dagdhe śarāve bhuñjīta peyaṃ cāñjalinā pibet" iti | akharvamahrasvaṃ pātram | āsyaśodhanaṃ mukhaśodhanam | "gandhamālyaṃ divāsvāpaṃ tāmbūlaṃ kāṃsyabhājanam" | iti devarātavacanapāṭhaḥ | kāṃsyabhājananiṣedhena sauvarṇarājatādyabhyanujñā gamyate | viśvaprakāśe -- "divāsvāpamalaṃkāraṃ krīḍāṃ śilpakriyāṃ tathā | gṛhakarma ca tāmbūlamadhvānaṃ rātribhojanam | jyotiṣāṃ darśanaṃ sparśaṃ parapuṃsāṃ ca darśanam | hasanaṃ jalpanaṃ caiva varjayecca rajasvalā" iti | jalpanaṃ bahubhāṣaṇam | atha prayogapārijātakṛtarajasvalāviśeṣadharmaprayogaḥ pradarśyate | tailābhyaṅgaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ nakhakṛntanaṃ netrāñjanaṃ tantunā rajjvādikaraṇaṃ tacchedanaṃ tālavṛntādibandhanaṃ muktāphalaratnānāṃ mālākaraṇaṃ bhuvi lekhanamalpaśarāvaparṇapātrabhojanaṃ madhughṛtakṣāradadhicandanaṃ(bhakṣaṇaṃ) gandhapuṣpabhūṣaṇaṃ(ṇa)dhautavastradhāraṇaṃ tāmbūlasevanaṃ grahekṣaṇaṃ divāsvāpaṃ cākurvatī śaucādiśodhanaṃ snānamagnisparśanamanyarajasvalāśūdrāntyajaśvakukkuṭādisparśanaṃ cākurvatī kāṃsyapātre viśālamṛnmayapātre vā kṣīradadhighṛtavarjitamannaṃ bhuñjānā gamanāgamanakāle pāduke upānahau vā dhṛtvā'gacchantī lauhenā''yasena pātreṇāñjalinā vā jalaṃ pibantī snānadivase ṣaṣṭimṛttikābhiḥ śaucaṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakaṃ saṃgave snānaṃ kṛtvā patimukhamiṣṭadevatāṃ vā'valokayet, iti | alpaśabdasya śarāvaparṇaśabdayoranvayaḥ | tenālpaparṇasya niṣedho na tu mahataḥ kadalyādiparṇasyeti | prathamartau viśeṣaḥ prayogapārijāte smṛticandrikāyām -- "udvāhitāṅganāyāśca prathame tvārtave tataḥ | akṣatairāsanaṃ kṛtvā tasmiṃstāmupaveśayet || haridrāgandhapuṣpādīndadyustāmbūlakaṃ srajam | āśiṣo vācayeyustāḥ patiputravatī bhava || dīpairnīrājanaṃ kuryātsadīpe vāsayedgṛhe | apūpāllam̐vaṇaṃ mudgaguḍamiśraṃ tathā haviḥ || dadyādbrāhmaṇaputrībhyastābhyo dadyāttu bhojanam" iti | atha rajodoṣāvadhiḥ | madanapārijāte marīciḥ -- "śuddhā bhartuścaturthe'hni snānena strī rajasvalā | daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śudhyati" iti || upagamanārhā bhavatīti pūrvārdhaḥ | idaṃ ca rajonivṛttau jñeyam | "gamyā nivṛtte rajasi nānivṛtte kathaṃcana" ityāpastambavacanāt | uttarārdhaṃ tu karmānadhikāraṃ pratipādayati | yadyapi marīcivacanena sarveṣu śrauteṣu smārteṣu daivapitryakarmasu caturthadivase rajonivṛttau satyāmapi karmānarhatvaṃ pratipāditaṃ tathā'pi "rajasyuparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā" | iti manuvākye madanapārijātena sādhvī garbhādhānādivihitakarmayogyetyādipadopādānena pradhānānurodhena tadadhikārasaṃpattyarthaśāntāvapyadhikārasya pradarśitatvāt, evaṃ śrauteṣu darśādiṣu caturthe'hanyapi śuddhiḥ | "caturthe'hani gomūtramiśrābhiradbhiḥ snātā prakṣālitāni tānyeva vāsoyoktrajālāni punarmantrairdhārayet" | iti somaprakaraṇe baudhāyanavacanāt, yadā trirātreṇetivacanādrajasvalāyāḥ snānadivase'pi śrautakarmāṇi kartavyānyeva na tu pañcame'hanyeveti niyama iti bhāṣyakārokteśca rajonivṛttāveva caturthe'hanyadhikāra iti prāyaścittacandrikāyām | evamudāhṛtamadanapārijātagrantha ādipadamupanayanāderapi grāhakaṃ, tatrāpi vakṣyamāṇaśrīsūktahomapūrvakābhiṣekeṇa caturthe'hanyadhikārasaṃbhavāt | etaccānyadinānanukūlatāyām | tadanukūlatāyāṃ tu śāntipūrvakametatpañcame'hanyeveti bodhyam | iti rajodoṣāvadhiḥ | atha snānavidhiḥ | smṛtyarthasāre -- "brāhmaṇī rajasvalā caturthe'hni ṣaṣṭipalamṛttikābhiḥ śaucaṃ kuryāt | kṣatriyādistriyaḥ pādanyūnamṛttikābhirvidhavā dviguṇamṛttikābhistato malaṃ prakṣālya dantadhāvanapūrvakaṃ sacailaṃ saṃgave snāyāt" iti | atriḥ -- "rajasvalā caturthe'hni mṛttikāṣaṣṭibhiḥ pṛthak | śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ tathā || kṛtvā tu saṃgave'tīte sacailaṃ snānamācaret | bhasmagomayamṛdbhiśca sarvairanyatamena vā || snātvāṃ'śukaṃ paricchādya gandhapuṣpairalaṃkṛtā | ācamya puṣpairādityamarcayitvā yathocitam || aindraṃ varaṃ prabho mahyamidānīṃ dātumarhasi | ityuktvā''thaindrabhāvena prārthayettu svakaṃ patim || ṛtusnātā tu yā nārī yaṃ snehānnaramīkṣate | tādṛśaṃ janayetputraṃ patimeva nirīkṣayet" iti || kātyāyanaḥ -- "na niṣevyamudakyābhiḥ snānaṃ mālyānulepanam | haste vā mṛnmaye pātre divaiva laghubhojanam || haviṣyaṃ madhuraṃ cānnaṃ kaṭutiktādivarjitam | ekānte prākśirā bhūmāvāstṛtāyāṃ śayīta sā || caturthe divase snāyādāturā koṣṇavāriṇā | caturthe divase snātvā bhaktyā''dityaṃ samīkṣate || bhartāraṃ devaraṃ vā'pi śvaśuraṃ nānyamīkṣayet" iti | smṛtyantare tu -- "caturthe'hani kurvīta snānamabhyudite ravau" ityudayānantarameva snānamuktam | tena vikalpaḥ | sūryodayātpūrvaṃ snānācaraṇaṃ tu durācāra eva | rajasvalāyāṃ naimittikasnānaprakāramāha vyāsaḥ -- "snāne naimittike prāpte nārī yadi rajasvalā | pātrāntaritatoyena snānaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ caret || siktagātrā bhavedadbhiḥ sāṅgopāṅgā kathaṃcana | na vastrapīḍanaṃ kuryānnānyadvāso vidhārayet" iti || jvarādipīḍitāyā rajasvalāyāḥ śuddhiprakāramāho śanā -- "jvarābhibhūtā yā nārī rajasā ca pariplutā | kathaṃ tasyā bhavecchaucaṃ śuddhiḥ syātkena karmaṇā || caturthe'hani saṃprāpte spṛśedanyā tu tāṃ striyam | sā sacailā'vagāhyāpaḥ snātvā snātvā punaḥ spṛśet || daśadvādaśakṛtvo vā hyāca(cā)mecca punaḥ punaḥ | ante ca vāsasāṃ tyāgastataḥ śuddhā bhavettu sā || dadyācchaktyā tato dānaṃ puṇyāhena viśudhyati | āturāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmevaṃ śuddhirvidhīyate" iti || iti snānavidhiḥ | atha prasaṅgādrajodarśanamadhye pāraṇāprāptau vicāraḥ | tatra ṛṣyaśṛṅgaḥ -- "saṃpravṛtte'pi rajasi na tyājyaṃ dvādaśīvratam" iti | dvādaśīvratamityupalakṣaṇam | "prārabdhadīrghatapasāṃ nārīṇāṃ yadrajo bhavet | na tatrāpi vratasya syāduparodhaḥ kadācana" iti satyavratokteḥ | satyavratavacanasyāyamarthaḥ -- navarātramāsopavāsādidīrghakālasādhyakāmyavratavatī nārī madhye rajaḥ paśyati tadopavāsādi kuryādeva taddinasādhyapūjādikaṃ tu pañcame'hani kuryāt | "pañcame'hani śuddhā syāddaive pitrye ca karmaṇi" iti vacanādatikrāntapūjādānādi pañcame'hani kuryāditi mādhavokteḥ | hemādristu -- "garbhiṇī sūtakī caiva kumārī vā'tha rohiṇī | yadā'śuddhā tadā'nyena kārayetprayatā satī" iti pādmamevaṃ vyācakhyau -- liṅgasyāvivakṣitatvātpumānvā strī vā'śuddhāvupavāsapūjādiyukte vrate svayamupoṣya pūjādyanyena kārayediti | tithyādiniyatakālaśeṣavihiteṣvevam | anyeṣu tu kokilādivrateṣu pañcame'hanītyādi | kiṃcaikādaśyādau pañcaṣāśaucapāte māsānte pāraṇāpattirmāsopavāsānte pañcaṣāśaucapāte jīvanāsaṃbhavaśca | yattu -- "niyamasthā yadā nārī prapaśyedantarā rajaḥ | upoṣya caturo(tasro) rātrīḥ snātvā śeṣaṃ caredvratam" ityaṅgiraso vacanam | yacca hārītavacanaṃ -- "niyamasthā yadā nārī rajaḥ paśyetkathaṃcana | trirātraṃ tu kṣapedūrdhvaṃ vrataśeṣaṃ samāpayet" iti tadvidhavopavāsaviṣayaṃ, tāsāṃ tatra bhojananiṣedhāditi kecit | anye tu satyavratavacane dīrghatapasāmitiviśeṣaṇopādānāddvādaśīvratavyatiriktasakalaikāhopavāsaviṣayo'yaṃ niṣedhaḥ | trirātranavarātrādidīrghavrateṣu tu rajomadhya eva pāraṇetyāhuḥ | apare tu dīrghatapaḥśabdenaikāhopavāsasyāpi grahaṇaṃ, naktādyapekṣayaitasyāpi dīrghatvāt | tenaikāhopavāsasyāpi rajomadhya eva pāraṇetyāhuḥ | āśaucamadhye tu sarvā'pi pāraṇā bhavati | "kāmyopavāse prakrānte tvantarā mṛtasūtake | tatra kāmyavrataṃ kuryāddānārcanavivarjitam" iti mādhavīye kaurmokteḥ | "vratayajñavivāheṣu śrāddhe home'rcane jape | prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe tu sūtakam" iti viṣṇūkteśca || rudrayāmale -- "sūtake pāraṇaṃ kuryānnavamyāṃ homapūrvakam | tadante bhojayedviprāndānaṃ dadyācca śaktitaḥ" iti || navamyāmiti vratāntaropalakṣaṇam | tadante sūtakānte | prārambhastu vivāhaprakaraṇa uktaḥ -- 'prārambho varaṇaṃ yajñe' itivacanena | iti pāraṇāvicāraḥ | atha snānānantaramapi rajaḥsrāve śuddhivicāraḥ | prayogapārijāte bṛhaspatiḥ -- "rāgajaṃ rogajaṃ caiva dravyajaṃ kālajaṃ tathā | yadrāgarogadravyotthaṃ tadraktaṃ prāha bhārgavaḥ || kālajaṃ tu rajaḥsaṃjñaṃ tasmāttatraiva sā'śuciḥ" iti | aśuciriti padacchedaḥ | tatraiva kālaje rajasyeva sā strī trirātramaśucirbhavatītyarthaḥ | eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇāni sa evā''ha -- "arvākprasūterutpannaṃ medo vandhyāṅganāsu yat | tadrāgajamati proktaṃ majjābhedasamudbhavam || pittādidoṣavaiṣamyādasakṛdyatpravartate | tadrogajaṃ samuddiṣṭamatha dravyajamucyate || bhavedyaddhātuvaiṣamyahetudravyopabhogajam | taddravyajaṃ samuddiṣṭamatha kālajamucyate || ārabhya cā''rtavadinādekaviṃśativāsare | māsādūrdhvaṃ rajo yatsyāttatkālajamudāhṛtam || rajasvalā yadā nārī punareva rajasvalā | sā viṃśatidinādūrdhvaṃ trirātramaśucirbhavet" iti || smṛtyarthasāre viśeṣaḥ -- "saptadaśadinamadhye punā rajodarśane snānamātram | aṣṭādaśa ekarātram | ūnaviṃśe dvyahaṃ, viṃśatiprabhṛti trirātram" iti | etacca yasyā viṃśatidinottarameva prāyaśo rajodarśanaṃ tadviṣayam | kaśyapaḥ -- "rajasvalā yadā nārī punareva rajasvalā | aṣṭādaśāhātprāgvā'pi aśuciḥ syātrirātrakam || ekādaśe tvahorātraṃ dvirātraṃ dvādaśe'hani | ūrdhvaṃ trirātraṃ vijñeyamiti kauṇḍinyabhāṣitam" iti || etacca vacanaṃ yasyā yauvanāvasthābhedena ṣoḍaśadinātprāgeva prācuryeṇa rajodarśanaṃ tadviṣayam | smṛtyarthasāre'pi -- "trayodaśadinādūrdhvaṃ prāyo rajovatīnāmekādaśadinādarvāgaśucitvaṃ nāsti | ekādaśadina ekarātraṃ, dvādaśe dvirātramūrdhvaṃ trirātram" iti | prayogapārijāte'pyevam | idamapi ṣoḍaśarturniśāḥ strīṇāmitivacanātsnānadivasātparaṃ jñeyam | rogaje rajasi nāśucitetyāha bṛhaspatiḥ -- "rogeṇa yadrajaḥ strīṇāmanvahaṃ hi pravartate | nāśuciḥ syāttatastena yato vaikārikaṃ matam" iti || vikārājjātaṃ vaikārikam | rogeṇeti vacanaṃ rāgajadravyajayorupalakṣaṇam | anvahamiti śravaṇānmadhye vyavadhāne yadi prāyo viṃśatidinottarameva sā rajovatī tadā viṃśatiprabhṛti trirātramūnaviṃśe dvyaham , aṣṭādaśa ekarātraṃ saptadaśadinaparyantaṃ snānamātramiti pūrvoktavyavasthā'tra jñeyā | yadi tu ṣoḍaśadinātprāgeva prācuryeṇa rajovatī tadā tvekādaśa ekarātraṃ dvādaśe dvirātraṃ trayodaśaprabhṛti trirātramityeṣāṃ vyavasthā | yadi tu kadācitprathamarajodarśanamārabhyaivānvahaṃ rajodarśanaṃ tadā'pyeṣa eva prakāraḥ | rogaje rajasyapi karmādhikārastu rajonivṛttāveva -- "sādhvācārā na tāvatsyātsnātā'pi strī rajasvalā | yāvatpravartamānaṃ hi rajo naiva nivartate" || iti śrāddhahemādrau śaṅkhokteḥ | sūtikāyā rajodarśane viśeṣamāha prajāpatiḥ -- "prasūtikā tu yā nārī snānato viṃśateḥ param | ārtavī rajasā proktā prāktu naimittikaṃ rajaḥ || tattu naimittike na syādāśaucamiti sūrayaḥ" iti || bṛhaspatiḥ -- "niḥsaṃdehaṃ parijñāte ārtave'śuddhikāraṇam | saṃdehamātre śuddhiḥ syādityuvāca prajāpatiḥ" iti || pūrvatrāśuddhiriti padacchedaḥ | (yamaḥ -- " vyasanātkāryakaraṇānnidrāvismaraṇādapi | rajaḥsrāvamavijñāya sā śuciḥ pūrvakarmasu || jñātājñāteṣu doṣeṣu anukteṣvaśubheṣu ca | puṇyāhavācanaṃ kuryādviprāṇāmanuśāsanāt" iti ||) atha rajodarśanadinavyavasthā | tatra kaśyapaḥ -- "ardharātrādārdharātraṃ dinaṃ syātsūtakādiṣu" iti | ārdharātramardharātraparyantamityarthaḥ | ādipadena ṛturgṛhyate | yājñavalkyastu -- "rātriṃ kuryāttribhāgāṃ tu dvau bhāgau pūrvagāminau | uttamoṃ'śaḥ prabhātena yujyate ṛtusūtake" ityāha | atra saṃdhyabhāva ārṣaḥ | rātrau rajasi jananādau ca rātriṃ tribhāgāṃ kṛtvā''ghabhāgadvaye cetpūrvadinaṃ grāhyam | parataśceduttaraṃ dinamityarthaḥ | smṛtyantare tu -- "rātrāveva samutpanne mṛte rajasi sūtake | pūrvameva dinaṃ grāhyaṃ yāvannābhyudito raviḥ" ityuktam | pūrvarātrerantyārdhamārabhyottararātreḥ pūrvārdhaparyantaṃ dinaṃ, tridhā vibhaktāyā rātrestṛtīyabhāgamārabhyottararātrerādyabhāgadvayaparyantaṃ dinaṃ, sūryodayamārabhya sūryodayaparyantaṃ dinamityevaṃ pakṣatrayaṃ siddham | sacca deśādvyavasthitaṃ jñeyam -- "trayāṇāmapi pakṣāṇāṃ vyavasthā deśabhedataḥ" iti saṃgrahokteḥ | iti rajodarśanadinavyavasthā | atha prasaṅgādanyonyasparśe śvaśūdrādisparśane ca śuddhiprakāraḥ | tatra smṛtimañjaryāṃ vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ -- "udakye dve tu saṃsṛṣṭe savarṇe caikabhartṛke | tayoḥ snānaṃ mithaḥsparśe pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pibet || savarṇayonisaṃbandhe sagotre ca rajasvale | mithaḥ spṛṣṭe tvamatyā tu snānamātreṇa śudhyataḥ || matyā tvamu(bhu)ktirekāhaṃ pañcagavyāśanaṃ tataḥ | udakyayoryadā'nyonyamasaṃbandhasavarṇayoḥ || sparśe tvamatyā snātvā ca tasminnādyācchucirbhavet | matyā tu nādyādāśuddherbhuktā cetprativāsaram || upoṣaṇaṃ tadā kecidāhustaddinasaṃkhyayā | upoṣaṇe na śaktā cetsamaṃ dānaṃ samācaret" iti || rūpyamāṣadānamupavāsapratyāmnāya iti śūlapāṇiḥ | nādyānna bhuñjīyāt | atra pañcagavyāśanamapyuktaṃ kaśyapena -- "rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā brāhmaṇyā brāhmaṇī yadi | ekarātraṃ nirāhārā pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti || etaccākāmataḥ | "spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇyā brāhmaṇī tathā | tāvattiṣṭhennirāhārā trirātreṇaiva śudhyati" || iti parāśaroktaṃ tu kāmataḥ | sapatnyorekagotrayośca sparśe vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "spṛṣṭe rajasvale'nyonyaṃ sagotre caikabhartṛke | kāmādakāmato vā'pi sadyaḥ snānena śudhyati(taḥ)" iti || rajasvale'nyonyamityatra prakṛtibhāvābhāva ārṣaḥ | asavarṇāsparśe parāśaraḥ -- "spṛṣṭe rajasvale'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣattriyā tathā | trirātreṇa viśuddhiḥ syādvyāghrasya vacanaṃ yathā || rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā vaiśyā ca brāhmaṇī ca yā | pañcarātraṃ nirāhārā pañcagavyena śudhyati || rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śūdrā ca brāhmaṇī ca yā | ṣaḍrātreṇa viśuddhiḥ syādbrāhmaṇyā(ṇyāḥ) kāmakārataḥ || ajñānataścaredardhaṃ brāhmaṇī sarvajātiṣu" iti || atra yathā brāhmaṇīrajasvalayoḥ sparśa upavāsaḥ pañcagavyāśanaṃ ca tathā'nyāsāmapi savarṇarajasvalāsparśe tadeva | yathā brāhmaṇyāḥ kṣattriyāsparśe trirātraṃ tathā kṣattriyāyā vaiśyāsparśe vaiśyāyāḥ śūdrāsparśe | tathā ca bhavadevanibandhe smṛtiḥ -- "rajasvalā tu yā nārī anyonyamupasaṃspṛśet | savarṇā pañcagavyena trirātramasavarṇakā" iti || pañcagavyenopavāsasahiteneti bhavadevaḥ | tathā ca śātātapaḥ -- "rajasvale ubhe nāryāvanyonyaṃ spṛśato yadi | savarṇe tu nirāhāre pañcagavyāśanaṃ tataḥ" iti || yattu vṛddhavasiṣṭhaḥ -- "spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī kṣattriyā tathā | ardhakṛcchraṃ caretpūrvā pādakṛcchraṃ tvanantarā || pūrvā brāhmaṇyanantarā kṣattriyā | spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī vaiśyajā tathā | pādahīnaṃ caretpūrvā pādakṛcchraṃ tvanantarā || pūrvā brāhmaṇyanantarā vaiśyā | spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ brāhmaṇī śūdrajā tathā | kṛcchramekaṃ caretpūrvā śūdrā dānena śudhyati, iti || dānaṃ pādakṛcchrasamam | spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ kṣattriyā śūdrajā tathā | upavāsaistribhiḥ pūrvā ahorātreṇa tūttarā || pūrvā kṣattriyā | uttarā śūdrā | spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ kṣattriyā vaiśyajā tathā | trirātrācchudhyate pūrvā ahorātreṇa tūttarā || pūrvā kṣattriyottarā vaiśyā | "spṛṣṭvā rajasvalā'nyonyaṃ vaiśyā śudrā tathaiva ca | trirātrācchudhyate pūrvā ahorātreṇa tūttarā" [iti] || pūrvā vaiśyā | uttarā śūdrā | etacca kāmataḥ sparśe | 'varṇānāṃ kāmataḥ sparśe vidhireṣa sanātanaḥ' | iti vākyaśeṣāt | patitacaṇḍālādisparśe prāyaścittamāhaturbṛhaspativṛddhavasiṣṭhau -- "patitāntyaśvapākena saṃspṛṣṭā cedrajasvalā | tānyahāni vyatikramya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret | prathame'hni trirātraṃ syāddvitīye dvyahameva tu | ahorātraṃ tṛtīye'hni caturthe naktameva tu" iti || tānyahāni rajasvalāvratavanti ahāni vyatikramyopavāseneti śeṣaḥ | atra sarvatra pañcagavyaprāśanamapi kartavyamiti bhavadevaḥ | yattu baudhāyanavacanaṃ -- "rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā caṇḍālāntyaśvavāyasaiḥ | tāvattiṣṭhennirāhārā yāvatkālena śudhyati" || iti, tadaśaktāyā akāme vā | yattu śātātapaḥ -- "udakyā sūtikā vā'pi śavāntyaṃ saṃspṛśedyadi | trirātreṇaiva śudhyetetyāha vārṣyāyaṇimuniḥ" iti | tathā smṛtyantaram -- "caṇḍāla(laṃ)śvapacairvā'(caṃ vā')pi ātreyīṃ(yo) spṛśate yadi | trirātropoṣitā bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti || tathā kātyāyanaḥ -- "caṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭā kadācitstrī rajasvalā | tānyahāni vyatikramya prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || trirātramupavāsaḥ syātpañcagavyena śodhanam" | iti, tadetatprathamadinaviṣayam | upavāsāsamarthāyāṃ tvaṅgirāḥ -- "caṇḍālaḥ śvapaco vā'pi yadyātreyīṃ spṛśedyadi(rtadā)| akālakṛṣṭairvarteta pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti || pañcagavyapānaṃ tu snānānantaraṃ jñeyam | caṇḍālena sahaikavṛkṣādyārohaṇe parāśaraḥ -- "ekavṛkṣasamārūḍhā caṇḍālena rajasvalā | ahorātroṣitā bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati" iti || śvādisparśe viśeṣamāha yamaḥ -- "rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śunā jambūkavāyasaiḥ | nirāhārā bhavettāvadyāvatkālena śudhyati" iti || etadakāmataḥ | kāmatastu rajasvalānuvṛttau bṛhaspatiḥ -- "śunā cocchiṣṭayā'śūdrā saṃspṛṣṭā dvyahamācaret | ahorātraṃ tṛtīye'hni parato naktamācaret" iti || prathamadvitīyadine śvādisparśe dvyahaṃ, tṛtīye dine'horātraṃ, parataścaturthe'hni naktamityarthaḥ | atrāpi tānyahāni vyatikramyeti yojyam | baudhāyanaḥ -- "rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā grāmyakukkuṭasūkaraiḥ | śvabhiḥ snātvā pibettāvadyāvaccandrasya darśanam" iti || candradarśanaṃ naktamityarthaḥ | etadaśaktāyāścaturthadinaviṣayaṃ vā | rajakādisparśa tu śvasparśasamānameva, tayoḥ samānatvāditi śūlapāṇiḥ | yattu pracetāḥ -- "rajasvalā tu saṃspṛṣṭā śunā caṇḍālarāsabhaiḥ | pañcarātraṃ nirāhārā pañcagavyena śudhyati" || iti, tatkāmato'bhyāse | bhojanakāle śvāntyajādisparśe tu baudhāyanaḥ -- "rajasvalā tu bhuñjānā śvāntyajādīnspṛśedyadi | gomūtrayāvakāhārā ṣaḍrātreṇa viśudhyati || aśaktau kāñcanaṃ dadyādviprebhyo vā'tha bhojanam" iti || smṛtyantare -- "puṣpiṇī saṃspṛśenmohādaśuddhaṃ vā naraṃ kvacit | snānādarvāṅna bhuñjīta bhuktvā kṛcchraṃ samācaret || spṛṣṭvodakyā pañcanakhāndviśaphaikaśaphānpaśūn | aṇḍajāni ca sarvāṇi nādyādāsnānavāsarāt" iti || ucchiṣṭayoḥ parasparaṃ sparśe tvatriḥ -- "ucchiṣṭocchiṣṭasaṃspṛṣṭā kadācitstrī rajasvalā | kṛcchreṇa śudhyate pūrvā śūdrā dānena śudhyati" iti || dānaṃ pādakṛcchrasamam | atra pūrvāśabdena brāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyastriyo'bhidhīyante | tena rajasvalayoḥ samānajātīyayorbrāhmaṇīkṣatriyāvaiśyānāṃ parasparaṃ sparśe prājāpatyam | asamānajātīyayoḥ sparśe tvekaikavṛddhirūhanīyā | tādṛśaśūdrayoḥ parasparaṃ sparśe tūpavāsasahitaprājāpatyāmnāyadānena śuddhiḥ | etacca kāmataḥ | akāmatastadardham | śūlapāṇistu -- "ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭā kadācitstrī rajasvalā | kṛcchreṇa tu viśudhyeta śūdrā dānena śudhyati" || iti papāṭha | ucchiṣṭena caṇḍālādinetyarthaḥ | atrāpi dānaṃ pādakṛcchrasamam | eṣu rajasvalātvameva nimittam | ato na kṣatriyāvaiśyayorbrāhmaṇyādi(ṇī)bhyo viśeṣa ityapi śūlapāṇiḥ | ucchiṣṭadvijasaṃsparśe tu mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- "dvijānkathaṃciducchiṣṭānsaṃspṛśeccedrajasvalā | adhocchiṣṭe tvahorātramūrdhvocchiṣṭe tryahaṃ kṣipet" iti || adhocchiṣṭa ityatra saṃdhirārṣaḥ | adhocchiṣṭakṣatriyādisparśe brāhmaṇyā adhikaṃ kalpyam | evaṃ hīnāyā ucchiṣṭottamasparśe nyūnam | bhojanakāle rajasvalāntaraṃ dṛṣṭvā punarbhojane tvāpastambaḥ -- "udakyā yadi vā bhuṅkte dṛṣṭvā'nyāṃ tu rajasvalām | āsnānakālaṃ nāśnīyātpañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pibet" iti || etacca kāmata iti śūlapāṇiḥ | bhojanakāle caṇḍāladarśane tvatriḥ -- "rajasvalā tu bhuñjānā caṇḍālaṃ yadi paśyati | upavāsatrayaṃ kuryātprājāpatyaṃ tu kāmataḥ" iti || rajasvalāyā āśaucisparśe śātātapaḥ -- "ārtavābhiplutā nārī spṛśeccecchavasūtakam | ūrdhvaṃ trirātrātsnānāttāṃ trirātramupavāsayet" iti || atriḥ -- "ārtavābhiplutā nārī mṛtasūtakinaṃ spṛśet | abhuktvā ca caretkṛcchraṃ bhuktvā tu tryahameva tu" iti || āśaucisparśe snānātprāgrajodarśane mārkaṇḍeyaḥ -- "mṛtasūtakisaṃsparśa ṛtuṃ dṛṣṭvā kathaṃ bhavet | āsnānakālaṃ nāśnīyādbhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret" iti || āsnānakālaparyantaṃ caturthadinaparyantam | madanaratne smṛtyantare -- "aprāyatye samutpanne malavadvasanā yadi | abhiṣekeṇa muktiḥ syāddinatrayamabhojanam" iti || abhiṣekeṇa muktiḥ sadyaḥ snānena bhojanam | idamaśaktāyā bālāpatyāviṣayaṃ vā | śaktāyāstu trirātramupavāsaḥ | bandhumaraṇaśravaṇādau vyāsaḥ -- "malavadvasanāyāstu aprāyatyaṃ bhavedyadi | abhiṣekeṇa śuddhiḥ syādabhuktiśca dinatrayam" iti || atrāpi pūrvavadvyavasthā | dinatrayamityavaśiṣṭakālopalakṣaṇam | aprāyatyaṃ bandhumaraṇādinā | paśvādisparśe kaśyapaḥ -- "spṛṣṭvodakyā pañcanakhāndviśaphaikaśaphānpaśūn | aṇḍajāni ca sarvāṇi anaśaḥ snānavāsarāt" iti || anaśo'naśanam | śvādidaṃśe pulastyaḥ -- "rajasvalā yadā daṣṭā śunā jambūkarāsabhaiḥ | pañcarātraṃ nirāhārā pañcagavyena śudhyati || ūrdhvaṃ tu dviguṇaṃ nābhervaktre tu triguṇaṃ tathā | caturguṇaṃ smṛtaṃ mūrdhni daṃśe'nyatrāśucirbhavet" iti || anyatra rajasvalāvasthāyā iti śeṣaḥ | yatra yatra snānaṃ dinatrayamadhye vihitaṃ tatra pūrvāktena naimittikasnānaprakāreṇa kartavyam | iti rajasvalāyāḥ śuddhivicāraḥ | atha prasaṅgādrajasvalāspṛṣṭacetanācetanānāṃ śuddhiprakāraḥ | tatra cetanānāṃ sacailaṃ snānam | acetanānāṃ pīṭhādīnāṃ prakṣālanam | rajasvalāspṛṣṭacetanasparśa ācamanam | "naro rajasvalāspṛṣṭaḥ sacailaṃ snānamācaret | acetanāṃstayā spṛṣṭānkṣālayecchuddhavāriṇā || udakyāspṛṣṭasaṃsparśe śuddhirācamanena hi" || iti smṛtyantarokteḥ | udakyā rajasvalā | etaccākāmataḥ | kāmatastu -- " divākīrtimudakyāṃ ca patitaṃ sūtikāṃ tathā | śavaṃ tatspṛṣṭinaṃ caiva spṛṣṭvā snānena śudhyati" || iti manūktaṃ snānameva tasyāpi | tṛtīyasyāpyācamanamāha saṃvartaḥ -- "tatsparśinaṃ spṛśedyastu snānaṃ tasya vidhīyate | ūrdhvamācamanaṃ proktaṃ dravyāṇāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tathā" iti || etadapyakāmataḥ | kāmatastu snānameva | tathā ca gautamaḥ -- "caṇḍālasūtikodakyāśavasparśinastatsparśyupasparśane sacailasnānācchudhyet" iti | evaṃ caturthasyāpi | "upaspṛśyāśucispṛṣṭaṃ tṛtīyaṃ cāpi mānavaḥ | hastau pādau ca toyena prakṣālyā''camya śudhyati" iti devalokteḥ | apiśabdātpañcamādīnāmapi grahaṇam | aśuddhasyodakyādisparśe tu sa evā''ha -- "aśuddhaḥ svayamapyetānaśuddhāṃstu yadi spṛśet | sa śudhyatyupavāsena tathā kṛcchreṇa vā punaḥ" iti || smṛtyarthasāre -- "pariveṣaṇe rajodṛṣṭau tatspṛṣṭānnasya tyāgaḥ | annādhāre caṇḍālasūtikodakyādispṛṣṭe rajakādispṛṣṭe ca jale nikṣipyāgnimarkaṃ vā spṛśet" iti | iti rajasvalāspṛṣṭacetanācetanānāṃ śuddhiprakāraḥ | atha prasaṅgātsaṃkṣepeṇa strīdharmāḥ | tatra manuḥ -- "bālyayauvanavatyā vā vṛddhayā vā'pi yoṣitā | na svātantryeṇa kartavyaṃ kiṃcitkāryaṃ gṛheṣvapi || pitrā bhartrā sutenāpi necchedvirahamātmanaḥ | eṣā hi viraheṇa strī garhitā syātkuladvaye || sadā pratiṣṭhayā bhāvyaṃ gṛhakāryeṣu dakṣayā | saṃskṛtopaskaratayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā" iti || manuḥ -- "pitā rakṣati kaumāre bhartā rakṣati yauvane | putro rakṣati vārdhakye na svātantryaṃ kvacitstriyāḥ || sūkṣmebhyo'pi pramādebhyaḥ striyo rakṣyā viśeṣataḥ | dvayorhi kulayoḥ śokamāvaheyurarakṣitāḥ" iti || bhārate -- "yānaṃ durjanasaṃsargaḥ patyā ca viraho'ṭanam | svāpo'nyagehe vāsaśca strīṇāṃ vai dūṣaṇāni ṣaṭ || naitā rūpaṃ parīpsante nā''śaṅkā vayasi sthitiḥ | surūpaṃ vā kurūpaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuñjate || śayyāsanamalaṃkāraṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā''rjavam | drohabhāvaṃ kukāryaṃ ca strībhyo manurakalpayat || na kaścidyoṣitaḥ śaktaḥ prasahya parirakṣitum" iti | strīṇāṃ doṣā apyuktāḥ purāṇe -- "anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ māyā mūrkhatvamatilobhatā | aśucitvaṃ nirdayatvaṃ strīṇāṃ doṣāḥ svabhāvajāḥ" iti || yājñavalkyaḥ -- "saṃskṛtopaskarā dakṣā tdṛṣṭā vyayaparāṅmukhī | kuryācchvaśurayoḥ pādasevanaṃ bhartṛtatparā || strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ kāryameṣa dharmaḥ paraḥ striyāḥ | ā śuddheḥ saṃpratīkṣyo hi mahāpātakadūṣitaḥ" iti || mahāpātakādidūṣito bhartā yāvatparyantaṃ śuddho na bhavati tāvatparyantaṃ saṃgamārthaṃ bhartrā''hūtā'pi na tadvaco'ṅgī kuryādevaṃ bhojane, iti tātparyārthaḥ | manuḥ -- "viśīlaḥ kāmavṛtto vā guṇairvā parivarjitaḥ | upacāraiḥ striyā sādhvyā satataṃ devavatpatiḥ || pūjanīya iti śeṣaḥ | nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣaṇam | śuśrūṣayati bhartāraṃ tena svarge mahīyate || patyau jīvati yā nārī upoṣya vratacāriṇī | āyuṣyaṃ harate bharturnarakaṃ cādhigacchati" iti || ayaṃ copavāsaniṣedho māsopavāsadhāraṇāpāraṇādivratopavāsaparo na tu gauryādivratakuladharmopavāsapara iti nibandhakārāḥ | yuktaṃ caitat | anyathā haritālikādisaubhāgyakārakavratakuladharmopavāsācaraṇocchedāpatteḥ | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "strīdharmiṇī trirātraṃ tu svamukhaṃ naiva darśayet | svavākyaṃ śrāvayennāpi yāvatsnātā na śudhyati | susnātā bhartṛvadanamīkṣennānyasya kasyacit | athavā manasi dhyātvā patiṃ bhānuṃ vilokayet || haridrāṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva sindūraṃ kajjalaṃ tathā | kūrpāsakaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ māṅgalyābharaṇaṃ śubham || kūrpāsakaṃ tālavṛntādi | keśasaṃskārakabarīṃ karakarṇavibhūṣaṇam | bharturāyuṣyamicchantī dūṣayenna kvacitsatī || bhartṛvidveṣiṇīṃ nārīṃ na saṃbhāṣeta karhicit | naikākinī kvacidbhūyānna nagnā snāti vai kvacit || nolūkhale na musale na vardhanyāṃ dṛṣadyapi | na yantrake na dehalyāṃ sā strī copaviśetkvacit || uktā pratyuttaraṃ dadyānnārī krodhena saṃyutā | sā śunī jāyate grāme śṛgālī nirjane vane || ativādo na kartavyaḥ kalahaṃ dūratastyajet | gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau kvāpi na brūyānna ca vai haset || tāḍitā tāḍituṃ cecchetsā vyāghrī dvipadaṃśikā | bhartāraṃ yā samutsṛjya miṣṭamaśnāti kevalam || grāme sā sūkarī vā syācchārdūlī vā purīṣabhuk" iti | yogī -- "krīḍāśarīrasaṃskāraṃ samājotsavadarśanam | hāsyaṃ paragṛhe yānaṃ tyajetproṣitabhartṛkā" iti || devalaḥ -- "patipriyahite yuktā svācārā vijitendriyā | iha kīrtimavāpnoti pretya cāpyuttamāṃ gatim" iti || smṛtyantare -- "tīrthasnānārthinī nārī patipādodakaṃ pibet | śaṃkarādapi viṣṇorvā patirevādhikaḥ striyāḥ" iti || skānde -- "prātaḥkāle tu yā nārī dadyādarghyaṃ vivasvate | saptajanmani vaidhavyaṃ sā nārī naiva paśyati || kṛtvā tu maṇḍalaṃ bāhye sūryaṃ tatrākṣatādibhiḥ | pūjayetsatataṃ yā vai tasyāstuṣyanti devatāḥ || prātaḥkāle tu yā nārī śucirbhūtvā samāhitā | pūjayeddvāradeśaṃ tu sarvānkāmānsamaśnute || na dadāti yadā nārī jyeṣṭhāyai pratyahaṃ balim | bhojyānnena yathāśakti sā pretya narakaṃ vrajet || avaśyameva nārībhirjyeṣṭhāyā balikarmaṇā | prīṇanaṃ pratyahaṃ kāryaṃ putrapautradhanepsubhiḥ" iti || bhārate -- aṭṭaśūlā janapadāḥ śivaśūlāścatuṣpathāḥ | vanitāḥ keśaśūlinyo bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge" iti || asyārthamāha paraśurāmaḥ -- "aṭṭamannaṃ śivo vedaḥ śūlaṃ vikraya eva tu | keśaśca bhagamityāhurvedatattvārthadarśinaḥ" iti || bhaviṣyanti kalau yuga ityanena nindyatvapradarśane tātparyam | evaṃ ca strībhirvyabhicāro varjya iti prakṛtārthaḥ | "bhartā devo gururbhartā dharmatīrthavratāni ca | tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya patimekaṃ samarcayet | patyau bhuṅkte(kte) tu yā bhuṅkte hyāsīnā cāpi cā''site | vinidrite vinidrāti sā strī jñeyā pativratā || ārtā''rte mudite tdṛṣṭā proṣite malinā kṛśā | namrībhūtā yā manasā sā strī jñeyā pativratā" iti || śaṅkhaḥ -- "premṇā na tvaritaṃ vrajenna parapuruṣaṃ saṃbhāṣeta na hāsyaṃ kuryādāgulphādvāsaḥ paridadhyānna stanāvanāvṛtau kuryānna bhartāraṃ tadbandhūnvā dviṣyānna gaṇikādhūrtādibhiḥ sahaikatra tiṣṭhet" iti | anāvṛtāvanācchannau | smṛtyantare -- "bhuṅkte bhukte tu yā patyau tasmiṃstiṣṭhati tiṣṭhati | nidrite ca vinidrāti prathamaṃ paribudhyate || analaṃkṛtamātmānaṃ patyurno darśayetkvacit | kāryārthaṃ proṣite patyau syādalaṃkāravarjitā || na ca tannāma gṛhṇīyāttasyā''yuṣyavivṛddhaye | ākruṣṭā'pi na cā''krośettāḍitā'pi prasīdati || idaṃ kuru kṛtaṃ svāminmanyatāmiti vakti ca | idaṃ kurviti patyokte svāminkṛtameva manyatāmiti yā vakti sā pativratetyarthaḥ | āhūtā gṛhakarmāṇi tyaktvā''gacchati satvaram || āgacchatīti padacchedaḥ | pūjopakaraṇaṃ sarvamapsu saṃśodhayetsvayam | udakaṃ patrapuṣpādi pūjārthaṃ saṃbharetsvayam || seveta bharturucchiṣṭaṃ piṣṭamannaphalādikam | mahāprasāda ityuktvā patidattaṃ pratīcchati" iti || strīśūdradvijabandhūnāṃ vedaśravaṇe'nadhikāraḥ | tathā ca purāṇam -- "strīśūdradvijabandhūnāṃ trayī na śrutigocarā | iti bhāratamākhyātaṃ kṛpayā muninā kṛtam" iti || dvijācchūdrāyāṃ jāto dvijabandhuḥ | yadīyaśravaṇe'nadhikāre kimu vaktavyaṃ paṭhanānadhikāre | sūtasaṃhitāyām -- "anye ca brāhmaṇā viṣṇo rājānaśca tathaiva ca | vaiśyāśca tāratamyena jñānābhyāse'dhikāriṇaḥ || dvijastrīṇāmapi śrautajñānābhyāse'dhikāritā | śūdrāṇāṃ ca viraktānāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ mahāmune || siddhāntaśravaṇaṃ proktaṃ purāṇaśravaṇaṃ budhaiḥ" iti || siddhāntaḥ smṛtyarthaḥ | rāmāyaṇe'pi -- "paṭhandvijo vāgṛṣabhatvamīyātsukṣatriyo bhūpatitāṃ samīyāt | vaṇigjanaḥ puṇyaphalatvamīyācchṛṇvaṃstu śūdro'pi mahattvamīyāt" iti || idamapi vipradvāraiva | taduktaṃ bhaviṣye -- "devārcāṃ purataḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāṃśca nṛpottama | śrotavyameva śūdreṇa tathā'nyaiśca dvijātibhiḥ" iti || smṛtyantare'pi -- "śrāvayeccaturo varṇānkṛtvā brāhmaṇamagrataḥ" iti | purāṇaśravaṇavidhānādeva tadantargatavaidikamantraśravaṇe'pi na doṣaḥ | taduktaṃ vārtike -- "tāneva vaidikānmantrānbhāratādiniveśitān | vihāya mantraniyamaṃ lokabuddhyā prayuñjate" iti || yada(dya)pyadṛṣṭahetutvaṃ na vaidikatvaṃ vinā'sti tena stotrāderapi vede sattvaṃ kalpyate tathā'pi vacanāddoṣābhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca śūdrasya vipradvāreṇa purāṇaśravaṇena jñānamiti | nanvevaṃ śravaṇavidhau śrāvayeccaturo varṇānityukterdvijānāmapi mantraśravaṇameva syānna pāṭha iti cet | atra brūmaḥ -- "adhyetavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vaiśyena kṣatriyeṇa ca | niṣekādiśmaśānāntāḥ" || ityādivacanebhyo'dhyayanasyaiva karmāṅgatvam | śravaṇaṃ tu phalaviśeṣārtham | "ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaścāpi parikīrtayet | nāśubhaṃ prāpnuyātkicitso'mutreha ca mānavaḥ" || ityādau caṇḍīpāṭhādau ca phalaśruteḥ | "ya idaṃ śrāvayedvidvāndvijānparvasu parvasu | aśvamedhaphalaṃ tasya tadbhavānanumanyatām" iti yājñavalkyokteśca | purāṇādhyayanaśravaṇayorvidhāne'pyadhyayanaṃ jñānadvārā karmārthatvāddṛṣṭārthaṃ śravaṇaṃ tvadṛṣṭārthameva | śūdrāṇāṃ tu viparītaṃ śravaṇaṃ jñānadvārā karmārthatvāddṛṣṭārthaṃ phalārthatvādadṛṣṭārthaṃ ca | adhyayanaṃ tu nāstyeva | "śrotavyameva śūdreṇa nādhyetavyaṃ kadācana" iti vacanāt | "sugatimiyācchravaṇāttu śūdrajātiḥ" iti harivaṃśokteśca | etena purāṇaviṣṇusahasranāmacaṇḍīstotrādipāṭhe'dhikāro'pyapāstaḥ | yattu sahasranāmapratipādake stotre -- "vedāntago brāhmaṇaḥ syātkṣatriyo vijayī bhavet | vaiśyo dhanasamṛddhaḥ syācchūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt" || iti vacanaṃ tadapi śravaṇaparameva | āhuśca śrīmacchaṃkarācāryā etadvyākhyāne -- 'śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt' ityatra śūdraḥ śravaṇenaiveti | gaṇapatisahasranāmapratipādake stotre tu -- "sakṛtpāṭhena saṃsiddhaḥ strīśūdrapatitairapi | sahasranāmamantro'yaṃ japitavyaḥ śubhāptaye" || iti vacanādadhikāraḥ | evamanyatrāpi | kiṃ bahunā śūdrakartṛkasnānadānaśrāddhādau dvijasyaiva paurāṇamantrapāṭhaḥ | śūdrasya tu śravaṇamātram | strīṇāmanupanītānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca sthāpane'dhikāro na | "strīṇāmanupanītānāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca nareśvara | sthāpane nādhikāro'sti viṣṇorvā śaṃkarasya vā" || iti vacanāditi kecit | viṣṇvādipratiṣṭhāyāṃ śūdrasya vikalpa ityanye | pūjā ca sparśarahitā | śivapañcākṣarādayo mantrā namontā jñeyāḥ | etanmūlaṃ śūdraprakāśakamalākarādau draṣṭavyam | atra yāni śūdraparāṇi vākyāni tāni strīparāṇyapi jñeyāni | "strī śūdrāśca sadharmāṇaḥ" itivacanāt | iti saṃkṣepeṇa strīdharmāḥ | atha garbhādhānakālaḥ | tatredaṃ dharmasūtram -- "ṛtau ca saṃnipāto dāreṇānuvratam" iti | rajodarśanadinamārabhya ṣoḍaśāhorātraparimita ṛtuḥ | tatra saṃnipātaḥ saṃyogo dāreṇa kartavyaḥ | chāndasamekavacanam | bahuvacanānto hi dāraśabdaḥ | śāstrato niyamo vrataṃ tadanurodhenetyarthaḥ | ṛtudinasaṃkhyāmāha manuḥ -- "ṛtuḥ svābhāvikaḥ strīṇāṃ rātrayaḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ | caturbhiritaraiḥ sārdhamahobhiḥ saha garhitaiḥ | yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyo'yugmāsu rātriṣu | tasmādyugmāsu putrārthī saṃviśedārtave striyam" iti || atra rātrigrahaṇāddivasapratiṣedhaḥ | tathā ca śaṅkhalikhitau -- "nā''rtave'pi divā vrajet" iti | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "ṣoḍaśarturniśāḥ strīṇāṃ tasminyugmāsu saṃviśet | brahmacarye ca parvāṇyādyāścatasro vivarjayet" iti || strīṇāṃ ṣoḍaśa niśā ṛturgarbhagrahaṇayogyaḥ kālaḥ | tatra sarvāsu yugmāsu gamanamāvaśyakaṃ, yugmāsviti bahuvacananirdeśāt | yatra śrāddhādau brahmacaryaṃ vihitaṃ tatrāpyṛtau gacchato na brahmacaryaskhalanadoṣaḥ | parvāṇīti bahutvenāṣṭamīcaturdaśyorgrahaṇamiti vijñāneśvaraḥ | yastu hemādrau śivarahasye -- "divā janmadine caiva na kuryānmaithunaṃ vratī | śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca śreyorthī na ca parvasu" || iti śrāddhadānabhojanadivase strīgamananiṣedhaḥ so'nṛtuviṣayaḥ | darśādau tu na bhavatyeva | parvaṇāṃ paryudastatvāt | "ṛtusnātā bhavennārī caturthe divase tataḥ | ṛtukālastu nirdiṣṭa āṣoḍaśadināvadhi || tatrāyugmadine strī syātpumānyugmadine bhavet" || iti pādmīyaśivagītāsthavacanavyākhyānāvasare vyaṅkaṭadīkṣitāstu -- "yattu ṛtau gacchedeveti niyamasya śrāddhādau brahmacaryavidhānasya ca parasparaparihāreṇa labdhāvakāśasya sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvānāpannasyaikatra prasaktau kiṃ bādhyamiti saṃśaye gacchato'pi na brahmacaryasya bhaṅga ityāśayena brahmacarye ceti mūlamiti vijñāneśvareṇa vyākhyātaṃ taccintyam | 'ṛtukālaniyukto'pi naiva gacchetstriyaṃ kvacit' | iti śrāddhaprakaraṇasthavṛddhamanuvacanavirodhāt | tasmānnā''rtave'pi divā vrajediti śaṅkhalikhitasmṛtiṃ prati mūlatayopanyaste 'prāṇaṃ vā ete praskandanti ye divā ratyāṃ saṃyujyante brahmacaryameva tadyadrātrau saṃyujyante' ityātharvaṇaśrutivākya iva yājñavalkyasmṛtāvapi brahmacaryoktirarthavādarūpeti mādhavācāryaprabhṛtīnāṃ granthā eva prabalāḥ" ityāhuḥ | ṣoḍaśadinarūpo'vadhiḥ ṣoḍaśadināvadhistamabhivyāpyetyāṣoḍaśadināvadhi | tathā ca rajodarśanadinamārabhya ṣoḍaśadinātmaka ṛtukālo nirdiṣṭaḥ | śāstrakārairiti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ sthite nārī caturthadivasa ṛtusnātā bhavet | tataścaturthadivasānantaraṃ tatrartāvayugmadine pañcamādau strī syādyugmadine ṣaṣṭhādau pumānbhavet | yadyapi rajobāhulyādikaṃ strītvādau hetutayoktaṃ tathā'pyayugmāyāṃ rajobāhulye yugmāyāṃ śukrabāhulye ca tāvadavirodha eva | yadā tvayugmāyāṃ śukrabāhulyaṃ tadā tu pumāneva bhavati kiṃtu stryākṛtiḥ | kālarūpanimittakāraṇāpekṣayopādānakāra ṇībhūtasya rajasaḥ prābalyāditi vijñāneśvaraprabhṛtayaḥ | evaṃ yugmāyāṃ rajobāhulye'pi stryeva puruṣākṛtirbhavatītyapi bodhyam | atra ca ṣoḍaśadinātmakamṛtuṃ nirdiśya caturthadivasānantarameva putrādyutpattiṃ vadatā''dyacatuṣṭayaṃ varjyamiti sūcitam | tathā ca yājñavalkyaḥ -- "ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāṃ tasminyugmāsu saṃviśet | brahmacarye ca parvāṇyādyāścatasro vivarjayet" iti || yugmāsvapi pratiṣiddhetarāsveva gacchet | tāścoktā manunā -- "tāsāmādyāścatasrastu nindyā ekādaśī ca yā | trayodaśī ca śeṣāḥ syuḥ praśastā daśa rātrayaḥ" iti || ekādaśītrayodaśyāvṛtorna pakṣasyeti madanapārijāte | yattu -- "caturthyāṃ snātāṃ prayatavastrāmalaṃkṛtāṃ brāhmaṇasaṃbhāṣāmācamyopahvayate" | iti gṛhyoktaṃ caturthyāṃ rātrau gamanaṃ, yaccā''pastamboktaṃ -- "caturthīprabhṛtyāṣoḍaśīmuttarāṃ yugmāṃ prajāniḥśreyasamṛtṛgamanamityupadiśanti" | iti, yacca hārītoktaṃ -- "caturthe'hani snātāyāṃ yugmāsu ca garbhādhānaṃ tadupetaṃ brahmagarbhaṃ saṃdadhāti" | iti, tadrajonivṛttau jñeyam | "snānaṃ rajasvalāyāstu caturthe'hani śasyate | gamyā nivṛtte rajasi nānivṛtte kathaṃcana" ityāpastambokteḥ | "rajasyuparate sādhvī snānena strī rajasvalā" iti manūkteśca | vastutastu svasūtre spaṣṭatayoktasya caturthīgamanasya smṛtyā saṃkoco'tyantānucitaḥ | tathā cānivṛtte'pi rajasi caturthyāṃ gamanaṃ bhavatyevetyayameva kalpaḥ sādhīyān | manuvacane sādhvī gamanārheti mādhavaḥ | evaṃ cānantarokte manuvacane caturthīniṣedho rajonivṛttisadbhāvaparaḥ | anantarokte hārītavacane yugmāsvityanenaiva caturthīgrahaṇe siddhe pṛthagupādānaṃ mukhyatvadyotanārthamiti jñeyam | etadapi rajonivṛttāveva | parvāṇi varjayediti yājñavalkyenoktam | tatra tāni kānītyapekṣāyāṃ brahmapurāṇe -- "caturdaśyaṣṭamī caiva amāvāsyā ca pūrṇimā | parvāṇyetāni rājendra ravisaṃkrāntireva ca || tailastrīmāṃsabhogī ca sarveṣveteṣu vai pumān | viṇmūtrabhojanaṃ nāma prayāti narakaṃ nṛpa" iti || cakārādekādaśyā grahaṇam | eteṣu parvasu | manurapi -- "amāvāsyāmaṣṭamīṃ ca paurṇamāsīṃ caturdaśīm | brahmacārī bhavennityamapyṛtau snātako dvijaḥ" iti || śrutirapi -- "nāmāvāsyāyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca striyamupeyādyadupeyānnirindriyaḥ syāt" iti | yājñavalkyaḥ -- "evaṃ gacchanstriyaṃ kṣāmāṃ maghāṃ mūlaṃ ca varjayet | sustha indau sakṛtputraṃ lakṣaṇyaṃ janayetpumān" iti || kṣāmā kṛśā | etacca kṣāmatvaṃ rajasvalāvratenaiva bhavati | no cedalpasnigdhabhojanādinā kāryaṃ rajaḥkṣayārtham | tathāca bṛhaspatiḥ -- "striyāḥ śukre'dhike strī syātpumānpuṃso'dhike bhavet | tasmācchukravivṛddhyarthaṃ snigdhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ prakalpayet || laghvāhārāṃ striyaṃ kuryādevaṃ saṃjanayetsutam" iti | manuḥ -- "pumānpuṃso'dhike śukre strī bhavatyadhike striyāḥ | same'pumānpuṃstriyau vā kṣīṇe'lpe ca viparyayaḥ" iti || apumānnapuṃsakaḥ | puṃstriyau vā yadi bījavibhāgaḥ | tadāha yamaḥ -- "yadi saṃbhogakāle tu puruṣo rāgamohitaḥ | dvidhā samutsṛjecchrukraṃ yamakaṃ tatra jāyate" iti || kṣīṇe niḥsāre, alpe ca viparyayo garbhāgrahaṇam | maghāṃ mūlaṃ ceti cakāraḥ śāstrāntaroktavarjyanakṣatrāṇāṃ samuccayārthaḥ | susthe śubhasthānasthite | indau candre sakṛdekasyāṃ rātrau na dvistrirvetyarthaḥ | nāradaḥ -- "upavītī yugmatithau na nagnaḥ kāmayetstriyam | putrārthī puruṣastyaktvā parvamūlāhipaitṛkam" iti || putrārthī puruṣa etāni nakṣatrāṇi tyaktvā yugmatithau gacchedityarthaḥ | ahirāśleṣāḥ | paitṛkaṃ maghāḥ | grāhyatithaya uktāḥ śrīdhareṇa -- "ṣaṣṭhyaṣṭamīṃ pañcadaśīṃ caturthīṃ caturdaśīmapyubhayatra hitvā | śeṣāḥ śubhāḥ syustithayo niṣeke vārāḥ śaśāṅkāryasitendujānām" iti || ubhayatra pakṣadvaye | niṣeko garbhādhānam | śaśāṅkaścandraḥ | āryo guruḥ | sitaḥ śukraḥ | indujo budhaḥ | nakṣatrāṇi ratnamālāyām -- "viṣṇuprajeśaravimitrasamīrapauṣṇamūlottarāvaruṇabhāni niṣekakārye | pūjyāni puṣyavasuśītakarāśvicitrādityāśca madhyamaphalā viphalāḥ syuranye(nyāḥ)" iti || viṣṇuḥ śravaṇam | prajeśo rohiṇī | ravirhastaḥ | mitro'nurādhāḥ | samīraḥ svātī | pauṣṇaṃ revatī | mūlaṃ prasiddham | uttarāśabdenottarātrayam | varuṇabhaṃ śatatārakānakṣatram | niṣekakārye garbhādhānakārye, etāni pūjyāni | puṣyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | vasavayāśraviṣṭhāḥ | śītakaro mṛgaśīrṣam | aśvināvaśvinīnakṣatram | citrā prasiddhā ādityaṃ(tye) punarvasū | etāni madhyamaphalāni | anyā avaśiṣṭāstārā viphalā ityarthaḥ | mūlasya vihitapratiṣiddhatvādvikalpa iti kecit | vastutastu mūlasya pūjyatvaṃ cintyameva | vṛddhavasiṣṭhasaṃhitāyām -- "pauṣṇadvaye paitṛbhayāmyasārpaviṣṇudvaye naiva ca janmabheṣu | utpātapāpagrahadūṣiteṣu na kāryamādhānamaniṣṭalagne" iti || aniṣṭalagnāni meṣavṛścikamakarakumbhākhyāni | śravaṇarevatyorvihitapratiṣiddhatvādvikalpaḥ | atra janmatrayamapi varjyam | tathā ca prayogapārijāte bṛhaspatiḥ -- "śrāddhaṃ pitryaṃ cikitsāṃ ca maithunābhyañjane tathā | caulopanayanādīni varjayettu trijanmasu" iti || trijanmāni janmanakṣatraṃ daśamaikonaviṃśe ca | janmanakṣatre(traṃ) tatpūrvottare nakṣatre iti kecit | jyotirvasiṣṭhaḥ -- "upaplave vaidhṛtipātayośca viṣṭyādike pārighapūrvabhāge | saṃdhyāsu parvasvapi mātṛpitrormṛte'hni patnīgamanaṃ vivarjyam" iti || jyautiṣe -- "dineṣu yugmeṣu ca vakṣyamāṇairyogaiḥ sutārthī svasatīmupeyāt | dineṣvayugmeṣu ca kanyakārthī hitvā tu gaṇḍaṃ tithilagnabhāgān" iti || mātāpitrośca śrāddhadivasapūrvadivaso'pi varjya ityuktaṃ muhūrtamārtaṇḍe | etacca guruśukrāstādāvapi kāryam | "utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu sīmanta ṛtujanmanoḥ | surāsurejyayoścaiva mauḍhyadoṣo na vidyate" || iti jyotirnibandhe bhṛgūkteḥ | cakārādaticārādīnāṃ grahaṇam | malamāse'pyetadbhavati | "amāsaṃkrāntiviṣṭyādau prāptakāle'pi nā''caret | garbhādhānādikarmāṇi nādhimāse vivarjayet" iti gargokteḥ | strīṇāmanekatva ṛtuyaugapadye gamanakramamāha devalaḥ -- "yaugapadye tu tīrthasya viprādikramaśo vrajet | rakṣaṇārthamaputrāṃ vā grahaṇakramaśo'pi vā" iti || tīrthamṛtuḥ | tadyogapadye, aputrāṃ prathamaṃ gacchet | sarvāsāmaputratve putravattve vā varṇakrameṇa grahaṇakrameṇa vetyarthaḥ | grahaṇakramaḥ pāṇigrahaṇakramaḥ | tathā ca kaśyapaḥ -- "yaugapadye tu tīrthasya vivāhakramaśo vrajet " iti | ṛtau gamanaṃ śrutāvuktam -- ṛtau bhāryāmupeyāditi | ṛtāvagamane prāyaścittamāha bṛhaspatiḥ -- "āhitāgnirupasthānaṃ na kuryādyastu parvaṇi | ṛtau na gacchedyo bhāryā so'pi kṛcchrārdhamācaret" iti || ṛturatra snānadinamārabhya trayodaśa dināni | pañcamadinamārabhya dvādaśadināni vā | yattu saṃvartaḥ -- "ṛtau nopaiti yo bhāryāṃ niyatāṃ vratacāriṇīm | niyamātikamāttasya prāṇāyāmaśataṃ smṛtam" iti, tadakāmataḥ || etacca samānadeśaviṣayam | "ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati | ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ" iti parāśarokteḥ || saṃnidhāvityuktyā'saṃnihitasya na doṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | devalaḥ -- "yaḥ svadārānṛtusnātānsvasthaḥ sannopagacchati | bhrūṇahatyāmavāpnoti prajā prāptā vinaśyati" iti || svastha iti vacanādasvasthasya na doṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | sūtakādiṣu ṛtāvagacchato na doṣaḥ | tathā ca manuḥ -- "sūtake bandhane vipro havyakavyādivarjitaḥ | nainasā lipyate tadvadṛtāvagamanādapi" iti || enasā pāpena | vyāsaḥ -- "vyādhito bandhanastho vā pravāseṣvatha parvasu | ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ bhrūṇahatyā na yujyate" iti || ṛtukāla ityanantaramagamana iti śeṣaḥ | yo'yamṛtau bhāryāgamananiyamaḥ so'jātaputraṃ pratyeva | 'jāyamāno vai brāhmaṇastribhirṛṇavā jāyate brahmacaryeṇarṣibhyo yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ' itiśrutimūlakatvenāsyopapatteḥ śrutyantarakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt | tathā ca manuḥ -- "jyeṣṭhena jātamātreṇa putrī bhavati mānavaḥ | pitṝṇāmanṛṇaścaiva sa tasmātsarvamarhati" iti || kūrmapurāṇamapi -- "ṛtukālābhigāmī syādyāvatputro'bhijāyate" iti || evaṃ caikaputrotpādanena śāstrārthasya kṛtatvādānṛṇye ca jāte na putrāntarotpādanamāvaśyakam, iti | kecittu ṛtornimittatvātpratinimittaṃ naimittikyāvṛttirucitā | smaranti ca -- "eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyeko'pi gayāṃ vrajet" [iti] ityāhuḥ | ṛtukāle bhāryāyā api bhartāraṃ prati gamanaṃ niyatamanyathā doṣaḥ | tathā ca saṃgrahe -- "ṛtusnātā tu yā nārī bhartāraṃ nānumanyate | sā mṛtā tu bhavennārī sūkarī ca punaḥ punaḥ" iti || yamo'pi -- "ṛtusnātā tu yā nārī bhartāraṃ nopagacchati | tāṃ grāmamadhye vikhyāpya bhrūṇaghnīmiti vāsayet" iti || bhrūṇaghnīyamiti tāṃ striyaṃ grāmamadhye vikhyāpya prakaṭīkṛtya pṛthagvāsayedityuttarārdhārthaḥ | atrāpi saṃnidhāviti jñeyam | prāyaścittaṃ tu pūrvoktameva jñeyam | vyādhitādīnāṃ strīṇāmapi bhartāraṃ pratyṛtāvagamane na doṣaḥ | anantarodāhṛtavyāsavākye puṃliṅgasyāvivakṣitatvāt | anṛtāvapi gamanamāha śrutiḥ -- "tā abruvanvaraṃ vṛṇāmahā ṛtviyātprajāṃ vindāmahai kāmamāvijanitoḥ saṃbhavāmeti tasmādṛtviyātstriyaḥ prajāṃ vindante kāmamāvijanitoḥ saṃbhavanti vāre vṛta hyāsām" iti | ṛtviyādṛtukālikātpuruṣasaṃbandhāt | āvijanitoḥ prasūtiparyantam | saṃbhavanti mithunī bhavanti | dharmasūtre'pi -- "a ntarāle'pi dāra eva brāhmaṇavacanādvā saṃveśanam" iti | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "yathākāmī bhavedvā'pi strīṇāṃ varamanusmaran | svadāranirataścaiva striyo rakṣyā yataḥ smṛtāḥ" iti || varamindradattavaram | bṛhaspatirapi -- "ṛtukālābhigamanaṃ puṃbhiḥ kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ | sadaiva vā parvavarjyaṃ strīṇāmabhimataṃ hi tat" iti || viṣṇupurāṇe'pi -- "iti matvā svadāreṣu ṛtumatsu naro vrajet | yathoktadoṣahīneṣu sakāmeṣvanṛtāvapi" iti || yastu -- "ṛtau nopaiti yo bhāryāmanṛtau yaśca gacchati | tulyamāhustayoḥ pāpamayonau yaśca siñcati" || iti baudhāyanenānṛtau gamananiṣedha uktaḥ sa striyāḥ kāmābhāve jñeyaḥ | kāsāṃcinniṣedhamāha vyāsaḥ -- "nāsnātāṃ tu striyaṃ gacchennā''turāṃ na rajasvalām | nāniṣṭāṃ na prakupitāṃ nāpraśastāṃ na garbhiṇīm || vṛddhāṃ vandhyāmasadvṛttāṃ mṛtāpatyāmapuṣpiṇīm | bahuputravatīṃ caiva gamane parivarjayet" iti || chadmavattvādidoṣarahitā praśastā | na praśastā'praśastā tāṃ varjayedityarthaḥ | vṛddhāṃ sarajaskāmapi aśaktāṃ garbhadhāraṇe | puṣpiṇī, ṛtumatī | tadanyā'puṣpiṇī | aprāptārtavā gatārtavā ca gamane'nena niṣidhyate | bahuputravatīmityatra bahuputraśabdenaikādaśaprabhṛtireva saṃkhyā grāhyā | "daśāsyāṃ putrānādhehi" iti liṅgāt | ṛtuviśeṣeṇa saṃbhoganiyamaḥ kāmaśāstre -- "pakṣānnidāghe hemante nityamanyartuṣu tryahāt | striyaṃ kāmayamānasya jāyate na balakṣayaḥ" iti || yattu vāgbhaṭṭīye -- " tryahādvasantaśaradoḥ pakṣādvarṣanidāghayoḥ | seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ hemante śiśire balī" || ityuktaṃ, tatra balītyabhidhānena dṛṣṭārthatvokteryathābalaṃ vyavasthā | ratideśamāha paiṭhīnasiḥ -- "saṃvṛtte deśe maithunāyā''hvayīta" iti | saṃvṛtte pariśrite | deśaviśeṣaniṣedho viṣṇupurāṇe -- "devadvijagurūṇāṃ ca vyavāyī nā''śrame bhavet | caityacatvarasīreṣu na caiva ca catuṣpathe" iti || devadvijagurūṇāmāśrame vyavāyī na bhavedityanvayaḥ | vyavāyo maithunaṃ tadasyāstīti vyavāyī | ratisamaye dīpasāṃnidhyamuktaṃ ratiprakāśe -- "dīpasamīpe ratiṃ kuryāt" iti | jyotirnibandhe -- "dīpe'pradīpte yaḥ saṅgaṃ karoti manujo yadi | yāvajjanma daridratvaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ" iti || ayaṃ ca dīpo bhāryayaiva prajvālanīyaḥ | taduktaṃ tatraiva -- "bhāryaiva dīpaṃ prajvālya patyuścittānuvartinī | namaskṛtya tu bhartāraṃ ramayetsaha tena tu" iti || dīpe śalākāṃ prajvālya tena dīpaprajvālanaṃ kāryaṃ na tu sākṣāddīpe | "dīpena dīpaṃ prajvālya daridrī(dro) vyādhimānbhavet" | iti laiṅge doṣasyokteḥ | dīpalopanaṃ puruṣasya niṣiddham | "dīpapralopanaṃ puṃsāṃ kūśmāṇḍacchedanaṃ striyāḥ | acireṇaiva kālena vaṃśacchedo bhaveddhruvam" iti vacanāt || etacca sārvatrikaṃ draṣṭavyam | jyotirnibandhe | (ācāraprakāśe smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "kañcukotthena marutā dīpaṃ naiva nivārayet | ānanotthena vātena hastasaṃjātavāyunā || visṛjeti samuccārya lopayeddīpamañcalāt | tāvacca tūṣṇīṃ sthātavyaṃ yāvaccheṣaḥ praśāmyati" iti || visṛjetyatra dīpaḥ saṃbodhyaḥ | he dīpa visṛja jyotiriti visṛjetyasyārthaḥ | añcalādañcalena | śeṣo dīpaśeṣaḥ |) "pradoṣakāle yā nārī patisaṅgaṃ samācaret | āyuṣyaṃ harate bhartuḥ sā nārī narakaṃ vrajet || pādo lagnatanuścaiva ucchiṣṭaṃ tāḍanaṃ tathā | kopaṃ(po) roṣaṃ ca(paśca) nirbhartsaṃ(rtsaḥ) saṃyoge na ca doṣabhāk || kañcukena samaṃ nārī bhartuḥ saṅgaṃ samācaret | tribhirvaṣaiśca madhye vā vidhavā bhavati dhruvam || tāḍapatramilatkarṇā yadi maithunamācaret | pañcame saptame varṣe vaidhavyamiha jāyate || kāmātureṇa patinā saṃyoge yadi yācitā | nivārayati taṃ nārī bālaraṇḍā bhavetsadā || (ṛtusnātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati | ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati ||) kuṅkumaṃ cāñjanaṃ caiva tāmbūlaṃ sinduraṃ tathā | dhautavastraṃ ca kusumaṃ saṃyoge ca śubhāvaham || namaskṛtvā(tya) bhartṛpādau paścācchayyāṃ samāviśet | nārī sukhamavāpnoti na cedduḥkhasya bhāginī || galattāmbūlavadanāṃ nagnāmākrandarodanām | durmukhāṃ(khīṃ) ca kṣudhāyuktāṃ saṃyoge parivarjayet || bhartrucchiṣṭaṃ sadā bhojyamannaṃ tāmbūlameva ca | ucchiṣṭaṃ na tu bhuñjīta gṛhastho hyadharaṃ vinā || dīpenā''tmatanucchāyāṃ bhartuścopari cettyajet | tau daṃpatī daridratvamāpnuvītāṃ viniścitam" iti || snāne taduttaraṃ ca viśeṣa uktaḥ smṛtisaṃgrahe -- "koṣṇena vāriṇā snāyātsnātā''dau ravimīkṣayet | tato bhartā prekṣitavyaḥ kuryāttenaiva bhāṣaṇam" iti || ṛtugamane viśeṣo gṛhyasūtre -- "caturthyā snātāṃ prayatavastrāmalaṃkṛtāṃ brāhmaṇasaṃbhāṣāmācamyopahvayate" iti | snātāṃ kṛtasnānām | prayatavastrāṃ śuddhavastrām | alaṃkṛtāṃ gandhālaṃkārairbhūṣitām | brāhmaṇasaṃbhāṣāmakauṭilabrāhmaṇena samyagbhāṣā bhāṣaṇaṃ yasyāḥ sā tām | etādṛśīṃ striyamācamanaṃ kṛtvā samīpamāhvayata ityarthaḥ | (jyotirgranthe -- "tāmbūlamādau carvitvā bhāryāsaṅgaṃ samācaret " iti | śaunakīye -- "ekapūgaṃ sadā śreṣṭhaṃ dvipūgaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet | atiśreṣṭhaṃ tripūgaṃ ca adhikaṃ naiva dṛśyate || dvātriṃśatparṇakaṃ caiva dadyātsarvamahībhuje | caturviṃśatiparṇaṃ ca sāmantānāmudāhṛtam || daśāṣṭaparṇakaṃ jñeyaṃ jāmātṝṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ | dvādaśaparṇaṃ viduṣe bandhūnāṃ daśaparṇakam || aṣṭaparṇaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ sāmānyaṃ turyaparṇakam | triparṇaṃ tu na dātavyamekaparṇaṃ tathaiva ca || ṣaṭparṇaṃ tu pradātavyaṃ ripūṇāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ | ekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaḍbhiḥ pūgaiḥ phalaṃ kramāt || parṇamūle bhavedvyādhiḥ parṇāgre pāpasaṃbhavaḥ | cūrṇaparṇaṃ haratyāyuḥ śirā buddhivināśinī || ūrdhvāgraṃ vikaṭaṃ dhāryaṃ parṇamekaṃ tathaiva ca | aṅguṣṭhacūrṇalepaṃ ca carci(rvi)taṃ dhanadāyakam || anidhāya mukhe parṇaṃ pūgaṃ khādati yo naraḥ | sadā janmadaridrī(draḥ) syādante na smarate harim || tarjanyā cūrṇamādāya tāmbūlaṃ na tu khādayet | yadi vā khādayenmūḍho rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || kaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhyātarjanyaṅguṣṭhayogataḥ | śoko hānistathā mṛtyuranaiśvaryāyuṣī kramāt || aṅguṣṭhena tu lepena sarvasiddhipradāyakam | jayastrīvastralābhādi bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || vāmahastena khādenna strīhastema tathaiva ca | yadi vā khādayenmūḍhastasya lakṣmīrvinaśyati || divā khadirasāreṇa tāmbūlaṃ tu suśobhitam | rātrau khadirasāreṇa śakrasyāpi śriyaṃ haret || prātaḥkāle phalādhikyaṃ cūrṇādhikyaṃ tu madhyataḥ | niśi parṇādhikaṃ bhakṣettasya lakṣmīrvivardhate || kramukasāraṃ trivāraṃ dvivāraṃ parṇasārakam | khādireṇa sahaikaṃ ca utkṣipetsarvadā budhaḥ" iti ||) saṃbhogakāle striyamakañcukāṃ kṛtvā bhogaṃ kuryāt | "sakañcukaratiṃ kṛtvā sacailaṃ snānamācaret" iti ratiprakāśe prāyaścittaśravaṇāt | maithunakāle tarjanyāṃ raupyaṃ cettatparityājyaṃ śikhā ca visarjanīyā | "tarjanīṃ raupyasaṃyuktāṃ brahmagranthiyutāṃ śikhām | bhojane maithune mūtre kurvankṛcchreṇa śudhyati" iti saṃgrahe prāyaścittaśravaṇāt | saṃbhogottarakṛtyaṃ dharmasūtre -- "udakopasparśanam" iti | udakopasparśanaṃ snānam | etaccartukāla iti vyākhyātamujjvalākṛtā | parāśaro'pi -- "ṛtau tu garbhaśaṅkitvātsnānaṃ maithuninaḥ smṛtam" iti | etacca snānamaśiraskam | ṛtugamananimittakasnānaṃ prakṛtya -- "aśiraskameva majjanaṃ kuryāt" iti bṛhadvasiṣṭhokteḥ | anṛtau tu dharmasūtre -- "lepānprakṣālya pādau cā''camya prokṣaṇamaṅgānām" iti | parāśaro'pi -- "anṛtau tu yadā gacchecchaucaṃ mūtrapurīṣavat" iti | strīṇāṃ tu na snānapādaprakṣālane | tāsāmaśucitvābhāvāt | tathā ca vṛddhaśātātapaḥ -- "umāvapyaśucī syātāṃ daṃpatī śayanaṃ gatau | śayanādutthitā nārī śuciḥ syādaśuciḥ pumān" iti | garbhotpattāvāhātriḥ -- "ṣaṇmāsānkāmayenmartyo garbhiṇīṃ striyameva hi | ādantajananādūrdhvamevaṃ dharmo na hīyate" iti || evakāraḥ ṣaṇmāsānityanantaramanveti | na caivaṃ 'kāmamāvijanitoḥ saṃbhavanti' ityanayā śrutyā prasavaparyantaṃ gamanasyābhyanujñātatvādanena virodha iti vācyam | tatra prasavāparaparyāyavijananaśabdena 'ata ūrdhvaṃ prasūtiḥ syāt' iti pāribhāṣikasyaiva vijananasya grahaṇānna virodhaḥ | ādantajananādūrdhvaṃ bālake jāte tasya dantajananādūrdhvaṃ gacchenna tu tataḥ pūrvamityarthaḥ | mātsyakaśyapābhyāṃ varṣadvādaśakādūrdhvamṛtoraprāptāvapi gamanamuktam -- "varṣadvādaśakādūrdhvaṃ yadi puṣpaṃ bahirnahi | antaḥ puṣpaṃ bhavatyeva panasodumbarādivat || atastatra prakurvīta strīsaṅgaṃ buddhimānnaraḥ" iti || varṣadvādaśakāditiśravaṇādarthātpūrvaṃ gamanaṃ niṣiddhamiti jñeyam | caturthīkarmasaṃbandhigamanaṃ tu bhavatyeva tasya vaidhatvāt | āśvalāyanaḥ -- "dīkṣitastu mahāyajñe pitroḥ prāgvatsarāddvijaḥ | neyādbhāryāṃ prayatnena ṛtāvapyarthito budhaḥ" iti || neyānna gacchet | arthitaḥ prārthitaḥ | bhogārthaṃ bhāryayeti śeṣaḥ | "prāgrajodarśanātpatnīṃ neyādgatvā patatyadhaḥ | vyarthīkāreṇa śukrasya brahmahatyāmavāpnuyāt" || iti dakṣāśvalāyanābhyāṃ niṣedha uktaḥ sa bahvṛcādiviṣayaḥ | taittirīyaistu rāgaprāptau gamanaṃ kāryameveti sudarśanaḥ | trirātramadhye rajasvalāgamane prāyaścittamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "trirātrānte ghṛtaṃ prāśya gatvodakyāṃ viśudhyati" iti | trirātrānta upavāsatrayānta ityarthaḥ | "rajasvalāṃ tu yo gacchedupavāsatrayaṃ caret | gavāṃ ghṛtaṃ samaśnīyāttataḥ pāpātsa mucyate" iti marīcyukteḥ || sa rajasvalāgāmī | etaccākāmataḥ | kāmatastvāha saṃvartaḥ -- "rajasvalāṃ tu yo gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ patitāṃ tathā | tasya pāpaviśuddhyarthamatikṛcchraṃ viśodhanam" iti || ayaṃ ca garbhiṇīgamananiṣedho'nantarodāhṛtātrivākyānurodhena saptamamāsamārabhyaiva pravartate | garbhādhānākaraṇe prāyaścittamāhā''śvalāyanaḥ -- "garbhādhānasyākaraṇāttasyāṃ jātastu duṣyati | akṛtvā gāṃ dvije dattvā kuryātpuṃsavanaṃ patiḥ" iti || akṛtvetyanantaramapiśabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | "prāyaścitte kṛte paścādatītamapi karma vai | kāryamityeka ācāryā netyanye tu vipaścitaḥ" || iti vacanasaṃvādāt | gāṃ dvijāya dattvā'kṛtvā'pi garbhādhānaṃ patiḥ puṃsavanaṃ kuryādityuttarārdhārthaḥ | etacca prāyaścittaṃ kevalasya garbhādhānasya mukhyakālānatikrāntena kevalena puṃsavanena saha kriyāyāṃ, mukhyakālātikrāntena puṃsavanena saha kriyāyāṃ tu pūrvoktaṃ kṛcchrātmakaṃ jñeyam | athavobhayatrāpi samuccayaḥ | etacca garbhādhānaṃ māsādiśubhāśubhaphalāni vicārya svalpe doṣe pūrvaṃ śāntiṃ kṛtvā śubhe muhūrte kartavyameva na tu śubhakālikatvāpekṣā | prabhūtadoṣe tu prathamartau śāntimeva kṛtvā'gre śubhakālika ṛtau prāpte kāryam | tathā ca jyotirvasiṣṭhaḥ -- "prabhūtadoṣaṃ yadi dṛśyate tatpuṣpaṃ tataḥ śāntikakarma kāryam | vivarjayeccaiva tathaikaśayyāṃ yāvadrajodarśanamuttame'hni" iti || ṛtau prabhūtadoṣatvaṃ nāmānekadoṣavattvaṃ mahādoṣavattvaṃ veti draṣṭavyam | mahādoṣāstu vaidhavyapradatvakuṭilatvasaṃtatināśakatvādirūpāḥ | jyotiṣkaśyapo'pi -- "tithivāsaradhiṣṇyeṣu puṣpaṃ duṣṭeṣu dṛśyate | gamanaṃ varjayettatra punaḥ śasteṣu darśanāt" iti || atra prabhūtadoṣe śubhakālikatvāpekṣāyā vidhānādaprabhūtadoṣe tasminnevartau śāntikarmottaraṃ garbhādhānānuṣṭhānamabhyanujñātaṃ bhavati | tacchāntikarma śāntiratnamālāyāṃ draṣṭavyam | atha garbhādhānaprayogaḥ | tatra rajodarśane sati trirātraṃ rajasvalā strī, yuñjāmyavimocanāya" iti surataṃ karoti | "oṃ cākravāka saṃvananaṃ yannadībhya udāhṛtam | yadyukto devagandharvastena saṃvaninau svake" iti mukhamīpsate | "oṃ bhūḥ prajāpatinā'tyṛṣabheṇa skandayāmi vīraṃ dhatsvāsau" | "oṃ bhuvaḥ prajāpatinā'tyṛṣabheṇa skandayāmi vīraṃ dhatsvāsau" || "oṃ suvaḥ prajāpatinā'tyṛṣabheṇa skandayāmi vīraṃ dhatsvāsau" ityetaiḥ pratimantraṃ reto'vaskandayet | adhikaṃ cettūṣṇīmevāvaskandanīyam | eteṣu mantreṣvasāvitipadaṃ niṣkāśya tatra bhāryāyāḥ saṃbuddhyā dāntaṃ nāma grāhyam | yathā'mukada iti | nānāvidhasurataprakārāstu pañcasāyakādikāmaśāstragranthebhyo draṣṭavyāḥ | yadi kāmayeta svīrityaṅgulīritivacanātstrīṇāmeva jananāyopagamanaṃ cettadā liṅgavirodhādvākyaśeṣavirodhācca mantrābhāva ityeke | anye tu jātinirdeśātpuṃliṅgasyāvivakṣitatvādduhitṛputrādipuṃjananasya vidyamānatvādvā liṅgārthavādāvirodhānna mantrābhāva ityāhuḥ | tato yajñopavītyaśiraskaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā niṣkāśitaṃ tarjanīdhṛtaṃ raupyaṃ punastarjanyāṃ dhṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā paurāṇācamanaprāṇāyāmau kṛtvā viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | ṛtuvyatiriktakāle gamane tu pādaprakṣālanāṅgaprokṣaṇe eva na snānam | lepaprakṣālanaṃ tvatrāpi | tataḥ pṛthakśayanau bhavataḥ | bhāryāyāstūbhayatrāpyaśucitā naivāsti | ṛtuvyatiriktakāle svecchāto na gacchet | strīcchayā gacchaṃstu naiva duṣyati | tataḥ śvobhūte nityanirvartanānantaraṃ brāhmaṇebhyo bhūyasīṃ dattvā devatā visṛjya brāhmaṇānbhojayet | anyadapi kulācāraprāptaṃ cettatsarvaṃ kartavyam | nāndīśrāddhottaraṃ vā devatāvisarjanam | brāhmaṇabhojanabhūyasīdānādikaṃ tu dvitīyadina eva | pradhānātpūrvametatkaraṇasyātyantaviruddhatvādeteṣāṃ pradhānottarāṅgatvasyaiva sarvatra dṛṣṭatvāt | sarvāṇyupagamanāni samantrāṇi bhavantītyātreyo munirmanyate | pratipradhānaṃ guṇāvṛttiriti tadāśayaḥ | bādarāyaṇastu yadvivāhottaraṃ caturthyāṃ rājyāmupagamanaṃ yacca rajodarśanottaraṃ caturthyādiṣūpagamanaṃ tadeva samantrakaṃ nānyaditi manyate | prathamasya strīsaṃskārārthatvāddvitīyasya garbhādhānārthatvādityāśayaḥ | yadi daivāccaturthīkarma na kṛtamṛtuśca prāptastadā pūrvakṛcchrātmakaprāyaścittapūrvakaṃ caturthīkarma kṛtvā'nantaraṃ garbhādhānasaṃskāraḥ kartavyaḥ | duṣṭamāsādau prathamarajodarśane tāmbūlabhakṣaṇādimaṅgalācāraṃ na kuryāt | dvitīyādau śubhaśāntipūrvakaṃ kuryāditi kecit | prathame duṣṭarajodarśane dvitīyaṃ pratīkṣet(ta)| tasminnapyaśubhe vistāreṇa śāntiṃ kuryādityapyanye | prathama eva yathāśakti śāntiṃ caret | dvitīyādāvapyaśubhe vistāreṇa śāntiṃ kṛtvā maṅgalācāraṃ garbhādhānaṃ ca kuryādityapare | tṛtīye'pi duṣṭe'tivistāreṇa śāntiṃ kṛtvā garbhādhānaṃ kuryāt | na tu prathamadvitīyayoḥ śāntiṃ kṛtvā'pīti bahavaḥ | tatra yuktaṃ grāhyam | atraikasminnapyaśubhe prabhūte doṣe vakṣyamāṇā śāntiḥ kāryā | dvitrādyaśubhasaṃnipāte tu tatsūcitabahvaśubhanirāsārthavakṣyamāṇāhutisaṃkhyāvivṛddhyā kāryā yathāśaktītyādi jñeyam | iti garbhādhānaprayogaḥ | evaṃ kṛte'pi garbhādhāne yadā garbho notpadyate tadā pratibandhakībhūtapretanivṛttyarthaṃ nārāyaṇabalināgabalī kāryau | tatra yadyapi baudhāyanasūtrasyaiva yajurvedināmabhyarhitatvena grāhyatvaṃ tathā'pi nāgabalisūtrasyedānīmatrānupalambhādbāhvṛca eva nāgabaliprayogaḥ pradarśyate | baudhāyanoktanārāyaṇabalividhisattve'pi saṃniyogaśiṣṭatvādbāhvṛca evocyate | (baudhāyanasūtroktarītyā kriyamāṇe tvardhajaratīyanyāya āpadyeteti |) atha nārāyaṇabaligṛhyapariśiṣṭam -- "atha nārāyaṇabalirarvāksaṃvatsarācchuddhe kāle śuklaikādaśyāṃ snātaḥ śucau deśe viṣṇuṃ vaivasvataṃ yamaṃ ca yathāvadabhyarcya tadagre tilamiśrānmadhughṛtaplu tāndaśa piṇḍānviṣṇurūpaṃ pretaṃ dhyāyankāśyapagotrāsau viṣṇudaivatāyaṃ te piṇḍa iti dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ prācīnāvītī parācīnena pāṇinā dattvā piṇḍānarghyādibhirabhyarcya pravāhaṇāntaṃ kṛtvā nadyāṃ kṣipet, atha rātrāvayugmānbrāhmaṇānnimantryopoṣitaḥ śvo madhyaṃdine viṣṇumabhyarcya pretamuddiśya brāhmaṇānekoddiṣṭavidhinā bhojayitvā tṛpteṣu brāhmaṇasamīpe piṇḍavidhinā ninayanāntaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kṛtvā viṣṇave brahmaṇe śivāya saparivārāya yamāya ca viṣṇo ayaṃ te piṇḍa ityevaṃ caturaḥ piṇḍānbhaktaśeṣeṇa dakṣiṇasaṃsthaṃ datvā'tha pañcamaṃ kāśyapagotra devadatteti pretaṃ dhyātvā tadrūpāya viṣṇo ayaṃ ta iti dadyādathā''cāntāndakṣiṇayā saṃtoṣyaikaṃ teṣu guṇavantaṃ viśeṣato vastrābharaṇagohiraṇyaiḥ pretabuddhyā toṣayedatha taiḥ pavitrapāṇibhiḥ pretāya kāśyapagotrāya te tilodakāñjaliriti tilodakaṃ dāpayitvā'nena nārāyaṇabalikarmaṇā bhagavānviṣṇurimaṃ devadattaṃ śuddhamapāpamarhaṃ karotviti vācayitvā visṛjedeṣa nārāyaṇabalikalpa evamanyāmapi svābhimatadevatāṃ yamadvitīyāyāmabhyarcya vidhimimaṃ kuryātso'pyenamapāpaṃ karoti na tu puṇyakṛto'pi balimenamakṛtvā pāralaukikaṃ kuryātkṛtaṃ nopatiṣṭhate'ntarikṣe vinaśyati tasmādyathāsaṃbhavamapi kuryāt" iti | devadatteti tattannāmna upalakṣaṇam | pretasya nāmājñāne kāśyapagotra viṣṇurūpa pretetyevaṃ dhyānam | atha prayogaḥ | kartā śuklaikādaśyāṃ nadītīrādiśucau deśe snānādinityakriyānta ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya madīyakulābhivṛddhipratibandhakapretasya pretatvanivṛttyarthaṃ nārāyaṇabaliṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya kalaśasthāpanavidhinā sthāpitakalaśadvaye suvarṇanirmitapratimayorviṣṇumāvāhayāmi vaivasvataṃ yamamāvāhayāmīti krameṇā''vāhya puruṣasūktena yamāya somamiti ca krameṇa ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya tatpūrvabhāge rekhāyāṃ dakṣiṇāgrakuśāstaraṇānte śundhatāṃ viṣṇurūpī preta iti daśasu sthāneṣu dakṣiṇasaṃsthamapo ninīyaṃ tatra madhughṛtaplutāndaśa piḍānsatilānkāśyapa gotrāmukapreta viṣṇudaivatāyaṃ te piṇḍa iti dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ prācīnāvītī dakṣiṇāgreṣu kuśeṣu parācīnena pāṇinā savyaṃ jānvācya viṣṇurūpaṃ pretaṃ dhyāyandadyāt | tato gandhādibhirabhyarcya pravāhaṇāntaṃ kṛtvā nadyādau kṣipet | tasyāmeva rātrau śvaḥ kariṣyamāṇaśrāddhe kṣaṇaḥ kriyatāmityevaṃ pañca trīnekaṃ vetyevamayugmānbrāhmaṇāñśrāddhoddeśena nimantryopoṣaṇaṃ kuryāt | śvobhūte madhyāhne viṣṇumabhyarcya pretaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇamuddiśyaikoddiṣṭavidhinā pādaprakṣālanāditṛptipraśnāntaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇasamīpe piṇḍapitṛyajñavadullekhanādyudakaninayanāntaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kṛtvā viṣṇave brahmaṇe śivāya saparivārāya yamāya ca nāmamantraiścaturaḥ piṇḍāndattvā viṣṇo ayaṃ te piṇḍa iti viṣṇurūpaṃ pretaṃ dhyāyanpañcamaṃ piṇḍaṃ dattvā'rcanādipravāhaṇāntaṃ tūṣṇīṃ kṛtvā''cāntānbrāhmaṇāndakṣiṇayā saṃtoṣya teṣvekasmai guṇavate pretabuddhyā vastrābharaṇagohiraṇyādi dattvā, ekapakṣe tasmā eva dattvā, bhavantaḥ pretāya tilodakāñjalidānaṃ kurvantviti vadet | te ca pavitrapāṇayaḥ sakuśatulasīpatratoyāñjaliṃ pretāya kāśyapagotrāyāmukaśarmaṇe viṣṇurūpiṇe'yaṃ tilatoyāñjaliriti dadyuḥ | tato brāhmaṇānvācayet, anena nārāyaṇabalikarmaṇā bhagavānviṣṇurimaṃ pretaṃ śuddhamapāpamarhaṃ karotviti | tato viprāstathā'stviti pratyūcuḥ (pratibrūyuḥ)| tataḥ kartā snātvā bhuñjīteti | iti nārāyaṇabaliprayogaḥ | atha nāgabaliḥ | tatra śaunakaḥ -- "atha vakṣyāmi sarvasya saṃskāravidhimuttamam | sinīvālyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ kārayedvidhivattataḥ || pañcamyāmathavā kuryādāśleṣāsu dine'tha vā | kṛtasarpavadho vipraḥ pūrvajanmani vā yadi || snātvā''gatya tato brahmadaṇḍaṃ dadyāddvijātaye | vadhaṃ prakhyāpayeccāpi caretkṛcchrāṃścaturdaśa || vadhe'smiñjanmani kṛte lohadaṇḍaṃ dvijātaye | dadyātpāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ śrotriyāya kuṭumbine || viprāya daṇḍamūlyaṃ vā hyabhāve sati dāpayet | sākṣādvadhātkarmakarturetadeva pradāpayet || niṣkatrayaṃ dviniṣkaṃ vā niṣkamekaṃ kanīyasam | anumatyādikartṝṇāṃ niṣkamardhaṃ tadardhakam || vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta dadyādvittānusārataḥ | anujñāṃ ca gurorlabdhvā saṃskuryāttadanantaram || priyaṃguvrīhigodhūmatilapiṣṭena vaikataḥ | ekata etadanyatamenaikena piṣṭena vetyarthaḥ | kṛtvā sarpākṛtiṃ tena navaśūrpe nidhāya ca | anena vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa prārthayedahim || ehi pūrvaṃ mṛtaḥ sarpa asminpiṣṭe samāviśa | saṃskārārthamahaṃ bhaktyā prārthayāmi samāhitaḥ || vastropavītagandhādyairakṣataiḥ kusumādibhiḥ | kartā puṣpāñjaliṃ dattvā praṇipatya haredbahiḥ || prakṣālitāṅghripāṇistu hyācamyopaviśedbhuvi | kuryātsaṃskārasaṃkalpaṃ prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaram || yajñopavītinā kāryaṃ sarpasaṃskārakarma tu | laukikāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya samidādhānamācaret || tato'gneragnidigbhāge bhūmiṃ saṃprokṣya vāribhiḥ | citiṃ kṛtvā'tha saṃstīrya kuśairāgneyakāgrakaiḥ || paryukṣyāgniṃ paristīrya pariṣicya samarcayet | kṛtvedhmādhānaparyantaṃ ṣaṭpātrāsādanādikam || āghārau cakṣuṣī hutvā sarpiṣā'tha yathāvidhi | sarpaṃ gṛhītvā yatnena citimāropayetsudhīḥ || apaḥ spṛṣṭvā spṛśecchrotre gatvā cāgnisamīpataḥ | sruveṇa juhuyādājyamagnau vyāhṛtibhistribhiḥ || sarpāsye juhuyādājyaṃ vyāhṛtyā tu samastayā | ājyaśeṣaṃ sruveṇaiva sarpadehe niṣecayet || samastābhirvyātdṛtibhiḥ pāṇinā camasodakaiḥ | tamabhyukṣyāgne rakṣeti citāvagniṃ samarpayet || sruvaṃ tatra nidhāyātha yajñapātrāṇi barhiṣā | citiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇipatya kṣamāpayet | upatiṣṭheddahyamānaṃ namo'stu sarpamantrataḥ || jñānato'jñānato vā'pi kṛtaḥ sarpavadho mayā | pūrvajanmani vā sarpa tatsarvaṃ tvaṃ kṣamasva me || iti saṃprārthya nāgendraṃ snātvā''gatya punaḥ punaḥ | kṣīrājyena tataścāgniṃ prokṣya vyāhṛtibhistribhiḥ || hute sarpe jalenāgnimabhiṣiñcettataḥ param | nāsthisaṃcayanaṃ kuryātsnātvā''camya gṛhaṃ vrajet || brahmacaryādikaṃ kāryaṃ trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate | caturthe'hani saṃprāpte sacailaṃ snānamācaret || ghṛtapāyasabhakṣyaiśca dvijānaṣṭau tu bhojayet | kartā nāmapadairviprānarcayedvakṣyamāṇakaiḥ || sarpo'nantastathā śeṣaḥ kapilo nāga eva ca | kālikaḥ śaṅkhapālaśca bhūdharaśca prakīrtitaḥ || pādaprakṣālanaṃ kuryādebhirnāmapadaiḥ pṛthak | gandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpadīpādyairarcayeddvijān || evaṃ kṛte vidhāne vai sarvasaṃskārakarmaṇi | sarpahiṃsākṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || kuṣṭhavyādhyādibhirmuktaḥ sarvathā bheṣajaṃ tvidam | āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ prāpya kāmānavāpnuyāt" iti || atha prayogaḥ | guruśukrāstādirahite kāle'yanadvaye'pi paurṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāyāṃ pañcamyāmāśleṣāyuktadine vā kuryāt | tatrādhikārārthaṃ caturdaśakṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittaṃ caret | tasya prayogaḥ -- uktadinātpūrvedyustadahareva vā samastasaṃpaditi parṣadaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya natvā niṣkatrayaṃ niṣkadvayamekaṃ niṣkaṃ vā pāpatāratamyena parṣadagre nidhāya, anumatyādikartṛtve niṣkamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śaktyanusāreṇa nidhāyāmukaśarmaṇā mayeha janmani janmāntare vā jñānādajñānādvā kṛtena sarpavadhena janitasya doṣasya parihārārthamanugrahaṃ kṛtvā prāyaścittamupadiśantu bhavanta iti prārthayet | te copadiśāma iti pratibrūyuḥ | tataḥ kartā -- "sarve dharmavivettāro goptāraḥ sakalā dvijāḥ | mama dehasya saṃśuddhiṃ kurvantu dvijasattamāḥ || mayā kṛtaṃ mahāghoraṃ jñātamajñātakilbiṣam | prasādaiḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ śubhānujñāṃ prayacchatha || pūjyaiḥ kṛtaḥ pavitro'haṃ bhaveyaṃ dvijasattamaiḥ" | iti ślokānpaṭhitvā māmanugṛhṇantu bhavanta iti parṣadaṃ praṇamet | tataḥ kartā nibandhapūjanaṃ parṣatpūjanamanuvādakapūjanaṃ ca kuryāt | anuvādakāya bhṛtirūpāṃ yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | tato'nuvādako'mukaśarmaṇā tvayeha janmani janmāntare vā jñānādajñānādvā kṛtena sarpavadhena janitasya doṣasya parihārārthaṃ parṣadupadiṣṭacaturdaśakṛcchrācaraṇapūrvakayathāvidhisarpasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tvaṃ śuddho nirupadravo bhaviṣyasītyupadeśastriḥ | tataḥ kartā, omityaṅgīkṛtya parṣadaṃ namaskṛtya visarjayedanuvādakaṃ ca | tata ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtyāmukaśarmaṇā mayeha janmani janmāntare vā jñānādajñānādvā kṛtena sarpavadhena janitasya doṣasya parihārārthaṃ parṣadupadiṣṭacaturdaśakṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittamamukapratyāmnāyadvārā kariṣya iti saṃkalpya, "yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca | keśānāśritya tiṣṭhanti tasmātkeśānvapāmyaham" || iti śikhākakṣopasthavarjaṃ keśaśmaśrunakharomāṇi vāpayitvā, "āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajāḥ paśuvasūni ca | brahma prajñāṃ ca medhāṃ ca tvaṃ no dehi vanaspate" || iti vanaspatiṃ prārthya tasmātprādeśamātraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ gṛhītvā, -- "mukhadurgandhināśāya dantānāṃ ca viśuddhaye | ṣṭhīvanāya ca gātrāṇāṃ kurve'haṃ dantadhāvanam" || iti tena kāṣṭhena dantānsaṃśodhya dvādaśa gaṇḍūpānkṛtvā vakṣyamāṇotsarjanarītyā bhasmagomayamṛttikāsnānāni vidhāya pañcagavyaiḥ kuśodakena ca tattanmantraiḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā''po hi ṣṭheti tribhirmantraiḥ śuddhodakena snātvā vakṣyamāṇasnānavidhinā snānaṃ kuryāt | (kartā jīvatpitrādikaścettadā keśasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ pūrvoktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dviguṇaṃ kuryāt | tatra kramaḥ -- pradhānaprāyaścittasaṃkhyena keśasaṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ prāyaścittena saha caturdaśakṛcchrātmakaṃ prāyaścittamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya bhasmasnānādi kuryāditi |) tato viṣṇupūjanaviṣṇuśrāddhagodānavyāhṛtihomapañcagavyahomānkuryāt | tatra viṣṇupūjanamidaṃ viṣṇuritimantreṇa viṣṇuśrāddhasiddhyarthaṃ viprānāhūya saṃpūjya tebhyaścatvāryāmānnāni dadyāt | viṣṇuśrāddhasya mukhyavidhistu śrāddhaprakaraṇe vakṣyate | jīvatpitṛkasya tu na viṣṇuśrāddhamiti kecit | tato vipraṃ gāṃ ca saṃpūjya tasmai yathāvibhavakalpitopaskārasahitāṃ gāṃ dadyāt | gorabhāve tanmūlyaṃ vā | tato vyāhṛtihomaḥ -- kartā''camyollekhanādisaṃskṛta āyatane laukikamagniṃ viṇnāmānamagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmīti pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā sarpasaṃskārādhikārārthaprāyaścittāṅgabhūtahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi | prathamayā vyāhṛtyā'gniṃ saptabhirājyāhutibhiḥ, dvitīyayā vyāhṛtyā vāyuṃ saptabhirājyāhutibhiḥ, tṛtīyayā vyāhṛtyā sūryaṃ saptabhirājyāhutibhiḥ, samastavyāhṛtibhiḥ prajāpatiṃ saptabhirājyāhutibhiryakṣye | pañcagavyahome -- agnimekayā pañcagavyāhutyā somamekayā pañcagavyāhutyā viṣṇuṃ tisṛbhiḥ pañcagavyāhutibhī rudramekayā pañcagavyāhutyā | atrodakasparśaḥ | savitāramekayā pañcagavyāhutyā brahmaikayā pañcagavyāhutyā paramātmānamagniṃ vā praṇavena caturthabhāgena yāvatya āhutayo bhavanti tāvatībhirāhutibhiryakṣye | etā devatāḥ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā samidho'gnāvādhāyāgniṃ paristīryottareṇāgniṃ darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu darvīṃ saptapatrātmakānharitānkuśānājyasthālīṃ pañcagavyārthaṃ tāmrapātraṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānbarhirekāṃ samidhamājyaṃ pañca gavyānītyāsādya pavitre kṛtvā prokṣaṇīḥ saṃskṛtya pātrāṇi pañca gavyāni ca prokṣya darvīṃ saptapatrātmakānkuśāṃśca saṃmṛjya tattanmantraiḥ pañca gavyāni pavitrāntarhite tāmrapātra ekīkṛtya devasya tveti saptasaṃkhyaiḥ kuśairudakaṃ tasminsrāvayitvā''po hi ṣṭheti tribhirmantrairāloḍayet | tata ājyavilepanādi | ājyaparyagnikaraṇakāle pañcagavyasyāpi paryagnikaraṇam | pavitrābhyādhānānte'gneḥ paścādbarhirāstīrya tatrā''jyasthālīṃ pañcagavyapātraṃ ca nidhāya taduttarato darvīṃ saptapatrātmakānkuśāṃśca nidhāyādita iti pariṣicya āsāditāṃ samidhaṃ tūṣṇīmabhyādhāya darvyā saptavāramāvṛttābhirvyastābhiḥ samastābhiśca vyāhṛtibhirājyāhutīrjuhuyāt | tataḥ saptapatrātmakānkuśānādāya tairuddhṛtyoddhṛtya juhoti | agnaye svāhā somāya svāhetidvayorvāmadevo viśve devā vā ṛṣiḥ | agnisomau krameṇa devatā | yajuḥ | irāvatītyasya somo viṣṇustriṣṭup | idaṃ viṣṇurityasya somo viṣṇurgāyatrī | viṣṇornukamityasya somo viṣṇustriṣṭup | mā nastoka ityasyāgnirviśve devā vā rudrastriṣṭup | tatsaviturityasyā gāyatryā viśvāmitro'gniścarṣiḥ savitā devatā gāyatrī chandaḥ | brahma jajñānamityasyāgnirbrahma triṣṭup | praṇavasyāgniḥ parabrahmarṣiḥ paramātmā'gnirvā devatā gāyatrī chandaḥ | sarveṣāṃ pañcagavyahome viniyogaḥ -- 'oṃ agnaye svāhā' agnaya idaṃ0 | 'oṃ somāya svāhā' somāyedaṃ0 | 'oṃ irāvatī0 mayūkhaiḥ svāhā' viṣṇava idaṃ0 |'oṃ viṣṇornukaṃ vīryāṇi0 gāya svāhā' viṣṇava idaṃ0 | 'oṃ mā nastoke ta0 vidhema te svāhā' rudrāyedaṃ0 | apa upaspṛśya | 'oṃ tatsavitu0 yātsvāhā' savitra idaṃ0 | 'oṃ brahma jajñā0 vaḥ svāhā' brahmaṇa idaṃ0 | "oṃ svāhā" iti praṇavena yāvatībhirāhutibhiścaturthabhāgahomo bhavati tāvatīrāhutīstaiḥ kuśaireva juhuyāt | paramātmana idaṃ0 | agnaya idamiti vā | tato'vaśiṣṭaṃ pañcagavyaṃ praṇavenā''loḍya praṇavenābhimantrya vratagrahaṇaṃ kariṣya iti dvijānpṛṣṭvā kuruṣveti tairanujñāta āsanādbahirupaviśya praṇavena sarvaṃ pibet | tato mukhahastapādānprakṣālya dvivāramācamyā''sana upaviśya (tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdādihomaśeṣaṃ samāpya) parṣadupadiṣṭacaturdaśakṛcchrātmakaprāyaścittamācaret | dravyadānasya pratyāmnāyatvapakṣe kṛcchrasaṃkhyākagoniṣkrayadravyamagre nidhāya tatsaṃpūjya viprānsaṃpūjya parṣadupadiṣṭacaturdaśakṛcchrasaṃkhyākagoniṣkrayadravyaṃ nānānāmagotrebhyo brāhmaṇebhyo yuṣmabhyaṃ saṃpradade dātumahamutsṛjya iti vā dadyāt | tataḥ pūrvavadvyāhṛtihomaviṣṇupūjanaviṣṇuśrāddhagodānāni kuryāt | nātra pañcagavyahomaḥ | tato gave grāsaṃ dattvā śaktau satyāṃ gobhūtilahiraṇyājyavastradhānyaguḍaraupyalavaṇātmakāni daśa dānāni sadakṣiṇāni pūjanapūrvakaṃ viprebhyo dattvā mayā yatkṛtaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tadacchidramastviti bhavanto bruvantviti viprānprārthayet | tatastairacchidramastviti prayukte karmasādguṇyāya viṣṇuṃ saṃsmaret | iha janmani cetsākṣādvadhe(dho) viprāya lohadaṇḍaṃ dadyāt | tasya prayogaḥ | deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamaitajjanmakṛtasarpabadhajanitadoṣaparihārārthamimaṃ lohadaṇḍaṃ niṣkrayadravyaṃ vā'mukaśarmaṇe brāhmaṇāya tubhyamahaṃ saṃpradade na mameti viprahaste jalasahitaṃ dattvā kṛtasya lohadaṇḍadānasya saṃpūrṇatāsiddhaya imāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ saṃpradada iti dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā'nena lohadaṇḍadānenānantaḥ prīyatāṃ na mameti vadet | atha daśadānamantrāḥ | "gavāmaṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa | yasmāttasmācchivaṃ me syādiha loke paratra ca" iti goḥ || "sarvasasyāśrayā bhūmirvarāheṇa samuddhṛtā | anantasasyaphaladā mama śāntiṃ prayacchatu" iti bhūmeḥ || "tilāḥ pāpaharā nityaṃ viṣṇudehasamudbhavāḥ | tiladānena sarvaṃ me pāpaṃ nāśaya keśava" iti tilānām || "hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hema bījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ | anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāntiṃ prayacchatu" iti hiraṇyasya || "kāmadhenoḥ samudbhūtaṃ devānāmuttamaṃ haviḥ | āyurvivardhanakaramājyaṃ pātu sadaiva mām" ityājyasya || "śaraṇyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ lajjāyā rakṣaṇaṃ param | suveṣadhāri vastra tvaṃ sadā śāntiṃ prayaccha me" iti vastrasya || "dhanyaṃ karoti dātāramiha loke paratra ca | tasmātpradīyate gohiraṇyadānatīrthayātrādyanyatamapratyāmnāyadvārā prāyaścittaṃ vidhāya deśakālau saṃkīrtya pūrvajanmopārjitapāpajanyānapatyatvadoṣaparihārapūrvakanīrogadīrghāyurakṣayyasuguṇaputraprāptikāmāvāvāṃ
