dīrghāyurnīrogākṣayyasuguṇaputraprāptaye'nayā patnyā saha harivaṃśaṃ śroṣya iti saṃkalpaḥ kāryaḥ | tato gaṇeśapūjanapuṇyāhādivācane kṛtvā hiraṇyatāmbūlapūgīphalasahitakaro'mukagotramamukaśarmāṇaṃ tvāṃ harivaṃśaśrāvayitṛtvena vṛṇa iti vṛtvā vṛto'smīti tenokte caraṇakṣālanārghyavastradvayopavītadvayamudrikākuṇḍalādyābharaṇacandanākṣatapuṣpādibhistamabhyarcya taddakṣiṇakaramūle bṛhatsāmeti rakṣābandhanaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ śrāvayitraivameva daṃpatīhastayo rakṣābandhanaṃ kāryam | striyāstu vāmahaste rakṣābandhanam | tataḥ pratidinaṃ trāyantāmityādyairāpo hi ṣṭhādibhiśca vaidikairmantraiḥ surāstvetyādyaiḥ paurāṇamantraiśca susnātau svalaṃkṛtau daṃpatī ācamya, -- "namaste bhagavanvyāsa sarvaśāstrārthakovida | brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ mūrte satyavatīsuta" || iti vyāsaṃ namaskṛtya śucau deśa āsanayoḥ prāṅmukhāvupaviśya parameśvaraṃ dhyāyantau tadekacittau brahmacaryādiniyamapūrvakaṃ śṛṇuyātām | vācako'pi niyamapūrvakaṃ pratidinaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ namaskṛtyetyādimaṅgalaślokānpaṭhitvā -- nārāyaṇāya namaḥ, narottamāya namaḥ, sarasvatyai devyai namaḥ, vyāsāya namaḥ, gaṇapataye namaḥ, brahmaṇe namaḥ, viṣṇave namaḥ, śivāya namaḥ, gurubhyo nama iti namaskṛtya vācayet | daṃpatī pratidinaṃ vācakaṃ pustakaṃ ca pūjayetām | granthasamāptau vācakāya suvarṇaṃ kṣaumaṃ vastraṃ godānoktavidhinā svalaṃkṛtāṃ sopaskarāṃ savastrāṃ savatsāṃ payasvinīṃ gāṃ ca dadyāt | tataḥ śrotā viṣṇugāyatryā'ṣṭottarasahasraṃ ghṛtāktatilahomaṃ kuryāt | tasya prayogaḥ | ācamya prāṇānāyamyāgnyāyatanollepanādyagnipratiṣṭhāpanāntaṃ kuryāt | atra balavardhananāmā'gniḥ | tato'nvādhānam | samitrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā harivaṃśaśravaṇāṅgabhūtahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādi vyāhṛtyantaṃ prasādhanīdevyantaṃ voktvā, pradhānahome viṣṇuṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmaha iti viṣṇugāyatryā'ṣṭottarasahasrasaṃkhyābhirghṛtāktatilāhutibhiryakṣya ityuktvā, aṅgahome varuṇaṃ dvābhyāmājyāhutibhyāmityādi, agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣaghṛtā ktatilāhutyā yakṣya ityādi vā | pātrāsādana ājyena saha tilānāmapyāsādanam | ājyaparyagnikaraṇakāle ghṛtāktatilānāmapi paryagnikaraṇam | tata ājyodvāsanādi vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ prasādhanīdevīhomāntaṃ vā'nvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇa kṛtvā pradhānahomaṃ kuryāt | nārāyaṇāyetyasyā viṣṇugāyatryā yājñikyo devatā upaniṣado viṣṇuranuṣṭup, home viniyogaḥ, ityṛṣyādi smṛtvoktasaṃkhyayā ghṛtāktaistilairhomaḥ kāryaḥ | tato'nvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇāṅgahomādi sviṣṭakṛdādi vā sarvaṃ homaśeṣaṃ samāpayet | tata ekaṃ mithunaṃ śrāvayitāraṃ ca bhojayitvā nyūnaṃ saṃpūrṇamastviti śrāvayitāraṃ vadet | tathā'stviti śrāvayitā | tato daṃpatī rakṣābandhanaṃ visrasya dugdhāktaṃ kṛtvā śuddhodake nikṣipetām | śrāvayitā'pi rakṣābandhanaṃ visrasya dugdhāktaṃ kṛtvā śuddhodake nikṣipet | tataḥ śrāvayitṛsuhṛdyutau daṃpatī bhuñjīyātām | tataḥ sarve yathārthaṃ gaccheyuḥ | iti harivaṃśaśravaṇavidhiḥ | atha saṃkṣepeṇa pārthivaliṅgapūjanavidhiḥ | tatra tithitattve bhaviṣyapurāṇe -- "mṛdbhasmagośakṛtpiṇḍatāmrakāṃsyamayaṃ tathā | kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sakṛtpūjya vasetkalpāyutaṃ divi" iti || nandipurāṇe -- " āyuṣmānbalavāñśrīmānputravāndhanavānsukhī | varamiṣṭaṃ labhelliṅgaṃ pārthivaṃ yaḥ samarcayet || tasmāttu pārthivaṃ jñeyaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam" iti | śivadharme -- "vālukāni ca liṅgāni kārayetpārthivāni ca | sahasrapūjanātso'pi labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam" iti || tatraiva kālakaumudyām -- "akṣādalpapramāṇaṃ tu na liṅgaṃ kutracinnaraḥ | kurvītāṅguṣṭhato hrasvaṃ na kadācitsamācaret" iti || akṣo'śītiraktikāḥ | "te ṣoḍaśākṣaḥ" ityamarāt | aṅguṣṭhaśabdenāṅguṣṭhabṛhatparvagranthirucyate | "aṅguṣṭhāṅgulimānaṃ tu yatra yatropadiśyate | tatra tatra bṛhatparvagranthibhirminuyātsadā" iti cchandogapariśiṣṭāt | aṅguṣṭhamānamaṅgulimānaṃ cetyarthaḥ | tatraiva gautamaḥ -- "rātrāvudaṅmukhaḥ kuryāddevakāryaṃ sadaiva hi | śivārcanaṃ sadā'pyavaṃ śuciḥ kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ" iti || sadā divā rātrau cetyarthaḥ | tatraiva laiṅge -- "vinā bhasmatripuṇḍreṇa vinā rudrākṣamālayā | pūjito'pi mahādevo na syāttasya phalapradaḥ || tasmānmṛdā'pi kartavyaṃ lalāṭe vai tripuṇḍrakam" iti || oṃ hūṃ nama iti rudrākṣānpratyekamabhimantrya mālāṃ dhārayedityapyuktaṃ tatraiva | tatrādhikārārthaṃ tatraiva pañcākṣaramantra uktaḥ -- "apavitraḥ pavitro vā sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā | mahāpātakayukto vā mantrasyāsya jape sadā || adhikārī bhavetsarva iti devo'bravīcchivaḥ" iti | mṛdgrahaṇavidhiḥ śivapurāṇe -- ("śucideśasamudbhūtāṃ mṛdamāhārayettataḥ | śrīaṣṭamūrtaye namaḥ -- ityetena ca mantreṇa mṛdamādāya yatnataḥ | saṃśodhya mṛttikāṃ tatra sthāpayedvidhivatpumān | athavā kṛṣṇapakṣasya caturdaśyāṃ samānayet || punaśca māsamātreṇa hyāharettāvadeva hi" iti |) pūjāvidhirdevīpurāṇe -- "mṛdāharaṇasaṃghaṭṭapratiṣṭhāhvānameva ca | snapanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva visarjanamataḥ param || haro maheśvaraścaiva śūlapāṇiḥ pinākadhṛk | paśupatiḥ śivaścaiva mahādeva iti kramāt" iti || nāmakrameṇānantaroktāni karmāṇi kāryāṇityarthaḥ | yadyapyatra nāmānyeva viniyuktāni tathā'pi -- "dhyātvā praṇavapūrvaṃ tu tatastasmātsamāhitaḥ | namaskāreṇa puṣpādi vinyasecca pṛthakpṛthak" || iti sāmānyavākyānnamontatā jñeyā | nandipurāṇe -- " gobhūhiraṇyavastrādibalipuṣpanivedane | jñeyo namaḥ śivāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || sarvamantrādhikaścāyamoṃkārādyaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥ" iti | vastrādītyādipadenetaropacāragrahaṇam | visarjanātpūrvaṃ vāmāvartenāṣṭamūrtipūjoktā bhaviṣye -- "pūjyā aṣṭau harasyaitāḥ pūrvādikramayogataḥ | āgneyyantāḥ prapūjyāstu vedyāṃ liṅge śivaṃ yajet" iti || etā vedyāṃ, liṅge śivaṃ yajedityarthaḥ | atra prasiddhaiva prācī | "na prācīmagrataḥ śaṃbhoḥ" iti rudrayāmale niṣedhāt | (tato japaṃ kuryāt | sa coktaḥ śivapurāṇe -- "yathāśakti japaṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśakam | mārjanaṃ ca daśāṃśaṃ ca kuryācchivahitecchayā" iti || tarpaṇamārjanayorasaṃbhave caturguṇo dviguṇo vā japa iti sāmānyataḥ) | laiṅge -- "liṅgadvayaṃ pratidinaṃ mallikābhiḥ prapūjayet | arpayedguḍanaivedyamevaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ sudhīḥ || liṅgasya pūjanaṃ kuryātputra utpadyate śubhaḥ" iti || athaitatpūjāprakāraḥ | deśakālau saṃkīrtya śrīsāmbasadāśivaprītyarthaṃ pārthivaliṅgadvayapūjanamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya pūjāsāmagrīṃ svasamīpe nidhāya vibhūtirudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā''sanavidhyādi vidhāya, namaḥ śivāyeti pañcākṣareṇa, oṃ namaḥ śivāyeti ṣaḍakṣareṇa vā karaṣaḍaṅganyāsānkṛtvā, "sarvādhāre dhare devi tvadrūpāṃ mṛttikāmimām | liṅgārthaṃ vai pragṛhṇāmi śobhanā bhava sarvadā" || iti bhūmiṃ prārthya, (oṃ harāya nama iti śodhitāṃ śuddhadeśasthāṃ mṛdaṃ tato gṛhītvā) jalaṃ nikṣipya, oṃ maheśvarāya nama iti ghaṭṭayitvā mūlena liṅgaṃ kṛtvā jhaṭiti tanmastake'kṣatānnidhāya, oṃ śūlapāṇaye nama iti pratiṣṭhāpya prāṇapratiṣṭhāṃ vidhāya dhyāyennityaṃ maheśamiti śāradoktarītyā śivaṃ dhyātvā, oṃ pinākadhṛṣe namaḥ śrīsāmbasadāśivehā''gaccheha saṃnihito bhavetyāvāhayet | sarvatra mūlamantrasamuccayaḥ | mūlamantreṇaivā''sanaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvā, oṃ paśupataye nama iti snāpanīyaṃ dattvā śivāya nama iti vastrādigandhāntānupacārāndattvā mallikāpuṣpāṇi dattvā bilvapatrāṇi samarpya dhūpadīpau dattvā nānopahārādīnguḍaṃ ca nivedya phalatāmbūladakṣiṇā dattvā nīrājya puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyāt | śarvāya kṣitimūrtaye namaḥ | bhavāya jalamūrtaye namaḥ | rudrāya tejomūrtaye namaḥ | ugrāya vāyumūrtaye namaḥ | bhīmāyā''kāśamūrtaye namaḥ | paśupataye yajamānamūrtaye namaḥ | mahādevāya somamūrtaye namaḥ | īśānāya sūryamūrtaye namaḥ | ityaṣṭabhirliṅgavedyāṃ prasiddhaprāgādidikṣvapradakṣiṇamaṣṭamūrtīḥ pūjayitvā yathāśakti mūlamantraṃ japtvā(japitvā) (taddaśāṃśatarpaṇaṃ mārjanaṃ ca kuryāt | asaṃbhave tatsthāne caturguṇo dviguṇo vā japaḥ kevalaṃ japamātrameva vā |) tataḥ pūrvavatkaraṣaḍaṅganyāsānkṛtvā dhyāyennityamiti pūrvavaddhyātvā, "guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu deveśa tvatprasādānmayi sthirā" || iti japaṃ nivedya stotraiḥ stutvā, ("tāvakastvadgataprāṇastvaccitto'haṃ sadā mṛḍa | kṛpānidhe iti jñātvā bhūtanātha prasīda me || ajñānādyadi vā jñānājjapapūjādikaṃ mayā | kṛtaṃ tadastu saphalaṃ kṛpayā tava śaṃkara || ahaṃ pāpī mahānnātha pāvanaśca mahānbhavān | iti vijñāya deveśa yadicchasi tathā kuru" || iti saṃprārthya) vakṣyamāṇamabhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ putraprāptyarthaṃ paṭhitvā pradakṣiṇānamaskārānkuryāt | tataḥ -- "yathedānīṃ ca deveśa kṛpārthaṃ samupāgataḥ | tathā tvayā punardeva samāgantavyameva ca || oṃ mahādevāya namaḥ" iti visṛjya karmeśvarāyārpayet | etaccaikasaṃvatsaraparyantaṃ brahmacaryayuktaḥ patistathābhūtā patnī vā pratidinamavicchedena pūrvaṃ pārthivagaṇapatipūjanaṃ pārthivaskandapūjanaṃ ca vidhāya kuryāt | pūjanānte'bhilāṣāṣṭakapāṭhāḥ saṃvatsaraparyantaṃ kāryaḥ | sa ca pāṭha ittham -- "viśvānara uvāca -- ekaṃ brahmaivādvitīyaṃ samastaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ neha nānā'sti kiṃcit | eko devo na dvitīyo'vatasthe tasmādekaṃ tvāṃ prapadye maheśam || 1 || ekaḥ kartā tvaṃ hi sarvasya śaṃbho nānārūpo'pyekarūpo'pyarūpaḥ | yadvatpratyambvarka eko'pyanekastasmānnānyaṃ tvāṃ vineśaṃ prapadye || 2 || rajjau sarpaḥ śuktikāyāṃ ca rūpyaṃ nairaḥ pūrastanmṛgākhye marīcau | yadvattadvadviṣvageṣa prapañco yasmiñjñāte taṃ prapadye maheśam || 3 || toye śaityaṃ dāhakatvaṃ ca vahnau tāpo bhānau śītabhānau prasādaḥ | puṣpe gandho dugdhamadhye ca sarpiryattacchaṃbho tvaṃ tatastvāṃ prapadye || 4 || śabdaṃ gṛhṇāsyaśravāstvaṃ hi jileraghrāṇastvaṃ vyaṅghrirāyāsi dūrāt | vyakṣaḥ paśyestvaṃ rasajño'pyajihvaḥ kastvāṃ samyagvettyatastvāṃ prapadye || 5 || no vedastvāmīśa sākṣādviveda no vā viṣṇurno vidhātā'khilasya | no yogīndrā nendramukhyāśca devā bhakto veda tvāmatastvāṃ prapadye || 6 || no te gotraṃ nāpi janmāpi nā''khyā no vā rūpaṃ naiva śīla na deśaḥ | itthaṃbhūto'pīśvarastvaṃ trilokyāḥ sarvānkāmānpūrayestadbhaje tvām || 7 || tvattaḥ sarvaṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ smarāre tvaṃ gaurīśastvaṃ ca nagno'tiśāntaḥ | tvaṃ vai vṛddhastvaṃ yuvā tvaṃ ca bālastatkiṃ yattvaṃ nāsyatastvāṃ nato'smi || 8 || stutveti bhūmau nipapāta vipraḥ sa daṇḍavadyāvadatīva hṛṣṭaḥ | tāvatsa bālo'khilavṛddhavṛddhaḥ provāca bhūdeva varaṃ vṛṇīhi || 9 || tata utthāya hṛṣṭātmā munirviśvānaraḥ kṛtī | pratyabravītkimajñātaṃ sarvajñasya tava prabho || 10 || sarvāntarātmā bhagavānsarvaḥ sarvaprado bhavān | yāñcā prati niyuktā māṃ kimīśe dainyakāriṇīm(ṇī) || 11 || iti śrutvā vacastasya devo viśvānarasya ha | śuceḥ śucivratasyātha śuci smitvā'bravīcchuciḥ || 12 || bāla uvāca -- tvayā śuceḥ(ce) śuciṣmatyāṃ yo'bhilāṣaḥ kṛto hṛdi | acireṇaiva kālena sa bhaviṣyatyasaṃśayam || 13 || tava putratvameṣyāmi śuciṣmatyāṃ mahāmate | khyāto gṛhapatirnāmnā śuciḥ sarvāmarapriyaḥ || 14 || abhilāṣāṣṭakaṃ puṇyaṃ stotrametattvayeritam | abdaṃ trikālapaṭhanātkāmadaṃ śivasaṃnidhau || 15 || etatstotrasya paṭhanaṃ putrapautradhanapradam | sarvaśāntikaraṃ vā'pi sarvopatparinā(ṇā)śanam || 16 || svargāpavargasaṃpattikārakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | prātarutthāya susnāto liṅgamabhyarcya śāṃbhavam || 17 || varṣaṃ japannidaṃ stotramaputraḥ putravānbhavet | vaiśākhe kārtike māghe viśeṣaniyamairyutaḥ || 18 || ya paṭhetsnānasamaye labhate sakalaṃ phalam | kārtikasya tu māsasya prasādādahamavyayaḥ || 19 || tava putratvameṣyāmi yastvanyastatpaṭhiṣyati | abhilāṣāṣṭakamidaṃ na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || 20 || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mahāvandhyāprasūtikṛt | striyā vā puruṣeṇāpi niyamālliṅgasaṃnidhau || 21 || abdaṃ japtamidaṃ stotraṃ putradaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ | ityuktvā'ntardadhe bālaḥ so'pi vipro gṛhaṃ gataḥ" || iti śrīskandapurāṇe kāśīkhaṇḍe vīreśvarastotraṃ saṃpūrṇam | atha saṃtānagopālamantravidhiḥ | tatrā''dau saṃkṣepeṇa gurulakṣaṇaṃ nāradapañcarātre -- "brāhmaṇaḥ sarvakālajñaḥ kuryātsarveṣvanugraham | tadabhāvāddvijaśreṣṭhaḥ śāntātmā bhagavanmayaḥ || bhāvitātmā ca sarvajñaḥ śāstrajñaḥ satkriyāparaḥ | siddhitrayasamāyukta ācāryatve'bhiṣecitaḥ" iti || tattvasāre rudrayāmale -- (" na patnīṃ dīkṣayedbhartā na pitā dīkṣayetsutām | na putraṃ ca tathā bhrātā bhrātaraṃ naiva dīkṣayet" iti || anyacca tatrāntare -- ) "bahvāśī dīrghasūtrī ca viṣayādiṣu lolupaḥ | hetuvādarato duṣṭo vāgvādī guṇanindakaḥ || aromā bahuromā ca ninditāśramasevakaḥ | kāladanto'sitoṣṭhaśca durgandhiśvāsavāhakaḥ || duṣṭalakṣaṇasaṃpanno yadyapi svayamīśvaraḥ | bahupratigrahāsakta ācāryaḥ śrīkṣayāvahaḥ" iti || tantrarāje -- " (sundaraḥ sumukhaḥ svacchaḥ sulabho bahutantravit | asaṃśayaḥ saṃśayacchinnirapekṣo gururmataḥ || saundaryamanavadyatvaṃ rūpe sumukhatā punaḥ | smerapūrvābhibhāṣitvaṃ svacchatā'jihmavṛttitā || saulabhyamapyagarvatvaṃ saṃtoṣo bahutantratā | asaṃśayastattvabodhastacchittatpratipādanāt || nairapekṣyamavicchettā gurutvaṃ hitaveditā | evaṃvidho gururjñeyastvitaraḥ śiṣyaduḥkhadaḥ" iti || ajihmavṛttiteti cchedaḥ | bahutantratā bahutantravittetyarthaḥ | tathā -- "caturbhirādyaiḥ sahitaḥ śraddhāvānsusthirāśayaḥ | alubdhaḥ sthiragātraśca prekṣyakārī jitendriyaḥ || āstikī dṛḍhabhaktiśca gurau mantre sadaivate | evaṃvidho bhavecchiṣya itaro duḥkhakṛdguroḥ" iti || caturbhirādyairiti sundaratvādibhiḥ | śiṣyaparīkṣākālastatraiva -- "ekadvitricatuṣpañcavarṣāṇyālocya yogyatām | bhaktiyuktānguṇāṃścāpi kramādvarṇe sasaṃkare || paścāduktakameṇaiva vadedvidyāmananyadhīḥ" iti | sasaṃkare'nulomajātisahite varṇe | brāhmaṇādivarṇeṣvityarthaḥ | ekavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇasya yogyatāparīkṣā kṣatriyādiṣu tu dvyādivatsaraparīkṣetyarthaḥ | atha śiṣyadharmāḥ | mukhyatayā svaprakāśamātmānamanusaṃdadhyātpūjyeṣu parāṅmukho na bhavet | śarīramarthamasūṃśca gurvarthaṃ dhārayet | taduktaṃ kuryāt | tadvacasi yuktāyuktaṃ na vicārayet | paradhane spṛhāṃ na kuryāt | ātmastutiṃ paranindāṃ marmaspṛgvacanaṃ parihāsaṃ dhikkāramākośaṃ trāsotpādanaṃ ca na vidadhyāt | guruparamagurvoḥ samamāgamane prathamaṃ paramaguruṃ praṇamet | tadagre gurvanumatyā tannatiṃ (tadanumatyā gurunatiṃ) kalayet | etānanyāṃścānta(''cā)rānanutiṣṭhet | iti saṃkṣepeṇa śiṣyadharmāḥ |) jñānonayane -- "nivārya tu piturmantraṃ tathā mātāmahasya ca | sodarasya kaniṣṭhasya vairipakṣāśritasya ca || pramādādyadi vā'jñānātpiturdīkṣāṃ samācaret | prāyaścittaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā punardīkṣāṃ samācaret" iti || piturityupalakṣaṇaṃ mātāmahādīnāmapi | prāyaścittaṃ tvayutagāyatrījapaḥ sarvatra tathā darśanāt | siddhamantragrahaṇe tu nāyaṃ niṣedhaḥ | tathā ca siddhayāmale -- "yadi bhāgyavaśenaiva siddhavidyāṃ labhetpriye | tadaiva tāṃ tu dīkṣeta tyaktvā guruvicāraṇām" iti || siddhamantre na duṣyatīti tatrāntaravacanācca | puṇyatīrtha uparāge sati pitrāderapīṣṭamantro grāhya eva | tathā ca vaiśampāyanasaṃhitāyāṃ vyāsavacanaṃ śaunakaṃ prati -- "prasannahṛdayaḥ svasthaḥ pitā me karuṇānidhiḥ | kurukṣetre mahātīrthe sūryaparvaṇi dattavān" iti || prakaraṇānmantramiti saṃbadhyate | kaniṣṭhasya svāpekṣayā nyūnavayaskasya kasyāpi | tathā śaivāgame -- "bhikṣubhyaśca vanasthebhyo varṇibhyaśca maheśvari | gṛhastho bhogamantrā(mokṣā)rthī mantradīkṣāṃ na cā''caret || tyaktāgnayaḥ kriyāhīnā yatayo hyaparigrahāḥ | vanasthāstādṛśā eva varṇī nyūnāśramī yataḥ | atasteṣāṃ nādhikāro mantradāne maheśvari" iti || nyūnāśramī gṛhasthāpekṣayā gārhasthyasya dvitīyāśramatvāt | etena gṛhasthādyatibhirapi mantragrahaṇaṃ na kāryamityavagamyate | ata eva sārasaṃgrahe -- "tapasvī satyavādī ca gṛhasthaḥ svasthamānasaḥ" iti gurulakṣaṇamuktam | śivasadbhāve'pi -- "dīkṣāyāṃ na gurutvena yatīnvaikhānasānpriye | vṛṇuyādbhogamokṣārthī gṛhastho varṇinaṃ tathā" iti || vaikhānasā vānaprasthāḥ | varṇī brahmacārī | atra strīṇāmapyadhikāraḥ | "vaidiko miśrito vā'pi viprādīnāṃ vidhīyate | tāntriko viprabhaktasya śūdrasyāpi prakīrtitaḥ || svāgamoktena mārgeṇa strīśūdraiścāpi pūjanam | kartavyaṃ śraddhayā viṣṇościntayitvā patiṃ hṛdi || strīṇāmapyadhikāro'sti viṣṇorārādhanādiṣu | patipriyaratānāṃ ca śrutireṣā sanātanī" || iti padmapurāṇavacanāt | "na vaidikaṃ japecchūdraḥ striyaścaiva kadācana | namontaṃ(ntaḥ) śivamantraṃ(ntro) vā vaiṣṇavaṃ(vo) veṣyate budhaiḥ" iti yājñavalkyavacanāt | "laghuśyāmā kālarātrirgopālo jānakīpatiḥ | chinnamastā ca mātaṅgī tripurā kālikā śivaḥ || ugratārā bhairavaśca deyā varṇacatuṣṭaye | mṛgīdṛśāṃ viśeṣeṇa mantrā ete susiddhidāḥ" || iti mantraprakāśādivacanācca | (athātra prasaṅgādbālayauvanavārdhakyeṣu siddhipradā mantrāḥ krameṇa pradarśyante -- "bījamantrāstathā mantrā mālāmantrā iti tridhā | bījamantrā daśārṇāntāstato mantrā nakhāvadhi || viṃśatyadhikavarṇā ye mālāmantrāstu te smṛtāḥ" iti || eta evāvasthāntareṣvapi dviguṇajapātsidhyanti | atha prasaṅgānmantrāṇāṃ vyaktiviśeṣaḥ -- "vaṣaḍantāḥ phaḍantāśca pumāṃso manavaḥ smṛtāḥ | vauṣaṭsvāhāntimā nāryo huṃnamontā napuṃsakāḥ" iti || eteṣāṃ viniyogastu -- "vaśyoccāṭanarodheṣu pumāṃsaḥ siddhidāyakāḥ | kṣudrakarmarujāṃ nāśe strīmantrāḥ śīghrasiddhidāḥ || abhicāre smṛtāḥ klībā ityevaṃ mantrayojanā" iti ||) atha guroralābhe mantragrahaṇaprakāraḥ śāradātilakādiṣu -- "guroralābhe mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇakrama ucyate | kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃnidhau || likhitvā rājate pātre tālapatre'thavā punaḥ | mantraṃ taṃ sthaṇḍile sthāpya pūjayitvā maheśvaram || pāyasādi nivedyaṃ ca dattvā taṃ praṇipatya ca | śatakṛtvaḥ paṭhenmantraṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃnidhau || sarveṣāṃ caiva mantrāṇāmevaṃ grahaṇamiṣyate" iti || athavā -- "nadyāstu sindhugāminyāstīre cottarataḥ sthite | sthaṇḍilaṃ kārayettatra śucau deśe śubhe dine || tālapatre likhitvā'tha mantraṃ tatra nidhāya ca | āvāhya bhāskaraṃ tatra yathāvidhi supūjayet || tatsaṃnidhāvaṣṭaśataṃ paṭheddeśikato yathā | evaṃ gṛhṇīyānmatimānapūrvo'yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || atha kālaḥ | "mantrārambhastu caitre syātsamastapuruṣārthadaḥ | vaiśākhe ratnakāmaḥ syājjyeṣṭhe ca maraṇaṃ bhavet || āṣāḍhe bandhunāśaḥ syātpūrṇārthaḥ śrāvaṇe bhavet | prajānāśo bhavedbhādra āśvine ratnasaṃcayaḥ || kārtike mantrasiddhiḥ syānmārgaśīrṣe tathā bhavet | pauṣe tu śatrupīḍā syānmāgho medhāvivardhanaḥ || phālgune sarvakāmāḥ syurmalamāsaṃ vivarjayet" iti | malamāsagrahaṇaṃ kṣayamāso(sasyāpyu)palakṣaṇam | "pratipadi dvitīyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ ca vai śuciḥ | caturthyāṃ vittanāśaḥ syātpañcamyāṃ buddhivardhanam || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ jñānakṣayaḥ saukhyaṃ labhate saptamīdine | aṣṭamyāṃ buddhināśaḥ syānnavamyāṃ vapuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ || daśamyāṃ rājasaubhāgyamekādaśyāṃ śucirbhavet | dvādaśyāṃ sarvasiddhiḥ syāttrayodaśyāṃ daridratā || tiryagyoniścaturdaśyāṃ hānirmāsāvasānake | māsāvasānakamamāvāsyā | pūrṇimāyāṃdharmavṛddhirmantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe smṛtāḥ | pūrṇimāśabdena pūrṇimottarārdhameva grāhyaṃ na tu pūrvārdham | tasya bhadrātvena sāmānyataḥ sarvakarmasu niṣiddhatvāt | ravivāre bhavedvittaṃ some śāntirbhavetkila | āyuraṅgārako hanti saundaryaṃ saumyavāsare || guruvāre bhavejjñānaṃ śukre saubhāgyamīritam | śanaiścare yaśohāniriti vārāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || aśvinyoḥ sukhamāpnoti bharaṇīṣu mṛtirbhavet | kṛttikāsu bhaveduḥkhī rohiṇyāṃ vākpatirbhavet || mṛgaśīrṣe sukhāvāptirādrāyāṃ bandhunāśanam | punarvasvordhanāḍhyaḥ syātpuṣye śatruvināśanam || āśleṣāsu bhavenmṛtyurduḥkhānmuktirmaghāsu ca | saundaryaṃ pūrvaphalgunyoḥ prāpnoti ca na saṃśayaḥ || jñānamuttaraphalgunyorhaste ca dhanavānbhavet | citrāyāṃ jñānasiddhiḥ syātsvātyāṃ śatruvināśanam || viśākhayoḥ sukhaṃ cānurādhāsviṣṭavivardhanam | jyeṣṭhāyāṃ sutahāniḥ syānmūle kīrtivivardhanam || pūrvāṣāḍhāḥ kīrtidāḥ syuruttarā api kīrtidāḥ | śravaṇe ca bhavedduḥkhī dhaniṣṭhāsu daridratā || buddhiḥ śatabhiṣagbhe syātpūrvā(rva)bhādrapade sukhī | uttarāsu bhavetsaukhyaṃ revatyāṃ kīrtivardhanam || śubhaḥ siddhistathā''yuṣmāndhruvayogastataḥ param | prītiḥ saubhāgyayogaśca vṛddhiyogaśca harṣaṇaḥ || sukarmā ca dhṛtiḥ siddho brahmā aindraśca śobhanaḥ | varyāṇaśca śivaścaiva mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe śubhāḥ || mantrāṇāṃ grahaṇe śeṣā aśubhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ | bavabālavataitilā(la) kaulavaṃ vaṇijaṃ tathā || karaṇāni śubhānyeva sarvatantreṣu bhāmini" iti || vaiśampāyanasaṃhitāyām -- "mantrādyārambhaṇaṃ meṣe dhanadhānyapradaṃ bhavet | karkaṭe sarvasiddhiḥ syātkanyā lakṣmīpradā nṛṇām || tulāyāṃ sarvasiddhiḥ syātsarvalābhaśca vṛścike | makaraṃ putradaṃ prāhuḥ kumbho dhanasamṛddhidaḥ || itarāṇi tu lagnāni syuraniṣṭaphalāni hi | śuklapakṣe śubhā dīkṣā kṛṣṇe'pyāpañcamīdināt || bhūtikāmaiḥ site pakṣe muktikāmaiḥ sitetare" iti | atra gurubhārgavamauḍhyaṃ candratārānukūlyaṃ lagnasya grahabalādikaṃ ca vicāryam | grahabalaṃ tu -- "triṣaḍāyagatāḥ pāpāḥ śubhāḥ kendratrikoṇagāḥ | dīkṣāyāṃ tu śubhāḥ sarve randhrasthāḥ sarvanāśakāḥ" iti || āya ekādaśasthānam | pāpāḥ pāpagrahā ravibhaumaśanirāhuketukṣīṇendavaḥ pāpayuktāḥ saumyāśca | śubhāḥ śubhagrahāḥ, akṣīṇendupāpayogarahitabudhagurubhṛgavaḥ | kendrāṇi prathamacaturthasaptamadaśamasthānāni | trikoṇe navamapañcamasthāne | sarve pāpāḥ śubhāśca grahā uktasthānagatā dīkṣāyāṃ śubhā eva | ata eva randhre'ṣṭamasthāne sthitā yadi sarve nāśakā iti yojanā | athoktakālamantareṇāpi dīkṣārhaḥ kālastantrāntare -- "viṣuve'pyayanadvaṃdve saṃkrāntyāṃ damanotsave | dīkṣā kāryā tvakāle'pi pavitre guruparvaṇi" iti || viṣuve tulāmeṣasaṃkramayoḥ | ayanadvaṃdve karkamakarasaṃkrāntyoḥ | saṃkrāntyāṃ tadanyasaṃkrāntiṣu | damanotsave caitrapaurṇimādiṣu damanakaraṇakapūjādine | pavitre śrāvaṇapūrṇimāyām | guruparvaṇi gurorjanmavyāptidinayoḥ | anyatrāpi -- "sattīrthārkavidhugrāse puṇyāraṇyavaneṣu ca | mantradīkṣāṃ prakurvāṇo māsarkṣādīnna śodhayet" iti || prakārāntaraṃ ca -- "sarve vārā grahāḥ sarve nakṣatrāṇi ca rāśayaḥ | yasminnahani saṃtuṣṭo guruḥ sarve śubhāvahāḥ || saṃtuṣṭe ca gurau tasya saṃtuṣṭāḥ sarvadevatāḥ | guruṃ saṃtoṣayedbhaktyā dvayameva tadā bhavet" iti || dvayaṃ bhogamokṣau | evakāro'pyarthaḥ | adhikāribhedena kālo yathā -- "mumukṣūṇāṃ sadā kālaḥ strīṇāṃ kālastu sarvadā" iti || atharṇadhanacakram -- "nāmādyakṣaramārabhya yāvanmantrādimākṣaram | gaṇayenmātṛkāvarṇakrameṇa guṇayettribhiḥ || vibhakte saptabhiḥ śiṣṭo nāmarāśirudīritaḥ | evaṃ mantrārṇamārabhya yāvannāmādimākṣaram || gaṇayitvā tribhirhatvā vibhajetsaptabhiḥ sudhīḥ | mantrarāśiḥ smṛtaḥ śiṣṭaḥ pūrvavaddhanitā(ta)rṇitā || yadvā mantrākṣarāṇīha kharavyañjanarūpataḥ | pṛthakkṛtya dviguṇayedyojayetsādhakākṣaraiḥ || tādṛśairaṣṭabhirbhakte mantrarāśirudāhṛtaḥ | evaṃ nāmārṇasaṃgho'pi dviguṇīkṛtya yojitaḥ || mantravarṇairaṣṭabhakto nāmarāśiḥ smṛto budhaiḥ | ṛṇitā dhanitā cātra pūrvavatparikīrtitā || uktānyataramārgeṇa śodhanīyamṛṇaṃ dhanam" iti | (atha prasaṅgātsiddhāriśodhanaprakāraḥ | "ūrdhvābhiśca tiraścībhī rekhābhiḥ pañcapañcabhiḥ | koṣṭhaṣoḍaśakaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkārṇaiḥ prapūrayet" || yathā -- "ekatrirudranavadṛṅ nigamārkapaṅktiṣaṇnāgabhūpamanubāṇahayeṣutithyām | kāme kramādakathahaprabhṛtīnmanīṣī varṇānsamālikhatu ṣoḍaśa [keṣu ca]trīn" iti | asyārthaḥ -- rudra ekādaśaṃ koṣṭham | dṛgdvitīyam | nigamāścaturtham | arkā dvādaśam | paṅktirdaśamam | nāgo'ṣṭamam | bhūpāḥ ṣoḍaśam | kāmastrayodaśam | ekādikāmānteṣu prathamaṃ kramādakārādīnsvarān, tataḥ kāditāntān, tatasthādisāntānvarṇānvilikhya tataḥ prathamakoṣṭhe tṛtīya ekādaśe ca halakṣānvilikhediti | "vidiggateṣu koṣṭhānāṃ catuṣkeṣu caturṣviha | yatra sādhakanāmādivarṇastatsiddhisaṃjñakam || prādakṣiṇyakrameṇāsmāccatuṣkatritayaṃ param | sādhyaṃ tathā susiddhaṃ ca śatruścetyabhidhīyate || ekaikasmiṃścatuṣke'pi yasminkoṣṭhe yadakṣaram | tadādyuktakrameṇaiva siddhasādhyādikalpanā || evaṃ sādhyacatuṣkādau tattulyasthānakoṣṭhataḥ | sādhyasiddhaḥ sādhyasādhya ityādyākhyāḥ kramānmatāḥ" || siddhasiddhaprabhṛtyaparyantaṃ ṣoḍaśasaptasu yatra yasya manorādyo varṇaḥ so'pi tadāhvaya iti spaṣṭo'rthaḥ | athaiteṣāṃ phalāni | "siddhaḥ sidhyati kālena sādhyaḥ sidhyati vā na vā | susiddhastatkṣaṇādeva arirmūlaṃ nikṛntati" iti || tantrarāje -- "siddhasiddho japātsidhyeddviguṇātsiddhasādhyakaḥ | siddhaḥ sasiddhaḥ saṃprāpteḥ siddhārirhanti gotrajān | sādhyasiddho'tisaṃkleśātsādhyasādhyo'tiduḥkhakṛt || sādhyaḥ susiddho bhajanātsādhyāriḥ svastriyaṃ haret | susiddhasiddho'rdhajapātphalaṃ dadyādyathepsitam || susiddhasādhyo jāpādyaiḥ siddhaye syādato'nyathā | susiddhe ca susiddhastu pūrvajanmakṛtaśramaḥ || tasmāttaṃ sarvasiddhīnāṃ sādhane yojayenmanum | susiddhāriraśeṣeṇa svakulaṃ mārayeddhṛvam || arisiddhaḥ sutaṃ hanyādarisādhyastu kanyakām | tatsusiddhastu patnīṃ svāmaryariḥ sādhakāpahaḥ" iti || saṃprāpteḥ prāptimātrāt | jāpādyairityādyaśabdena homatarpaṇabrāhmaṇabhojanāni gṛhyante | atha prakārāntareṇa ṛṇadhanaśodhanam | "dviguṇīkṛtya sādhyasthaṃ svaravyañjanamaṇḍalam | sādhanākhyājuṣā tena melayitvā'ṣṭabhirharet || śeṣaḥ sādhyasya rāśiḥ syādyojayetsādhako'nyathā | sādhikādhikaśeṣastu ṛṇī sādhyaḥ śubhāvahaḥ || śodhito nyūnaśeṣaḥ syādvarṇalakṣajapācchubhaḥ" iti | sādhyo mantraḥ | tena svaravyañjanasamudāyena | anyatheti | sādhakanāmagataṃ svaravyañjanasamūhaṃ dviguṇīkṛtya sādhyagatasvaravyañjananikareṇa saṃmelyāṣṭabhirharet | śeṣaṃ sādhakarāśiṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ | śodhita ityuktena siddhārikrameṇa śodhito'nukūlo mantro yadi sādhakānnyūnaśeṣaḥ syāttadā yāvatyā varṇasaṃkhyayā nyūnatā tāvallakṣajapādinarṇamapākṛtya puraścaraṇādikaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | yasya mantrarāśiradhikaḥ sa ṛṇī jñeyaḥ | grāhya evāyam | yasya manarāśirnyūnaḥ sa dhanī tyājyo'yam | prakārāntarāṇi cānyato'vagantavyāni | athaitadapavādaḥ sīmasiddhāntaratnāṅgasārarudrayāmalāgastisaṃhitāsiddhāntaśekharādivacanagato'punaruktaḥ saṃgṛhyate -- "ekākṣare tathā kūṭe traipure strīsamarpite | svapnalabdhe nṛsiṃhārkavarāhāṇāṃ manuṣvapi || prāsāde praṇave tadvatsapiṇḍākṣaramantrake | mṛtyuṃjaye ca pāśādye vaiṣṇave caṇḍanāyake || vyomavyāpini māyāyāṃ mālāmantreṣvaghorake | ekatripañcaṣaṭsaptebhāṅkarudrākṣareṣu ca | napuṃsake ca dantārṇe kālikāśyāmalāmanau | siddhakālīcaṇḍikayormantre rāmamanuṣvapi || gopālamātṛkāmantre haravallabhayā saha | śrīvidyā siddhavidyā ca mātaṅgī bhuvaneśvarī || padmāvatī madhumatī dattātreyaśca pārvatī | mitreśoḍḍīśaṣaṣṭhīśacaryānandamanuṣvapi || saptapraṇavamantrāṇāṃ haridrocchiṣṭayorapi | āsurī sumukhī caiva reṇukā ca sarasvatī || kumbhodbhayā'rṇavaścaiva mataṅgagaṇikasya ca | śābarāṇāṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ vṛddhajaptamanuṣvapi || kulāgatānāṃ mantrāṇāṃ siddhādīnnaiva śodhayet | bahurūpāhvaye mantre jainabauddhamanuṣvapi || siddhāritvādidhanitāmṛṇitāṃ ca na śodhayet" iti | kūṭe kūṭākṣare mantre | strīsamarpite strīviśeṣasamarpita ityarthaḥ | tathā ca tantrāntare -- "sādhvī caiva sadācārā gurubhaktā jitendriyā | sarvamantrārthatattvajñā suśīlā pūjane ratā | guruyogyā bhavetsā hi vidhavā parivarjitā | striyo(yā) dīkṣā śubhā proktā mātuścāṣṭaguṇā smṛtā" iti || svapnalabdhe kartavyatāviśeṣo yathā -- "svapnalabdhe tu kalaśe guroḥ prāṇaṃ niveśya ca | kalaśe guroḥ prāṇaṃ niveśitaṃ bhāvayet | gurubhāvanāṃ kalaśe kuryāditi yāvat | vaṭapatre kuṅkumena likhitvā grahaṇaṃ śubham | tataḥ śuddhimavāpnoti anyathā viphalaṃ bhavet" iti || idaṃ tu sadgurorabhāve | tatsaṃbhave tu tata eva gṛhṇīyāditi | prāsāde prāsādabījāḍhye | pāśa(śo)bījam | vyomavyāpini hakārādau | māyāyāṃ hṛllekhāyām | aṅke navākṣare | dantārṇe dvātriṃśadakṣare | haridrocchiṣṭayostadgaṇapatyoḥ | aṇu(manu)rmantra iti | keṣāṃcinmantrāṇāṃ śāpābhāva ukto vātulāgame -- "purā śāpavihīnaṃ ca vartate mantrapañcakam | śrīvidyāsāluvaṃ mantraṃ nṛsiṃhārkavarāhakam" iti || tatrāntare tu -- "mantrādiṣu sarveṣu hṛllekhākāmabījakam | śrībījaṃ vā vinikṣipya japenmantrasya siddhaye || tārasaṃpuṭito vā'pi duṣṭamantro'pi sidhyati" iti | hiraṇyagarbhasaṃhitāyāṃ ca -- "svanāmādivarṇaiḥ svamitrākṣarairvā manuṃ saṃpuṭīkṛtya ye'nusmaranti" iti | sa mantrasteṣāṃ sidhyatīti śeṣaḥ | anusmaraṇaṃ japaḥ | mantrāṇāṃ saṃskārādikaṃ tu śāradātilakasaubhāgyaratnākarādigrantheṣu draṣṭavyavyam |) ādau mantrasiddhaye puraścaraṇamavaśyaṃ kartavyam | tathā ca vaiśampāyanaḥ -- "puraścaraṇasaṃpanno mantro hi phaladāyakaḥ | kiṃ homaiḥ kiṃ japaiścaiva kiṃ mantranyāsavistaraiḥ || rahasyānāṃ hi mantrāṇāṃ yadi na syātpuraskriyā | puraskriyā hi mantrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ bījamucyate || vīryahīno yathā devi sarvakarmasu na kṣamaḥ | puraścaraṇahīnastu tathā mantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ" iti || puraścaraṇaśabdaniruktirvāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -- "sādhanaṃ mūlamantrasya puraścaraṇamucyate | purataścaraṇīyatvādviniyogākhyakarmaṇām || purato viniyogasya caraṇādvā tathoditam" iti | viniyogalakṣaṇaṃ tu mantratantraprakāśe -- "dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ śāstramārgeṇa yojanam | siddhamantrasya saṃprokto viniyogo vicakṣaṇaiḥ || puraścaṇapūrvo'sau viniyogo vinirmitaḥ | phalāya mantrasevā vā rājasevā yathā tathā || caraṇātpūrvamevāsau puraścaraṇamucyate" iti | etena viniyogākhyakarmasāmarthyajanakakriyā, aihikāmuṣmikamantrātmaśuddhihetukriyā vā puraścaraṇamityuktam | atha mūlamantroddhāro mantrasyarṣyādinyāso dhyānaṃ japasaṃkhyā pūjāvidhiścocyate -- "atha putrapradaṃ vacmi kṛṣṇamantramanuṣṭubham | devakīsutavarṇānte govindapadamuccaret || vāsudevapadaṃ procya saṃbuddhyantaṃ jagatpatim | dehi me tanayaṃ procya kṛṣṇa tvāmahamīrayet || śaraṇaṃ gata ityanto mantro dvātriṃśadakṣaraḥ | nārado munirasyokto'nuṣṭupchandaḥ samīritam || devaḥ sutapradaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pādaiḥ sarveṇa cāṅgakam | vijayena yuto rathasthitaḥ praptamānīya samudramadhyataḥ || adadattanayāndvijanmane smaraṇīyo vasudevanandanaḥ | lakṣaṃ japo'yutaṃ homastilairmadhurasaplutaiḥ || arcā pūrvoditā caivaṃ mantraḥ putraprado nṛṇām" | iti | mantrakaumudyāmādau kāmabījayogo'pyuktaḥ | tatrāntare tvante'pi | atra tarpaṇamārjanabrāhmaṇabhojanānya'pi kāryāṇi -- "japo homastarpaṇaṃ ca mārjanaṃ viprabhojanam | mantravidbhistu pañcāṅgaṃ puraścaraṇamīritam" || iti mantrakaumudyādyukteḥ | etatsaṃkhyā'pyuktā tatraiva -- "homo japadaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena tarpaṇam | mārjanaṃ taddaśāṃśena taddaśāṃśena bhojanam" iti || aṅganyāsacakrādikaṃ tu gopāladaśākṣaramantravidhānavat | tadyathā -- "ācakrāya hṛdākhyātaṃ vicakrāya śiro'pi ca | sucakrāya śikhā paścāttrailokyarakṣaṇaṃ tataḥ || cakrāya kavacaṃ proktamasurāntakaśabdataḥ | cakrāyāstramidaṃ kuryādaṅgānāṃ pañcakaṃ manoḥ" iti || tantrāntare tu -- "asurāntakacakrāya netradvayaṃ sudarśanacakrāyāstram "| ityevamaṅgaṣaṭkamuktam | atha cakram | "agnyādikoṇeṣvabhyarcya tdṛdādyaṅgacatuṣṭayam | diśāsvastraṃ daleṣvaṣṭau mahiṣīḥ paripūjayet || rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca nagnajittanayārkajā | mitravindā lakṣmaṇā ca jāmbavatī suśīlikā || mahiṣyo'ṣṭau suvarṇābhā vicitrābharaṇasrajaḥ | dalāgne vasudevaṃ ca devakīnandagopatim || yaśodāṃ balabhadraṃ ca subhadrāṃ gopagopikāḥ | indrādīnapi vajrādīnpūjayettadanantaram || mantreṣveṣu daśārṇoktānprayogānvidadhīta ca" iti || aṅgaṣaṭkapakṣe saṃniveśastantrāntara evoktaḥ -- "agnyādikoṇeṣvabhyarcya hṛdādyaṅgacatuṣṭayam | diśāsu netramabhyarcya sarvadikṣvastramarcayet" iti || atha saṃkṣepeṇa puraścaraṇakartṛdharmāḥ | tantrasāre -- "adhaḥśāyī haviṣyāśī maunī caiva jitendriyaḥ | asūyādambharahitaḥ puraścaraṇamācaret" iti || vyāsaḥ -- "kṣīrāhārī phalāśī vā śākāhārī haviṣyabhuk | bhikṣāśī vā japaṃ kuryājjapaṃ cā(paṃścā)ndrāyaṇādikam || lavaṇaṃ kṣāramamlaṃ ca gṛñjanaṃ kāṃsyabhojanam | tāmbūlaṃ ca dvibhuktaṃ ca duḥsaṃvāsaṃ pramattatām || śrutismṛtiviruddhaṃ ca japaṃ rātrau ca varjayet" iti | duḥsaṃvāso duṣṭaiḥ saha saṃvāsaḥ | mantratantraprakāśe -- "bhūśayyā brahmacāritvaṃ maunacaryā'nasūyatā | nityaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ kṣudrakarmavivarjanam || nityapūjā nityadānaṃ devatāstutikīrtanam | naimittikārcanaṃ caiva viśvāso gurudevayoḥ || japaniṣṭhā dvādaśaite dharmāḥ syurmantrasiddhidāḥ iti | evamādau(dīṃ)śca niyamānpuraścaraṇakṛccaret | [iti |] brahmacaryamaṣṭavidhamaithunanivṛttiḥ | taduktaṃ dakṣeṇa -- "smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇam | saṃkalpo'dhyavasāyaśca kriyānirvṛttireva ca || etanmaithunamaṣṭāṅgaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ | viparītaṃ brahmacaryametadevāṣṭalakṣaṇam" iti || abhilāṣā(ṣa)pūrvakaṃ smaraṇakīrtanaprekṣaṇāni niṣiddhāni | keliḥ parihāsādibāhyaceṣṭā | guhyabhāṣaṇaṃ saṃbhogārthaṃ rahomantraṇam | saṃkalpo mānasaṃ karma | adhyavasāyaḥ saṃbhoganiścayaḥ | kriyānivṛttiḥ kriyāniṣpattiḥ | triṣavaṇasnānaṃ tu śaktaparam | "snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ proktamaśaktau dviḥ sakṛccaret" iti vaiśampāyanavacanāt | kṣudrakarma tu -- "dambhadveṣau tathotsāda uccāṭe bhramamāraṇe | vyādhiśceti smṛtaṃ kṣudram" iti nārāyaṇīyoktam | nityaṃ pūjā tatpūrvakameva japavidhānāt | naimittikārcanamayanādau viśeṣapūjā | sā coktā mantratantraprakāśe -- "aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu kṛtvā'ntaryāgamādarāt | japetpratidinaṃ yattu nitya eṣa japaḥ smṛtaḥ || ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ | dvādaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu teṣu naimittiko japaḥ || nityāttriguṇitaḥ so'tha pūjā caiva harestathā" iti | hareriti sveṣṭadevatopalakṣaṇam | ārabdhe puraścaraṇe madhya āśauce'pi na japabādhastaduktaṃ viṣṇunā -- "vratayajñavivāheṣu śrāddhe home'rcane jape | prārabdhe sūtakaṃ na syādanārabdhe tu sūtakam" iti || prārambhaśabdārthastu viṣṇunoktaḥ -- "prārambho varaṇaṃ yajñe saṃkalpo vratasatrayoḥ | nāndīmukhaṃ vivāhādau śrāddhe pākaparikriyā" iti || mantramahodadhau -- "ādau devaṃ vaśīkartuṃ puraścaraṇamācaret | tīrthādau nirjane sthāne bhūmigrahaṇapūrvakam || navadhā tāṃ dharāṃ kṛtvā pūrvādiṣu samālikhet | koṣṭheṣu sapta vargāṃśca lakṣo madhye tathā svarān || kṣetranāmādimo varṇo yatra koṣṭhe bhavettataḥ || upaviśya japaṃ kuryānnānyasminduḥkhade sthale | āmadhyāhnaṃ japaṃ kuyodupāṃśuṃ vā'tha mānasam || haviṣyaṃ niśi bhuñjīta triḥsnāpya(yya)calanastathā | vyagratālasyaniṣṭhīvakrodhapādaprasāraṇam || anyabhāṣāntyajekṣe ca japakāle tyajetsudhīḥ | anyabhāṣā cāntyajaścāṇḍālastasyekṣā cānyabhāṣāntyajekṣe | anyena saha bhāṣaṇamantyajasyekṣaṇaṃ ca varjayedityarthaḥ | strīśūdvabhāṣaṇaṃ nindāṃ tāmbūlaṃ śayanaṃ divā | pratigrahaṃ nṛtyagīte kauṭilyaṃ varjayetsadā || bhūśayyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ ca trikālaṃ devatārcanam | naimittikārcanaṃ devastutiṃ viśvāsamāśrayet || pratyahaṃ pratyahaṃ tāvannaivaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ kvacit" iti | navakoṣṭhakaṃ caturaśraṃ kṛtvā tasminpūrvadiśamārabhya kādīnsapta vargānante laṃ kṣaṃ ca vilikhet | evaṃ madhyakoṣṭhe nava koṣṭhānkṛtvā pūrvāditaḥ svarayugmaṃ likhet | kṣetranāmādyavarṇo yasminkoṣṭhe bhavettatra mukhaṃ tadadhastātkrameṇa hastapārśvapādapucchādikaṃ jñeyam | tatra mukha upaviśya japaṃ kuryāt | nānyasminhastapārśvādiṣu | tatra -- "udaṅmukhaḥ sakāmastu niṣkāmaḥ prāṅmukho japet | abhicārādikaṃ yāme nairṛtye(te) māraṇaṃ smṛtam" iti vacanādyathākāmam | atha prakārāntareṇa kūrmacakram | samīkṛte bhūtale prākpratyagāyatā dakṣiṇottarāyatāścatasraścatasro lekhā vilikhya nava koṣṭhāni vidhāya tatra pūrvādiprādakṣiṇyena krameṇāṣṭasu koṇeṣu kacaṭatapayaśalā(lā)khyānaṣṭa vargānakārādisvaradvayaṃ ca vilikhya madhyakoṣṭhe śrīkāraṃ vilikhet | athavā madhyakoṣṭhe svarāḥ prāgādikrameṇa | idaṃ ca kūrmacakraṃ kṣetragrāmagṛhabhedāttrividham | tatra kṣetragrāmayostattannāmādyakṣarayuktaṃ koṣṭhaṃ mukhaṃ kūrmasya | etadeva dīpasthānamucyate | gṛhe tu gṛhapatināmādyakṣarayukkoṣṭhaṃ mukham | tatpārśvadvayagataṃ koṣṭhadvayaṃ hastau, tadadhaḥ sthitaṃ kukṣī, tadadhaḥ sthitaṃ tu caraṇau, kukṣimadhyagataṃ koṣṭhaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ, caraṇamadhyagataṃ koṣṭhaṃ pucchamiti vivekaḥ | evamuktaprakārasya kṣetrādau vibhāvitasya kūrmasya mukhe pṛṣṭhe vā jape home ca sarvārthasiddhiḥ | karayoḥ stanau | koṣṭhāntarāṇyanupayuktānīti | kūrmacakrānāvaśyakatoktā katipayeṣu sthaleṣu | yathā -- "kurukṣetre prayāge ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṃgame | mahākāle ca kāśyāṃ ca dīpasthānaṃ na cintayet" iti || dīpasthānopalakṣitatvātkūrmacakramapi dīpasthānamityuktam | iha cakre cokteṣu koṣṭheṣu ripusthānaṃ vicintya tattyāgapūrvamavaśiṣṭamitrasthānamupādeyam | arimitravicāro yathā -- "advayasya thakāreṇa ṭhakārasyāpi tena ca | lṛdvayasya pra(pa)kāreṇa pakārasyāpi tena ca || audvayasya ṣakāreṇa ṣakārasyauyugena ca | jakārasya ṭakāreṇa jñakārasya khakārataḥ || ukārasya lakāreṇa phakārasya dhakārataḥ | bhakārasya tu repheṇa yakārasya sakārataḥ || aritvameṣāṃ varṇānāmanyeṣāṃ mitrabhāvanā" iti | puraścarappārambhātprāṅmantrasiddhyarthamayutatrayaṃ gāyatrījapaḥ kāryaḥ | taduktaṃ mantrakaumudyām -- "sarvamantraprasiddhyarthaṃ gāyatrīṃ tryayutaṃ japet" iti | āsanavidherāvaśyakatvamuktaṃ siddhāntaśekharādau -- "āsanaṃ prokṣya saṃpūjya japaṃ tatra samācaret" iti | tatra tasminnāsane | āsanamāha nāradaḥ -- "kuśājināmbarairyuktaṃ caturaṅgulamūrdhvataḥ | caturaśraṃ dvihastaṃ ca sudṛḍhaṃ mṛdu nirmalam || āsanaṃ kalpayitvā tu japakarma samārabhet" iti | ajinānyāha vaiśampāyanaḥ -- "sarvasiddhyai vyāghracarma jñānasiddhyai mṛgājinam | vastrāsanaṃ rogaharaṃ vetrajaṃ śrīvivardhanam || kauśeyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ kambalaṃ duḥkhamocanam" iti | vastramāvikaṃ na tu kārpāsamayam | "āsane kārpāsamaye japo bhavati niṣphalaḥ" | iti brahmayāmale [kārpāsamaya]vastrāsane doṣaśravaṇāt | bhūtaśuddhirapyavaśyaṃ kartavyā | "bhūtaśuddhivihīnena kṛtā pūjā'bhicāravat | viparītaṃ phalaṃ dadyādabhaktyā pūjane yathā" || iti kumbhasaṃbhavena tadakaraṇe doṣasyoktatvāt | prāṇapratiṣṭhāpanamapyuktaṃ sārasaṃgrahe -- "bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyetthaṃ tato vai sthāpayedasūn" iti | asūnprāṇān | antarmātṛkābahirmātṛkānyāsāvapi tatraiva -- "kṛtvā'ntarmātṛkānyāsaṃ bahirnyāsaṃ tataścaret" iti | bahirnyāso bahirmātṛkānyāsaḥ | nyāsasyā''vaśyakatvamuktaṃ gautamīye -- "dhyānaṃ japārcanāhomāḥ siddhamantrakṛtā api | aṅgavinyāsavidhurā na dāsyanti phalānyamī" iti || kapilapañcarātre -- "ṛṣicchandodevatānāṃ vinyāsena vinā yadā | japaḥ saṃsādhito'pyeṣa tatra tucchaphalaṃ bhavet" iti || atha mudrāḥ | tatra bahirnyāsamudrā dakṣiṇāmūrtisaṃhitāyām -- "puṣpairanāmayā vā'pi manasā vā nyasedaṇūn" iti || atraivaṃ vyavasthā | puṣpairdevatāmūrtau | anāmayā svadehe | manasā mūlādhārādicakreṣu, tatra karasparśāsaṃbhavāt | anāmayā sāṅguṣṭhayā -- "aṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu nyāsaḥ sarvatra saṃmataḥ" | iti padyavāhinīvacanāt | aṅganyāsamudrāstu tantrarājādau -- "prasāritamanaṅguṣṭhaṃ tarjanyādicatuṣṭayam | hṛdi mūrdhani cāṅguṣṭhahīno muṣṭiḥ śikhātale || cakārāddhṛdaye devamūrdhani | skandhamārabhya nābhyantāddaśāṅgulyastu varmaṇi | tarjanyāditrayaṃ netratraye netradvaye dvayam || prasāritābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ kṛtvā tālatrayaṃ sudhīḥ | tarjanyaṅguṣṭhayoragre sphālayanbandhayandiśaḥ || eṣā'stramudrā saṃproktā viṣṇoretāḥ prakīrtitāḥ" iti | ṛṣyādinyāsamudrā api tatraiva -- "ṛṣicchandodevatānāṃ nyāse tvaṅgulayaḥ smṛtāḥ | catasro'ṅguṣṭharahitā iti vidvatprabhāṣitam" iti || athā''vāhanyādimudrāḥ -- "hastābhyāmañjaliṃ baddhvā'nāmikāmūlaparvaṇoḥ | aṅguṣṭhau nikṣipetseyaṃ mudrā tvāvāhano matā || adhomukhī tviyaṃ cetsyātsthāpanīti nigadyate | iyamāvāhanī mudrā'dhomukhī cetsthāpanī mudrā bhavedityarthaḥ | etenaiva jñāyate āvāhanī mudrottānahasteti | ucchritāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭyostu saṃyogātsaṃnidhāpanī | antaḥ praveśitāṅguṣṭhā saiva saṃrodhinī matā || aṅguṣṭhagarbhamuṣṭidvayaṃ saṃrodhinītyarthaḥ | uttānamuṣṭiyugulā saṃmukhīkaraṇī bhavet | uttānau muṣṭī saṃmukhīkaraṇī mudretyarthaḥ | devatāṅge ṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syātsakalīkṛtiḥ | sakalīkaraṇī mudretyarthaḥ | saṃnirodhena mudrāyāstarjanyau sarale yadā | avaguṇṭhanamudreyamabhito bhrāmitā matā || anyonyagrathitāṅguṣṭhā praptāritaparāṅguliḥ | mahāmudreyamuditā paramīkaraṇī priye || karayoraṅguṣṭhau saṃgrathyetarāṅgulīḥ prasārayediti mahāmudretyarthaḥ | iyameva paramīkaraṇītyucyate | vāmāṅgulīnāṃ madhyeṣu dakṣiṇā aṅgulīratha | niyojya tarjanīṃ dakṣāṃ madhyayā vāmayā tathā || dakṣamadhyamayā vāmāṃ tarjanīṃ ca niyojayet | vāmayā'nāmayā dakṣāṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ viniyojayet || dakṣayā'nāmayā vāmāṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ ca niyojayet | vihitā'dhomukhī caiṣā dhenumudrā prakīrtitā || iyamevāmṛtīkaraṇītyucyate | kaniṣṭhānāmayoḥ pṛṣṭhe syādaṅguṣṭhastu tarjanī | kuṭilā madhyamā tvṛjvī mudrā'sāvaṅkuśābhidhā || ṛjvīṃ madhyamāṃ kṛtvā tarjanīṃ madhyama(mā)parvaṇi saṃyojyā''kuñcayedityarthaḥ | vāmāṅguṣṭhaṃ tu saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇena tu muṣṭinā | kṛtvottānaṃ tathā muṣṭimaṅguṣṭhaṃ tu prasāda(ra)yet || vāmāṅgulyastathā''śliṣṭāḥ saṃyuktāḥ suprasāritāḥ | dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhake lagnā mudrā śaṅkhasya bhūtidā" iti || "dakṣasyānāmikāṅguṣṭhamadhyamāgrāṇi yojayet | śiṣṭe dve utthite kuryānmṛgamudreyamīritā" iti || mudrāśabdārthastantrasāre -- "mudaṃ svarūpalābhāya dehadvāreṇa cā''tmanaḥ | yā hyarpayantyayatnena mudrāstāḥ śaktayo matāḥ || mocayanti grahādibhyaḥ pāpaughaṃ drāvayanti ca | mocanaṃ drāvaṇaṃ yasmānmudrā śāstreṣu varṇitā" iti || japadeśo vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -- "sūryasyāgnergurorindordīpasya jvalitasya vā | viprāṇāṃ vā gavāṃ vā'pi saṃnidhau śasyate japaḥ || athavā nivasettatra yatra cittaṃ prasīdati | gṛhe japaḥ samaḥ prokto goṣṭhe daśaguṇastu saḥ || ārāme ca tathā'raṇye sahasraguṇa ucyate || ayutaṃ parvate puṇye nadyāṃ lakṣaguṇastu saḥ | koṭiṃ devālaye prāhuranantaṃ śivasaṃnidhau" iti || śivagrahaṇaṃ sveṣṭadevopalakṣaṇam | yogayājñavalkyo'pi -- "agnyagāre jalānte vā japeddevālaye'pi vā | puṇyatīrthe gavāṃ goṣṭhe dvijakṣetre'thavā gṛhe" iti || śaṅkho'pi -- "gṛhe tvekaguṇaṃ japyaṃ nadyādau dviguṇaṃ smṛtam | gavāṃ goṣṭhe daśaguṇamagnyagāre śatādhikam || siddhatīrtheṣu kṣetreṣu devatāyāśca saṃnidhau | sahasraśatakoṭīnāmanantaṃ viṣṇusaṃnidhau" iti || viṣṇuriti sveṣṭadevopalakṣaṇam | kūrmapurāṇe'pi -- "guhyakā rākṣasāḥ siddhā haranti prasabhaṃ yataḥ | ekānte tu śubhe deśe tasmājjapyaṃ sadā caret" iti || atha japamālā | sā trividhā | mātṛkākṣaramayī, rudrākṣādimaṇimayī, dakṣiṇakaraparvamayī ceti | tatra prathamāmāha sārasaṃgrahakāraḥ -- "akārādikṣakārāntairbinduvanmātṛkākṣaraiḥ | anulomavilomasthaiḥ klṛptayā varṇamālayā || pratyekaṃ varṇayuṅmantrā japtāḥ syuḥ kṣiprasiddhidāḥ | vairimantrā api nṝṇāṃ susiddhādyāstu kiṃ punaḥ" iti || tatprakārastantraprakāśe -- " brahmanāḍīgatānādikṣāntavarṇānvibhāvya ca | arṇaṃ binduyutaṃ kṛtvā sveṣṭamantraṃ japetsudhīḥ || akārādiṣu saṃyojya tathā kādiṣu ca kramāt | kṣārṇaṃ merumatho tatra kalpayejjagadīśvari || tadā lipirbhavedakṣamālārdhaśatasaṃkhyayā | anayā sarvamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || kṣakāraṃ merusaṃdhāne lakārādivilomataḥ | ekaikāntaritaṃ mantrairjapedevaṃ phalapradam" iti || yadā prātyā(tya)hiko'ṣṭottarasahasramaṣṭottaraśataṃ vā japaḥ kāryastadā -- "vargāṣṭakavibhedena bhavedaṣṭottaraṃ śatam" | iti prakāro jñeyaḥ | akṣamālāśabdastvatraiva mukhyaḥ | uktaṃ ca śāradātilake -- "ādikṣāntārṇayogitvādakṣamāleti kīrtitā" iti | jñānārṇave'pi -- " akāraḥ prathamo devi kṣakāro'ntyastataḥ param | akṣamāleti vikhyātā mātṛkāvarṇarūpiṇī" iti || vargāṣṭakajapastūddiṣṭaśatādisaṃkhyāvasāne kāryaḥ | taduktaṃ mātṛkārṇave -- "ārabhyākāramādau manasi parijapenmātṛkāṃ sāvasānāṃ dhṛtvā taccāvasānaṃ punarapi ca paṭhedāntamevāvarohe | lāntānaṣṭau ca vargāstadanu parijapedbhūya evāvasāne hyāntaṃ saṃhāramuktaṃ paśupatigaditā yāmale mālikeyam" iti || dhṛtvā merusthāne | avasānaṃ kṣakāraḥ | lāntānkacaṭatapayaśalākhyān | tadanūddiṣṭasaṃkhyāsamāptyanantaram | avasāne, uddiṣṭaśatādisaṃkhyāvasāne | evo'vadhāraṇe | dvitīyā tu sārasaṃgrahe -- "atha vakṣye'kṣamālāyā vidhānaṃ mantrikāmyayā | pañcaviṃśatibhiḥ proktā maṇibhirmuktidāyinī || triṃśadbhirdhanadā saptaviṃśatyakṣaistu sarvadā | abhicārakarī pañcadaśabhiḥ kalpitā tu sā || catuṣpañcāśadakṣaiḥ sā kāmyakarmasu siddhidā | aṣṭottaraśataiḥ klṛptā sarvābhīṣṭapradā matā || maṇayaḥ śaṅkhasaṃbhūtāḥ proktā lakṣmīpradāyakāḥ | bhuktimuktipradāḥ sphaṭikajā padmākṣāḥ puṣṭivardhanāḥ || bhuktimuktipradāḥ proktā rudrākṣāḥ sarvasiddhidāḥ | putrajīvabhavāḥ putrapaśudhānyasamṛddhidāḥ || vidrumotthāstu maṇayo dhanasaubhāgyavaśyadāḥ | mauktikā muktidāḥ proktāḥ sarvasaṃpatsamṛddhidāḥ || pāpāpahāḥ kuśamayāḥ kāmadāḥ svarṇarūpyajāḥ" iti | hārītaḥ -- "śaṅkharūpyamayī mālā kāñcanī vanajotpalaiḥ | padmākṣakaiśca rudrākṣairvidrumairmaṇimauktikaiḥ || rājatendrākṣakairmālā tathaivāṅguliparvabhiḥ | putrajīvamayī mālā śastā vai japakarmaṇi" iti || gautamo'pi -- "aṅgulyā japasaṃkhyānamekamekamudāhṛtam | rekhayā'ṣṭaguṇaṃ putrajīvairdaśaguṇādhikam || śataṃ syācchaṅkhamaṇibhiḥ pravālaiśca sahasrakam | sphāṭikairdaśasāhasraṃ mauktikairlakṣamucyate || padmākṣairdaśalakṣaṃ tu sauvarṇaiḥ koṭirucyate | kuśagranthyā ca rudrākṣairanantaphalamucyate" iti || gopālasya tu padmākṣamālā'tīva praśastā | "maunī śāntaḥ śucirdāntaḥ padmabījākṣamālayā | japetsamāhitamanā gopālasya manuṃ sadā" iti gautamokteḥ | miśraṇe niṣedha uttaratantre -- "indrākṣairyadi japyeta rudrākṣaiḥ sphāṭikaistathā | nānyanmadhye prayoktavyaṃ putrajīvādikaṃ ca yat || yadyanyattu prayuñjīta mālāyāṃ japakarmaṇi | tasya kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca na dadāti priyaṃkari || janmāntare jāyate'sau vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ | miśrībhāvaṃ tato yāti caṇḍālaiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ" iti || maṇisaṃkhyāmāha prajāpatiḥ -- "aṣṭottaraśataṃ kuryāccatuṣpañcāśikā tathā | saptaviṃśatikā kāryā tato naivādhikā hitā || aṣṭottaraśatā mālā uttamā sā prakīrtitā | catuṣpañcāśikā vatsa madhyamā sā prakīrtitā || adhamā procyate nityaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā" iti | ayutādisaṃkhyajape tu -- "na khaṇḍāṃ kārayenmālāṃ japakarmaṇi mānavaḥ" | iti mālākhaṇḍananiṣedhādetāsāṃ mālānāṃ japasādhanatvāsaṃbhavena śatasaṃkhyamaṇighaṭitamālāyā vidhānābhāve'pyanāyatyā(pattyā) śatasaṃkhyamaṇighaṭitaiva mālā'tra kalpanīyā | "ayutādijape proktā mālā'kṣaiḥ śatasaṃkhyakaiḥ" iti vacanāditi kecit | anye tu -- ayutādisaṃkhyajape śatasaṃkhyavarṇamālaiva draṣṭavyā na tu maṇimayī | etasyā mālāyā akhaṇḍāyā atrāsaṃbhavāt | śatasaṃkhyamaṇimālāpratipādakavacanasya nirmūlatvāccetyāhuḥ | aṣṭottarasahasrajape tu varṇamayī karamayī vā māleti | sā cāgre vakṣyate | gautamaḥ --
śaivāgame -- "tarjanyā na spṛśetsūtraṃ kampayenna ca gharṣayet | na spṛśedvāmahastena karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayet || akṣāṇāṃ cālane'ṅguṣṭhenānyamakṣaṃ na saṃspṛśet | japakāle sadā vidvānmeruṃ naiva vilaṅghayet || parivartanakāle ca saṃghaṭṭaṃ naiva kārayet | kaliḥ khaṭakhaṭāśabde dolamāne calanmatiḥ || calite caiva vidveṣaḥ sphuṭite vyādhisaṃbhavaḥ | hastacyute mahāvighnaḥ sūtracchede vinaśyati" iti || calite madhyamāto'ṅgulyantaragate | sphuṭite maṇau | sūtracchede guṇacchede'pītyarthaḥ | tathā -- "kāṃse kṣute ca jṛmbhāyāmekamāvartanaṃ tyajet | pramādāttarjanīsparśo bhavedāvartanaṃ tyajet || āvartanaṃ mantrasya | jape niṣiddhasaṃsparśe kṣālayitvā punarjapet" iti | anyacca -- "ullaṅghite tathā merau patite vā'kṣasūtrake | prāṇāyāmatrayaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati" iti || (anyacca -- "galitā cetkarānmālā chinnā spṛṣṭā'thavā bhavet | prakṣālya tāṃ pañcagavyairabhimṛśya tatastu tām || aṣṭottaraśataṃ mūlamantrasya japamācaret" iti |) athaitasyā mālāyāḥ saṃskārakālaḥ | sa ca yoginītantre -- "dvādaśyāṃ vaiṣṇavī mālā kartavyā sādhakottamaiḥ | mantrajñairviṣṇubhaktaistu divyabhāge prayatnataḥ" iti || divyabhāgaḥ pūrvāhṇaḥ | sūtramapi tatraiva -- "kārpāsairvaiṣṇavī mālā paṭṭasūtrairathāpi vā" iti || kārpāsasūtre viśeṣastatraiva -- "tato dvijendrapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ granthivarjitam | triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya sūtraṃ prakṣālya yatnataḥ" iti | (tantrāntare -- "brāhmaṇyā ca suvāsinyā tadabhāve'nyavarṇayā | kārpāsanirmitaṃ sūtraṃ triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtam || prakṣālya tatra mālāyāṃ maṇīnyuktyā niyojayet" iti || anyacca -- "sūtrāntareṣu tu sthaulyamānayorniyamo na hi" iti | kārpāsavyatirikteṣu sūtreṣu | athaitasyā mālāyāḥ saṃskāraḥ |) mālāracanāprakāraḥ pādme -- "gopucchāvayavākārāmakṣamālāṃ vidhāya ca | mervākhyaṃ yojayedakṣamekamūlāgrasūtrake || granthiṃ kuryāttadagreṇa kīrtitā cākṣamālikā" iti || vārāhasaṃhitāyām -- " akṣānyathoktānsaṃhṛtya vividhāndoṣavarjitān | kṣālitānpañcagavyena pañcavedāntavidyayā || sadyojātādyaiḥ pañcabrahmamantrarityarthaḥ | āropayeddhemasūtre dviguṇatriguṇīkṛte | sūtre vā rājate kṣaume śaṇakeśādivarjite | kārpāse vā yathālābhaṃ kṣālite pariśodhite | pṛṣṭhena pṛṣṭhabhāgaṃ ca mukhena mukhameva ca || parasparaṃ tu saṃnaddhā maṇayaḥ sadṛśāḥ śubhāḥ | sūtreṇa vā suvarṇasya madhye madhye ca sāntarāḥ" iti || tantracintāmaṇau -- "kuśodakaiḥ pañcagavyairmālāṃ prakṣālayetsudhīḥ | aśvatthapatranavake mālāṃ saṃsthāpayettataḥ || mātṛkāstatra vinyasya sadyojātādipañcabhiḥ | abhimantrya tato mālāṃ pañcagavyena vāribhiḥ || prathamena tu mantreṇa tāṃ mālāṃ kṣālayetpunaḥ | udvartayeddvitīyena candanena sugandhinā || guggulvagarubhirmālāṃ tṛtīyena sudhūpayet | kastūrīcandanādyaistu caturthenānulepayet || sarvānmaṇīnpañcamena mantreṇa tvabhimantrayet | tṛtīyena tato meruṃ śatavāraṃ hi mantrayet || tatastaiḥ pañcabhirmantrairmālāṃ samyakprapūjayet" iti | anyatrāpi -- "maṇimekaikamādāya sūtre tatra niyojayet | mukhe mukhaṃ tu saṃyojya pṛṣṭhe pṛṣṭhaṃ tu yojayet || proktasaṃkhyānyamekākṣaṃ merutvenāgrato nyaset | ekaikamaṇimadhye tu granthibandhaṃ prakalpayet || mātṛkāstatra vinyasya pañcagavyaiḥ samāhitaḥ | gāyatryā mūlamantreṇa sadyojātādibhistathā || prakṣālya taireva mantrairabhimantrya sudhūpayet" iti || (granthāntare tu viśeṣāntaramuktaṃ mālāsaṃskāre -- "prāṇānāṃ sthāpanaṃ kuryāttatrā''vāhyeṣṭadevatām | iṣṭadevatāṃ yadīyamantrajapastām | mūlenābhyarcyābhimantrya mātṛkārṇaiśca mūlataḥ | mātṛkāvarṇairmūlena ca mālāmabhimantryetyarthaḥ | ājyāhutīraṣṭaśataṃ mūlena juhuyāttataḥ | saṃpātājyaṃ tu mālāyāṃ pratyāhuti vinikṣipet || homāśaktau tu mūlena mālāyā abhimantraṇam | homasaṃkhyādviguṇitasaṃkhyayā sādhakaścaret" iti ||) tantrāntare -- "japakāle prayoktavyā niyamena sumedhasā | paradṛṣṭigatā mālā niṣphalā japakarmaṇi | japakāle'kṣamālāṃ tu gurave'pi na darśayet | madhyamānāmikāṅguṣṭhairgṛhītvā japamācaret" iti || uttaratantre -- "japādau pūjayenmālāṃ toyairabhyukṣya yatnataḥ | nidhāya maṇḍalasyāntaḥ savyahastagatāṃ ca vā | iṣṭamantreṇa mālāyāḥ prokṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam || oṃ māṃ māle mahāmāye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi | caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava || pūjayitvā tato mālāṃ gṛhṇīyāddakṣiṇe kare | bījaṃ gāṇapataṃ pūrvamuccārya tadanantaram || avighnaṃ kuru māle tvamiti tāṃ prārthayeddvijaḥ | mālāṃ svatdṛdayāsanne dhṛtvā dakṣiṇapāṇinā || devīṃ vicintayañjāpyaṃ kuryādvāmena na spṛśet | japānte tāṃ namaskṛtya nidadhyānmastake tataḥ || tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama | śivaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā ||
puṣkaraṃ śikhibījasthaṃ sūkṣmasūkṣmānvitaṃ bhavet | ākāśaśaśisaṃyuktaṃ siddhyai hṛdayasaṃyutam || eṣa pañcākṣaro mantro mālāyāḥ parikīrtitaḥ | grahaṇe sthāpane caiva pūjane viniyojayet" iti || puṣkaraṃ hakāraḥ | śikhī rephaḥ | sūkṣmasūkṣmā "īkāraḥ" | ākāśaśaśibhyāṃ bindvardhacandrābhyāṃ yutam | siddhyai svarūpam | hṛdayaṃ nama iti | (japānte tāṃ mālāṃ na dhārayet | taduktaṃ tatraiva -- "na dhārayetkare mūrdhni kaṇṭhe vā japamālikām | japakāle japaṃ kṛtvā sadā śuddhasthale kṣipet" iti || anyacca(śca)viśeṣastantrāntare -- "yanmantrasya japārthaṃ sā(syā)dyā mālā saṃskṛtā tayā | tanmantrasyaiva kurvīta japaṃ nānyasya kasyacit" iti | anyo'pi tantrāntare viśeṣaḥ -- "śivamantreṇa saṃgrathya śaktimantraṃ japedapi | śaktimantreṇa saṃgrathya śivamantraṃ japecchive || dhruveṇa mātṛkābhirvā grathyante maṇayo yadi | tadā sarve'bhijaptavyā manavo mālayā tayā" iti | dhruvaḥ praṇavaḥ | "pramādādgalitā hastānmālā chinnā'thavā bhavet | spṛṣṭā vā syāniṣiddhena mūlamaṣṭaśataṃ japet" iti ||) atha tṛtīyā karamālā | "madhyamāyā madhyamūlaparvaṇī tridaśeśvari | meruṃ kṛtvā japaṃ kuryāttarjanīmūlakāvadhi || anāmāmadhyaparvādi prādakṣiṇyakrameṇa vai" iti | (aṣṭottaraśatāṣṭottarasahasrādisaṃkhyopayuktā karamālā bhairavītantre -- "anāmāmadhyamārabhya kaniṣṭhānukrameṇa tu | madhyamāmūlaparyantā karamālā prakīrtitā" iti || gautamo'pyāha -- "kaniṣṭhānāmikāṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhirjapetsadā" iti | anāmāmadhyamūlakaniṣṭhāmūlamadhyāgrānāmāgramadhyamāgramadhyamūlaparyantamiti navasu parvasu gaṇanāyāṃ kṛtāyāṃ navavāraṃ mantrajapo bhavati | evaṃ dvādaśavāraṃ punaḥ punarāvartanenāṣṭottaraśatajapo bhavati | dvādaśottaraśatāvṛttyā'ṣṭottarasahasrajapo bhavati | itthamayutādiṣvapyūhanīyam |) atha japavidhiḥ | kapilapañcarātre -- "ekacittaḥ praśāntātmā'pyakṣasūtrakaraḥ śuciḥ | bhugnagrīvonnataḥ śāntaḥ kaṇḍūnmīlanavarjitaḥ || savisargaṃ samātraṃ ca sabinduṃ sākṣaraṃ sphuṭam | na drutaṃ nāpi viśrāntaṃ kramānmantraṃ japetsudhīḥ" iti || vyāsaḥ -- "na ca krāmanna ca hasanna pārśvamavalokayan | nāpāśrito na jalpaṃśca na prāvṛtaśirāstathā || na padā pādamākramya na caiva hi tathā karau | na cāsamāhitamanā na ca saṃśrāvayañjapet" iti || baudhāyano'pi -- "nābheradhastu saṃsparśaṃ karmayukto hi varjayet" iti | vyāso'pi -- "japakāle na bhāṣeta vratahomādikeṣu ca | eteṣvevāvasaktastu yathā gacchandvijottamaḥ || abhivādya tato vipraṃ yogaṃ kṣemaṃ ca kīrtayet" iti | gautamo'pi -- "krodhaṃ mohaṃ kṣutaṃ nidrāṃ niṣṭhīvanavijṛmbhaṇe | darśanaṃ ca śvanīcānāṃ varjayejjapakarmaṇi" iti || nṛsiṃhapurāṇe -- "trividho japayajñaḥ syāttasya bhedaṃ nibodhata | vācikaśca upāṃśuśca mānasastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ || trayāṇāṃ japayajñānāṃ śreyānsyāduttarottaraḥ" iti | vācikopāṃśutvayorlakṣaṇaṃ purāṇe'bhihitam -- "yaduccanīcasvaritaiḥ śabdaiḥ spaṣṭapadākṣaraiḥ | mantramuccārayedvācā vāciko'yaṃ japaḥ smṛtaḥ || śanairuccārayenmantramīṣadoṣṭhau pracālayet | aparairaśrutaḥ kiṃcitsa upāṃśujapaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || viśvāmitreṇa mānasasya lakṣaṇamuktam -- "dhiyā yadakṣaraśreṇyā varṇādvarṇaṃ padātpadam | śabdārthacintanaṃ bhūyaḥ kathyate mānaso japaḥ" iti || trayāṇāṃ tāratamyaṃ ca tenaivoktam -- "uttamaṃ mānasaṃ japyamupāṃśu madhyamaṃ smṛtam | adhamaṃ vācikaṃ prāhuḥ sarvamantreṣu vai dvijaḥ(jāḥ) || . vācikasyaikamekaṃ syādupāṃśu śatamucyate | sahasraṃ mānasaḥ prokto manvatribhṛgunāradaiḥ" iti || japalakṣaṇamāha kumbhasaṃbhavaḥ -- "gurorlabdhasya mantrasya śaśvadāvartanaṃ hi yat | antaraṅgākṣarāṇāṃ ca nyāsapūrvo japaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || aṅgeti sutīkṣṇasaṃbodhanam | akṣarāṇāmantarāvartanaṃ japa iti saṃbandhaḥ | vāyavīyasaṃhitāyām -- "evamuktavidhānena vilambatvaritaṃ vinā | uktasaṃkhyaṃ japaṃ kuryātpuraścaraṇasiddhaye || devatāgurumantrāṇāmaikyaṃ saṃbhāvayandhiyā | japedekamanāḥ prātaḥkālānmadhyaṃdināvadhi || yatsaṃkhyayā samārabdhaṃ tatkartavyaṃ dine dine | yadi nyūnādhikaṃ kuryādvratabhraṣṭo bhavennaraḥ" iti || ayaṃ ca japo divaiva kāryaḥ | "divā caiva japaṃ kuryātpauraścaraṇiko vidhiḥ" | iti phetkāriṇītantre divāpadābhidhānāt | 'japaṃ rātrau vivarjayet |' iti kumbhasaṃbhavena rātrijapaniṣedhācca | deśakālādyupadravasaṃbhāvanāyāṃ nāyaṃ niyamaḥ | "yatsaṃkhyayā samārabdhaṃ pratyahaṃ tāvadeva hi | japakarma prakurvītopaplave niyamo nahi" iti tantrāntaravacanāt || tatrāpi caturthabhāgaparyantameva japta(pita) vyaṃ na pañcamabhāge | "rākṣasī nāma velā sā garhitā sarvakarmasu" || iti matsyapurāṇe ninditatvāt | vaiśampāyanaḥ -- "nairantaryavidhiḥ prokto na dinaṃ vyatilaṅghayet | divasātikramātpuṃso mantrasiddhirbhavenna hi || yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ japedahni pūrvasmiṃstāvadeva tu | dināntare'pi prajapedanyathā siddhirodhakṛt" iti || phetkāriṇītantre -- "japakāle yadā paśyedaśuciṃ mantravittamaḥ | prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā japaśeṣaṃ samāpayet || yadā caivaṃ bhavenmantrī svayamapyaśuciḥ punaḥ | snātvā''camya yathāpūrvaṃ nyāsaṃ kṛtvā punarjapet" iti || nyāso'dhikārasaṃpādakaḥ | etena mūtrotsargādāvaśucitvasaṃbhavaścetsnānamanyathā prāṇāyāmakaraṣaḍaṅganyāsānkṛtvā śeṣaṃ samāpayediti pratīyate | nāsikāpuṭacāriṇaḥ" iti || yogayājñavalkyaḥ -- "yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syājjapādiṣu kadācana | vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ mantraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam" iti || vaiṣṇava mantra idaṃ viṣṇuriti | saṃvarto'pi -- "lokavārtādikaṃ śrutvā śrutvā ca pu(pa)ruṣaṃ vacaḥ | saṃkhyāṃ vinā ca yajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet" iti || (gautamo'pi -- "gacchatastiṣṭhato vā'pi svecchayā karma kurvataḥ | aśucervā vinā saṃkhyāṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet" iti ||) nāradaḥ -- "saṃkhyāpūrtau nijairdravyairjapasaṃkhyādaśāṃśataḥ | yathoktakuṇḍe juhuyādyathāvidhi samāhitaḥ || athavā pratyahaṃ japtvā juhuyāttu daśāṃśataḥ" iti | (lakṣānte lakṣānte homādi, ityapi tantrāntare | homāśaktau brāhmaṇānāṃ puraścaraṇajapasaṃkhyādviguṇo japa iti mukhyaḥ pakṣaḥ | homasaṃkhyādviguṇo japa iti gauṇaḥ | kṣattriyādīnāṃ triguṇādijapaḥ śyāmaṃ caturbhujam | devakītanayaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pītavāsasamacyutam || samarpayantaṃ viprāya naṣṭānānīya bālakān | mayūrabarhiśirasaṃ dhyāye saudāminīnibham" ityapyanyatra ||
eteṣāmanyatamena yathākāmaṃ dhyātvā mānasopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya kalaśārādhanaṃ kuryāt | śuddhajalapūritaṃ kalaśaṃ svavāmabhāge saṃsthāpya kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇurityādinā tasminkumbhe'ṅkuśamudrayā tīrthānyāvāhayet | kalaśaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ saṃpūjya taddakṣiṇataḥ prakṣālitaṃ śaṅkhamādhārapātre saṃsthāpya kalaśodakena śaṅkhaṃ pūrayitvā śaṅkhamudrāṃ pradarśya, "oṃ pāñcajanyāya vidmahe pāvamānāya dhīmahi | tannaḥ śaṅkhaḥ pracodayāt" iti śaṅkhagāyatryā taṃ gandhapuṣpākṣataiḥ saṃpūjya tadudakaṃ kiṃcitkalaśe prakṣipya śaṅkhātkiṃcidudakaṃ pātrāntare gṛhītvā tena jalena pūjādravyāṇi bhūmimātmānaṃ ca prokṣya jagaddhvanimantramātaḥ svāheti ghaṇṭāṃ saṃpūjya, "āgamārthaṃ tu devānāṃ gamanārthaṃ tu rakṣasām | kuru ghaṇṭe śubhaṃ nādaṃ devatāhvānalāñchanam" iti vādayet || tato mahī dyaurityādividhinā kalaśaṃ saṃsthāpya śuddhajalena pūraṇādipūrṇapātranidhānāntaṃ kṛtvā tatra varuṇamāvāhya saṃpūjayet | tatastadupari pītaṃ vastramāstīrya, kṛtvā balavardhananāmānaṃ laukikāgniṃ sthaṇḍile pratiṣṭhāpya prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādi prāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā mālāsaṃskārahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatā tāṃ parigrahīṣyāmi | mūlamantreṇa mantradevatāmaṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyākābhirājyāhutibhi ryakṣye | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣājyāhutyā yakṣya ityuktvā'nvādhānasamidabhyādhānādyāpūrvikatantreṇa pradhānahomātpūrvatanaṃ karma kuryāt | tataḥ -- "oṃ klīṃ devakīsuta govinda vāsudeva jagatpate | dehi me tanayaṃ kṛṣṇa tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ svāhā" || iti mūlamantreṇāṣṭottaraśatamājyāhutīrjuhuyāt | pratyāhuti saṃpātājyaṃ mālāyāṃ nikṣipet | agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhetyekāṃ hutaśeṣājyāhutiṃ hutvottarapariṣekādyāpūrvikatantreṇottarāṅgāni(ṇi) kuryāt | homāśaktau homasaṃkhyādviguṇasaṃkhyayā mūlena mālābhimantraṇam | tataḥ -- hrīṃ siddhyai nama iti mantreṇa mālāṃ devatābhāvanayā saṃpūjayet | iti mālāsaṃskāraḥ | tataḥ -- "oṃ māṃ māle mahāmāye sarvaśaktisvarūpiṇi | caturvargastvayi nyastastasmānme siddhidā bhava, hrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ" || iti mālāṃ namaskṛtya hrīṃ siddhyai nama iti dakṣiṇakare gṛhītvā gaṇapatibījamuccārya, avighnaṃ kuru māle tvamiti saṃprārthya vastrādinā''cchāditāṃ mālāṃ svahṛdayasamīpe dhṛtvā'ṅguṣṭhamadhyamābhyāṃ maṇīnāvartayanyathoktabrahmacaryādiniyamavānunnatagātro manasopāṃśu vā madhyāhnaparyantaṃ yathāśakti japaṃ kuryāt | ārambhadivase yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ japaḥ kṛtastāvatsaṃkhya eva pratyahaṃ kāryaḥ | upadravasaṃbhāvanāyāṃ divasacaturthabhāgaparyantamapi japaḥ kartavyaḥ | na tatra saṃkhyātikramadoṣaḥ | japasamāptau tāṃ mālāṃ hrīṃ siddhyai nama iti namaskṛtya, "tvaṃ māle sarvadevānāṃ prītidā śubhadā mama | śivaṃ kuruṣva me bhadre yaśo vīryaṃ ca sarvadā, hrīṃ siddhyai namaḥ" iti mālāṃ śirasi nidhāya suguptasthale nidadhyāt | tato mūlena prāṇānāyamya pūrvavatkaranyāsāṅganyāsānkṛtvā pūrvavaddhyātvā devaṃ pañcopacāraiḥ saṃpūjya, "guhyātigṛhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japam | siddhirbhavatu deveśa tvatprasādānmayi sthirā" || iti jaladhārayā devasya dakṣiṇahaste japaṃ nivedayet | yadyanyadīyaṃ japaṃ karoti tadā mayītyatra yajamāna ityūhaḥ | evaṃ puraścaraṇa samāptiparyantaṃ pratyahaṃ devaṃ saṃpūjyā''sanavidhyādi mūrtisaṃskārāvāhanamālāsaṃskāravarjaṃ japanivedanāntaṃ karma kuryāt | samāpte puraścaraṇe homaṃ kuryāt | sa yathā -- ācamya prāṇānāyamya gaṇeśaṃ saṃpūjya brahmādīnvṛtvā pūjayet | atra puṇyāhavācanamapi kecitkurvanti | tato devasya pūjāṃ vidhāya kuṇḍakaraṇollepanādyagnisthāpanāntaṃ kuryāt | atra balavardhananāmā'gniḥ | tato'nvādhānam | samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā sutapradagopālakṛṣṇamantrajapadaśāṃśahomakarmaṇi yā ityādi prasādhanīdevyantaṃ vyāhṛtyantaṃ voktvā pradhānahome -- sutapradagopālakṛṣṇaṃ mūlamantreṇa japadaśāṃśasaṃkhyābhirājyakṣīramadhvaktatilāhutibhiryakṣye | pīṭhadevatā āvaraṇadevatāścaikaikayā''jyakṣīramadhvaktatilāhutyā''jyāhutyā vā yakṣye | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣadravyāhutyā yakṣya ityādi | aṅgahome varuṇaṃ dvābhyāmityādi vā | pātrāsādana ājyena saha kṣīramadhutilānāsādayet | tato brahmopaveśanādi | ājyaparyagnikaraṇakāle tilānājyakṣīramadhubhirabhyaktānkṛtvā teṣāmapyājyena saha paryagnikaraṇaṃ kuryāt | tataḥ paridhiparidhānādyanvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇa prasādhanīhomāntaṃ vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ vā kṛtvā pradhānahomamṛtvigbhiḥ kārayet | ṛtvijo dvirācamya kṛtanyagjānukāḥ kṛtaprāṇāyāmāsanavidhibhūtaśuddhyādyṛṣyādinyāsāḥ prāṅmukhā udaṅmukhā vā mṛgīmudrayā sāvadhānamanaso homaṃ kuryuḥ | tilāśculakamitāḥ śatasaṃkhyā vā | ājyaṃ karṣapramāṇam | karṣastu daśaguñjāmitamāṣaṣoḍaśakapramāṇaḥ | annaṃ grāsamitam | anekadinasādhye home tu pratidivasaṃ kayācitsaṃkhyayā vahnirakṣaṇapūrvakaṃ śubhadine samāptiṃ kuryāt | pratidinaṃ homādyantayoḥ pradhānadevatāṅgadevatāḥ pūjayet | ārambhe samāptidine'gniṃ mūlamantreṇa svāhāsvadhāsahitaṃ pūjayet | samāpte pradhānahome svayameva pīṭhadevatābhya āvaraṇadevatābhyaścaikaikamājyakṣīramadhvaktatilāhutimājyāhutiṃ vā'nvādhānotkīrtitapakṣānusāreṇa hutvā hutaśeṣeṇa sviṣṭakṛdādyaṅgahomādi vā'nvādhānotkīrtanānusāreṇa kuryāt | prāyaścittahomākaraṇapakṣe sviṣṭakṛdante tatkaraṇapakṣe tadante vā pūrṇāhutiṃ hutvā homaśeṣaṃ samāpya devasyottarapūjāṃ kuryāt | tata ṛtvijaḥ sapatnīkaṃ yajamānaṃ kalaśodakenā''po hi ṣṭhādyairmantrairabhiṣiñceyuḥ | tato yajamāna ṛtvigbhyo hiraṇyaṃ tanniṣkrayaṃ vā yathāvibhavaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā gurave pīṭhasahitāṃ pratimāṃ dattvā homakarmeśvarāyārpayet | tato mūlamantramuktvā sutapradaṃ gopālakṛṣṇaṃ tarpayāmi nama iti homadaśāṃśena dugdhena jalena vā tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantrānte sutapradaṃ gopālakṛṣṇamabhiṣiñcāmi nama iti tarpaṇadaśāṃśena mārjanaṃ vidhāya mārjanadaśāṃśena brāhmaṇānbhojayet | svasya puraścaraṇakaraṇāśaktāvetatprayogābhijñenā''cāryeṇa kārayet | tasmā eva pratimāṃ dadyāt | yatra homa eva prayogaviśeṣe phalapradatvātpradhānaṃ na punarjapāṅgaṃ tatra brāhmaṇabhojanasaṃkhyā tantre viśeṣānuktā smṛtyuktā grāhyā | tatra lakṣahome ṣaṣṭyadhikā navaśatī mukhyaḥ pakṣaḥ | viṃśatyadhikā pañcaśatī madhyamaḥ | daśādhikā triśatyadhamaḥ | yatra pradhānadevatāṅgatvena smṛtitantroktayoravirodhe samuccayapakṣamāśritya grahā api pūjyante tatra tadaṅgabrāhmaṇabhojanamapi kāryam | tatrottame pakṣe viṃśatyadhikā saptaśatī brāhmaṇānāṃ bhojanīyā | madhyamapakṣe catvāriṃśaduttaraṃ śatatrayam | adhamapakṣe daśādhikaṃ śatamiti | kalau caturguṇaṃ proktamitivacanāccaturlakṣātmakaṃ puraścaraṇaṃ kṛtvā kāmyaprayogaṃ kuryāt | tatra mamāpatyotpattibandhakībhūtasakaladoṣanivṛttisaṃtatikṣemasuputraprāptidvārā sutapradagopālakṛṣṇaprītyarthaṃ caturlakṣaṃ sutapradagopālakṛṣṇamantrajapamahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpavākye viśeṣaḥ | ācāryapakṣa ācāryadvārā kariṣya iti saṃkalpa ūhet | strīkartṛkajapapakṣe homādikamācāryādidvāraiva | atrāṣṭottaraśatasaṃkhyākānviprānbhojayet | anyatsamānaṃ puraścaraṇavat | tāntrikahomavidhistu matkṛte sāmānyahomavidhau draṣṭavyaḥ | (atha puraścaraṇakāle vihitāni -- manaḥsthairyaśaucamaunamantrārthacintanānirvedaśraddhotsāhasaṃtoṣendriyanigrahabrahmacaryagurupraṇatitrikāladevatārcanaparvaviśeṣanimittakaviśeṣārcanadevastutidevaviśvāsaguruviśvāsamadhyapatravarjapalāśapatrāvalībhojanamitaikavārahaviṣyabhojanarātribhojanaprakṣālitadarbhāstīrṇadhautavastraśayanatriṣavaṇasnānādīni | aśaktau tu prātaḥsnānamātram | atha niṣiddhāni -- apriyānṛtabhāṣaṇadambhonmādacalanavyagratālasyaniṣṭhīvanakrodhapādaprasāraṇatāmbūlavapanadivāsvāpakarañjavibhītakārkasnuhi(hī)cchāyākramaṇakauṭilyanṛtyagītapratigrahādīkṣitastrīśūdrapatitanāstikādisaṃbhāṣaṇacaṇḍālādīkṣaṇabahvekamalinavastradhāraṇakāmyakarmāvihitakarmakāṃsyapātrabhojanāsatsaṅgoṣṇajalasnānakañcukoṣṇīṣadhāraṇaprāṇihiṃsāpādukāyānaśayyārohaṇanagnatvakuśarahitakaratvātibhojanādīni | vibhītako behaḍā iti | snuhi(hī) niga(va)ḍuṅga iti | kāṃsyapātrabhojananiṣedhātsauvarṇādīnāmanyenānupabhuktānāmabhyanujñā gamyate | bhojyabhakṣyāṇi tu śuklaikavidhānnahaimantanīvārakaṅguṣaṣṭikā yavāḥ śūdrānavahatā guḍavarjitamaikṣavaṃ kṛṣṇatilamudgakalāyakandaviśeṣanālikerakadalīlavalīpanasāmrāmalakārdrakasāmudralavaṇānuddhṛtasāragavyapippalījīrakanāraṅgādīni | niṣiddhāni tu -- guḍakṛtrimalavaṇaparyuṣitaniḥsnehakīṭādidūṣitakāñjikagṛñjanavṛntākaśigrubilvakarañjalaśunapalāṇḍumūlakādīni | tailapakvamāṣamasūracaṇakagodhūmadevadhānyādīni ca |) iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāmanapatyatvaharavidhānaharivaṃśaśravaṇavidhipārthivapūjanavidhisaṃtānagopālakṛṣṇamantravidhayaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ pañcadaśaṃ prakaraṇam || 15 || <16> atha ṣoḍaśaṃ prakaraṇam | vyāsenauṣadhirūpā apyupāyā uktāḥ -- "aṅkolamūlakalkaṃ tu cūrṇayedguḍasaṃyutam | kākāṇḍamitamaśnīyātputriṇī sahasā bhavet || kṣīravṛkṣāṅkuraṃ gṛhya peṣayitvā payaḥ pibet | devodarakṛto doṣo vinaśyati śubhaṃ labhet ||
uttamaṃ karṇikāmūlaṃ peṣayitvā payaḥ pibet | sā pāyasānnaṃ nāśnīyātputriṇī sahasā bhavet" iti || kṣīravṛkṣāṅkuro vaṭāṅkuraḥ | karṇikā gokarṇī | "nāgakeśarasaṃyuktaṃ jīrakaṃ goghṛtena ca | tridinaṃ yā pibennārī sā garbhaṃ labhate dhruvam" iti || tīrtharūpamupāyamāha parāśaraḥ -- "mahātīrthe mahāyoge mahānadyāṃ tu saṃgame | palāśasya dalaiḥ snānaṃ kuryātputrasukhārthinī" iti || devarātaśca -- "palāśadalasāhasrātsāvitreṇa dalaṃ prati | snapayetsapavitreṇa ekādaśyāṃ prajārthinī" iti || (baudhāyanagṛhye'pi -- "atha prajārthahomaḥ pūrvapakṣe puṇye nakṣatre'māvāsyāyāṃ viṣuve'yane vā nadītīre'śvatthasya cchāyāyāṃ vā gocarmamātraṃ caturaśraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyṛddhimiti vācayitvā prācyāṃ diśi brahmāṇaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya pārśvayordhātāraṃ dakṣiṇato vidhātāramuttaratastatastānarcayetpūrvaṃ brahmāṇamāvāhayāmi prajāpatimāvāhayāmi parameṣṭhinamāvāhayāmi hiraṇyagarbhamāvāhayāmītyāvāhya sāvitryā pādyaṃ dadāti sāvitryā nivedayettaireva nāmadheyaiḥ śuklamannaṃ brahmaṇe mudgānnaṃ dhātuḥ pītānnaṃ vidhātustataḥ sāvitryā'pa ācamayya praṇavenāṣṭaśataṃ hutvā brahmāṇamupatiṣṭhate namo vāce namo vācaspataya ityagnimupatiṣṭhate namo brahmaṇe saptavitsaptajihvaśca saptadhā'gniḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ saptaiva viśvabhūtāni ko hyagniḥ pratitiṣṭhati tattvamasi viśvamasi yonirasītyatha striyamāhūya sāvitryā palāśaparṇairaṣṭasahasraiḥ snāpayitvā puruṣasūktena juhuyāttatsaṃpātena mūrdhni juhuyātpraṇavena namaskuryādadhvaryuṃ ca vastrakuṇḍalābhyāmalaṃ karoti tataḥ sā garbhiṇī bhavatītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | pārśvayorbrahmaṇaḥ | tānbrahmadhātṛvidhātṝn | dhātāramāvāhayāmītyevaṃ dhātṛvi dhātrorāvāhanādi | nivedanaṃ naivedyasya | aṣṭasahasrairaṣṭādhikasahasraiḥ | anyatspaṣṭārtham |) nīcamehanasya vājīkaraṇamuktaṃ vaḍavācāryeṇa -- "vājīvātibalo yena yātyapratihato yataḥ | tadvājīkaraṇaṃ nāma dehasyaujaskaraṃ param" iti || tatprayogaśca tenaivoktaḥ -- "bhallātakabṛhatīphaladāḍimakalkaprasādhitaṃ kurute | liṅgonmardanaṃ vi(navi)dhinā kaṭutailaṃ vājiliṅgābham" iti || vaidyakagranthe -- " sitāśvagandhāsindhūtthacchāgakṣīraighṛtaṃ pacet | tallepānmardanālliṅgavṛddhiḥ saṃjāyate parā" iti || sitā śarkarā | aśvagandhā''skandaḥ | sindhūtthaṃ saindhavam | evamanye'pyupāyā vaidyakagranthapañcasāyakādau draṣṭavyāḥ | evamapi phalāprāptau dattakaputrasvīkāraṃ kuryāt | atha dattaputravidhānam | tadvidhirbaudhāyanasūtre -- "putrapratigrahavidhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ śukraśoṇitasaṃbhavo mātṛ(tā)pitṛnimittakastasya pradānaparityāgavikrayeṣu mātāpitarau prabhavato na tvevaikaṃ putraṃ dadyātpratigṛhṇīyādvā sa hi saṃtānāya pūrveṣāṃ na strī putraṃ dadyātpratigṛhṇīyādvā'nyatrānujñānādbhartuḥ pratigrahīṣyannupakalpayate dve vāsasī dve kuṇḍale aṅgulīyakaṃ cā''cāryaṃ ca vedapāragaṃ kuśamayaṃ barhiḥ parṇamayamidhmamityatha bandhūnāhūya madhye rājani cā''vedya pariṣadi cāgāramadhye brāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāha svastyṛddhimiti vācayitvā'tha devayajanollekhanaprabhṛtyā praṇītābhyaḥ kṛtvā dātuḥ samakṣaṃ gatvā putraṃ medehīti bhikṣeta dadāmītītara āha taṃ parigṛhṇāti dharmāya tvā gṛhṇāmi saṃtatyai tvā gṛhṇāmītyathainaṃ vastrābhyāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmaṅgulīyakena cālaṃkṛtya paridhānaprabhṛtyā'gnimukhātkṛtvā pakvānnuhoti yastvā hṛdā kīriṇā manyamāna iti puronuvākyāmanūcya yasmai tva sukṛte jātaveda iti yājyayā juhotyatha vyāhṛtīrhatvā sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti siddhamā dhenuvarapradānāddakṣiṇāṃ dadātyete ca vāsasī ete kuṇḍale etaccāṅgulīyakaṃ yadyevaṃ kṛtvaurasaḥ putra utpadyate turīyabhāge prabhavatītyāha bhagavānbaudhāyanaḥ" iti | mātāpitṛnimittakaḥ śukraśoṇitasaṃbhava ityanvayaḥ | mātāpitṛnimittaka ityanena kṣetrajādivyāvṛttiḥ | idaṃ ca saṃbhavaviśeṣaṇam | śukraśoṇitasaṃbhava ityanantaraṃ yasyeti śeṣaḥ | etenaurasasyaiva pradānaparityāgavikrayā nānyeṣāṃ dattakādīnāmiti sūcyate | mātāpitarau prabhavata iti | mātāpitroreva dānādhikāra ityāśayaḥ | sa hi saṃtānāya pūrveṣām | hi yasmātsa ekaḥ putraḥ pūrveṣāṃ saṃtānāya bhavatyata ekaṃ putraṃ naiva dadyādityarthaḥ | aṅgulīyakaṃ cetyatra cakāraśchatrādisamuccayārthaḥ | kuśamayaṃ barhiriti pratinidhirnaivātra bhavatīti jñāpanārtham | evaṃ parṇamayamidhmamityatrāpi | madhya iti | bandhusamakṣaṃ rājanyāvedanaṃ kāryamityāśayaḥ | aṅgulīyakamityanantaramanuṣaktena dadātītyanena putrasaṃbandhivastradvayakuṇḍalāṅgulīyakadānaṃ vidhīyate | striyā tu bhartranujñayā grāhyaḥ | sā ca sadhavāyā eva dṛṣṭārthatvāt | vidhavāyāstu tāṃ vinā'pi pitustadabhāve jñātīnāmājñayā bhavati | ata eva -- "rakṣetkanyāṃ pitā vinnāṃ patiputrāstu vārdhake | abhāve jñātayasteṣāṃ na svātantryaṃ kvacitstriyāḥ" || iti yājñavalkyenāvasthāviśeṣa eva bhartuḥ pāratantryamuktam | tadabhāve vārdhakādinā tasyākṣamatāyāṃ vā putrādīnāmapi | kātyāyanenāpi -- "nārī khalvananujñātā pitrā bhartrā sutena vā | viphalaṃ tadbhavettasmādyatkarotyaurdhvadehikam" || ityavasthāviśeṣa eva pitṛbhartrādyanujñoktā | aurdhvadehikaṃ pāralaukikam | yasyāmavasthāyāṃ bharturanujñā prāptā saivātrānūdyate na tvapūrvā vidhīyate'to vidhavā yā bharturanujñāṃ vinā'pyadhikāra iti navīnāḥ | pariṇīta utpannaputro'pi ca dattako bhavatīti dvaitanirṇaye | yattu dattakamīmāṃsādau vṛddhagautamīyaṃ, "dattaputre yathājāte kadācittvauraso bhavet | piturvittasya sarvasya bhavetāṃ samabhāginau" || iti vacanaṃ taddattakasya guṇavattva aurasasya ca nirguṇatve veditavyam, yathājāta iti viśeṣaṇāt | yathā guṇānāṃ jātaṃ samūho yasminniti yathājāto guṇasamūhavānityarthaḥ | yathāśabdasya guṇayoge sādṛśye śaktatvāt | ata eva manuḥ -- "upapanno guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ putro yasya tu dattimaḥ | sa haretaiva tadrikthaṃ saṃprāpto'pyanyagotrataḥ" ityaurasābhāve sarvarikthagrahaṇamuktavān | tadyuktamevaurase satyardhāṃśaharatvam | parigrahavidhyabhāve viśeṣamāha sa eva -- "avidhāya vidhānaṃ yaḥ parigṛhṇāti putrakam | vivāhavidhibhājaṃ taṃ kuryānna dhanabhājanam" iti || parigrahavidhiṃ vinā parigṛhītasya vivāhamātraṃ kāryaṃ na dhanadānamityarthaḥ | kiṃtu tatra patnyādaya eva dhanabhājaḥ | vidhiṃ vinā tasya putratvānutpādāt | ata eva vṛddhagautamaḥ -- "svagotreṣu kṛtā ye syurdattakrītādayaḥ sutāḥ | vidhinā gotratāṃ yānti na sāpiṇḍyaṃ vidhīyate" iti || vidhinaiva gotratāṃ yāntīti niyamaḥ | dānādividhīnāṃ dattakādilakṣaṇāntargatatvena svarūpanirvāhakatvāt | yathoktam -- "yamadbhiḥ putramāpadi" iti | āpadgrahaṇaṃ sakaladānavidherupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ca pratigrahavidhirapyākṣipto bhavati | saṃprāpto'pyanyagotrata iti mānavāt | samyagvidhinā prāptami(pta i)tyarthaḥ | etadabhipretyaiva ca vasiṣṭhenāpi tasya dānavikrayaparityāgeṣu mātāpitarau prabhavata ityupakramya parigrahavidhirabhihitaḥ | manuvākye krītādaya ityādiśabdena kṛtrimāpaviddhasvayaṃdattānāṃ grahaṇam | tasmādeṣāṃ pañcānāṃ putrāṇāṃ baudhāyanādyuktavidhiparigraheṇaiva putratvaṃ nānyatheti | vistarastvanyatrānusaṃdheyaḥ | tatra pañcavārṣikastato nyūnaḥ pitṛgotreṇākṛtacūḍaśca pratigrāhyaḥ | nādhikavayaskaḥ kṛtacūḍaśca | tatra putro bhrāturgrāhyaḥ | tadabhāve sagotraḥ sapiṇḍo'pi yaḥ kaścit | tadabhāve tvasagotraḥ sapiṇḍaḥ | tadabhāve tvasapiṇḍaḥ sagotraḥ | tadabhāve tvasapiṇḍo'sagotro'pi | tatrāpi bhāgineyadauhitramātṛṣvasrīyapitṛṣvasrīyavarjaṃ putratvabuddhyanarhabhrātṛpitṛvyamātulavarjaṃ ca | trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ svasamānavarṇa eva | tatrāpi deśabhedaprayuktagurjaratvādijātyā samānajātīya eva | sarvo'pi sabhrātṛka eva jyeṣṭhabhinnaśceti | atra pramāṇaṃ prācīnanavīnagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam, vistarabhītyā na pradarśyate | (atra nakṣatrādikamuktaṃ vyavahārasāre -- "hastādipañcakabhiṣagvasupuṣyabheṣu sūryakṣamājagurubhārgavavāsareṣu | riktāvivarjitatithiṣvalikumbhasiṃhavṛṣeṣu vai bhavati dattaparigraho'yam" iti || hastādipañcakaṃ hastacitrāsvātīviśākhānūrādhāḥ | bhiṣagaśvinī nakṣatram | vasuḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ | kṣamājo bhaumaḥ | anyatspaṣṭam |) atha prayogaḥ | pūrvedyuḥ kṛtopavāso vāsasī kuṇḍale aṅgulīyakaṃ chatramuṣṇīṣamācāryaṃ dharmasaṃyuktaṃ vedapāragaṃ kuśamayaṃ barhiḥ pālāśamidhmamanyāṃ homasāmagrīṃ ca saṃpādya śiṣṭāniṣṭāñjñātīnbandhūṃścā''hūya tānsaṃpūjya tatsamakṣaṃ rājñi sabhāsatsu ca nivedya tairanujñātaḥ pavitrapāṇirācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya mamāprajatvaprayuktapaitṛkarṇāpākaraṇasiddhipunaṃnāmanarakatrāṇasiddhidvārā śrīparameśvaraprītyarthaṃ putrapratigrahaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya tadaṅgatvena gaṇapatiṃ saṃpūjya bandhuvargebhyo viniyoga iti viniyogavākye viśeṣaḥ | tataḥ sviṣṭakṛdādi, aṅgahomādi vā homaśeṣaṃ samāpyā''cāryāya dhenuṃ dadyāt | te eva vāsasī kuṇḍale aṅgulīyakaṃ ca | dhenudānaṃ na vā | tato daśa trīnvā anyatrānujñānādbharturitipratiprasavena pradhānādhikārasiddhāvadhikṛtādhikāreṇa homamantrādiprāptau strīśūdrāṇāmamantrakamiti
