"athoḍhakṣetrajakṛtrimaputrikāputrastrīdvārajāsurādyūḍhajadakṣiṇājānāṃ pitrośca" iti satyāṣāḍhasūtre strīdvārajasya gotradvayasaṃbandho'bhihitaḥ "māturuttaraṃ pituḥ prathamam" iti sūtreṇeti | pitṛgotrasaṃbandhaśca putratvena | putratvaṃ ca pitranujñānenaiva na parigraheṇa, vratasya tatra strīkartṛkatvāt | ūḍhaḥ sahoḍhaḥ | strīdvārajaḥ striyā yācitaḥ strīsattākaḥ | yajñe dakṣiṇātvena prāptāyāṃ kanyāyāṃ jāto dakṣiṇājaḥ | anye prasiddhāḥ, iti śabarasvāminaḥ | nanu sūtrakṛtā " na svāmitvasya bhāryāyāḥ putrasya deśasya kālasyāgnerdevatāyāḥ karmaṇaḥ śabdasya ca pratinidhirvidyate" iti putrapratinidhinirākaraṇāddattakaputrasvīkaraṇamanupapannamiti cenna | tasya "tantave jyotiṣmatīṃ tāmāśiṣamāśāse" ityādau pitāputrīyasubrahmaṇyāhvānādau ca putrapratinidhiṃ kṛtvā''śīrāśaṃsanapravacananivṛttyarthatvāt | anyathā "putrapratinidhīnāhuḥ" ityādibahusmṛtiviplavāpatteḥ | "tāmāśiṣamāśāse tantave jyotiṣmatīmiti brūyādyasya putro jātaḥ syāttejasvyevāsya brahmavarcasī putro jāyate" iti śrutirapyāśīrāśaṃsanaṃ putrapratinidhiṃ kṛtvā na kartavyamityatra sādhiketi draṣṭavyam | iti putrapratigrahavidhiḥ | atha punaḥsaṃdhānam | tatra gṛhyasūtram -- "dvādaśāhaṃ vicchinnaḥ punarādheyaḥ pratisaṃkhyāya vā sarvānhomāñjuhuyāt" iti | dvādaśāhaṃ vicchinna ityatra homaścediti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca dvādaśāhaṃ homavicchede punaragnirādheya ityarthaḥ | athavā tāvatsaṃkhyānsāyaṃprātarhomānpratisaṃkhyāya gaṇayitvā samasyavidhinā juhuyādityarthaḥ | nātra punaragnirādheyaḥ | ayaṃ ca pakṣaḥ saṃkaṭe | anyānyapi nimittāni gṛhya uktāni -- "yadi pārvaṇo vicchidyeta tasminpāthikṛtena yājayedyadi dvau vaiśvānarapāthikṛtau yadi bahūnpunarādheyo yadi nāśo vināśo vā'nyairagnibhiragnau saṃsṛṣṭe vā punarādheyaḥ" iti | pārvaṇaḥ parvasu bhavaḥ sthālīpākaḥ | tasminniti nimittasaptamī, tannimittamityarthaḥ | nāśa ityatrāgneriti śeṣaḥ | "bhāryāyāṃ proṣitāyāṃ cedudetyarko'stameti vā | tasya syātpunarādheyam" ityādivacanaproktanimittāni viśabdena grāhyāṇīti sūcyate | yo'gnisattvepi tasya nāśaḥ sa vināśaśabdenocyate | vastutastu -- adhikamevedaṃ prayogavaijayantyāmadhṛtatvāt | śatadvayyām -- "vihārakāle yadi kāryadoṣātpatnī tu sīmānamatītya gacchet | niḥsaṃśayo'gniḥ khalu nāśameti gṛhasya sīmā'tra vivakṣitā syāt" iti || maṇḍanaḥ -- "agnihotreṇa rahitaḥ panthānaṃ śatayojanam | āhitāgniḥ prayāyāccedagnihotraṃ vinaśyati" iti || agnihotreṇa sahita ityapi keṣucitpustakeṣu pāṭho dṛśyate | tathā -- "abdaṃ svayamajuhvanyo(dyo) hāvayedṛtvigādinā | tasya syātpunarādheyaṃ pavitreṣṭirathāpi vā" iti || tathā -- "mantraṃ vinā samārūḍho'raṇyorātmani vā yadi | tatra jvalanaśāntiḥ syādasamārūḍhaśāntivat || ārūḍho'pi yathāśāstramavarūḍho na śāstrataḥ | tṛtīye homakāle tu saṃprāpte punarāhitiḥ" iti || araṇyātmagrahaṇaṃ gṛhyavihitasamārohaṇādhikaraṇībhūtāyāḥ samidha upalakṣaṇam | jvalano'gniḥ | tathā -- "bhāryāyāṃ proṣitāyāṃ cedudetyarko'stameti vā | tasya syātpunarādheyamanye tvāhurihānyathā || jyeṣṭhā cedagnisaṃyuktā gacchantyanyā yathāruci | yajamānena sahitā yadvā tā eva kevalāḥ || proṣitaḥ syādadhaḥśāyī tvastryupāyī tvamaithunaḥ | vadanbaudhāyanastvitthamekā cedagnisaṃnidhau || itarāsāṃ yathākāmaṃ pravāsamanumanyate | ityuktaṃ bhavabhāṣye'pi pretaślokeṣvapīritam || ekasyāmapyatiṣṭhantyāmagnihotrasamīpataḥ | patistiṣṭhati cedagnināśo netyapare jaguḥ || saṃdhyāvadanyadā'pyagnīnhitvā ceddaṃpatī gatau | grāmāntaṃ vā'tha sīmāntaṃ tatraike'gnīngatānviduḥ || anye grāmāntaraṃ gatvā na tvatikramamātrataḥ | sīmni tvatikramādeva kevalānnāśamabruvan || yadobhāvapyatikramya sīmāṃ pratyāgatau punaḥ | udayāstamayātpūrvaṃ na nāśo'treti kecana || chandogapariśiṣṭoktahomakālātyaye'nalaḥ | sīmātikrāntayornaśyennodayāstamayāditi || vinā'gnibhiryadā patnī nadīmambudhigāminīm | atikrāmettadā'gnīnāṃ vināśaḥ syāditi śrutiḥ" iti || chandogapariśiṣṭaṃ karmapradīpastadukto yo navanāḍikātmako homakālastadatyaye satyanalo'gnirnaśyet | udayāstamayahetunā neti | idamapi pakṣāntaram | tathā -- "patnyantare'thavā patyau hutāśanasamīpage | tadā patnī yathākāmamatikrāmennadīmapi" iti || asamudragāminīmiti kecit | idaṃ ca homakāle'nāgamane | prayāṇaprakaraṇe trikāṇḍamaṇḍanaḥ -- "jyeṣṭhā cedbahubhāryasya hyaticāreṇa gacchati | punarādhānamatraika icchanti nayakovidaḥ" iti || aticāreṇa bhartraraṇyasahāyena | punarādhānaprakaraṇe sa eva -- "patnī sīmāmatikrāmedvinā bhartrā'gnibhiḥ saha | tatra nāśaṃ pare tvāhurbhayādyāne na duṣyati || vihāyāgnīnsabhāryaścetsīmāmullaṅghya gacchati | homakālātyaye tasya punarādheyamiṣyate || jalena hetunā vahnirupaśānto yadā bhavet | kartavyaṃ punarādheyamagnāvanugate sati || asamādhāya cetsvāmī sīmāmullaṅghya gacchati | asamādhānamanugataprāyaścittavidhinā'nutpādanam | sūkararāsabhakākaśṛgālaiḥ kukkurakukkuṭamarkaṭaśūdraiḥ | antyajapātakibhiḥ kuṇapairvā sūtakayā'pi rajasvalayā vā || retomūtrapurīṣairvā pūyāśruśleṣmaśoṇitaiḥ | viṣṭhāsthimāṃsamajjābhiranyairvā'pi jugupsitaiḥ || āropitāraṇīsparśe kṛte'gneḥ sparśane'pi vā | ātmārūḍheṣu majjedvā vadedvā patitādibhiḥ || athavā yoṣitaṃ gacchedanṛtau kāmamohitaḥ | vadantyeṣu nimitteṣu kecidagnivināśanam || tatrāraṇīgate vahnau duṣṭe syātpunarāhitiḥ | itareṣu nimitteṣu tvagnyādheyaṃ pracakṣate || yadvā sarvopaghāteṣu punastveti samindhanam" iti || gārhye karmaṇi punarādheyābhāvātpunaḥsaṃdhānameva | rajasvalāsparśaviṣaye gobhilo'pi -- "agniṃ rajasvalā cetstrī saṃspṛśedagnihotrakam | iṣṭiraṣṭākapālena kāryā tantumate'gnaye || caṇḍālapatitodakyāsūtikākuṇapādibhiḥ | saṃsarge'pi vināśaḥ syādādadhīteti kecana" iti || sarvāgnisparśa eva punarādhānamiti vyaṅkaṭeśaḥ | jñānājñānakṛtā vyavasthetyanye | uktaṃ ca mahābhārate -- "rajasvalā cecchrautāgnimajñānātspṛśate yadi | iṣṭiraṣṭākapālena kartavyā śucaye'gnaye" iti || atra śrautamityagniviśeṣaṇādajñānataḥ smārte sparśe'pi punaḥsaṃdhānameva | sākṣātparamparākṛtā vyavasthaiva yukteti bahavaḥ | caṇḍālasparśe patitasparśe cā''dhānameveti keśavavaradarājādayaḥ | sūtakyupasparśe śavasparśe caivamiti kecit | mānuṣāsthisparśe punarādhānameva | itarāsthisparśe tu śucīṣṭimātramiti keciditi prāyaścittasārakārādayaḥ | maṇḍanaḥ -- "rajodoṣe samutpanne sūtake mṛtake tathā | pravasannagnimānvipraḥ punarādhānamarhati || bahvīnāmapi caikasyāmudakyāyāṃ na tu vrajet | śikyenodvāhayedagnīnpunarādhānamarhati" iti || "ekākinī yadā patnī vahnimādāya gacchati | agnināśaṃ pare tvāhurbhayādyāne na duṣyati || na rucyaikākinī patnī prayāyādagnibhiḥ saha | rāṣṭrabhraṃśādisaṃprāptāvuditaṃ yānamīdṛśam || na kvāpyārambhaṇaṃ kecillaugākṣyādyanibandhanāt | udakyā cedbhavetpatnī prasūtā prasavantyapi || anvārambhavikalpatvātpunarādhirna tanmatāt | jyeṣṭhā'nvārabhate patnī bahubhāryasya netarāḥ || āpadyagniṣu dīpyatsu māsārdhaṃ cenna hūyate | sarvahomānatikrāntāpakṣānte pakṣahomavat || samasya juhuyātpaścādiṣṭistantumatī bhavet | na tatra punarādheyamiti kauṣītakī śrutiḥ || vatsaraṃ vatsarārdhaṃ vā homalope matāntaram | āpatkāle na naśyanti dīpyante ceddhutāśanāḥ" iti || prāyaścittakutūhale -- "kharoṣṭravṛṣabhaṃ nārī samāruhyāthavā pumān | yojane yojane kṛcchramagniścāpi vinaśyati" iti || yajñapārśve -- "gajoṣṭravṛṣabhaṃ nārī samāruhyāthavā pumān | yojane yojane kṛcchramagniścāpi vinaśyati" iti || ayaṃ ca gajārohaṇaniṣedho rājavyatiriktaparaḥ | rājño gajārohaṇasya bahuṣu purāṇeṣu darśanāt | "yasyacchatraṃ hayaścaiva kuñjarārohamṛddhimat | aindrasthānamupāsīta tasmāttaṃ na vicārayet" iti mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇācca | cakārāttaptakṛcchrapunaḥsaṃskārādikasya samuccayaḥ | kharoṣṭravṛṣabhārohaṇaniṣedho niragnerapi | "yadi cedvai dvijo gacchedāruhyoṣṭraṃ kharaṃ vṛṣam | punastasya kriyāḥ kāryāḥ śikhāyā vāpanena ca || ādau tu vidhinā tryabdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret" iti svatantraniṣedhasya sattvāt | gajārohaṇaniṣedhastu tathāniṣedhābhāvāttasya na bhavati | evaṃ ca samāvartanottaramaupāsanāgnyutpatteḥ prāggajārohaṇe viprasyāpi niṣedho nāstīti siddhaṃ bhavati | gajārohaṇe taptakṛcchrapunaḥsaṃskārādikasya samuccayo na bhavati | yadi cedvai dvijo gacchedityanantarodāhṛtavacane kharoṣṭravṛṣabhārohaṇa eva taptakṛcchrapunaḥsaṃskārādikasya vihitatvāt | yajñapārśve -- "nāgnikāryasya velāyāṃ pravasenna ca parvaṇi | na vinā ca nimittena krīḍādyarthaṃ tu na vrajet || āhitāgnistu yo lobhātpravāsaṃ parvasaṃdhiṣu | karoti punarādhānaṃ prāyaścittamṛtāvṛtau" iti || tathā -- "āhitāgnistu yo mohādanugacchecchavaṃ yadi | tadā'gnīnāṃ vināśaḥ syāditi prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ" iti || idamanyagotraviṣayam | "āhitāgniḥ(gneḥ) pramādādvā pretānugamanaṃ yadi | agnināśaṃ vijānīyātsapiṇḍe tu na doṣakṛt" || iti prāyaścittakeśavīkārokteḥ | "āhitāgneḥ pramādāccecchavānugamanaṃ tadā | agnināśaṃ vijānīyātsagotreṣu na doṣakṛt" || iti prayogadarpaṇe smṛtivacanācca | vāhinīpatāvapi -- "asapiṇḍaśavānugamane śavasparśe ca punarādhānam" iti | āhitāgnigrahaṇaṃ sāgnikopalakṣaṇamiti kecit | evamanyānyapi nimittāni tatraiva draṣṭavyāni | nadīśabdapravṛttinimittamapi tatraivoktam -- "kūladvayāntarālaṃ tu nadīśabdena nocyate | kiṃtu taddeśavartyeva jalasaṃgho nadī bhavet || aṣṭau dhanuḥsahasrāṇi na saṃsravati yajjalam | nadīśabdābhidheyatvaṃ tasyecchanti na sūrayaḥ || ekena nāmadheyena śatayojanagāmi yat | udakaṃ tannadīśabdavācyamityapare jaguḥ" iti || iti saṃkṣepeṇa punarādhānanimittāni | athāgnityāgaprāyaścittāni | tatra smṛtiḥ -- "nāstikyādvā pramādādvā ālasyādvā kathaṃcana | vicchede'gneḥ prakartavyaṃ prāyaścittaṃ tu tadyathā" iti || manuḥ -- " agnihotryapavidhyāgniṃ brāhmaṇaḥ kāmakārataḥ | cāndrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsaṃ vīrahatyāsamaṃ hi tat" iti || apavidhya tyaktvā | māsamapavidhyetyanvayaḥ | yattu hārītaḥ -- "saṃvatsarotsanne'gnihotre cāndrāyaṇaṃ kṛtvā punarādadhyāddvivarṣotsanne somāyanacāndrāyaṇe kuryāttrivarṣotsanne saṃvatsaraṃ kṛcchramabhyasya punarādadhyāt" iti, tadakāmato jñeyam | śaṅkhastu -- " agnyutsādī saṃvatsaraṃ prājāpatyaṃ caredgāṃ ca dadyāt "| iti trivarṣotsāde godānamapyadhikamāha | viṣṇurapi -- "vedāgnyutsādī triṣavaṇasnāyyadhaḥśāyī saṃvatsaraṃ bhaikṣeṇa vartayet" iti | vyāghraḥ -- "māsadvayaṃ tayorvahniṃ tyajedevaṃ samācaret | nāstikyātkṛcchramekaṃ tu homadravyaṃ dadāti ca" iti || tayoḥ pramādālasyayoḥ | homadravyaṃ yāvatkālaṃ homo na kṛtastāvaddhomaparyāptam | tathā ca bharadvājagṛhye -- "yāvatkālamahomī syāttāvaddravyamaśeṣataḥ | taddānaṃ caiva viprebhyo yathā homastathaiva tat" iti || jātūkarṇyo'pi -- "atītakālaṃ juhuyādagnau viprāya vā svayam | dadyādvedavide samyakkṛtvā''dhānaṃ punardvijaḥ" iti || atra homa iti sthālīpākopalakṣaṇam | yadyapyagnivicchede sati homādāvadhikārābhāvena doṣābhāvāddhomalopaprāyaścittārthasya homadravyadānasyāprāptistathā'pi vyāghravacane nāstikyāditiśravaṇānnāstikyato'gniviccheda eva homalopaprāyaścittārthahomadravyadānaṃ kāryaṃ netarayoriti jñeyam | etacca homadravyadānaṃ śrautāgnityāge na bhavatīti mādhavaḥ | ubhayatyāge'pi yuktamiti navīnāḥ | māsacatuṣṭayatyāge tu vyāghra evā''ha -- "catuṣṭaye tu saṃpūrṇe māsānāṃ tu hutāśanam | tyaktvā'tikṛcchraṃ kurvīta tataḥ pāpātpramucyate" iti || smṛtyantare'pi -- "yo'gniṃ tyajati nāstikyātprājāpatyaṃ careddvijaḥ | māsadvaye tathā kuryādatikṛcchraṃ catuṣṭaye" iti || māsacatuṣṭaye'tikṛcchramityarthaḥ | ṣaṇmāsatyāge parākaḥ | ata ūrdhvamabdaparyantaṃ payovratam | tathā''hośanā -- "ṣaṇmāsāṃstyajate yo vai parākaṃ tu samācaret | urdhvaṃ payovrataṃ kuryānmāsamekaṃ samāhitaḥ || varṣaparyantamevā''hurmunayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ" iti || māsaṣaṭkādūrdhvaṃ yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ yājñavalkyoktānyupapātakasāmānyaprāyaścittāni jātiśaktiguṇādyapekṣayā yojanīyāni | saṃvatsarādūrdhvaṃ tu manuḥ -- "ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarādagniṃ yastyajetsa payovratam | dvaimāsikaṃ tataḥ kuryāttraimāsikamathāpi vā" iti || atra dvaimāsikatraimāsikayoḥ kālālpatvamahattvāpekṣayā vikalpaḥ | etāni ca sarvāṇi prāyaścittāni nāstikyādagniparityāge | yadā tu pramādāttyajati tadā bharadvājagṛhye viśeṣaḥ -- "prāṇāyāmaśatamā trirātrādupavāsaḥ syādā viṃśatirātrādata ūrdhvamā ṣaṣṭirātrāttisro rātrīrupavasedata ūrdhvamā saṃvatsarātprājāpatyaṃ caredata ūrdhvaṃ kālabahutve doṣabahutvam" iti | idamevākāmato gṛhyāgnityāga ityaparārke | atraiva viṣaye skānde -- "hutāśanaṃ tu yo vipraḥ pramādāttyajati prabho | prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kuryādupavāsamathāpi vā" iti || kūrmapurāṇe -- "ṣaṣṭirātriṃ tyajedagniṃ pramādācchṛṇu me prabho | upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryātprājāpatyaṃ tataḥ param" iti || tata ityanena trirātramucyate | māsadvayamagnityāge trirātramupavāsaḥ saṃvatsaramagnityāge prājāpatyamiti | skānde tu dvādaśāhvātikrame tryahamupavāsaḥ | māsātikrame dvādaśāhamupavāsaḥ | saṃvatsarātikrame māsamupavāsaḥ payobhakṣaṇaṃ vā kuśmāṇḍībhirhomaḥ krameṇobhayaṃ vetyuktam | idaṃ ca kāmataḥ | upavāsāśaktau māsaṃ payobhakṣaṇam | saṃvatsarānantaramadhikakālātikrama ubhayamiti madanapārijāte | ālasyādagniparityāge smṛtyantaram -- "ālasyena yadā vahniṃ dvādaśāhātparaṃ tadā | upavāsatrayaṃ kuryātpaścānmāsāttathaiva ca || upavāso dvādaśāhaṃ ṣaṇmāsātikrame tathā | māsaṃ payovrataṃ kuryādvatsarātikrame tathā || māsopavāsaḥ kartavyaḥ payo vā bhakṣayettathā | kūśmāṇḍahomaḥ kartavyaḥ krameṇobhayameva vā || dvimāsaṃ vā trimāsaṃ vā kālālpatvamahattvataḥ | payovrataṃ cāta ūrdhvaṃ bahukālātyaye sati || prāyaścittabahutvaṃ syādevamā vatsaratrayāt | trivarṣe varṣamekaṃ tu prājāpatyaṃ caredvratam || evamevādhike'pi syātkāle caiva tato'dhikam " iti | atha prasaṅgātsaṃkṣepeṇa kṛcchrādīnāṃ lakṣaṇāni | tatra kṛcchralakṣaṇaṃ dharmasūtre -- "tryahamanaktāśyadivāśī tatantryahamayācitavratatryahaṃ nābhāti kiṃcana " iti | kṛcchradvādaśarātrasya vidhirayam | manunā'pyuktam " tryahaṃ prātantryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitam | tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyaṃ carandvijaḥ" iti || yājñavalkyenāpyuktam -- "ekamaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca | upavāsena caikena laghukṛcchra udāhṛtaḥ || yathākathaṃcitriguṇāḥ(gaḥ) prājāpatyaḥ sa ucyate " iti | laghukacchū udāhṛta ityatra pādakṛcchraḥ prakīrtita iti pāṭhāntaram | laghukacchūsyaiva śiśukaccha iti saṃjñāntaram | yathākathaṃcidityanenānulomaḥ pratilomo daṇḍakalitavadāvṛttaḥ svasthānaviśraddho veti smṛtyantarasiddhaṃ pakṣacatuṣṭayaṃ saṃgṛhyate| grāsasaṃkhyāparimāṇe āhā''pastambaḥ -- " sāyaṃ dvāviṃśatisāḥ prātaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ smṛtāḥ | caturviśatirāyācyāḥ pare niraśanāstrayaḥ|| kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇāḥ syuryathā vā''syaṃ viśetsukham " iti | anayoḥ pakṣayoḥ śaktāśaktaparatvena vyavasthā | pārāśare tu -- " sāyaṃ tu dvādaśa grāsāḥ prātaḥ pañcadaśa smṛtāḥ" iti pūrvārdhaṃ paṭhitam | caturviṃśatimate tu -- "prātastu dvādaśa grāsāḥ sāyaṃ pañcadaśaiva tu | ayācite tu dvāvaṣṭau paraṃ vai mārutāśanaḥ" iti || āsāṃ ca saṃkhyānāṃ śaktāśaktaparatvena vyavasthā| kṛcchrasaṃvatsaralakṣaṇamuktaṃ dharmasūtre -- evamevābhyasyetsaṃvatsaraṃ sa kṛcchūsaṃvatsaraḥ" iti | pūrvasūtre kṛcchradvādaśarātravidheṣaktatvāttasyaivaṃśabdena grahaṇam | abhojyabhojanābhyāse'yam | atikṛcchūlakṣaṇamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "eṣa evātikṛcchraḥ syātpāṇipūrānnabhojanaḥ" iti | atra yeṣu navadineṣu bhojanaṃ prāptaṃ tatra pāṇipūrānaṃ niyamyate | pāṇipūramekagrāsaparimitamannam | "ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyācyahāṇi(dahāni) trīṇi pūrvavat | tryahaṃ copavasedantyamatikṛcchre carandvijaḥ" iti manūkteḥ| kacchralakṣaṇamapi tenaivoktam -- "kṛcchrātikṛcchraḥ payasā divasānekaviṃśatiḥ(m)" iti | patrapuṭakādinā grāsaparimāṇaṃ kṛtvaikagrāsaparyāptaṃ dugdhamekaviṃśatidineṣvaśnīyāt | prājāpatyoktadvāviṃśatyādisaṃkhyayā vā yāvatā prāṇadhāraṇaṃ bhavati tāvadveti madanapārijātaḥ | payo'tra jalam | "caretkṛcchrātikṛcchre tu pibettoyaṃ tu śītalam " iti brahmāṇḍapurāṇāt | abhakṣaḥ kṛcchrātikṛcchra iti gautamokteśceti bhavadevaḥ | parākalakṣaṇamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ parikīrtitaḥ" iti | māsopavāsakṛcchramāha jābāliḥ -- " anaśnanmāsamekaṃ tu mahāpātakanāśanam ' iti | yavikakṛcchramāha śaṅkhaḥ -- " gopurīpādyavānaśnanmāsamekaṃ samāhitaḥ | vrataṃ tu yāvakaṃ kuryātsarvapāpāpanuttaye " iti || taptakṛcchramāha manuḥ -- " taptakṛcch caranvipro jalakṣīraghṛtānilān | prativyahaṃ pibeduṣṇānsakṛtsnāyī samāhitaḥ" iti || smṛtyantare tu -- " taptakṣīravṛtāmbūnāmekaikaṃ pratyahaṃ pibet | ekarātropavāsaśca taptakṛcchū udāhṛtaḥ" ityuktam || kṣīrādīnāṃ parimāṇamuktaṃ parāśareṇa -- " ṣaṭpalaṃ tu pibedambhastripalaṃ tu payaḥ pibet | palamekaṃ pibetsarpistaptakṛcchro vidhīyate " iti || taptakṛcchramuktvā śaṅkalikhitau -- " eṣa eva śītaiḥ śītakṛcchraḥ" iti | sāṃtapanamāha śaṅkhaḥ -- "gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchre sāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam " iti | yatisāṃtapanamāha sa eva -- "etadeva tryahābhyastaṃ yatisāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam" iti | yatisāṃtapanamiti saṃjñāmātram | tena na yatimātrasyaivādhikāraḥ kiṃ tu sarveṣām | mahāsāṃtapanamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "pṛthaksāṃtapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ | saptāhena tu kṛcchro'yaṃ mahāsāṃtapanaḥ smṛtaḥ" iti || yamaḥ -- "etānyeva ca peyāni ekaikaṃ ca dvyahaṃ dvyaham | atisāṃtapanaṃ nāma śvapākamapi śodhayet" iti | dvādaśāho'yam | "tryahaṃ pibettu gomūtraṃ tryahaṃ vai gomayaṃ pibet | tryahaṃ dadhi tryahaṃ kṣīraṃ tryahaṃ sarpistataḥ śuciḥ" [iti] || (pañcadaśāho'yam | jābālaḥ -- "ṣaṇṇāmekaikameteṣāṃ trirātramupayojayet | tryahaṃ copavasedantyaṃ mahāsāṃtapanaṃ viduḥ") iti || ekaviṃśatyaho'yam | tulāpuruṣakṛcchramāha śaṅkhaḥ -- " piṇyākācāmatakrāmbusaktūnāṃ prativāsaram | upavāsāntarābhyāsāttulāpuruṣa ucyate" iti || ācāma odananisrāvo maṇḍa iti yāvat | vajrakṛcchramāhāṅgirāḥ -- "gomūtreṇa samāyuktaṃ yāvakaṃ vopayojayet | ekāhena tu kṛcchro'yamuktastvaṅgirasā svayam || sarvapāpaharo divyo nāmnā vajra iti smṛtaḥ" iti | pūrvaprakrāntadadhitakrāpekṣayā vikalpaḥ | cāndrāyaṇamāha yamaḥ -- "vardhayetpiṇḍamekaikaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca hrāsayet | etaccāndrāyaṇaṃ nāma yavamadhyaṃ prakīrtitam || ekaikaṃ hrāsayetpiḍaṃ śukle kṛṣṇe ca vardhayet | etatpipīlikāmadhyaṃ cāndrāyaṇamudāhṛtam || trīṃstrīnpiṇḍānsamaśnīyānniyatātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ | haviṣyānnasya vai māsamṛṣicāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || caturaḥ prātaraśnīyāccaturaḥ sāyameva ca | piṇḍānetaddhi bālānāṃ śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || piṇḍānaṣṭau samaśnīyānmāsaṃ madhyaṃdine ravau | yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ hyetatsarvakalmaṣanāśanam" iti || śiśucāndrāyaṇamiti saṃjñāmātram | evaṃ yaticāndrāyaṇamityapi| yavapipīlikāmadhyayostithivṛddhau hrāse vā grāsānāmapi hrāsavṛddhī | tathā ca viṣṇuḥ -- " grāsānāsyāvikāramaśnīyāttāṃścandrakalābhivṛddhau krameṇa vardhayeddhānau ca hrāsayedamāvāsyāyāṃ ca nāśnīyāt" iti | sāmānyacāndrāyaṇamāha viṣṇuḥ -- "yathākathaṃcitpiṇḍānāṃ tisro'śītīraśnīyātsāmānyacāndrāyaṇe" iti | pratidinaṃ saṃkhyāniyamādareṇa māsena catvāriṃśaduttaraśatadvayaṃ grāsānaśnīyādityarthaḥ | pipīlikāmadhyayavamadhyabhinnacāndrāyaṇeṣu dināntare'pyārambho na pratipadyeva | grāsaparimāṇamāha yājñavalkyaḥ -- "tithivṛddhyā carepiṇḍāñchukle śikhyaṇḍasaṃmitān" iti | śikhī mayūraḥ | cāndrāyaṇaṃ prakṛtya parāśarastu -- "kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu grāsaṃ vai parikalpayet" iti | śaṅkhastu -- "ārdrāmalakamātrāstu grāsā induvrate smṛtāḥ" iti | induvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇam | eteṣāṃ ca parimāṇānāṃ śaktāśaktaparatvena vyavasthā | ekādaśyādau nityaprāpta upavāsaścāndrāyaṇavidhinā bādhyate | etasya "dharmārthaṃ ca caredetaccandrasyeti salokatām" iti kāmyatvāt | laśunabhakṣaṇādinimitte vihitatvena naimittikatvācca | kāmyastvekādaśyādyupavāso'nyadvārā kāraṇīyaḥ | pratinidhinā kṛte'pi phalaprāpteḥ kātyāyanādibhiruktatvāt | ayaṃ caikādaśyādyupavāsabādho na sāmānyacāndrāyaṇe, tatra pratidinaṃ grāsagrahaṇaniyamābhāvāt | atha saṃkṣepeṇa pratyāmnāyāḥ | caturviṃśatimate -- "kṛcchro devyayutaṃ caiva prāṇāyāmaśatadvayam | tilahomasahasraṃ tu vedapārāyaṇaṃ tathā || viprā dvādaśa vā bhojyāḥ pāvakeṣṭistathaiva ca | anyā vā pāvamāneṣṭiḥ samānyāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ" iti || parāśaraḥ -- "kṛcchro devyayutaṃ caiva prāṇāyāmaśatadvayam | puṇyatīrthe'nārdraśiraḥsnānaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyayā" iti | anārdraśiraḥsnānamiti padacchedaḥ | aparārke smṛtyantare -- "samidghṛtaṃ havirdhānyaṃ tilānvā mārutāśanaḥ | hutvā dvādaśasāhasraṃ gāyatryā kṛcchramāpnuyāt || dvādaśaiva sahasrāṇi japeddevīmupoṣitaḥ | jalānte vidhivanmaunī prājāpatyo'yamucyate" iti || dvādaśasāhasraṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyasāhasraṃ dvādaśādhikasāhasramiti kecit | jalānte jalasamīpe | yājñavalkyo'pi -- "yatra yatra ca saṃkīrṇamātmānaṃ manyate janaḥ | tatra tatra tilairhomo gāyatryā vācanaṃ tathā" iti || saṃkīrṇaṃ pāpayuktam | aparārkeḥ -- "upoṣya śraddhayā yuktastilapātrāṇi dharmataḥ | dvādaśabrahmavādibhyaḥ prājāpatyena tatsamam || svayamāhṛtya yo mūrdhnā tṛṇabhārānupoṣitaḥ | dadyādgomaṇḍale kṛcchre dvādaśaiva na saṃśayaḥ || annadānahiraṇyena dvādaśa brāhmaṇāñśucīn | tarpayenmārutāśī ca śrotriyānkṛcchra ucyate || prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā dvātriṃśottaramārtiṣu | ahorātroṣitastiṣṭhetprāṅmukhaḥ kṛcchra ucyate || namaskārasahasrāṇi dvādaśaiva dṛḍhavrataḥ | goviprapitṛdeveṣu kuryātkṛcchratrayaṃ bhavet" iti || tilapātrāṇyuktāni kaurme -- "tilapātraṃ tridhā proktaṃ kaniṣṭhottamamadhyamam | tāmrapātraṃ daśapalaṃ jaghanyaṃ parikīrtitam || dviguṇaṃ madhyamaṃ proktaṃ triguṇaṃ tūttamaṃ smṛtam" iti | bhāro dvisahasrapalaparimitaḥ | vasiṣṭhaḥ -- "gomūtreṇa samāyuktaṃ yāvakaṃ copayojayet | kṛcchramaikāhikaṃ proktaṃ dṛṣṭamaṅgirasā svayam | niśyāsīno divā tiṣṭhettrirātraṃ mārutāśanaḥ | prājāpatyaṃ vijānīyātkūśmāṇḍairjuhuyāghṛtam" iti || mādhavīye smṛtyantare -- "prājāpatyaṃ caranvipro yadyaśaktaḥ kathaṃcana | ahāni pañca viprāgryānbhojayetsamyagīpsitān" iti || atra kapiñjalādhikaraṇanyāyena pañcasvapyahaḥsu trayastrayo viprā bhojyā iti kecit | pañcasaṃkhyāyā dehalīdīpanyāyenobhayatrānvayaḥ | tena pañca viprā bhojanīyā ityanye | smṛtyarthasāre -- "rudraikādaśinī kṛcchro dvādaśāṃśo nivartanāt | yojanaṃ sindhugātīre ghṛtahomaśatadvayam" iti || nivartanalakṣaṇaṃ tu -- "daśahastena daṇḍena triṃśaddaṇḍā nivartanam" iti | nivartanadvādaśāṃśabhūmidānena kṛcchra ityarthaḥ | mādhavīye -- " prājāpatyakriyāśaktau dhenuṃ dadyātpayasvinīm | dhenorabhāve dātavyaṃ tulyaṃ mūlyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ" iti || madanaratne brāhme -- "gavāmabhāve niṣkaḥ syāttadardhaṃ pādameva vā" iti | caturviṃśatimate -- "prājāpatye tu gāmekāmatikṛcchre tathā dvayam | parāke taptātikṛcchre tisrastisrastu tāḥ smṛtāḥ || aṣṭau cāndrāyaṇe jñeyāstisro vā śaktyapekṣayā" iti || smṛtyarthasāre tu -- "ṣaḍupavāsāḥ prājāpatyapratyāmnāyaḥ | ekaviprabhojanamupavāsasyeti ca" iti | pakṣivadhe naktaṃ rūpyamāṣakaṃ vā dadyāditi hārītokte rūpyamāṣakadānaṃ naktasyeti śūlapāṇiḥ | śūlapāṇireva -- "cāndrāyaṇaṃ tu kurvāṇāḥ kuryuḥ kṛcchracatuṣṭayam" iti | tathā -- " cāndrāyaṇaparākābhyāṃ niṣkṛtiṃ yo na śaknuyāt | sa karotyātmaśuddhyarthaṃ prājāpatyasya pañcakam" iti || kṛcchrātikṛcchre dhenucatuṣṭayamiti bhavadevaḥ | atra gurulaghupakṣāṇāṃ śaktāśaktaparatvena vyavasthā | iti pratyāmnāyāḥ | atha punaḥsaṃdhānam | tatra nakṣatrāṇi -- "kṛttikā rohiṇī mṛgaśīrṣa punarvasū phalgunyau hastaścitrā viśākhe anūrādhāḥ śroṇā proṣṭhapadāścottare'gnyādheyanakṣatrāṇi" iti | kṛttikābahuvacanāntenaikameva nakṣatram | anūrādhāḥ, proṣṭhapadāḥ, punarvasū, puṃliṅgāḥ | phalgunyau viśākhe strīliṅge | spaṣṭānyanyāni | "amāvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmāpūryamāṇapakṣe vā puṇye nakṣatre" iti | āpūryamāṇaḥ pakṣaḥ pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ | āpūryamāṇapakṣa ityanena pūrṇamāsagrahaṇe punarupādānamatiśayārthaṃ tatpratipadgrahaṇārthaṃ ca | āpūryamāṇapakṣa ityanena puṇye nakṣatra iti samuccīyate | vāśabdasyātrānanvayāt | āṣāḍhe māsi punaḥsaṃdhānaṃ na kartavyam | "ādadhītānalānvipro nā''ṣāḍhe māsi karhicit | bhādre māsi na rājanyo nā''śvine'pyūrujaḥ kvacit" iti kātyāyanokteḥ | ūrujo vaiśyaḥ | vistarastu śrautājjñeyaḥ | vicchinnasaṃdhānasya naimittikatvānnimittānantaramadhimāse'pi karaṇamucitaṃ nātipannasya jāteṣṭivat | amunaivā''śayena dīpikāyāmuktam -- "yannaimittikamagninaṣṭyanugatāgnyādhānamarcāsu vā saṃskārādivilopane sati punaḥ proktaṃ pratiṣṭhādikam | dāheṣṭyādi ca yatsvakālavigame gauṇaṃ vidhānātparaṃ lupyetādhikamāsi tadvitanuyāt" iti || athavā vivāhoktānyeva nakṣatrādīni grāhyāṇi | asminpakṣe vivāhahomīyapradhānājyāhutiṣaṭkaṃ lājāhutitrayaṃ cāyāścetyāhutyopavāsena vā samuccitaṃ draṣṭavyam | nyāyato'pyevam | yadi tu sarvathā putrādyabhāvastadā mantraliṅgavirodhādājyāhutiṣaṭkābhāva eva | ca na | asaṃkarātsarvatredameva yuktam | sarvapakṣeṣu nimittānantarakaraṇapakṣe na nakṣatrādyapekṣeti draṣṭavyam | atha punaḥsaṃdhānaprayogaḥ | kartā''dau homasāmagrīṃ sthālīpākārthaṃ ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ prakaraṇam || 16 || <17> atha saptadaśaṃ prakaraṇam | atha prayāṇavidhiḥ | tatredaṃ gṛhyam -- "yadi prayāyādvyākhyātamātmannaraṇyorvā samāropaṇa samidhi vā samāropayedaraṇīkalpena khādirī pālāśyaudumbaryāśvatthī vā yatrāvasyettasmiñśrotriyāgārādagnimāhṛtyā''juhvāna udbudhyasveti dvābhyāṃ yasyā samārūḍhastāmādadhāti vyākhyāto homakalpaḥ" iti | asyārthaḥ -- yadi prayāyātprayāṇaṃ kuryāttadā vyākhyātam "ṛte gṛhasya pravāsaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ" itikhaṇḍasthenāyaṃ te yonirityārabhya laukikamagnimāhṛtya tasminnupāvarohayata ityantena sūtreṇoktam | ātmannaraṇyorvā samāropaṇaṃ kuryādityarthaḥ | yadi prayāyāttasya vyākhyāto vidhirityetāvaducyamāne vāstoṣpatihomāvasitahomāvapi prāpnutastannivṛttyarthamevaṃ sūtrakaraṇam | agninā bhāryayā ca saha gamanaṃ prayāṇaṃ tābhyāṃ vinā'nyatra grāmāntara ekarātrāvamo vāsaḥ pravāsaḥ | ātmannātmanītyarthaḥ | supāṃ sulugiti saptamyā luk | "atho khalvāhuryadaraṇyoḥ samārūḍho naśyet" ityādinā śrutāvātmasamāropasyaiva saṃstavādātmasamāropa uktaḥ | araṇyoryathā samāropakalpastena kalpenetyarthaḥ |
kalpaḥ prakāraḥ | samidhi vā samāropayedityuktaṃ tatra saminniyamamāha -- khādirīti | khadirādyanyatamavṛkṣasyetyarthaḥ | yatra yasmindeśe'vasyedvāsaṃ kuryāttasmindeśe śrotriyāgārācchrotriyagṛhādagnimāhṛtyā''juhvāna udbudhyasvetidvābhyāṃ mantrābhyāṃ yasyāṃ samidhi samārūḍho'gnistāṃ samidhaṃ tasminnagnāvādadhāti | vyākhyāta uktaḥ | "nityamata ūrdhva sāyaṃprātarityārabhya saurīṃ pūrvāṃ prātareke samāmananti" iti sūtreṇeti śeṣaḥ | athavā vyākhyātaḥ śrutau homakalpo vāstoṣpatihomakalpa ityarthaḥ | asminpakṣe'vasitahomanivṛttyarthaṃ pūrvatra gurusūtraṃ draṣṭavyam | etasya kṣepakatve samitsamāropo nāstyeva | ātmasamāropāraṇisamāropāvākāṅkṣitatvena śrautasūtrātprāpnutaḥ | iyaṃ prāptistu śrautamadhye smārtāmnānātsiddhā | kṛtātmasamāropaṇasya dharmā uktā baudhāyanena -- "ātmani samārūḍheṣu na khādenna pibennopari śayīta nāpsu nimajjyānna maithunaṃ vrajediti kāmaṃ khādetkāmaṃ pibetkāmaṃ tvevopari śayīta na tvevāpsu nimajjyānna maithunaṃ vrajet" iti | upari khaṭvādau | nāpsu nimajjyāditi nimajjanasyaiva niṣedho na tu snānasya | dvividhaṃ hi snānam | nimajjanarūpamāplavanarūpaṃ ca | tatra nimajjanamapsvantardhānarūpam | āplavanaṃ tu śītoṣṇābhiradbhiḥ snātvā''camyā''plavanta ityādinā vihitaṃ śarīraprakṣālanarūpam | ata evāvabhṛtheṣṭau -- "patnīyajamānau snātāvamajjantāvanyonyaṃ pṛṣṭhe pradhāvataḥ " iti sūtre majjanavyatiriktaprakārakasnānoktiḥ saṃgacchate | majjane kṛte tu punarādhānam | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "ātmārūḍheṣu majjedvā vadedvā patitādibhiḥ | athavā yoṣitaṃ gacchedanṛtau kāmamohitaḥ || vadantyeṣu nimitteṣu kecidagnivināśanam | yadvā sarvopaghāteṣu punastveti samindhanam" iti || ātmārūḍheṣviti sarvatrānuvartate | asminvākye nimajjanapatitādisaṃbhāṣaṇānṛtukālikayoṣidgamanairagnivināśasya pākṣikatvokteritareṣu naivāgnivināśa ityarthādavagamyate | maithunamajjane vihāyānyaniyamātikrame manasvatīmantrajapaḥ prāyaścittamiti pradīpācca | atra maithunamajjanagrahaṇaṃ patitādisaṃbhāṣaṇopalakṣaṇaṃ maṇḍanenaikavākyatvāya | ātmasamāropaṇakaumudyāmāpastambaḥ -- "yadyagnyārūḍhā samidapsu nimajjayedyadyātmarūḍhāgnirapsu nimajjecchiro dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇiṃ vā nimajjayetpunarādhānakāraṇaṃ bhavatītyeke" iti | mukhe samāropaṇapakṣe śiraso nimajjananiṣedhaḥ | haste samāropaṇapakṣe hastanimajjanasya niṣedha iti vyavasthā draṣṭavyā | prāyaścittasāra ātmasamāropaṃ prakṛtya -- "jale nimajjya na snāyānnopeyācca striyaṃ tathā | kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe tu ciraṃ nā''sīta cāśuciḥ" iti || baudhāyanaḥ -- "atha yadyātmasamārūḍheṣvavratyaṃ caredaraṇināśoktadoṣo vā bhavedagnyādheyamaraṇivināśena vināśa uktaḥ" iti | asyāyamabhiprāyaḥ -- araṇyorupaghāte tayorutsarga evoktastaddvārā'gnīnāṃ nāśastatra samārūḍhatvāt | tathā pāṇyorapyaraṇīsāmyadṛṣṭyā'raṇīnāśoktadoṣo vā bhavedagnyādheyamityuktam | na tvantarātmani doṣasaṃbhavaḥ | tatra tu yadi buddhipūrvamabhakṣyabhakṣaṇādirūpamavratyācaraṇaṃ kuryāttadā''tmano doṣaḥ punarupanayanādikāraṇarūpaḥ syāt | tatra samārūḍhatvādagnīnāmapi vināśastadaiva punarādhānamiti | śarīrasya tvāyatanasthānāpannatvācchūdrādisparśe'pi snānādinaiva śuddhiḥ | anyathā gāyatryādimantrāṇāmapi nāśaḥ syāt | ātmanaḥ sarvavyāpitve satyapi sthānaviśeṣa eva samāropite'gnau saptabhiḥ pañcabhistribhirvā veṣṭanairaraṇī samidhaṃ vā saṃveṣṭya gacchet | uktaṃ caitadyajñapārśve -- "saptabhiḥ pañcabhirvā'pi tribhirvā veṣṭanairyute | araṇī na praduṣyete patitādisamāgame" iti || araṇīvatsamidho'pi jñeyam | veṣṭanadravyāṇi tu śaunakenoktāni -- "ajinaṃ kambalaṃ darbhā gokeśāḥ śāṇameva ca | bhūrjapatraṃ tālapatraṃ saptadhā veṣṭanaṃ smṛtam" iti || pañcapakṣe bhūrjapatratālapatrayornivṛttiḥ | tritvapakṣe gokeśaśāṇabhūrjapatratālapatrāṇāṃ nivṛttiriti jñeyam | atha prayogaḥ | prayāsyanpūrvaṃ svīkṛte araṇī gṛhītvā'yaṃ ta ityasyāgnirjātavedā agnistriṣṭup | samāropaṇe viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ ayaṃ te yoni0 rayim' iti patnyanvārabdhastayoragniṃ samāropayati | tato nivāsasthale śuddhadeśe'raṇī nidhāyāgnyāyatanaṃ saṃpādya, upāvarohetyasya viśve devā jātavedā anistriṣṭup | upāvarohaṇe viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ upāvaroha jātave0 duroṇe' iti patnyanvārabdhaḥ prāgastamayānmanthanenopāvarohya puṣṭaṃ kṛtvā''yatanasaṃskāraṃ kṛtvā tamagniṃ sthāpayet | manthanakāle'nyena manthane kriyamāṇe yāvadagnerjanma tāvadaraṇī saṃspṛśannāste | yadyutpādanaprayatno niṣphalastadā punarmantramuktvā yatnaḥ kāryaḥ | mantro yajamānasyaiva | ātmasamārope tu -- yā te agne yajñiyetyasya viśve devā agnistriṣṭup | ātmasamārope viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ yā te agne yajñiyā tanū0 kṣaya ehi' ityātmani samāropayati | tato nivāsasthale prāgastamayācchuddhe deśe'raṇī saṃsthāpya tayorupāvaroha jātaveda ityupāvarohati | ātmasamāropo nāma dakṣiṇahastasyāgnau pratapanamiti kecit | hastadvayapratāpanamityanye | tūṣṇīmeva pratāpya mantreṇa tamūṣmāṇaṃ mukhe gṛhṇīyāt | mantreṇa pratāpya tūṣṇīṃ mukhe gṛhṇīyādvetyapare | ātmasamāropa upāvarohaṇaṃ nāma nāsikayā śvāsamocanam | etaccoṣmaṇo mukhe grahaṇamiti pakṣe | hastapratapanamātrapakṣe tu mantreṇa saṃsparśanamiti jñeyam | araṇyoryadi na svīkārastadā śrotriyagṛhāllaukikamagnimāhṛtya saṃskṛtāyatane saṃsthāpyā''tmārūḍhāgnestenaiva mantreṇa tatropāvarohaṇaṃ kuryāt | samitsamārope tu khādirapalāśodumbarāśvatthānyatamavṛkṣasya samidhaṃ gṛhītvā'yaṃ ta iti tasyāṃ samāropya yatra nivasettatra śuddhe deśe śrotriyāgārādāhṛtaṃ laukikāgniṃ saṃskṛtāyatane saṃsthāpya prajvālya, ā juhvāna udbudhyasveti dvābhyāṃ samārūḍhāgnikāṃ samidhaṃ tasminnādhāya nityahomaṃ kuryāt | vyādhite proṣite vā yajamāne samāropārthamṛtvijaṃ vṛtvā tena kāraṇīyaḥ | tadalābhe bhāryayā'pi | yajamānasya svasaṃskāravyatiriktakarmasu bhavedeva pratinidhiriti sthāpitatvāt | tasyāmapyayogyāyāṃ putrādinā kāryaḥ | ātmasa māropo yajamānena patnyā vā kāryaḥ, na tu ṛtvikputrādibhiḥ | āpadi prayāṇaprāptāvasaṃnihite ca yajamāna ṛtvijā'raṇīsamāropaḥ kāryaḥ | bhāryayā''tmasamāropo vetyādi jñeyam | araṇīsamitsamārope -- ayaṃ te yonirityayaṃ mantro bhramānna paṭhito'nyathā paṭhito vā tadā na samāropasiddhiḥ | samāropabhrameṇopekṣitasyāgneranugamane'nugataprāyaścittavidhinaivāgnirutpādyo nāvaropavidhinā | anyathotpādane punaḥsaṃdhānameva | agnyanugamanimittakamagnisaṃdhānaṃ proṣite yajamāne patnyartvijā kāraṇīyaṃ dvādaśāhātprāk | ūrdhvaṃ tu yajamānāgamanottaraṃ punaḥ saṃdhānameva | tatra saṃkalpatyāgau patnyaiva kāryau | saminnāśādinimittakamagnisaṃdhānamapi yajamānāgamanottarameva | yajamāne proṣite patnyāmṛtumatyāmapyanugate'gnāvanugataprāyaścittārthamagnisthāpanādiprāyaścittamṛtvijā kāryameva | āśauce samāropāvaropau na bhavato'śucitvāt | na cartvijā kāraṇīyāvetāviti vācyaṃ, mantraliṅgāt | svaparasūtratadvyākhyānebhyaśca svasyaiva kartṛtāyāḥ klṛptatvāt | yadi tu samārūḍhāgneḥ parvaṇyāśaucaṃ prāpnoti tadā punaḥsaṃdhānameva | yadi bhrāntyā tasyāgneḥ punaḥsaṃdhānamakṛtvaiva tatra saṃskārāṅgahomādi karoti tadā smaraṇottaraṃ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyānna punaḥ pradhānakriyā | grāmasīmātikramasamaye nadyatikramasamaye ca daṃpatī araṇyanvārambhaṃ kurutaḥ | akaraṇe'gnirlaukikaḥ | nānāsīmāsvapi prathamāntyayoriti kecit | āpadi yajamānāsaṃnidhau bhāryaivānvārabhate | anekāsu bhāryāsu satīṣu jyeṣṭhāyā evānvārambha āvaśyakaḥ, "jyeṣṭhā'nvārabhate vahniṃ bahubhāryasya netarāḥ" iti saṃgrahokteḥ | nānvārambhaḥ patnyā ātmasamārope | aproṣite'pi yajamāne homakāle patnyā grāmāntaragamane nadyatikrame ca laukikatvamevāgneriti jñeyam | iti prayāṇavidhiḥ | atha pravāsavidhiḥ | tatredaṃ sūtram -- ṛte gṛhasya pravāsaṃ vyākhyāsyāmo'gnīnsamādhehītyādi bhāryāṃ samīkṣata ityantam | atra yāvadupayuktaṃ sūtraṃ tāvata eva vyākhyā pradarśyate | mā pragāmeti mantradvayamuktvā vihāradeśamāgacchati | agnīnāṃ sakāśe samīpe vācaṃ yacchati | asakāśe yasminpradeśe'gnīnāṃ chadīṃṣyadṛśyāni bhavanti tatra gatvā vācaṃ visṛjate | vratakāle vratācaraṇaṃ kartavyamityāha -- vratakāleṣu vrataṃ caratīti | prāduṣkaraṇaprabhṛti nāśnīyādā homādityādi vratam | etaccartāvṛtau kāryamityāha -- ṛtuṃ pratyupatiṣṭhata iti | pravāsavilambe pratyṛtu pravāsopasthānaṃ kuryānmāsadvaye māsadvaya ityarthaḥ | yadyanupasthitāgniṃ prati pravāsa āpadyeta prāpnuyāttadehaiva sannityanena vihārābhimukhastatraivopasthāya gacchet | proṣya pravāsaṃ kṛtvā''gato'gnīnāmasakāśe yasmātpradeśādagrime pradeśe'gnīnāṃ chadīṃṣi dṛśyāni bhavanti tatra sthito vācaṃ niyamyāgnisamīpaṃ gatvā vācaṃ visṛjet | kaḥ puruṣaḥ śreyāṃsaṃ mahāntaṃ pūjyaṃ puruṣaṃ viṣuptaṃ viśeṣeṇa svapantaṃ bodhayatīti lokaprasiddhiḥ, ato'gnestu sutarāṃ ko bodhayitā | aprāduṣkṛtasyaiva bhasmacchannasyaivāgnerupasthānamityekeṣāmācāryāṇāṃ mataṃ taccābhayaṃkarābhyāmeva | aprāduṣkṛtopasthānaṃ prakṛtyaivoktatvāt | alpopasthānavidhirevātropayujyate na pūrvaḥ | tasya bahvagniviṣayatvāt | aprāduṣkṛtānāmiti bahuvacanaṃ śrauta upayujyate, tatrāgnīnāṃ bahutvātpravāsaṃ kariṣyannabhayaṃkarābhayaṃ me kuru svasti me'stu pravatsyāmītyupasthānaṃ kuryāt | proṣya tu -- abhayaṃkarābhayaṃ me kārṣīḥ svasti me'stu prāvātsyamiti | tato gṛhā mā bibhītetyādi bhāryāṃ samīkṣata ityantaṃ kuryāt | maunaviṣaye pakṣadvayamuktaṃ maṇḍanana -- "agnyantikaṃ samārabhya tāvanmaunī pratiṣṭhate | yāvacchadīṃṣi dṛśyante havyavāhanasadmani || cakṣurgocaratā'gnīnāṃ jāyate yāvadantarā | tāvatyeva bhavenmaunamiti sāṃkhyāyanāśayaḥ" iti || araṇyāropite'gnau pravāsaprāptau sa eva -- "araṇyāropito'pyagnirabhayaṃkaramantrataḥ | upastheyo'praṇeyatvādbhasmasaṃchannavahnivat" iti || asminviṣaye pakṣāntaramapyuktaṃ tenaiva -- "yadvā'raṇigate vahnau pravasedāvrajeta vā | ubhayatrāpyupasthānaṃ nāsti kauṣītakiśruteḥ" iti || upasthāya pravāsaṃ na karoti cettadā'pyāgatopasthitiḥ kāryaiva | tathā ca sa eva -- " pravatsyāmītyupasthāya vahniṃ na pravasedyadi | āgatopasthitiṃ cātrāpyāha kauṣītakī śrutiḥ" iti || pravāsanimittena pravatsyāmīti saṃkalpya pravāsaṃ yadi na karoti tadā'pyupasthānaṃ kāryameva | tadāha sa eva -- "upasthānaṃ hi saṃkalpya prākpravāsānnivartate | upasthātavyameveti prakramanyāyino viduḥ || āgatopasthitistatrāpīṣṭā kauṣītakiśruteḥ" iti | yadi rājādipuruṣā upasthānāyāvasaraṃ na dadyustadehaivetyupasthānaṃ kṛtvā gantavyam | tathā ca sa eva -- "balādrājādipuruṣā yajamānaṃ nayanti cet | na prayacchantyupasthānāvasaraṃ krūraceṣṭitāḥ || tadā kuryādupasthānaṃ taddeśagata eva san | ihaivetyādimantreṇa sarvāgnīnāṃ ca tantrataḥ" iti || gṛhye tu -- ihaiva santatra santaṃ tvetyayameva mantro grāhyaḥ | na tvihaiva santatra sato vo agnaya iti | agnerekatvāt | yadi tu yatra kutrāpi sthitasya pravāsa āpadyeta tadā'pyeṣa eva vidhiḥ | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "āgamiṣyāmi cādyaivetyanupasthāya nirgataḥ | daivāttatra sthitaḥ kuryādidameveti kecana" iti | yadi tu yatra kutrāpi sthitasya pravāsaprāptau vismṛtya vidhirna kṛtastatrāpyeṣa eva kāryo vidhiḥ | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "vismṛte'pi yadā yātastatrāpyeṣa vidhirbhavet" iti | buddhipūrvaṃ darpādanupasthāya nirgame sa evā''ha -- "buddhipūrvaṃ yadā darpādanupasthāya nirgataḥ | anājñātajapaṃ kṛtvā tatrāpyeṣa vidhirbhavet" iti || eṣo'nantaroktaḥ, ihaivetyupasthānarūpaḥ | atra manasvatīhomo'pi bharadvājasūtravyākhyātṛbhiruktaḥ -- "yadyupasthānamakṛtvā pravāsaṃ karoti tadā manasvatīṃ juhoti" iti | āgatopasthiterakaraṇe'pīdameva prāyaścittaṃ draṣṭavyam | ihetyupasthānapakṣe mā pragāmetyasya lopaḥ | vāgyamasya vikalpaścokto maṇḍanena -- "ihetyupasthānapakṣe mā pragāmeti lupyate | vāgyamasya na lopo'tra bhāṣyakāreṇa darśitaḥ || anye tvāhurmantralopo maunalopopalakṣaṇam | ihetipakṣe nāstyanyaditi nārāyaṇo'bravīt" iti || ihaivetyupasthāya gata ṛtunimittakamupasthānamabhayaṃkareṇaiva kāryamiti kecit | ihaivetyanenaivetyanye | āgatopasthitirnehaivetyanena | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "ihaiveti gatasyāpi nā''gatasya tadiṣyate" iti | atra pratyetyopasthānaṃ tvabhayaṃkareṇaiva | daśarātrādhikapravāse manasvatīhoma uktaḥ sūtre -- "manojyotirjuṣatāmityadhvaryurāhutiṃ juhoti yadi daśamīmatipravasati" iti | maṇḍano'pi -- "proṣya bhūyo daśarātrājjuhotītyāśvalāyanaḥ" iti | gṛhābhigamanādikaṃ manasvatīhomottarameva kāryam | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "hute manasvatīhome gṛhābhigamanādikam" iti | ayaṃ manasvatīhomaḥ prāduṣkṛtopasthānāntargate(ta i)ti nābhayaṃkaropasthāne nāpīhetyupasthāna iti bhāṣyakṛt | anye tu homārthamuddhṛte manasvatīmicchanti | sūtrakramo'pyetādṛśa eva | saṃvatsarātipravāse tu pavitreṣṭiḥ | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "saṃvatsaramatiproṣya pavitreṣṭyā yajediti | baudhāyanādayaḥ prāhurnecchantīṣṭimathāpare || iṣṭipakṣaṃ yatra kuryāttatra hutvā manasvatīm | punarvihṛtya kṛtveṣṭiṃ gṛhābhigamanādikam || iṣṭiparyāptakālaścettasminnahni na labhyate | tadaiva sarvaṃ kartavyamiṣṭimātraṃ pare'hani" iti || gṛhye tviṣṭisthāne caruḥ, ("ya āhitāgneḥ puroḍāśāste'nāhitāgneścaravaḥ" iti śāstrāt |) ṛtvatipravāse vrātabhṛtī kaiściduktā | atrāpi manasvatyāḥ samuccayaḥ | ṛtvatipravāse vrātabhṛtī | saṃvatsarātipravāse pavitreṣṭiḥ | taduktaṃ sūtrāntare -- "yadyṛtumatipravasedvrātabhṛtyā yajeta yadi saṃvatsaramatipravasetpavitreṣṭyā" iti | sūtrāntare tu -- "yadi saṃvatsaramatipravasetpavitreṣṭyā vaiśvānaryā vā yajeta" iti | pakṣe vaiśvānaryapyuktā | sarvatra manojyotiriti samuccīyata iti vyākhyātāraḥ | candrikāyāṃ paiṭhīnasiḥ -- "praskhalīkṛtadharmasya pīḍyamānasya śaktibhiḥ | māsadvayaṃ pravāso'sti parato nā''hitāgnivat" iti || māsadvayasyoparyanāhitāgnerāhitāgnivatpravāso nāstītyarthaḥ | atra homārthaṃ dvijaṃ prakalpya pravasedityuktaṃ kūrmapurāṇe -- "nikṣipyāgniṃ svadāreṣu parikalpyartvijaṃ tathā | pravasetkāryavānvipro vṛthaiva na ciraṃ vaset" iti || atra kāryavāniti dhanārthī na tu tīrthādyarthī | tathā ca maṇḍanaḥ -- "dhanamarjayituṃ yuktaḥ pravāso hyagnihotriṇaḥ | dhanairhi saṃbhavedijyā tīrthādyarthaṃ tu na vrajet" iti || tīrthādyakaraṇe kāraṇamāha sa eva -- "brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ sūryo gaurviprāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ | agnihotrigṛhe santi tīrthāni ca tapāṃsi ca" iti || madhye tīrthaprāptau snānaṃ kartavyameva, "dhanādyarthaṃ vrajanmārge yadi tīrthamavāpnuyāt | śālīno labhate snātuṃ na tadarthaṃ pṛthagvrajet" iti || prayāṇe madhye naukādhirohaṇaprāptau mṛtpūrṇaṃ śūrpaṃ nidhāya tatrāraṇī saṃnidhaṃ vā saṃsthāpya tapatīṃ vā'nvārabhyaiśvapāraṃ gacchetāmiti viśeṣaḥ | atha prayogaḥ | pravāsaṃ kariṣyannācamya pravāsaṃ kartumupasthānaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya, abhayaṃkarābhayaṃ me kuru svasti me'stu pravatsyāmīti bhasmacchannamevāgnimupasthāya 'mā pragāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñādindra sominaḥ | māṃ tasthurno arātayaḥ | udasmā uttarāṃ nayāgne ghṛtenā''huta | rāyaspoṣeṇa sa sṛja prajayā ca bahūnkṛdhi' [iti] tasmāddeśādgacchati | ita ārabhya vācaṃ yacchati yāvacchadīṃṣyadṛśyāni bhavanti, agnirvā bhavatyadṛśyastāvatparyantamanantaraṃ vācaṃ visṛjate | madhye vāgyamalope -- idaṃ viṣṇuriti vaiṣṇavyṛgja(vargja)paṃ samastavyāhṛtijapaṃ ca kṛtvā punarvācaṃ yacchati | gṛhaṃ pratyāgamane yadā chadīṃṣi dṛśyāni bhavanti, agnirvā bhaveddṛśyastāvatparyantaṃ vācaṃ yacchati | tato gṛhagato hastapādaprakṣālanaṃ kṛtvā''camya vācaṃ visṛjya, "abhayaṃkarā bhayaṃ me kārṣīḥ svasti me'stu prāvātsyam" iti bhasmacchannamevāgnimupatiṣṭhate | etacca pravāsasthenartāvṛtau kartavyam | atra tasmāddeśādgamanābhāve'pi kevalamupasthānamātraṃ kartavyaṃ vratakāle vratācaraṇaṃ ca | yadi tu yatra kutrāpi sthitasya pravāsa āpadyeta tadā tatraiva tiṣṭhansvāgnyabhimukha ihaiva santatra santaṃ tvetyasya viśve devā agnistriṣṭup | upasthāne viniyogaḥ | "oṃ ihaiva santatra santaṃ tvā'gne prā0 nareṇopatiṣṭhe" ityupasthāya gacchet | yadi rājādipuruṣā balānnayanti, upasthānāvasaraṃ na prayacchanti tadā taddeśagata evopasthānaṃ kuryāt | pravāsādāgataṃ upasthānānantaraṃ gṛhā mā bibhītetyādi kuryāt | tacca vāstuśamananirūpaṇānantaraṃ vakṣyate | upasthāya nirgatasya punastadahareva pratyāgamane bhavedevopasthānam | pravāsādāgatasya gṛhapraveśottaraṃ yadyāśaucajñānaṃ tadā'pyāgatopasthitirbhavatyeva | yathā''ha śrautagranthe maṇḍanaḥ -- "rajodoṣe samutpanne sūtake mṛtake'pi ca | nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kuryātkāmyaṃ karma na kiṃcana" iti || anenaivāgatikapravāsagamane'pi na doṣaḥ | yattu -- "rajodoṣe samutpanne sūtake mṛtake'pi vā | pravasannagnimānvipraḥ punarādhānamarhati" || iti tadagniyuktasya gamananiṣedhakam | anyathā'gnimatpadavaiyarthyāpatteḥ | yāni tu sūtakādau pravāsaniṣedhakāni tāni smārtaviṣayāṇīti prāyaścittakutūhale | kecittu -- ātmasamārūḍhāgnikasya gamananiṣedhakamityāhuḥ | vastutastu rajodoṣe samutpanna ityetadvacane'gnimānityanantaramapiśabdasyānvayaḥ kāryaḥ | tathā ca yathā'gniyuktasyā''tmasamārūḍhāgnikasya ca gamananiṣedhakaṃ tathā'gnivirahitasyāpīti | evaṃ ca śiṣṭācāro'pyanugṛhīto bhavati | āśauca āgatopasthānaṃ gṛhyāgnerna bhavatīti kecit | etasyāpi śrautatvādbhavatyevetyanye | araṇipakṣe'raṇyārūḍhasyāpyagnerbhasmacchannavahnivadabhayaṃkaramantreṇopasthānaṃ bhavati | evaṃ samidārūḍhasyāgnerbuddhyopasthānamakṛtvaiva nirgamane pratyāgamanānantaraṃ manasvatīhomaḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ ca | amatyā gamane'nājñātatrayajapaḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ ca | pratyāgamanopasthānākaraṇe'pīdameva prāyaścittam | daśarātrādhikapravāse manasvatī hotavyā | ṛtvadhikapravāse'gnaye vratabhṛte caruḥ | saṃvatsarātipravāse pavitreṣṭidevatābhyo juhuyāt | tatrāgnaye pavamānāya caruḥ sarasvatyai priyāyā ājyam | agnaye pāvakāya caruḥ | savitre satyaprasavāyā''jyam | agnaye śucaye caruḥ | vāyave niyutvata ājyam | agnaye vratapataye caruḥ | viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāyā''jyam | agnaye vaiśvānarāya caruḥ | dadhikrāvṇa ājyam | sthālīpākoktarītyā''ghāravattantreṇaiva yathākramaṃ homaḥ | athavā vaiśvānarasthālīpāka eva kāryaḥ | ubhayatrāpi manasvatyāḥ samuccayaḥ | yasyāṃ diśyagnirbhavati tadabhimukhaḥ sthitvā homasaṃbandhyupasthānaṃ kuryāt | patyau proṣite patnyaupāsanahomapārvaṇasthālīpākapiṇḍapitṛyajñanaimittikaprāyaścittānyṛtvigdvārā kāraṇīyāni | uddeśatyāgamātraṃ svakartṛkam | svayaṃ yadi rajovatī prasūtā vā tadā tyāga ṛtvijaiva kāraṇīyaḥ | āgrayaṇaṃ tu -- agnihotrīṃ vai nānā''dayitvā tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa juhuyādityanukalpenaiva | punaḥsaṃdhānagṛhadāhādinimittakasthālīpākāstu patyāgamanaparyantaṃ na kāryaḥ(ryāḥ)| prāyaścittārthasthālīpākaprāptau pūrṇāhutiḥ | pravāsasya nimittaṃ tu dhanaṃ vidyā ca, na tu tīrthādikam | patyurdhanārjanārthaṃ pravāsaṃ kartumaśaktau patnyā'pi pravāsopasthānamakṛtvaiva tadarthaṃ pravāsaḥ kartavya eva | homasaṃbandhyupasthānaṃ tu tayā na kāryam | vratācaraṇaṃ tu bhavatyeva | sarvo'pi pravāsavidhirgārhye kṛtākṛtaḥ | tatra karaṇe tvabhyudayaḥ | akaraṇe pratyavāyābhāva iti jñeyam | karaṇapakṣe sarvathā kartavya eva | iti pravāsavidhiḥ | athāntaritasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | kartā pāthikṛtena sthālīpākena sahāmukasthālīpākena yakṣya iti saṃkalpyāgniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā pathikṛtsahitāṃntaritāmukasthālīpākakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā devatāstāḥ sarvāḥ parigrahīṣyāmi, agniṃ pathikṛtaṃ carvāhutyā yakṣye, āgniṃ carvāhutyā yakṣye, agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutaśeṣacarvāhutyā yakṣye, etā devatāḥ sadyo yakṣya ityuktvā'nvādhānasamidho'gnāvabhyādhāyāgniṃ paristīrya, agneruttarato darbhānsaṃstīrya teṣu darvīmājyasthālīṃ prokṣaṇīpātramupaveṣaṃ carusthālīdvayaṃ mekṣaṇadvayaṃ śūrpaṃ kṛṣṇājinamulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ saṃmārgadarbhānavajvalanadarbhānājyaṃ samidhaṃ cā''sādayet | asaṃbhavena samopyaitaṃ vyuddhāraṃ juhuyādityāśvalāyanoktapakṣāntarāṅgīkāre tvekaiva carusthālī, ekameva mekṣaṇamuddharaṇapātradvayamekaṃ veti viśeṣaḥ | tataḥ pavitrakaraṇādi carūdvāsanāntaṃ samānam | vyuddhṛtya juhuyādityetasminpakṣe -- ayamagnaye pathikṛte'yamagnaya iti nirdeśaḥ | tato'gniṃ pariṣicyā''sāditāṃ samidhaṃ tūṣṇīmabhyādhāyā''sāditena prathamacarumekṣaṇena prathamacarorupahatya, 'oṃ agnaye pathikṛte svāhā' iti juhoti | agnaye pathikṛta idaṃ0 | tato dvitīyacarumekṣaṇena dvitīyacarorupahṛtya, 'oṃ agnaye svāhā' iti juhoti | agnaya idaṃ0 | tato dvayoścarvoruttarārdhātsakṛtsakṛttattanmekṣaṇena darvyāṃ gṛhītvā, 'oṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' itīśānyāṃ pūrvāhutibhyāmasaṃsaktāṃ juhoti | agnaye sviṣṭakṛta idaṃ0 | ekatra śrapaṇapakṣa ekamekṣaṇasyaiva sattvāttenaiva dvayoścarvoḥ kauśalyenopahratya homaḥ kāryaḥ | bahudaivate karmaṇyasaṃbhavāddarvyāṃ mekṣaṇena gṛhītvā tayā homaḥ kāryaḥ | tato mekṣaṇamaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā'kṛtvā vā paristaraṇavisargavyāhṛtihomottarapariṣekāgnipūjanasaṃsthājapopasthānabrāhmaṇabhojanabhūyasīdānaviṣṇusmaraṇeśvarārpaṇāni kuryāt | athavā kevalaṃ pāthikṛta eva kartavyaḥ | na tvatikrāntakālaḥ prākṛto'pi | yadyayaṃ sthālīpāka uttaraparvaṇyapi na kṛtastadā pratipadādiṣu pādakṛcchrātmakaprāyaścittapūrvakaṃ vaiśvānarasthālīpākaṃ kevalaṃ vā prākṛtena sthālīpākena samānatantraṃ vā kṛtvā'nantarameva pāthikṛtaḥ sthālīpāko'ntaritadvitīyasthālīpākena samānatantraḥ kevalo vā kartavyaḥ | athavā vaiśvānarapāthikṛtāvevāsamānatantrau kartavyau | yadvi dvitīyo'pyuttaraparvaṇi na kṛtastadā pratipadādiṣvardhakṛcchraṃ caritvā vaiśvānarapāthikṛtau prākṛtābhyāṃ sthālīpākābhyāṃ samānatantrau kevalau vā kṛtvaitāveva sthālīpākau tṛtīyena sthālīpākena samānatantrau kevalau vā kuryāt | yadi tṛtīyo'pyuttaraparvaṇi na kṛtastadā punaḥsaṃdhānameva | uttarasthālīpākaparyantaṃ pūrvasya gauṇakālaḥ | etadatikrama eva pāthikṛtādi prāyaścittaṃ na mukhyakālātikrame | ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ | mukhyakālātikrame'pīdaṃ prāyaścittamiti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ | āśaucādimattvena bhāryāyā rajasvalātvena vā'pyantaritasthālīpāko dvitīyācaturthīpañcamyaṣṭamīnavamīcaturdaśīṣu na kartavyaḥ | uktaṃ caitatprayogapārijāta āśvalāyanena -- "nātīteṣṭiścaturdaśyāṃ caturthyāṃ madhyapañcake | navamyāṃ ca dvitīyāyāṃ kāryā āhutayastathā" iti || madhyapañcake, madhye pakṣamadhye'ṣṭamyāmityarthaḥ | pañcake pañcamadivase pañcamyāmityarthaḥ | na ca madhyaṃ ca tatpañcakaṃ ca madhyapañcakaṃ tatra, tathā ca ṣaṣṭhyādidaśamyantānāṃ niṣedha iti vācyam | tathā sati navamyupādānavaiyarthyāpatteriti kecit | navamyupādānasya doṣātiśayapratipādanārthatvena sārthakyasaṃbhavānna ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyaṣṭamīdaśamyanyatamatithiṣvapyasaṃbhave kriyāyāṃ na doṣaḥ | navamyāṃ tu sarvathaivākriyetyanye | āhutayaḥ sthālīpākāhutaya ityarthaḥ | sāyaṇīye prajāpatiḥ -- "darśaśca pūrṇamāsaśca lupto'tha dvayameva vā | ekasya pādakṛcchraṃ syāddvayorardhaṃ prakīrtitam" iti || ityantaritasthālīpākaprayogaḥ | atha gṛhasthasya gṛhakaraṇamarthaprāptaṃ taducyate | tatredaṃ gṛhyasūtram -- "śālāṃ kārayiṣyannudagayana āpūryamāṇapakṣe rohiṇyāṃ triṣu cottareṣu" ityādi | atra māsaniyamo nāradenoktaḥ -- "saumyaphālgunavaiśākhamāghaśrāvaṇakārtikāḥ | māsāḥ syurgṛhanirmāṇe putrārogyadhanapradāḥ" iti | saumyo mārgaśīrṣaḥ | vārādikamapyuktaṃ tatraiva -- "ādityabhaumavarjaṃ tu vārāḥ sarve śubhāvahāḥ | candrādityabalaṃ labdhvā lagne śubhanirīkṣite || stambhocchrāyādi kartavyamanyattu parivarjayet" iti | nakṣatrāṇi gargeṇoktāni -- "tryuttarāmṛgarohiṇyaḥ puṣyamaitrakaratrayam | dhaniṣṭhādvitayaṃ pauṣṇaṃ gṛhārambhe praśasyate" iti || karatrayaṃ hastacitrāsvātayaḥ | dhaniṣṭhādvitayaṃ dhaniṣṭhāśatatārakānakṣatre | pauṣṇaṃ revatī | vistarastu śāntiratnamālāyāṃ draṣṭavyaḥ | atha prayogaḥ | kartodagayane śuklapakṣe rohiṇyuttarā(ra)phalgunyuttarāṣāḍhottarā(ra)proṣṭhapadānyatame nakṣatre'saṃbhave'nyasminnapi jyotiḥśāstravihite nakṣatre jyotirvidādiṣṭe muhūrte kṛtanityakriya ācamya prāṇānāyamya deśakālau saṃkīrtya śālāṃ kārayiṣyanhomaṃ kariṣya iti saṃkalpya gaṇeśapūjanādināndīśrāddhāntaṃ kuryāt | atra śālākaraṇakarmaṇaḥ puṇyāhaṃ bhavanto bruvantvityādivākyeṣu vāstoṣpatiḥ prīyatāmiti puṇyāhadevatollekhavākye ca viśeṣaḥ | tata aupāsanāgniṃ prajvālya dhyātvā samittrayamādāya śraddha ehītyādiprāṇāyāmāntaṃ kṛtvā śālākaraṇāṅgabhūtahomakarmaṇi yā yakṣyamāṇā ityādivyāhṛtyantamuktvā'ṅgahome varuṇaṃ dvābhyāmityādi vyāhṛtihomāntaṃ kṛtvā'ṅgahomajayādyupahomādisaṃsthājapāntaṃ kṛtvā trivṛdannahomapuṇyāhādivācane kuryāt | tatra śālākaraṇahomakarmaṇītyanvādhānavākye viśeṣaḥ | atrāpi vāstoṣpatiḥ prīyatāmityeva | nāstyatra vaiśeṣikahomaḥ | jayādayaste ca(stvatra) vaikalpikāḥ | tato'hataṃ vāsaḥ paridhāya dvirācamya devasya tvetyasya somo'gnirvā viśve devā vā savitābhriryajuḥ | abhryādāne viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ devasya tvā savi0 mādade'bhrirasi nārirasi' ityabhrimādāya, parilikhitamityasya somo'vaṭo yajuḥ | parilekhane viniyogaḥ | 'oṃ parilikhita ra0 api kṛntāmi' [iti] triḥ pradakṣiṇamavaṭaṃ parilikhati sakṛnmantreṇa dvistūṣṇīm | evaṃ pratyavaṭaṃ yāvadbhiravaṭaiḥ prayojanaṃ tāvataḥ khātvā vaṭasaṃbandhipāṃsūñśālāyā abhyantaraṃ prakirati | ucchrayaṇakramo'vaṭānāṃ kramaḥ | 'oṃ ihaiva dhruvāṃ niminomi śālāṃ kṣeme tiṣṭhati ghṛtamukṣamāṇā | tāṃ tvā śāle suvīrāḥ sarvavīrā ariṣṭavīrā anusaṃcarema |' iti dvārasthūṇayordakṣiṇāṃ sthūṇāmucchrayati | ucchri[tāṃ kṛ]tvā'vaṭe sthāpayatītyarthaḥ | kṛtvā'grato dvijavarānatha pūrṇakumbhaṃ dadhyakṣatāmradalapuṣpaphalopaśobham | dattvā hiraṇyavasanāni tathā dvijebhyo māṅgalyaśāntinilayaṃ svagṛhaṃ viśecca" iti || tathā -- "vāstupūjāmakṛtvā yaḥ praviśennavamandiram | rogānnānāvidhānkleśānaśnute sarvasaṃkaṭān" iti || atha prayogaḥ | "gṛhā mā bibhīta mā vepīḍhvamūrjaṃ bibhrata emasi | ūrjaṃ bibhradvasuvaniḥ sumedhā gṛhānemi manasā modamānaḥ || yeṣāmabhyeti pravasanneti saumanaso babhuḥ | gṛhānupahvayāmahe te no jānantu jānataḥ || upahūtā iha gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ | atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ || upahūtā bhūrisakhāḥ sakhāyaḥ svānusaṃmudaḥ | ariṣṭāḥ sarvapūruṣā gṛhā naḥ santu sarvadā || ūrjasvantaḥ payasvanta irāvanto ha sāmudaḥ | anaśyā atṛṣyā gṛhā mā'smadbibhītana" || iti dhṛtapūrṇakumbhasuvāsinīpuraḥsaraḥ seṣṭadevataḥ sakuṭumbo gṛhasamīpaṃ gacchati "oṃ kṣemāya vaḥ śāntyai prapadye śiva śagma śaṃyoḥ śaṃyoḥ"| iti jyotirvidādiṣṭe muhūrte gṛhaṃ praviśati | praveśānantaramasmindine kalahaṃ naiva karoti | "oṃ gṛhānaha sumanasaḥ prapadye'vīraghno vīravataḥ suśevān | irāṃ vahantaḥ sumanasyamānāsteṣvaha sumanāḥ saṃviśāmi" || iti gṛhamadhya upaviśati | "oṃ viśvā uta tvayā vayaṃ dhārā udanyā iva | atigāhemahi dviṣaḥ" [iti] bhāryāṃ samīkṣate | bhāryādvitve tvayetyatra yuvābhyāmityūhaḥ | bhāryābahutve yuṣmābhiriti | naitadaharāgata ityatrā''gata iti vacanaṃ grāmāntarādāgatasyānāhitāgnerapyetatpraveśanavidhānamitikhyāpanārtham | tasmānnūtanagṛhapraveśane grāmāntarādāgamane cedaṃ vidhānam | kecinnūtanagṛhapraveśa evecchanti | tanna | gṛhānīkṣetāpyanāhitāgnirityāśvalāyanasūtre'nāhitāgnerapi grāmāntarādāgatasya praveśanadarśa nāt | anye tu grāmāntarādāgamana evecchanti | tadapi na | uktaṃ gṛhaprapadanamityāśvalāyanasūtravirodhāt, tasmādubhayārthataiva yukteti jñeyam | sajjīkṛtagṛhapraveśe'pīdaṃ vidhānam | ekasyāḥ śālāyā dvayorvā sajjīkaraṇe tu -- uktavidhānena tameva deśaṃ śamayitvā praveśaḥ kartavyaḥ | tato gaṇapatipūjanaṃ puṇyāhavācanaṃ ca kāryam | anyadapi kulācāraprāptaṃ cetadapi kartavyam | iti saṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ vāstukaraṇavāstuśamanavāstupraveśaprayogaḥ | ityokopāhvaśrīmatsāgnicidvājapeyapauṇḍarīkayājisarvatomukhayājigaṇeśadīkṣitatanūjabhaṭṭagopīnāthadīkṣitaviracitāyāṃ satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśismārtasaṃskāraratnamālāyāṃ saptadaśaṃ prakaraṇam || 17 || samāpto'yaṃ gṛhyasūtraprathamapraśnaḥ || 1 || | samāptimagamadidamatra saṃskāraratnamālāyāḥ pūrvārdham |
